jobs.title: System Development Troubleshooter

titleByLocale.it: Risoluzione dei problemi di sviluppo del sistema

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Roche Diagnostics International Ltd in Rotkreuz is one of the world’s leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for clinics, laboratories, and doctors’ offices. The company employs over 2200 people in Rotkreuz and is one of Roche Diagnostics main sites.

Roche is an equal opportunity employer and strictly prohibits unlawful discrimination based upon an individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, mental/physical disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

( Please note that this vacancy is currently not linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.)

The Position

In a global and cross-functional environment, the System Development department is responsible for workflow optimization and the successful integration of hardware, software, consumables and reagents to finally perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments.

As a System Integration Troubleshooter, you will work as a part of a cross-functional team on the development or product care of complex diagnostics systems consisting of fluidcs, robotics software, thermal, electrical, mechanical and biochemistry elements.

As System Integration Troubleshooter, your main responsibilities will consist of (but will not be limited to):

• Conducting root-cause investigations of systemic issues found during development or escalated from field or Operations in all lifecycle phases (from early feasibility to product care), and collaborate with other functions do develop solutions for complex issues

• Building up subject matter expertise and providing support to the RMD Development Teams (Assay-, Software- and Instrument-Development), Global Customer Support (GCS), Case Investigation and Resolution (CIR) and Operations. This requires close cross-department interaction to gather all information needed to ensure high-quality support.

• Responsible for internal repair visits, retrofitting of mechanical parts, configuration management monitoring and tracking and installing or updating of the Instrument Software.

• Independent Planning of assigned Workpackages and continuously monitoring and tracking of the working progress.

• Conduct integration development activities on system component level, thereby closely interact with project teams, and participating and coordinating with other internal groups and departments.

• Performing statistical data analysis to support root-cause investigation & problem solving, risk assessment, product development and process improvement.

Who you are

You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

To be successful in this role (you provide):

• Degree in Biomedical or Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

• Ability to work independently, handling cross-departmental development tasks

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English and German

• Strong analytical and interdisciplinary thinking

• Experience in statistical data analysis

Who we are
At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche Diagnostics International in Rotkreuz is a leading provider of diagnostic systems solutions, and the largest manufacturer of fully automated in vitro diagnostic systems in Switzerland. We are more than 2’700 passionate colleagues from over 65 nationalities. Find out more abo

descriptionByLocale.it:
Chi siamo Roche Diagnostics International Ltd a Rotkreuz è uno dei principali fornitori di soluzioni di sistema diagnostico al mondo per cliniche, laboratori e uffici medici. L'azienda impiega oltre 2200 persone a Rotkreuz ed è uno dei principali siti di Roche Diagnostics. Roche è un datore di lavoro di pari opportunità e vieta rigorosamente discriminazioni illecite basate su razza, colore, religione, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere / espressione, origine / ansia nazionale, disabilità mentale / fisica, condizione medica, stato civile, stato veterano, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. (Si prega di notare che questo posto vacante non è attualmente collegato ad una posizione aperta. Stiamo anticipando i bisogni futuri nella nostra organizzazione. Se siete interessati a questo tipo di ruolo, si prega di applicare oggi e possiamo contattare si dovrebbe una posizione corrispondente al tuo profilo diventare disponibile.) La posizione In un ambiente globale e interfunzionale, il dipartimento System Development è responsabile dell'ottimizzazione del flusso di lavoro e dell'integrazione riuscita di hardware, software, materiali di consumo e reagenti per eseguire infine la verifica del sistema degli strumenti diagnostici. Come System Integration Troubleshooter, lavorerai come parte di un team interfunzionale per lo sviluppo o la cura dei prodotti di sistemi diagnostici complessi costituiti da fluidi, software robotico, elementi termici, elettrici, meccanici e biochimica. Poiché System Integration Troubleshooter, le tue responsabilità principali saranno costituite da (ma non saranno limitate a):
• Condurre indagini a causa delle radici di problemi sistemici trovati durante lo sviluppo o escalati dal campo o Operazioni in tutte le fasi del ciclo di vita (dalla fattibilità precoce alla cura del prodotto), e collaborare con altre funzioni sviluppano soluzioni per problemi complessi
• Costruire competenze di materia soggetto e fornire supporto ai team di sviluppo RMD (Assay-, Software- e sviluppo strumenti), Global Customer Support (GCS), Case Investigation and Resolution (CIR) e Operazioni. Ciò richiede una stretta interazione tra di loro per raccogliere tutte le informazioni necessarie per garantire un supporto di alta qualità.
• Responsabile per le visite di riparazione interne, retrofitting di parti meccaniche, monitoraggio della gestione della configurazione e monitoraggio e installazione o aggiornamento del Software Strumento.
• Pianificazione indipendente dei pacchetti di lavoro assegnati e monitoraggio continuo e monitoraggio dei progressi di lavoro.
• Condurre le attività di sviluppo di integrazione a livello di componenti di sistema, interagire con i team di progetto e partecipare e coordinare con altri gruppi e dipartimenti interni.
• Eseguire l'analisi statistica dei dati per sostenere le indagini di root-cause & problem solving, la valutazione del rischio, lo sviluppo del prodotto e il miglioramento del processo. Chi sei Sei qualcuno che vuole influenzare il tuo sviluppo. Stai cercando una società in cui hai la possibilità di perseguire i tuoi interessi attraverso funzioni e geografie. Dove un titolo di lavoro non è considerato la definizione finale di chi sei, ma il punto di partenza. Per avere successo in questo ruolo (fornisci):
• Laurea in ingegneria biomedica o meccanica o equivalente
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, gestire compiti di sviluppo trasversale
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e fluidità in inglese e tedesco
• Forte pensiero analitico e interdisciplinare
• Esperienza nell'analisi statistica dei dati Chi siamo A Roche, più di 100.000 persone in 100 paesi stanno spingendo indietro le frontiere della salute. Lavorando insieme, siamo diventati uno dei principali gruppi sanitari focalizzati sulla ricerca al mondo. Il nostro successo si basa sull'innovazione, la curiosità e la diversità. Roche Diagnostics International di Rotkreuz è un fornitore leader di soluzioni di sistemi diagnostici, e il più grande produttore di sistemi diagnostici in vitro completamente automatizzati in Svizzera. Siamo più di 2’700 colleghi appassionati di oltre 65 nazionalità. Scopri di più abo

Wer wir sind Roche Diagnostics International Ltd in Rotkreuz ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Diagnosesystemlösungen für Kliniken, Labore und Arztpraxen. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt über 2200 Mitarbeiter in Rotkreuz und ist einer der Hauptstandorte von Roche Diagnostics. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit und verbietet eine rechtswidrige Diskriminierung aufgrund der Rasse, der Hautfarbe, der Religion, des Geschlechts, der sexuellen Orientierung, der Geschlechtsidentität/-ausdruck, der nationalen Herkunft/Abstammung, der geistigen/körperlichen Behinderung, des Gesundheitszustands, des Familienstands, des Veteranenstatus oder anderer gesetzlich geschützter Merkmale. (Bitte beachten Sie, dass diese Vakanz derzeit nicht mit einer offenen Position verbunden ist.) Wir antizipieren zukünftige Bedürfnisse in unserer Organisation. Wenn sie an dieser art von rolle interessiert sind, bewerben sie sich bitte noch heute und wir können sie kontaktieren, wenn eine position, die ihrem profil entspricht, verfügbar wird. Die Position In einem globalen und funktionsübergreifenden Umfeld ist die Abteilung Systementwicklung für die Workflow-Optimierung und die erfolgreiche Integration von Hardware, Software, Verbrauchsmaterialien und Reagenzien verantwortlich, um schließlich die Systemüberprüfung von Diagnoseinstrumenten durchzuführen. Als System Integration Troubleshooter arbeiten Sie als Teil eines funktionsübergreifenden Teams an der Entwicklung oder Produktpflege komplexer Diagnosesysteme bestehend aus Fluidcs, Robotik-Software, thermischen, elektrischen, mechanischen und biochemischen Elementen. Als System Integration Troubleshooter bestehen Ihre Hauptaufgaben aus (aber nicht beschränkt auf):
• Durchführung von Ursachenuntersuchungen von systemischen Problemen, die während der Entwicklung gefunden wurden oder in allen Lebenszyklusphasen (von der frühen Machbarkeit bis zur Produktpflege) aus dem Feld oder aus dem Betrieb eskaliert sind, und Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Funktionen entwickeln Lösungen für komplexe Probleme
• Aufbau von Fachkompetenz und Unterstützung der RMD Development Teams (Assay-, Software- und Instrumentenentwicklung), Global Customer Support (GCS), Case Investigation and Resolution (CIR) und Operations. Dies erfordert eine enge abteilungsübergreifende Interaktion, um alle Informationen zu sammeln, die für eine qualitativ hochwertige Unterstützung erforderlich sind.
• Verantwortlich für interne Reparaturbesuche, Nachrüstung mechanischer Teile, Überwachung und Nachverfolgung des Konfigurationsmanagements und Installation oder Aktualisierung der Instrumentensoftware.
• Unabhängige Planung zugewiesener Arbeitspakete und kontinuierliches Monitoring und Tracking des Arbeitsfortschritts.
• Führen Sie Integrationsentwicklungsaktivitäten auf Systemkomponentenebene durch, interagieren Sie dabei eng mit Projektteams und nehmen Sie teil und koordinieren Sie sich mit anderen internen Gruppen und Abteilungen.
• Durchführung statistischer Datenanalysen zur Unterstützung der Ursachenuntersuchung und Problemlösung, Risikobewertung, Produktentwicklung und Prozessverbesserung. Wer du bist Du bist jemand, der deine eigene Entwicklung beeinflussen will. Sie suchen ein Unternehmen, in dem Sie die Möglichkeit haben, Ihre Interessen über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg zu verfolgen. Wo eine Berufsbezeichnung nicht als die endgültige Definition dessen gilt, wer Sie sind, sondern als Ausgangspunkt. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein (Sie bieten):
• Abschluss in Biomedizin oder Maschinenbau oder gleichwertig
• Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und abteilungsübergreifende Entwicklungsaufgaben zu bewältigen
• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und fließend in Englisch und Deutsch
• Starkes analytisches und interdisziplinäres Denken
• Erfahrung in der statistischen Datenanalyse Wer wir sind Bei Roche drängen mehr als 100.000 Menschen in 100 Ländern die Grenzen des Gesundheitswesens zurück. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Qui nous sommes Roche Diagnostics International Ltd à Rotkreuz est l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux de solutions de systèmes de diagnostic pour les cliniques, laboratoires et cabinets de médecins. L'entreprise emploie plus de 2200 personnes à Rotkreuz et est l'un des sites principaux de Roche Diagnostics. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances et interdit strictement toute discrimination illégale fondée sur la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l'orientation sexuelle, l'identité/expression de genre, l'origine/l'activité nationale, l'incapacité mentale/physique, l'état de santé, l'état matrimonial, le statut d'ancien combattant ou toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi. ( Veuillez noter que cette vacance n'est actuellement pas liée à un poste ouvert. Nous anticipons les besoins futurs de notre organisation. Si vous êtes intéressé par ce type de rôle, s'il vous plaît postuler aujourd'hui et nous pouvons vous contacter si un poste correspondant à votre profil devient disponible.) La position Dans un environnement global et interfonctionnel, le département Développement du Système est responsable de l'optimisation des flux de travail et de l'intégration réussie du matériel, des logiciels, des consommables et des réactifs pour effectuer enfin la vérification du système des instruments de diagnostic. En tant que dépanneur d'intégration de systèmes, vous travaillerez dans le cadre d'une équipe interfonctionnelle sur le développement ou le soin du produit de systèmes de diagnostic complexes composés de fluides, de logiciels robotiques, d'éléments thermiques, électriques, mécaniques et biochimiques. En tant que dépanneur d'intégration du système, vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :
• La réalisation d'enquêtes sur les causes profondes des problèmes systémiques constatés au cours du développement ou de l'intensification des opérations sur le terrain pendant toutes les phases du cycle de vie (de la faisabilité précoce aux soins des produits) et la collaboration avec d'autres fonctions permettent de trouver des solutions à des problèmes complexes
• Renforcer l'expertise en la matière et fournir un soutien aux équipes de développement RMD (Assay-, Software- and Instrument-Development), Global Customer Support (GCS), Case Investigation and Resolution (CIR) et Operations. Pour ce faire, il faut une interaction étroite entre les ministères afin de recueillir toutes les informations nécessaires pour assurer un soutien de qualité.
• Responsable des visites internes de réparation, de la modernisation des pièces mécaniques, du suivi de la gestion de la configuration et du suivi, de l'installation ou de la mise à jour du logiciel Instrument.
• Planification indépendante des lots de travail assignés et suivi et suivi continu des progrès de travail.
• Mener des activités de développement de l'intégration au niveau des composantes du système, en interaction étroite avec les équipes de projet, et participer et coordonner avec d'autres groupes et départements internes.
• Effectuer une analyse des données statistiques pour appuyer les enquêtes et la résolution de problèmes, l'évaluation des risques, le développement de produits et l'amélioration des processus. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes quelqu'un qui veut influencer votre propre développement. Vous êtes à la recherche d'une entreprise où vous avez la possibilité de poursuivre vos intérêts à travers des fonctions et des géographies. Lorsqu'un titre d'emploi n'est pas considéré comme la définition finale de qui vous êtes, mais comme le point de départ. Pour réussir dans ce rôle (vous fournissez) :
• Diplôme en génie biomédical ou mécanique ou équivalent
• Aptitude à travailler de façon indépendante, à gérer les tâches de développement interministérielle
• Excellentes compétences en communication et maîtrise en anglais et en allemand
• Forte réflexion analytique et interdisciplinaire
• Expérience en matière d ' analyse des données statistiques Qui nous sommes À Roche, plus de 100 000 personnes dans 100 pays repoussent les frontières des soins de santé. Ensemble, nous sommes devenus l'un des principaux groupes de santé axés sur la recherche. Notre succès repose sur l'innovation, la curiosité et la diversité. Roche Diagnostics International à Rotkreuz est un fournisseur leader de solutions de systèmes de diagnostic, et le plus grand fabricant de systèmes de diagnostic in vitro entièrement automatisés en Suisse. Nous sommes plus de 2.700 collègues passionnés de plus de 65 nationalités. En savoir plus

jobs.title: Praktikum für Pharmaziestudenten (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
The Position
Dein Team

Als Pharmazeut/in im Praktikum hast Du im Rahmen des 6-monatigen Praktikantenprogramms für angehende Apotheker die Möglichkeit, einen spannenden Einblick in die pharmazeutische Industrie zu erhalten. Hierbei lernst Du die Arbeit eines Apothekers in der pharmazeutischen Industrie umfassend kennen.Mögliche Einsatzgebiete sindz. B. die Zulassung, Produktion, Qualitätssicherung oder Qualitätskontrolle von Arzneimitteln und Medizinprodukten Außerdem wird Dir während des gesamten Praktikums ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner zur Seite stehen.

Deine Aufgaben

• Je nach Bereich unterstützt Du bei der Herstellung, Kontrolle und Qualitätssicherung der vom Betrieb hergestellten Produkte (Arzneimittel / Medizinprodukte) oder deren Einsatzstoffe

• Du koordinierst und erstellst die Dokumentation, zb Arbeitsanweisungen

• Außerdem kümmerst Du dich um die Bearbeitung von Projekten lokal und global

• Zudem unterstützt Du durch Deine Mitarbeit verschiedenen Recherchen zB für Abweichungen oder Reklamationen

• Du lernst dabei typische Aufgabengebiete eines Apothekers (gemäß AMG und AMWHV) kennen

Dein Profil

• Du hast den zweiten Abschnitt der Pharmazeutischen Prüfung (zweites Staatsexamen) erfolgreich abgelegt und kannst gute Studienleistungen vorweisen

• Entsprechend der Approbationsordnung für Apotheker möchtest Du nun die Hälfte deines praktischen Jahrs dazu nutzen, die pharmazeutische Industrie näher kennenzulernen

• Idealerweise hast Du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen in der Industrie gesammelt

• Durch Deine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise begeisterst Du ebenso wie durch Dein analytisches Denken

• Du hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, freust Dich auf die Arbeit im Team und bringst Engagement und Eigeninitiative mit

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten (37,5 Stundenwoche)

• 1958€ Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiter-Kantine

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Vernetzung mit anderen Praktikanten

Zeitraum: 6 Monate, Startmöglichkeiten: jährlich zum 01. Mai und 01. November.
Generisch suchen wir Pharmazeuten für Standort: Grenzach, Ludwigsburg, Mannheim, Penzberg (Du kannst Deine Standort-Präferenz bei der Bewerbung eingeben.)

Für eine vollständige Bewerbung bitten wir Dich, einen aktuellen Lebenslauf, ein für die Stelle passendes Anschreiben und relevante Zeugnisse hinzuzufügen. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

germany.talent_acquisition@roche.com

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche Pharma AG at Grenzach-Wyhlen is steering central elements of the technical quality control for the whole European region. Numerous opportunities for personal development, flexible work hours, attractive compensation packages and special family assistance programs are available.

The Position
Dein Team

Als Pharmazeut/in im Praktikum hast Du im Rahmen des 6-monatigen Praktikantenprogramms für angehende Apotheker die Möglichkeit, einen spannenden Einblick in die pharmazeutische Industrie zu erhalten. Hierbei lernst Du die Arbeit eines Apothekers in der pharmazeutischen Industrie umfassend kennen.Mögliche Einsatzgebiete sindz. B. die Zulassung, Produktion, Qualitätssicherung oder Qualitätskontrolle von Arzneimitteln und Medizinprodukten Außerdem wird Dir während des gesamten Praktikums ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner zur Seite stehen.

Deine Aufgaben

• Je nach Bereich unterstützt Du bei der Herstellung, Kontrolle und Qualitätssicherung der vom Betrieb hergestellten Produkte (Arzneimittel / Medizinprodukte) oder deren Einsatzstoffe

• Du koordinierst und erstellst die Dokumentation, zb Arbeitsanweisungen

• Außerdem kümmerst Du dich um die Bearbeitung von Projekten lokal und global

• Zudem unterstützt Du durch Deine Mitarbeit verschiedenen Recherchen zB für Abweichungen oder Reklamationen

• Du lernst dabei typische Aufgabengebiete eines Apothekers (gemäß AMG und AMWHV) kennen

Dein Profil

• Du hast den zweiten Abschnitt der Pharmazeutischen Prüfung (zweites Staatsexamen) erfolgreich abgelegt und kannst gute Studienleistungen vorweisen

• Entsprechend der Approbationsordnung für Apotheker möchtest Du nun die Hälfte deines praktischen Jahrs dazu nutzen, die pharmazeutische Industrie näher kennenzulernen

• Idealerweise hast Du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen in der Industrie gesammelt

• Durch Deine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise begeisterst Du ebenso wie durch Dein analytisches Denken

• Du hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, freust Dich auf die Arbeit im Team und bringst Engagement und Eigeninitiative mit

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten (37,5 Stundenwoche)

• 1958€ Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiter-Kantine

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Vernetzung mit anderen Praktikanten

Zeitraum: 6 Monate, Startmöglichkeiten: jährlich zum 01. Mai und 01. November.
Generisch suchen wir Pharmazeuten für Standort: Grenzach, Ludwigsburg, Mannheim, Penzberg (Du kannst Deine Standort-Präferenz bei der Bewerbung eingeben.)

Für eine vollständige Bewerbung bitten wir Dich, einen aktuellen Lebenslauf, ein für die Stelle passendes Anschreiben und relevante Zeugnisse hinzuzufügen. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

Do you need more support?
Our Talent Acquisition Team welcomes your questions. Please send an email to
germany.talent_acquisition@roche.com

Who we are
At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche Pharma AG at Grenzach-Wyhlen is steering central elements of the technical quality control for the whole European region. For the German market clinical research, marketing and all sales activities are located there. From your beginning with Roche, our motivated team will welcome and support you. Numerous opportunities for personal development, flexible work hours, attractive compensation packages and special family assistance programs are available.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

Roche is a global healthcare company - founded 125 years ago in Basel, Switzerland, offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. We are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (1 office day/week on average) and provide fully remote working conditions (even after the pandemic situation).

What we do:
The Audit and Compliance department provides services for the affiliates in the EMEA region . Our main areas covered are: Financial Compliance, SAP Authorization, Travel and Expense Compliance.

Your day to day responsibilities are:

As a T&E Compliance Analyst you will be responsible for working with the finance, audit, compliance and other departments of selected Roche affiliates.
As a qualified expert , you:

• Verify T&E expense claims from VAT point of view

• Handle integration between Concur and SAP

• Support the preparation of reports and training material where required on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process

• Work collaboratively with the team to identify opportunities to improve compliance documentations (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc.)

• Take responsibility for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Participate in compliance programs, projects and other ad-hoc tasks assigned by supervisor/HOD.

• Clearly document all compliance assessment (i.e. assessment results) activities in concur during claim processing

What can you bring to our team:
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• At least 1 year of experience in a relevant position in the field of Finance/Accounting

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business related field

• Appreciative mindset and customer focus

• Good administrative & communication skills

• High commitment to maintain / improve service levels

• Open mindset and focus on identifying potential improvement areas

• Interest to gain experiences in SAP / Financial Compliance

• Proficiency in English and any European language

Desirable:

• Knowledge of finance and accounting principles

• Experience in SAP / Concur system

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: free language courses, a wide range of training & learning opportunities, long-term career opportunities, lateral and vertical career moves, exciting projects & assignments, etc.

• Excellent benefits and flexibility : competitive salary and cafeteria package, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move sport pass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, Themed Holiday party, people-focused company culture, annual bonus in March, etc.

• Great opportunity in a truly international work environment with high-profile colleagues and excellent in-house learning and networking opportunities, plus an opportunity to make your mark at Roche. We will make sure your daily work will make an impact and you will be able to learn a lot along the way.

*Please note, that this is a requisition for Talent Pool building purposes, which means it may not necessarily reflect a current opening with ongoing recruitment or selection process, but a position we are frequently recruiting for or we are planning to open in the near future.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Roche promuove la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione, rappresentando le comunità che serviamo. Quando si tratta di assistenza sanitaria su scala globale, la diversità è un ingrediente essenziale per il successo. Crediamo che l’inclusione sia fondamentale per comprendere le diverse esigenze sanitarie delle persone. Insieme, abbracciamo l'individualità e condividiamo una passione per la cura eccezionale. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione
• Cerchiamo di aderire al nostro TALENT POOL al nostro Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest! Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche . Mansioni Il reparto Audit e Compliance fornisce servizi per gli affiliati nella regione EMEA. Le nostre aree principali sono: Compliance Finanziaria, Autorizzazione SAP, Compliance Viaggi e Spese. In qualità di Analista di Compliance Viaggi e Spese, sarai responsabile del lavoro con il finanziamento, l'audit, la conformità e altri dipartimenti di affiliati Roche selezionati. In questa posizione ti concentrerai su: - Verificare le richieste di spesa di T&E dal punto di vista IVA - Gestione dell'integrazione tra Concur e SAP - Sostenere la preparazione di report e materiale formativo laddove richiesto su base periodica per affrontare gli aggiornamenti del processo di monitoraggio della conformità - Lavorare in collaborazione con il team per identificare le opportunità di migliorare la documentazione di conformità (ad esempio manuali di revisione, codifica dei motivi di ritorno ecc.) - Assumersi la responsabilità di valutare la conformità dei reclami sulle spese dei dipendenti in modo tempestivo e accurato, nei confronti delle politiche, delle procedure e dei requisiti normativi esterni della Società. - Partecipazione a programmi di conformità, progetti e altri compiti ad-hoc assegnati dal supervisore/HOD.
• Requisiti

Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

The Audit and Compliance department provides services for the affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Financial Compliance, SAP Authorization, Travel and Expense Compliance.

Your Opportunity
As a Travel and Expense Compliance Analyst you will be responsible for working with the finance, audit, compliance and other departments of selected Roche affiliates. In this position you will focus on:

• Verifying T&E expense claims from VAT point of view

• Handling integration between Concur and SAP

• Supporting the preparation of reports and training material where required on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process

• Working collaboratively with the team to identify opportunities to improve compliance documentations (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc.)

• Taking responsibility for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Participating in compliance programs, projects and other ad-hoc tasks assigned by supervisor/HOD.

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• At least 1 year of experience in a relevant position in the field of Finance/Accounting

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business related field

• Good administrative & communication skills

• High commitment to maintain / improve service levels

• Open mindset and customer focus

• Proficiency in English and Hebrew

Desirable:

• Knowledge of finance and accounting principles

• Experience in SAP / Concur system

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, language allowance (if the position requires extra language), annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (1 office day/week on average, and we provide fully remote working conditions within Hungary). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global diverse community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

• Cosa offriamo En échange, nous vous fournissons : - Des opportunités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage.
• Nous offrons des possibilités de développement constant, des cours et des formations linguistiques gratuits, la possibilité d'affectations internationales, des changements de position internes et la possibilité de façonner votre propre carrière. - Excellents avantages et flexibilité : salaire concurrentiel et forfait cafétéria, allocation linguistique (si le poste nécessite une langue supplémentaire), bonus annuel, Services médicaux privés, Programme d'aide aux employés, All You Can Move Sportpass, occasion de coaching / mentorat, programme de copains, bâtiments d'équipe, fête de vacances. Nous assurons également la flexibilité, pour vous aider à trouver votre équilibre: le bureau à domicile est une pratique courante (1 jour/semaine de bureau en moyenne, et nous fournissons des conditions de travail totalement éloignées en Hongrie). Nous créons l'occasion pour la liberté de travailler, où votre vie privée et professionnelle coexistent en harmonie. - Une communauté mondiale diversifiée, où nous apprenons les uns des autres. Chez Roche, nous coopérons, débattons, prenons des décisions, célébrons les succès et nous amusons en équipe. • Connaissance des principes financiers et comptables

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

The Audit and Compliance department provides services for the affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Financial Compliance, SAP Authorization, Travel and Expense Compliance.

Your Opportunity
As a Travel and Expense Compliance Analyst you will be responsible for working with the finance, audit, compliance and other departments of selected Roche affiliates. In this position you will focus on:

• Verifying T&E expense claims from VAT point of view

• Handling integration between Concur and SAP

• Supporting the preparation of reports and training material where required on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process

• Working collaboratively with the team to identify opportunities to improve compliance documentations (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc.)

• Taking responsibility for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Participating in compliance programs, projects and other ad-hoc tasks assigned by supervisor/HOD.

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• At least 1 year of experience in a relevant position in the field of Finance/Accounting

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business related field

• Good administrative & communication skills

• High commitment to maintain / improve service levels

• Open mindset and customer focus

• Proficiency in English and Spanish

Desirable:

• Knowledge of finance and accounting principles

• Experience in SAP / Concur system

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, language allowance (if the position requires extra language), annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (1 office day/week on average, and we provide fully remote working conditions within Hungary). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global diverse community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

*Please note, that this is a requisition for Talent Pool building purposes, which means it may not necessarily reflect a current opening with ongoing

• Requisiti Desiderabili - Conoscenza dei principi finanziari e contabili - Esperienza nel sistema SAP / Concur In cambio vi forniamo: - opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera. - Ottimi benefici e flessibilità: pacchetto salariale competitivo e caffetteria, indennità di lingua (se la posizione richiede lingua extra), bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare Sportpass, coaching / opportunità di mentoring, programma amico, team building, festa. Garantiamo anche la flessibilità, per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio: l'ufficio è una pratica comune (1 giorno/settimana in media, e forniamo condizioni di lavoro completamente remote all'interno dell'Ungheria). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia. - Una comunità diversificata globale, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto focalizzata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità di condividere la tua opinione. jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

The Audit and Compliance department provides services for the affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Financial Compliance, SAP Authorization, Travel and Expense Compliance.

Your Opportunity
As a Travel and Expense Compliance Analyst you will be responsible for working with the finance, audit, compliance and other departments of selected Roche affiliates. In this position you will focus on:

• Verifying T&E expense claims from VAT point of view

• Handling integration between Concur and SAP

• Supporting the preparation of reports and training material where required on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process

• Working collaboratively with the team to identify opportunities to improve compliance documentations (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc.)

• Taking responsibility for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Participating in compliance programs, projects and other ad-hoc tasks assigned by supervisor/HOD.

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• At least 1 year of experience in a relevant position in the field of Finance/Accounting

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business related field

• Good administrative & communication skills

• High commitment to maintain / improve service levels

• Open mindset and customer focus

• Proficiency in English and Italian

Desirable:

• Knowledge of finance and accounting principles

• Experience in SAP / Concur system

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, language allowance (if the position requires extra language), annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (1 office day/week on average, and we provide fully remote working conditions within Hungary). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global diverse community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

*Please note, that this is a requisition for Talent Pool building purposes, which means it may not necessarily reflect a current opening with ongoing

• Cerchiamo di aderire al nostro TALENT POOL al nostro Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest! Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche . Mansioni Il reparto Audit e Compliance fornisce servizi per gli affiliati nella regione EMEA. Le nostre aree principali sono: Compliance Finanziaria, Autorizzazione SAP, Compliance Viaggi e Spese. In qualità di Analista di Compliance Viaggi e Spese, sarai responsabile del lavoro con il finanziamento, l'audit, la conformità e altri dipartimenti di affiliati Roche selezionati. In questa posizione ti concentrerai su: - Verificare le richieste di spesa di T&E dal punto di vista IVA - Gestione dell'integrazione tra Concur e SAP - Sostenere la preparazione di report e materiale formativo laddove richiesto su base periodica per affrontare gli aggiornamenti del processo di monitoraggio della conformità - Lavorare in collaborazione con il team per identificare le opportunità di migliorare la documentazione di conformità (ad esempio manuali di revisione, codifica dei motivi di ritorno ecc.) - Assumersi la responsabilità di valutare la conformità dei reclami sulle spese dei dipendenti in modo tempestivo e accurato, nei confronti delle politiche, delle procedure e dei requisiti normativi esterni della Società. - Partecipazione a programmi di conformità, progetti e altri compiti ad-hoc assegnati dal supervisore/HOD.

• Stiamo cercando qualcuno che sia automotivato, davvero appassionato del suo lavoro e capisce che fornire un servizio di alta qualità è fondamentale per l'organizzazione. Inoltre, hai: - Almeno 1 anno di esperienza in una posizione rilevante nel campo delle Finanze/Accounting - Corso di laurea in Contabilità, Finanza o Business correlati campo - Buone competenze amministrative e di comunicazione - Alto impegno a mantenere / migliorare i livelli di servizio - mentalità aperta e focus del cliente - Proficienza in inglese e italiano Desirable: - Conoscenza dei principi di finanza e contabili - Esperienza in SAP / Concur system In cambio vi forniamo: - opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera. - Ottimi benefici e flessibilità: pacchetto salariale competitivo e caffetteria, indennità di lingua (se la posizione richiede lingua extra), bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare Sportpass, coaching / opportunità di mentoring, programma amico, team building, festa. Garantiamo anche la flessibilità, per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio: l'ufficio è una pratica comune (1 giorno/settimana in media, e forniamo condizioni di lavoro completamente remote all'interno dell'Ungheria). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia. - Una comunità diversificata globale, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto focalizzata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità di condividere la tua opinione. Contatto *Si prega di notare che questa è una requisizione per scopi di costruzione Talent Pool, il che significa che non può necessariamente riflettere un'apertura corrente con in corso

Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

The Audit and Compliance department provides services for the affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Financial Compliance, SAP Authorization, Travel and Expense Compliance.

Your Opportunity
As a Travel and Expense Compliance Analyst you will be responsible for working with the finance, audit, compliance and other departments of selected Roche affiliates. In this position you will focus on:

• Verifying T&E expense claims from VAT point of view

• Handling integration between Concur and SAP

• Supporting the preparation of reports and training material where required on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process

• Working collaboratively with the team to identify opportunities to improve compliance documentations (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc.)

• Taking responsibility for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Participating in compliance programs, projects and other ad-hoc tasks assigned by supervisor/HOD.

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• At least 1 year of experience in a relevant position in the field of Finance/Accounting

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business related field

• Good administrative & communication skills

• High commitment to maintain / improve service levels

• Open mindset and customer focus

• Proficiency in English and Turkish

Desirable:

• Knowledge of finance and accounting principles

• Experience in SAP / Concur system

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, language allowance (if the position requires extra language), annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (1 office day/week on average, and we provide fully remote working conditions within Hungary). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global diverse community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

*Please note, that this is a requisition for Talent Pool building purposes, which means it may not necessarily reflect a current opening with ongoing

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

Position
Die Abteilung
In der Abteilung People Relations arbeiten wir in einem kollegialen Team an der Entwicklung kreativer und innovativer Lösungen zur kontinuierlichen Optimierung und Flexibilisierung der Arbeitsbedingungen. In einer leistungsorientierten Umgebung, die von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Aufrichtigkeit und Vertrauen getragen wird, bieten wir Dir den Raum für eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten.

Dein Referendariat

Im Rahmen Deiner juristischen Wahlstation hast Du bei uns als Referendar (m/w/d) die Möglichkeit, den Alltag eines People Relations Partner in einem internationalen Großkonzern kennenzulernen. Dabei wirst Du insbesondere mit folgenden Aufgaben vertraut:

• Du bearbeitest Fragestellungen aus dem Bereich des nationalen und internationalen Arbeitsrechts

• Du erarbeitest gutachterliche Stellungnahmen zu arbeits-, betriebsverfassungs- und sozialversicherungsrechtlichen Fragestellungen und wirkst an Vertragsgestaltungen mit

• Du bist an der Beratung von Führungskräften und People & Culture Mitarbeitenden in personalrechtlichen Themen beteiligt

• Du nimmst an der Vorbereitung von Verhandlungen mit den Arbeitnehmervertretungen teil

• Du erarbeitest selbstständig Teilprojekte

Dein Profil

• Du bist Rechtsreferendar (m/w/d) und möchtest Deine Wahlstation in einem global agierenden Unternehmen absolvieren

• Die erste juristische Staatsprüfung hast Du mit Erfolg bestanden

• Du hast Kenntnisse in und Interesse an Arbeitsrecht sowie wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen

• Du handelst selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich und bist aufgeschlossen für neue Ideen und Wege

• You are proficient in English and not afraid of talking to international clients

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung, mobiles Arbeiten und attraktive Vergütung

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (- 50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Attraktive Standorte mit zahlreichen Benefits

• Moderne IT-Ausstattung und Teilnahme an Team-Events

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden/Referendaren

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte lade Deinen Lebenslauf und ein Motivationsschreiben online hoch. Bitte ergänze den möglichen Anfangs- und Endzeitpunkt Deines Referendariates.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.
With round about 8,000 employees Mannheim is the third largest Roche site in the world. It headquarters the Diabetes Care business unit and the sales organization of diagnostics products and is the hub of the worldwide diagnostics business. From your beginning with Roche, our motivated team will welcome and support you. Numerous opportunities for personal development, flexible work hours, attractive compensation packages and special family assistance programs are available.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Sei esperto in inglese e non hai paura di parlare con i clienti internazionali I vostri vantaggi
• Distribuzione flessibile del tempo, lavoro mobile e remunerazione attraente

Con circa 8.000 dipendenti Mannheim è il terzo sito Roche più grande del mondo. Ha sede l'unità aziendale Diabetes Care e l'organizzazione di vendita di prodotti diagnostici ed è il fulcro dell'attività di diagnostica mondiale. Dal vostro inizio con Roche, il nostro team motivato vuole accogliervi e supportarvi. Sono disponibili opportunità per lo sviluppo personale, orari di lavoro flessibili, pacchetti di compensazione interessanti e programmi speciali di assistenza familiare. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

From your beginning with Roche, our motivated team will welcome and support you. Numerous opportunities for personal development, flexible work hours, attractive compensation packages and special family assistance programs are available.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.fr: Stage en marketing et gestion de produits Solutions moléculaires (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Position:

Bist Du auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum, das Dir die Möglichkeit bietet, sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich zu wachsen? Möchtest Du Deine theoretischen Kenntnisse in einem praxisorientierten Umfeld anwenden und in einem hochrelevanten und dynamischen Bereich mit globaler Bedeutung tätig werden? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und profitiere von individueller Betreuung und regelmäßigem Feedback, um Dein Potenzial voll auszuschöpfen.

Über uns:

Unsere Abteilung Marketing Molecular Solutions am Standort Mannheim (Division Roche Diagnostics) verantwortet die Marketingplanung, Strategieentwicklung und das Produktmanagement im Bereich der Gewebediagnostik und Women’s Health in Deutschland. Wir suchen mit dieser dauerhaft ausgeschriebenen Stelle immer wieder motivierte Talente, die mit uns gemeinsam die Zukunft der Diagnostik gestalten wollen.

Deine Aufgaben:

In Deinem Praktikum übernimmst Du vielfältige Aufgaben und trägst maßgeblich zur Unterstützung des Marketing- und Produktmanagements bei:

• Du übernimmst die Durchführung von (Teil-)Projekten zur Unterstützung des Produktmanagements, darunter die Optimierung von Prozessen und Reportings.

• Du führst Markt- und Potentialanalysen durch, um strategische Entscheidungen zu unterstützen und hilfst bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Multi-Channel-Marketingkampagnen

• Du bist aktiv an der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Marketingkampagnen beteiligt, um unsere Produkte erfolgreich am Markt zu positionieren.

• In Zusammenarbeit mit externen Agenturen entwickelst Du kreative Kommunikationsmittel (z. B. Werbebroschüren, Anzeigen) oder setzt Deine eigenen Ideen bei der Erstellung von Marketingmaterialien um.

• Du bereitest wissenschaftliche und produktbezogene Informationen auf und unterstützt unser Vertriebsteam dabei, diese gezielt und effektiv einzusetzen.

• Du unterstützt bei der Planung und Durchführung von Schulungen und Events

Wer Du bist:

• Studienstatus: Du bist eingeschriebene/r Student/in der Natur- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, wie z.B. Biologie, Betriebswirtschaftslehre und Gesundheitsmanagement und befindest Dich bereits in einem fortgeschrittenen Bachelor- oder Masterstudium. Auch ein Praktikum in Deinem Gap Year ist bei uns möglich.

• Erfahrung: Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Marketing und Vertrieb sind von Vorteil.

• Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest proaktiv, eigenverantwortlich und mit hoher Motivation. Deine schnelle Auffassungsgabe hilft Dir dabei, komplexe Sachverhalte schnell zu verstehen und umzusetzen.

• Interessen: Du begeisterst Dich für Biologie, komplexe Erkrankungen und Herausforderungen im Gesundheitsmarkt.

• Technische Fähigkeiten: Unsere Arbeit basiert hauptsächlich auf Google-Tools wie G-Sheets und G-Slides. Vorkenntnisse sind daher ein Plus, aber mit Excel- oder PowerPoint-Erfahrung wirst Du Dich schnell einfinden . Sehr gute Deutsch- (C-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B-Niveau) runden Dein Profil ab.

Deine Vorteile:

• Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden und Praktikant:innen (online/offline)

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung (Teil der Arbeitszeit im Homeoffice möglich)

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Nutzung verschiedenster Learning-Angebote, wie z.B. LinkedIn Learning

• Hospitationsmöglichkeiten

Deine Bewerbung:

Bitte füge einen aktuellen Lebenslauf und relevante Zeugnisse bei. Ein Anschreiben hilft uns, mehr über Dich und Deine Eignung für die Stelle zu erfahren. Ein Motivationsschreiben

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Customer Identity & Access Management Analyst

We focus on the long - term, leading investment in research and development, striving to improve lives today and for generations to come. In Roche Informatics we are a diverse team of open and friendly people, enthusiastic about technological novelties and efficient IT solutions.

The opportunity:

• Participate in all aspect of the implementation of Enterprise CIAM strategies, policies, and procedures, ensuring they align with overall security and risk management objectives

• Assist with the delivery of CIAM projects and programs, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to a high standard of quality

• Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure CIAM solutions are integrated with existing systems and processes.

• Perform security assessments and identify potential improvements.

• Participate in incident response and troubleshooting efforts

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

Position
Deine Abteilung

Als Referendar der Rechtswissenschaft (m/w/d) unterstützt und begleitest Du die Roche-Datenschutzorganisation bei allen Anliegen innerhalb des Datenschutzrechts und angrenzender rechtlicher Themenfelder. Du gewinnst so Einblicke in ein global tätiges Healthcare-Unternehmen und erhältst die Möglichkeit, Deine rechtlichen Kenntnisse in spannenden Projekten und im Austausch mit Deinen Kolleg:innen der Rechtsabteilungen anzuwenden und auszubauen. Die Tätigkeit kann nach Absprache ganz oder teilweise im Home Office sowie an den Standorten Mannheim, Penzberg (Großraum München) oder Grenzach erfolgen.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du bearbeitest Fragestellungen aus dem Bereich des Datenschutzrechts und unterstützt den Datenschutzbeauftragten der deutschen Roche-Gesellschaften

• Du hilfst bei der Ausgestaltung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Datenschutzprozesse

• Du beteiligst Dich an der Durchführung von Datenschutz-Reviews/-Audits

• Du berätst Führungskräfte und Mitarbeitende in datenschutzrechtlichen Themen

• Du arbeitest selbstständig in Teilprojekten mit Bezug zum Datenschutz und Datenschutz-Management

Dein Profil

• Du bist Referendar (m/w/d) der Rechtswissenschaft und möchtest Deine Wahlstation in einem global agierenden Unternehmen absolvieren

• Die erste juristische Staatsprüfung hast Du mit überdurchschnittlichem Erfolg bestanden

• Du hast idealerweise erste Kenntnisse im und ein gesteigertes Interesse am Datenschutzrecht

• Deine Persönlichkeit zeichnet sich durch Professionalität, Teamfähigkeit und Kreativität aus

• Du handelst selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich und bist aufgeschlossen für neue Ideen und Wege

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung und Home-Office

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Attraktive Standorte mit zahlreichen Benefits

• Moderne IT-Ausstattung und Teilnahme an Team-Events

• Vernetzung mit anderen Rechtsreferendaren (online/offline)

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte lade Deinen Lebenslauf und ein Motivationsschreiben online hoch.

Bitte gib an, für welchen Zeitraum Du Deine Referendariatsstation vorgesehen hast.

Zeitraum: ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von mind. 3 Monaten

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.
With round about 8,000 employees Mannheim is the third largest Roche site in the world. It headquarters the Diabetes Care business unit and the sales organization of diagnostics products and is the hub of the worldwide diagnostics business. From your beginning with Roche, our motivated team will welcome and support you. Numerous opportunities for personal development, flexible work hours, attractive compensation packages and special family assistance programs are available.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Career Conversion Programme (CCP) (Train-and-Place) for Advanced Biopharmaceuticals Manufacturing Executives/Professionals is a talent development programme aimed at building the next generation of skilled manpower for Singapore’s Biopharmaceuticals manufacturing industry in anticipation of hiring demand. This programme is jointly supported by the Workforce Singapore (WSG) and Workforce Advancement Federation (WAF).

The training programme consists of 15 months of local attachment with Roche.

The Opportunity

• Support the Biochemical Manufacturing Department by working effectively within the group to meet department goals and objectives.

• Responsible for completing assigned tasks which may include preparing small equipment, cleaning and sterilizing vessels, preparing solutions, monitoring and operation biochemical processing equipment, raw materials sampling, dispensing and environmental monitoring sampling and maintain housekeeping of the areas while adhering to Safety, cGMP and Biochemical Manufacturing guidelines.

• Assigned tasks must be prioritized and work must be documented per approved manufacturing formulae.

• Support process improvement efforts.

• Operate computers for process control and data entry.

• Participate in staff and shift change meetings and work closely with other shift personnel and external support groups.

• Ensure all assigned tasks are performed as per safety requirement. Report safely incident and near misses on a timely basis and support SHE in incident investigation.

Safety, Health & Environment:

• Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.

• Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.

Lean Production System:

• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or Engineering, or equivalent qualifications such as a Diploma, NITEC, or similar.

• Experience in biologics is a plus.

• Must possess strong problem-solving abilities, interpersonal communication, and teamwork skills.

Who we are
At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Support process improvement efforts.

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be:

• Co-ordinate with SSC KL Finance teams (AP, GAMA, AR, TR, T&E, Compliance and Procurement) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with month-end close checklist.

• Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, accountable for the financial accuracy of the affiliate’s Financials. Responsible of all Internal Controls of Financial Reporting (ICFR) documentation and internal controls matters, act as owner for the ICFR tools – INVOLVE and BWISE

• Review monthly balance sheet reconciliation – follow up on open items and rectify any anomalies encountered. Submission other reporting packages accurately and within specified timeline i.e. Sustainability, Insurance reporting. Responsible of IFRS 16 Leasing related matters i.e SimSol /Planon . Review and provide approval for all manual journal entries for posting by SSC KL team. Responsible for all management accounting aspects i.e. Period cost allocation, COPA allocation, SSC allocation, etc

• Accounts Receivables / Accounts Payables : Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Receivables – review and approve manual billings, review debtors ageing and determine follow up actions, ensure all sales related activities are reported timely and accurate. Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Payables – review and provide approval of AP related activities i.e. vendor invoices, payment, etc.

• Treasury : Cash flow management - forecast current and future cash flow requirement and arrangement for necessary fund transfers (if required). Responsible for all treasury matters i.e. FX deal, credit facilities, payment request, banking matters.

• Master Data : Managing of master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc. Others activities which include : Preparation of statutory taxes calculations and reconciliation, including tax reporting and liaising with Tax Consultant. Preparation of audit related schedules and documentation, including liaising with the Auditor. Participate in any compliance audits and responding to audit queries. Identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation. Being the main contact person for SSC KL Finance teams for issue resolution for all financial matters. Being the main contact person for FM in the affiliates for all financial matters, requests and advisory.

Who you are :

• A degree in Finance/ Accounting/ Commerce or equivalent. ACCA, CPA Australia or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage.

• Minimum 5 years of working experience in related field and minimum 3 years In accountant role / audit experience. Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit and taxation.

• Proficiency in relevant accounting software preferably SAP and MS office tools. Meticulous, independent, proactive and ability to execute tasks within tight deadlines.

• Strong communication skills, expressing ideas and expectations in a clear and concise manner. Proven track record of effective relationship and stakeholder management with diverse populations (customers, colleagues and senior leaders). Proficiency in influencing skills. Comfortable working in a dynamic, changing and growing environment. The ability to operate effectively across diverse cultural and business environments.Able to commit for business travel when required.

• Proficient in English, Japa

jobs.title: Rechtsreferendar (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wer wir sind
Bei Roche leisten über 94.000 Menschen in mehr als 100 Ländern Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Gemeinsam haben wir uns zu einem weltweit führenden, forschungsorientierten Healthcare-Konzern entwickelt. Unser Erfolg baut auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt. Die Roche Pharma AG an ihrem Standort in Grenzach-Wyhlen steuert zentrale Elemente der technischen Qualitätssicherung für den gesamten europäischen Raum sowie die klinische Forschung, das Marketing und die Vertriebsaktivitäten für den deutschen Markt. Vom ersten Tag an werden Sie bei Roche von einem kollegialen Team aufgenommen und unterstützt. Neben zahlreichen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen und einer attraktiven Vergütung erwarten Sie Angebote zum Thema Familie Beruf.

Was Sie erwartet
Ihr Referendariat im Bereich Rechtswissenschaften beinhaltet folgende Themen:

• Unterstützung der Anwälte der Rechtsabteilung bei der umfassenden rechtlichen Beratung der Fachabteilungen

• Bearbeitung verschiedener typischer wirtschafts- und pharmarechtlicher Fragestellungen aus dem Alltag eines Syndikusrechtsanwaltes

• Verhandlungen mit Vertragspartnern und Regelung außergerichtlicher Streitigkeiten

• Kostenlose Unterkunft im Roche Boardinghaus ab einer Entfernung zum Wohnort von mind. 100 km

• Die Möglichkeit aus dem Home Office heraus zu arbeiten

Wer Sie sind
Für Ihr Referendariat im Bereich Rechtswissenschaften bringen Sie folgende Voraussetzungen und Kenntnisse mit:

• Sie sind Referendar (m/w/d) der Rechtswissenschaft

• Die erste juristische Staatsprüfung mit kleinem Prädikat haben Sie bereits erfolgreich bestanden

• Ihre Persönlichkeit zeichnet sich durch Professionalität, Teamfähigkeit, Kreativität und Verhandlungsgeschick aus

• Sie handeln selbständig und eigenverantwortlich und sind aufgeschlossen für neue Ideen und Wege

Referendaren (m/w/d) wird die Absolvierung der Pflichtwahl oder Anwaltsstation (Teilableistung in Wirtschaftsunternehmen bis zu 4 Monaten) geboten.

Für weiterführende Informationen besuchen Sie bitte: https://www.roche.de/about/standorte/grenzach

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche Pharma AG at Grenzach-Wyhlen is steering central elements of the technical quality control for the whole European region. For the German market clinical research, marketing and all sales activities are located there. Grenzach-Wyhlen is the location of Roche Deutschland Holding GmbH. From here, the German Roche Group coordinates the financial activities of the national organization. From your beginning with Roche, our motivated team will welcome and support you. Numerous opportunities for personal development, flexible work hours, attractive compensation packages and special family assistance programs are available.

jobs.title: Development Engineer (contract 80-100%)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

In a global, cross-functional environment, the System Development (SD) department within R&D is responsible for workflow optimization and successfully integrating hardware, software, consumables, and reagents to perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments. As a Development Engineer, you will work as a cross-functional team on automating and tooling to maintain and further develop launched complex diagnostic systems.

In this position, you will be responsible for the following areas:

• Elaborating on (Cobots-)Robotics concepts within a laboratory environment towards our vision of a dark lab by fully automating laboratory operations and workflows.

• Programming, testing, and maintaining of newly created and existing automated solutions within our laboratories.

• Supporting our Integration Teams in the installation and troubleshooting of Robotics Solutions within our laboratory environment

• Plan, coordinate, and execute work packages within your area of responsibility, including reporting and escalating topics or issues to the team and management.

• Be able to work as an individual and as part of a team.

Who you are:

• You are graduated with a bachelor's or master preferably in computer science, with specific knowledge in, e.g., robotics and/or vision, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or systems engineering or equivalent.

• Knowledge of professional Software development with one or more programming languages (e.g. UR-Polyscope, Python, C#/NET, LabView)

• You are excited to work as a professional in the medical diagnostics industry.

• Excellent spoken and written command of English (German is advantageous).

• You can communicate appropriately with different target groups.

• You are motivated to build, manage, and foster relationships and networks within the department and the related projects.

• Quick grasp and understanding of complex issues conceptual and creative thinking.

Please note that this vacancy is not currently linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today, and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products.
