jobs.title: Medical Writer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. We are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Roche Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office days/week on average).
The Global Digital Hub growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.

As a Medical Writer, you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners. You will be part of formulating and identifying current and future content needs and support different content creation initiatives. In addition, you will work with senior medical writers and stakeholders to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that writing activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs. The medical copy and content team within the Global Digital Hub operates under the Content Creation Chapter. This specialized team focuses on generating commercial content intended for various digital formats (emails, videos, banners, infographics, websites etc.). Their work plays a crucial role in supporting the communication strategies developed by Roche's global and local business teams.

You will be :

As a Medical Writer, you will contribute to the growing medical writing team within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. You will develop medical writing and digital content solutions across various therapeutic areas and play an integral role in business development and stakeholder engagement.
Key Responsibilities:

• Create and edit medical content for various digital channels and platforms, including patient information, educational materials for healthcare professionals (slides, posters, speaker briefs, and presentations for conferences), newsletters, medical reports, study summaries, and materials for public relations. May research, write, and edit pre-clinical and/or clinical reports, summarizing data from studies.

• Assist in the development of formats and guidelines for clinical documentation, prepare scientific manuscripts, abstracts, and posters. Manage multiple concurrent projects across therapeutic areas, ensuring timely delivery. Ensure content complies with regulatory guidelines and Roche best practices.

• Monitor and manage workload, anticipate capacity issues, and provide solutions. Ensure projects meet deadlines and maintain scientific accuracy. Prepare content for LMR approval in VVPM, including referencing.

• Collaborate with the Creative Artworker to develop content. Contribute creative ideas and suggestions. Liaise professionally with internal teams, clients, healthcare professionals, and other stakeholders to obtain comprehensive briefs and responses.

• Understand customer business needs to create relevant content. Engage resources, using both formal and informal networks to achieve goals and work closely with Business Partners. Suggest improvements to service and responsiveness to business partners.

Who you are :

We are looking for dynamic individuals who are highly involved and

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere di manipolazione di reclami - software medico
titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur de traitement des plaintes - Logiciel médical

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Complaint Handling Engineer - Medical Software you will be dealing with complaints concerning Digital Solutions quality and product performance of Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medical data networks, middleware solutions. data communication, apps algorithms.

As a member of the Digital Solutions Chapter, you will be working in a very transversal Software environment having the opportunity to work with cutting edge technologies and different programming languages for on-premise and cloud-based software. You need to be able to read and understand source code in order to find out the root cause/causal factor of a SW malfunction/SW issue, and also be able to learn about Software requirements, fixing bugs process (even if you will not fix them) and general code maintenance, all of it in an Agile environment where you could contribute with your own ideas and proposals in a team continuously improving

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

• Accountable for the timely handling of individual cases (Inquiry, Complaint, Potential Reportable and Safety issues) according to ISO Quality System requirements and regulations, and needs of the Country Organizations including creation, acceptance, classification, investigation, complete documentation, on-site trouble-shooting and resolution of cases.

• Resolves cases in the assigned area, potentially requiring consultation with more senior team members on technical or process-related aspects.

• Interface with Affiliates and assumes responsibility for timely communication of quality related information to the Country Organizations. Supports initiatives and measures to maintain enhanced interfaces with country organizations and regional representatives.

• Analyzes data using statistical measures for determining a potential product performance issue.

• Responsible for escalating cases which cannot be directly resolved to appropriate levels and initiating further investigation and communicating case derived information as appropriate.

• Ensures cases are compliant and conform to established quality processes, standards, and regulations.

Who you are:

• You own a degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, biomedical engineering, computer science, or an IT related field.

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential

• Work experience in the area of Software related or bioinformatics and/or in support related functions is desired.

• Experience reading source code

• Understanding of cloud computing platforms as well as experience managing on premise infrastructure (including servers and high performance computing clusters) is desired.

• You are able to read and or debug source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues.

Apply if you are:

• Looking for an opportunity to continue growing in your career while mixing both the technical (IT) and medical fields.

• Quick technology learner.

• A team player who truly believes that together we can go further.

• Not afraid to fail and learn.

• Comfortable with uncertainty.

• Looking for a purpose where your work will have a real impact on patient lives. Your work

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come un Ingegnere di Manipolazione della Cappella - Medico Software si tratta di reclami per quanto riguarda la qualità delle soluzioni digitali e le prestazioni di prodotto dei sistemi di informazione ospedaliera/laboratoria (HIS/LIS), reti di dati medici, soluzioni middleware. comunicazione dati, algoritmi app. Come membro del Capitolo Soluzioni Digitali, lavorerai in un ambiente Software molto trasversale avendo l'opportunità di lavorare con tecnologie all'avanguardia e linguaggi di programmazione diversi per il software on-premise e cloud-based. È necessario essere in grado di leggere e comprendere il codice sorgente per scoprire il fattore causa/causale radice di un problema SW malfunzionamento/SW, e anche essere in grado di conoscere i requisiti del software, correggere il processo di bug (anche se non li si corregge) e la manutenzione generale del codice, tutto in un ambiente Agile dove si potrebbe contribuire con le proprie idee e proposte in un team in continuo miglioramento A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. L'opportunità:
• Contabile per la tempestiva gestione dei singoli casi (informazioni, reclami, potenziali segnalabili e problemi di sicurezza) secondo i requisiti e le normative del Sistema di Qualità ISO, e le esigenze delle Organizzazioni del Paese tra cui creazione, accettazione, classificazione, indagine, documentazione completa, risoluzione dei problemi in loco e risoluzione dei casi.
• Sostiene i casi nell'area assegnata, potenzialmente richiedendo la consultazione con più membri del team senior sugli aspetti tecnici o legati al processo.
• Interfaccia con gli Affiliati e si assume la responsabilità per una tempestiva comunicazione di informazioni di qualità relative alle Organizzazioni del Paese. Supporta iniziative e misure per mantenere interfacce potenziate con organizzazioni di paesi e rappresentanti regionali.
• Analizza i dati utilizzando misure statistiche per determinare un potenziale problema di prestazioni del prodotto.
• Responsabile di casi di escalation che non possono essere risolti direttamente a livelli appropriati e avviando ulteriori indagini e comunicando le informazioni relative ai casi, se del caso.
• Assicura che i casi siano conformi e conformi ai processi, agli standard e ai regolamenti di qualità stabiliti. Chi sei:
• Possiedi una laurea in bioinformatica, biologia computazionale, ingegneria biomedica, informatica o un campo relativo all'IT.
• Le forti capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato) sono essenziali
• L'esperienza di lavoro nell'area del Software correlato o bioinformatica e/o nelle funzioni relative al supporto è desiderata.
• Esperienza di lettura codice sorgente
• Si desidera la comprensione delle piattaforme di cloud computing e la gestione dell'esperienza nell'infrastruttura di premessa (compresi i server e i cluster di calcolo ad alte prestazioni).
• È possibile leggere e debug codice sorgente di diversi linguaggi di programmazione per comprendere la causa principale dei problemi segnalati. Applicare se sei:
• Alla ricerca di un'opportunità per continuare a crescere nella tua carriera mescolando sia i campi tecnici (IT) che quelli medici.
• Imparatore di tecnologia veloce.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Complaint Handling Engineer - Medical Software you will be dealing with complaints concerning Digital Solutions quality and product performance of Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medical data networks, middleware solutions. data communication, apps algorithms.

As a member of the Digital Solutions Chapter, you will be working in a very transversal Software environment having the opportunity to work with cutting edge technologies and different programming languages for on-premise and cloud-based software. You need to be able to read and understand source code in order to find out the root cause/causal factor of a SW malfunction/SW issue, and also be able to learn about Software requirements, fixing bugs process (even if you will not fix them) and general code maintenance, all of it in an Agile environment where you could contribute with your own ideas and proposals in a team continuously improving

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

• Accountable for the timely handling of individual cases (Inquiry, Complaint, Potential Reportable and Safety issues) according to ISO Quality System requirements and regulations, and needs of the Country Organizations including creation, acceptance, classification, investigation, complete documentation, on-site trouble-shooting and resolution of cases.

• Resolves cases in the assigned area, potentially requiring consultation with more senior team members on technical or process-related aspects.

• Interface with Affiliates and assumes responsibility for timely communication of quality related information to the Country Organizations. Supports initiatives and measures to maintain enhanced interfaces with country organizations and regional representatives.

• Analyzes data using statistical measures for determining a potential product performance issue.

• Responsible for escalating cases which cannot be directly resolved to appropriate levels and initiating further investigation and communicating case derived information as appropriate.

• Ensures cases are compliant and conform to established quality processes, standards, and regulations.

Who you are:

• You own a degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, biomedical engineering, computer science, or an IT related field.

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential

• Work experience in the area of Software related or bioinformatics and/or in support related functions is desired.

• Experience reading source code

• Understanding of cloud computing platforms as well as experience managing on premise infrastructure (including servers and high performance computing clusters) is desired.

• You are able to read and or debug source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues.

Apply if you are:

• Looking for an opportunity to continue growing in your career while mixing both the technical (IT) and medical fields.

• Quick technology learner.

• A team player who truly believes that together we can go further.

• Not afraid to fail and learn.

• Comfortable with uncertainty.

• Looking for a purpose where your work will have a real impact on patient lives. Your work

• Auf der Suche nach einer Möglichkeit, in Ihrer Karriere weiter zu wachsen und gleichzeitig die technischen (IT) und medizinischen Felder zu mischen.
• Schneller Techniker.
• Ein Teamplayer, der wirklich glaubt, dass wir gemeinsam weiter gehen können.
• Keine Angst zu scheitern und zu lernen.
• Bequem mit Unsicherheit.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant qu'ingénieur chargé du traitement des plaintes - Services médicaux Logiciels que vous traiterez des plaintes concernant la qualité des solutions numériques et la performance du produit des systèmes d'information hôpital/laboratoire (HIS/LIS), des réseaux de données médicales, des solutions intermédiaires. communication de données, algorithmes d'applications. En tant que membre du chapitre Solutions numériques, vous travaillerez dans un environnement logiciel très transversal ayant la possibilité de travailler avec des technologies de pointe et différents langages de programmation pour des logiciels sur site et basés sur le cloud. Vous devez être en mesure de lire et comprendre le code source afin de découvrir la cause racine / facteur causal d'un problème SW dysfonctionnement/SW, et aussi être en mesure d'apprendre sur les exigences du logiciel, la correction des bogues processus (même si vous ne les corrigerez pas) et la maintenance générale du code, tout cela dans un environnement Agile où vous pourriez contribuer avec vos propres idées et propositions dans une équipe en constante amélioration Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. La possibilité :
• Responsable du traitement en temps voulu des cas individuels (questions d'enquête, de plainte, de déclaration éventuelle et de sécurité) conformément aux exigences et règlements du système qualité ISO, et des besoins des organisations de pays, y compris la création, l'acceptation, la classification, l'enquête, la documentation complète, le dépannage sur place et le règlement des cas.
• Résoudre les cas dans le domaine assigné, ce qui pourrait nécessiter des consultations avec des membres plus expérimentés de l'équipe sur les aspects techniques ou liés aux processus.
• Interface avec les affiliés et prise en charge de la communication en temps voulu d'informations de qualité aux organisations de pays. Appuie les initiatives et les mesures visant à maintenir des interfaces renforcées avec les organisations de pays et les représentants régionaux.
• Analyser les données en utilisant des mesures statistiques pour déterminer un problème potentiel de performance du produit.
• Responsable de l'escalade des affaires qui ne peuvent être résolues directement à des niveaux appropriés et de l'ouverture d'une enquête plus approfondie et de la communication, le cas échéant, de l'information dérivée des affaires.
• S'assurer que les dossiers sont conformes aux processus, aux normes et aux règlements établis en matière de qualité. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous possédez un diplôme en bioinformatique, en biologie informatique, en génie biomédical, en informatique ou en informatique.
• De solides compétences en communication en anglais (écrit et parlé) sont essentielles
• Une expérience de travail dans le domaine des logiciels ou de la bioinformatique et/ou des fonctions de soutien est souhaitée.
• Expérience de lecture du code source
• La compréhension des plateformes de calcul en nuage ainsi que l'expérience de gestion sur l'infrastructure de base (y compris les serveurs et les clusters de calcul à haute performance) est souhaitée.
• Vous pouvez lire et ou déboguer le code source de différents langages de programmation pour comprendre la cause profonde des problèmes signalés. Si vous êtes :
• Vous cherchez l'occasion de poursuivre votre carrière tout en mélangeant les domaines techniques (IT) et médicaux.
• Apprentisseur de technologie rapide.
• Un joueur d'équipe qui croit vraiment que nous pouvons aller plus loin ensemble.
• Ne pas avoir peur d'échouer et d'apprendre.
• Confortable avec l'incertitude.
• La recherche d'un but où votre travail aura un impact réel sur la vie des patients. Votre travail

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任

• 建立并维系 与区域政府决策部门及核心智囊机构的战略合作关系； 制定并落地 区域市场准入策略，推动产品 加速纳入 多层次医疗保障体系并实现报销覆盖最大化； 深度协同 区域业务团队，确保持续、顺畅的医保落地与报销执行。 Establish and cultivate strategic partnerships with regional government authorities and key think tanks. Formulate and execute regional market access strategies to accelerate product inclusion into multi-level reimbursement schemes and maximize coverage. Collaborate closely with the Regional Business Team to ensure seamless reimbursement implementation.

• 确保区域准入策略与产品核心策略的深度协同 ；基于全生命周期管理要求及新政策环境，制定并落地区域市场准入计划。通过 优化医保报销政策 、 前瞻性化解准入风险与壁垒 ，持续最大化患者的用药可及性。 Ensure strategic alignment between regional market access initiatives and core product strategies. Formulate and execute regional access plans grounded in lifecycle management and the evolving policy landscape. Optimize reimbursement policies , proactively mitigate risks and barriers , and maximize patient accessibility.

• 确保中央准入策略在团队内的协同与高效执行 ；建立并维护区域内医疗及卫生技术（HTA）领域的关键利益相关者关系； 全方位支持 从中央到省级及区域层面的市场准入工作。 Ensure alignment and execution of central market access strategies within the team. Manage key stakeholders in the medical and health technology (HTA) sectors. Provide comprehensive support for market access initiatives at national, provincial, and regional levels.

• 构建并运营 区域市场准入平台，确立与政府部门的 长期战略合作 机制，统筹相关项目的落地实施。 深度研判 区域医药政策趋势，为业务决策提供智力支持，并 赋能 区域业务团队，确保政策信息的精准传达与应用。 Establish and operate regional market access platforms , ensuring the effective execution of collaborative projects. Cultivate long-term strategic partnerships with government authorities. Analyze and interpret key regional healthcare policies to support business decision-making, while empowering local commercial teams with actionable policy intelligence.

• 构建区域跨职能协作与资源整合平台 ，统筹各部门资源以最大化利用效率； 强化 部门间协调机制，确保公司级项目中的深度协同，共同 驱动 区域业务目标的达成。 Establish a cross-functional collaboration and resource integration platform within the region. Orchestrate inter-departmental coordination to maximize resource efficiency, ensuring seamless synergy on corporate projects to drive the achievement of business objectives.

Q ualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications教育程度 / 所获资格证书 : 本科及以上, 医学、药学、药经或相关领域优先考虑
Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力

• Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry and policy affairs. 至少 2 年医药行业及政策事务相关工作经验。

• Specialization: Possess at least 4 years (please verify) of experience in reimbursement account management. 具备至少 2 年政府客户管理经验。

• Project Management: Proven track record in project management and execution. 具备出色的项目管理与落地执行能力。

• Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication and networking skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and build strong professional relationships. 卓越的人际沟通与影响力，善于建立并维护稳固的业务关系网。

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Please note this is a fixed-term maternity cover role.

The Global Learning Services teams focus on executing system data maintenance and administrative activities in Cornerstone and all relevant Learning management systems as well as providing all necessary non-systems related Learning process support. Global Learning Services provides customer service and advisory support to the Learning Community and business partners on global Learning systems and processes and ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business.

The Opportunity:
As a Learning Systems & Solutions Analyst you work closely with internal Global Learning Services, People Support Solutions, Learning IT staff, business leaders and Learning system vendors to effectively meet the Learning technology needs of the organization. Partner with global and local counterparts to represent business needs within the larger global People Support Solutions organization on behalf of Global Learning Services and the wider Learning community. Your responsibilities include supporting and maintaining of the Cornerstone On Demand system, in addition to other interfaced systems used within the People Support Solutions organization and Learning community.

• Serve as a technical/functional point-of-contact for Global Learning Services teams and related business groups. Work with other Technology Analysts, Learning Service Advisors, the Learning Center of Excellence and Global Learning Services teams on the development of new enhanced functionality requests, which includes reviewing enhancements and functionality provided by Cornerstone and other HR Technology/HRIS systems. May require development of training materials/content including coordination and execution.

• Perform varied and complex tasks associated with the support of Roche’s Cornerstone system, as well as support and provide system administration on other learning related systems, i.e. case management system.

• Serve as subject matter expert and provide support to the Learning Center of Excellence and Global Learning Services with a focus on business processes and application support activities including release management, application optimization, system role assignments/access, and incident & problem resolution, gathering requirements and specifications from users, creating specification documents, work with HR, the Learning community and IT teams to configure enhancements in system, and serves as linkage to IT for technical enhancements and investigations.

• Provide troubleshooting support and resolution for People Support Solutions as appropriate for system related issues (i.e. Cornerstone, ServiceNow)

• Partner with local and global teams on the implementation of new systems and initiatives across People Support Solutions

• Support the development of training content and delivery as needed and ensure consistent and reliable service delivery for customers serviced and i mplement processes and initiatives to ensure continuous improvement as well as service enhancement.

• Ensure end to end ownership of resolution, operations according to defined KPIs and SLAs, and ensure regulatory compliance in line with the countries, customers, and regulations.

• Collaborate with peers within the region and globally to ensure the People Support Solutions network provides consistent and effective services to our customers and achieve our People Support Solutions vision by dr

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Si prega di notare che questo è un ruolo di copertura premaman a tempo determinato.

I team di Global Learning Services si concentrano sull'esecuzione delle attività di manutenzione e di gestione dei dati del sistema in Cornerstone e in tutti i sistemi di gestione dell'apprendimento pertinenti, oltre a fornire tutti i necessari non sistemi relativi supporto del processo di apprendimento. Global Learning Services fornisce assistenza clienti e supporto consultivo alla comunità di apprendimento e ai partner commerciali sui sistemi e processi di apprendimento globali e garantisce il completamento del processo end-to-end in linea con i principi focalizzati sul cliente per garantire il lavoro Roche People Practices per il business.

L'opportunità:
In qualità di Learning Systems & Solutions Analyst si lavora a stretto contatto con i servizi interni di apprendimento globale, soluzioni di supporto per le persone, personale IT di apprendimento, leader aziendali e fornitori di sistemi di apprendimento per soddisfare efficacemente le esigenze della tecnologia di apprendimento dell'organizzazione. Partner con le controparti globali e locali per rappresentare le esigenze aziendali all'interno della più grande organizzazione globale People Support Solutions per conto di Global Learning Services e della più ampia comunità di apprendimento. Le tue responsabilità includono il supporto e il mantenimento del sistema Cornerstone On Demand, oltre ad altri sistemi interfacciati utilizzati all'interno dell'organizzazione People Support Solutions e della comunità Learning.

• Servire come punto di contatto tecnico/funzionale per i team di Global Learning Services e i relativi gruppi aziendali. Lavora con altri Analisti Tecnologici, Learning Service Advisors, i team di Learning Center of Excellence e Global Learning Services sullo sviluppo di nuove richieste di funzionalità avanzate, che includono la revisione di miglioramenti e funzionalità fornite da Cornerstone e altri sistemi HR Technology/HRIS. Può richiedere lo sviluppo di materiali di formazione/contenuto, compreso il coordinamento e l'esecuzione.

• Eseguire attività varie e complesse associate al supporto del sistema Cornerstone di Roche, oltre a supportare e fornire l'amministrazione di sistema su altri sistemi di apprendimento correlati, cioè sistema di gestione dei casi.

• Servire come esperto di materia e fornire supporto al Learning Center of Excellence e Global Learning Services con un focus sui processi aziendali e le attività di supporto alle applicazioni, tra cui gestione del rilascio, ottimizzazione delle applicazioni, assegnazioni di ruolo di sistema / accesso, risoluzione di problemi, requisiti di raccolta e specifiche da parte degli utenti, la creazione di documenti di specificazione, lavorare con HR, la comunità di apprendimento e team IT per configurare miglioramenti nel sistema, e serve come collegamento a IT per miglioramenti tecnici e indagini.

• Fornire supporto per la risoluzione dei problemi e la risoluzione per le soluzioni di supporto per le persone appropriate per i problemi relativi al sistema (ad esempio Cornerstone, ServiceNow)

• Partner con team locali e globali per l'implementazione di nuovi sistemi e iniziative in ambito People Support Solutions

• Sostenere lo sviluppo del contenuto e della consegna di formazione secondo le necessità e garantire la fornitura di servizi coerente e affidabile per i clienti serviti e i processi di implementazione e le iniziative per garantire il miglioramento continuo e la valorizzazione del servizio.

• Assicurare la cessazione della proprietà della risoluzione, delle operazioni secondo KPI e SLA definiti e garantire la conformità normativa in linea con i paesi, i clienti e le normative.

• Collaborare con i coetanei all'interno della regione e a livello globale per garantire che la rete People Support Solutions fornisca servizi coerenti ed efficaci ai nostri clienti e raggiunga la nostra visione People Support Solutions di Dr.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

Bitte beachten Sie, dass dies eine befristete Mutterschaftsdeckungsrolle ist.

Die Teams von Global Learning Services konzentrieren sich auf die Durchführung von Systemdatenwartungs- und -verwaltungsaktivitäten in Cornerstone und allen relevanten Learning-Management-Systemen sowie auf die Bereitstellung aller notwendigen, nicht systembezogenen Lernprozessunterstützung. Global Learning Services bietet Kundenservice und beratende Unterstützung für die Lerngemeinschaft und Geschäftspartner bei globalen Lernsystemen und -prozessen und stellt sicher, dass der Prozess im Einklang mit kundenorientierten Prinzipien abgeschlossen wird, um sicherzustellen, dass die Roche People Practices für das Unternehmen funktionieren.

Die Gelegenheit:
Als Learning Systems & Solutions Analyst arbeiten Sie eng mit internen Global Learning Services, People Support Solutions, Learning IT-Mitarbeitern, Führungskräften und Learning-Systemanbietern zusammen, um die Learning-Technologieanforderungen des Unternehmens effektiv zu erfüllen. Zusammenarbeit mit globalen und lokalen Partnern, um Geschäftsanforderungen innerhalb der größeren globalen Organisation von People Support Solutions im Auftrag von Global Learning Services und der breiteren Learning-Community zu vertreten. Ihre Aufgaben umfassen die Unterstützung und Wartung des Cornerstone On Demand-Systems sowie andere Schnittstellensysteme, die innerhalb der Organisation und der Lerngemeinschaft von People Support Solutions verwendet werden.

• Dienen Sie als technischer/funktionaler Ansprechpartner für Global Learning Services-Teams und verwandte Unternehmensgruppen. Arbeiten Sie mit anderen Technologieanalysten, Learning Service Advisors, dem Learning Center of Excellence und Global Learning Services-Teams an der Entwicklung neuer erweiterter Funktionsanforderungen, einschließlich der Überprüfung von Verbesserungen und Funktionen, die von Cornerstone und anderen HR Technology / HRIS-Systemen bereitgestellt werden. Kann die Entwicklung von Schulungsmaterialien / -inhalten einschließlich Koordination und Durchführung erfordern.

• Führen Sie vielfältige und komplexe Aufgaben durch, die mit der Unterstützung des Roche Cornerstone-Systems verbunden sind, sowie unterstützen und bieten Sie die Systemadministration für andere lernbezogene Systeme, z. B. Case Management System.

• Dienen Sie als Fachexperte und unterstützen Sie das Learning Center of Excellence und Global Learning Services mit Schwerpunkt auf Geschäftsprozessen und Anwendungsunterstützungsaktivitäten, einschließlich Release-Management, Anwendungsoptimierung, Systemrollenzuweisungen / -zugriff und Incident & Problemlösung, Sammeln von Anforderungen und Spezifikationen von Benutzern, Erstellen von Spezifikationsdokumenten, Arbeiten mit HR, der Learning-Community und IT-Teams, um Verbesserungen im System zu konfigurieren, und dient als Verknüpfung mit der IT für technische Verbesserungen und Untersuchungen.

• Bereitstellung von Unterstützung und Behebung von Problemen bei der Fehlerbehebung für People Support-Lösungen, je nach Bedarf für systembezogene Probleme (z. B. Cornerstone, ServiceNow)

• Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen und globalen Teams bei der Implementierung neuer Systeme und Initiativen in allen People Support Solutions

• Unterstützen Sie die Entwicklung von Schulungsinhalten und -lieferungen nach Bedarf und gewährleisten Sie eine konsistente und zuverlässige Servicebereitstellung für Kunden, die betreut werden, und implementieren Sie Prozesse und Initiativen, um eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung sowie eine Serviceverbesserung zu gewährleisten.

• Gewährleistung der End-to-End-Eigentumsrechte an Abwicklungen, der Operationen gemäß definierter KPIs und SLAs und Gewährleistung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften in Übereinstimmung mit den Ländern, Kunden und Vorschriften.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Kollegen in der Region und weltweit zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass das Netzwerk von People Support Solutions unseren Kunden konsistente und effektive Dienstleistungen bietet, und erreichen Sie unsere Vision von People Support Solutions von Dr.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Veuillez noter qu'il s'agit d'un rôle de couverture de maternité à durée déterminée.

Les équipes Global Learning Services se concentrent sur l'exécution des activités de maintenance des données et d'administration des systèmes à Cornerstone et de tous les systèmes de gestion de l'apprentissage pertinents, ainsi que sur l'appui nécessaire aux processus d'apprentissage non liés aux systèmes. Global Learning Services fournit un service à la clientèle et des conseils à la communauté d'apprentissage et aux partenaires commerciaux sur les systèmes et les processus d'apprentissage mondiaux et assure l'achèvement des processus de bout en bout conformément aux principes axés sur les clients afin d'assurer le travail des pratiques humaines de Roche pour l'entreprise.

La possibilité :
En tant qu'analyste des systèmes et des solutions d'apprentissage, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les Services d'apprentissage à l'échelle mondiale, les Solutions de soutien aux personnes, le personnel informatique d'apprentissage, les chefs d'entreprise et les fournisseurs de systèmes d'apprentissage pour répondre efficacement aux besoins technologiques d'apprentissage de l'organisation. S'associer avec des homologues mondiaux et locaux pour représenter les besoins des entreprises au sein de l'organisation plus vaste de People Support Solutions au nom de Global Learning Services et de la communauté d'apprentissage. Vos responsabilités comprennent le soutien et la maintenance du système Cornerstone On Demand, en plus des autres systèmes interfacés utilisés au sein de l'organisation People Support Solutions et de la communauté Apprentissage.

• Servir de point de contact technique/fonctionnel pour les équipes de Global Learning Services et les groupes professionnels connexes. Collaborer avec d'autres analystes technologiques, des conseillers en services d'apprentissage, des équipes du Centre d'apprentissage d'excellence et des services d'apprentissage mondiaux à l'élaboration de nouvelles demandes de fonctionnalités améliorées, ce qui comprend l'examen des améliorations et des fonctionnalités fournies par Cornerstone et d'autres systèmes de technologie des RH/RHS. Peut nécessiter la mise au point de matériels/contenus de formation, y compris la coordination et l'exécution.

• Effectuer des tâches variées et complexes associées au soutien du système Roches Cornerstone, ainsi que le soutien et l'administration du système sur d'autres systèmes liés à l'apprentissage, c'est-à-dire le système de gestion de cas.

• Servir d'expert en la matière et fournir un appui au Centre d'excellence en apprentissage et aux services d'apprentissage mondiaux, en mettant l'accent sur les processus opérationnels et les activités de soutien aux applications, y compris la gestion des versions, l'optimisation des applications, les affectations/accès aux rôles du système et la résolution des incidents et des problèmes, la collecte des exigences et des spécifications auprès des utilisateurs, la création de documents de spécification, le travail avec les RH, la communauté de l'apprentissage et les équipes de TI pour configurer les améliorations du système, et sert de lien avec les TI pour les améliorations techniques et les enquêtes.

• Fournir un soutien pour le dépannage et la résolution des problèmes pour les solutions de soutien aux personnes, selon les besoins, pour les questions liées au système (c.-à-d. Cornerstone, ServiceNow)

• Partenaire avec des équipes locales et mondiales sur la mise en œuvre de nouveaux systèmes et initiatives dans le cadre de People Support Solutions

• Soutenir le développement du contenu et de la prestation de la formation au besoin et assurer une prestation de services cohérente et fiable pour les clients desservis et les processus et initiatives d'i mplement pour assurer une amélioration continue ainsi que l'amélioration du service.

• Assurer la fin de l'appropriation finale de la résolution, les opérations selon des KPI et des SLA définis, et assurer la conformité réglementaire conformément aux pays, aux clients et aux règlements.

jobs.title: RA Senior Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Responsibilities
Key roles and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

1. Portfolio Management

• Oversee and is accountable for regulatory strategy, risk mitigation and HA interactions of product portfolios, ensuring alignment with organization objectives and regulatory requirements.

• Ensure regulatory activities through the product life cycle, including CTA, initial licensure and later management are appropriately actioned and managed.

• Collaborate with and influence industry associations and Health Authorities on key portfolio and regulatory policy matters

• Act as an advisor for the member of the Portfolio Team to consult with and a subject matter expert in regulatory strategy, and lead/contribute to the generation of regulatory knowledge and insights.

• Accountable for building partnerships with PDR global and key stakeholders from other functions to ensure the strategic business goals/prioritizations alignment, issue escalation and conflict solving.

• Establish fit-for-purpose ways of working and effectiveness of the Portfolio Team

2. People Management

• Ensure the necessary regulatory science knowledge and multiple sub-function domain expertise and resources are available to deliver the work and foster growth and development of the team

• Responsible for leading (VACC), mentoring, and developing a diverse team of professionals within the product and community matrix.

• Role model and supports talent flow within, into, and out of the portfolio team

• Builds an implementable and robust succession plan for the future Portfolio Team Lead

• Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning; boost team members to take ownership of their development and contributions.

• Manage team performance, including goal setting and regular evaluations, ensuring the long-term success of both individuals and the organization.

3. Community Management

• Build, nurture, and lead cross-team communities that drive collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovation across the organization.

• Act as a central point of contact within the community matrix, aligning community initiatives with function goals and ensuring consistent communication and engagement across teams.

• Develop and implement strategies that enhance community cohesion, break down silos, and create an environment where all members can contribute to the organization’s success.

Requirements/qualifications:
The ideal person for this role will have the following experience, skills and attributes:

• Proven experience in drug development, a deep understanding of the regulatory science/requirements, full product lifecycle and the ability to manage complex product portfolios.

• Demonstrated expertise in people management, with a strong track record of leading, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.

• Experience or track record of managing dynamic cross-functional projects/initiatives, which require great collaboration, engagement, and knowledge sharing across diverse teams.

• Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to influence and inspire stakeholders internally and externally, including NMPA and its affiliated organizations.

• The candidate should have a University or higher degree in pharmaceutical or life sciences with 10+ years of experience in R&D based pharmaceutical companies.

• The candidate is open minded and collaborative with a growth mindset and purpose-led.

• Excellent Chin

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione responsabilità I ruoli chiave e le responsabilità includono, ma non sono limitati ai seguenti: 1. Gestione del portafoglio
• Controllare ed è responsabile per la strategia di regolamentazione, la mitigazione dei rischi e le interazioni HA dei portafogli di prodotto, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi organizzativi e i requisiti normativi.
• Assicurare le attività di regolamentazione attraverso il ciclo di vita del prodotto, tra cui CTA, la licenza iniziale e la gestione successiva sono opportunamente attivati e gestiti.
• Collaborare con e influenzare le associazioni del settore e le autorità sanitarie su portafogli chiave e questioni di politica regolamentare
• Agire come consulente per il membro del team Portfolio per consultare e un esperto di materia nella strategia di regolamentazione, e portare/contribuire alla generazione di conoscenze e approfondimenti normativi.
• Contabile per la costruzione di partenariati con gli stakeholder globali e chiave della RDT da altre funzioni per garantire l'allineamento strategico degli obiettivi aziendali/prioritizations, l'escalation e la risoluzione dei conflitti.
• Stabilire modi di lavoro e di efficacia adatti all'uso del Team Portfolio 2. Gestione delle persone
• Assicurare la necessaria conoscenza delle scienze regolamentari e competenze e risorse di dominio sotto-funzione multiple sono disponibili per fornire il lavoro e promuovere la crescita e lo sviluppo del team
• Responsabile per il leader (VACC), mentoring, e lo sviluppo di un team diversificato di professionisti all'interno del prodotto e della matrice comunitaria.
• Modello Role e supporta il flusso di talento all'interno, all'interno e all'esterno del team di portafoglio
• Costruire un piano di successione attuabile e robusto per il futuro Portfolio Team Lead
• Promuovere una cultura della trasparenza, della responsabilità, dell'innovazione e dell'apprendimento continuo; rafforzare i membri del team per prendere possesso del loro sviluppo e dei loro contributi.
• Gestire le prestazioni del team, tra cui l'impostazione degli obiettivi e le valutazioni regolari, garantendo il successo a lungo termine sia delle persone che dell'organizzazione. 3. Gestione della Comunità
• Costruire, coltivare e guidare comunità trasversali che guidano la collaborazione, la condivisione delle conoscenze e l'innovazione in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Agire come punto centrale di contatto all'interno della matrice della comunità, allineare le iniziative della comunità con gli obiettivi di funzione e garantire una comunicazione coerente e un impegno tra le squadre.
• Sviluppare e implementare strategie che migliorano la coesione della comunità, abbattere i silos e creare un ambiente in cui tutti i membri possono contribuire al successo dell’organizzazione. Requisiti/qualifica: La persona ideale per questo ruolo avrà la seguente esperienza, abilità e attributi:
• Esperienza comprovata nello sviluppo della droga, una profonda comprensione della scienza e dei requisiti normativi, del ciclo di vita completo del prodotto e della capacità di gestire portafogli di prodotti complessi.
• Competenza dimostrata nella gestione delle persone, con un forte record di leader, sviluppo e mantenimento di squadre ad alto rendimento.
• Esperienza o track record di gestione di progetti/iniziativi interfunzionali dinamici, che richiedono una grande collaborazione, impegno e condivisione delle conoscenze in diversi team.
• Forte leadership, comunicazione e capacità organizzative, con la capacità di influenzare e ispirare gli stakeholder internamente ed esternamente, tra cui NMPA e le sue organizzazioni affiliate.
• Il candidato dovrebbe avere una laurea in scienze farmaceutiche o di vita con 10 anni di esperienza nelle aziende farmaceutiche basate su R&D.
• Il candidato è aperto e collaborativo con una mentalità di crescita e orientato allo scopo.
• Eccellente mento

• Berechnungsfähig für den Aufbau von Partnerschaften mit PDR Global und Schlüsselstakeholdern aus anderen Funktionen, um die strategischen Geschäftsziele/Prioritisierungen Ausrichtung, Eskalation und Konfliktlösung zu gewährleisten.
• Schaffung von geeigneten Arbeits- und Effektivitätsmöglichkeiten des Portfolio-Teams 2. Personalmanagement

• Verantwortung für führende (VACC), Mentoring und Entwicklung eines vielfältigen Teams von Fachleuten innerhalb der Produkt- und Community-Matrix.

• Teamleistung verwalten, einschließlich Zielsetzung und regelmäßige Bewertungen, um den langfristigen Erfolg sowohl von Einzelpersonen als auch von der Organisation sicherzustellen. 3. Gemeinschaftsmanagement

• Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Strategien, die den Zusammenhalt der Gemeinschaft verbessern, Silos abbrechen und eine Umgebung schaffen, in der alle Mitglieder zum Erfolg der Organisation beitragen können. • bewährte Erfahrungen in der Drogenentwicklung, ein tiefes Verständnis der regulatorischen Wissenschaft/Anforderungen, des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus und der Fähigkeit, komplexe Produktportfolios zu verwalten.
• Demonstrantes Know-how im Personalmanagement mit einem starken Erfolg von führenden, entwickelnden und leistungsfähigen Teams.
• Erleben Sie oder verfolgen Sie einen Überblick über das Management dynamischer funktionsübergreifender Projekte/Initiativen, die eine große Zusammenarbeit, Engagement und Wissensaustausch über verschiedene Teams erfordern.
• Starke Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Organisationskompetenzen, mit der Fähigkeit, Akteure intern und extern zu beeinflussen und zu inspirieren, einschließlich NMPA und seinen verbundenen Organisationen.
• Der Kandidat sollte eine Universität oder einen höheren Abschluss in Pharma- oder Life Sciences mit 10+ Jahren Erfahrung in FuE-basierten Pharmaunternehmen haben.
• Der Kandidat ist offen geistig und kollaborativ mit einem Wachstumsgeist und einem gezielten Verhalten.
• Ausgezeichnet Chin

• Favoriser une culture de transparence, de responsabilité, d'innovation et d'apprentissage continu; encourager les membres de l'équipe à s'approprier leur développement et leurs contributions.
• Gérer le rendement de l'équipe, y compris l'établissement d'objectifs et les évaluations régulières, en assurant le succès à long terme des individus et de l'organisation. 3. Gestion communautaire
• Créer, entretenir et diriger des communautés d'équipes qui favorisent la collaboration, le partage des connaissances et l'innovation dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Agir en tant que point de contact central au sein de la matrice communautaire, aligner les initiatives communautaires sur les objectifs de fonction et assurer une communication et un engagement cohérents entre les équipes.
• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies qui renforcent la cohésion communautaire, décomposent les silos et créent un environnement où tous les membres peuvent contribuer au succès de l'organisation. Exigences/qualifications: La personne idéale pour ce rôle aura l'expérience, les compétences et les attributs suivants:
• Expérience éprouvée en matière de développement de médicaments, compréhension approfondie de la science et des exigences réglementaires, cycle de vie complet des produits et capacité de gérer des portefeuilles de produits complexes.
• Expertise démontrée dans la gestion des personnes, avec une solide expérience de leadership, de développement et de rétention d'équipes performantes.
• Expérience ou expérience de la gestion de projets/initiatives transfonctionnels dynamiques, qui nécessitent une collaboration, un engagement et un partage des connaissances entre différentes équipes.
• Des compétences solides en leadership, en communication et en organisation, avec la capacité d'influencer et d'inspirer les parties prenantes à l'interne et à l'externe, y compris la NMPA et ses organisations affiliées.
• Le candidat devrait avoir une université ou un diplôme supérieur en sciences pharmaceutiques ou en sciences de la vie avec plus de 10 ans d'expérience dans des sociétés pharmaceutiques basées en R-D.
• Le candidat est ouvert d'esprit et de collaboration avec un esprit de croissance et dirigé par un but.

jobs.title: Market Access and Policy Advisor
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role scope :

• Develop and implement market access strategies/solutions for strategic products covering reimbursement, pricing, pharmacoeconomics/HTA strategy, and policy-related strategy to maximize patient access and portfolio value.

• Shape sustainable pricing strategies from pre-launch through lifecycle management, aligned with overall portfolio and long-term business objectives.

• Prioritize pipeline assets and define access pathways to ensure successful future launches.

• Ensure payer relevant evidence is generated through clinical trials, health economic modeling, real-world evidence studies, systematic literature research and meta-analysis effectively to demonstrate the value comprehensively.

• Translate evidence into compelling value propositions tailored to Taiwan payer and policy environment.

• Identify patient access opportunities and/or issues/barriers and develop access solutions to address them and create access for patients for Roche innovations in self-pay market

• Engage external stakeholders to remove access barriers and deliver value based discussion for Roche products.

• Reimbursement:

• Work cross functionally with PPOC, Marketing, and Medical stakeholders to develop the reimbursement strategy and engagement plan with KOL and advocacy groups.

• Collect data and prepare a dossier for the National Health Insurance Administration (NHIA) submission. Highlight the key evidence and product value proposition for the payer.

• Support policy shaping activities to support patient access as appropriate.

• Lead negotiation and contracting processes to secure an optimal outcome for the company

• Collaborate with the global team and other affiliates through the network to ensure alignment on the access and pricing strategy.

• Contribute to the planning and execution of our policy and health system shaping activities to ensure the system is ready and willing to recognize, value, and reimburse our future innovations.

Qualifications:

• Good compliance track record. No material compliance violation has been identified in the past 5 years.

Education:

• A bachelor degree in the field (pharmacy, nursing, public health, economics, public policy). An advanced (Master’s or doctorate) degree is preferred.

Working Experience:

• Experience working on reimbursement applications and self-pay strategy is preferred

• Some prior commercial experience within the pharmaceutical, medical device, or broader healthcare industry is essential.

• Familiar with NHIA process of medical devices and key stakeholders.

Skills & Knowledge:

• Strong business acumen with ability to think strategically.

• Deep appreciation of science and ability to translate scientific information into strategy. Ability to take evidence and other complex data and convert them into easy to understand deliverables that can support commercial use.

• Possess an understanding of the access landscape, relevant stakeholder groups, value assessment/HTA methods and pricing concepts.

• Possess an understanding of how policies are made within the healthcare system, including identifying key institutions and stakeholders involved and the importance of policy in shaping the healthcare environment.

• A collaborative attitude and ability to manage multiple demands and priorities on time, influence without authority, gain alignment and drive decision making.

• Excellent communication and leadership skills are a must with a strong track record of delivering results in a matrix-based environmen

jobs.title: Product Specialist Trainee (Portuguese speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Product Specialist Trainee, your main responsibility will be to provide specialized remote technical and applications support to users of our analyzers in the Anatomic Pathology and Molecular Biology product lines. You will be responsible for maintaining excellent communication, follow-up, and proactive collaboration with customers to ensure a rapid resolution of any issues or requests raised. This position offers a hybrid work arrangement. You will have the flexibility to work remotely while also having the opportunity to collaborate and engage with colleagues in the office.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide specialized remote technical and applications support to users of our analyzers in the Anatomic Pathology and Molecular Biology product lines

• Maintain excellent communication, follow-up, and proactive collaboration with customers

• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in a timely manner

• Document and escalate complex issues to higher-level support teams when necessary

• Provide training and guidance to customers on the operation and maintenance of our analyzers

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure customer satisfaction

Required Profile:

• Students of Biomedical Engineering, Biomedicine, or Health and Life Sciences.

• Ability to make curricular and/or extracurricular internship agreements

• Fluent in Spanish and English (conversational and good writing skills), Portuguese is a must

• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset

• Strong teamwork and collaboration skills

• Interest in new technologies

• Analytical thinking

What do we offer?

During the internship, you will get an insight into a global company. As a Product Specialist Trainee, you will have the opportunity to gain practical experience and develop your skills in the following areas:

• Learn the functioning of a microbiology and/or anatomical pathology laboratory.

• Receive specific product training on Roche's offerings in these areas.

• Enhance your communication, troubleshooting and customer service skills and expand your network within the company.

• Develop essential core skills such as customer interaction, critical thinking, intercultural collaboration, and resilience.

• Provide remote support to customers and field specialists, assisting with troubleshooting, application usage, and implementing new protocols.

Additionally, you will have the chance to collaborate with cross-functional and collaborate with global teams when necessary. This internship will provide valuable hands-on experience and the opportunity to contribute to customer satisfaction.

You will learn what "Customer centricity" means and how the Global Customer Support of Roche Diagnostics implements this in its daily work.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units to develop novel therapeutics that will have an impact on patient lives. Within the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence, the Computational Biology and Medicine department focuses on furthering our understanding of disease pathogenesis, patient populations, and target biology by having access to the largest Pharma R&D datasets in the world. In partnership with our scientists across Roche, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a highly motivated computational scientist to join our Neuroscience and Rare Diseases therapeutic area. In this role, you will be a key member of an interdisciplinary team dedicated to advancing our understanding of neurological diseases. As Roche continues to build and advance its capabilities in computational and data-driven R&D, this position offers an integral role in our strategy. You will identify novel therapeutic targets and biomarkers by analyzing high-dimensional data. You will collaborate closely with leading laboratory scientists and clinicians, contributing directly to a pipeline of innovative medicines for patients with neurodegenerative and neuroinflammation diseases. You will also be part of the wider Computational Biology and Medicine unit of the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence drawing on the shared experience and expertise of colleagues globally.

Data Analysis & Insight Generation

• Lead the analysis of high-dimensional datasets such as single-cell, spatial, proteomics, metabolomics, and human genetics data to support therapeutic and biomarker development

• Collaborate closely with the AI/ML Foundation Model development teams and apply advanced quantitative methods, supporting drug discovery projects in Neuroscience and Rare Diseases.

• Deliver clear and objective data-driven insights to inform portfolio decision-making

Collaboration & Strategy

• Contribute to the data and analytics strategy for Neuroscience and Rare Diseases efforts in collaboration with partners in the therapeutic area

• Develop effective working relationships with key stakeholders in the disease therapeutic area, laboratory teams, and computational teams

Team & Culture

• Contribute to a collaborative workplace culture of scientific rigor, continuous improvement, and open feedback

• Support the scientific growth of team members by sharing knowledge and expertise

Who you are

You are a dedicated scientist with a strong background in applying computational methods to biological problems. You are motivated by scientific challenges and have a clear interest in translating data into meaningfu

In collaborazione con i nostri scienziati attraverso Roche, creiamo migliori farmaci aumentando ogni parte della R&D attraverso la nostra cultura basata sui dati. L'opportunità: Stiamo cercando uno scienziato computazionale altamente motivato per unirsi alla nostra area terapeutica Neuroscience e Malattie Rare. In questo ruolo, sarete un membro chiave di un team interdisciplinare dedicato a promuovere la nostra comprensione delle malattie neurologiche. Mentre Roche continua a costruire e avanzare le sue capacità in R&D computazionale e data-driven, questa posizione offre un ruolo fondamentale nella nostra strategia. Identificherai nuovi obiettivi terapeutici e biomarcatori analizzando dati altamente dimensionali. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i principali scienziati di laboratorio e clinici, contribuendo direttamente ad una pipeline di farmaci innovativi per i pazienti con malattie neurodegenerative e neuroinfiammatorie. Sarete anche parte della più ampia unità Computational Biology and Medicine del Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza che si basa sull'esperienza condivisa e sulle competenze dei colleghi a livello globale. • Guidare l'analisi di dataset ad alta dimensione come singolo-cellula, spazio, proteomica, metabolomica e dati genetici umani per supportare lo sviluppo terapeutico e biomarcatore
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team di sviluppo di AI/ML Foundation Model e applicare metodi quantitativi avanzati, sostenendo i progetti di scoperta della droga in neuroscienze e malattie rare.
• Fornire informazioni chiare e obiettive basate sui dati per informare il processo decisionale del portafoglio Collaborazione e strategia

• Contribuire a una cultura di lavoro collaborativa di rigore scientifico, miglioramento continuo e feedback aperto

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units to develop novel therapeutics that will have an impact on patient lives. Within the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence, the Computational Biology and Medicine department focuses on furthering our understanding of disease pathogenesis, patient populations, and target biology by having access to the largest Pharma R&D datasets in the world. In partnership with our scientists across Roche, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a highly motivated computational scientist to join our Neuroscience and Rare Diseases therapeutic area. In this role, you will be a key member of an interdisciplinary team dedicated to advancing our understanding of neurological diseases. As Roche continues to build and advance its capabilities in computational and data-driven R&D, this position offers an integral role in our strategy. You will identify novel therapeutic targets and biomarkers by analyzing high-dimensional data. You will collaborate closely with leading laboratory scientists and clinicians, contributing directly to a pipeline of innovative medicines for patients with neurodegenerative and neuroinflammation diseases. You will also be part of the wider Computational Biology and Medicine unit of the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence drawing on the shared experience and expertise of colleagues globally.

Data Analysis & Insight Generation

• Lead the analysis of high-dimensional datasets such as single-cell, spatial, proteomics, metabolomics, and human genetics data to support therapeutic and biomarker development

• Collaborate closely with the AI/ML Foundation Model development teams and apply advanced quantitative methods, supporting drug discovery projects in Neuroscience and Rare Diseases.

• Deliver clear and objective data-driven insights to inform portfolio decision-making

Collaboration & Strategy

• Contribute to the data and analytics strategy for Neuroscience and Rare Diseases efforts in collaboration with partners in the therapeutic area

• Develop effective working relationships with key stakeholders in the disease therapeutic area, laboratory teams, and computational teams

Team & Culture

• Contribute to a collaborative workplace culture of scientific rigor, continuous improvement, and open feedback

• Support the scientific growth of team members by sharing knowledge and expertise

Who you are

You are a dedicated scientist with a strong background in applying computational methods to biological problems. You are motivated by scientific challenges and have a clear interest in translating data into meaningfu

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de file de la politique de réglementation technique de la Chine

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

• Provide Leadership, oversight and execution of technical regulatory policy activities for the Roche Pharma Group relevant to China including the development of Roche policy positions on key topics relevant to Pharma Technical, and effective advocacy of such positions externally.

• Collaborate closely with the regulatory colleagues in China and globally to develop and execute the China regulatory policy roadmap

• Ensure alignment and stakeholder engagement within Pharma Technical Operations, Product Development, Pharma International, governmental affairs as well as external interest groups

Key Responsibilities and Tasks

Identify and enable regulatory policy activities in China such that Roche is globally recognized as an industry leader with health authority agencies and industry peer groups and that significant value is realized in facilitating pipeline development, marketing authorizations and excellence in manufacturing

Build and maintain relationships based on trust and respect with key health authority professionals, relevant academic and opinion leaders and non-profit scientific associations

Establish a strong partnership and networks with internal (i.e. Regulatory, Technical, Quality, Medical,, Gov. Affairs ) and external stakeholders

Ensure the development, execution and communication of the China regulatory policy roadmap

Lead strong cross-functional teams and regional/global regulatory communities of practice to drive policy change in China

Represent Roche technical regulatory policy views in China (and beyond) during external stakeholder engagement

Take leadership in local, regional and/or global associations (e.g. RDPAC, BIO, IFPMA…) and/or governmental organizations (e.g. APEC, ICH) in line with the Roche positions .

Provide leadership and consultancy to Roche Pharma Division leaders on regulatory policy and strategy related topics affecting China

Act as subject matter expert for key technical regulatory policy and strategy areas as assigned, lead the development of specified Global Regulatory Policy positions in close collaboration with SMEs.

Build influencing and advocacy knowledge and capacity and empowers other colleagues to shape the regulatory environment

Core Competencies, Skills
Excellent collaboration skills

Recognized expert in relevant CMC technical/regulatory area with established external credibility as thought leader

Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with global health authorities

Strong team player and communicator

Creates an environment of strong team spirit, good communication, high motivation, inspire cross-functional project teams

Excellent advocacy, communication and presentation skills

Strategic thinking and analytical skills, ability to simplify complex topics and to pull it all together to strategic planning.

Challenges the status quo to drive innovation

Ability to operate successfully in a global matrix environment with shared accountability and responsibilities.

Minimum Qualifications and Experience

Degree in relevant technical area ( Analytical, Biochemistry, Biology, Pharmacy)

At least 10 years of work experience in relevant area or advanced degree (PhD) in relevant technical area combined with a minimum of 5 yrs work experience

Previous experience in Regulatory (Industry or Agency) is preferred

In depth Knowledge of China regulatory environment

Previous participation and proven effectiveness in international regulatory/industry forums is highly preferr

jobs.title: Patient Safety Partner

titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire de la sécurité des patients

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceuticals

Job Purpose

The Patient Safety Partner (Lead) is accountable for the implementation, maintenance and oversight of the local PV system for the assigned affiliate(s)/country(ies) and sets the strategic direction for patient safety including risk management within the Affiliate, ensuring alignment with IPS priorities and local business needs.

Key Responsibilities

General

• Lead/facilitate APS strategy and planning to enable effective prioritisation for impact.

• Collaborate strategically with the Country Cluster Lead, Safety Net, Affiliate PV Net, Patient Safety Operations, and affiliate leadership by leveraging country safety insights to determine priorities, shape organisational strategies, and influence regional and global decisions.

PV System

• Act as the local single point of contact for safety-related aspects , internally and externally, including the local regulatory authority.
(In Case of a formal requirement for a local QPPV /Local PV Officer (depending on the wording of local legislation) replace with the following):
Local Qualified Person for Pharmacovigilance (QPPV): As the named and qualified point of contact, the Local Qualified Person for Pharmacovigilance (QPPV) holds responsibility for both establishing and maintaining the local PV system, and for guaranteeing adherence to local requirements mandated by the local Regulatory Authority.

• Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of local PV processes and PV oversight ensuring they are effective and efficient, while driving continuous improvement and alignment with evolving needs and requirements globally and locally. Ensure appropriate escalation and action taken in case of compliance gaps.

• Enable operational excellence and maintain oversight* of safety-related activities relevant to the PV system through collaboration with key stakeholders such as Patient Safety Operations and Affiliate PV Net, by ensuring that day-to-day operations are executed effectively and efficiently to maintain the monitoring of the safety profile of Roche medicinal products and medical devices and their safety risk management, meet regulatory requirements, and ensure license to operate.
Key areas of oversight/activities include the following in line with Roche standard operating procedures (where applicable):

• Individual Case Safety Reports (e.g. data collection and submissions to HA)

• Signal Detection & Signal Management for Local Products

• Aggregate safety reports (e.g. submission to HA)

• Pharmacovigilance Agreements (e.g. PVA, Safety Data Exchange Agreement)

• Risk Management and Safety Communication (e.g., Direct Healthcare Professional Communication, Risk Minimization Measures, emerging safety issues)

• Studies, Programs and other projects with PV implications (e.g., ICT, NIS, PASS, PAES, MAP, PAA, CUP, PTAP, Dicela)

• Safety Labeling and PV Commitments

• (Local) Pharmacovigilance System Master File

*Oversight includes activities to ensure that the local PV system is in line with local regulatory requirements and internal procedures including the review of relevant compliance metrics.

• Lead in shaping country PV regulation and the broader country pharmacovigilance ecosystem according to APS grouping, in particular in order to promote regulatory reliance and international harmonization in partnership with, and not limited to, pharma trade associations, healthcare organizations, patient groups etc, where applicable.

• Ensure business continuity and coordinate APS
