jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing, resulting in a sample in, result out workflow.

Our Verification and Validation team, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is responsible for ensuring a software product meets its specified requirements and performs as intended by rigorously testing and analyzing the software throughout its development lifecycle.

As a Principal Software Developer in Test, you will be responsible for test design, development, automation, deployment, execution, and reporting. Specifically, you will develop an integrated hardware-software framework for end-to-end test automation that leverages a third-party Hardware-in-the-Loop solution. In this role, you will represent quality engineering and verification on behalf of your team in all events and activities related to this effort, working closely with software and hardware engineers across multiple global locations.

The Opportunity

• You develop solutions for Hardware-in-the-Loop testing for end-to-end testing of embedded instrument software

• You author and confirm correctness of requirements-driven tests, covering aspects including:

• Testing approaches (exploratory, white box, black box, etc.)

• Testing level (end-to-end, system, integration, unit, etc.)

• Testing types (functional, performance, scalability, etc.)

• You automate and execute front-end and back-end tests, covering for:

• Instrument software

• Web applications

• You automate deployment and testing pipelines across branches and stages

• You report quality metrics and enhancing quality dashboards

• You perform root cause analysis of defects and discoveries

• You develop automation frameworks and validate automation toolchains

• You ensure regulatory compliance of quality engineering deliverables

• You partner with Test Architects, Test Leads, and Verification & Validation Leads on practices

• You collaborate with designers, architects, developers, system engineers and testers on product development

• You participate in all development events, and activities and guide junior testing team members as needed

• Technologies which may be utilized : C++, Java, Cucumber (Behavior-Driven Development), Gherkin, Playwright, Windows, Cypress/JDI/Selenium/WebDriver/TestNG, Typescript/Javascript, Angular, Docker, Jenkins, Groovy, Bash, Jira, Github, Confluence, Google Suite, macOS/Linux, MS SQL, Vector HIL Solutions

Who You Are

• You have a Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related. Advanced degree preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered, with three years of experience for each year of missing education

• You have 10+ years related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience with Jav

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per chi sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Così ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Entra a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione Un futuro più sano. E' ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Avanzerà continuamente la scienza e garantirà a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria di cui hanno bisogno oggi e alle generazioni future. Creare un mondo dove tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

A Roche stiamo lavorando per rendere il sequenziamento di nuova generazione abbastanza semplice e accessibile per l'uso di routine. Accelerando la ricerca clinica, razionalizzando i flussi di lavoro e ampliando i menu di test, stiamo ampliando l'accesso ai dati genomici e riducendo le barriere all'adozione. Da solidi strumenti di isolamento e preparazione dei campioni a nuove tecnologie di sequenziamento e bio-informatica avanzata, stiamo sviluppando soluzioni end-to-end differenziate e altamente integrate per il sequenziamento di nuova generazione, con conseguente campionamento, risultato fuori flusso di lavoro.

Il nostro team di verifica e convalida, parte di Roche Sequencing Solutions, è responsabile per garantire che un prodotto software soddisfi i requisiti specificati ed funzioni secondo le finalità attraverso test rigorosi e analisi del software durante tutto il suo ciclo di vita di sviluppo.

In qualità di sviluppatore principale di software in Test, sarete responsabili per la progettazione, lo sviluppo, l'automazione, l'implementazione, l'esecuzione e la rendicontazione dei test. In particolare, svilupperete un framework hardware-software integrato per l'automazione dei test end-to-end che sfrutta una soluzione hardware-in-the-Loop di terze parti. In questo ruolo, rappresenterete l'ingegneria e la verifica della qualità per conto del vostro team in tutti gli eventi e le attività connesse a questo sforzo, lavorando a stretto contatto con i tecnici del software e hardware in più sedi globali.

Opportunità - Sviluppi soluzioni per il test Hardware-in-the-Loop per il test end-to-end di software strumenti incorporati - Autorizza e conferma la correttezza dei test basati sui requisiti, coprendo aspetti tra cui: - Approcci di test (esploratory, white box, black box, ecc.) - Livello di test (end-to-end, sistema, integrazione, unità, ecc.) - Tipi di test (funzionali, performance, capacità di scala, ecc.) - Automatizza ed esegue test front-end e back-end, copre per: - Software strumenti - applicazioni Web - Automatizza la distribuzione e la sperimentazione di condotte attraverso rami e stadi -

Si segnalano metriche di qualità e si migliora la qualità dashboard - Si esegue l'analisi delle cause root di difetti e scoperte - Si sviluppano quadri di automazione e convalidare le catene di strumenti di automazione - Si garantisce la conformità normativa dei risultati di ingegneria della qualità - Si collabora con gli architetti test, e le guide e verifica Leads sulle pratiche - Si collabora con progettisti, architetti, sviluppatori, ingegneri di sistema e tester sullo sviluppo dei prodotti - Si partecipa a tutti gli eventi di sviluppo, e attività e guidare i membri del team di test junior, se necessario - Tecnologie che

può essere utilizzato: - C++ - Java - Cutrium (Comportamento-Sviluppo Driven) - Gherkin - Playwright - Windows - Cypress/JDI/Selenium/WebDriver/TestNG - Typescript/Javascript - Angolar - Docker - Jenkins - Groovy - Bash - Jira - Github - Confluence - Google Suite - macOS/Linux - MS SQL - Vector HIL Solutions

Chi sei - Hai un Laurea in Informatica, Matematica, Fisica, Ingegneria Elettrica o affini. Laurea preferita. Una combinazione equivalente di istruzione ed esperienza può essere considerata, con tre anni di esperienza per ogni anno di istruzione mancante - Hai 10+ anni di esperienza relativa o equivalente combinazione di istruzione ed esperienza con Java

Contatto - Entra in Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, für wen Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat, heute und für Generationen.

Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Sie, das treibt uns zu Innovationen. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und allen Menschen Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung zu geben, die sie heute und für die kommenden Generationen benötigen.

Bei Roche arbeiten wir daran, die Sequenzierung der nächsten Generation für den Routineeinsatz einfach und zugänglich zu machen. Durch die Beschleunigung der klinischen Forschung, die Rationalisierung der Arbeitsabläufe und die Erweiterung der Assay-Menüs erweitern wir den Zugang zu genomischen Daten und verringern die Hindernisse für die Annahme. Von robusten Probenisolierungs- und Vorbereitungstools bis hin zu neuartigen Sequenzierungstechnologien und fortschrittlicher Bioinformatik entwickeln wir differenzierte, hochintegrierte End-to-End-Lösungen für die Sequenzierung der nächsten Generation, die zu einer Probe führen, die zu Workflow führt.

Unser Verifikations- und Validierungsteam, Teil der Roche Sequencing Solutions, ist dafür verantwortlich, dass ein Softwareprodukt seinen spezifischen
• Anforderungen entspricht und die Software während des gesamten Entwicklungszyklus rigoros getestet und analysiert wird.

Als Principal Software Developer in Test sind Sie für Testdesign, Entwicklung, Automatisierung, Bereitstellung, Ausführung und Reporting verantwortlich. Insbesondere entwickeln Sie ein integriertes Hardware-Software-Framework für die End-to-End-Testautomatisierung, das eine Hardware-in-the-Loop-Lösung von Drittanbietern nutzt. In dieser Funktion werden Sie Qualitäts-Engineering und Verifikation im Auftrag Ihres Teams bei allen Veranstaltungen und Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit diesem Aufwand darstellen, wobei Sie eng mit Software- und Hardware-Ingenieuren an mehreren globalen Standorten zusammen arbeiten.

Die Gelegenheit - Sie entwickeln Lösungen für Hardware-in-the-Loop-Tests für die End-to-End-Tests von Embedded Instrument Software - Sie erstellen und bestätigen die Richtigkeit von anforderungsgesteuerten Tests, die Aspekte umfassen, einschließlich: - Testansätze (exploratory, White Box, Black Box, etc.) - Testniveau (end-to-end, System, Integration, Unit, etc.) - Testtypen (funktional, Leistung, Skalierbarkeit, etc.) - Sie automatisieren und führen Frontend- und Backend-Tests aus, die umfassen: - Instrument Software - Web-Anwendungen - Sie automatisieren Bereitstellung und Test von Pipelines über Branchen und Stufen hinweg -

Sie melden Qualitätsmetriken und verbessern Qualitäts-Dashboards - Sie führen die Grundursachenanalyse von Defekten und Entdeckungen durch - Sie entwickeln Automatisierungsrahmen und validieren Automatisierungs-Toolchains - Sie gewährleisten die Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Qualitätsstandards bei der Entwicklung von Qualitäts-Engineering-Lieferungen - Sie arbeiten mit Testarchitekten, Testleitern und Verifikations- und Validierungs-Führungen zu Praktiken zusammen - Sie arbeiten mit Designern, Architekten, Entwicklern, Systemingenieuren und Testern bei der Produktentwicklung zusammen - Sie nehmen an allen Entwicklungsveranstaltungen teil, und begleiten Junior-Testteammitglieder bei Bedarf - Technologien, die

kann verwendet werden: - C++ - Java - Cucuber (Behavior-Driven Development) - Gherkin - Playwright - Windows - Zypressen/JDI/Selenium/WebDriver/TestNG - Typescript/Javascript - Winkel - Docker - Jenkins - Groovy - Bash - Jira - Github - Confluence - Google Suite - macOS/Linux - MS SQL - Vector HIL Lösungen

Wer Sie sind - Sie haben einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Elektrotechnik, oder verwandt. Fortgeschrittener Abschluss bevorzugt. Eine gleichwertige Kombination von Bildung und Erfahrung kann berücksichtigt werden, mit drei Jahren Erfahrung für jedes Jahr fehlenden Bildung - Sie haben 10+ Jahre Erfahrung oder eine gleichwertige Kombination von Bildung und Erfahrung mit Java

Kontakt - Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à assurer que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir.

La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser la science en permanence et faire en sorte que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons.

Nous travaillons à rendre le séquençage de la prochaine génération assez simple et accessible pour une utilisation courante. En accélérant la recherche clinique, en rationalisant les flux de travail et en élargissant les menus de tests, nous élargissons l'accès aux données génomiques et abaissons les obstacles à l'adoption.

Notre équipe de vérification et de validation, une partie de Roche Sequencing Solutions, est chargée de s'assurer qu'un produit logiciel répond aux exigences spécifiées et qu'il se produit comme prévu en testant et en analysant rigoureusement le logiciel tout au long de son cycle de vie de développement.

En tant que développeur principal de logiciels dans Test, vous serez responsable de la conception, du développement, de l'automatisation, du déploiement, de l'exécution et du reporting. Plus précisément, vous développerez un cadre de logiciels matériels intégré pour l'automatisation de test de bout en bout qui exploite une solution de matériel dans le circuit tierce.

L'Opportunité - Vous développez des solutions pour les tests Hardware-in-the-Loop pour les tests de bout en bout de logiciels embarqués d'instruments - Vous écrivez et confirmez la justesse des tests axés sur les exigences, couvrant notamment : - les approches de test (exploratoire, boîte blanche, boîte noire, etc.) - le niveau de test (end-to-end, système, intégration, unité, etc.) - les types de test (fonctionnel, performance, évolutivité, etc.) - vous automatisez et exécutez des tests front-end et back-end, couvrant : - les logiciels instrument - les applications Web - vous automatisez le déploiement et testez des pipelines entre les branches et les étapes -

Vous publiez des données de qualité et améliorez des tableaux de bord de qualité - Vous effectuez l'analyse des défauts et des découvertes - Vous développez des cadres d'automatisation et validez des outils d'automatisation - Vous assurez la conformité réglementaire des produits livrables d'ingénierie de qualité - Vous êtes partenaire avec les architectes de test, les responsables de test et les responsables de validation et de vérification des pratiques - Vous collaborez avec les concepteurs, les architectes, les développeurs, les ingénieurs de système et les expérimentations sur le développement de produits - Vous participez à tous les événements de développement et activités et guidez les membres de l'équipe de test junior au besoin - Technologies qui

Peut être utilisé: - C++ - Java - Cucumber (Behavior-Driven Development) - Gherkin - Playwright - Windows - Cypress/JDI/Selenium/WebDriver/TestNG - Typescript/Javascript - Angulaire - Dockers - Jenkins - Groovy - Bash - Jira - Github - Confluence - Google Suite - macOS/Linux - MS SQL - Vector HIL Solutions

Qui vous êtes - Vous avez un baccalauréat en informatique, mathématiques, physique, génie électrique, ou apparenté. Diplôme avancé préféré. Une combinaison équivalente de l'éducation et de l'expérience peut être envisagée, avec trois ans d'expérience pour chaque année de l'éducation manquante - Vous avez 10 ans d'expérience liée ou équivalent combinaison de l'éducation et de l'expérience avec Java

Contact - Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

jobs.title: Global Product Planner - Fixed Term
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Are you ready to take your career to the next level with a dynamic and global role? As a Global Product Planner, you will be at the forefront of supply chain management, driving operational excellence and ensuring product availability across our Indianapolis and Mannheim, Germany hubs. You will develop and manage supply plans utilizing both affiliate and statistical forecasts to create accurate and efficient supply chains. By proactively addressing supply and demand planning issues, you will maintain seamless operations and ensure the accuracy and continuous optimization of MRP master data. Leading bottleneck management, allocation, reserve management, and scrap mitigation across the network will be vital components of your role.

In this position, you will be the primary point of contact for product supply-related communications with suppliers, regions, business areas, and affiliates. You will guarantee the timely supply of finished goods to regional and local warehouses, aligning with service level agreements (SLAs), and strive to meet customer service objectives at the lowest possible total costs, including distribution, inventory, and write-offs.

We are looking for someone with specialized and comprehensive knowledge in supply chain management or a related business area. Your analytical and problem-solving skills will be engaged in varied and complex duties involving research, analysis, and solution development. You will provide expert guidance to department leadership in setting strategic direction and utilize originality and ingenuity in your daily responsibilities and decision-making processes. Applying a wide range of principles, practices, and procedures to navigate more complex and challenging assignments will be crucial. Additionally, your commitment to maintaining and continuously improving the planning objectives and goals through daily actions will be key.

This is your opportunity to make a significant impact in a highly professional and strategic role. Join us and contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional service and operational efficiency. Apply now to be part of a global team committed to excellence!

The Opportunity

• Supply Planning: Develops global supply plan based on affiliate forecasts and GSC strategic guidance. Delivers supply plans to Manufacturing and supplier partners. Works with external suppliers to ensure agreed plans are met. In case of exception, works with partners to resolve situations with the least disruption to customers. Monitors cycle time, critical batches and the optimization of planning parameter settings to avoid destruction costs or stock outs. Monitors schedule adherence and discusses if below target during Supply Review meetings (S&OP). Monitors system alerts for potential / actual supply issues throughout the global network. Makes recommendations to provide timely resolution with minimum impact to customers: Works with IBL/IPM to define regional/country product allocations in case of bottleneck; Keeps Regions / Affiliates / BAs informed as to potential and actual product bottlenecks.

• Inventory & Product availability management: Manages inventories at global distribution centers to ensure high service level to customers at low

Applying a wide range of principles, practices, and procedures to navigate more complex and challenging assignments will be crucial. Additionally, your commitment to maintaining and continuously improving the planning objectives and goals through daily actions will be key.

This is your opportunity to make a significant impact in a highly professional and strategic role. Join us and contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional service and operational efficiency. Apply now to be part of a global team committed to excellence!

The Opportunity

• Supply Planning: Develops global supply plan based on affiliate forecasts and GSC strategic guidance. Delivers supply plans to Manufacturing and supplier partners. Works with external suppliers to ensure agreed plans are met. In case of exception, works with partners to resolve situations with the least disruption to customers. Monitors cycle time, critical batches and the optimization of planning parameter settings to avoid destruction costs or stock outs. Monitors schedule adherence and discusses if below target during Supply Review meetings (S&OP). Monitors system alerts for potential / actual supply issues throughout the global network. Makes recommendations to provide timely resolution with minimum impact to customers: Works with IBL/IPM to define regional/country product allocations in case of bottleneck; Keeps Regions / Affiliates / BAs informed as to potential and actual product bottlenecks.

• Inventory & Product availability management: Manages inventories at global distribution centers to ensure high service level to customers at low

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
治疗领域经理

治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Senior Group Director, Technical Regulatory Affairs
titleByLocale.en: Senior Group Director, Technical Regulatory Affairs
titleByLocale.fr: Directeur du groupe principal, Affaires réglementaires techniques

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The people leader leads a team of China Technical Partners (CTPs) and CMC professionals that are accountable for China regulatory CMC submissions, through developing and implementing robust end-to-end China filing strategies based on close collaboration with global development teams, China business priorities, China regulatory requirements and landscape. The scope includes the complete Roche portfolio, the global products (small molecules, biologics, new modalities). The focus of this role is to lead and coach the team members in order to accelerate drug access and continuous supply to the patients by ensuring right first-time submissions to Chinese Health Authorities and effective interactions with the Health Authority. The incumbent of the role is responsible to shape the regulatory environment in China in close collaboration with PTR Policy and translate that into innovative regulatory strategies. In line with Roche’s China strategy and the China First initiative, this is a role with a high business impact.
In this position, the people leader is responsible for the management of China Technical Partners (CTPs) and CMC program managers, which includes setting performance objectives, providing timely feedback, and ensuring alignment of short-term development goals with longer-term career goals. Provides guidance and manages work activities of others for specific projects and/or objectives. Demonstrates the fundamentals of effective coaching skills and mentoring. Adapts coaching style to meet the needs of the individual.
The people leader leads cross-functional regulatory initiatives and strategies, defines associated critical steps and resources needed and takes responsibility for implementation of these initiatives and strategies. Proactively communicates with regulatory and cross-functional personnel in support of internal and partner-associated project goals. Collaborates with management in leading communications with HA on projects and initiatives of major complexity. Makes decisions based on cross-functional priorities rather than functional area priorities.

Project People Leader

• Provide leadership to a team of regulatory professionals.

• Responsible for performance management of employees.

• Work with direct reports and ensure that objective and timely feedback is provided to employees, focus on the development of the employee by facilitating regular development discussions and check-ins.

• Provide coaching and mentoring to colleagues for an assigned area of technical regulatory responsibility.

• Work closely with the Portfolio Leader to coordinate resources and priorities at a Portfolio level.

• Regularly follow up and check in the progress of every specific project in the team, enlighten the team to work out submission strategies for different applications and identify regulatory risks and develop migration plans.

• Build and maintain a healthy relationships with internal & external key stakeholders, like NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, Supply Chain, Quality and compliance, PDR China and PTR global,

• Collaborate with internal key stakeholders for development and alignment of technical strategy, maximizing and balancing regulatory and supply needs in China.

QUALIFICATIONS
Education
Master’s Degree in life science disciplines is preferred; Post Graduate Degree is a plus.

Experience

• 8 or more years work experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or related industry and CMC, quality, regulatory or related experience.

• Previous People management o

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il leader della gente guida un team di Cina partner tecnici (CTPs) e professionisti CMC che sono responsabili per le presentazioni CMC di regolamentazione della Cina, attraverso lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di robuste strategie di archiviazione end-to-end Cina basate sulla stretta collaborazione con i team di sviluppo globale, le priorità aziendali della Cina, i requisiti normativi della Cina e il paesaggio. La portata include il portafoglio completo di Roche, i prodotti globali (piccole molecole, biologiche, nuove modalità). L'obiettivo di questo ruolo è quello di guidare e allenare i membri del team al fine di accelerare l'accesso alla droga e la fornitura continua ai pazienti assicurando le giuste presentazioni di prima volta alle autorità sanitarie cinesi e le interazioni efficaci con l'Autorità sanitaria. L'incombente del ruolo è responsabile di modellare l'ambiente normativo in Cina in stretta collaborazione con PTR Policy e tradurlo in strategie normative innovative. In linea con la strategia cinese di Roche e la prima iniziativa della Cina, questo è un ruolo con un alto impatto commerciale. In questa posizione, il leader delle persone è responsabile per la gestione dei partner tecnici cinesi (CTPs) e dei gestori dei programmi CMC, che include l'impostazione degli obiettivi di performance, il feedback tempestivo e l'allineamento degli obiettivi di sviluppo a breve termine con obiettivi di carriera a lungo termine. Fornisce indicazioni e gestisce attività di lavoro di altri per progetti e/o obiettivi specifici. Dimostra i fondamenti delle competenze di coaching efficaci e di mentoring. Adapts stile di coaching per soddisfare le esigenze dell'individuo. Il leader delle persone guida iniziative e strategie di regolamentazione interfunzionali, definisce i passi critici associati e le risorse necessarie e si assume la responsabilità per l'attuazione di queste iniziative e strategie. Proattivamente comunica con personale normativo e interfunzionale a supporto degli obiettivi di progetto interni e associati ai partner. Collabora con la gestione nelle principali comunicazioni con HA su progetti e iniziative di grande complessità. Prende decisioni basate su priorità interfunzionali piuttosto che su priorità di area funzionale. Leader del progetto
• Fornire leadership a un team di professionisti di regolamentazione.
• Responsabile per la gestione delle prestazioni dei dipendenti.
• Lavorare con rapporti diretti e garantire che il feedback oggettivo e tempestivo sia fornito ai dipendenti, concentrarsi sullo sviluppo del dipendente facilitando le discussioni e i check-in di sviluppo regolari.
• Fornire coaching e mentoring ai colleghi per un'area assegnata di responsabilità tecnica di regolamentazione.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il Leader Portfolio per coordinare risorse e priorità a livello Portfolio.
• Seguire regolarmente e controllare i progressi di ogni progetto specifico nel team, illuminare il team per elaborare strategie di presentazione per diverse applicazioni e identificare i rischi normativi e sviluppare piani di migrazione.
• Costruire e mantenere un rapporto sano con gli stakeholder chiave interni ed esterni, come NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, Supply Chain, Qualità e conformità, PDR Cina e PTR globale,
• Collaborare con le parti interessate chiave interne per lo sviluppo e l'allineamento della strategia tecnica, massimizzare e bilanciare le esigenze normative e di fornitura in Cina. QUALIFICA Istruzione Laurea magistrale in scienze della vita è preferito; Laurea post è un plus. Esperienza
• 8 o più anni di esperienza lavorativa nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o relativo settore e CMC, qualità, normazione o relativa esperienza.
• Gestione delle persone precedenti

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le chef du personnel dirige une équipe de partenaires techniques chinois (PTC) et de professionnels du CMC qui sont responsables des présentations de CMC réglementaires en Chine, en élaborant et en mettant en oeuvre des stratégies de classement de bout en bout de la Chine fondées sur une collaboration étroite avec les équipes de développement mondial, les priorités commerciales de la Chine, les exigences réglementaires de la Chine et le paysage. La portée comprend le portefeuille complet de Roche, les produits mondiaux (petites molécules, produits biologiques, nouvelles modalités). Ce rôle a pour but de diriger et d'entraîner les membres de l'équipe afin d'accélérer l'accès aux médicaments et l'approvisionnement continu des patients en veillant à ce que les premières présentations appropriées aux autorités sanitaires chinoises et les interactions efficaces avec l'autorité sanitaire. Le titulaire du rôle est responsable de façonner l'environnement réglementaire en Chine en étroite collaboration avec la Politique sur les PTR et de la traduire en stratégies réglementaires novatrices. Conformément à la stratégie de la Chine et à l'initiative China First, il s'agit d'un rôle qui a un impact commercial élevé. Dans ce poste, le chef de file est responsable de la gestion des partenaires techniques de la Chine (PTC) et des gestionnaires de programme du MCC, ce qui comprend l'établissement d'objectifs de rendement, la fourniture de rétroaction en temps opportun et l'harmonisation des objectifs de perfectionnement à court terme avec les objectifs de carrière à plus long terme. Fournit des conseils et gère les activités de travail d'autres personnes pour des projets ou des objectifs précis. Démontre les principes fondamentaux de l'efficacité de l'encadrement et du mentorat. Adapte le style de coaching pour répondre aux besoins de l'individu. Le chef des personnes dirige des initiatives et des stratégies de réglementation interfonctionnelles, définit les étapes et les ressources essentielles qui s'y rattachent et assume la responsabilité de la mise en oeuvre de ces initiatives et stratégies. Communiquer de façon proactive avec le personnel de réglementation et le personnel interfonctionnel à l'appui des objectifs des projets internes et associés aux partenaires. Collabore avec la direction pour diriger les communications avec l'AP sur les projets et les initiatives de grande complexité. Prendre des décisions fondées sur des priorités interfonctionnelles plutôt que sur des priorités fonctionnelles. Chef de projet Personnes
• Diriger une équipe de professionnels de la réglementation.
• Responsable de la gestion de la performance des salariés.
• Collaborer avec des rapports directs et veiller à ce que des commentaires objectifs et opportuns soient fournis aux employés, en mettant l'accent sur le perfectionnement de l'employé en facilitant des discussions régulières sur le perfectionnement et des vérifications.
• Fournir un encadrement et un encadrement aux collègues dans un domaine de responsabilité réglementaire technique assigné.
• Collaborer étroitement avec le chef de portefeuille pour coordonner les ressources et les priorités au niveau du portefeuille.
• Suivre et vérifier régulièrement l'avancement de chaque projet spécifique de l'équipe, éclairer l'équipe pour élaborer des stratégies de soumission pour différentes applications, identifier les risques réglementaires et élaborer des plans de migration.
• Établir et maintenir des relations saines avec les principaux acteurs internes et externes, tels que NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, chaîne d'approvisionnement, qualité et conformité, PDR Chine et PTR mondial,
• Collaborer avec les principales parties prenantes internes à l'élaboration et à l'alignement de la stratégie technique, en maximisant et en équilibrage des besoins en matière de réglementation et d'approvisionnement en Chine. QUALIFICATIONS Éducation Masters Le diplôme en sciences de la vie est préféré; le diplôme d'études supérieures est un plus. Expérience
• 8 ans ou plus d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, la biotechnologie ou l'industrie connexe et le CMC, la qualité, la réglementation ou l'expérience connexe.
• Gestion des personnes précédente

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （ 1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （ 2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （ 3 ） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （ 4 ） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （ 1 ）在校大学生
• （ 2 ）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （ 3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （ 4 ）熟练运用 Excel 、 PPT 、 Word 等办公应用软件
• （ 5 ）拥有良好的英语书写能力

A healthier future drives us to innovate. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Technical Services and Operations (TSO) group within DDC is accountable for providing application support (Level 1-3) for hundreds of software solutions. In addition, TSO is responsible for DevOps and Operations for the DDC’ application landscape, both Cloud and On Premise. Finally, TSO provides technical support for systems that offer tools to train large language models (LLMs) and create autonomous agents, as well as ensuring users are effectively enabled to leverage these advanced systems, from LLM training platforms to autonomous agent building tools.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will join the TSO Leadership team and will work closely with DDC colleagues as well as directly with our key stakeholders including Computational Scientists, ML Scientists and Research Scientists. You will also work closely with vendors who provide managed services which form the core of many of the TSO activities.

You are an experienced and hands-on technical expert with the proven ability to lead and deliver enterprise scale technical operations. You will be managing operations for Applications and Software and also contributing as an SRE supporting our Infrastructure. Together with the Technical Operations leadership team, you will integrate expertise across on-premises operations, cloud services, and advanced AI/ML technologies. Your strategic focus will be on ensuring high performance, user enablement, and efficient service delivery while effectively managing relationships with external vendors. This comprehensive approach will drive operational excellence and support the evolving technical needs of our organization.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, i dati e le scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CS CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare il potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e mutevoli per la vita per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. All'interno dell'organizzazione CS CoE, l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduce l'ammodernamento dei nostri ecosistemi computazionali e dati integrando le tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per potenziare gli stakeholder, promuovere la scienza dei dati e accelerare il processo decisionale. Il gruppo Servizi Tecnici e Operazioni (TSO) all'interno di DDC è responsabile per fornire supporto alle applicazioni (Level 1-3) per centinaia di soluzioni software. Inoltre, TSO è responsabile per DevOps e Operazioni per il paesaggio delle applicazioni DDC, sia Cloud che On Premise. Infine, TSO fornisce supporto tecnico per sistemi che offrono strumenti per la formazione di modelli linguistici di grandi dimensioni (LLM) e per la creazione di agenti autonomi, oltre a garantire che gli utenti siano effettivamente abilitati a sfruttare questi sistemi avanzati, dalle piattaforme di formazione LLM agli strumenti di costruzione di agenti autonomi. Come Ingegnere Principale Software, si unirà al team di Leadership TSO e lavorerà a stretto contatto con i colleghi DDC e direttamente con i nostri principali stakeholder, tra cui scienziati computazionali, scienziati ML e scienziati di ricerca. Potrai anche lavorare a stretto contatto con i fornitori che forniscono servizi gestiti che formano il nucleo di molte delle attività TSO. Sei un esperto e pratico esperto tecnico con la comprovata capacità di guidare e fornire operazioni tecniche su scala aziendale. Potrai gestire le operazioni per applicazioni e software e contribuire anche come SRE supportando la nostra infrastruttura. Insieme al team di leadership Technical Operations, integrerai le competenze nelle operazioni on-premise, nei servizi cloud e nelle tecnologie AI/ML avanzate. Il vostro obiettivo strategico sarà quello di garantire prestazioni elevate, l'attivazione degli utenti e la consegna efficiente dei servizi, mentre la gestione efficace dei rapporti con i fornitori esterni. Questo approccio completo guiderà l'eccellenza operativa e sosterrà le esigenze tecniche in evoluzione della nostra organizzazione. L'opportunità

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Technical Services and Operations (TSO) group within DDC is accountable for providing application support (Level 1-3) for hundreds of software solutions. In addition, TSO is responsible for DevOps and Operations for the DDC’ application landscape, both Cloud and On Premise. Finally, TSO provides technical support for systems that offer tools to train large language models (LLMs) and create autonomous agents, as well as ensuring users are effectively enabled to leverage these advanced systems, from LLM training platforms to autonomous agent building tools.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will join the TSO Leadership team and will work closely with DDC colleagues as well as directly with our key stakeholders including Computational Scientists, ML Scientists and Research Scientists. You will also work closely with vendors who provide managed services which form the core of many of the TSO activities.

You are an experienced and hands-on technical expert with the proven ability to lead and deliver enterprise scale technical operations. You will be managing operations for Applications and Software and also contributing as an SRE supporting our Infrastructure. Together with the Technical Operations leadership team, you will integrate expertise across on-premises operations, cloud services, and advanced AI/ML technologies. Your strategic focus will be on ensuring high performance, user enablement, and efficient service delivery while effectively managing relationships with external vendors. This comprehensive approach will drive operational excellence and support the evolving technical needs of our organization.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les progrès de l'IA, des données et des sciences informatiques transforment la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Les organismes de recherche et de développement précoce de Genentech (GRED) et de Pharma (PRED) ont démontré comment ces technologies accélèrent la R-D, tirent parti des données et de nouveaux modèles de calcul pour produire des effets. Le partage de données sans soudure et l'accès aux modèles à travers gRED et pRED sont essentiels pour maximiser ces opportunités. Le Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles (CS CoE) est un groupe stratégique unifié dont l'objectif est d'exploiter la puissance transformatrice des données et de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider nos scientifiques dans les domaines pRED et gRED à fournir des médicaments plus innovants et changeants pour les patients du monde entier. Au sein de l'organisation du Conseil de l'Europe, l'organisation Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) dirige la modernisation de nos écosystèmes informatiques et de données en intégrant les technologies numériques dans la recherche et le développement précoce pour autonomiser les parties prenantes, faire progresser la science axée sur les données et accélérer la prise de décisions. Le groupe Services et opérations techniques (TSO) au sein du DDC est responsable de fournir un soutien aux applications (niveau 1-3) pour des centaines de solutions logicielles. En outre, TSO est responsable de DevOps et des opérations pour le paysage d'application DDC, à la fois Cloud et On Premise. Enfin, TSO fournit un soutien technique aux systèmes qui offrent des outils pour former de grands modèles de langue (LLM) et créer des agents autonomes, ainsi que pour veiller à ce que les utilisateurs soient efficacement en mesure de tirer parti de ces systèmes avancés, des plates-formes de formation LLM aux outils de construction d'agents autonomes. En tant qu'ingénieur principal du logiciel, vous vous joindrez à l'équipe de leadership de l'OST et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des collègues de DDC ainsi qu'avec nos principaux intervenants, notamment les scientifiques en informatique, les scientifiques en ML et les chercheurs. Vous travaillerez également en étroite collaboration avec les fournisseurs qui fournissent des services gérés qui constituent le cœur de nombreuses activités du BSF. Vous êtes un expert technique expérimenté et pratique avec la capacité éprouvée de diriger et de livrer des opérations techniques à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Vous gérerez les opérations pour les applications et les logiciels et contribuerez également en tant que SRE soutenant notre infrastructure. Avec l'équipe de direction des opérations techniques, vous intégrerez l'expertise dans les opérations sur site, les services cloud et les technologies avancées d'IA/ML. Votre objectif stratégique sera d'assurer une performance élevée, l'habilitation des utilisateurs et une prestation de services efficace tout en gérant efficacement les relations avec les fournisseurs externes. Cette approche globale favorisera l'excellence opérationnelle et soutiendra l'évolution des besoins techniques de notre organisation. L'opportunité
• Planification stratégique et intégration des services – Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des plans stratégiques alignés sur les objectifs organisationnels, intégrant les services gérés, les opérations sur site et les initiatives en nuage tout en tirant parti de l'IA comme un accélérateur clé.
• Engagement des fournisseurs et des parties prenantes – Relations avec les fournisseurs, négociation des contrats et respect des ALS.
• Excellence opérationnelle et gestion du changement – Appliquer les principes d'ingénierie logicielle aux opérations pour mettre à l'échelle et maintenir des systèmes de production très fiables, en conciliant la sortie rapide de nouvelles fonctionnalités w

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Solution Architect will design business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions to enable Roche’s omnichannel orchestration capabilities. This role focuses on building and scaling an integrated ecosystem leveraging Adobe Experience Platform (RT-CDP, AJO, CJA), ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, data strategy, and governance standards.
You will operate within a complex, multi-solution environment, driving the architecture vision across data, platforms, and activation use cases. The role requires balancing current delivery needs with long-term scalability, while ensuring robust handling of non-functional requirements (NFRs), data privacy, and system performance.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

• Define end-to-end omnichannel architecture aligned with business and enterprise standards

• Establish data models, identity frameworks, and integration patterns

• Manage NFRs (performance, scalability, security, compliance)

Data & Integration

• Integrate CRM, MDM, consent, and web/app event data
Enable unified customer profiles and audience segmentation

• Ensure data quality, governance, and privacy compliance

Platform (Adobe Stack)

• Architect and guide implementation of RT-CDP, AJO, and CJA

• Enable real-time segmentation, journey orchestration, and activation

• Ensure seamless integration with enterprise systems

Real-time & Orchestration

• Design event-driven and streaming architectures

• Enable multi-channel activation (email, paid media, others)

• Establish reusable audience and journey frameworks

Strategy & Delivery

• Define architecture roadmap and support delivery across use cases

• Identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities

• Drive adoption of best practices, patterns, and new technologies

Stakeholder Management

• Collaborate across business, product, and tech teams

• Communicate complex concepts clearly and drive alignment

Qualifications

Experience

• Proven experience in solution architecture within data and martech ecosystems

• Experience with CDPs and omnichannel platforms (Adobe preferred)

• Experience working in global, cross-functional teams

• Certifications on Adobe stack - (AJO, CJA and RT-CDP)

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of:

• Customer data platforms, identity resolution, segmentation

• Event-driven / streaming architectures

• Integration with CRM, MDM, consent systems

• Experience with APIs, cloud data platforms, and data governance concepts (GDPR)

What Success Looks Like

• Scalable omnichannel architecture aligned with enterprise standards

• Reliable data foundation enabling unified profiles and segmentation

• Real-time orchestration and activation across channels

• Measurable business impact through improved customer engagement

• Strong stakeholder alignment through clear communication and effective translation of complex concepts into business value

• Ability to influence and drive adoption of architectural decisions across cross-functional teams

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

We are seeking a visionary Data/Information Architect within the RDT Data Platforms function to lead the strategic design and implementation of our AI-driven Master Data Management (MDM) solutions. In this role, you will be the core architect enabling artificial intelligence across our MDM ecosystem, transforming legacy relational master records into intelligent, context-aware, and AI-ready data assets.

The first key priority of this architectural roadmap will focus on the modernization of Healthcare Professional (HCP) and Healthcare Organisation (HCO) master data programs , with a broader scaling strategy across alternative master data domains in future waves. A defining focus of your architectural design will be bridging the gap between traditional MDM platforms and advanced enterprise semantic layers, seamlessly transitioning master datasets into unified knowledge graphs that fuel cutting-edge Generative AI applications.

The Data Management and Data Quality Platforms area serves as the foundational intelligence engine of our global digital enterprise. Our mission is to scale a harmonized, FAIR-compliant master data framework that integrates heavily with an automated, AI-enabled Semantic Layer . By injecting contextual meaning, ontology standards, and relationship graphs into raw master data, we provide the enterprise with a single, high-trust, and discoverable view of our network. Joining this area means taking a leading role in ensuring that healthcare-specific data models remain contextually accurate, highly secure, compliant with global regulatory standards, and completely optimized for state-of-the-art machine learning deployment.

The opportunity:

• AI-Enabled MDM Architecture: Architect, design, and lead the technical execution of modernizing enterprise Master Data Management systems by integrating AI/ML capabilities for data matching, entity resolution, and data enrichment.

• HCP & HCO Program Leadership: Act as the primary technical architect for the foundational Healthcare Professional (HCP), Healthcare Organisation (HCO), and Business Partner/Vendor master data initiatives, ensuring high-fidelity modeling and scalability for subsequent domains.

• Semantic Layer Integration: Define the blueprints and mapping rules required to connect transactional master data with unified semantic layers, ontologies, and enterprise knowledge graphs.

• AI-Ready Data Engineering: Ensure that master data models are fully machine-readable and explicitly struct

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data/Information Architect - Piattaforme dati Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è il luogo in cui l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. In qualità di team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnici orientati al business impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale dell’assistenza sanitaria di domani. La nostra missione è potenziare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all’avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell’intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Spinti dallo scopo e dalla passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale sarà un punto di forza fondamentale per tutta Roche, consentendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, liberando il potenziale umano e promuovendo scoperte che contano davvero per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. In Roche offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità e collaborazione di persona. Per ora, richiediamo che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni di ufficio specifici possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi di collaborazione. Cerchiamo un visionario Data/Information Architect all'interno della funzione RDT Data Platforms per guidare la progettazione strategica e l'implementazione delle nostre soluzioni Master Data Management (MDM) basate sull'intelligenza artificiale. In questo ruolo, sarai l'architetto principale che abilita l'intelligenza artificiale nel nostro ecosistema MDM, trasformando i record anagrafici relazionali legacy in asset di dati intelligenti, sensibili al contesto e pronti per l'intelligenza artificiale. La prima priorità chiave di questa roadmap architetturale si concentrerà sulla modernizzazione dei programmi di dati master degli operatori sanitari (HCP) e delle organizzazioni sanitarie (HCO), con una strategia di scalabilità più ampia attraverso domini di dati master alternativi nelle ondate future. Un obiettivo determinante della progettazione dell'architettura sarà colmare il divario tra le piattaforme MDM tradizionali e i livelli semantici aziendali avanzati, trasformando senza soluzione di continuità i set di dati master in grafici della conoscenza unificati che alimentano applicazioni di intelligenza artificiale generativa all'avanguardia. L'area Data Management e Data Quality Platforms funge da motore di intelligence fondamentale della nostra impresa digitale globale. La nostra missione è quella di scalare un quadro di dati master armonizzato e conforme a FAIR che si integri fortemente con un livello semantico automatizzato e abilitato all'intelligenza artificiale. Inserendo significato contestuale, standard ontologici e grafici relazionali nei dati master grezzi, forniamo all'azienda una visione unica, altamente attendibile e rilevabile della nostra rete. Unirsi a quest’area significa assumere un ruolo di primo piano nel garantire che i modelli di dati specifici del settore sanitario rimangano contestualmente accurati, altamente sicuri, conformi agli standard normativi globali e completamente ottimizzati per l’implementazione del machine learning all’avanguardia. L'opportunità:
• Architettura MDM abilitata all'intelligenza artificiale: architettura, progettazione e guida dell'esecuzione tecnica della modernizzazione dei sistemi di gestione dei dati master aziendali integrando funzionalità AI/ML per la corrispondenza dei dati, la risoluzione delle entità e l'arricchimento dei dati.
• Leadership nei programmi HCP e HCO: agire come architetto tecnico primario per le iniziative di base dei professionisti sanitari (HCP), delle organizzazioni sanitarie (HCO) e dei partner commerciali/fornitori, garantendo modellazione ad alta fedeltà e scalabilità per i domini successivi.
• Integrazione del livello semantico: definire i modelli e le regole di mappatura necessarie per connettere i dati master transazionali con livelli semantici unificati, ontologie e grafici della conoscenza aziendale.
• Ingegneria dei dati pronta per l'intelligenza artificiale: garantisce che i modelli di dati master siano completamente leggibili dalle macchine e strutturati in modo esplicito

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und in den kommenden Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Daten-/Informationsarchitekt – Datenplattformen Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation auf Zweck trifft. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft geschäftsorientierter Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien voranzutreiben und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der die Digitalisierung eine zentrale Stärke von Roche darstellt. Wir ermöglichen intelligentere Arbeitsweisen, setzen menschliches Potenzial frei und treiben Durchbrüche voran, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wirklich von Bedeutung sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Derzeit verlangen wir von unseren Mitarbeitern, dass sie durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Townhalls, Teambesprechungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Wir suchen einen visionären Daten-/Informationsarchitekten innerhalb der RDT Data Platforms-Funktion, der das strategische Design und die Implementierung unserer KI-gesteuerten Master Data Management (MDM)-Lösungen leitet. In dieser Rolle sind Sie der Hauptarchitekt, der künstliche Intelligenz in unserem gesamten MDM-Ökosystem ermöglicht und ältere relationale Stammdatensätze in intelligente, kontextbezogene und KI-fähige Datenbestände umwandelt. Die erste Hauptpriorität dieser Architektur-Roadmap wird sich auf die Modernisierung der Stammdatenprogramme von Healthcare Professional (HCP) und Healthcare Organization (HCO) konzentrieren, mit einer breiteren Skalierungsstrategie über alternative Stammdatendomänen in zukünftigen Wellen. Ein entscheidender Schwerpunkt Ihres Architekturentwurfs wird darin bestehen, die Lücke zwischen traditionellen MDM-Plattformen und fortschrittlichen semantischen Unternehmensebenen zu schließen und Stammdatensätze nahtlos in einheitliche Wissensgraphen umzuwandeln, die hochmoderne generative KI-Anwendungen vorantreiben. Der Bereich Datenmanagement- und Datenqualitätsplattformen dient als grundlegender Intelligenzmotor unseres globalen digitalen Unternehmens. Unsere Mission ist es, ein harmonisiertes, FAIR-konformes Stammdaten-Framework zu skalieren, das sich stark in eine automatisierte, KI-gestützte semantische Schicht integrieren lässt. Indem wir kontextuelle Bedeutung, Ontologiestandards und Beziehungsdiagramme in Rohstammdaten einfügen, bieten wir dem Unternehmen eine einzige, äußerst vertrauenswürdige und auffindbare Ansicht unseres Netzwerks. Der Beitritt zu diesem Bereich bedeutet, eine führende Rolle dabei zu übernehmen, sicherzustellen, dass gesundheitsspezifische Datenmodelle kontextgenau, hochsicher, mit globalen Regulierungsstandards konform und vollständig für den Einsatz modernster maschineller Lernmethoden optimiert sind. Die Chance:
• KI-gestützte MDM-Architektur: Entwerfen, entwerfen und leiten Sie die technische Ausführung der Modernisierung von Stammdatenverwaltungssystemen für Unternehmen durch die Integration von KI/ML-Funktionen für den Datenabgleich, die Entitätsauflösung und die Datenanreicherung.
• HCP- und HCO-Programmleitung: Fungieren Sie als primärer technischer Architekt für die grundlegenden Stammdateninitiativen für medizinisches Fachpersonal (HCP), Gesundheitsorganisation (HCO) und Geschäftspartner/Anbieter und stellen Sie eine hochpräzise Modellierung und Skalierbarkeit für nachfolgende Bereiche sicher.
• Semantische Layer-Integration: Definieren Sie die Blaupausen und Zuordnungsregeln, die erforderlich sind, um transaktionale Stammdaten mit einheitlichen semantischen Layern, Ontologien und Unternehmenswissensgraphen zu verbinden.
• AI-Ready Data Engineering: Stellen Sie sicher, dass Stammdatenmodelle vollständig maschinenlesbar und explizit strukturierbar sind
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Architecte de données/informations - Plateformes de données Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation rencontre l'objectif. En tant qu’équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues à l’esprit commercial engagés à contribuer à façonner l’avenir numérique des soins de santé de demain. Notre mission est de propulser Roche grâce à des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Animés par un objectif et une passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique constitue une force essentielle dans l’ensemble de Roche, permettant des méthodes de travail plus intelligentes, libérant le potentiel humain et conduisant à des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous proposons un modèle de travail hybride qui allie flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l’instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient présents dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise, tels que des ateliers, des conférences, des assemblées publiques, des réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements collaboratifs. Nous recherchons un architecte de données/information visionnaire au sein de la fonction RDT Data Platforms pour diriger la conception stratégique et la mise en œuvre de nos solutions de gestion des données de référence (MDM) basées sur l'IA. Dans ce rôle, vous serez l'architecte principal permettant l'intelligence artificielle dans notre écosystème MDM, transformant les enregistrements maîtres relationnels existants en actifs de données intelligents, sensibles au contexte et prêts pour l'IA. La première priorité clé de cette feuille de route architecturale se concentrera sur la modernisation des programmes de données de base des professionnels de la santé (HCP) et des organisations de santé (HCO), avec une stratégie de mise à l'échelle plus large dans des domaines de données de base alternatifs dans les vagues futures. Un objectif déterminant de votre conception architecturale sera de combler le fossé entre les plates-formes MDM traditionnelles et les couches sémantiques d'entreprise avancées, en transformant de manière transparente les ensembles de données de base en graphiques de connaissances unifiés qui alimentent les applications d'IA générative de pointe. Le domaine des plates-formes de gestion des données et de qualité des données constitue le moteur d’intelligence fondamental de notre entreprise numérique mondiale. Notre mission est de mettre à l'échelle un cadre de données de référence harmonisé et conforme à la norme FAIR qui s'intègre fortement à une couche sémantique automatisée et activée par l'IA. En injectant une signification contextuelle, des normes d'ontologie et des graphiques de relations dans les données de base brutes, nous fournissons à l'entreprise une vue unique, hautement fiable et découvrable de notre réseau. Rejoindre ce domaine signifie jouer un rôle de premier plan pour garantir que les modèles de données spécifiques aux soins de santé restent contextuellement précis, hautement sécurisés, conformes aux normes réglementaires mondiales et entièrement optimisés pour le déploiement de l'apprentissage automatique de pointe. L'opportunité :
• Architecture MDM basée sur l'IA : concevez, concevez et dirigez l'exécution technique de la modernisation des systèmes de gestion des données de référence d'entreprise en intégrant des fonctionnalités d'IA/ML pour la mise en correspondance des données, la résolution d'entités et l'enrichissement des données.
• Leadership des programmes HCP et HCO : agir en tant qu'architecte technique principal pour les initiatives fondamentales de données de base des professionnels de la santé (HCP), des organisations de santé (HCO) et des partenaires commerciaux/fournisseurs, garantissant une modélisation haute fidélité et une évolutivité pour les domaines ultérieurs.
• Intégration de la couche sémantique : définissez les modèles et les règles de mappage requis pour connecter les données de base transactionnelles aux couches sémantiques, aux ontologies et aux graphiques de connaissances d'entreprise unifiés.
• Ingénierie des données prête pour l'IA : assurez-vous que les modèles de données maîtres sont entièrement lisibles par machine et explicitement structurés.

jobs.title: China Biomarker Studies Asset Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
YOUR TEAM
You will report to the HGR Officer and partner closely with the global biosample operations teams across the enterprise. You will be recognized as a leader and work autonomously in both local as well as global cross functional study teams.
ROLE PURPOSE
As a China Biosample Operations Asset Lead, you will provide biosample operational expertise to one or more cross-functional local or global study teams through all phases and stages in accordance with the appropriate quality standards and applicable local regulations.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• PROVIDE BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS GUIDANCE TO CLINICAL CHINA STUDY TEAMS AND GLOBAL STUDY TEAMS FOR CHINA RELATED ACTIVITIES by planning, coordinating, and overseeing all operational activities required to manage the lifecycle of study samples (collection, processing, analysis, data delivery and final disposition).

• LEAD THE DEVELOPMENT OF A CHINA SPECIFIC BIOMARKER MANAGEMENT PLAN WITHIN CLINICAL STUDIES based on input from scientific and operational stakeholders to execute biosample operational strategies in China

• PROVIDE INPUT TO HGRAC APPLICATION to support Country Study Managers - when applicable - and within Biosample Operations’ remit.

• PARTNER CLOSELY WITH BIOMARKER SCIENTISTS AND BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS PROGRAM LEADS LOCALLY AND GLOBALLY to align study specific activities with program sample collection strategies. Evaluate the operational feasibility of specific testing in China and provide input to global program teams.

• PROVIDE OPERATIONAL INPUT AND RECOMMENDATIONS INTO STUDY RELATED DOCUMENTATION AND PROCESSES (e.g. protocol, ICF, HGRAC applications)

• PRESENT CHINA STUDY SAMPLE COLLECTION STRATEGY AT OPERATIONS TEAM MEETINGS AND CHINA INVESTIGATOR MEETINGS

• CONTRIBUTE TO LOCAL LAB/ REGIONAL VENDOR SELECTION FOR SPECIFIC TESTING in collaboration with Biosample Ops Lead, biomarker scientist, Procurement and based on technology expertise, performance and compliance.

• ESTABLISH BIOSAMPLE ANALYSIS AND DATA DELIVERY MILESTONES AND ENSURE ACCURATE TRACKING AND REPORTING OF BIOSAMPLE METRICS (sample collection, assay status, analyses updates). Provide study level updates to the study and global biomarker teams. Support study teams in addressing local vendor/site sample queries. Actively partner with Data Management to oversee and coordinate data format, and delivery timelines.

• PROVIDE DAY TO DAY OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT OF CHINA BIOSAMPLE VENDORS. Partner with internal/external stakeholders in the central lab set up, providing sample collection and processing instructions. Review central lab documents to ensure alignment with protocol and HGRAC submissions. Perform ongoing biomarker vendor management including development and oversight of scope of work, budget and performance management. Interact with vendors to help evaluate data size for compliance, plan sample shipments, export, storage, define data retention, ensure samples are analysed and data are transferred.

• IDENTIFY AREAS OF BEST PRACTICE AND PROCESS IMPROVEMENTS. Contribute to the development of internal guidelines within Biosample Operations’ remit, based on HGRAC process and local regulations as well as program needs. Partner with relevant stakeholders, both locally and globally, to optimize processes for sample management in China.

• DEMONSTRATE AGILITY AND ABILITY TO PERFORM IN A HIGHLY FAST-PACED, MATRIX ENVIRONMENT WHERE CROSS-TEAM COLLABORATION IS CRUCIAL. Leverage excellent verbal and written communication skills to motivate teams, neg
