• PROVIDE BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS GUIDANCE TO CLINICAL CHINA STUDY TEAMS AND GLOBAL STUDY TEAMS FOR CHINA RELATED ACTIVITIES by planning, coordinating, and overseeing all operational activities required to manage the lifecycle of study samples (collection, processing, analysis, data delivery and final disposition).

• LEAD THE DEVELOPMENT OF A CHINA SPECIFIC BIOMARKER MANAGEMENT PLAN WITHIN CLINICAL STUDIES based on input from scientific and operational stakeholders to execute biosample operational strategies in China

• PROVIDE INPUT TO HGRAC APPLICATION to support Country Study Managers - when applicable - and within Biosample Operations’ remit.

• PARTNER CLOSELY WITH BIOMARKER SCIENTISTS AND BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS PROGRAM LEADS LOCALLY AND GLOBALLY to align study specific activities with program sample collection strategies. Evaluate the operational feasibility of specific testing in China and provide input to global program teams.

• PROVIDE OPERATIONAL INPUT AND RECOMMENDATIONS INTO STUDY RELATED DOCUMENTATION AND PROCESSES (e.g. protocol, ICF, HGRAC applications)

• PRESENT CHINA STUDY SAMPLE COLLECTION STRATEGY AT OPERATIONS TEAM MEETINGS AND CHINA INVESTIGATOR MEETINGS

• CONTRIBUTE TO LOCAL LAB/ REGIONAL VENDOR SELECTION FOR SPECIFIC TESTING in collaboration with Biosample Ops Lead, biomarker scientist, Procurement and based on technology expertise, performance and compliance.

• ESTABLISH BIOSAMPLE ANALYSIS AND DATA DELIVERY MILESTONES AND ENSURE ACCURATE TRACKING AND REPORTING OF BIOSAMPLE METRICS (sample collection, assay status, analyses updates). Provide study level updates to the study and global biomarker teams. Support study teams in addressing local vendor/site sample queries. Actively partner with Data Management to oversee and coordinate data format, and delivery timelines.

• PROVIDE DAY TO DAY OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT OF CHINA BIOSAMPLE VENDORS. Partner with internal/external stakeholders in the central lab set up, providing sample collection and processing instructions. Review central lab documents to ensure alignment with protocol and HGRAC submissions. Perform ongoing biomarker vendor management including development and oversight of scope of work, budget and performance management. Interact with vendors to help evaluate data size for compliance, plan sample shipments, export, storage, define data retention, ensure samples are analysed and data are transferred.

• IDENTIFY AREAS OF BEST PRACTICE AND PROCESS IMPROVEMENTS. Contribute to the development of internal guidelines within Biosample Operations’ remit, based on HGRAC process and local regulations as well as program needs. Partner with relevant stakeholders, both locally and globally, to optimize processes for sample management in China.

• DEMONSTRATE AGILITY AND ABILITY TO PERFORM IN A HIGHLY FAST-PACED, MATRIX ENVIRONMENT WHERE CROSS-TEAM COLLABORATION IS CRUCIAL. Leverage excellent verbal and written communication skills to motivate teams, neg

jobs.title: Medical Software Engineer - Complaint Handling

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere di software medico - Manipolazione di reclami
titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur en logiciel médical - Traitement des plaintes

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a focused investigative detective. Supported by senior experts, you will dive into code and logs to untangle software issues , growing your expertise in both cutting-edge IT and medical compliance frameworks. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

Main tasks:

• You are accountable for handling medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• Independently manage standard cases through their lifecycle, while partnering with senior colleagues to navigate complex or critical safety issues. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as a technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions. You can reference the Roche internal process confidently in discussions to justify decisions. You will consult with senior experts on technical and process-related aspects as needed.

• You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives to stakeholders in close collaboration with senior colleagues

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

Requirements:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.

• 2+ years of work experience in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions is desired

• Solid IT skills, especially the strong foundational ability to navigate and read source code in multiple languages, with an eagerness to learn complex system dependencies quickly

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Automation skills and experience with data analytics are a plus

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Sant Cugat del Vallès. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions th

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Ingegnere del Software nella Qualità del Mercato Postale (PMQ), sarete in prima linea nel garantire la qualità e le prestazioni delle Soluzioni Digitali di Roche, la gestione delle lamentele relative ai Sistemi Informativi Ospedalieri/Laboratori (HIS/LIS), reti di dati medici, soluzioni middleware, comunicazione dei dati, app e algoritmi. Unire il Capitolo Soluzioni Digitali significa lavorare in un ambiente software altamente trasversale, dandovi l'opportunità di impegnarsi con tecnologie all'avanguardia e linguaggi di programmazione diversi per il software on-premise e cloud-based. La vostra missione principale sarà quella di agire come detective investigativo concentrato. Supportato da esperti senior, si immergerà in codice e registri per unire i problemi del software, aumentando la vostra esperienza sia nei quadri di conformità IT all'avanguardia e medicale. Mentre la vostra attenzione è sull'analisi della causa principale, non sarete responsabili per le correzioni di bug finali. Questo ruolo è ambientato in un ambiente Agile dove le tue idee e le tue proposte innovative sono altamente apprezzate, contribuendo direttamente a un team focalizzato sul miglioramento continuo. Principali compiti:
• Sei responsabile per la gestione di reclami del software medico, problemi di sicurezza e richieste di prodotti software (su premessa, cloud, mobile, applicazioni,...).
• Gestire in modo indipendente i casi standard attraverso il loro ciclo di vita, mentre collaborare con i colleghi senior per navigare problemi di sicurezza complessi o critici. Per i casi che non possono essere risolti direttamente, si prende la proprietà di aumentare al reparto sviluppo.
• Si agisce come esperto tecnico per la risoluzione dei casi, utilizzando la capacità di leggere e comprendere il codice sorgente per identificare il fattore principale causa di malfunzionamenti software. È possibile fare riferimento al processo interno Roche con fiducia nelle discussioni per giustificare le decisioni. Si consulterà con esperti senior su aspetti tecnici e legati al processo, come necessario.
• Sarà responsabile della comunicazione tempestiva delle informazioni essenziali relative alla qualità e del supporto alle iniziative degli stakeholder in stretta collaborazione con i colleghi senior
• Utilizza le tue capacità di automazione e analisi dei dati per migliorare il processo di gestione dei casi e monitorare proattivamente i dati sulle prestazioni dei prodotti Requisiti:
• Una laurea in informatica o un campo relativo all'IT.
• 2+ anni di esperienza lavorativa nell'area dell'ingegneria del software o funzioni correlate supporto IT è desiderato
• Competenze informatiche solide, in particolare la forte capacità di base di navigare e leggere il codice sorgente in più lingue, con l'ansia di imparare le dipendenze di sistema complesse rapidamente
• Forte capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato)
• Capacità di automazione e esperienza con l'analisi dei dati sono un plus Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Sant Cugat del Vallès. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter offrire soluzioni sanitarie mutevoli per la vita

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Als Software-Ingenieur in Post Market Quality (PMQ) sind Sie an der Spitze der Sicherstellung der Qualität und Leistung von Roche’s Digital Solutions, Behandlung von Beschwerden im Zusammenhang mit Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medizinische Datennetze, Middleware-Lösungen, Datenkommunikation, Apps und Algorithmen. Mit dem Digital Solutions Chapter arbeiten Sie in einem hochtransversalen Software-Umfeld und bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, sich mit modernsten Technologien und verschiedenen Programmiersprachen sowohl für On-Premise als auch für Cloud-basierte Software zu engagieren. Ihre Kernaufgabe wird es sein, als fokussierter investigativer Detective zu fungieren. Unterstützt von hochrangigen Experten, tauchen Sie in Code und Protokolle, um Software-Probleme zu entwirren, Ihre Expertise in modernsten IT- und medizinischen Compliance-Frames zu erweitern. Während Ihr Fokus auf der Wurzelursanalyse liegt, werden Sie nicht für die letzten Fehlerbehebungen verantwortlich sein. Diese Rolle ist in einer Agile-Umgebung festgelegt, in der Ihre innovativen Ideen und Vorschläge hoch geschätzt werden und direkt zu einem Team beitragen, das sich auf eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung konzentriert. Hauptaufgaben:
• Sie sind verantwortlich für die Behandlung von medizinischen Softwarebeschwerden, Sicherheitsfragen und Produktanfragen für Softwareprodukte (auf Prämisse, Cloud, Mobile, Apps,...).
• Unabhängige Verwaltung von Standard-Fällen durch ihren Lebenszyklus, während die Zusammenarbeit mit Senior-Kollegen, um komplexe oder kritische Sicherheitsprobleme zu navigieren. Für Fälle, die nicht direkt gelöst werden können, nehmen Sie das Eigentum an der Eskalation an der Entwicklungsabteilung.
• Sie fungieren als technischer Experte für Fallauflösung, indem Sie Ihre Fähigkeit nutzen, Quellcode zu lesen und zu verstehen, um den Ursachefaktor von Softwarestörungen zu identifizieren. Sie können den internen Prozess von Roche zuversichtlich in Diskussionen zur Rechtfertigung von Entscheidungen verweisen. Sie werden sich bei Bedarf mit hochrangigen Experten zu technischen und verfahrensbezogenen Aspekten beraten.
• Sie werden für die zeitnahe Kommunikation wesentlicher qualitätsrelevanter Informationen und unterstützende Initiativen an Interessenvertreter in enger Zusammenarbeit mit hochrangigen Kollegen verantwortlich sein
• Sie nutzen Ihre Automatisierungs- und Datenanalysefähigkeiten, um den Fallbearbeitungsprozess zu verbessern und Produktleistungsdaten proaktiv zu überwachen Anforderungen:
• Ein Abschluss in Informatik oder ein IT-bezogenes Feld.
• 2+ Jahre Arbeitserfahrung im Bereich Software-Engineering oder IT-Support-bezogene Funktionen sind erwünscht
• Solide IT-Fähigkeiten, insbesondere die starke Basisfähigkeit, Quellcode in mehreren Sprachen zu navigieren und zu lesen, mit einer Eifer, komplexe Systemabhängigkeiten schnell zu lernen
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch (schriftlich und gesprochen)
• Automatisierungskompetenzen und Erfahrungen mit Datenanalysen sind ein Plus Bei Anwendung der Bezahlungstransparenz werden auf der Basis des primären Buchungsorts Angaben gemacht. Für diese Rolle ist die primäre Lage Sant Cugat del Vallès. Wenn Sie an weiteren Standorten interessiert sind, an denen die Rolle zur Verfügung stehen kann, stellen wir die entsprechenden Vergütungsdetails später im Einstellungsprozess zur Verfügung. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen anbieten können
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel en qualité post-commercialisation (PMQ), vous serez à l'avant-garde de la qualité et des performances des solutions numériques de Roches, du traitement des plaintes liées aux systèmes d'information hospitaliers/laboratoires (HIS/LIS), aux réseaux de données médicales, aux solutions intermédiaires, à la communication de données, aux applications et aux algorithmes. Rejoindre le chapitre Solutions numériques signifie travailler dans un environnement logiciel hautement transversal, vous donnant la possibilité de vous engager avec des technologies de pointe et divers langages de programmation pour les logiciels sur site et cloud. Votre mission principale sera d'agir comme un détective d'investigation ciblé. Avec le soutien d'experts chevronnés, vous plongerez dans le code et les journaux pour démêler les problèmes logiciels, développant votre expertise dans les cadres de conformité informatique et médicale de pointe. Bien que votre attention soit sur l'analyse de la cause racine, vous ne serez pas responsable de la correction finale du bug. Ce rôle est établi dans un environnement agile où vos idées et propositions innovantes sont très appréciées, contribuant directement à une équipe axée sur l'amélioration continue. Principales tâches:
• Vous êtes responsable du traitement des plaintes relatives aux logiciels médicaux, des problèmes de sécurité et des demandes de renseignements sur les produits logiciels (sur place, cloud, mobile, applications,...).
• Gérer indépendamment les cas standard tout au long de leur cycle de vie, tout en s'associant à des collègues de haut niveau pour aborder des questions de sécurité complexes ou critiques. Pour les cas qui ne peuvent être résolus directement, vous prenez en main l'escalade vers le département du développement.
• Vous agissez en tant qu'expert technique pour la résolution de cas, en utilisant votre capacité à lire et comprendre le code source pour identifier le facteur de cause racine des dysfonctionnements logiciels. Vous pouvez citer le processus interne de Roche avec confiance dans les discussions pour justifier les décisions. Vous consulterez des experts de haut niveau sur les aspects techniques et liés aux processus au besoin.
• Vous serez responsable de la communication en temps opportun des informations essentielles liées à la qualité et des initiatives d'appui aux parties prenantes, en étroite collaboration avec des collègues de haut niveau
• Vous utilisez vos compétences d'automatisation et d'analyse de données pour améliorer le processus de traitement des cas et surveiller de manière proactive les données sur les performances des produits Exigences:
• Diplôme en informatique ou en informatique.
• 2 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans le domaine de l'ingénierie logicielle ou des fonctions liées au support informatique est souhaitée
• Des compétences informatiques solides, en particulier la forte capacité fondamentale de naviguer et de lire le code source dans plusieurs langues, avec un désir d'apprendre rapidement des dépendances complexes du système
• Fortes compétences en communication en anglais (écrit et parlé)
• Capacités d'automatisation et expérience en matière d'analyse de données Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'emplacement principal est Sant Cugat del Vallès. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de soins de santé qui changent la vie

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner - Immune Ecosystem
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Local customer facing role unlocking value along patient journeys
Roche is a company with a 125 year history and our ongoing success is based on our strong focus on delivering meaningful value for our customers and society, and we will need to evolve our offering and approach in order to do so.
In response to the increasingly volatile world we live in, Roche Pharma International began a wide scale transformation process - changing our ways of working to be more agile, less hierarchical, highly collaborative. Now we take the next STEP in our journey focusing on how we can deliver the greatest value and make a meaningful difference to our customers, patients and society.

Mission and responsibilities:
As the Patient Journey Partner (PJP), you will be at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering extraordinary medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption.
You will be locally embedded and integrated in the healthcare ecosystem in a functionally agnostic way (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs).
As an empowered leader and the face of Roche, you will collaborate closely with all partners directly touching the patient journey, gaining a deep understanding of their needs, in service of connecting Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions. In addition, you will be responsible for:

• Acting as a trusted partner and the primary point of contact between stakeholders and Roche, prioritising and securing resources, and driving solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• Collaborating with patient journey partners to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• Guiding Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supporting their appropriate use, sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.

• Ensuring great experiences whenever partners in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services.

Who are you:
You demonstrate personal purpose in improving the patient journey, as well as a strong passion to bring value and impact to the healthcare ecosystem.
You are a true visionary, defining and embedding the strategy around creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand).

In addition, you bring the following skills & experience:

• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche

• Self managed and self directed - altruistic in supporting the global network

• Display of integrity in everything as a leader who senses, reflects and responds

• Boldly acts on key decisions and opportunities and boldly stops any activity that is not adding value. Ability to say “No” to partners when the value is not predictable/foreseen.

• Excellent stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and organizations is required. Experience partnering with Patient Advocacy Groups (PGAs) is highly desired.

• Experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrating cross-functional teams

• Strong eye for business with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience excell

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapte r is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos.

The Role

We are seeking an R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist I to join our global service and support team. You are well organized and detail-oriented. You will be the reliable service provider handling critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients.

This role requires building organizational know-how—understanding who our internal customers are, how they work, and solving problems in a way that anticipates their support needs. You are quick in learning new software systems and tools, enjoy helping your coworkers every day, and are motivated to innovate internal processes to automate tasks, you will fit right into our team!

Your key Responsibilities

As a part of a global centralized expert support team, execute enterprise tool system tasks based on R&D customer requests, leveraging expert knowledge of business tools, compliance requirements, and R&D teams and processes.

• Execute R&D System Requests: Fulfill customer tool requests using expertise in business systems and compliance standards.

• Provide Timely Expert Support: Offer professional, empathetic, and quick solutions to R&D operational issues and system problems. You may be the primary contact for R&D scientists and engineers in the use of our internal enterprise systems.

• Expert in our Global Business Applications: Act as the subject matter expert for one or more complex R&D business applications.

• Specialize in R&D Business Processes: Develop deep expertise in key processes (e.g., records management, lab data, training system data, change requests) for timely and accurate execution.

• Maximize Scientist Productivity: Use your expertise across business data and organizational structure to streamline operations and save significant time for R&D scientists.

• Anticipate Customer Needs: Build organizational know-how of R&D roles and priorities to deliver proactive system support.

• Maintain Global Service Excellence: Demonstrate a strong, collaborative customer service mindset within a diverse, global team.

• Drive Process Improvement: Identify manual steps and actively suggest opportunities for digitization and improvement.

• Automate Administrative Tasks: Apply or develop automation and AI tools to reduce administrative load on R&D staff.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes, supporting audits and data retrieval.

Who you are:

Education : Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical, scientific, or business discipline.

Experience : 2+ years of professional experience in an operations, technical support, or system administration role, or equivalent academic projects / internships

Language Skills: Excellent written and verbal English Language skills are required to support our global organization. German language skills are a plus.

System Proficiency:

• Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new software, systems, and processes is essential.

• P

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapter is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing the complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos.

The Role

We are seeking an R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist II to join our global internal service and support team. In this mid-level role, you will apply your conceptual knowledge and significant working experience to perform a range of assignments with limited guidance. You will act as a reliable service provider with a customer-oriented mindset to handle critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients.
Rather than just managing system change requests, you will manage the integrity of the business process within our internal tools. By developing a deep understanding of the R&D organization and unique team needs, you will translate diverse business needs into effective system and data configurations. You will handle complex requests, ensuring that as our internal digital infrastructure evolves, our global R&D teams remain compliant, organized, and productive.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute System Requests with Limited Guidance: Fulfill customer requests and generate business metrics by performing a range of assignments related to your discipline, ensuring that enterprise system tool configurations / data updates align with actual R&D workflows / needs.

• Anticipate and Solve Complex Problems: Understand the impact of system changes on the broader level to anticipate issues. Analyze possible solutions to operational issues and system problems by relying on your experience, judgment, and established precedents.

• Functional Decision-Making: Use your knowledge of your internal customers (the R&D teams) and their diverse needs to make informed decisions on system logic, such as grouping training curricula based on learner job functions, or making logical document hierarchies based on your learned organisational knowledge.

• Organizational Transition Management: Execute structural data migrations and updates within system tools driven by acquisitions, reorganizations, and digitalization projects to ensure user permissions, configurations, access, and data reflect the current state of the company.

• Mentorship and Guidance: Provide guidance to new team members and R&D internal customers. Based on your expertise navigating our enterprise tool workflows, configurations, and data - you provide guidance and oversight of system usage. You routinely will need to explain information to others in a straightforward manner, and deliver presentations when needed to support training, onboarding, and engaging stakeholders participation in our projects.

• Anticipate Customer Needs: Understand key organizational drivers and areas of expertise to proactively anticipate needs, accomplish your work, and represent internal customers' needs to global project teams.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes

• Provide data monitoring and statistics You may be asked to support audits by showing adherence to our quality management systems and pr

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Service Engineer

W Roche Diagnostics skupiamy się na wprowadzaniu innowacyjnych rozwiązań w obszarze medycyny laboratoryjnej. W Polsce działamy od kilkudziesięciu lat i należymy do wiodących pracodawców na światowym rynku diagnostycznym. Opracowujemy i wdrażamy rozwiązania diagnostyczne, które odpowiadają dzisiejszym wyzwaniom i są przygotowane na przyszłe potrzeby.

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy Specjalisty/-ki ds. Serwisu Technicznego z województwa mazowieckiego .

Zatrudnienie przez zewnętrzną agencję na okres 18 miesięcy

Zadania:

• Instalacje i wdrażanie aparatury laboratoryjnej

• Naprawy gwarancyjne i pogwarancyjne sprzętu

• Szkolenia klientów z obsługi aparatury i systemów laboratoryjnych

• Pomoc techniczna dla klientów

• Raportowanie wyników pracy

O Tobie:

• Mieszkasz na terenie województwa mazowieckiego

• Posiadasz wyższe wykształcenie techniczne (preferowane: mechanika precyzyjna, elektronika lub pokrewne)

• Z łatwością potrafisz zrozumieć potrzeby Klienta i efektywnie się komunikować

• Posiadasz prawo jazdy kategorii B

• Dobrze znasz język angielski (min. B2)

• Umiesz priorytetyzować zadania i pracować pod presją czasu

• Doświadczenie w pracy na podobnym stanowisku będzie dodatkowym atutem

Oferujemy:

• Zatrudnienie na podstawie umowy o pracę tymczasową

• Pracę w przyjaznej atmosferze w międzynarodowym środowisku

• Możliwość wdrażania własnych inicjatyw

• Program szkoleniowy i wdrożeniowy

Brzmi interesująco? Nie czekaj - aplikuj!

Administratorem danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Domaniewskiej 28 (02-672). Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Osobom, które zaaplikują przysługuje prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-dia-pl

Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. działa w pełnej zgodności z przepisami prawa i nie toleruje żadnych naruszeń. W Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. obowiązuje Procedura zgłaszania naruszeń prawa. W przypadku chęci zgłoszenia nieprawidłowości związanych z naszą działalnością, wszelkie niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgłaszania naruszeń znajdują się na naszej stronie internetowej: https://www.roche.pl/kontakt/ochrona-sygnalistow-zglaszanie-naruszen .

Compensation & Benefits
Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Poland. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Information about the compensation package for this position will be provided ahead of any interview

A healthier future drives us to innovate. jobs.title: Head of Healthcare Transformation

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de la transformation des soins de santé

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose

• The Head of Healthcare Transformation serves as a cornerstone in advancing Roche Diagnostics' commitment to enhancing patient care. By synthesizing clinical evidence, access frameworks, and governmental advocacy with business development, this leader ensures that breakthrough diagnostics gain market entry, clinical recognition, and financial sustainability within Taiwan. This executive role fundamentally evolves the local medical landscape while establishing Roche as a premier partner in the health ecosystem.

• A primary focus involves the evaluation and refinement of healthcare pathways and public policy to foster robust internal and external partnerships, thereby modernizing the local environment to drive substantive commercial growth. Achieving systemic change necessitates the seamless integration of policy shaping, medical insights and reimbursement expertise. Furthermore, you will identify and cultivate emerging business opportunities that respond to shifting clinical trends, overseeing the launch of programs that improve healthcare delivery and ensure the enduring availability of innovative diagnostic tools.

• Possessing a profound sense of purpose, the incumbent will mobilize teams to achieve superior outcomes under the "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan" vision, directly contributing to the execution of the RDTW 1000 days strategic roadmap.

• In this capacity, you will demonstrate an entrepreneurial spirit and system-wide perspective, converting visionary concepts into disciplined, high-impact strategies that secure organizational success across both immediate and future horizons.

• As a member of the RD Taiwan Leadership Team, you will role model VACC behaviors and uphold the LT Purpose Statement. Close collaboration with peers across the Leadership Team is essential to realize the company's broader objectives. This leadership approach centers on cultivating high-performing, customer-centric teams within an agile and continuously evolving organizational culture.

• Ultimately, you must exhibit the determination and resilience required to transform Taiwan's healthcare landscape, embodying the core Roche mission: "Doing what patients need next."

Key Responsibilities:

• Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute an integrated medical, market access & policy strategy aligned with global/regional guidelines and local business objectives.

• Medical Affairs Strategy: Lead the generation and dissemination of scientific evidence, foster strategic relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and medical societies, and ensure scientific accuracy in all activities.

• Market Access & Reimbursement: Drive successful NHI (National Health Insurance) listing and optimal pricing strategies for key diagnostic products, utilizing health economics and outcomes research (HEOR).

• Public Policy & Government Affairs: Proactively monitor the healthcare policy landscape. Engage collaboratively with government authorities (e.g., MOHW, NHIA), industry associations, and patient advocacy groups to shape favorable policies for diagnostic innovations.

• Business Development: Identify, develop, and manage strategic emerging business opportunities and partnerships that promote growth and innovation and ensure the delivery of scalable and impactful healthcare solutions.

• Team Leadership & VACC Culture: Lead, coach, and inspire a cross-functional Medical, Market Access, Policy and Business Development team to unl

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

A Roche, potete presentarsi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove siete apprezzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Così ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Scopo del ruolo

- Il responsabile della trasformazione sanitaria serve da pietra angolare per far progredire l'impegno di Roche Diagnostics per migliorare l'assistenza ai pazienti. Sintassi delle prove cliniche, quadri di accesso e difesa governativa con lo sviluppo delle imprese, questo leader assicura che la diagnostica di innovazione ottenere l'ingresso sul mercato, riconoscimento clinico e sostenibilità finanziaria all'interno di Taiwan. Questo ruolo esecutivo evolve fondamentalmente il paesaggio medico locale, mentre la creazione di Roche come partner kicker nell'ecosistema sanitario.

- Un obiettivo primario consiste nella valutazione e nel perfezionamento dei percorsi sanitari e della politica pubblica per promuovere solidi partenariati interni ed esterni, modernizzando così l'ambiente locale per stimolare una crescita commerciale sostanziale. Il raggiungimento di un cambiamento sistemico richiede l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità tra definizione delle politiche, approfondimenti medici e competenze in materia di rimborso.

Inoltre, potrete individuare e coltivare opportunità di business emergenti che rispondono alle mutevoli tendenze cliniche, supervisionando il lancio di programmi che migliorano la fornitura di assistenza sanitaria e garantire la disponibilità duratura di strumenti diagnostici innovativi.

- Possesso un profondo senso dello scopo, l'operatore storico mobiliterà i team per ottenere risultati superiori sotto la visione "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan," contribuendo direttamente all'esecuzione della roadmap strategica RDTW 1000 giorni.

- In questa veste, si dimostrerà uno spirito imprenditoriale e una prospettiva di sistema, convertendo concetti visionari in strategie disciplinari e ad alto impatto che garantiscono il successo organizzativo in orizzonti sia immediati che futuri.

- Come membro del team di leadership di RD Taiwan, potrai svolgere un ruolo modello di comportamento VACC e sostenere la dichiarazione di intenti LT. Una stretta collaborazione con i pari in tutto il team di leadership è essenziale per realizzare gli obiettivi più ampi dell'azienda. Questo approccio di leadership si concentra sulla coltivazione di team ad alte prestazioni, customer-centric all'interno di una cultura organizzativa able e in continua evoluzione.

- In definitiva, è necessario mostrare la determinazione e la resilienza necessaria per trasformare il paesaggio sanitario di Taiwan, incarnando la missione principale Roche: "Fare ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno di prossimo."

Responsabilità chiave

- Leadership strategica: sviluppare ed attuare una strategia integrata in materia di salute, accesso al mercato e politica, in linea con gli orientamenti globali/regionali e gli obiettivi aziendali locali.

- Strategia per gli affari medici: guidare la generazione e la diffusione di prove scientifiche, promuovere relazioni strategiche con i leader chiave dell'opinione (KOL) e le società mediche, e garantire l'accuratezza scientifica in tutte le attività.

- Accesso al mercato e rimborso: Guidare successo NHI (National Health Insurance) elenco e strategie di prezzi ottimali per i principali prodotti diagnostici, utilizzando l'economia sanitaria e la ricerca sui risultati (HEOR).

- Politica pubblica e affari governativi: monitorare proattivamente il panorama della politica sanitaria. Coinvolgere in collaborazione con le autorità governative (ad esempio, MOHW, NHIA), associazioni di settore e gruppi di sostegno dei pazienti per definire politiche favorevoli per le innovazioni diagnostiche.

- Sviluppo di imprese: individuare, sviluppare e gestire opportunità commerciali e partnership strategiche emergenti che promuovano la crescita e l'innovazione e garantiscano l'erogazione di soluzioni sanitarie di tipo "bassa" e "impatto."

- Team Leadership & Cultura VACC: guida, allenatore e ispirare un team di assistenza medica, accesso al mercato, politica e sviluppo aziendale per liberare il loro pieno potenziale e sostenere la cultura VACC.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, sich für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen, einsetzen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönliche Ausdrucksweisen, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, für wen Sie sind, damit Sie persönlich und professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat, heute und für Generationen.

Die Position

Aufgabenbereich

- Der Leiter der Healthcare Transformation ist ein Eckpfeiler für die Weiterentwicklung des Engagements von Roche Diagnostics für die Verbesserung der Patientenversorgung. Durch die Synthese klinischer Evidenz, Zugangsrahmen und staatliches Engagement für die Geschäftsentwicklung sorgt dieser Marktführer dafür, dass bahnbrechende Diagnosen in Taiwan Markteintritt, klinische Anerkennung und finanzielle Nachhaltigkeit gewinnen. Diese Führungsrolle entwickelt die lokale medizinische Landschaft grundlegend weiter und etabliert Roche als führenden Partner im Gesundheitsökosystem.

- Ein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Bewertung und Verfeinerung der Gesundheitswege und der öffentlichen Politik, um robuste interne und externe Partnerschaften zu fördern und damit die lokale Umwelt zu modernisieren, um ein substanzielles kommerzielles Wachstum zu fördern.

Darüber hinaus werden Sie neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten identifizieren und pflegen, die auf die Verschiebung der klinischen Trends reagieren, die Einführung von Programmen überwachen, die die Gesundheitsversorgung verbessern und die dauerhafte Verfügbarkeit innovativer Diagnoseinstrumente gewährleisten.

- Die Entscheidung über einen tiefen Sinn für eine bestimmte Aufgabe wird die etablierten Teams mobilisieren, um im Rahmen der Vision "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan" bessere Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die direkt zur Umsetzung der strategischen Roadmap RDTW 1000 Tage beitragen.

- In dieser Funktion zeigen Sie unternehmerischen Geist und systemweite Perspektive, visionäre Konzepte in disziplinierte, hochwirksame Strategien umzuwandeln, die organisatorischen Erfolg sowohl über unmittelbare als auch über zukünftige Horizonte sichern.

- Als Mitglied des RD Taiwan Leadership Teams werden Sie modellhaft VACC-Verhaltensverhaltens und die LT-Zweckerklärung aufrecht erhalten. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Gleichaltrigen im gesamten Leadership Team ist unerlässlich, um die breiteren Ziele des Unternehmens zu verwirklichen. Dieser Führungsansatz konzentriert sich auf die Kultivierung hochperformanter, kundenorientierter Teams innerhalb einer agilen und sich ständig weiterentwickelnden Organisationskultur.

- Letztlich müssen Sie die Entschlossenheit und Widerstandsfähigkeit aufweisen, die erforderlich sind, um Taiwans Gesundheitslandschaft zu verändern, und die Kernaufgabe von Roche verkörpern: "Tun, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen."

Wichtige Aufgaben

- Strategische Führung: Entwicklung und Durchführung einer integrierten medizinischen, Marktzugangs- und Politikstrategie, die mit globalen/regionalen Leitlinien und lokalen Geschäftszielen abgestimmt ist.

- Strategie für medizinische Angelegenheiten: Führen Sie die Generierung und Verbreitung wissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse, fördern Sie strategische Beziehungen zu Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) und medizinischen Gesellschaften und gewährleisten Sie wissenschaftliche Genauigkeit in allen Aktivitäten.

- Marktzugang & Rückzahlung: Führen Sie die erfolgreiche NHI-Liste (National Health Insurance) und optimale Preisstrategien für wichtige diagnostische Produkte durch, indem Sie Gesundheitsökonomie und Ergebnisforschung (HEOR) nutzen.

- Public Policy & Government Affairs: Proaktiv die Gesundheitspolitiklandschaft überwachen. Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden (z.B. MOHW, NHIA), Industrieverbänden und Patientengruppen zur Gestaltung günstiger Strategien für diagnostische Innovationen.

- Business Development: Ermittlung, Entwicklung und Verwaltung von strategischen aufstrebenden Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Partnerschaften, die Wachstum und Innovation fördern und die Bereitstellung skalierbarer und wirkungsvoller Gesundheitslösungen gewährleisten.

- Team Leadership & VACC Culture: Führen, coachen und inspirieren Sie ein funktionsübergreifendes Team aus den Bereichen Medizin, Marktzugang, Politik und Business Development, um ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten und die VACC-Kultur zu wahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassés pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à assurer que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir.

La position

Rôle Objet

- Le chef de la transformation des soins de santé est la pierre angulaire de l'engagement de Roche Diagnostics à améliorer les soins aux patients. En synthétisant les données cliniques, les cadres d'accès et la défense des intérêts des gouvernements avec le développement des entreprises, ce chef de file s'assure que les diagnostics révolutionnaires obtiennent l'entrée sur le marché, la reconnaissance clinique et la viabilité financière à Taiwan.

- L'évaluation et le perfectionnement des voies de soins de santé et des politiques publiques pour favoriser des partenariats internes et externes solides, modernisant ainsi l'environnement local pour stimuler une croissance commerciale substantielle.

De plus, vous identifierez et cultiverez les nouvelles occasions d'affaires qui répondent aux tendances cliniques changeantes, superviserez le lancement de programmes qui améliorent la prestation des soins de santé et assureront la disponibilité durable d'outils de diagnostic novateurs.

- S'appuyant sur un profond sens de l'objectif, le titulaire mobilisera des équipes pour obtenir des résultats supérieurs dans le cadre de la vision « Diagnostics de Pioneering et façonner des soins de santé efficaces à Taiwan », contribuant directement à l'exécution de la feuille de route stratégique de 1000 jours de la Stratégie.

- En cette qualité, vous démontrerez un esprit d'entreprise et une perspective à l'échelle du système, en convertissant des concepts visionnaires en stratégies disciplinées et à fort impact qui assurent le succès organisationnel dans l'immédiat et dans l'avenir.

- En tant que membre de l'équipe de leadership RD Taiwan, vous jouerez un rôle de modèle de comportement VACC et de maintien de l'énoncé de but LT. Une collaboration étroite avec les pairs de l'équipe de leadership est essentielle pour réaliser les objectifs plus généraux de l'entreprise.

- En fin de compte, vous devez faire preuve de la détermination et de la résilience nécessaires pour transformer le paysage de la santé de Taiwan, en incarneant la mission de Roche : « Faire ce dont les patients ont besoin ensuite. »

Principales responsabilités

- Leadership stratégique : Élaborer et exécuter une stratégie intégrée en matière de santé, d'accès aux marchés et de politique générale, alignée sur les orientations mondiales/régionales et les objectifs commerciaux locaux.

- Stratégie relative aux affaires médicales : Diriger la production et la diffusion de données scientifiques, favoriser les relations stratégiques avec les leaders clés de l'opinion (KOL) et les sociétés médicales, et assurer la précision scientifique de toutes les activités.

- Accès au marché et remboursement : faire en sorte que l'INS (assurance-maladie nationale) soit bien cotée et que les stratégies de tarification optimales pour les principaux produits diagnostiques soient utilisées à l'aide de la recherche sur l'économie et les résultats de la santé (HEOR).

- Politique publique et affaires gouvernementales : surveiller de façon proactive le paysage des politiques de santé.

- Développement des entreprises : Identifier, développer et gérer des opportunités et des partenariats stratégiques émergents qui favorisent la croissance et l'innovation et assurent la fourniture de solutions de santé évolutives et efficaces.

- Leadership d'équipe et culture VACC : Diriger, entraîner et inspirer une équipe interfonctionnelle de développement des politiques, des politiques et des affaires médicales et de l'accès aux marchés afin de libérer tout leur potentiel et de maintenir la culture VACC.

jobs.title: Facilities Technician II
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Work shift: M-F 2:00pm - 10:30pm

The Facilities Technician II at GenMark Diagnostics, A Member of the Roche Group, is responsible for the overall maintenance, upkeep, and cleanliness of the designated facility, preventative or otherwise. In this position, you are

• Preventative Maintenance & Operations – Perform routine maintenance on HVAC and central plant equipment, conduct daily facility tours, monitor all rooftop and building systems, and make necessary operational adjustments
• Work Request Management & Response – Handle internal customer facility work requests, respond to alarm system alerts 24/7, investigate and document process alarms, and provide on-call coverage
• Equipment & Inventory Support – Maintain spare parts inventory, manage repair parts for work requests, conduct maintenance on specialized systems (water purification, heating/cooling, humidity control, building controls), and support validation protocols
• Quality & Compliance – Ensure all duties comply with ISO, FDA, and regulatory requirements; demonstrate awareness of quality consequences and potential device defects; support Quality Management System implementation
• Coordination & Professional Development – Coordinate contractor/vendor site escorts and training, support cross-functional staff training, collaborate with technicians on daily tasks, and maintain professionalism with internal and external stakeholders

Who you are

• You possess a High School Diploma, or Technical Education with 2 to 4 years of maintenance experience preferably in Biotech, cGMP, medical or health related environment or equivalent.

• You must be available to work any shift and be “on call” via pager and/or cell phone.

• You possess a clean & valid CA driver’s license

Behaviors, Competencies, and Qualities of the ideal applicant.

• Proficiency with power tools and machine shop equipment, knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration systems, and plumbing; ability to read schematics and drawings.

• Experience in high-paced manufacturing environments, routine building and grounds maintenance, and familiarity with welding and precision tools (drill press, hand tools).

• Excellent understanding and application of safety procedures; knowledge of federal regulations including QSR, ISO, and ISO 13485 standards; CMDR familiarity preferred.

• Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work independently; basic computer skills (MS Word, Excel, Access, Google); excellent documentation and record-keeping abilities.

• Strong interpersonal, communication, and cooperation skills; ability to work effectively with diverse teams in regulated environments.

Work Environment
The essential functions of the job are usually performed in an environmentally controlled facility where the noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. This position may involve a combination of office and biotechnology laboratory environments. You may be exposed to hazardous chemicals, blood-borne, pathogens and automated equipment.

While performing the job duties, you are regularly required to sit; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. You are frequently required to stand and walk. You may sometimes be required to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

Relocation benefits are not offered for this job posting

The expected salary range for this position based on California is 53,800.00 - 99,800

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
客户管理
• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道 , 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（ HCP ）观念、学术需求 传递专业化医学 / 疾病 / 产品信息
• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生 / 科室教育 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
• 组织和支持区域专家会议
• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 ( 使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维 )

工作年限
• 3 年以上医药行业工作经验
• 既往有学术推广 / 市场 / 医学经验
• 跨职能工作经验为佳

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 ( 使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维 )

工作年限
• 3 年以上医药行业工作经验
• 既往有学术推广 / 市场 / 医学经验
• 跨职能工作经验为佳

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: 实习医药信息顾问
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （ 1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （ 2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （ 3 ） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （ 4 ） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （ 1 ）在校大学生
• （ 2 ）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （ 3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （ 4 ）熟练运用 Excel 、 PPT 、 Word 等办公应用软件
• （ 5 ）拥有良好的英语书写能力

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics and Clinical Evidence

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Principal Business Analyst is a senior, high-impact role that sits at the crossroads of clinical science, product strategy, and technology delivery. While positioned as a Business Analyst, this role operates with the breadth, depth, and strategic influence of a seasoned analyst owning the vision, innovation pipeline, and feature delivery of the Study Designer, a flagship product enabling clinical trial teams to design smarter, faster, and more impactful studies.This individual brings a rare combination of deep scientific credibility, product leadership, and technical fluency - capable of earning the trust of Clinical Scientists in one meeting and driving an engineering sprint in the next. They are relentlessly curious, innovation-driven, and passionate about using technology to transform how clinical trials are conceived and executed - ultimately accelerating therapies to patients.

The Opportunity

• Clinical & Scientific Collaboration : Act as the primary link between clinical/scientific teams and product engineering, building long-term relationships and facilitating discovery workshops with medical experts to deeply understand trial design and represent the clinical user's voice.

• Product Feature Innovation: Define and own the feature roadmap by balancing business, scientific, and technical needs; foster innovation through design thinking sprints to identify new opportunities, create compelling business cases, and track feature success metrics/KPIs post-release.

• Feature Design & Requirements Excellence: Author precise, actionable user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria; partner with UX to create wireframes and prototypes, ruthlessly filter requests based on value, and maintain a living product specification traceable to user needs.

• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Act as a technical translator by converting complex clinical workflows into structured requirements, leveraging strong literacy in architecture, data modeling, and APIs to collaborate with engineers on technical risks, dependencies, and solutions.

• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner with architects, senior engineers, and QA leads throughout the development build cycle to ensure feature scalability and quality, while supporting UAT design and execution to meet scientific intent and usability standards.

• Agile Leadership & Delivery: Drive iterative delivery, rapid feedback, and hypothesis-driven development; own and groom a sprint-ready product backl

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics e la prova clinica Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Il Principal Business Analyst è un ruolo senior, ad alto impatto che siede al crocevia della scienza clinica, della strategia del prodotto e della consegna della tecnologia. Mentre si posiziona come Business Analyst, questo ruolo opera con l'ampiezza, la profondità e l'influenza strategica di un analista esperto che possiede la visione, l'innovazione pipeline, e la consegna caratteristica dello Studio Designer, un prodotto di punta che consente ai team di prova clinici di progettare studi più intelligenti, più veloci e più efficaci. Questo individuo porta una rara combinazione di profonda credibilità scientifica, leadership di prodotto e fluidità tecnica - in grado di guadagnare la fiducia degli scienziati clinici in un incontro e di guidare uno sprint di ingegneria nel prossimo. Sono instancabilmente curiosi, orientati all'innovazione e appassionati di utilizzare la tecnologia per trasformare come le sperimentazioni cliniche sono concepite e eseguite - alla fine accelerando le terapie ai pazienti. L'opportunità
• Collaborazione clinica e scientifica: agire come collegamento primario tra team clinici/scientifici e ingegneria dei prodotti, costruire relazioni a lungo termine e facilitare i laboratori di scoperta con esperti medici per comprendere profondamente il design di prova e rappresentare la voce dell'utente clinico.
• Innovazione di funzionalità del prodotto: Definire e possedere la roadmap caratteristica bilanciando le esigenze aziendali, scientifiche e tecniche; promuovere l'innovazione attraverso progetti di pensiero di progettazione per identificare nuove opportunità, creare casi aziendali convincenti, e tracciare metriche di successo / KPI post-release. Eccellenza: Autore storie utente precise e attuabili, epici e criteri di accettazione; partner con UX per creare wireframe e prototipi, filtrare senza scrupoli richieste basate sul valore, e mantenere una specifica di prodotto vivente tracciabile alle esigenze dell'utente.
• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Agire come traduttore tecnico convertendo complessi flussi di lavoro clinici in requisiti strutturati, sfruttando una forte alfabetizzazione in architettura, modellazione dei dati e API per collaborare con gli ingegneri sui rischi tecnici, dipendenze e soluzioni.
• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner con architetti, ingegneri senior e QA porta in tutto il ciclo di costruzione dello sviluppo per garantire scalabilità e qualità delle funzionalità, supportando al contempo la progettazione e l'esecuzione UAT per soddisfare gli standard di intenti scientifici e di usabilità.
• Leadership Agile & Delivery: consegna iterativa di guida, feedback rapido e sviluppo basato su ipotesi; proprio e sposo un backl prodotto pronto sprint

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrie und klinische Beweise Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation den Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Community von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die dazu beitragen, die digitale Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen zu gestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien zu treiben und das Potenzial künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren Tech-Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zweck und Leidenschaft, bauen wir eine Zukunft, in der digital eine Kernkraft für alle Roche ist, die intelligentere Möglichkeiten der Arbeit ermöglicht, das menschliche Potenzial zu entsperren und Durchbrüche zu treiben, die wirklich für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wichtig sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Wir verlangen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter im Durchschnitt zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Bedarf variieren, z.B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathause, Teamtreffen und andere kollaborative Veranstaltungen. Der Principal Business Analyst ist eine hochwirksame Rolle, die an der Kreuzung der klinischen Wissenschaft, Produktstrategie und Technologielieferung sitzt. Während sie als Business Analyst positioniert ist, arbeitet diese Rolle mit der Breite, Tiefe und strategischem Einfluss eines erfahrenen Analysten, der die Vision, Innovationspipeline besitzt, und der Feature-Lieferung des Study Designer, einem Flagship-Produkt, das klinische Testteams ermöglicht, intelligentere, schnellere und effektvollere Studien zu entwickeln. Dieses Individuum bringt eine seltene Kombination aus tiefen wissenschaftlichen Glaubwürdigkeit, Produktführerschaft und technischer Glaubwürdigkeit - in der Lage, das Vertrauen der Klinischen Wissenschaftler in einem Treffen zu verdienen und einen Engineering-Sprint im nächsten zu treiben. Sie sind unermüdlich neugierig, innovationsgetrieben und leidenschaftlich über die Anwendung von Technologie, um zu transformieren, wie klinische Studien konzipiert und durchgeführt werden - letztendlich beschleunigen Therapien für Patienten. Die Chance
• Klinische und wissenschaftliche Zusammenarbeit: Akt als primäre Verbindung zwischen klinischen/wissenschaftlichen Teams und Produkttechnik, Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen und Erleichterung von Entdeckungsworkshops mit medizinischen Experten, um das Testdesign zu verstehen und die Stimme des klinischen Benutzers zu repräsentieren.
• Produkt-Feature Innovation: Definieren und besitzen Sie die Funktion Roadmap durch den Ausgleich von Geschäfts-, wissenschaftlichen und technischen Bedürfnissen; fördern Sie Innovation durch Design Thinking Sprints, um neue Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren, überzeugende Geschäftsfälle zu schaffen, und verfolgen Sie die Funktion Erfolg Metriken/KPIs post-Release.
• Feature Design & Anforderungen Exzellenz: Autor präzise, aktivierbare Benutzergeschichten, Epische und Akzeptanzkriterien; Partner mit UX, um Drahtrahmen und Prototypen zu erstellen, Filteranfragen auf Basis des Wertes lückenlos zu filtern und eine lebende Produktspezifikation zu erhalten, die auf die Bedürfnisse der Nutzer zurückzuführen ist.
• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Act als technischer Übersetzer, indem komplexe klinische Workflows in strukturierte Anforderungen umgewandelt werden und starke Alphabetisierung in Architektur, Datenmodellierung und APIs nutzen, um mit Ingenieuren auf technische Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Lösungen zusammenzuarbeiten.
• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner mit Architekten, Senior Engineers und QA führt während des gesamten Entwicklungs-Bauzyklus, um die Funktion Skalierbarkeit und Qualität zu gewährleisten, und unterstützt UAT Design und Ausführung, um wissenschaftliche Absichts- und Usability Standards zu erfüllen.
• Agile Führung & Lieferung: Fahren Sie iterative Lieferung, schnelles Feedback und Hypothese-getriebene Entwicklung; eigene und pflegen Sie ein sprint-ready Produkt Backl
