Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Analyste des affaires TI - DDT Biométrie et preuves cliniques Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. L'analyste principal des affaires joue un rôle de premier plan à fort impact qui se situe au carrefour des sciences cliniques, de la stratégie des produits et de la prestation de la technologie. Tout en étant un analyste d'affaires, ce rôle fonctionne avec l'étendue, la profondeur et l'influence stratégique d'un analyste chevronné possédant la vision, le pipeline d'innovation et la prestation de fonctions du concepteur d'études, un produit phare permettant aux équipes d'essais cliniques de concevoir des études plus intelligentes, plus rapides et plus pertinentes. Cette personne apporte une rare combinaison de crédibilité scientifique profonde, de leadership de produit et de compétence technique - capable de gagner la confiance des scientifiques cliniques dans une réunion et conduire un sprint d'ingénierie dans la prochaine. Ils sont inlassablement curieux, motivés par l'innovation et passionnés par l'utilisation de la technologie pour transformer la façon dont les essais cliniques sont conçus et exécutés - en fin de compte, accélérer les traitements aux patients. L'opportunité
• Collaboration clinique et scientifique : agir comme premier lien entre les équipes cliniques/scientifiques et l'ingénierie des produits, établir des relations à long terme et faciliter des ateliers de découverte avec des experts médicaux pour bien comprendre la conception des essais et représenter la voix de l'utilisateur clinique.
• Caractéristiques du produit Innovation: Définir et posséder la feuille de route des caractéristiques en conciliant les besoins commerciaux, scientifiques et techniques; encourager l'innovation par des sprints de réflexion de conception pour identifier de nouvelles opportunités, créer des analyses de rentabilisation convaincantes et suivre les caractéristiques de réussite métriques/KPI après la sortie.
• Conception des caractéristiques et exigences Excellence : Auteur d'histoires d'utilisateurs précises, exploitables, épopées et critères d'acceptation ; partenaire avec UX pour créer des trames filaires et des prototypes, filtrer impitoyablement les requêtes en fonction de la valeur et maintenir une spécification de produit vivante traçable aux besoins de l'utilisateur.
• Partenariat technologique et ingénierie : agir en tant que traducteur technique en convertissant des flux de travail cliniques complexes en exigences structurées, en tirant parti d'une solide connaissance de l'architecture, de la modélisation des données et des API pour collaborer avec les ingénieurs sur les risques techniques, les dépendances et les solutions.
• Assurance qualité et soutien de l'UAT: Partenaire avec les architectes, les ingénieurs seniors et l'AQ mène tout au long du cycle de construction de développement pour assurer l'évolutivité et la qualité des fonctionnalités, tout en soutenant la conception et l'exécution de l'UAT pour répondre aux objectifs scientifiques et aux normes d'utilisation.
• Agile Leadership & Delivery: Diriger la livraison itérative, la rétroaction rapide et le développement basé sur l'hypothèse; propre et préparer un produit prêt au sprint backl

jobs.title: Medical Enabler, APAC Rare Diseases
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceutical

At Roche, we are driven by an urgent commitment to delivering medical solutions today while innovating for tomorrow. Our bold new A2 operating model leverages collective capabilities across the enterprise to create rapid, impactful solutions for patients globally. We believe in personalized, sustainable healthcare and are uniquely positioned to integrate pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, digital health, and big data.

We are seeking a passionate Medical Enabler to join our dynamic APAC Rare Diseases team. This permanent, full-time role is an above-country pooled resource position, requiring an 80-100% FTE above country commitment within our network .

Ideally, we are seeking someone who has extensive experience working healthcare systems across Asia and will be located in Hong Kong or Taiwan, however this role offers a thrilling opportunity to focus on cross-border work packages and enablement, collaborating across various regional and Global networks to drive meaningful change.

What You'll be working on:
As a Medical Enabler, (APAC) Rare Diseases, you will:

• Provide strategic input and operational support for late-stage development/near-launch therapies in Rare Diseases.

• Act as a scientific expert for our medicines and solutions throughout their product life cycles.

• Work in virtual, cross-border, cross-functional teams to realize and scale country, regional and Global outcomes.

• Foster meaningful scientific collaborations and value-based partnerships with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), healthcare professionals, patient organizations across multiple healthcare systems.

• Contribute to understanding data gaps and support data generation plans (e.g., Phase IV studies, registries).

• Build high-value continuing medical education programs for external stakeholders.

• Provide strategic medical review and approval for materials and communications.

• ​Liaise closely with global medical colleagues and teams to ensure coordination and consistency to our data dissemination

Who you are:
You are a passionate Medical Affairs professional ready to make a significant impact on Rare Disease health across Asia. As a subject matter expert with the potential for future leadership roles you have an entrepreneurial spirit, identify opportunities, are comfortable with ambiguity and challenge the status quo.

You have:

• Relevant experience in a Medical Affairs role within Pharmaceutical, Diagnostics, Health Sciences, Biotechnology, or related fields.

• Experience of working in Rare Diseases would be very desirable.

• Strong data comprehension, critical appraisal, synthesis, and delivery skills.

• A "System Thinker" mindset, able to build strong internal/external collaborations to drive change.

• Customer-Centric approach, co-creating solutions to address needs and transform clinical practice.

• A culture of humanity, curiosity, and responsibility, thriving in an empowered, dynamic, and agile working environment.

• Proven track record of building, leading, and contributing to high-performing, diverse, agile / matrix teams.

• MD degree; PhD or Bachelor’s degree in science, biology, immunology, neuroscience, or equivalent preferred. Clinical experience in Rare Diseases is a plus.

This is an incredible development opportunity to apply your scientific expertise, collaborate with colleagues and customers from across the globe, and contribute to innovation that will impact families living with rare diseases across Asia and beyond.

Siamo alla ricerca di un appassionato medico Enabler per unirsi al nostro team dinamico APAC Malattie Rare. Questo ruolo permanente e a tempo pieno è una posizione di risorse in pool sopra il paese, che richiede un 80-100% FTE sopra l'impegno del paese all'interno della nostra rete. Idealmente, stiamo cercando qualcuno che ha una vasta esperienza di sistemi sanitari di lavoro in tutta l'Asia e si trova a Hong Kong o Taiwan, tuttavia questo ruolo offre un'emozionante opportunità di concentrarsi su pacchetti di lavoro transfrontalieri e di abilitazione, collaborando attraverso varie reti regionali e globali per guidare cambiamenti significativi. Su cosa lavorerai: Come ambulante medico, (APAC) Malattie Rare, si:
• Fornire input strategici e supporto operativo per lo sviluppo del tardo stadio / terapie a distanza in Malattie Rare.
• Agire come esperto scientifico per le nostre medicine e soluzioni durante i loro cicli di vita del prodotto.
• Lavorare in team virtuali, transfrontalieri, interfunzionali per realizzare e scalare i risultati del paese, regionale e globale.
• Promuovere collaborazioni scientifiche significative e partnership basate sul valore con Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), professionisti sanitari, organizzazioni dei pazienti attraverso sistemi sanitari multipli.
• Contribuire alla comprensione delle lacune dei dati e sostenere i piani di generazione dei dati (ad esempio, studi di fase IV, registri).
• Costruire programmi di istruzione medica continua ad alto valore per gli stakeholder esterni.
• Fornire una rassegna medica strategica e l'approvazione per materiali e comunicazioni.
• Liaise a stretto contatto con colleghi e team medici globali per garantire il coordinamento e la coerenza alla diffusione dei dati Chi sei: Sei un appassionato professionista medico pronto a fare un impatto significativo sulla salute delle malattie rare in tutta l'Asia. Come esperto di materia con il potenziale per i ruoli di leadership futuri avete uno spirito imprenditoriale, identificare le opportunità, sono confortevoli con ambiguità e sfidare lo status quo. Hai...
• Esperienza rilevante in un ruolo di Affari medici all'interno di settori farmaceutici, diagnostici, scienze della salute, biotecnologie o correlati.
• L'esperienza di lavorare nelle malattie rare sarebbe molto auspicabile.
• Forte comprensione dei dati, valutazione critica, sintesi e capacità di consegna.
• Una mentalità "System Thinker", in grado di costruire forti collaborazioni interne/esterne per guidare il cambiamento.
• approccio Customer-Centric, soluzioni di co-creazione per soddisfare le esigenze e trasformare la pratica clinica.
• Una cultura dell'umanità, della curiosità e della responsabilità, che prospera in un ambiente di lavoro potenziato, dinamico e agile.
• Provato track record di costruzione, leader, e contribuendo a team di alta qualità, diversi, agili / matrice.
• Laurea in scienze, biologia, immunologia, neuroscienze, o equivalente preferito. L'esperienza clinica nelle malattie rare è un vantaggio. Questa è un'incredibile opportunità di sviluppo per applicare le tue competenze scientifiche, collaborare con colleghi e clienti da tutto il mondo, e contribuire all'innovazione che influenzerà le famiglie che vivono con malattie rare in tutta l'Asia e oltre. Dove
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceutical

At Roche, we are driven by an urgent commitment to delivering medical solutions today while innovating for tomorrow. Our bold new A2 operating model leverages collective capabilities across the enterprise to create rapid, impactful solutions for patients globally. We believe in personalized, sustainable healthcare and are uniquely positioned to integrate pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, digital health, and big data.

We are seeking a passionate Medical Enabler to join our dynamic APAC Rare Diseases team. This permanent, full-time role is an above-country pooled resource position, requiring an 80-100% FTE above country commitment within our network .

Ideally, we are seeking someone who has extensive experience working healthcare systems across Asia and will be located in Hong Kong or Taiwan, however this role offers a thrilling opportunity to focus on cross-border work packages and enablement, collaborating across various regional and Global networks to drive meaningful change.

What You'll be working on:
As a Medical Enabler, (APAC) Rare Diseases, you will:

• Provide strategic input and operational support for late-stage development/near-launch therapies in Rare Diseases.

• Act as a scientific expert for our medicines and solutions throughout their product life cycles.

• Work in virtual, cross-border, cross-functional teams to realize and scale country, regional and Global outcomes.

• Foster meaningful scientific collaborations and value-based partnerships with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), healthcare professionals, patient organizations across multiple healthcare systems.

• Contribute to understanding data gaps and support data generation plans (e.g., Phase IV studies, registries).

• Build high-value continuing medical education programs for external stakeholders.

• Provide strategic medical review and approval for materials and communications.

• ​Liaise closely with global medical colleagues and teams to ensure coordination and consistency to our data dissemination

Who you are:
You are a passionate Medical Affairs professional ready to make a significant impact on Rare Disease health across Asia. As a subject matter expert with the potential for future leadership roles you have an entrepreneurial spirit, identify opportunities, are comfortable with ambiguity and challenge the status quo.

You have:

• Relevant experience in a Medical Affairs role within Pharmaceutical, Diagnostics, Health Sciences, Biotechnology, or related fields.

• Experience of working in Rare Diseases would be very desirable.

• Strong data comprehension, critical appraisal, synthesis, and delivery skills.

• A "System Thinker" mindset, able to build strong internal/external collaborations to drive change.

• Customer-Centric approach, co-creating solutions to address needs and transform clinical practice.

• A culture of humanity, curiosity, and responsibility, thriving in an empowered, dynamic, and agile working environment.

• Proven track record of building, leading, and contributing to high-performing, diverse, agile / matrix teams.

• MD degree; PhD or Bachelor’s degree in science, biology, immunology, neuroscience, or equivalent preferred. Clinical experience in Rare Diseases is a plus.

This is an incredible development opportunity to apply your scientific expertise, collaborate with colleagues and customers from across the globe, and contribute to innovation that will impact families living with rare diseases across Asia and beyond.

Where

• Starkes Datenverständnis, kritische Beurteilungs-, Synthese- und Lieferfähigkeiten.

• Customer-Centric-Ansatz, Co-Creating-Lösungen, um Bedürfnisse zu lösen und klinische Praxis zu transformieren.
• Eine Kultur der Menschlichkeit, Neugier und Verantwortung, die in einem bestärkten, dynamischen und agilen Arbeitsumfeld blüht.
• Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz von Gebäuden, Führungen und Beiträgen zu hochperformierenden, vielfältigen, agilen / Matrix-Teams.
• MD-Abschluss; PhD oder Bachelor-Abschluss in Wissenschaft, Biologie, Immunologie, Neurowissenschaften oder gleichwertig bevorzugt. Klinische Erfahrung in seltenen Krankheiten ist ein Plus. Dies ist eine unglaubliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeit, um Ihr wissenschaftliches Know-how anzuwenden, mit Kollegen und Kunden aus aller Welt zusammenzuarbeiten und zu Innovationen beizutragen, die Familien mit seltenen Krankheiten in ganz Asien und darüber hinaus beeinflussen. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. La position Roche Pharmaceutique Chez Roche, nous sommes animés par un engagement urgent à fournir des solutions médicales aujourd'hui tout en innovant pour demain. Notre nouveau modèle d'exploitation A2 audacieux met à profit les capacités collectives de l'entreprise pour créer des solutions rapides et efficaces pour les patients à l'échelle mondiale. Nous croyons en des soins de santé personnalisés et durables et sommes particulièrement bien placés pour intégrer les produits pharmaceutiques, les diagnostics, la santé numérique et les mégadonnées. Idéalement, nous recherchons quelqu'un qui possède une vaste expérience des systèmes de soins de santé en Asie et qui sera situé à Hong Kong ou à Taïwan, mais ce rôle offre une occasion passionnante de se concentrer sur les paquets de travail transfrontaliers et de permettre, en collaborant à travers divers réseaux régionaux et mondiaux pour conduire un changement significatif. Vous allez travailler sur : En tant que catalyseur médical des maladies rares (PACA), vous :
• Apporter une contribution stratégique et un soutien opérationnel aux thérapies de développement et de lancement précoce des maladies rares.
• Agir en tant qu'expert scientifique pour nos médicaments et solutions tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
• Travailler dans des équipes virtuelles, transfrontalières et transfonctionnelles afin de réaliser et d'élargir les résultats nationaux, régionaux et mondiaux.
• Favoriser des collaborations scientifiques significatives et des partenariats fondés sur la valeur avec des experts des domaines thérapeutiques, des professionnels de la santé, des organisations de patients dans plusieurs systèmes de santé.
• Contribuer à la compréhension des lacunes dans les données et appuyer les plans de production de données (par exemple, études de phase IV, registres).
• Élaborer des programmes de formation médicale continue de grande valeur à l'intention des intervenants externes.
• Fournir un examen médical stratégique et l'approbation des documents et des communications.
• Assurer une liaison étroite avec les équipes et collègues médicaux mondiaux pour assurer la coordination et la cohérence de notre diffusion des données Qui vous êtes : Vous êtes un professionnel passionné des affaires médicales prêt à avoir un impact significatif sur la santé des maladies rares en Asie. En tant qu'expert en matière de leadership potentiel, vous avez un esprit d'entreprise, identifiez les possibilités, êtes à l'aise avec l'ambiguïté et contestez le statu quo. Vous avez :
• Expérience pertinente dans le domaine des affaires médicales dans le domaine des produits pharmaceutiques, des diagnostics, des sciences de la santé, de la biotechnologie ou dans des domaines connexes.
• L'expérience du travail dans les maladies rares serait très souhaitable.
• Une bonne compréhension des données, une évaluation critique, une synthèse et des compétences d'exécution.
• Un état d'esprit "System Thinker", capable de construire de solides collaborations internes/externes pour stimuler le changement.
• Approche client-centre, co-créant des solutions pour répondre aux besoins et transformer la pratique clinique.
• Une culture de l'humanité, de la curiosité et de la responsabilité, prospère dans un environnement de travail dynamique, dynamique et agile.
• Expérience éprouvée de la construction, de la direction et de la contribution à des équipes de haute performance, diversifiées, agiles et matricielles.
• Diplôme MD; doctorat ou baccalauréat en sciences, biologie, immunologie, neurosciences ou équivalent préféré. L'expérience clinique dans les maladies rares est un plus. C'est une occasion incroyable de développer votre expertise scientifique, de collaborer avec des collègues et des clients du monde entier et de contribuer à l'innovation qui touchera les familles vivant avec des maladies rares en Asie et au-delà. Où

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a team member of Roche Services (Europe) Ltd. Site Services Department, the Procurement & Car Fleet Management Intern is responsible for:

• Supporting the work of the Strategic Procurement Partner and the Office Executives in administration regarding Procurement tasks and Car Fleet Management.

Responsibilities
Car fleet:

• Managing administrative duties including: monitoring car fleet contract start/end dates, highway tickets, penalties etc.

• Keeping contact with the Leasing companies and following up the incoming messages.

• Informing the employees about the car policy and assisting them with any car fleet related questions.

• Managing and updating the database containing comprehensive car fleet details.

• Supporting the car handover process and performing regular car condition checks.

• Assisting with the request, distribution, and record-keeping of fuel cards and motorway vignettes.

• Supporting the team with ad-hoc projects and tasks as needed.

• Supporting system related activities in MyBuy, eg.: PO creation, reports.

Procurement:

• Supporting the Strategic Procurement Partner providing administrative assistance during the bidding process and organizing tender documentation.

• Analyzing supplier offers and maintaining data accuracy to support decision-making.

• Creating Purchase Orders (POs) and ensuring all transaction details are correct.

• Following up on orders and deliveries with vendors.

• Partnering with various departments to ensure their procurement needs are met efficiently and Ensuring all activities and documentation align with the official Procurement Policy.

Employees are responsible for performing their duties in line with the SHE (Safety, Security, Health and Environmental Protection) Guidelines and the applicable law. It is required to complete the mandatory training courses and follow procedures and instructions accordingly.

What you can bring to our team

• Fluency in English & Hungarian

• You are currently studying in Hungarian University/College on a day-time schedule

• You are available to work 20-30 hours on a weekly basis

• B category driving license with active driving experience

• Stakeholder management skills, ability to multi-task

• Strong service orientation and communication skills

• Precise, focused, accountable way of working, high level of organizational and problem solving skills

• Proactive mindset

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Team player attitude, accuracy, ability to meet deadlines and set the right priorities

• Ability to adapt changes quickly

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche .

At Roche Diagnostics, we are driven by our vision: innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare, and changing lives. We are excited to see this vision come to life.

The opportunity
Join our team as the Global Strategic Pricing leader in the Diagnostics Global Access & Policy (GA&P) team. You'll play a vital role in developing strategic global pricing guidance for our products and solutions, collaborating closely with global, regional, and local teams to optimize revenues and ensure sustainable access. Be part of shaping our global pricing strategy and policy for a brighter future.
Your impact:

• Lead the design and implementation of global value-based pricing strategies for prioritized pipeline and on-market products, utilizing analytics to assess elasticity, forecast trends, and manage profitability.

• Co-lead the roll-out of pricing strategies, including innovative pricing and contracting solutions, in collaboration with access and commercial stakeholders to drive market access and profitability.

• Act as the main responsible for exception management, providing clear guidance and supporting affiliates with local strategy development to address access barriers.

• Be the key responsible for price monitoring and insights generation using internal databases (e.g., DIAprice, sCORE), delivering actionable insights to affiliates, regions, and IBTs.

• Establish and lead pricing committee meetings, issue price memos, and drive pricing governance, including the maintenance and monitoring of pricing policies, controls, and KPIs (e.g., floor price).

• Conduct and leverage primary and secondary payer, reimbursement, and pricing research to inform global strategy and provide consolidated pricing and reimbursement advice to relevant product teams.

• Partner cross-functionally to inform IBTs and their Product Managers on recommended price setting, ensuring adherence to relevant governance processes.

Who You Are

• Minimum 8-10 years of professional experience with recognized expertise in pricing and reimbursement, preferably in the diagnostics, medical device, or pharmaceutical industry. Affiliate and/or regional experience is a plus.

• Possess a Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field such as business, finance, economics, health economics, life sciences, or public health. An MBA or other Graduate/higher-level Degree is beneficial.

• Deep financial and commercial understanding with in-depth knowledge of the global reimbursement environment, competitive intelligence, and market segmentation for effective global price setting.

• Demonstrated Strategic & Analytical Acumen with strong influencing, negotiation, and Agile leadership skills to excel in a global matrix organization and lead diverse multicultural teams.

• Committed to permanently optimizing processes to increase quality and efficiency standards and implement pricing competence and awareness across the organization through training and support.

Essential Skills

• Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Must be able to design and implement global value-based pricing strategies, utilizing analytics to assess elasticity, forecast trends, and manage profitability. Deep financial and commercial understanding is critical.

You lead complex risk assessments, develop refined audit and continuity programs, and establish best practices for handling critical disruptions and regulatory compliance. Acting as an expert advisor to high-level stakeholders, you lead responses to critical incidents and ensure the scalability and future-proofing of enterprise-wide risk and continuity solutions.

The Opportunity:

• Conduct post-incident reviews and "deep-dives" to identify systemic failures and implement continuous improvement frameworks.

Opportunità - svilupperai e raffinerai strategie di gestione, conformità e continuità a livello aziendale per migliorare i nostri piani di recupero globale. - Guidare la risposta agli eventi critici relativi al rischio IT, all'audit e alla continuità, stabilendo le migliori pratiche globali per la gestione delle interruzioni. - Condurre revisioni post-incidenti e "deep-dives" per identificare guasti sistemici e implementare quadri di miglioramento continuo. - Gestire relazioni di stakeholder di alto livello, agendo come consulente strategico per allineare le politiche di rischio con le esigenze aziendali in evoluzione. - Fornire informazioni strategiche basate sulle best practice del settore per garantire che i nostri quadri di conformità rimangano di livello mondiale. - supervisionare la scalabilità delle soluzioni di resilienza IT, integrando politiche complesse con sistemi enterprise esistenti. - Valutare e selezionare strumenti avanzati per la gestione aziendale a prova di futuro il nostro paesaggio di resilienza tecnica. - Facilitare sessioni di formazione avanzate per team interfunzionali sulle best practice BCM e tecniche avanzate di problem solving. Chi sei? - Possiedi un'ampia esperienza nell'archiviare le strategie di resilienza IT a livello aziendale e di gestione dei rischi a livello strategico. - Esperto nelle normative Life Sciences, tra cui GxP, SOX e HIPAA, con una profonda comprensione della convalida dei sistemi informatici (CSV). - Altamente conoscibile in IT General Controls (ITGC) e strutture come SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2, e DORA. - Tecnicamente competente in ambienti AWS e Azure, in particolare per quanto riguarda i modelli di responsabilità condivisa e l'orchestrazione DR nativo cloud. - Prove capacità di stabilire guardrails di governance per le tecnologie emergenti come AI Generativo, RPA e SaaS. - Compliance-as-Code. - Titolare di un Bachelor o Master in IT o Cybersecurity, e almeno una credenziale attiva: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, o ISO 22301. Cosa? - Campo d'insalatura 19 000 - 35 400PLN g ross basato sul contratto di lavoro. - Pagamento bonus annuale basato sulle tue prestazioni. - Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.). - Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile). - Prenda tempo Programma (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile. - Flex Location (possibilità di eseguire il nostro lavoro da diversi luoghi del mondo per un certo periodo di tempo). - Prendere Tempo per la Carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta). - Assistenza sanitaria privata (pacchetti LuxMed), assicurazione vita di gruppo (UNUM) e Multisport. - Aggiunti di acquisto azionario. - Vendita annuale di computer portatili aziendali e automobili e molti altri! Contatto Applicare direttamente e unirsi a noi per plasmare il futuro della salute. Se lo sentite fuori
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

IT GRC Expert - RDT Quality, Risk & Compliance

As an IT GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) Expert - RDT (Roche Digital Technology) Quality, Risk & Compliance you design and implement comprehensive IT resilience, risk management, and compliance strategies aligned with business objectives. You lead complex risk assessments, develop refined audit and continuity programs, and establish best practices for handling critical disruptions and regulatory compliance. Acting as an expert advisor to high-level stakeholders, you lead responses to critical incidents and ensure the scalability and future-proofing of enterprise-wide risk and continuity solutions.

The Opportunity:

• You will develop and refine enterprise-wide risk management, compliance, and continuity strategies to enhance our global recovery plans.

• Lead the response to critical IT risk, audit, and continuity events while establishing global best practices for handling disruptions.

• Conduct post-incident reviews and "deep-dives" to identify systemic failures and implement continuous improvement frameworks.

• Manage high-level stakeholder relationships, acting as a strategic advisor to align risk policies with evolving business needs.

• Provide strategic insights based on industry best practices to ensure our compliance frameworks remain world-class.

• Oversee the scalability of IT resilience solutions, integrating complex policies with existing enterprise systems.

• Evaluate and select advanced tools for enterprise management to future-proof our technical resilience landscape.

• Facilitate advanced training sessions for cross-functional teams on BCM best practices and advanced problem-solving techniques.

Who you are:

• You possess extensive experience in architecting enterprise-wide IT resilience and risk management strategies at a strategic level.

• Expert in Life Sciences regulations, including GxP, SOX, and HIPAA, with a deep understanding of computer systems validation (CSV).

• Highly knowledgeable in IT General Controls (ITGC) and frameworks such as SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2, and DORA.

• Technically proficient in AWS and Azure environments, specifically regarding shared responsibility models and cloud-native DR orchestration.

• Proven ability to establish governance guardrails for emerging technologies like Generative AI, RPA, and SaaS.

• Skilled in secure SDLC and DevOps stacks (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket) with the ability to implement Compliance-as-Code.

• Holder of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT or Cybersecurity, and at least one active credential: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or ISO 22301.

What you get:

• Salary range 19 000 - 35 400PLN g ross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.

• Stock share purchase additions.

• Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!

Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

If you feel this off

jobs.title: Customer Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
Customer Partner

Role Purpose
As the Customer Partner, you will be responsible for growing the market share and achieving sales goals for the assigned territory. You will be responsible for executing the sales process, ensure operation effectiveness and efficiency, with proficient interpersonal and communication skills, and providing effective solutions to establish and maintain relationships that result in customer satisfaction, retention and acquisition.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

In this role, you will
Account Management

• Responsible in solution/technical/consultative selling.

• Leads sales process including prospecting, qualification, quantification, needs assessment, competitive differentiation, presentation, closing, contracting and implementation and ensuring after sales support is maintained and of the highest standard.

• Build long-term value-based relationships through continuously uncovering customers’ changing needs, improving customer experience, anticipating new opportunities for their business in the future and adding values through creative solutions / products

• Build credibility with customers and other stakeholders at different levels through demonstrating business acumen and professional expertise, confidence and effective communication.

• Develop and build strategic engagement and partnering with KOLs and relevant stakeholders in key accounts. Be a partner/consultant in shaping their plans, decisions and supporting their professional objectives to achieve RDMY business strategy and goals.

• Understand the customers’ working / communication styles and flex one’s style to adapt to that.

• Identify and develop business opportunities within the area of responsibility and collaborate across teams to ensure attainment.

• Implement a sales management process to assist the team in identifying and prioritizing customers and prospects.

• Responsible for developing and leading implementation of annual territorial plans with the goal of achieving sales objectives and future growth.

• Identify new accounts in line with the marketing strategy.

• Retain, extend and acquire customers and accounts through effective identification of opportunities and the creation and implementation of solutions.

• Responsible for profiling accounts, placing RDMY in the strongest position to win tenders and new accounts.

• Update Accounts and contacts in Salesforce regularly to ensure accuracy of data

• Ensure Salesforce activities, business opportunities are entered in REXIS on a weekly basis.

• Monitor all Opportunities to ensure they are up to date.

• Able to conduct Basic troubleshooting.

• Proficient in Global Deal Calculator (GDC) in preparing sales proposal.

• Participation in relevant marketing events/exhibition/trade.

• Responsible for arranging and conducting relevant training or presentation sessions for customers.

Product Knowledge

• Strong knowledge of assigned product portfolio to manage sales process, involving cross function team’s expertise, as needed

• Promote co-positioning of cross-BA products, where applicable, with the objective to maximize RDMY total revenues and profitability

Teamwork

•

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Solutions team within the DDC Organization develops modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems. The Data Ecosystem is foundational to building solutions that accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable ML/AI tool creation and adoption. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing.

Join our Data and Digital Catalyst team as a Software Engineer, where you will develop the modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems that are foundational to our research. You'll build robust and scalable systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data, directly accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients. This is a unique opportunity to empower our scientists and advance data-driven science through innovative technology.

The Opportunity

• Build and enhance a modern, scalable ecosystem of applications and tools to capture, move, and prepare scientific data for analysis.

• Design and deliver complex, user-friendly data applications and pipelines that integrate diverse data sets across key scientific domains.

• Leverage standard patterns like microservices and event-driven architecture to improve our data workflows and application ecosystem.

• Champion technical excellence by ensuring our solutions are innovative, best-in-class, and seamlessly integrated.

• Integrate diverse data sets to power Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and Natural Language Search capabilities.

• Provide technical leadership on ongoing initiatives and identify new opportunities to build common, reusable solutions.

Costruirete sistemi robusti e scalabili che sbloccano il potenziale dei nostri diversi dati scientifici, accelerando direttamente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di trattamenti per il cambiamento della vita per i pazienti. • Costruire e migliorare un ecosistema moderno e scalabile di applicazioni e strumenti per catturare, spostare e preparare i dati scientifici per l'analisi.
• Progettare e fornire applicazioni e tubazioni di dati complesse e facili da usare che integrano diversi set di dati in ambiti scientifici chiave.
• Levare modelli standard come microservizi e architettura orientata agli eventi per migliorare i nostri flussi di lavoro dati e l'ecosistema delle applicazioni.
• Campione di eccellenza tecnica assicurando che le nostre soluzioni siano innovative, di classe migliore e perfettamente integrate.
• Integrare diversi set di dati per alimentare l'intelligenza artificiale (AI), l'apprendimento automatico (ML), e le capacità di ricerca della lingua naturale.
• Collaborare direttamente con gli scienziati computazionali e di ricerca per comprendere le loro sfide e tradurli in soluzioni tecnologiche efficaci.
• Fornire leadership tecnica sulle iniziative in corso e identificare nuove opportunità per costruire soluzioni comuni e riutilizzabili.
• Mentor junior sviluppatori, promuovendo la loro crescita professionale e mantenendo elevati standard di ingegneria. Si prospera sul coinvolgimento di partner scientifici per risolvere la conformità

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Fortschritte in der KI, Daten und rechnerische Wissenschaften transformieren die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von Drogen. Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisationen von Genentech (gRED) und Pharma (pRED) haben gezeigt, wie diese Technologien die FuE beschleunigen, Daten nutzen und neue Rechenmodelle nutzen, um Auswirkungen zu erzielen. Der nahtlose Datenaustausch und der Zugriff auf Modelle über gRED und pRED sind unerlässlich, um diese Möglichkeiten zu maximieren. Das Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) ist eine strategische, einheitliche Gruppe, deren Ziel es ist, die transformative Kraft von Daten und Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) zu nutzen, um unseren Wissenschaftlern sowohl pRED als auch gRED zu helfen, innovativere und lebensverändernde Medikamente für Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Innerhalb der CS CoE-Organisation führt die Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC)-Organisation die Modernisierung unserer Rechen- und Datenökosysteme durch die Integration digitaler Technologien in Forschung und Frühentwicklung, um Stakeholder zu stärken, datenorientierte Wissenschaft zu fördern und die Entscheidungsfindung zu beschleunigen. Das Solutions-Team innerhalb der DDC-Organisation entwickelt modernisierte und vernetzte Rechen- und Datenökosysteme. Das Data Ecosystem ist ein Fundament für den Aufbau von Lösungen, die die Arbeit unserer Computational- und Bench-Wissenschaftler beschleunigen und die Erstellung und Annahme von ML/AI-Tools ermöglichen. Unser Team ist spezialisiert auf den Aufbau von Data Pipelines und Applikationen für Datenerfassung, Sammlung, Speicherung, Transformation, Verknüpfung und Weitergabe. Registrieren Sie sich bei unserem Data- und Digital Catalyst-Team als Software Engineer, wo Sie die modernisierten und vernetzten Rechen- und Datenökosysteme entwickeln, die für unsere Forschung von grundlegender Bedeutung sind. Sie bauen robuste und skalierbare Systeme auf, die das Potenzial unserer vielfältigen wissenschaftlichen Daten freischalten und die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von lebensverändernden Behandlungen für Patienten direkt beschleunigen. • Erstellen und verbessern Sie ein modernes, skalierbares Ökosystem von Anwendungen und Werkzeugen, um wissenschaftliche Daten für die Analyse zu erfassen, zu bewegen und vorzubereiten.
• Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von komplexen, benutzerfreundlichen Datenanwendungen und Pipelines, die verschiedene Datensätze über wichtige wissenschaftliche Domänen integrieren.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les progrès de l'IA, des données et des sciences informatiques transforment la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Les organismes de recherche et de développement précoce de Genentech (GRED) et de Pharma (PRED) ont démontré comment ces technologies accélèrent la R-D, tirent parti des données et de nouveaux modèles de calcul pour produire des effets. Le partage de données sans soudure et l'accès aux modèles à travers gRED et pRED sont essentiels pour maximiser ces opportunités. Le Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles (CS CoE) est un groupe stratégique unifié dont l'objectif est d'exploiter la puissance transformatrice des données et de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider nos scientifiques dans les domaines pRED et gRED à fournir des médicaments plus innovants et changeants pour les patients du monde entier. Au sein de l'organisation du Conseil de l'Europe, l'organisation Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) dirige la modernisation de nos écosystèmes informatiques et de données en intégrant les technologies numériques dans la recherche et le développement précoce pour autonomiser les parties prenantes, faire progresser la science axée sur les données et accélérer la prise de décisions. L'équipe Solutions de l'organisation DDC développe des écosystèmes informatiques et de données modernisés et interconnectés. L'écosystème des données est fondamental pour construire des solutions qui accélèrent le travail de nos chercheurs en informatique et en banque et permettent la création et l'adoption d'outils ML/AI. Notre équipe est spécialisée dans la construction de pipelines de données et applications pour l'acquisition, la collecte, le stockage, la transformation, le couplage et le partage de données. Rejoignez notre équipe Data and Digital Catalyst en tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, où vous développerez les écosystèmes informatiques et de données modernisés et interconnectés qui sont fondamentaux pour notre recherche. Vous allez construire des systèmes robustes et évolutives qui libèrent le potentiel de nos diverses données scientifiques, accélérant directement la découverte et le développement de traitements qui changent la vie des patients. C'est une occasion unique d'habiliter nos scientifiques et de faire progresser la science axée sur les données grâce à une technologie novatrice. L'opportunité
• Construire et améliorer un écosystème moderne et évolutif d'applications et d'outils pour capturer, déplacer et préparer des données scientifiques à analyser.
• Concevoir et fournir des applications et des pipelines de données complexes et conviviaux qui intègrent divers ensembles de données dans des domaines scientifiques clés.
• Tirer parti des modèles standard comme les microservices et l'architecture événementielle pour améliorer nos flux de données et l'écosystème d'application.
• Championne l'excellence technique en s'assurant que nos solutions sont innovantes, de qualité supérieure et parfaitement intégrées.
• Intégrer divers ensembles de données pour alimenter l'intelligence artificielle (AI), l'apprentissage automatique (ML) et la recherche en langage naturel.
• Collaborer directement avec les chercheurs et les chercheurs pour comprendre leurs défis et les traduire en solutions technologiques efficaces.
• Fournir un leadership technique sur les initiatives en cours et identifier de nouvelles possibilités d'élaborer des solutions communes et réutilisables.
• Mentor junior développeurs, favorisant leur croissance professionnelle et le maintien de normes d'ingénierie élevées. Qui vous êtes Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur logiciel passionné et collaboratif avec un talent pour construire des plateformes évolutives et fiables. Vous prospèrez en vous engageant avec des partenaires scientifiques pour résoudre

• Assicurare l'eccellenza tecnica offrendo flussi di dati innovativi e di alta qualità e tubazioni in ambiti scientifici chiave.
• Promuovere l'adozione di tendenze e tecnologie chiave applicando un approccio Open Source, Cloud First, API First e AI First alla risoluzione dei problemi.
• Migliorare i nostri flussi di lavoro dati e l'architettura delle applicazioni sfruttando modelli standard come microservizi e design orientato agli eventi.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Solutions team within DDC Organization develops modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems. The Data Ecosystem is foundational to building solutions that accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable ML/AI tool creation and adoption. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing.

As a Software Engineer on our Solutions Engineering team, you will build robust, scalable, and reusable capabilities for our shared data platform. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Product Leaders, and scientific partners to design and implement systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data. Your work will directly contribute to accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients by building the modern ecosystem that captures, moves, and prepares scientific data for analysis.

The Opportunity

• Ensure technical excellence by delivering innovative, best-in-class data flows and pipelines across key scientific domains.

• Promote the adoption of key trends and technologies by applying an Open Source, Cloud First, API First, and AI First approach to problem-solving.

• Improve our data workflows and application architecture by leveraging standard patterns like microservices and event-driven design.

• Integrate diverse data sets to power AI/ML, Natural Language Search, and downstream visualization and analytics tools.

• Facilitate the implementation of cutting-edge AI models that take advantage of advances in machine learning.

• Influence technical decisions around data workflows and application development in collaboration with key partners.

• Learn and deeply understand our Data Ecosystem to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

Who You Are

You are a passionate engineer who cares about technical and product excellence, with a drive to build highly usable solutions. You thrive in a collaborative environment, leveraging modern development practices to translate complex challenges into effective technology solutions.

• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a similar technica

L'opportunité
• Assurer l'excellence technique en fournissant des flux de données et des pipelines innovants et de qualité supérieure dans des domaines scientifiques clés.
• Promouvoir l'adoption de tendances et de technologies clés en appliquant une approche Open Source, Cloud First, API First et AI First à la résolution de problèmes.
• Améliorer nos flux de travail de données et l'architecture d'application en tirant parti des modèles standard tels que les microservices et la conception d'événements.
• Intégrer divers ensembles de données pour alimenter l'IA/ML, la recherche en langage naturel et les outils de visualisation et d'analyse en aval.
• Faciliter la mise en œuvre de modèles d'intelligence artificielle de pointe qui tirent parti des progrès de l'apprentissage automatique.
• Influencer les décisions techniques sur les flux de données et le développement des applications en collaboration avec les principaux partenaires.
• Apprenez et comprenez profondément notre écosystème de données pour stimuler l'amélioration continue et l'innovation. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un ingénieur passionné qui se soucie de l'excellence technique et des produits, avec un moteur pour construire des solutions hautement utilisables. Vous prospèrez dans un environnement collaboratif, en tirant parti des pratiques de développement modernes pour traduire les défis complexes en solutions technologiques efficaces.
• Baccalauréat en informatique ou technica similaire

jobs.title: Country Medical Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Country Medical Director is a senior leader who easily navigates between science, data and business in service of our vision at Roche. You are an experienced professional with a solid scientific background. You are confident in playing a key role in developing the local medical strategy to enable future success of the organization and you have experience in transforming complex healthcare challenges into clear and compelling actions that benefit patients.

Building relationships and scientific partnerships with our stakeholders is your second nature. Considering the nature of Bosnia and Herzegovina healthcare system, the Medical Director will bring understanding of the operating environment (or comparable market) and its challenges. You come with a strong vision on evidence generation and data enabled healthcare. You are passionate about innovation and can envision how healthcare data and science can have a sustainable impact on the healthcare system.

As a member of the Roche Bosnia and Herzegovina Enabling/Leadership Team, you will be responsible for setting the strategic direction and achieving company objectives within the Affiliate and Medical Chapter, including strategic decision making and empowering teams. You will serve as a role model to the entire organization, lead the functional chapter, and focus on upskilling and coaching team members, while also co-creating organizational strategies and fostering agility and cultural change. Additionally, you will collaborate with other Country Medical Directors, Chapter Heads and Squad Leads to allocate resources and support professional development within the Network, Affiliate and Chapter.

Who are we looking for?

Beyond strong focus on external engagement, strategic partnerships, data and science you have the following responsibilities:

• Shape and develop the overall affiliate medical strategy based on external insights and Roche’s product portfolio developments

• Drive above-brand medical strategy and alignment

• Represents Roche medical authority with key external stakeholders

• As a member of the Enabling /Leadership Team, develop and implement the vision, mission and overarching strategy for Roche Bosnia and Herzegovina and ensure it adheres to the highest scientific and ethical standards and fulfills all regulatory and compliance requirements.

• Ensure excellence in scientific consulting with stakeholders, patient safety, quality, compliance, regulatory, evidence generation and medical information

• Establish and maintain local medical and scientific independence and assurance of medical compliance acting as the local delegate of authority of Roche`s Pharma CMO ensuring business integrity and company reputation.

• Drive early health data gap identification, prioritization and integrated evidence planning inclusion by being actively involved and by collaborating with strong medical enablers

• Bring clinical practice perspective and act as a sparring partner to decide how (and which) data should be used / generated to build the medical narrative in the respective disease areas

• Work closely with local, cross-country and global compliance networks, strong cross-functional partnership with other affiliate (and network) functions and actively engage with Roche global functions and group members.

• Being a servant leader to the entire affiliate and network acting with courage and integrity. Role model creative leadership and network mindset supporting transparency across the organization.

jobs.title: Commissioning & Qualification Manager (m/f/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de la mise en service et des qualifications (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global Engineering executes projects in Pharma Technical Operations (PT), and other divisions within Roche on demand. Within Global Engineering, the Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Manager has overall responsibility for the compliant, in time and in budget delivery of Commissioning & Qualification deliverables. The Commissioning & Qualification Manager reports to the PTT Regional Head of C&Q. Work is self-directed in nature. Projects / initiatives can vary in both length of time and complexity, requiring extensive cross-functional collaboration and agile execution strategies in support of GMP manufacturing operations, affiliates and CMOs. The position requires excellent internal and external collaboration and influencing skills and the ability to lead diverse, cross-functional teams.

Are you ready to lead large-scale engineering projects that deliver life-saving medicines to patients worldwide? Join our Global Engineering team and take overall responsibility for the compliant and timely delivery of Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) for our pharmaceutical technical operations

The Opportunity
As a C&Q Manager, you will act as a Sub-Project Manager within Global Engineering, driving excellence in a dynamic and collaborative team environment.
You will:

• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Motivate and inspire diverse teams during the C&Q phase, setting clear expectations and fostering a "one team" culture.

• Drive Project Success: Manage C&Q project scope to ensure deliverables are met within the approved budget and schedule.

• Ensure Global Compliance: Execute all deliverables in full alignment with the Roche Pharmaceutical Quality Management System (PQS) and international regulatory standards.

• Innovate and Challenge: Identify better ways to accomplish objectives by introducing best practices and innovation for C&Q Capex project management.

• Partner Strategically: Proactively build trustful relationships with key stakeholders and customers to support Roche’s strategic business goals.

Who you are

You bring:

• A University Degree in Engineering, Science, or a related discipline.

• Bachelor with 6-8 years experience, Master with 5-7 years experience in the (bio)pharmaceutical industry, specifically in sterile drug product manufacturing or qualification.

• You have gained particular experience in leading a drug product sterile filling facility commissioning and qualification, leading the commissioning and qualification of packaging and autoinjector assembly, as well as in the commissioning and qualification of cleanroom systems.

• Deep knowledge of C&Q strategies (ASTM E2500), risk-based approaches, and global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH).

• Proficient in both German and English (written and spoken) with the ability to adjust your style to various audiences.

• Travel (20%) may be required to meet the business need, in order to lead the team at the project site/location. Expectation if assigned to a specific project during design or construction it is required to spend most of the time on site.

This is a 100% full time role and locally based in potential future EU sites and / or Mannheim / Penzberg.

Application documents - very pragmatic:
We ask you for a current CV in English and your official (educational) certificates/credentials. Further documents are not mandatory at the moment. Please note before sending your application that no further documents can be added afterwards.
Apply now - we are looking forward to it!

Your contact to us! Wit

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Global Engineering realizza progetti in Pharma Technical Operations (PT), e altre divisioni all'interno di Roche su richiesta. All'interno di Global Engineering, il Manager di Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) ha la responsabilità generale per la conformità, nel tempo e nella consegna di bilancio dei consegnabili Commissioning & Qualification. Il Commissioning & Qualification Manager riporta al PTT Regional Head of C&Q. Il lavoro è autodiretto in natura. Progetti / iniziative possono variare sia in termini di durata che di complessità, richiedendo ampie strategie di collaborazione interfunzionale e di esecuzione agile a supporto delle operazioni di produzione GMP, affiliati e CMO. La posizione richiede un'eccellente collaborazione interna ed esterna e influenza le competenze e la capacità di guidare squadre diverse e interfunzionali. Siete pronti a condurre progetti di ingegneria su larga scala che forniscono farmaci salvavita ai pazienti in tutto il mondo? Unisciti al nostro team di Global Engineering e assumi la responsabilità generale per la fornitura conforme e tempestiva di Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) per le nostre operazioni tecniche farmaceutiche L'opportunità Come C&Q Manager, agirai come Sub-Project Manager all'interno di Global Engineering, guidando l'eccellenza in un ambiente di team dinamico e collaborativo. • Assicurare il Compliance Globale: Eseguire tutti i prodotti in pieno allineamento con il sistema di gestione della qualità farmaceutica Roche (PQS) e gli standard normativi internazionali.
• Innovare e sfida: Identificare modi migliori per raggiungere gli obiettivi introducendo best practice e innovazione per la gestione dei progetti C&Q Capex.
• Partner Strategicamente: Proattivamente costruire relazioni fiduciose con i principali stakeholder e clienti per sostenere gli obiettivi strategici di Roche. Chi sei Tu porti:
• Una laurea in Ingegneria, Scienza o una disciplina relativa.
• Corso di laurea con 6-8 anni di esperienza, Master con 5-7 anni di esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica (bio), in particolare nella produzione o nella qualificazione di prodotti di droga sterili.
• Hai acquisito una particolare esperienza nella guida di un impianto di riempimento sterile del prodotto di droga che commissiona e qualifica, conducendo la messa in servizio e la qualificazione di imballaggio e assemblaggio di autoiniettori, così come nella messa in servizio e nella qualificazione dei sistemi di cleanroom.
• Conoscenza profonda delle strategie C&Q (ASTM E2500), approcci basati sui rischi e normative globali (FDA, EMA, ICH).
• Proficiente sia in tedesco che in inglese (scritto e parlato) con la capacità di regolare il vostro stile a vari pubblico.
• Il viaggio (20%) può essere richiesto per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali, al fine di guidare il team presso il sito/location del progetto. L'aspettativa se assegnata a un progetto specifico durante la progettazione o la costruzione è tenuto a trascorrere la maggior parte del tempo in loco. Questo è un ruolo a tempo pieno al 100% e localmente basato in potenziali futuri siti UE e / o Mannheim / Penzberg. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global Engineering executes projects in Pharma Technical Operations (PT), and other divisions within Roche on demand. Within Global Engineering, the Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Manager has overall responsibility for the compliant, in time and in budget delivery of Commissioning & Qualification deliverables. The Commissioning & Qualification Manager reports to the PTT Regional Head of C&Q. Work is self-directed in nature. Projects / initiatives can vary in both length of time and complexity, requiring extensive cross-functional collaboration and agile execution strategies in support of GMP manufacturing operations, affiliates and CMOs. The position requires excellent internal and external collaboration and influencing skills and the ability to lead diverse, cross-functional teams.

Are you ready to lead large-scale engineering projects that deliver life-saving medicines to patients worldwide? Join our Global Engineering team and take overall responsibility for the compliant and timely delivery of Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) for our pharmaceutical technical operations

The Opportunity
As a C&Q Manager, you will act as a Sub-Project Manager within Global Engineering, driving excellence in a dynamic and collaborative team environment.
You will:

• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Motivate and inspire diverse teams during the C&Q phase, setting clear expectations and fostering a "one team" culture.

• Drive Project Success: Manage C&Q project scope to ensure deliverables are met within the approved budget and schedule.

• Ensure Global Compliance: Execute all deliverables in full alignment with the Roche Pharmaceutical Quality Management System (PQS) and international regulatory standards.

• Innovate and Challenge: Identify better ways to accomplish objectives by introducing best practices and innovation for C&Q Capex project management.

• Partner Strategically: Proactively build trustful relationships with key stakeholders and customers to support Roche’s strategic business goals.

Who you are

You bring:

• A University Degree in Engineering, Science, or a related discipline.

• Bachelor with 6-8 years experience, Master with 5-7 years experience in the (bio)pharmaceutical industry, specifically in sterile drug product manufacturing or qualification.

• You have gained particular experience in leading a drug product sterile filling facility commissioning and qualification, leading the commissioning and qualification of packaging and autoinjector assembly, as well as in the commissioning and qualification of cleanroom systems.

• Deep knowledge of C&Q strategies (ASTM E2500), risk-based approaches, and global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH).

• Proficient in both German and English (written and spoken) with the ability to adjust your style to various audiences.

• Travel (20%) may be required to meet the business need, in order to lead the team at the project site/location. Expectation if assigned to a specific project during design or construction it is required to spend most of the time on site.

This is a 100% full time role and locally based in potential future EU sites and / or Mannheim / Penzberg.

Application documents - very pragmatic:
We ask you for a current CV in English and your official (educational) certificates/credentials. Further documents are not mandatory at the moment. Please note before sending your application that no further documents can be added afterwards.
Apply now - we are looking forward to it!

Your contact to us! Wit

Drive business results and customer value
a) Responsible for ensuring that manufactured products in Suzhou meet Health Authority regulations, Notified Body requirements, Company standards and expectations. Establish and support inspection readiness to ensure successful outcomes. Prepare adequate and timely responses to any inspection

and regulatory filings are meticulously drawn up, maintained up-to-date, and fully aligned with NMPA, FDA, and European regulations to safeguard our right to operate.

a) Partner with the Operations Site Head on strategic business direction and decisions. dependencies, as well as rebalance work & help in line with greater strategic priorities.

a) Develop and communicate organizational strategies, which ensure the GMP compliance of the site, continuous improvements and achievement of long-term goals.
b) Negotiate with Senior Leadership across the organization to influence decision making.

Stabilire e sostenere la disponibilità all'ispezione per garantire risultati positivi. Preparare risposte adeguate e tempestive a qualsiasi osservazione di ispezione e attuare correzioni adeguate e approfondite, se necessario.

- Attivare e influenzare l'organizzazione per garantire che la Qualità del Prodotto sia il nostro obiettivo assicurando che i prodotti fabbricati a Suzhou soddisfino i requisiti normativi e le specifiche del prodotto. Lavora direttamente in un ambiente complesso e globale con i capitoli e gli altri Network Leads per fornire prodotti di alta qualità, garantire il nostro diritto di operare e migliorare continuamente. - Fornire guida e guida al personale che dirige funzioni di qualità, gestire le prestazioni e lo sviluppo di report diretti per garantire il raggiungimento di obiettivi organizzativi, dipartimentali e un ambiente produttivo.

- Mantenere un'efficace governance della qualità e migliorare continuamente la governance per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali e di conformità. Comunicare questioni e rischi significativi di qualità o regolamentazione che possono incidere sulla qualità dei prodotti o sulla conformità normativa in modo tempestivo alla Direzione esecutiva. - Sviluppare il bilancio annuale, rivedere le previsioni per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali e monitorare/controllare le spese per garantire un uso efficiente delle risorse aziendali.

- Nominato Rappresentante di Gestione del Sito e Responsabile della Conformità Regolativa (PRRC) equivalente ai sensi della normativa GMP del dispositivo medico cinese e standard internazionali (ad esempio, ISO 13485:2016). Responsabile per garantire la documentazione tecnica del sito, sistemi di gestione della qualità e archiviazione normativa sono meticolosamente redatto, mantenuto aggiornato, e pienamente allineato con NMPA, FDA, e normative europee per salvaguardare il nostro diritto di operare.

Avanzare il lavoro della rete, facendo compromessi e rompendo silos - Partner con il sito operativo Head sulla direzione strategica del business e le decisioni. abbattere silos e migliorare l'efficacia lavorativa come un.integratore. in tutta l'organizzazione, se necessario; in particolare attraverso la collaborazione con altri leader della rete e stakeholder per risolvere strozzature e dipendenze e aumentare il lavoro e aiutare in linea con le priorità strategiche più grandi.

- Costruire e mantenere solide partnership con altri leader di sito e rete per assicurare l'allineamento intorno a progetti strategici e attività quotidiane e per garantire relazioni di lavoro reciprocamente di successo. - Coordinare con i Partner Funzionali per aggregare le future esigenze LCT e le prossime priorità, per comprendere meglio le future esigenze di risorse sulla rete.

Potenziare e consentire la rete - Sviluppare e comunicare strategie organizzative, che garantiscono la conformità GMP del sito, continui miglioramenti e il raggiungimento di obiettivi a lungo termine. - Negoziare con Senior Leadership in tutta l'organizzazione per influenzare il processo decisionale. - Lead,
