La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data Architetto Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. L'opportunità In qualità di Data Architect, formerai architetture di dati pronte per il futuro che colpiranno direttamente la nostra missione per migliorare la salute globale. Operando all'interno di un ecosistema di dati collaborativo, tradurrai requisiti di prodotto complessi in soluzioni scalabili e standard aziendali. Contribuirai a questa visione da:
• Progettazione di soluzioni innovative che soddisfano le priorità aziendali, gli standard tecnici e i requisiti critici non funzionali nel ciclo di vita del prodotto.
• Mantenere la roadmap architettonica strategica, la visione e il paesaggio attuale per le nostre soluzioni di dati per garantire scalabilità e affidabilità a lungo termine.
• Risolvere complesse sfide di dati con una prospettiva nuova, valutare più fonti di informazioni per guidare scelte architettoniche sonore.
• Definire architetture e modelli di riferimento, assicurando che i registri delle decisioni di architettura (ADR) siano rigorosamente documentati e mantenuti.
• Collaborare con i team di consegna per fornire supervisione architettonica, consultare i modelli di progettazione, gestire in modo proattivo il debito tecnico e ottimizzare i sistemi di dati esistenti.
• Valutare le tecnologie dei dati emergenti e pilotare soluzioni all'avanguardia per migliorare continuamente la governance dei dati e il valore aziendale.
• Promuovere il consenso tra diversi gruppi di stakeholder comunicando informazioni tecniche complesse con chiarezza, apertura ed empatia. Chi sei Sei un leader tecnico avanzato che prospera a trasformare la complessità dei dati in chiarezza. Siete appassionati di governance dei dati e desiderosi di collaborare con team interfunzionali per costruire sistemi sostenibili e ad alto impatto. Per trovare successo in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Esperienza dimostrata che progetta architetture di dati gestite da aziende, basate su standard e pronte per il futuro in domini di dati singoli o multipli.
• Una profonda conoscenza tecnica nelle aree principali della tecnologia dei dati, tra cui una forte comprensione dei modelli di dati concettuali e logici, delle tassonomie e delle Ontologie.
• Prova capacità di stabilire architetture di riferimento, definire le funzioni di fitness, monitorare le tendenze del settore e valutare la fattibilità della tecnologia dei fornitori.
• Capacità di comunicazione eccezionale con una capacità naturale di spiegare concetti tecnici complessi agli stakeholder non tecnici e creare un consenso collaborativo.
• Una mentalità proattiva e orientata alla crescita focalizzata sulla minimizzazione del debito tecnico, l'identificazione delle opportunità di valore aggiunto e la mentoring peers all'interno della più ampia comunità di dati. Che cosa si ottiene
• Intervallo salato 14.000 - 26.000 PLN lordo basato sul

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme zählt. Beim Position Data Architect Roche Digital Technology (RDT) trifft Innovation auf Zweck. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien zu unterstützen und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der Digital eine Kernstärke von Roche ist, intelligentere Arbeitsweisen ermöglicht, menschliches Potenzial freisetzt und Durchbrüche vorantreibt, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt von Bedeutung sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Im Moment verlangen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathäuser, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Die Chance Als Data Architect gestalten Sie zukunftsfähige Datenarchitekturen, die sich direkt auf unsere Mission zur Verbesserung des globalen Gesundheitswesens auswirken. In einem kollaborativen Daten-Ökosystem werden komplexe Produktanforderungen in skalierbare, unternehmensspezifische Lösungen umgesetzt. Sie tragen zu dieser Vision bei, indem Sie innovative Lösungen entwickeln, die Geschäftsprioritäten, technische Standards und kritische nicht-funktionale Anforderungen über den gesamten Lebenszyklus von Datenprodukten erfüllen.
• Beibehaltung der strategischen architektonischen Roadmap, Vision und aktuellen Landschaft für unsere Datenlösungen, um Skalierbarkeit und langfristige Rentabilität zu gewährleisten.
• Lösung komplexer Datenherausforderungen mit einer neuen Perspektive, Bewertung mehrerer Informationsquellen, um fundierte architektonische Entscheidungen zu treffen.
• Definieren von Referenzarchitekturen und Mustern, um sicherzustellen, dass Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) streng dokumentiert und gepflegt werden.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Lieferteams, um die Architekturaufsicht zu gewährleisten, Designmuster zu konsultieren, technische Schulden proaktiv zu verwalten und bestehende Datensysteme zu optimieren.
• Bewertung neuer Datentechnologien und Pilotierung innovativer Lösungen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Data Governance und Business Value.
• Förderung des Konsenses zwischen verschiedenen Interessengruppen durch die Kommunikation komplexer technischer Informationen mit Klarheit, Offenheit und Empathie. Sie sind ein zukunftsorientierter technischer Führer, der es schafft, Datenkomplexität in Klarheit zu verwandeln. Sie haben eine Leidenschaft für Data Governance und sind bestrebt, mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten, um nachhaltige, wirkungsvolle Systeme aufzubauen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie folgendes mit:
• Demonstrierte Erfahrung beim Entwerfen unternehmensorientierter, standardbasierter, zukunftsfähiger Datenarchitekturen über einzelne oder mehrere Datendomänen hinweg.
• Tiefes technisches Wissen in Kerndatentechnologiebereichen, einschließlich eines fundierten Verständnisses von konzeptionellen und logischen Datenmodellen, Taxonomien und Ontologien.
• Bewährte Fähigkeit, Referenzarchitekturen zu erstellen, Fitnessfunktionen zu definieren, Branchentrends zu verfolgen und die Machbarkeit der Anbietertechnologie zu bewerten.
• Außergewöhnliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der natürlichen Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Konzepte nicht-technischen Stakeholdern zu erklären und einen kollaborativen Konsens aufzubauen.
• Eine proaktive, wachstumsorientierte Denkweise, die sich auf die Minimierung technischer Schulden, die Identifizierung von Mehrwertmöglichkeiten und die Betreuung von Peers innerhalb der breiteren Datengemeinschaft konzentriert. Was Sie erhalten

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Architecte de données Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. L'opportunité En tant qu'architecte de données, vous façonnerez des architectures de données prêtes à l'avenir qui influent directement sur notre mission d'améliorer les soins de santé mondiaux. En travaillant au sein d'un écosystème collaboratif de données, vous transformerez les exigences complexes du produit en solutions évolutives et standard pour l'entreprise. Vous contribuerez à cette vision en :
• Concevoir des solutions innovantes qui répondent aux priorités des entreprises, aux normes techniques et aux exigences critiques non fonctionnelles tout au long du cycle de vie des produits de données.
• Maintenir la feuille de route stratégique, la vision et le paysage actuel pour nos solutions de données afin d'assurer l'évolutivité et la viabilité à long terme.
• Résoudre les défis complexes en matière de données avec une nouvelle perspective, en évaluant de multiples sources d'information pour générer des choix architecturaux solides.
• Définir les architectures et les modèles de référence, en veillant à ce que les documents décisionnels d'architecture (ADR) soient rigoureusement documentés et tenus à jour.
• Établir des partenariats avec les équipes chargées de l'exécution pour assurer la supervision architecturale, consulter les modèles de conception, gérer de manière proactive la dette technique et optimiser les systèmes de données existants.
• Évaluer les nouvelles technologies de données et mettre à l'essai des solutions de pointe pour améliorer continuellement la gouvernance des données et la valeur opérationnelle.
• Favoriser le consensus entre les divers groupes d'intervenants en communiquant des informations techniques complexes avec clarté, ouverture et empathie. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader technique avant-gardiste qui prospère en transformant la complexité des données en clarté. Vous êtes passionné par la gouvernance des données et désireux de collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour construire des systèmes durables et à impact élevé. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• Expérience démontrée en matière de conception d'architectures de données axées sur les entreprises, basées sur des normes et prêtes à l'avenir dans des domaines de données uniques ou multiples.
• Connaissances techniques approfondies dans les domaines fondamentaux de la technologie des données, y compris une bonne compréhension des modèles conceptuels et logiques de données, des taxonomies et des ontologies.
• Capacité éprouvée d'établir des architectures de référence, de définir les fonctions de conditionnement physique, de suivre les tendances de l'industrie et d'évaluer la faisabilité technologique des fournisseurs.
• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication avec une capacité naturelle d'expliquer des concepts techniques complexes aux acteurs non techniques et d'établir un consensus collaboratif.
• Un état d'esprit proactif et axé sur la croissance, axé sur la réduction de la dette technique, l'identification des possibilités d'ajout de valeur et le mentorat des pairs au sein de la communauté des données. Ce que vous obtenez
• Salaires compris entre 14 000 et 26 000 PLN brut

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, smoke study, VHP, Isolator EMPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.
● Support the initial development and optimization of aseptic filling processes.
● Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan.
● Trained and qualified on equipment operation and aseptic techniques.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:
● Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.
● Performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, filling and stoppering, capping.
● Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team.
● Support environmental monitoring activities to ensure that the Isolatore environment meets aseptic standards.
● Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA.
● Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime.
● Execute regular validation activities, such as APS.
● Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area.
● Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
● College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies
● 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.
● Experienced in strategic projects of Aseptic Filling facility including design, commissioning & qualification，Isolator filling line is preferred.
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.
● Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
TAM 治疗领域经理
Therapeutic Area Manager

治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Principal Commercial Training Consultant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary
According to RDSL business and people strategies, partner with business stakeholders, perform comprehensive analysis of business knowledge and capabilities gaps. Provide the commercial training consultancy, design and develop an effective and consistent commercial training system and content, implement the learning plan effectively to ensure the good learning experience. Continue to evolve the commercial training system to ensure fit-for-future organizational needs.

Main Tasks &
• Responsibilities
1. Develop and implement annual training plan of entire business to facilitate meeting organizational goals and individual professional needs.
2. Collect, evaluate, and identify training requirements of entire business with internal and external resources including global partners to develop, review and improve training programs, including customized programs, design and implement training strategies and solutions
3. Develop and organize training materials including manuals, slides, and other materials， deploy the online and offline trainings in bilingual language (English and Mandarin)
4. Develop measurement mechanism， evaluate and follow up of training effectiveness, report the feedbacks to the business.
5. Support training program effective communication plan to enhance the business engagement
6. Create and manage training budget to maximum return on investment
7. Other projects or tasks assigned by line manager

Education&
• Qualifications:
1. Bachelor Degree in Clinical Laboratory, Medical or business related major
2. Ability in facilitation and consultation, training organization and strong in communication skills
3. Good command of MS office software application
4. Training expertise is desired, healthcare industry background is a plus

Experience:
1. At least 5 years similar experience in the relevant function
2. Experience in project management with strong business acumen
3. Experience in cross function collaboration and result driven for business impact.

jobs.title: (Sr.) Analyst, Analytical Lab, Biologics
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roles & Responsibilities

Routine Operation :

Perform the physical and chemical testing on the samples from incoming raw materials and packaging materials, produced bulks and products, environment monitoring, process validation and cleaning validation, etc. Issue the reliable analytical report in reasonable lead time.

Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements

Assist Head of Analytical Testing lab to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance. Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely to, internal investigations and regulatory inspectors.

Accomplish the calibration and maintenance of assigned instruments, to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time.

Report the abnormal status, unexpected results to supervisors with initiative.

By reporting abnormal status and unexpected results during analysis processing by detailed data and information to alert supervisor to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.

Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of bioanalytical materials and cell supplies

Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification

Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness :

Analytical method transfer execution: Support and execute the analytical method transfer for the aseptic product.

Analytical Method Validation and Qualification: Execute the methods comparison, qualification and validation activities.

Equipment Support: Support the Performance Qualification (PQ) of laboratory equipment and ensure routine operation.

Qualification and Experience

Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

Job Required Competencies

• 2 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on bioanalytical and bioassay testing. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred

• Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance and physical and chemical testing.

• Experienced in QC new facility startup readiness and operation ramp up is preferred.

• ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Fluent communications skills in English

• Project management skills is preferred.

The Position
In Roche’s China Early Development (ED) Center of Excellence (CoE), we play a critical role in accelerating the global early development of transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. We are a strategic partner to global early development teams of Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED), and pharma Product Development (PD) to integrate China into the global early development programs. The Opportunity
This role will have the opportunity to shape global early development strategy and CDP, to drive innovative early development trial design, to make significant impacts to the efficiency and success of our early development programs in oncology/hematology, and contribute to the China drug development innovation ecosystem.

• Drive innovative trial design and trial conduct in close partnership with global early development functional experts on China-first clinical trials

• Being the Medical Monitor for China ED clinical trials

• Scientifically engage China TAEs, Roche internal and external stakeholders

• Serve as a scientific point of contact to global early development asset teams of oncology/hematology

• Mentor junior medical directors to further build capability and capacity of ED CoE

Who you are

• You hold a MD in oncology/hematology, or a Bachelor/Master of Clinical Medicine with at least 3 years of post-graduation clinical practice in oncology/hematology

• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry and extensive early development experience in oncology/hematology

• Essere il Medical Monitor per gli studi clinici ED in Cina
• Coinvolgere scientificamente i TAE cinesi e le parti interessate interne ed esterne di Roche
• Servire come punto di contatto scientifico per i team globali di sviluppo iniziale di oncologia/ematologia

• Hai almeno 5 anni di esperienza nel settore biofarmaceutico e una vasta esperienza di sviluppo iniziale in oncologia/ematologia
• Hai esperienza pratica nello sviluppo di CDP di sviluppo iniziale, progettazione e conduzione di studi clinici di sviluppo iniziale, interazione con le autorità sanitarie, collaborazione con ricercatori e ricerca clinica Hai un'ottima conoscenza delle linee guida e dei regolamenti di sviluppo globale di oncologia/ematologia, inclusi CDE, FDA ed EMEA
• Sei un comunicatore efficace: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese scritto e verbale, con la capacità di presentare concetti complessi a team interfunzionali globali, comitati di governance e le principali parti interessate in modo logico e conciso

• Encadrer les directeurs médicaux juniors pour renforcer davantage les capacités et les capacités du CoE ED Qui vous êtes

• Vous avez au moins 5 ans d'expérience d'expérience dans l'industrie biopharmaceutique et une vaste expérience de développement précoce en oncologie/hématologie
• Vous avez une expérience pratique dans le développement de CDP de développement précoce, la conception et la conduite d'essais cliniques de développement précoce, l'interaction avec les autorités sanitaires, la collaboration avec les enquêteurs et la recherche clinique. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
In Roche’s China Early Development (ED) Center of Excellence (CoE), we play a critical role in accelerating the global early development of transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. We are a strategic partner to global early development teams of Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED), and pharma Product Development (PD) to integrate China into the global early development programs. Together, we bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This position is located in the clinical science function of Roche Product Development China, home of the China ED CoE. This position is dedicated to leading and driving early development programs in therapeutic areas of immunology, neurology, CVRM, and ophthalmology as a clinical lead.

The Opportunity
This role will have the opportunity to shape global early development strategy and CDP, to drive innovative early development trial design, to make significant impacts to the efficiency and success of our early development programs in therapeutic areas of immunology, neurology, CVRM, and ophthalmology, and contribute to the China drug development innovation ecosystem.
In your role, you will:

• Contribute to and influence global asset strategy and early development CDP as a member of the global asset teams

• Proactively identify opportunities of accelerating and optimizing global ED CDP leveraging expertise, experience, speed, and scale in China

• Lead the China cross-functional team to evaluate opportunities of China joining global ED programs or China-first trials from strategic, scientific, regulatory, and operational perspectives

• Drive innovative trial design and trial conduct in close partnership with global early development functional experts on China-first clinical trials

• Being the Medical Monitor for China ED clinical trials

• Scientifically engage China TAEs, Roche internal and external stakeholders

• Serve as a scientific point of contact to global early development asset teams of non-oncology therapeutic areas (immunology, neurology, CVRM, ophthalmology)

• Mentor junior medical directors to further build capability and capacity of ED CoE

Who you are

• You hold a MD, or a Bachelor/Master of Clinical Medicine with at least 3 years of post-graduation clinical practice; clinical expertise in immunology preferred

• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry and extensive early development experience, early development experience in immunology preferred

• You have hands-on experience in developing early development CDP, designing and running early development clinical trials, interacting with Health Authorities, collaborating with investigators and clinical research sites, and interpreting early development clinical trial data

• You have a very good understanding of global development guidelines and regulations, including CDE, FDA and EMEA

• You are an effective communicator: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts to global cross functional teams, governance committees and key stakeholders in a logical and succinct manner

• You are a great team player; highly collaborative, good interpersonal and influencing skills, can influence without authority

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the glob
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position in Roches China Early Development (ED) Center of Excellence (CoE), spielen wir eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Beschleunigung der globalen frühen Entwicklung von transformativen Medikamenten für Patienten, um einige der weltweit härtesten unerfüllten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Wir sind ein strategischer Partner globaler Frühentwicklungsteams von Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED) und pharma Product Development (PD), um China in die globalen Frühentwicklungsprogramme zu integrieren. Gemeinsam bringen wir außergewöhnliche lebensverändernde Innovationen mit Geschwindigkeit voran. Diese Position befindet sich in der klinischen Wissenschaftsfunktion von Roche Product Development China, der Heimat des China ED CoE. Diese Position widmet sich der Leitung und Förderung von Frühentwicklungsprogrammen in therapeutischen Bereichen der Immunologie, Neurologie, CVRM und Augenheilkunde als klinischer Leiter. Die Chance Diese Rolle wird die Möglichkeit haben, die globale Frühentwicklungsstrategie und das CDP zu gestalten, das innovative Design von Frühentwicklungsstudien voranzutreiben, erhebliche Auswirkungen auf die Effizienz und den Erfolg unserer Frühentwicklungsprogramme in therapeutischen Bereichen der Immunologie, Neurologie, CVRM und Augenheilkunde zu haben und zum Innovationsökosystem der chinesischen Arzneimittelentwicklung beizutragen. In Ihrer Rolle werden Sie:
• Beitrag zu und Einfluss auf die globale Anlagestrategie und frühe Entwicklung CDP als Mitglied der globalen Anlageteams
• Proaktiv identifizieren Möglichkeiten zur Beschleunigung und Optimierung der globalen ED CDP durch die Nutzung von Know-how, Erfahrung, Geschwindigkeit und Skalierung in China
• Führen Sie das China Cross-Funktionsteam, um die Chancen zu bewerten, die China bei globalen ED-Programmen oder China-First-Studien aus strategischen, wissenschaftlichen, regulatorischen und operativen Perspektiven hat
• Führen Sie innovatives Studiendesign und Studiendurchführung in enger Partnerschaft mit globalen Experten für frühe Entwicklung Funktional in China Ersten klinischen Studien
• Als medizinischer Monitor für China ED klinische Studien
• Wissenschaftlich engagieren China TAEs, Roche interne und externe Stakeholder
• Dienen Sie als wissenschaftlicher Ansprechpartner für globale Early Development Asset Teams von nicht-onkologischen therapeutischen Bereichen (Immunologie, Neurologie, CVRM, Augenheilkunde)

• Sie haben einen MD oder einen Bachelor / Master of Clinical Medicine mit mindestens 3 Jahren klinischer Praxis nach dem Abschluss; klinische Expertise in Immunologie bevorzugt
• Sie haben mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der biopharmazeutischen Industrie und umfangreiche frühe Entwicklungserfahrung, frühe Entwicklungserfahrung in der Immunologie bevorzugt
• Sie haben praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von CDP für die frühe Entwicklung, der Gestaltung und Durchführung klinischer Studien für die frühe Entwicklung, der Interaktion mit Gesundheitsbehörden, der Zusammenarbeit mit Forschern und klinischen Forschungsstandorten und der Interpretation von Daten für klinische Studien für die frühe Entwicklung. Sie haben ein sehr gutes Verständnis für globale Entwicklungsrichtlinien und -vorschriften, einschließlich CDE, FDA und EMEA
• Sie sind ein effektiver Kommunikator: Hervorragende schriftliche und mündliche englische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Konzepte für globale funktionsübergreifende Teams, Governance-Ausschüsse und wichtige Stakeholder auf logische und prägnante Weise zu präsentieren. Du bist ein großartiger Teamplayer; sehr kooperative, gute zwischenmenschliche und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten, können ohne Autorität beeinflussen Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Zusammen mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter über den Globus

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position La position Dans le Centre d'excellence pour le développement précoce de la Chine (CED) de Roches, nous jouons un rôle crucial dans l'accélération du développement précoce mondial des médicaments transformateurs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Nous sommes un partenaire stratégique des équipes mondiales de développement précoce de Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (PRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (GRED) et Pharmaceutical Product Development (PD) pour intégrer la Chine dans les programmes mondiaux de développement précoce. Ensemble, nous apportons rapidement des innovations extraordinaires qui changent la vie. Cette position est située dans la fonction de science clinique de Roche Product Development China, la maison de la Chine ED CoE. Ce poste est dédié à diriger et à diriger des programmes de développement précoce dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'immunologie, de la neurologie, du CVRM et de l'ophtalmologie en tant que chef de file clinique. L'opportunité Ce rôle aura l'occasion de façonner la stratégie mondiale de développement précoce et le PDC, de stimuler la conception novatrice d'essais de développement précoce, d'avoir des répercussions importantes sur l'efficacité et le succès de nos programmes de développement précoce dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'immunologie, de la neurologie, du CVRM et de l'ophtalmologie, et de contribuer à l'écosystème d'innovation pour le développement de médicaments en Chine. Dans votre rôle, vous :
• Contribuer et influencer la stratégie mondiale en matière d'actifs et le développement rapide en tant que membre des équipes mondiales d'actifs
• Identifier de manière proactive les possibilités d'accélérer et d'optimiser le CDP mondial ED en tirant parti de l'expertise, de l'expérience, de la vitesse et de l'échelle en Chine
• Diriger l'équipe interfonctionnelle de la Chine pour évaluer les possibilités de la Chine de rejoindre les programmes mondiaux de DE ou les premiers essais de la Chine sur le plan stratégique, scientifique, réglementaire et opérationnel
• Favoriser la conception et la conduite d'essais innovants en partenariat étroit avec des experts fonctionnels mondiaux en développement précoce sur les premiers essais cliniques en Chine
• Être le moniteur médical pour les essais cliniques de DE en Chine
• Mobiliser scientifiquement les TAE chinois, les acteurs internes et externes de Roche
• Servir de point de contact scientifique avec les équipes mondiales de développement précoce des domaines thérapeutiques non oncologiques (immunologie, neurologie, CVRM, ophtalmologie)
• Mentor des directeurs médicaux juniors pour renforcer les capacités et les capacités du Conseil de l'Europe Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un MD ou d'un baccalauréat/maîtrise en médecine clinique avec au moins 3 ans de pratique clinique après l'obtention du diplôme; expertise clinique en immunologie préférée
• Vous avez au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie biopharmaceutique et une expérience de développement précoce étendue, expérience de développement précoce en immunologie préférée
• Vous avez une expérience pratique du développement précoce du PDC, de la conception et du déroulement des essais cliniques de développement précoce, de l'interaction avec les autorités sanitaires, de la collaboration avec les chercheurs et les sites de recherche clinique, et de l'interprétation des données des essais cliniques de développement précoce
• Vous avez une très bonne compréhension des lignes directrices et des règlements mondiaux en matière de développement, y compris le CDE, la FDA et l'EMEA
• Vous êtes un communicateur efficace : Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais, avec la capacité de présenter des concepts complexes aux équipes interfonctionnelles mondiales, aux comités de gouvernance et aux principales parties prenantes de manière logique et succincte
• Vous êtes un grand joueur d'équipe; hautement collaborative, de bonnes aptitudes interpersonnelles et influentes, peut influencer sans autorité Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le glob

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Security and Cybersecurity Analyst serves as a trusted advisor and independent leader who drives the analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents and technical problems
By bridging deep business and technical understanding, you will manage end-to-end security analysis tasks across multiple products within a domain
You will shape stakeholder perspectives, champion accountability by taking on security incident lead or project owner roles, and foster continuous improvement in security operations and best practices

Description of the area
The Identity Management Support Team manages and operates the solutions and components used to provide customers with Directory and Identity Management Services using SailPoint. We are part of a global Roche Digital Technology group (RDT).

Job Responsibilities
In this role, you are mainly responsible for the multi-cloud Identity Management environment, focusing specifically on Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), while maintaining consistency with AWS. This includes the design of new solutions, consultancy, maintenance, performance, tactical lifecycle management and continuous improvement of the underlying technologies.

Scope

• Strong background in IAM concepts at design level and evolution in Cloud environments, Azure and/or GCP.

• Contributes to the design of new solutions based on SailPoint and PingFederate, AD, Privilege Access Management.

• Design and implement Centralized Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) based on Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) principles.

• Access Governance and Controls: Enforce strong security controls across cloud environments, including Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and Identity Protection. Implement Least Privilege policies, often involving custom roles and organizational-level controls. Implement IAM Deny Policies to strictly block high-risk actions, ensuring separation of duties

• Automation and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Drive the core value of "Automate as much as possible". Design and implement IAM infrastructure using IaC, leveraging Terraform. For Azure, this mandates IaC using Terraform and Azure Verified Modules (AVM) with CI/CD pipelines in GitLab

• Privileged Access Management (PAM): Design and support Just-in-Time (JIT) Access mechanisms, ensuring no standing privileges for administrators, using tools like Cyberark for Just-in-Time access

• Operational Excellence: Act as an expert in the release management activities, providing 2nd and 3rd level support for the Identity Management Infrastructure. Proactively monitor systems for performance, availability, and capacity management

• Actively focus on self-development in creating actionable plans to improve.

Stakeholder Management

• Consultancy and Collaboration: Act as a mentor and reference, working closely with stakeholders to provide the right level of consultancy. Ensure regular interactions with the Managed Service Provider

• Acts as a strategic influencer, defining and driving stakeholder engagement strategies for complex initiatives, facilitating workshops, resolving conflicts, and proactively shaping stakeholder perspectives to align with project goals

Impact/Strategy

• Demonstrates strong and consistent performance across diverse products, with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster

• Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans that align with overall business objectives, and takes a proactive role in shaping team pro

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Territory Manager based in Bangalore, you will play a crucial role in driving our business with a primary focus on Retail promotion alongside vital Doctor/HCP support . You will champion our OTC (Over the counter) and OTX (Over The Counter and Prescription) portfolios, ensuring our products effectively penetrate the pharmacy and retail markets. By managing distribution networks, executing sales promotion plans, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will help us achieve our business goals.

The Opportunity

• Drive Retail Growth (Main Line Business): Lead retail sales and market penetration by building strong, lasting relationships with pharmacies, chemists, and retail partners to ensure optimal placement and movement of our OTC and OTX product lines.

• HCP Support: Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through targeted scientific communication, relationship building, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and support OTX prescriptions.

• Territory Planning: Assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing retail market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.

• Merchandising & Activation: Prepare and execute monthly retail sales promotion plans—including in-store field activation and pharmacy merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.

• Target Achievement: Ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the retail market.

• Network Management: Manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Motivate distributors, dealers, and retail chemists through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.

• Strategic Meetings & Collections: Organize distributor and retail dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.

• Market Intelligence: Act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities in the retail space, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your visits.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• You have proven practical experience in pharmacy sales , distribution management, or a territory management role.

• Product Expertise: You bring highly preferred experience working with OTC (Over the counter) and/or OTX (Over The Counter and Prescription) pharmaceutical products.

• You have a strong interest in driving retail market growth, with a focus on pharmacy relationship building, demand generation, and executing in-store marketing strategies.

• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Chemist, dealer, and Doctor intera

• Network Management: Manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Motivate distributors, dealers, and retail chemists through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.
• Strategic Meetings & Collections: Organize distributor and retail dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
¿Te apasiona impulsar el futuro del diagnóstico sanitario? Buscamos un/a Sales Specialist dinámico/a para unirse a nuestro equipo. En este rol, serás la cara estratégica de Roche Diagnostics dentro del ecosistema del laboratorio hospitalario, estableciendo relaciones sólidas y comprendiendo las necesidades técnicas y emocionales más profundas de nuestros clientes.
Tu misión irá más allá de la venta tradicional: realizarás análisis de situación exhaustivos para posicionar estratégicamente nuestro Portfolio de Near Patient Care y Diabetes. Promoviendo la eficiencia de los procesos, la innovación en los flujos de trabajo y la diferenciación de nuestros productos, ayudarás a los laboratorios a superar sus desafíos actuales, acelerando y mejorando el impacto en el paciente.

Your Main Responsibilities

• Ejecución Estratégica y Crecimiento: Implementar las actividades comerciales definidas para alcanzar y superar los objetivos anuales, ganar participación de mercado y cumplir con los KPI estratégicos en cuentas actuales y potenciales.

• Co-creación de Valor: Identificar las necesidades y retos en los laboratorios, así como en las áreas de compras, finanzas y gerencia hospitalaria. Propondrás soluciones diferenciadoras que ilusionen y enganchen al cliente.

• Gestión del Ciclo de Vida del Cliente (360°): Liderar todo el ciclo de vida del cliente, asegurando los máximos niveles de satisfacción y construyendo relaciones de confianza a largo plazo.

• Experto/a en el Portfolio: Desarrollar un profundo conocimiento de nuestras soluciones diagnósticas, realizando presentaciones y demostraciones de producto efectivas que comuniquen con claridad nuestras ventajas competitivas.

Who You Are (The skills you need)
Buscamos un/a profesional estructurado/a, metódico/a, con un fuerte empuje comercial y una gran pasión por el sector salud.

• Formación y Trasfondo: Licenciatura o Grado en Ciencias de la Salud y/o experiencia demostrada en el sector sanitario. Se valorará muy positivamente la experiencia previa como técnico/a de laboratorio o en tareas docentes/formativas.

• Experiencia: Mínimo de 3 a 4 años de experiencia contrastada en venta consultiva dentro del ámbito comercial del Sector Salud.

• "Hunter Mindset": Ambición, compromiso y un hambre clara por ganar nuevas cuentas, respaldado por un track record tangible de éxito comercial.

• Inteligencia de Mercado: Conocimiento profundo de la industria del diagnóstico, competidores, regulaciones y el funcionamiento de la Administración Sanitaria (licitaciones y concursos públicos).

• Enfoque Analítico: Capacidad para tomar decisiones basadas en datos y utilizar herramientas comerciales metodológicas para identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio en el territorio asignado.

• Orientación al Cliente: Alta capacidad de escucha activa para entender las necesidades técnicas y emocionales, asegurando que el valor diferencial de Roche sea evidente en cada interacción.

• Idiomas: Dominio del español; se valorarán positivamente los conocimientos de inglés para interactuar con redes globales y formaciones.

• Residencia en Castilla y León. Disponibilidad para viajar más de un 50% del tiempo.

jobs.title: DMR（営業職_東京）
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【職務内容】
担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、臨床検査センターなどを対象に、新規開拓を中心としたコンサルティング営業をお任せします。 まだ自社製品を導入していない医療施設へアプローチし、医療現場や検査室が抱える課題をヒアリングから抽出、解消に導くことが最優先のミッションです。自社製品をただ売り込むのではなく、お客様の課題解決に向けた最適なソリューションを提供していただきます。

【業務内容】
1. 新規開拓・コンサルティング提案営業

• 臨床検査技師などの現場担当者から、医師、事務長そして経営層まで幅広くアプローチし、検査室の課題を抽出します。製品導入によって見込まれる改善点や新しい提案を粘り強く行い、新規導入を目指します。

• 生化学、免疫、遺伝子（PCR）、病理領域の検査機器をはじめ、検査室自動化やITソリューション、デジタルソリューションまで、多岐にわたる製品群の中から、顧客のニーズに合わせて最適な解決策を組み立て、費用対効果（ROI）の提示や契約交渉を行います。

2. 既存顧客への運用サポートおよび社内連携

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Please note that this is a fixed term opportunity until 31/05/2028.

The Global Learning Services teams focus on executing system data maintenance and administrative activities in Cornerstone and all relevant Learning management systems as well as providing all necessary non-systems related Learning process support. Global Learning Services provides customer service and advisory support to the Learning Community and business partners on global Learning systems and processes and ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business.

The Opportunity
As a Learning Specialist - German speaking you are part of a global, international team and contribute to customer experience directly. Your key responsibilities are performing complete, stringent and timely Training & Learning related administrative and organizational tasks in area and understanding its linkage to Personnel Administration and Organizational Management.

• Providing insight, Tier 2 support and explanation on Learning system (Cornerstone), administering and updating Learning Catalog

• Managing course enrollments for learners, managing invitations, registrations, reminders and follow-up on courses and attendance

• Preparing and providing various Training-related reports and status updates for HR professionals and Training Owners

• Functionality testing of new learning management system and a dvising and supporting business with system / testing / Learning processes

• Providing customer service on Training related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting

• Developing and managing key stakeholder relationships in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way and building relationships with other colleagues within the GLS organization as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness.

What can you bring to our team: ​

• Ideally 1-3 years of experience in the fields of HR personnel administrative or service delivery or customer service with a college/university degree

• Accuracy in record keeping, focus and accountability

• The capability to multitask and handle complex cases

• Strong customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment and fluent in written and spoken German & English .

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (2 office day/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you alway

Global Learning Services provides customer service and advisory support to the Learning Community and business partners on global Learning systems and processes and ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business.

The Opportunity
As a Learning Specialist - German speaking you are part of a global, international team and contribute to customer experience directly. Your key responsibilities are performing complete, stringent and timely Training & Learning related administrative and organizational tasks in area and understanding its linkage to Personnel Administration and Organizational Management.

• Providing insight, Tier 2 support and explanation on Learning system (Cornerstone), administering and updating Learning Catalog

• Managing course enrollments for learners, managing invitations, registrations, reminders and follow-up on courses and attendance

• Preparing and providing various Training-related reports and status updates for HR professionals and Training Owners

• Functionality testing of new learning management system and a dvising and supporting business with system / testing / Learning processes

• Providing customer service on Training related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting

• Developing and managing key stakeholder relationships in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way and building relationships with other colleagues within the GLS organization as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness.

What can you bring to our team: ​

• Ideally 1-3 years of experience in the fields of HR personnel administrative or service delivery or customer service with a college/university degree

• Accuracy in record keeping, focus and accountability

• The capability to multitask and handle complex cases

• Strong customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment and fluent in written and spoken German & English .

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (2 office day/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you alway

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Au sein du hub français du Regional Customer Support Center basé à Meylan, le(la) Spécialiste Application RCSC avec une expertise en biologie moléculaire , apporte aux clients et aux collaborateurs de Roche Diagnostics l’assistance et le support demandés afin de garantir le fonctionnement optimal des systèmes Roche et ainsi le niveau de satisfaction des clients.

Vos principales responsabilités:

Assurer l’assistance téléphonique des clients (France, Belgique, Suisse francophone) sur les systèmes Roche Diagnostics et le support de second niveau aux collaborateurs des pays concernés et de la Division Export

• Réceptionne et traite toutes les demandes (téléphone, email), depuis la compréhension du besoin jusqu’au déclenchement des actions correctives adaptées, y compris le déclenchement d’interventions sur le terrain.

• Priorise les demandes selon la politique de service définie.

• Recherche activement la satisfaction des clients en apportant des réponses claires, précises et rapides.

• Documente précisément dans le logiciel CRM les symptômes décrits/observés et les actions réalisées.

• Escalade, si nécessaire, les problèmes traités vers l’équipe de support de niveau n+1.

Contribuer au partage des informations et à l’optimisation des pratiques

• Communique avec ses collègues terrain sur la situation d’un client en cas de problème ou de demande complexe.

• Alimente régulièrement la base de connaissances.

• Contribue aux lancements de nouveaux produits et/ou aux modifications des produits existants.

Assurer la progression de ses propres compétences

• Met à jour de manière régulière ses connaissances par la lecture des notes internes, mails et forums.

• Identifie les actions permettant d’accroître son autonomie.

• Prend en charge des problèmes complexes en collaboration active avec ses collègues référents.

Qui vous êtes:

• Licence Professionnelle ou Master scientifique idéalement en biologie moléculaire et ayant un attrait pour la technique également​

• 2 à 3 années d’expérience professionnelle dans un environnement applicatif et technique, acquises dans les domaines du service client.

• Compétences en biologie moléculaire : connaissance et interprétation des tests réalisés au laboratoire ( tests PCR, techniques d’extractions et d’amplifications et tests oncologie, virologie...)

• Sens du service client et pédagogie: aptitudes à la communication par téléphone, capacité à gérer les situations difficiles

• Bon niveau d’anglais

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【募集職種】 Clinician Engagement Sales_九州エリア担当
　　　　　　（小・中型医療機器のソリューション営業・保守サポート）

【職務内容】
担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、および開業医・クリニックに対し、中型医療機器（e411）および小型検査機器（Near Patient Care / POCT）の提案から導入後の保守点検まで、一貫した価値提供を担っていただきます。顧客の潜在的な課題を抽出し、現場に最適なオーダーメイド製品の提案を行い、導入から稼働後のアフターフォローまで伴走します。単なる機器の販売にとどまらず、検査の迅速化による院内ワークフローの改善や、救急・急性期医療における診療の質向上など、医療従事者との強固な信頼関係を構築しながら、患者ケアの質を高めるトータルソリューションを提供していただきます。また、定期的な保守点検やトラブルシューティングを通じて、機器が常に最適なパフォーマンスを発揮できるよう現場を支える重要な役割です。

＜具体的な業務内容＞
1. 提案・営業活動（Clinician Engagement）

• 担当エリア（大学病院、総合病院、クリニック、開業医）の医師、看護師、臨床検査技師などへのアプローチ

• 医療現場の課題のヒアリングと課題抽出

• ニーズに合わせた機器（cobas e 411、cobas pulse、cobas liatなど）や試薬のプレゼンテーション、デモンストレーションの実施

• 導入に伴う費用対効果（ROI）のシミュレーション、見積書作成、契約交渉

2. 導入・立ち上げサポート

• 機器納入時のセットアップおよび動作確認

• 医療従事者向けの操作説明会（アプリケーション・トレーニング）の実施

3. 保守点検・アフターフォロー（Technical Support）

• 契定期的な保守点検（メンテナンス）の実施

jobs.title: Data Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Lead Data Architect – Clinical Imaging and AI Platforms will lead the design, governance, and evolution of enterprise imaging and multi-modal data ecosystems, ensuring alignment with GxP, SaMD, FAIR, and clinical data governance frameworks. This role serves as the strategic bridge between scientific, business, and technology organizations across Research, Product Development, RIS, and RDT, translating business priorities into scalable, secure, and interoperable data architectures.
The role is responsible for defining enterprise data architecture strategy and establishing standards for metadata, interoperability, lineage, and AI-ready data models. It will enable scalable analytics and AI/ML workflows for Research (REDs) and Product Development(PD) while driving modernization of imaging data platforms in partnership with engineering, informatics, and governance teams.

Job Responsibilities

• Define and execute the enterprise data architecture strategy and roadmap for multi-modal imaging and research data within the Global Imaging Platform (GIP ).

• Design scalable and interoperable data architectures supporting Radiology, Digital Pathology, AI/ML, clinical, and translational research workflows.

• Establish and enforce standards for data modeling, metadata management, lineage, interoperability, cataloging, and governance across structured and unstructured datasets in close partnership with the Data managers and Study teams.

• Lead the design and implementation of cloud-native data platforms, data lakes/lakehouses, and distributed analytics ecosystems supporting global R&D and clinical initiatives.

• Partner with scientific, clinical, and technical stakeholders to translate business and research requirements into scalable, compliant, and reusable data solutions.

• Act as the primary architecture lead for imaging and multi-modal data ecosystems, coordinating across gRED, pRED, PD, RDT, RIS, and enterprise IT functions.

• Ensure alignment with GxP, FAIR standards, HIPAA/GDPR, security, privacy, and enterprise governance standards across all data architecture initiatives.

• Drive enterprise-wide adoption of common data models, interoperability standards, APIs, and semantic frameworks to improve data accessibility and reusability.

• Collaborate with engineering and platform teams to design robust data ingestion, transformation, storage, and access patterns optimized for AI/ML and advanced analytics, focussed on biomarker research and analysis of Imaging data.

• Define architecture patterns for high-volume imaging and pathology data, including metadata indexing, streaming, archival, and federated access strategies.

• Lead modernization efforts for legacy data environments towards scalable and efficient hybrid architectures.

• Drive automation and standardization across data lifecycle management, data quality monitoring, observability, and governance workflows.

• Oversee architecture reviews, technical governance, and cross-functional design decisions to ensure consistency, scalability, and operational excellence.

• Identify and implement opportunities to improve scalability, cost optimization, performance, automation, and operational efficiency across enterprise data platforms.

• Monitor emerging technologies and industry trends in data platforms, imaging data formats, AI/ML ecosystems, digital pathology, interoperability, and data standards to guide innovation and future-state architecture.

• Drive the evolution of AI-ready and semantically enriched

The role is responsible for defining enterprise data architecture strategy and establishing standards for metadata, interoperability, lineage, and AI-ready data models. It will enable scalable analytics and AI/ML workflows for Research (REDs) and Product Development(PD) while driving modernization of imaging data platforms in partnership with engineering, informatics, and governance teams.

Job Responsibilities

• Define and execute the enterprise data architecture strategy and roadmap for multi-modal imaging and research data within the Global Imaging Platform (GIP ).

• Design scalable and interoperable data architectures supporting Radiology, Digital Pathology, AI/ML, clinical, and translational research workflows.

• Establish and enforce standards for data modeling, metadata management, lineage, interoperability, cataloging, and governance across structured and unstructured datasets in close partnership with the Data managers and Study teams.

• Lead the design and implementation of cloud-native data platforms, data lakes/lakehouses, and distributed analytics ecosystems supporting global R&D and clinical initiatives.

• Partner with scientific, clinical, and technical stakeholders to translate business and research requirements into scalable, compliant, and reusable data solutions.

• Act as the primary architecture lead for imaging and multi-modal data ecosystems, coordinating across gRED, pRED, PD, RDT, RIS, and enterprise IT functions.

• Ensure alignment with GxP, FAIR standards, HIPAA/GDPR, security, privacy, and enterprise governance standards across all data architecture initiatives.

• Drive enterprise-wide adoption of common data models, interoperability standards, APIs, and semantic frameworks to improve data accessibility and reusability.

• Collaborate with engineering and platform teams to design robust data ingestion, transformation, storage, and access patterns optimized for AI/ML and advanced analytics, focussed on biomarker research and analysis of Imaging data.

• Define architecture patterns for high-volume imaging and pathology data, including metadata indexing, streaming, archival, and federated access strategies.

• Lead modernization efforts for legacy data environments towards scalable and efficient hybrid architectures.

• Drive automation and standardization across data lifecycle management, data quality monitoring, observability, and governance workflows.

• Oversee architecture reviews, technical governance, and cross-functional design decisions to ensure consistency, scalability, and operational excellence.

• Identify and implement opportunities to improve scalability, cost optimization, performance, automation, and operational efficiency across enterprise data platforms.

• Monitor emerging technologies and industry trends in data platforms, imaging data formats, AI/ML ecosystems, digital pathology, interoperability, and data standards to guide innovation and future-state architecture.

• Drive the evolution of AI-ready and semantically enriched

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Mission:
En tant que spécialiste commercial d’une/plusieurs gammes de produit (Core Lab), vous êtes responsable du développement et de l’atteinte des objectifs commerciaux et de part de marché de vos gamme de produits en coopération avec les Key Account Managers (KAM) / Customer Success Managers (CSM)
Vous interagissez en tant qu'expert(e) auprès des KAM / CSM en définissant et en présentant au client les solutions techniques envisagées.

Lieu d’habitation : Région de Paris

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous développez et maintenez une connaissance très forte de la gamme de produits/solutions dont vous avez la charge, grâce à une forte interaction avec le marketing et les experts produits du groupe; est en mesure de répondre à toutes les questions des clients sur ces produites, en autonomie et sait promouvoir la Valeur ajoutée différenciante de l’offre Roche vs les compétiteurs.

• Vous partagez les informations et tendance concurrence /marché que vous identifiez aux équipes marketing Roche. A ce titre, vous pouvez Identifier et informer le marketing des solutions de

• Vous soutenez les KAM et CSM d'un point de vue technique, médical ou scientifique sur le sujet dont vous êtes l'expert dans une perspective de développement du compte concerné

• Vous collaborez avec les CSM et le KAM à la construction de la stratégie commerciale des comptes sur ces gammes en identifiant les opportunités de croissance.

• Vous portez avec votre équipe la responsabilité de l’atteinte des objectifs de CA et de profitabilité associés à la/les gammes dont vous avez la charge - channel filling inclus.

• Vous construisez des offres spécifiques basées sur la compréhension des besoins clients en incluant les tierces parties nécessaires et en vous assurant notamment de la bonne adéquation entre l'offre commerciale et l'environnement opérationnel du client (CQ, repasse, volume, interface avec les autres chapters). Pour les dossiers AO publics - vous collaborez à la réponse financière et au pricing de la solution.

• Vous contribuez au sein de son équipe à l’amélioration de la performance de la/les gammes dont vous avez la responsabilité.

• Vous garantissez le respect de la compliance dans les relations avec le client

Qui vous êtes:

• De formation scientifique ou technique, vous maîtrisez l'environnement de la santé et les enjeux de l'industrie du Diagnostic In Vitro (DIV).

• Reconnu pour votre intelligence situationnelle et votre aisance relationnelle, vous maîtrisez l'art de la négociation et de la contractualisation de haut niveau.

• Doté d'une écoute active, vous savez traduire les demandes clients en solutions concrètes, conseiller avec valeur ajoutée et aligner vos interlocuteurs autour d'une vision stratégique commune.

• Vous possédez une forte capacité à inspirer, engager et influencer positivement. Vous excellez dans la collaboration transversale et la coopération hors lien hiérarchique.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: Government & External Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position: Government & External Affairs Lead
Team: Health System Shaping Lab
Reports to: General Manager

Roche Slovensko is seeking a Government & External Affairs Lead to join the Local Leadership Team (Purpose Enabling Board - PEB). This senior role is responsible for shaping national policy and creating patient access strategies.

The successful candidate will proactively drive changes in the national policy and legislative environment. You will lead strategies to influence key stakeholders, ensuring patient access to our innovations. This position requires strategic thinking, political knowledge, and an entrepreneurial approach to impact the Slovak healthcare system.

Key Responsibilities:

• Policy Advocacy: Lead targeted efforts to influence public health and pricing legislation to drive systemic improvements for patient access and innovation.

• Stakeholder Management: Develop and maintain strong, strategic relationships with political stakeholders, decision-makers, and payers at the national level.

• External Representation: Serve as the primary representative for OneRoche, building alliances with external organizations to enhance reputation and create value.

• Strategic Alignment: Manage the External Engagement Strategy, ensuring it supports Patient Access goals and integrates across Pharma, Diagnostics, and the wider Roche enterprise.

• Leadership: Participate in the Purpose Enabling Board (Affiliate Leadership Team), connecting the Health System Shaping group's goals to the affiliate strategy, and guiding the team.

Required Qualifications:

• Experience: Minimum 5 years in Government & External Affairs (policy/network development). Minimum 7 years of experience in the Slovak Health Care. Minimum 6 months in leadership roles.

• Expertise:
