descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Stellenbeschreibung Der Azure Cloud IT Infrastructure Network Engineer ist ein hochqualifizierter, technologieunabhängiger Experte, der für die Lösung ungewöhnlich komplexer Geschäftsprobleme mit innovativen Lösungen im gesamten Bereich der Infrastrukturtechnologie verantwortlich ist. In dieser Funktion nutzen Sie Ihr fundiertes Wissen über die Auswirkungen der IT-Infrastruktur auf das Geschäft von Roche, um kritische technische Entscheidungen mit erheblicher Unabhängigkeit zu treffen. Als Führungskraft beeinflussen Sie proaktiv die Technologiestrategie, beraten globale Teams und stellen sicher, dass alle technischen Entwürfe und Lieferungen mit langfristigen organisatorischen Zielen und regulatorischen Standards übereinstimmen. Beschreibung des Gebiets Aufgabenbereich
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Agiert als multidisziplinärer, technologieunabhängiger Lösungsarchitekt und entwirft, baut, testet und implementiert integrierte und belastbare Lösungen für den gesamten Technologiebereich der Infrastruktur. Zeigt einen breiten Überblick darüber, wie verschiedene Lösungen zusammenarbeiten und sich an geschäftliche Anforderungen anpassen, wobei die Verantwortung für die endgültige Entscheidungsfindung in der technischen Gestaltung und Lieferung mit erheblichem unabhängigem Urteilsvermögen übernommen wird.
• Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Nutzt herausragende Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, um innovative technologische Ideen zu entwickeln und sie in Endprodukte zu leiten. Verfolgt die Fortschritte der Industrie, um vielversprechende Technologien über Proofs of Concept (PoCs) in allen Technologiebereichen zu bewerten. Leitet das End-to-End-Design von Infrastrukturlösungen, unterhält die zugehörigen Komponentenstandards und bietet interne Eskalationsunterstützung, um große Vorfälle proaktiv zu lösen. Stakeholder-Management: Kommuniziert komplexe Informationen und potenzielle Lösungen im gesamten Unternehmen, einschließlich der obersten Ebenen des Unternehmens, in nicht-technischen Begriffen. Führt als Berater für leitende Manager zu Technologiestrategien, -richtlinien und -zielen und verwaltet gleichzeitig die Beziehungen zu Stakeholdern aus der Branche. Beeinflusst Technologieanbieter und arbeitet intensiv mit IT-Partnern wie Enterprise Architects und Solution Ownern zusammen, um Feedback zu integrieren. Impact/Strategie: Trifft strategische Entscheidungen, die die Abteilungsziele erheblich beeinflussen und führt zu großen Teilen zu Projektteams auf Unternehmensebene, um eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung sicherzustellen. Stellt sicher, dass alle Lösungen den Qualitäts- / Regulierungsstandards entsprechen und dem Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) der Organisation entsprechen. Spielt eine zentrale Rolle bei der Projektplanung, indem es technische Ressourcen, Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und Zeitpläne abschätzt. Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Fördert den Erfolg über mehrere Produktlinien innerhalb einer Domäne hinweg, indem es effektiv mit verschiedenen, virtuellen Teams von verschiedenen Standorten und kulturellen Hintergründen zusammenarbeitet. Führt geo-verteilte Teams durch Einfluss und Mentoring und bietet spezialisierte Anleitung zur Optimierung von Leistung und Innovation.
• Business / Technische Fähigkeiten: Wendet fortgeschrittene technische Prinzipien, Theorien und Konzepte an und handelt als anerkannter Experte mit nachgewiesener Tiefe und Breite in vielen Bereichen. Demonstriert fundierte Kenntnisse über mehrere Roche-Geschäftsbereiche jenseits der IT-Infrastruktur und versteht genau, wie sich die Infrastruktur auf Geschäftsprozesse auswirkt. Qualifikationen Bildung / Erfahrung
• Demonstrierte praktische Erfahrung bei der Architektur und Implementierung von Azure-Cloud-Netzwerklösungen, fundierte Kenntnisse über fortschrittliche Azure-Netzwerkarchitekturen und Interkonnektivitätsoptionen
• Allgemeine Network Engineering Erfahrung
• Infrastruktur als Code-Software: Terraform, Ansible, Pyt
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Description du poste L'ingénieur du réseau d'infrastructure informatique d'Azure Cloud est un expert hautement qualifié en technologie-agnostique chargé de résoudre des problèmes d'affaires inhabituellement complexes avec des solutions innovantes dans tout l'espace technologique d'infrastructure. Dans ce rôle, vous tirerez parti de votre connaissance approfondie de l'impact de l'infrastructure informatique sur les activités de Roche pour prendre des décisions techniques critiques avec une indépendance considérable. En tant que leader, vous influencerez de façon proactive la stratégie technologique, mentorerez les équipes mondiales et veillerez à ce que toutes les conceptions et livraisons techniques soient conformes aux objectifs organisationnels à long terme et aux normes réglementaires. Description de la zone Responsabilités professionnelles
• Portée / (Le leadership du contenu) : agit en tant qu'architecte de solutions multidisciplinaires, technologiques et agnostiques, concevant, construisant, testant et mettant en œuvre des solutions intégrées et résilientes dans tout l'espace technologique de l'infrastructure. Démontre une vision large de la façon dont les différentes solutions fonctionnent ensemble et s'adaptent aux exigences des entreprises, en prenant en charge la prise de décision finale dans la conception et l'exécution techniques avec un jugement indépendant considérable.
• Responsabilisation/Résoudre les problèmes : Utilise des compétences exceptionnelles en résolution de problèmes pour développer des idées technologiques innovantes et les orienter vers des produits finaux. Suivre de près les progrès de l'industrie pour évaluer les technologies prometteuses par l'intermédiaire de Proofs of Concept (PoC) dans tous les domaines technologiques. Diriger la conception de bout en bout des solutions d'infrastructure, maintenir les normes connexes des composantes, et fournir un soutien interne à l'escalade pour résoudre les incidents majeurs de façon proactive.
• Gestion des parties prenantes: Communique des informations complexes et des solutions potentielles dans l'ensemble de l'organisation, y compris aux niveaux les plus élevés de l'entreprise, en termes non techniques. Diriger, à titre de consultant, les cadres supérieurs sur la stratégie, les politiques et les objectifs technologiques, tout en gérant les relations avec les intervenants du secteur privé. Influe les fournisseurs de technologie et collabore étroitement avec les partenaires informatiques, tels que les architectes d'entreprise et les propriétaires de solutions, pour intégrer les commentaires.
• Impact/Stratégie: prend des décisions stratégiques qui ont une incidence importante sur les objectifs du Ministère et mène de vastes équipes de projet à l'échelle de l'entreprise pour assurer une mise en oeuvre réussie. S'assure que toutes les solutions sont conformes aux normes de qualité et de réglementation et respectent le cadre d'architecture technique (CTA) de l'organisation. Joue un rôle central dans la planification des projets en estimant les ressources, les dépendances, les risques et les échéanciers d'ingénierie.
• Complexité / (Taille du produit): Conduit le succès à travers plusieurs lignes de produits dans un domaine en collaborant efficacement avec des équipes virtuelles diverses de différents endroits et milieux culturels. Dirige les équipes géo-distribuées par l'influence et le mentorat, fournissant des conseils spécialisés pour optimiser la performance et l'innovation.
• Capacités d'affaires / techniques: Applique des principes techniques, des théories et des concepts avancés, agissant en tant qu'expert reconnu avec la profondeur et l'étendue prouvées dans de nombreux domaines. Démontrer une connaissance approfondie de multiples secteurs d'activité de Roche au-delà de l'infrastructure de TI, comprendre exactement comment l'infrastructure influe sur les processus opérationnels. Compétences Éducation / Expérience
• L'architecture et la mise en œuvre de solutions de réseau en nuage Azure, en profondeur, des architectures avancées de réseau Azure et des options d'interconnexion
• Expérience générale en ingénierie de réseau
• Infrastructure comme logiciel de code: Terraform, Ansible, Pyt

Description de la zone Responsabilités professionnelles
• Champ d'application / (Le leadership du contenu) : établit l'orientation technique de tout le cycle de vie des plates-formes et des services, depuis la création et la conception jusqu'au déploiement, à l'exploitation et à la retraite. Applique les principes d'ingénierie logicielle pour construire et gérer des produits et services d'infrastructure informatique à grande échelle, en éliminant la complexité de l'infrastructure pour fournir des outils en libre-service et des API aux développeurs. Concevoir des pipelines complexes d'IC/CD, concevoir et développer des caractéristiques d'autoguérison et diriger des plans de conception et d'exécution de la reprise après sinistre.

Dirige le maintien des services en direct en concevant des mesures pour mesurer la disponibilité, la latence et la santé du système, et il est chargé de déterminer les mesures critiques utilisées pour établir les ELS, les ALS et les ALS. Planifier proactivement la capacité, la performance et l'évolutivité de l'infrastructure de TI, et diriger de grandes initiatives visant à optimiser les plateformes interreliées. Responsable de la disponibilité, de l'accord, de l'efficacité, de la gestion du changement et de la configuration et de l'intervention d'urgence.
• Gestion des parties prenantes : Démontre l'orientation exceptionnelle de la clientèle et de la prestation en dirigeant de manière proactive le partenariat et la collaboration avec les développeurs, les fournisseurs de services gérés et les fournisseurs pour améliorer continuellement la vitesse de développement des applications et optimiser la fiabilité des services. Gérer les processus de la STIM, relever les défis à l'échelle durable des systèmes et appliquer l'innovation pour favoriser la stratégie opérationnelle.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

The Data Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex, multiple solution, or product context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance. Applies frameworks in a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for the product. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded and published for multiple solutions or the product. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including vendor assessments.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates difficult concepts clearly and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view. Drives information sharing across the complete product.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas. Proactively contributes to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context.

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes.

• Proven track record of proactively contributing to architecture practices development and mentoring others.

Technical Skills

• In-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas

• Strong understanding of modern data engineering architectures and patterns, including cloud-based data platforms, batch and streaming data pipelines, and analytics layers

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomie

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Digital Solution Lead at this level, you lead the strategy, operating model, and delivery governance for Clinical Data Standards, Master Data, and the supporting technology ecosystem, including Roche's in-house standards and reference data platforms (Global Clinical Data Standards Repository (GDSR) and Lynx). You partner with PD Data Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Study Teams, Roche Data Technologies, and Enterprise Informatics to ensure clinical data is defined once, governed consistently, delivered reliably, and reused at scale. This role requires deep expertise in CDISC and semantic modelling, combined with strong delivery leadership, to shape interoperable, metadata-driven foundations and ensure the associated platforms are run with the right quality, compliance, and service levels.

Description of the area

Within PD Data Sciences, this area is responsible for defining, governing, and operationalizing the standards and master data that underpin Roche's clinical data landscape. The team ensures consistent use of clinical data standards, controlled terminology, metadata, and master/reference data across protocol design, data collection, transformation, analysis, submission, and downstream reuse. It also drives the roadmap and business-facing direction for the in-house technologies that manage these assets (GDSR and Lynx), enabling study teams and downstream analytical environments to consume trusted standards and master data through governed, reusable services.
A key focus of the area is advancing semantic interoperability across the clinical ecosystem. This includes developing semantically rich information models, metadata structures, and linked data concepts that improve traceability, reuse, and machine readability across clinical workflows. By combining strong governance with fit-for-purpose technology and disciplined delivery management, the team creates AI-ready foundations that allow analytics and agentic solutions to reason over high-quality, well-defined clinical data assets safely and consistently, while sustaining operational reliability, release quality, and business continuity for downstream consumers.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Leads the domain vision for Clinical Data Standards, Master Data, and supporting technologies, shaping cross-functional strategy, governance, priorities, and delivery models. Acts as a subject matter expert in CDISC, master/reference data management, and semantic modelling, while setting clear expectations for platform health, release quality, and vendor or partner accountability.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads resolution of complex issues spanning data standards adoption, metadata definition, master data stewardship, technology integration, and downstream consumption. Establishes transparent tracking for roadmap delivery, defects, incidents, and service health; anticipates gaps in process, governance, and architecture; conducts root cause analysis across organizational boundaries; and drives sustainable solutions that improve data quality, lineage, platform reliability, and operational efficiency.

• Stakeholder Management: Builds trusted partnerships across PD Data Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Study Teams, Regulatory, Roche Data Technologies, Enterprise Data, Architecture, Informatics, and external delivery partners. Translates between scientific, operational, and technical stakeholders, acts as a trusted liaison between business owners

A key focus of the area is advancing semantic interoperability across the clinical ecosystem. This includes developing semantically rich information models, metadata structures, and linked data concepts that improve traceability, reuse, and machine readability across clinical workflows. By combining strong governance with fit-for-purpose technology and disciplined delivery management, the team creates AI-ready foundations that allow analytics and agentic solutions to reason over high-quality, well-defined clinical data assets safely and consistently, while sustaining operational reliability, release quality, and business continuity for downstream consumers. Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Leads the domain vision for Clinical Data Standards, Master Data, and supporting technologies, shaping cross-functional strategy, governance, priorities, and delivery models. Acts as a subject matter expert in CDISC, master/reference data management, and semantic modelling, while setting clear expectations for platform health, release quality, and vendor or partner accountability.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads resolution of complex issues spanning data standards adoption, metadata definition, master data stewardship, technology integration, and downstream consumption. Establishes transparent tracking for roadmap delivery, defects, incidents, and service health; anticipates gaps in process, governance, and architecture; conducts root cause analysis across organizational boundaries; and drives sustainable solutions that improve data quality, lineage, platform reliability, and operational efficiency.
• Stakeholder Management: Builds trusted partnerships across PD Data Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Study Teams, Regulatory, Roche Data Technologies, Enterprise Data, Architecture, Informatics, and external delivery partners. Translates between scientific, operational, and technical stakeholders, acts as a trusted liaison between business owners

• Fornire leadership strategica sulla modellazione delle informazioni ai team operativi e di progetto, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi informatici globali.
• Identificare e organizzare requisiti di informazioni e oggetti complessi per MRHub per garantire tracciabilità senza soluzione di continuità e facile accesso.
• Supportare la correzione dei flussi di dati non ottimali all'interno dei processi aziendali per migliorare l'efficienza e le prestazioni complessive del sistema.
• Garantire l'accuratezza dell'architettura mantenendo flussi automatizzati aggiornati in Archimedes e creando progetti concettuali che si adattino alle strategie IT/aziendali.
• Collaborare con team Agile e Solution Architect per documentare gli standard di governance, conformità e dati master all'interno dell'architettura della soluzione. Chi sei:

• Profonda competenza tecnica nei linguaggi di programmazione come Python e R, unita alla capacità di progettare e mantenere flussi di lavoro complessi di controllo delle versioni utilizzando Git.

• Stellen Sie architektonische Genauigkeit sicher, indem Sie aktuelle automatisierte Abläufe in Archimedes beibehalten und konzeptionelle Designs erstellen, die zu IT-/Geschäftsstrategien passen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit agilen Teams und Lösungsarchitekten zusammen, um Governance, Compliance und Stammdatenstandards innerhalb der Lösungsarchitektur zu dokumentieren. Wer Sie sind:
• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Datenwissenschafts- und Informationsarchitekturprojekte von Anfang bis Ende mit dem Streben nach erheblichen geschäftlichen Auswirkungen. Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung, um strategische Geschäftsentscheidungen und Datenrahmen auf hoher Ebene zu informieren und zu beeinflussen.
• Nachgewiesene Fachkenntnisse in der Gestaltung und Implementierung unternehmensweiter Data-Science-Frameworks, Informationslebenszyklen und Best Practices für die Governance.
• Tiefe technische Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie Python und R, gepaart mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Versionskontroll-Workflows mit Git zu entwerfen und zu verwalten.
• Umfassende Expertise im Cloud-nativen Datenbankmanagement

Chez Roche, nous proposons un modèle de travail hybride qui allie flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Le rôle d'un architecte de l'information est de comprendre les processus métier et les objets d'information et de travailler avec les membres de l'équipe informatique et commerciale pour identifier et concevoir des flux d'informations et des normes d'information qui répondent aux besoins de l'entreprise. The Position
We are currently seeking a Clinical Scientist to join our global team based in Basel in the Early Development department in the Neuroscience and Rare Disease DTA. This role will primarily support our latest development priorities.

We are a dedicated, collaborative team focused on meaningful lifecycle innovations that directly impact the neuroscience community. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to established science while addressing unmet needs in the Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s, multiple sclerosis, and rare disease community.

The Opportunity

• Provide support in developing and/or preparing clinical science information for inclusion into the Clinical Development Plan.

• Guided by the Lead/senior Clinical Scientist, contribute to protocol/ICF (writing or amendment), construct appropriate CRFs and coordinate cross-functionally.

• Guided by the Lead/senior Clinical Scientist, contribute to internal/external clinical presentations and communications (e.g. investigator meetings, study site interactions, patient information, study newsletters). • Work with Lead/senior Clinical Scientists/Medical Directors/Clinical Directors and cross-functional groups to execute the Medical Data Review Plan, data interpretation and contribute to study reporting.

• Work as medical monitor of phase 1 and phase 2 clinical trials in Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s disease

• Work on advanced imaging technique to measure neurodegeneration (e.g. neuromelanin-MRI) in Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s disease

• With guidance, contribute to Clinical Trial Application (CTA)/Ethics Committee (EC) written interactions, briefing packs, written responses to Health Authority (HA) questions, clinical science data/preparations for HA interactions and clinical data input to regulatory submissions.

Who you are

• Degree in Medicine required (e.g. MD, MBBS). An advanced clinical/Science Degree is highly preferred (e.g. PhD, PharmD, MSN, MPH, etc.).

• 1 to 3 years of clinical development experience. While prior experience is a plus, we are primarily looking for someone with high potential, strong motivation, and a willingness to learn

• Familiarity with governing laws, regulations, guidelines on global clinical trial execution is required and some knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonization of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA and other relevant guidelines and regulation.

• Good understanding of the multidisciplinary functions involved in drug development. Some therapeutic area relevant clinical trial experience or clear potential to assimilate with some support.

jobs.description:

The Position

Como Pasante de Corporate Affairs & Communications en Roche Chile, tienes la oportunidad única de adquirir experiencia real dentro de una industria altamente regulada. Al integrarte a nuestra área, serás un actor clave para dar vida a nuestra cultura, conectando nuestro propósito y valores institucionales con los medios de comunicación, líderes de la salud y nuestra propia comunidad interna.

La Oportunidad:

• Apoyas en tácticas de relaciones públicas mediante el monitoreo diario de prensa, la actualización de bases de datos de periodistas y la redacción de comunicados para hitos corporativos.

• Colaboras en planes de posicionamiento para promover a líderes internos de Roche como referentes técnicos del debate de salud pública.

• Ejecutas estrategias de comunicación interna usando narrativas transmedia para traducir información en mensajes movilizadores que fortalezcan nuestra cultura corporativa.

• Planificas y redactas contenido para los canales digitales de Roche Chile, adaptando mensajes complejos a formatos multiplataforma para interactuar de forma fluida con la comunidad digital.

• Asistes en el análisis de entorno y en la preparación de documentos de posición dirigidos a autoridades ministeriales y legislativas, apoyando nuestro rol en la modernización del sistema de salud chileno.

• Aseguras el soporte operativo controlando los flujos de trabajo de comunicación y garantizando el cumplimiento riguroso de los estándares normativos de la industria farmacéutica.

Quién eres:

• Eres estudiante activo de 3ero o 4to año de la carrera de Periodismo .

• Cuentas con alta capacidad de autogestión para dedicar al menos 4 horas diarias, las cuales puedes coordinar de manera flexible según tus compromisos universitarios.

• Posees sólidas habilidades de redacción periodística, ortografía, capacidad de entrevista y un excelente criterio editorial.

• Manejas a nivel intermedio herramientas de edición digital, multimedia y creación de imágenes.

• Tienes un nivel de inglés intermedio.

*Los beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta vacante.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Product Engineering Expert (Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz is one of the world's leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for hospitals, laboratories, and physician offices. With over 2,200 employees, Rotkreuz is one of Roche Diagnostics' main sites, making it the largest manufacturer of fully automated in vitro diagnostic systems in Switzerland with more than 2,700 passionate colleagues from over 65 nationalities. At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare, working together as one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups where success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity. We believe in the power of diversity and inclusion, striving to identify and create opportunities that enable all people to bring their unique selves to Roche, while offering extensive development and training opportunities, flexible working options, 18 weeks of maternity leave, 10 weeks of gender independent partnership leave, and multiple on-site services such as child-care facilities, medical services, restaurants, cafeterias, and various employee events.
In this highly specialized permanent, full-time role as Senior Specialist – Tech Transfer & Manufacturing Science (SBX Sequencing) within the DODINL Production Laboratory & QC line organisation led by Eric Wanko, you will be the key technical anchor for the critical technology transfer of advanced genetic sequencing workflows. As part of Roche’s global Dual-Site Strategy, we are expanding our manufacturing footprint to establish parallel production capabilities, where this transfer to Rotkreuz, Switzerland, is designed to complement and work in tandem with our existing operations in Santa Clara, USA, ensuring long-term global supply security and scaling our production capacity across both key sites. In this position, you will act as the ultimate Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical execution, optimization, and scaling of our proprietary sequencing consumable portfolios in Europe, leveraging your deep, pre-existing technical knowledge of our US-developed manufacturing lines to ensure seamless cross-site standardization as a central part of a genius team and shaping role.

The Opportunity

• Technology Transfer & Site Alignment: Drive the technical transfer of RUO (Research Use Only) and regulated genetic sequencing workflows (specifically SBX sequencing chemistry) from Roche Santa Clara (US) to the Rotkreuz site, ensuring absolute process alignment between both operating sites.

• Subject Matter Expert (SME): Serve as the primary technical authority for drafting, reviewing, and auditing site-specific operating procedures (SOPs), batch record templates, and work instructions for critical consumable components.

• Process Optimization & Scaling: Manage and execute complex experiments throughout the product lifecycle, from initial feasibility and stability testing through to official launch and routine manufacturing transfer.

• Advanced Quality Control: Oversee high-priority investigations into complex process failures or manufacturing deviations, applying advanced statistical techniques and data analysis to implement robust Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).

• Cross-Functional Training: Translate development workflows into standardized work procedures, providing deep technical guidance and training local operators on complex reagent handling, raw material formulation, automated dispensing, and data analyzation.

• End-to-End Quality Inspectio

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche Diagnostics International AG di Rotkreuz è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di soluzioni di sistema diagnostico per ospedali, laboratori e uffici medici. Con oltre 2.200 dipendenti, Rotkreuz è uno dei principali siti di Roche Diagnostics, che lo rende il più grande produttore di sistemi diagnostici in vitro completamente automatizzati in Svizzera con oltre 2.700 colleghi appassionati di oltre 65 nazionalità. A Roche, più di 100.000 persone in 100 paesi stanno spingendo indietro le frontiere della sanità, lavorando insieme come uno dei principali gruppi sanitari focalizzati sulla ricerca in cui il successo è costruito su innovazione, curiosità e diversità. Crediamo nel potere della diversità e dell'inclusione, cercando di identificare e creare opportunità che consentano a tutte le persone di portare i loro se stessi unici a Roche, offrendo ampie opportunità di sviluppo e formazione, opzioni di lavoro flessibili, 18 settimane di congedo di maternità, 10 settimane di congedo di partenariato indipendente di genere, e più servizi on-site come strutture per l'infanzia, servizi medici, ristoranti, caffetterie e vari eventi dei dipendenti. In questo ruolo permanente e a tempo pieno altamente specializzato come Senior Specialist – Tech Transfer & Manufacturing Science (SBX Sequencing) all'interno dell'organizzazione della linea DODINL Production Laboratory & QC guidata da Eric Wanko, sarete l'ancora tecnica chiave per il trasferimento di tecnologia critica dei flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento genetico avanzati. Nell’ambito della strategia globale Dual-Site di Roche, stiamo espandendo la nostra impronta produttiva per stabilire capacità di produzione parallele, dove questo trasferimento a Rotkreuz, in Svizzera, è stato progettato per integrare e lavorare in sintonia con le nostre operazioni esistenti a Santa Clara, negli Stati Uniti, garantendo la sicurezza globale a lungo termine e scalando la nostra capacità produttiva in entrambi i siti chiave. In questa posizione, si agirà come ultimo Oggetto Matter Expert (SME) per l'esecuzione tecnica, l'ottimizzazione e lo scaling dei nostri portafogli di materiali di sequenziamento proprietari in Europa, sfruttando la vostra profonda e preesistente conoscenza tecnica delle nostre linee di produzione sviluppate dagli Stati Uniti per garantire la standardizzazione trasversale senza soluzione di continuità come parte centrale di un team di genio e ruolo di modellazione. L'opportunità
• Trasferimento Tecnologico & Site Alignment: Guidare il trasferimento tecnico di RUO (solo ricerca) e i flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento genetico regolamentati (specialmente la chimica di sequenziamento SBX) da Roche Santa Clara (US) al sito Rotkreuz, garantendo l'allineamento assoluto del processo tra entrambi i siti operativi.
• Oggetto Matter Expert (SME): Serve come autorità tecnica primaria per la redazione, la revisione e l'audit delle procedure operative specifiche del sito (SOP), modelli di record batch e istruzioni di lavoro per i componenti di consumo critici.
• Ottimizzazione del processo & Scaling: Gestire ed eseguire esperimenti complessi in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla prima fattibilità e test di stabilità fino al lancio ufficiale e trasferimento di produzione di routine.
• Controllo avanzato della qualità: supervisionare le indagini ad alta priorità in caso di guasti complessi di processo o deviazioni di produzione, applicare tecniche statistiche avanzate e analisi dei dati per implementare robuste Azioni Correttive e Preventive (CAPA).
• Cross-Functional Training: Tradurre i flussi di lavoro di sviluppo in procedure di lavoro standardizzate, fornendo una profonda guida tecnica e formazione degli operatori locali sulla gestione complessa dei reagenti, la formulazione delle materie prime, l'erogazione automatica e l'analisi dei dati.
• Ispezione di qualità end-to-end

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Mit über 2.200 Mitarbeitern ist Rotkreuz einer der Hauptstandorte von Roche Diagnostics und damit der größte Hersteller vollautomatischer In-vitro-Diagnosesysteme in der Schweiz mit mehr als 2.700 leidenschaftlichen Kollegen aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Bei Roche treiben mehr als 100.000 Menschen in 100 Ländern die Grenzen des Gesundheitswesens zurück und arbeiten als eine der weltweit führenden forschungsorientierten Gesundheitsgruppen zusammen, in der Erfolg auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt basiert. Wir glauben an die Kraft von Vielfalt und Inklusion und streben danach, Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren und zu schaffen, die es allen Menschen ermöglichen, ihr einzigartiges Selbst zu Roche zu bringen, während sie umfangreiche Entwicklungs- und Schulungsmöglichkeiten, flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten, 18 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub, 10 Wochen geschlechtsunabhängigen Partnerschaftsurlaub und mehrere Vor-Ort-Services wie Kinderbetreuungseinrichtungen, medizinische Dienste, Restaurants, Cafeterias und verschiedene Mitarbeiterveranstaltungen anbieten. In dieser hochspezialisierten festen Vollzeitrolle als Senior Specialist - Tech Transfer & Manufacturing Science (SBX Sequencing) innerhalb der von Eric Wanko geleiteten DODINL Production Laboratory & QC Line Organisation werden Sie der wichtigste technische Anker für den kritischen Technologietransfer von fortschrittlichen genetischen Sequenzierungs-Workflows sein. Im Rahmen der globalen Dual-Site-Strategie von Roche erweitern wir unsere Produktionspräsenz, um parallele Produktionskapazitäten zu etablieren, wobei diese Übertragung nach Rotkreuz, Schweiz, darauf ausgelegt ist, unsere bestehenden Betriebe in Santa Clara, USA, zu ergänzen und mit ihnen zusammenzuarbeiten, um eine langfristige globale Versorgungssicherheit zu gewährleisten und unsere Produktionskapazitäten an beiden wichtigen Standorten zu skalieren. In dieser Position werden Sie als der ultimative Subject Matter Expert (SME) für die technische Ausführung, Optimierung und Skalierung unserer proprietären Sequencing-Verbrauchsmaterial-Portfolios in Europa fungieren und Ihr tiefes, bereits vorhandenes technisches Wissen über unsere in den USA entwickelten Fertigungslinien nutzen, um eine nahtlose standortübergreifende Standardisierung als zentraler Bestandteil eines genialen Teams und einer prägenden Rolle zu gewährleisten. Die Chance
• Technologietransfer & Site Alignment: Den technischen Transfer von RUO (Research Use Only) und regulierten genetischen Sequenzierungsworkflows (speziell SBX-Sequenzierungschemie) von Roche Santa Clara (USA) zum Rotkreuz-Standort vorantreiben, um eine absolute Prozessausrichtung zwischen beiden Betriebsstandorten zu gewährleisten.
• Subject Matter Expert (SME): Dienen Sie als primäre technische Autorität für die Erstellung, Überprüfung und Überprüfung von standortspezifischen Betriebsverfahren (SOPs), Batch-Datensatzvorlagen und Arbeitsanweisungen für kritische Verbrauchskomponenten.
• Prozessoptimierung & Skalierung: Verwalten und Ausführen komplexer Experimente während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus, von anfänglichen Machbarkeits- und Stabilitätstests bis hin zur offiziellen Einführung und routinemäßigen Fertigungsübertragung. Erweiterte Qualitätskontrolle: Überwachung von Untersuchungen mit hoher Priorität zu komplexen Prozessfehlern oder Fertigungsabweichungen unter Anwendung fortschrittlicher statistischer Techniken und Datenanalysen zur Implementierung robuster Korrektur- und Präventivmaßnahmen (CAPA).
• Cross-Functional Training: Übersetzen Sie Entwicklungsworkflows in standardisierte Arbeitsabläufe, bieten Sie fundierte technische Anleitung und schulen Sie lokale Betreiber in Bezug auf komplexes Reagenshandling, Rohmaterialformulierung, automatisierte Abgabe und Datenanalyse.
• End-to-End Qualitätsinspektion

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Roche Diagnostics International AG à Rotkreuz est l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux de solutions de systèmes de diagnostic pour les hôpitaux, laboratoires et cabinets de médecins. Avec plus de 2 200 employés, Rotkreuz est l'un des principaux sites de Roche Diagnostics, ce qui en fait le plus grand fabricant de systèmes de diagnostic in vitro entièrement automatisés en Suisse avec plus de 2 700 collègues passionnés de plus de 65 nationalités. À Roche, plus de 100 000 personnes dans 100 pays repoussent les frontières des soins de santé, travaillant ensemble comme l'un des principaux groupes de santé axés sur la recherche où le succès repose sur l'innovation, la curiosité et la diversité. Nous croyons au pouvoir de la diversité et de l'inclusion, nous nous efforçons d'identifier et de créer des possibilités qui permettent à tous de s'amener à Roche, tout en offrant des possibilités de perfectionnement et de formation étendues, des possibilités de travail flexibles, 18 semaines de congé de maternité, 10 semaines de congé de partenariat indépendant pour les femmes et de nombreux services sur place tels que les garderies, les services médicaux, les restaurants, les cafétérias et divers événements destinés aux employés. Dans ce rôle permanent hautement spécialisé et à temps plein en tant que spécialiste principal – Tech Transfer & Manufacturing Science (SBX Sequencing) au sein de l'organisation de la ligne DODINL Production Laboratory & QC dirigée par Eric Wanko, vous serez l'ancre technique clé pour le transfert de technologie critique des workflows de séquençage génétique avancés. Dans le cadre de la stratégie mondiale du double site de Roches, nous développons notre empreinte manufacturière pour établir des capacités de production parallèles, où ce transfert à Rotkreuz, en Suisse, est conçu pour compléter et travailler en parallèle avec nos activités existantes à Santa Clara, aux États-Unis, assurant la sécurité d'approvisionnement mondiale à long terme et augmentant notre capacité de production sur les deux sites clés. Dans cette position, vous agirez comme l'expert en matière (SME) ultime pour l'exécution technique, l'optimisation et la mise à l'échelle de nos portefeuilles consommables de séquençage propriétaires en Europe, en tirant parti de vos connaissances techniques profondes et préexistantes de nos lignes de fabrication développées aux États-Unis pour assurer une standardisation trans-site transparente comme partie centrale d'une équipe de génie et un rôle de façonnage. L'opportunité
• Transfert de technologie & Alignement du site: Diriger le transfert technique de RUO (Research Use Only) et les processus de séquençage génétique réglementés (séquençage SBX en particulier) de Roche Santa Clara (US) vers le site Rotkreuz, assurant l'alignement absolu des processus entre les deux sites opérationnels.
• Expert en la matière (SME): servir d'autorité technique principale pour la rédaction, l'examen et l'audit des procédures d'exploitation propres au site, des modèles d'enregistrement par lots et des instructions de travail pour les composants consommables critiques.
• Optimisation et calibrage des processus : gérer et exécuter des expériences complexes tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, depuis les essais initiaux de faisabilité et de stabilité jusqu'au lancement officiel et au transfert de fabrication de routine.
• Contrôle avancé de la qualité: Surveiller les enquêtes hautement prioritaires sur les défaillances complexes des procédés ou les écarts de fabrication, en appliquant des techniques statistiques avancées et des analyses de données pour mettre en œuvre des actions correctives et préventives robustes (CAPA).
• Formation interfonctionnelle : Traduire les flux de travail de développement en procédures de travail normalisées, fournir une orientation technique approfondie et former les opérateurs locaux à la manipulation complexe des réactifs, à la formulation des matières premières, à la distribution automatisée et à l'analyse des données.
• Inspectio de qualité de bout en bout

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As a Cluster Section Lead in the Global Finance Support organization, you will be responsible for establishing and leading day-to-day Finance Technical support, working with the respective Global Cluster Lead. The role has a strong focus on people management, compliance and operational excellence. In this position you will drive operational excellence to achieve the objectives of the Global Product Line, leading a team of Finance Business and System Analysts.
As a people manager you will inspire and help to shape the future of our organization.
You will actively coach and foster the development of the team members, help remove siloes and support your team to evolve with the organic development of the business.
You will lead the collaboration across clusters, as well as, across Global Product Lines, and Global teams.

• Strategic Talent Management: Lead the full employee lifecycle by managing recruitment with P&C, overseeing onboarding/integration, and ensuring comprehensive training through various learning channels.

• Performance & Development: Motivate and develop team members by setting clear goals, documenting performance, and providing proactive coaching and feedback.

• Operational Excellence: Drive service quality in Finance Business Support by meeting KPI targets, ensuring high end-user satisfaction, and maintaining a deep understanding of end-to-end finance processes.

• Collaboration & Communication: Foster a culture of teamwork and transparency by proactively sharing information, project roadmaps, and business knowledge across global and functional boundaries.

• Continuous Improvement: Partner with enabling functions to implement best practices and identify system/process enhancements that drive automation, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

• Stakeholder & Risk Management: Manage key business relationships and collaborate with leadership to set performance targets, manage team workloads, and mitigate operational risks.

• Values-Driven Leadership: Serve as a role model by embodying Roche values and Leadership Commitments while promoting Agile, LEAN, and ITIL methodologies.

Who you are

• Strategic Leadership & Change Management: Proven ability to lead projects in complex matrix organizations, drive organizational change, and mentor/coach team members to success.

• Operational Excellence & Metrics: Extensive experience in customer support (preferably Finance) with a focus on meeting department KPIs, managing escalations, and utilizing reporting tools for data-driven decisions.

• Stakeholder & Account Management: Expert in demand and relationship management, possessing exceptional negotiation, facilitation, and communication skills to navigate a dynamic international environment.

• Agile & Structured Methodologies: Proficient in implementing support processes through modern ways of working, such as Agile, ITIL, and LEAN, while maintaining a strong sense of urgency.

• Results-Oriented Professionalism: Highly accountable and resourceful problem-solver with a university degree and the ability to manage multiple priorities with composure and integrity.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private

The Opportunity

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care
Roche Diagnostics Nederland

We zijn op zoek naar een ervaren Medical Affairs professional om ons team te versterken in de functie van Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care. In deze functie maak je deel uit van het Medical & Access Chapter en werk je samen met collega's aan de uitdagingen en ontwikkelingen in de gezondheidszorg. In een multidisciplinair team en op een agile werkwijze, draag je bij aan de toegankelijkheid van de diagnostische en digitale innovaties voor de patiënt om het zorgpad en daarmee de patiëntuitkomsten te verbeteren.

Als Medical Value Partner ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de medische strategie van Cardiologie en Critical Care. Hiervoor werk je samen met diverse stakeholders, waaronder Key Opinion Leaders binnen cardiologie, interne geneeskunde en anesthesiologie, patiëntenverenigingen, beroepsverenigingen en zorgverzekeraars.
We zoeken iemand met een sterk strategisch en analytisch denkvermogen, creativiteit en een proactieve houding. Je hebt ervaring met evidence generation, het vertalen van bewijslast naar de dagelijkse praktijk, de toepassing van waardegedreven zorg, medische of waardegedreven projecten en het ontwikkelen van gerichte medische educatie. Daarnaast is ervaring met werken in multidisciplinaire teams, stakeholder engagement en kennis van de farmaceutische industrie en/of gezondheidszorg gewenst.

Als persoon ben je een teamspeler, flexibel, resultaatgericht en in staat om prioriteiten te stellen. Je hebt een open mindset en kunt in een dynamische en agile omgeving werken. Daarnaast ben je communicatief sterk en kun je helder en effectief communiceren in zowel Nederlands als Engels.

Je verantwoordelijkheden:

• Het identificeren en creëren van kansen om de patiëntenzorg te verbeteren

• Het bouwen en onderhouden van relevante stakeholder netwerken

• Het genereren van klinische bewijslast in samenwerking met artsen en onderzoekers

• Het organiseren van medische educatie

• Als subject matter expert ben je een (sparring) partner voor interne en externe stakeholders

Je vaardigheden:

• Kennis op het gebied van cardiologie en/of critical care

• Uitstekende communicatie vaardigheden en in staat mensen te verbinden en mobiliseren

• Ervaring met klinische studies, medische educatie en stakeholder engagement

• Relevante medisch wetenschappelijke opleiding (Msc, MD, PharmD, PhD)

• Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in de farmaceutische en/of medical device industrie

Waarom Roche?
Al meer dan 125 jaar werkt Roche aan een gezondere toekomst met één duidelijk doel: “Doing now what patients need next”. Wij geloven dat we de grootste medische uitdagingen alleen kunnen oplossen door intensieve samenwerking met zorgprofessionals en patiënten.
Onze impact gaat echter verder dan de zorg; we nemen ook de volle verantwoordelijkheid voor onze planeet. Zo draaien al onze locaties sinds 2025 op 100% duurzame elektriciteit, een belangrijke mijlpaal in onze ambitie om in 2045 volledig klimaatneutraal (net zero) te zijn. Bij Roche werk je dus niet alleen aan de zorg van morgen, maar ook aan een gezonde, duurzame wereld.

Dit krijg je bij ons:

• Een inspirerende werkomgeving waar plezier en maatschappelijke impact samenkomen.

• Een organisatie waar jouw expertise wordt gewaardeerd en waar je autonoom beslissingen kan nemen binnen je team.

• Werken met een portfolio van innovatieve producten die de cardiologische zorg fundamenteel transformeren.

• Volop ka

jobs.title: Senior Data Product Owner

titleByLocale.fr: Propriétaire principal de produits de données

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a passionate and experienced Data Product Owner ready to drive business value through innovative data solutions? Join Roche's PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) organization as a Senior Data Product Owner!

At Roche, our 10-year Pharma vision is centered on delivering new data analytics solutions to scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT). PTE is catalyzing PT's digital transformation, activating data citizenship, and building a FAIR data ecosystem. In this role, you will be pivotal in building, maintaining, and sustaining data products that drive operational excellence and enable impactful decision-making for our patients' benefit.

In this role, you will:

• Define & Communicate Product Vision: Lead the vision and roadmap for data products, aligning with organizational goals and stakeholder needs.

• Lead Data Product Development: Manage the full lifecycle of data products, from ideation to deployment, leveraging Roche’s IT/OT ecosystems for stable, automated solutions.

• Drive Value Delivery & Prioritization: Develop prioritized product backlogs, guiding teams to deliver scalable, reusable data products that achieve measurable business outcomes.

• Ensure Governance & Compliance: Guarantee data products adhere to Roche’s data quality standards, governance policies, and regulatory requirements (e.g., data privacy, GxP).

• Champion Collaboration & Mentorship: Act as a key liaison between business and technical teams, fostering harmonization and mentoring other Data Product Owners.
Who You Are:

• 7+ years of agile experience designing and delivering complex data solutions, including 4+ years as a Product Owner or Data Analyst, preferably in the pharma or healthcare industry.

• Proven track record of data management on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake)

• Strong understanding of data architectures, data modeling, data integration (e.g., data mesh, data warehousing), and SDLC/CSV.

• Excellent ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications and lead teams in an agile setting.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
ERP Solution Consultant - SAP Intercompany

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The ERP Solution Consultant leads independently complex ERP solution delivery, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to architecture. In this role, you will guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product or product line level. By bringing advanced ERP knowledge, in-depth expertise in key areas, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and team development.

Job Responsibilities

• Backlog Management: Defining, ordering, and refining Product Backlog items to align with business goals.

• Product Strategy: Evaluate existing SD processes to identify optimization opportunities, particularly in the areas of automated order processing and real-time analytics.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborating with Supply Chain stakeholders to gather feedback, manage expectations, and communicate product updates.

• Development Collaboration: Working with Scrum teams to define, build, and validate product features during sprints.

• Solution Design & Configuration: Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of new features within S/4HANA .

• Hands-on Core Customizing : Perform independent, hands-on SAP standard configuration and customization within the S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) and Material management (MM) module.

• WRICEF Specification & Design : Translate complex business requirements into detailed functional specifications for custom developments, actively designing and delivering WRICEF items (Workflow, Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms) from ideation to hypercare.

• Logistics Integration: Act as the functional lead for SD integration touchpoints with Decentralized EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) and Embedded TM (Transportation Management) to ensure seamless flow from Sales Order to TM Integration

Technical & Professional Qualifications

• S/4HANA SD: Minimum of 3 of experience in SAP SD, ideally with full-cycle S/4HANA implementations.

• Familiarity with Solution Manager (SolMan) or SAP Cloud ALM for documentation and transport management.

• Technical Literacy: Proficiency in monitoring and troubleshooting IDocs/ALE.

Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

• Life Sciences / Pharma Experience: Familiarity with pharmaceutical business models

• Analytical Mindset: Ability to translate comp

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per chi sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. È così che ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Entra a far parte di Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ERP Solution Consultant - SAP Intercompany Roche Digital Technology (STD) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a modellare domani.s futuro digitale della sanità. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale di intelligenza artificiale, dati, e innovazioni tecnologiche di scalable.Svolto da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutta Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano e guidare scoperte che veramente contano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità e collaborazione personale. Per ora, chiediamo ai nostri dipendenti di essere nei nostri uffici in media due giorni a settimana. I giorni di ufficio specifici possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, municipi, riunioni di gruppo, e altri eventi collaborativi. L'ERP Solution Consultant conduce in modo indipendente la fornitura di soluzioni ERP, risolve proattivamente i problemi dei prodotti e contribuisce all'architettura. In questo ruolo, guiderai i team di prodotti, la responsabilità dei campioni e comunicherai efficacemente con le parti interessate. Risolverai problemi complessi, prenderai decisioni indipendenti a livello di prodotto, fornirai una supervisione tecnica e riferirai a livello di prodotto o linea di prodotto. Portando a conoscenza ERP avanzate, competenze approfondite in settori chiave e forti competenze analitiche, contribuirai attivamente al miglioramento continuo e allo sviluppo di team. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Gestione Backlog: Definizione, ordinazione e raffinazione di articoli Backlog prodotto per allinearsi agli obiettivi aziendali.
• Strategia del prodotto: Evaluare i processi SD esistenti per individuare opportunità di ottimizzazione, in particolare nei settori dell'elaborazione automatizzata degli ordini e dell'analisi in tempo reale.
• Gestione delle parti interessate: il trattamento con gli stakeholder di Supply Chain per raccogliere feedback, gestire le aspettative e comunicare gli aggiornamenti dei prodotti.
• Sviluppo: il lavoro con i team Scrum per definire, costruire e convalidare le funzionalità del prodotto durante gli sprint.
• Solution Design & Con 209tion: Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of new features in S/4HANA.
• Personalizzazione manuale del nucleo: eseguire una configurazione e personalizzazione standard SAP, pratiche e indipendenti all'interno del modulo S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) e Material Management (MM).
• Specificazione e progettazione WRICEF: Tradurre requisiti aziendali complessi in specifiche funzionali dettagliate per sviluppi personalizzati, progettare e fornire attivamente articoli WRICEF (Workflow, Reports, Interfaces, Conversioni, Miglioramenti e Forme) dall'ideazione all'iper cura.
• Integrazione logistica: agire come il lead funzionale per i touchpoint di integrazione SD con EWM decentralizzato (Extended Warehouse Management) e Embedded TM (Transportation Management) per garantire il flusso senza soluzione di continuità dall'ordine di vendita all'integrazione TM Qualificazioni tecniche e professionali
• S/4HANA SD: minimo 3 esperienze in SAP SD, idealmente con implementazioni S/4HANA a ciclo pieno.
• Fa.
• Scienze della vita / Esperienza Farmaceutica: Fa 1 91% con modelli di business farmaceutico
• Mente analitica: Capacità di tradurre comp

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönliche Ausdrucks-, offene Dialog- und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, für wen Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat, heute und für Generationen. Kommen Sie zu Roche, wo es um jede Stimme geht. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die sich für die Gestaltung der digitalen Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung einsetzen. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien zu befähigen, das Potenzial künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbarer Tech-Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zweck und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft, in der Digital eine Kernstärke in ganz Roche ist, die intelligentere Arbeitsweisen ermöglicht, menschliches Potenzial freisetzt und Durchbrüche treibt, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wirklich wichtig sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Derzeit benötigen wir von unseren Mitarbeitern durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsbedarf variieren, wie z.B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathause, Teamtreffen und andere kollaborative Veranstaltungen. Der ERP Solution Consultant führt unabhängig komplexe ERP-Lösungen an, löst proaktiv Produktprobleme und trägt zur Architektur bei. In dieser Funktion leiten Sie Produktteams, Champions Accountability und kommunizieren effektiv mit Stakeholdern. Sie lösen komplexe Probleme, treffen unabhängige Entscheidungen auf Produktebene, sorgen für technische Aufsicht und berichten auf Produkt- oder Produktliniesebene. Durch die Bereitstellung von fortgeschrittenem ERP-Wissen, fundierter Expertise in Schlüsselbereichen und starker analytischer Fähigkeiten tragen Sie aktiv zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Teamentwicklung bei. Job Responsibilities
• Backlog Management: Definieren, bestellen und verfeinern Sie Product Backlog items, um sich an die Geschäftsziele anzupassen.
• Produktstrategie: Auswertung bestehender SD-Prozesse zur Ermittlung von Optimierungsmöglichkeiten, insbesondere in den Bereichen automatisierte Auftragsabwicklung und Echtzeitanalyse.
• Stakeholdermanagement: Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern der Supply Chain, um Feedback zu sammeln, Erwartungen zu verwalten und Produktupdates zu kommunizieren.
• Entwicklungszusammenarbeit: Zusammenarbeit mit Scrum-Teams zur Definition, Erstellung und Validierung von Produktfunktionen während Sprints.
• Lösungsdesign & Konfiguration: Führen Sie das End-to-End-Design und die Implementierung neuer Features innerhalb von S/4HANA.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung

Unser 14-köpfiges Team, bestehend aus Analytikern, Projektleitern und Gruppenleiter im Bereich der molekularbiologischen Analytik, freut sich auf tatkräftige Unterstützung von einem hilfsbereiten und flexiblen neuen Teammitglied. Du solltest Spaß an neuen Herausforderungen haben und Dich in unsere positive Arbeitsatmosphäre einfügen.

Wir möchten Dir als Praktikant (m/w/d) einen Einblick in das „ daily business “ im Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) Umfeld geben. Dabei wirst Du auch die Möglichkeit haben, Dich selbstständig mit Projektarbeiten zu befassen, um bestehende Prozesse zu optimieren.

Deine Aufgaben

• Unterstützung unserer Projektarbeiten im Bereich Design Transfer & Product Care

• Analytik von molekularbiologischen und biochemischen und Einsatzstoffen im diagnostischen Umfeld

Dein Profil

• Du bist aktuell in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium (Bachelor oder Master in Biochemie / Molekularbiologie / Lebensmittelchemie / Life Science) immatrikuliert oder Du befindest Dich in Deinem Gap-Year zwischen diesen beiden

• Kenntnisse in der molekularbiologische / biochemische Analytik (insbesondere qPCR & Nukleinsäureaufreinigung, wie auch Zellkultur )

• Du bist motiviert, neugierig und möchtest Dich und Deine Ideen einbringen

• solide Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate

• Vernetzungsmöglichkeiten für Deine weitere Karriereplanung

• Vergünstigte Preise in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Zugang zu unserem Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boarding House während des Praktikums

Für Deine Bewerbung benötigen wir ausschließlich Deinen vollständigen Lebenslauf.

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Roche’s sequencing and pathology product portfolios.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a highly autonomous, deep-dive technical investigator. You masterfully dissect complex, edge-case software failures, bridging the gap between field trouble-shooting and core R&D development teams. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity

• You are accountable for handling complex software complaints for our sequencing and pathology products, like safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as a senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause/causal factor of software malfunctions. You master the Roche internal quality processes and understand their regulatory background to justify decisions.

• You are an interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

• You serve as a trusted technical proxy for the Principal Engineer when required.

Who You Are

• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an IT related field (preferred) with knowledge of bioinformatics or genomics. Advanced degrees (Master’s or Ph.D.) are a plus but not required.

• 5+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Bioinformatics or IT support related functions

• Strong IT skills, especially the ability to read and debug complex source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues

• Good ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty.

• Good ability to present technical work to stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

Locations
This is a primarily onsite position in Tucson, Arizona.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson Arizona is $77,280 and $143,520. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Roche’s sequencing and pathology product portfolios.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a highly autonomous, deep-dive technical investigator. You masterfully dissect complex, edge-case software failures, bridging the gap between field trouble-shooting and core R&D development teams. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity

• You are accountable for handling complex software complaints for our sequencing and pathology products, like safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as a senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause/causal factor of software malfunctions. You master the Roche internal quality processes and understand their regulatory background to justify decisions.

• You are an interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

• You serve as a trusted technical proxy for the Principal Engineer when required.

Who You Are

• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an IT related field (preferred) with knowledge of bioinformatics or genomics. Advanced degrees (Master’s or Ph.D.) are a plus but not required.

• 5+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Bioinformatics or IT support related functions

• Strong IT skills, especially the ability to read and debug complex source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues

• Good ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty.

• Good ability to present technical work to stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

Locations
This is a primarily onsite position in Tucson, Arizona.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson Arizona is $77,280 and $143,520. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifi
