At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to bring structured thinking, execution, and focus to digitalization in procurement, unlocking new levels of automation and self-service for global operations? As our Digital Enablement Manager, located in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will proactively identify and drive digital opportunities that support our needs and positively impact process efficiency. Acting as a true ambassador for procurement digitization, you will provide strategic thought leadership in a dynamic global environment to ensure digital tools are seamlessly aligned with our overall business objectives.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Digital & Process Management Lead and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will manage cross-functional relationships across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Category, DOP Delivery, IT, external providers, and internal stakeholders (e.g., process managers and owners).

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on digital enablement, stakeholder advisory, and transformation governance.

• Impact: You drive global operational efficiency, process compliance, and large-scale digital adoption. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Digital Strategy & Roadmap: Developing and governing the digital enablement strategy, setting clear objectives, timelines, and Performance Indicators to monitor the impact of digital tools on procurement outcomes.

• Technology Assessment: Researching and evaluating emerging technologies (AI, Machine Learning, RPA) to enhance procurement processes. Conducting pilot programs to test feasibility and aligning initiatives across functions.

• Stakeholder Advisory & Management: Acting as a trusted advisor to business units and IT, understanding their unique priorities, and fostering an inclusive, collaborative approach to digital transformation.

• AI Pipeline: Spearheading our AI transformation by coordinating and/or building cutting-edge AI solutions in close collaboration with RSS Demand to Pay and Roche Digital Technology (RDT).

• Value Communication: Highlighting the ROI and impact of digital initiatives by developing and delivering data-driven presentations, success stories, and progress reports to senior stakeholders.

• Process Improvement: Conducting thorough analyses of current procurement activities to pinpoint inefficiencies or bottlenecks, using data to prioritize areas for digital intervention and automation.

• Implementation & Adoption: Guiding digitalization projects and solution deployments by creating clear roadmaps. Acting as a liaison with external partners to ensure accurate requirements and promoting seamless adoption by making digitalization "easy to understand for everyone" through targeted training and communication.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to bring structured thinking, execution, and focus to digitalization in procurement, unlocking new levels of automation and self-service for global operations? As our Digital Enablement Manager, located in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will proactively identify and drive digital opportunities that support our needs and positively impact process efficiency. Acting as a true ambassador for procurement digitization, you will provide strategic thought leadership in a dynamic global environment to ensure digital tools are seamlessly aligned with our overall business objectives.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Digital & Process Management Lead and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will manage cross-functional relationships across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Category, DOP Delivery, IT, external providers, and internal stakeholders (e.g., process managers and owners).

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on digital enablement, stakeholder advisory, and transformation governance.

• Impact: You drive global operational efficiency, process compliance, and large-scale digital adoption. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Digital Strategy & Roadmap: Developing and governing the digital enablement strategy, setting clear objectives, timelines, and Performance Indicators to monitor the impact of digital tools on procurement outcomes.

• Technology Assessment: Researching and evaluating emerging technologies (AI, Machine Learning, RPA) to enhance procurement processes. Conducting pilot programs to test feasibility and aligning initiatives across functions.

• Stakeholder Advisory & Management: Acting as a trusted advisor to business units and IT, understanding their unique priorities, and fostering an inclusive, collaborative approach to digital transformation.

• AI Pipeline: Spearheading our AI transformation by coordinating and/or building cutting-edge AI solutions in close collaboration with RSS Demand to Pay and Roche Digital Technology (RDT).

• Value Communication: Highlighting the ROI and impact of digital initiatives by developing and delivering data-driven presentations, success stories, and progress reports to senior stakeholders.

• Process Improvement: Conducting thorough analyses of current procurement activities to pinpoint inefficiencies or bottlenecks, using data to prioritize areas for digital intervention and automation.

• Implementation & Adoption: Guiding digitalization projects and solution deployments by creating clear roadmaps. Acting as a liaison with external partners to ensure accurate requirements and promoting seamless adoption by making digitalization "easy to understand for everyone" through targeted training and communication.

Who you are

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Von Standorten auf der ganzen Welt und mit einem vielfältigen und multikulturellen Team beziehen, verwalten wir unsere Lieferantenbasis, entwickeln und führen Kategoriestrategien aus und entwickeln und digitalisieren ständig Prozesse, die es uns ermöglichen, unser Geschäft bestmöglich zu unterstützen, um nachhaltig zu wachsen. Wenn Sie etwas bewirken möchten und Teil eines leistungsstarken und erstklassigen Beschaffungsteams sein möchten, ist dies das Richtige für Sie. Wir sind DOP. Bei Roche tun wir jetzt, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, strukturiertes Denken, Ausführung und Fokus auf die Digitalisierung in der Beschaffung zu bringen, um neue Ebenen der Automatisierung und Self-Service für globale Operationen zu erschließen? Als unser Digital Enablement Manager mit Sitz in Sant Cugat, Spanien, werden Sie proaktiv digitale Möglichkeiten identifizieren und vorantreiben, die unsere Bedürfnisse unterstützen und die Prozesseffizienz positiv beeinflussen. Als echter Botschafter für die Digitalisierung des Beschaffungswesens werden Sie in einem dynamischen globalen Umfeld eine strategische Vordenkerrolle übernehmen, um sicherzustellen, dass digitale Tools nahtlos an unseren allgemeinen Geschäftszielen ausgerichtet sind.

• Prozessverbesserung: Durchführung gründlicher Analysen der aktuellen Beschaffungsaktivitäten, um Ineffizienzen oder Engpässe zu erkennen, wobei Daten verwendet werden, um Bereiche für digitale Eingriffe und Automatisierung zu priorisieren.
• Implementierung & Adoption: Steuerung von Digitalisierungsprojekten und -lösungen durch die Erstellung klarer Roadmaps. • Stratégie numérique et feuille de route : Élaborer et régir la stratégie d'habilitation numérique, établir des objectifs clairs, des échéanciers et des indicateurs de rendement pour surveiller l'impact des outils numériques sur les résultats d'approvisionnement.

• Communication de la valeur : Mettre en valeur le RCI et l'impact des initiatives numériques en élaborant et en fournissant des présentations axées sur les données, des exemples de réussite et des rapports d'étape aux intervenants supérieurs.

• Mise en œuvre et adoption: guider les projets de numérisation et les déploiements de solutions en créant des feuilles de route claires. Agir en tant que liaison avec des partenaires externes pour assurer des exigences précises et promouvoir une adoption transparente en rendant la numérisation « facile à comprendre pour tous » grâce à une formation et une communication ciblées. Are you ready to architect the global digital process landscape and lead the strategic optimization of systems that drive our end-to-end global procurement operations? As our Business Capability Lead (BCL) located in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will take strategic and operational ownership over critical segments of the global Demand-to-Pay process landscape. In this high-impact role, you will define process governance, integrate complex interfaces across corporate ecosystems, and serve as a vital change agent to accelerate the myBuy solution adoption across the enterprise. myBuy is Roche's digital procurement platform, designed to enhance the procure-to-pay process by providing transparency, timely transactions, and automation for our buying operations.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to our Sourcing Lead and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Leads a global Business Capability Community formed by SMEs. You will manage cross-functional relationships across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Delivery, DOP Sourcing Teams, RSS Demand to Pay, Global Procurement, and external technology providers.

• Role Type: As BCL, you represent DOP`s business interests globally in relevant forums, and you are responsible for the development and continuous improvement of DOP`s procure-to-pay strategy.

• Impact: You drive global operational efficiency, process compliance, and large-scale digital adoption. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Process Design & Strategy: Developing and deploying the DOP roadmap for myBuy, in alignment with functional partners like DIA Global Supply Chain and RSS Demand to Pay.

• Automation & Innovation: Proactively identifying opportunities for process automation and digitalization in close collaboration with Delivery, Category, Digital & Process Management, and RSS Demand to Pay.

• SME Analysis & Governance: Acting as a deep subject matter expert to analyze, elaborate options, and design solutions that resolve process, system, performance indicator, or data concerns, while supporting data and rule definitions.

• Transformation Project Delegation: Serving as a responsible delegate on major corporate initiatives (such as the ASPIRE program; our overarching process and digital transformation) to support global template adoption and evaluate localized change impacts.

• Continuous Improvement: Leading continuous improvement initiatives, managing global requirement alignment, and partnering with fellow BCLs and Business Capability Owners (BCOs) to optimize end-to-end cross-functional performance.

• Community & ARTS Representation: Leading the Business Capability Community of SMEs and representing DOP in communities and Agile Release Trains (ARTs).

• Knowledge Management: Governing the development, structural maintenance, and delivery of global system process doc

• Process Design & Strategy: Sviluppo e distribuzione della roadmap DOP per myBuy, in allineamento con partner funzionali come DIA Global Supply Chain e RSS Demand to Pay.
• Automation & Innovation: individuare attivamente le opportunità per l'automazione dei processi e la digitalizzazione in stretta collaborazione con Delivery, Categoria, Digital & Process Management e RSS Demand to Pay.
• Analisi e Governance delle PMI: Agire come esperto di materia profonda per analizzare, elaborare opzioni e soluzioni di progettazione che risolvono problemi di processo, sistema, indicatori di performance o dati, supportando al contempo le definizioni dei dati e delle regole.
• Delegazione del progetto di trasformazione: servire come delegato responsabile per le principali iniziative aziendali (come il programma ASPIRE; il nostro processo di overarching e la trasformazione digitale) per sostenere l'adozione di modelli globali e valutare gli impatti di cambiamento localizzati.
• Miglioramento continuo: Conducendo iniziative di miglioramento continuo, gestendo l'allineamento dei requisiti globali e collaborando con altri BCL e Business Capability Owners (BCOs) per ottimizzare le prestazioni interfunzionali end-to-end.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the long-term supplier strategies and project pipelines that deliver medical innovation to patients worldwide? As our Associate Category Manager (ACM) in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will support the development, validation, and execution of global category strategies and annual strategic initiatives. In this role, you will leverage rigorous procurement analytics to transform market intelligence into actionable category guidance, ensuring global supply resilience and portfolio value.
We are looking to fulfill one Associate Category Manager position per team. Successful candidates will be aligned to support one of the following dedicated procurement categories: Biologicals & Chemicals, Plastics & Packaging, Electronics & Systems, Mechanicals, Logistics.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the respective Category Lead within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Collaborates closely with Category Managers, Sourcing Managers, Delivery Managers, Finance, Legal, and external market intelligence providers. Participates in a global ACM Community of Practice (CoP) coordinated by the Category Integration & Excellence Lead to ensure consistency of methodologies, reporting standards, strategic planning processes, and cross-category collaboration.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role in support of the allocated Category, focused on strategic enablement, market data intelligence, and stakeholder management.

• Impact: You drive category compliance, data integrity, and strategic execution across the global operations network. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Pipeline Support: Collation of supplier, market, and internal business data to help formulate the long-term Category Strategy and build a proactive pipeline of future initiatives.

• Strategic Initiative Deployment: Supporting Category Managers, Project Delivery, Delivery, and Sourcing Managers in executing and deploying complex projects in strict compliance with global standards and procedures.

• Negotiation & Contracting Preparation: Supporting contract drafting and vendor negotiations for strategic, key, or bottleneck suppliers by delivering comprehensive analytics, fact-bases, and market benchmarks.

• Strategic Sourcing: Support selected high-value strategic sourcing initiatives and complex RFx activities to convert pipeline targets into realized business value.

• Reporting & Analytics: Collaborating with data analytics experts to generate Category-specific insights, generating monthly spend/savings metrics, and conducting data validation to safeguard governance.

• Implementation Support: Converting strategic outcomes into clear category guidance documents and support materials to ensure category strategies can be effectively implemented across the organization.

• Negotiation & Contracting Preparation: Sostenere la redazione dei contratti e i negoziati dei fornitori per i fornitori strategici, chiave o strozzature offrendo analisi complete, basi di fatto e benchmark di mercato.
• Sourcing Strategico: Supporto selezionato iniziative strategiche ad alto valore e complesse attività RFx per convertire obiettivi pipeline in valore aziendale realizzato.
• Reporting & Analytics: Collaborare con esperti di analisi dei dati per generare informazioni specifiche sulla categoria, generare metriche mensili di spesa/risparmio e condurre la convalida dei dati per salvaguardare la governance.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Typically studying in a field related to the assigned function. May be assigned a variety of tasks relevant to the assigned function and/or special projects for the assigned function. The objective of assignments is for the intern to practically apply academic or vocational studies/learning in a Roche setting, as well as learn more about the Roche organisation, as future employment with Roche may be a possibility subject to job availability, candidate qualification and past performance. Assignments vary but are typically to support the activities of regular employees, such as entry-level research and reporting, analyses and modelling, preparing materials for others, coordinating small events or meetings, improving basic departmental operations such as filing or archiving systems, departmental libraries, etc. Length of internship will vary according to business needs and legal requirements in the market where the internship is occurring.

Academic requirement

• Good command of spoken and written English and Chinese

• Proactive at work and able to manage multiple tasks efficiently

• Strong analytical skills and great attention to details

• Able to challenge the status quo with skepticism and is passionate about process validation/ improvement

• Possess strong communication skills and a good record of extra-curricular activities.

• Good interpersonal skills, able to work in a team effectively, deliver on commitment.

Key Responsibilities

• Responsible for assessing compliance of employee reimbursement activities as well as associated healthcare compliance reviews in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• during claim processing

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Mission:
En tant que Responsable Commercial Territorial Multi-gammes (Sud Ests), rattaché(e) au Service Excellence Commercial, vous êtes la voix de nos clients et représentez Roche auprès de ces derniers pour l’ensemble de nos gammes.

Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous identifiez parfaitement les interlocuteurs clés, les processus de décision, l'environnement et les enjeux de vos clients. Vous définissez et assumez la responsabilité de la stratégie commerciale et financière des comptes territoriaux (existants ou futurs), tout en participant activement à celle des comptes nationaux.

Localisation idéale: Montpellier & alentours

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Garantir la couverture terrain et assurer le rôle d’interlocuteur privilégié : Développer des relations de confiance durables avec les structures clientes, comprendre leurs processus décisionnels, identifier leurs besoins, coordonner les actions et piloter rigoureusement les informations dans le CRM.

• Assurer la conquête, la fidélisation et le développement des comptes : Élaborer et piloter les account plans, gérer le pipeline d'opportunités de vente, négocier les contrats, construire les offres commerciales, veiller au respect des engagements et résoudre les éventuels litiges.

• Garantir la transversalité et la synergie interne : Développer les échanges et la communication entre les différents services de l'entreprise, assurer la complétude des dossiers contractuels et mettre votre expertise terrain au service de la satisfaction client globale.

• Maintenir et développer vos compétences métier : Suivre activement les formations internes, intégrer les nouveautés du marché et maîtriser les outils mis à disposition afin d'apporter un conseil à forte valeur ajoutée aux clients.

Qui vous êtes:

• Vous excellez dans les techniques de négociation commerciale et la gestion de projet. Une solide culture scientifique et la connaissance du marché de la biologie médicale sont des atouts majeurs pour réussir dans ce rôle.

• Vous établissez des relations interpersonnelles solides et possédez d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse, ainsi qu'une maîtrise de la gestion des données.

• Votre sens des affaires vous permet d'analyser et de comprendre les enjeux stratégiques et commerciaux de l'industrie du DIV (Diagnostic In Vitro) et du secteur de la santé au sens large.

• Vos compétences en conseil se manifestent par une écoute attentive, la capacité de traduire les demandes en besoins, l'alignement des parties prenantes autour d'une vision commune, le conseil expert et la contractualisation efficace.

• Vous faites preuve d'un leadership inspirant, capable d'engager et d'influencer, tout en collaborant et en coopérant de manière transversale.

• Votre niveau d'anglais courant vous permet de communiquer aisément dans un environnement international.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Recherche activement la satisfaction des clients en apportant des réponses claires, précises et rapides.

• Documente précisément dans le logiciel CRM les symptômes décrits/observés et les actions réalisées.

• Escalade, si nécessaire, les problèmes traités vers l’équipe de support de niveau n+1.

​ Contribuer au partage des informations et à l’optimisation des pratiques

• Communique avec ses collègues terrain sur la situation d’un client en cas de problème ou de demande complexe.

• Alimente régulièrement la base de connaissances.

• Met à jour de manière régulière ses connaissances par la lecture des notes internes, mails et forums.

• Identifie les actions permettant d’accroître son autonomie.

• Prend en charge des problèmes complexes en collaboration active avec ses collègues référents et ses collègues du global.

• Connaissances informatique et basique en infrastructure réseau.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are developing the next-generation of sequencing systems. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are also broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing workflows.

We are seeking a talented and highly motivated Postdoctoral Fellow with a proven track record of excellence in developing novel technology for biological applications. Joining our Systems Technology Group, you will play a major role in the Research and Early Development of new technology, devices, and instruments associated with our next-generation DNA sequencing and molecular diagnostic platforms.

At the heart of these instruments are highly integrated microfluidic systems capable of automating intricate workflows and handling complex biochemistry. To gear up for these ambitious goals, your near-term focus will involve deep, hands-on training with our foundational efforts. You will assist with current projects to master our chemistry, materials, and methods, gaining critical expertise in how we design, fabricate, bond, simulate, operate, characterize, and troubleshoot complex systems and processes.

This is a hands-on, interdisciplinary role designed to bridge the gap between biochemical applications and cutting-edge instrumentation. Collaborating closely with a small, agile team and the broader organization, you will solve challenging problems, invent new technology, and ultimately advance the state-of-the-art in DNA sequencing systems.

The Opportuniity:

• You will design, fabricate, and assemble custom devices, fixtures, and breadboards using various rapid prototyping tools, including custom equipment.

• You will develop and implement microfabrication processes, including photolithography, etching, drilling, bonding, and dicing—and utilize precision metrology instruments to characterize components and evaluate manufacturing methodologies.

• You will create and characterize new materials and bonding methodologies.

• You will test, characterize, and troubleshoot complex fluidic systems and devices. Develop and optimize workflows on these systems while collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to drive technical progress.

• You will generate comprehensive test plans, protocols, technical reports and invention disclosures to document findings and methodology.

• You will select, procure, install, validate, operate, repair, and maintain lab/fab equipment and custom instrumentation.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a Ph.D. in Bioengineering or a closely related discipline with a thesis focused on solving a molecular biology problem with clever engineering.

• You have a solid understanding of physics, engineering, chemistry, molecular biology and sequencing fundamentals.

• You have demonstrated experience with advanced microfabrication techniques (lithography, thin-film deposition, wet/dry etching, and thermal fusion bonding processes).

• You have demonstrated success porting complex biochemical assays or workflows onto novel fluidic systems and optimizing performance using a systematic approach.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are developing the next-generation of sequencing systems. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are also broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing workflows.

We are seeking a talented and highly motivated Postdoctoral Fellow with a proven track record of excellence in developing novel technology for biological applications. Joining our Systems Technology Group, you will play a major role in the Research and Early Development of new technology, devices, and instruments associated with our next-generation DNA sequencing and molecular diagnostic platforms.

At the heart of these instruments are highly integrated microfluidic systems capable of automating intricate workflows and handling complex biochemistry. To gear up for these ambitious goals, your near-term focus will involve deep, hands-on training with our foundational efforts. You will assist with current projects to master our chemistry, materials, and methods, gaining critical expertise in how we design, fabricate, bond, simulate, operate, characterize, and troubleshoot complex systems and processes.

This is a hands-on, interdisciplinary role designed to bridge the gap between biochemical applications and cutting-edge instrumentation. Collaborating closely with a small, agile team and the broader organization, you will solve challenging problems, invent new technology, and ultimately advance the state-of-the-art in DNA sequencing systems.

The Opportuniity:

• You will design, fabricate, and assemble custom devices, fixtures, and breadboards using various rapid prototyping tools, including custom equipment.

• You will develop and implement microfabrication processes, including photolithography, etching, drilling, bonding, and dicing—and utilize precision metrology instruments to characterize components and evaluate manufacturing methodologies.

• You will create and characterize new materials and bonding methodologies.

• You will test, characterize, and troubleshoot complex fluidic systems and devices. Develop and optimize workflows on these systems while collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to drive technical progress.

• You will generate comprehensive test plans, protocols, technical reports and invention disclosures to document findings and methodology.

• You will select, procure, install, validate, operate, repair, and maintain lab/fab equipment and custom instrumentation.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a Ph.D. in Bioengineering or a closely related discipline with a thesis focused on solving a molecular biology problem with clever engineering.

• You have a solid understanding of physics, engineering, chemistry, molecular biology and sequencing fundamentals.

• You have demonstrated experience with advanced microfabrication techniques (lithography, thin-film deposition, wet/dry etching, and thermal fusion bonding processes).

• You have demonstrated success porting complex biochemical assays or workflows onto novel fluidic systems and optimizing performance using a systematic approach.

• You have a solid publication record, including at least one first-authored and peer-reviewed publication in a top-tier journal.

• You have demonstrated experience with Python scripting for instru

jobs.title: Intern - China Procurement Facilities & Utilities
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:
This role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

As an Intern , you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Applying general procurement knowledge or expertise in a specific commodity or spend area, you will ensure effective and efficient delivery of core procurement services and continuous improvement of automation and content availability.

You will collaborate closely with internal procurement (i.e. Chapters and capability areas such as customer relationship management, contracting, solutions, analytics, etc.) and business stakeholders to translate business needs into sourcing and spend management activities and content enhancement.

You will work closely with other team members to support customer demand, improve the customer buying experience, deliver on day-to day operational activities, and provide capacity and expertise to deliver productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions.

You will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

• Applying your fast-learning skills to assist the team with ad-hoc business projects, continuous improvement initiatives, and new process implementations.

• Acting as a key point of contact to coordinate with external suppliers, track project progress, and help resolve day-to-day operational queries.

• Executing daily system operations, maintaining data accuracy, and ensuring smooth transactional flows within the SAP system.

Who you are:

• You are enrolled at university (preferably in business or a related discipline; preferably as a graduate)

• You demonstrate strong learning agility and a proactive willingness to quickly grasp new concepts, processes, and systems in a dynamic environment.

• You are capable of quickly getting hands-on with SAP systems, and ideally have some basic knowledge or practical exp

• Siete in grado di ottenere rapidamente hands-on con i sistemi SAP, e idealmente avere alcune conoscenze di base o pratico exp

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Das Gesundheitswesen entwickelt sich weiter, und Global Procurement reagiert darauf, indem es kontinuierlich nach höchstmöglicher Leistung strebt und innovative und strategische Ansätze für Geschäfts- und Lieferantenpartnerschaften verfolgt. Global Procurement verwaltet proaktiv das gesamte Lieferanten-Ökosystem und leistet einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Verbesserung der Gesundheitsergebnisse, zur Senkung der Kosten für Patienten und globale Gesundheitssysteme und stellt sicher, dass Roche weiterhin das tut, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Die Gelegenheit: Diese Rolle ist Teil der Gruppe Indirect Procurement Delivery, die die wichtigsten Beschaffungsaktivitäten von Category Management, strategischem und operativem Sourcing, Lieferantenmanagement, Contracting, Content Strategy Definition und Ausführung abdeckt. Die Gruppe Indirekte Beschaffung umfasst viele Gemeinschaften, die Kategorien derselben Wertschöpfungskette oder Gemeinsamkeiten gruppieren, darunter Forschung und Entwicklung, kommerzielle und Unternehmensdienstleistungen, Digital & Technology und Einrichtungen. Die Communities sind die wichtigsten Wegbereiter für eine starke Kategoriekompetenz und ermöglichen gleichzeitig Flexibilität bei der Beschaffungserbringung als Reaktion auf die sich ändernden Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden. Als Praktikant bringen Sie analytisches Denken, Planung, Ausführung und konzentrieren sich auf den Beschaffungs- und Lieferbereich. Durch die Anwendung von allgemeinem Beschaffungswissen oder Fachwissen in einem bestimmten Waren- oder Ausgabenbereich gewährleisten Sie eine effektive und effiziente Bereitstellung von Kernbeschaffungsdienstleistungen und eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Automatisierung und Verfügbarkeit von Inhalten. Sie arbeiten eng mit der internen Beschaffung (d. h. Kapiteln und Fähigkeitsbereichen wie Customer Relationship Management, Contracting, Lösungen, Analysen usw.) und Geschäftsbeteiligten zusammen, um Geschäftsanforderungen in Sourcing- und Ausgabenmanagementaktivitäten und Inhaltsverbesserung umzusetzen. Sie arbeiten eng mit anderen Teammitgliedern zusammen, um die Kundennachfrage zu unterstützen, das Kundenkauferlebnis zu verbessern, tägliche operative Aktivitäten durchzuführen und Kapazitäten und Fachwissen bereitzustellen, um Produktivität und andere kundenorientierte Projekte / Lösungen zu liefern. Sie werden eine Vielzahl von Rollen entsprechend Ihrer Erfahrung, Ihrem Wissen und Ihren allgemeinen Geschäftsanforderungen spielen, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf:
• Sie entwickeln Inhalte und Automatisierung und übersetzen Sourcing-Ergebnisse und -Möglichkeiten in Inhalte und automatisierte Einkaufskanäle, die die Akzeptanz, Zufriedenheit und Gesamteffizienz des Unternehmens verbessern.
• Anwendung Ihrer Schnelllernfähigkeiten, um das Team bei Ad-hoc-Geschäftsprojekten, kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen und neuen Prozessimplementierungen zu unterstützen.
• Sie fungiert als wichtiger Ansprechpartner, um sich mit externen Lieferanten abzustimmen, den Projektfortschritt zu verfolgen und die täglichen operativen Anfragen zu lösen.
• Ausführung des täglichen Systembetriebs, Aufrechterhaltung der Datengenauigkeit und Gewährleistung eines reibungslosen Transaktionsflusses innerhalb des SAP-Systems. Wer du bist:
• Sie sind an der Universität eingeschrieben (vorzugsweise in der Wirtschaft oder einer verwandten Disziplin; vorzugsweise als Absolvent)
• Sie zeigen eine starke Lernagilität und eine proaktive Bereitschaft, neue Konzepte, Prozesse und Systeme in einem dynamischen Umfeld schnell zu erfassen.
• Sie sind in der Lage, sich schnell mit SAP-Systemen vertraut zu machen und idealerweise über grundlegende Kenntnisse oder praktische Erfahrungen zu verfügen.

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les soins de santé évoluent, et Global Approvisionnement répond en s'efforçant constamment d'obtenir les meilleurs résultats possibles, en adoptant des approches novatrices et stratégiques pour les partenariats entre entreprises et fournisseurs. Global Approvisionnement gère de façon proactive l'ensemble de l'écosystème fournisseur, contribuant de façon vitale à améliorer les résultats en matière de santé, réduisant les coûts pour les patients et les systèmes de santé mondiaux, et faisant en sorte que Roche continue de faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. La possibilité : Ce rôle fait partie du groupe de la livraison indirecte d'approvisionnements, qui couvre les principales activités d'approvisionnement liées à la gestion des catégories, à l'approvisionnement stratégique et opérationnel, à la gestion des fournisseurs, à la passation de marchés, à la définition de la stratégie de contenu et à l'exécution. Le groupe de la livraison d'approvisionnements indirects comprend de nombreuses collectivités regroupant des catégories de la même chaîne de valeur ou ayant des points communs, y compris la recherche et le développement, les services commerciaux et ministériels, le numérique et la technologie et les installations. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec d'autres membres de l'équipe afin de soutenir la demande des clients, d'améliorer l'expérience d'achat des clients, de mener des activités opérationnelles quotidiennes et de fournir une capacité et une expertise pour fournir la productivité et d'autres projets/solutions axés sur les clients. • Vous développez du contenu et de l'automatisation, transformant les résultats et les possibilités d'approvisionnement en contenu et en canaux d'achat automatisés qui améliorent l'adoption, la satisfaction et l'efficacité globale des entreprises.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
Are you ready to lead the strategic gateway that bridges APAC innovation with global healthcare demand? As our Asia Sourcing Office Lead in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will drive global sourcing and operational excellence for DOP. In this role, you will lead a dedicated regional team across APAC, champion digital procurement transformation, and navigate complex global markets to ensure our supply networks remain highly competitive and resilient.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Head of Procurement Centre of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You are accountable for leading, coaching, and developing a global, cross-cultural matrix team of up to 15 Sourcing Managers and one Business Capability Lead. You manage key interfaces across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), DOP Category, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, and external suppliers.

• Role Type: A leadership position evenly split between strategic category alignment and tactical sourcing execution, focusing on regional sourcing expertise and talent empowerment.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing excellence, financial value, and digital governance across APAC. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics (PPV, preferred supplier share, cycle times), tracking stakeholder/supplier satisfaction, and managing your team's OPEX budget.

• Asia Sourcing Office Mandate: Finding potential suppliers across Asia, executing initial due diligence, and conducting targeted regional benchmarking.

• Sourcing & Analysis: Overseeing compliant global and regional sourcing, benchmarking (RfX), and detailed procurement analyses alongside NPI and Delivery managers.

• Contracts & SLAs: Ensuring template-based contract execution (CDAs, SOWs), repository health, and defining KPIs to guarantee on-time, in-full (OTIF) portfolio delivery.

• myBuy Governance: Serving as Business Capability Lead (BCL) to drive platform governance, policy, continuous improvement, and knowledge management alongside RSS.

• Conflict & Exposure: Resolving matrix priority and supplier selection conflicts, representing DOP at external events, and delivering monthly/quarterly updates to executive leadership (CoE, Category, Delivery, and DPLT).

Who you are
We look for leaders who can drive high-performance cultures, break down silos, and eliminate operational friction.

• Education: University degree (Business/Life Sciences required); MBA and CIPS certification highly preferred.

• Experience: 5-7+ years in Direct Procurement (Medtech, Automotive, etc.), including 3-5 years within a Shared Service or CoE environment.

• Market Expertise: Strong regional sourcing and NPI experience across complex direct categories (EMS/e-components, Plastics/Packaging, or Biologics/Chemicals).

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
Are you ready to lead the strategic gateway that bridges APAC innovation with global healthcare demand? As our Asia Sourcing Office Lead in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will drive global sourcing and operational excellence for DOP. In this role, you will lead a dedicated regional team across APAC, champion digital procurement transformation, and navigate complex global markets to ensure our supply networks remain highly competitive and resilient.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Head of Procurement Centre of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You are accountable for leading, coaching, and developing a global, cross-cultural matrix team of up to 15 Sourcing Managers and one Business Capability Lead. You manage key interfaces across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), DOP Category, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, and external suppliers.

• Role Type: A leadership position evenly split between strategic category alignment and tactical sourcing execution, focusing on regional sourcing expertise and talent empowerment.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing excellence, financial value, and digital governance across APAC. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics (PPV, preferred supplier share, cycle times), tracking stakeholder/supplier satisfaction, and managing your team's OPEX budget.

• Asia Sourcing Office Mandate: Finding potential suppliers across Asia, executing initial due diligence, and conducting targeted regional benchmarking.

• Sourcing & Analysis: Overseeing compliant global and regional sourcing, benchmarking (RfX), and detailed procurement analyses alongside NPI and Delivery managers.

• Contracts & SLAs: Ensuring template-based contract execution (CDAs, SOWs), repository health, and defining KPIs to guarantee on-time, in-full (OTIF) portfolio delivery.

• myBuy Governance: Serving as Business Capability Lead (BCL) to drive platform governance, policy, continuous improvement, and knowledge management alongside RSS.

• Conflict & Exposure: Resolving matrix priority and supplier selection conflicts, representing DOP at external events, and delivering monthly/quarterly updates to executive leadership (CoE, Category, Delivery, and DPLT).

Who you are
We look for leaders who can drive high-performance cultures, break down silos, and eliminate operational friction.

• Education: University degree (Business/Life Sciences required); MBA and CIPS certification highly preferred.

• Experience: 5-7+ years in Direct Procurement (Medtech, Automotive, etc.), including 3-5 years within a Shared Service or CoE environment.

• Market Expertise: Strong regional sourcing and NPI experience across complex direct categories (EMS/e-components, Plastics/Packaging, or Biologics/Chemicals).

• AI & Digitalization: You have a strong affinity to explore AI-driven solutions broadly, particularly regard

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team
We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
Are you ready to architect the overarching global procurement strategy and command the end-to-end supplier networks for the electronic components that power our next-generation diagnostic devices? As our Global Category Manager for e-Components in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will take ultimate accountability for developing strategies and leading strategic initiatives for this critical spend category. In this role, you will manage top-tier electronic component suppliers, navigate global supply chain complexities, and translate category goals into bottom-line value creation.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the Senior Global Category Lead Electronics & Systems within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Engages directly with cross-functional teams composed of representatives from Category, Delivery, Procurement Center of Excellence, and global business partners. Serves as a key business partner contact point for senior functional and business stakeholders.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role with global category leadership position focused on strategic vision, category development, pipeline building, and relationship ecosystem management

• Impact: You deliver commercial impact by anchoring cost and developing a resilience pipeline of projects, in addition to securing our sustainability priorities. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, supplier data, and business requirements to formulate a formalized, global Category Strategy and initiative pipeline, to be aligned with leaders across the organization.

• Commercial Negotiations: Leading high-value commercial and contractual negotiations for strategic suppliers within the category.

• Supplier Ecosystems: Managing key global suppliers, establishing development and innovation programs, monitoring value targets, and managing supplier risks.

• Guidance & Content: Developing and maintaining category guidance documents to translate strategy into clear, executable content for procurement colleagues and business users.

• Business Partnering: Building deep relationships with senior stakeholders, challenging demand/specifications to maximize value, and managing risk/CSR reviews.

• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching procurement colleagues, providing professional development, managing a shared Associate Category Manager within the team, and tracking budget spend.

Who you are
We look for strategic procurement champions with extensive knowledge of global electronics supply markets and the matrix leadership skills needed to drive complex organizational change.

• Education: University degree required (Business or Life Sciences focus preferred); a post-graduate business-related qualification is preferred.

En tant que Global Category Manager pour e-Components à Kuala Lumpur, en Malaisie, vous serez responsable de l'élaboration de stratégies et des initiatives stratégiques pour cette catégorie de dépenses critiques. Dans ce rôle, vous gérerez des fournisseurs de composants électroniques de premier ordre, naviguerez dans les complexités de la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale et traduireez les objectifs de catégorie en création de valeur de base.

Il sert de point de contact principal des partenaires commerciaux pour les principaux intervenants fonctionnels et commerciaux.
• Type de rôle : Un participant individuel occupant un poste de dirigeant de catégorie mondiale axé sur la vision stratégique, l'élaboration de catégories, la construction de pipelines et la gestion des rapports écosystémiques
• Impact: Vous produisez un impact commercial en ancrage des coûts et en développant un pipeline de résilience de projets, en plus de garantir nos priorités de durabilité. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Stratégie et pipeline annuel : Rassembler les renseignements sur le marché, les données sur les fournisseurs et les exigences opérationnelles pour formuler un pipeline officiel de la catégorie mondiale et de l'initiative, qui sera aligné sur les dirigeants de l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Négociations commerciales : Mener des négociations commerciales et contractuelles de grande valeur pour les fournisseurs stratégiques de la catégorie.
• Écosystèmes fournisseurs : Gestion des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux, établissement de programmes de développement et d'innovation, surveillance des objectifs de valeur et gestion des risques pour les fournisseurs.
• Orientation et contenu : Élaborer et tenir à jour des documents d'orientation de catégorie afin de traduire la stratégie en contenu clair et exécutable pour les collègues en approvisionnement et les utilisateurs commerciaux.
• Partenariat d'affaires : Établir des relations étroites avec les intervenants de haut niveau, mettre en doute la demande et les particularités afin de maximiser la valeur et gérer les examens des risques et des RCS.
• Surveillance de l'équipe et du budget : Encadrer les collègues en approvisionnement, assurer le perfectionnement professionnel, gérer un gestionnaire de catégorie associé partagé au sein de l'équipe et suivre les dépenses budgétaires. jobs.title: Sourcing Manager - Asia Sourcing Office (Malaysia)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.

We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to optimize the supply networks that make life-saving diagnostics possible? As our Sourcing Manager in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will be a vital part of our APAC sourcing operations. In this high-impact role, you will execute end-to-end, medium- to high-complexity sourcing projects while acting as a key mechanism for the Asia Sourcing Office - identifying regional suppliers, performing initial due diligence, and translating transactional requests into strategic, value-add solutions.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Asia Sourcing Office Lead, and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Partners with DOP Category, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, regional operations stakeholders, and external suppliers to resolve administrative bottlenecks and inform future strategies.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on end-to-end sourcing execution, master data management, and value creation.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing excellence, financial value, and compliance across the APAC footprint. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Asia Supplier Discovery: Identifying potential suppliers across Asia, executing initial due diligence, and conducting targeted regional benchmarking.

• Sourcing Execution: Compliantly executing regional sourcing projects, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and eSourcing tools for on-market products and New Product Introductions (NPI).

• Demand Aggregation: Analyzing site user requirements, aggregating regional demand to maximize leverage, and escalating non-standard requests to Category Management.

• Project & Risk Management: Developing comprehensive project plans (timelines, milestones, resources) and proactively identifying and mitigating risks to objectives.

• Contract Lifecycle: Setting up template-based contracts (such as CDAs and SOWs) and accurately managing their lifecycle repository, renewals, and potential contractual improvements.

• Operational Excellence: Utilizing enterprise tools (SAP, myBuy) and master data management to simplify workflows and ensure strict compliance with global procurement policies.

• Metrics & CSR: Tracking operational targets and customer service metrics (such as cycle times and compliance) while championing supplier diversity, sustainability, and ethical practices.

• Collaboration & Exposure: Partnering with support functions (like Accounts Payable) to clear administrative bottlenecks and presenting regular KPI and project updates to the Sourcing Lead and regional stakeholders.

Who you are

We strive to keep our standards high and look for analytical problem-solvers with a strong customer-service focus.

• Education: University degree (Business/Life Sciences preferred) is required; an MBA or CIPS certification is highly desirable.

• Experience: 3–5+ years in procurement or sourcing,

Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di sostenere al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Sei pronto ad ottimizzare le reti di alimentazione che rendono possibile la diagnostica salvavita? Come nostro Sourcing Manager a Kuala Lumpur, Malesia, sarete una parte vitale delle nostre operazioni di sourcing APAC. • Linea di segnalazione: Rapporti direttamente all'Ufficio di Sourcing Asiatico Lead, e fa parte del Centro di Eccellenza di Procurement (CoE).
• Squadra Wider e stakeholder: Partner con DOP Categoria, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, stakeholder di operazioni regionali e fornitori esterni per risolvere strozzature amministrative e informare le strategie future.
• Tipo di ruolo: Un ruolo di Contributor individuale focalizzato sull'esecuzione di sourcing end-to-end, la gestione dei dati master e la creazione di valore.
• Impatto: Guidate l'eccellenza globale, il valore finanziario e la conformità attraverso l'impronta APAC. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Asia Fornitore Discovery: Identificare i potenziali fornitori in tutta l'Asia, eseguire la due diligence iniziale e condurre benchmarking regionale mirato.
• Esecuzione Sourcing: Esecuzione completa di progetti di approvvigionamento regionale, processi standard (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), e strumenti di eSourcing per i prodotti on-market e Nuove Introduzioni del prodotto (NPI).
• Aggregazione della domanda: Analizzando i requisiti degli utenti del sito, aggregando la domanda regionale per massimizzare la leva e intensificando le richieste non standard alla gestione della categoria.
• Project & Risk Management: Sviluppo di piani di progetto completi (linee temporali, pietre miliari, risorse) e identificazione proattiva e mitigazione dei rischi per gli obiettivi.
• Contratto ciclo di vita: Impostazione di contratti basati su modelli (come CDAs e SOWs) e gestione accurata del loro archivio del ciclo di vita, rinnovi e potenziali miglioramenti contrattuali.
• Eccellenza operativa: Utilizzo di strumenti aziendali (SAP, myBuy) e gestione dei dati master per semplificare i flussi di lavoro e garantire una rigorosa conformità alle politiche di approvvigionamento globale.
• Metrics & CSR: Monitorare gli obiettivi operativi e le metriche del servizio clienti (come i tempi di ciclo e la conformità) e sostenere la diversità dei fornitori, la sostenibilità e le pratiche etiche.
• Collaborazione & Exposure: Partner con funzioni di supporto (come Accounts Payable) per eliminare i colli di bottiglia amministrativi e presentare regolarmente KPI e aggiornamenti di progetto al Sourcing Lead e agli stakeholder regionali. Chi sei Ci sforziamo di mantenere i nostri standard elevati e cercare i problem-solvers analitici con una forte attenzione al servizio clienti.
• Istruzione: laurea (Business / Scienze della vita preferita) è richiesto; una certificazione MBA o CIPS è altamente auspicabile.
• Esperienza: 3–5+ anni di approvvigionamento o approvvigionamento,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
¿Te apasiona conectar la innovación científica con la eficiencia hospitalaria? Buscamos un/a Sales Specialist Core para liderar y expandir nuestra presencia en el territorio de Cataluña. En este rol, serás el socio estratégico de los laboratorios y centros sanitarios de la región, estableciendo relaciones de confianza profunda y comprendiendo los retos del ecosistema de salud local.
Tu misión será impulsar el éxito del negocio basándote en la innovación de nuestro porfolio de especialidades diagnósticas y en la optimización de los flujos de trabajo de nuestros clientes. Si tienes una mentalidad estratégica, te apasiona el desarrollo de negocio y quieres transformar la atención al paciente a través de diagnósticos de vanguardia, ¡este es tu lugar!

Your Main Responsibilities

• Ejecución y Estrategia Comercial: Implementar los planes de acción y estrategias definidas en tu zona para alcanzar y superar los objetivos anuales, ganando cuota de mercado y cumpliendo con los KPI del negocio.

• Identificación de Retos y Co-creación: Detectar las necesidades tanto de los profesionales del laboratorio como de las direcciones económicas y gerenciales de los centros, proponiendo soluciones diferenciadoras que aporten un valor real.

• Gestión de Stakeholders (360°): Construir y mantener relaciones estrechas con el personal técnico del laboratorio y con áreas clave del hospital (adquisiciones, finanzas y gestión hospitalaria), garantizando la satisfacción del cliente en todo su ciclo de vida.

• Enlace y Colaboración Interna: Tras la firma de los acuerdos, asegurarás que los equipos y reactivos se implementen a la perfección en los laboratorios, colaborando estrechamente con nuestros equipos de soporte técnico y aplicaciones.

• Expertise y Demostraciones Técnicas: Desarrollar un conocimiento profundo del porfolio de Core Lab , realizando presentaciones y demostraciones de producto de alto impacto que resuelvan las dudas de los clientes y destaquen nuestro valor diferencial.

Who You Are (The skills you need)

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Scientist, Clinical Pharmacology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Clinical Pharmacology (CP) Scientist is responsible for developing and implementing quantitative Clinical Pharmacology strategies across early to late phases of clinical drug development to ensure that the right drug is administered to the right patient at the right dosing regimen and to deliver an optimal therapeutic benefit/risk profile for the patients. The CP Scientist uses state of the art modeling and simulation tools and is able to implement model-informed drug development strategies to address critical questions that are aligned with project needs. The CP Scientist is an active member of cross-functional drug development teams, and works in close partnership with Pharmacometricians, Biostatisticians, Clinicians, Biomarker Scientists, Toxicologists, Preclinical Pharmacologists, and other function) to support drug development decisions through registration and post-marketing commitments. The Senior/Principal CP Scientist represents CP function on filing teams and fosters effective collaboration and communications with regulatory agencies to support efficient drug development of drug candidates.

Key responsibilities include:

• Leading the design and review of clinical study protocols for the development of novel therapeutic agents with particular focus on China development (all drug and delivery modalities);

• Leading the planning and conduct of PK/PD data analyses and setting strategy to foster the appropriate use of modeling and simulations to inform clinical drug development decisions;

• CP functional representation and leadership at functional and cross-functional China development focused meetings internally and externally (eg. cross-functional teams, department meetings, governance review meetings, scientific conferences, etc.);

• Implementing strategic agility and effective project management to align critical CP deliverables according to the rapidly evolving regulatory and project needs in China;

• Authorship of regulatory documents and meeting background packages to support key clinical development milestones in China;

• Lead CP representation at health-authority meetings in China, and contribute to the planning, implementation and organization of regulatory filings (e.g. IND, BLA, NDA, sNDA);

• Support the global development strategies for clinical pharmacology and M&S as needed.

Technical Skills:
Required:

• The ability to plan, organize, interpret, and/or perform PK/PD data analyses.

• Familiarity with clinical drug development and clinical study design options for development of different drug and delivery modalities.

• Familiarity with quantitative modeling approaches in drug development and working knowledge of relevant modeling software (e.g. NONMEM, WinNonlin, R, SimCYP, GastroPlus, PKSim, Matlab, etc).

• Familiarity with agentic approaches for work streamlining and integrating agent-based workflows to improve efficiency throughout the drug development lifecycle.

• Working knowledge of statistical approaches as they apply to clinical study design and analysis.

Desired:

• Experience in leading regulatory filing strategy as a CP lead to support the totality of CP filing package, dose/regimen justification, and drug labeling is highly desired.

Communication Skills:

• Excellent written communication skills, in order to deliver high quality protocols, publications, and regulatory documents for team and management review.

• Excellent oral communications to make clear presentations and foster effective stakeholder engagemen

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Enterprise Master Data Management (EMDM) is a Roche cross-functional and cross-divisional network of master data specialists and subject-matter experts developing governance frameworks and maintenance processes to ensure high-quality and trusted master data as the backbone for seamless business operations, data analytics and digitalization.

The Opportunity
In the Enterprise Master Data Management Operations Business Analyst role, you are responsible for the dedication towards undisturbed business activities by committing to Service Level Agreement.
In this role, you will ensure that technological architecture meets user requirements, and will support the whole data maintenance related queries - including data quality, lifecycle management and monitoring. Execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level and in compliance with the SOPs of the respective business sub-process. Follow the instructions of the Cluster Lead - Enterprise Master Data Management Operations Business Partner domain regarding the daily work coordination, and propose process and system improvements across multiple divisions. Contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of the Finance, Procurement, Sales and Supply Chain
organizations by:
• ● Handling incoming incidents, supporting both Roche Affiliates and multiple regional and global IT departments
• ● 2nd level evaluation of user requests based on ITIL methodology and prioritization towards IT accordingly
• ● Collaborate with IT teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
• ● Perform and participate in the analysis, (re)design and implementation of business and systems processes and procedures following appropriate standards
• ● Management of continuous data cleansing and Data lifecycle management
• ● Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for automation and optimization
• ● Develop business cases and proposals for process improvements and system upgrades
• ● Maintenance of SOPs, Knowledge Base and User Guidance
• ● Audit control management (ICFR)
• ● Training material preparation and delivery (including delta training) – using Train the Trainer and end user concepts
• ● Project management (lead, coordinate, facilitate, participate within RSS projects and participate in global projects)

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development.
• ● Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential.
• ● Strong customer centricity and stakeholder management skills
• ● Experienced in SAP (FI, MM, CO, SD)
• ● Ability to work independently and in team as well
• ● Focus on details and innovation
• ● Skilled in multitasking and prioritization
• ● Has analytical thinking
• ● 3-5 years Master Data management experience is desirable
• ● Project experience (desirable)

In exchange we provide you with
Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Fu
