At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Cybersecurity Analyst investigates security incidents, performs vulnerability assessments, and contributes to improving security operations
You will be capable of independent work on defined tasks, independently handling less complex tasks and contributing to various stages of the analysis lifecycle
By taking ownership of delivering well-defined requirements and supporting the design of feasible security solutions, you will proactively identify solution-level issues and maintain a mindset of continuous improvement within the security domain

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities / Scope

• Independently handles less complex tasks and provides input to solution design by defining and managing requirements for small-scale problem areas

• Focuses on understanding the problem domain, recommending solution options, and proactively identifying solution-level issues, gaps, or inefficiencies to improve products or processes

Accountability/Problem Solving

• Takes ownership of delivering well-defined requirements and supporting the design of feasible solutions for specific features or components

• Independently analyzes less complex security technical problems, defines problem scope, contributes to identifying root causes, and provides solutions to a broad range of difficult problems

• Evaluates change and technology impacts with increasing accuracy, diagnoses gaps, and applies analytical and logical reasoning independently to identify discrepancies and challenge assumptions

Stakeholder Management

• Identifies key business, technical, and security stakeholders for assigned tasks, analyzing their needs and interests regarding security posture and risk

• Primarily interacts within security product teams/squads and across Security Operations functions, while establishing rapport and managing realistic security expectations

• Develops and delivers tailored communication for security tasks and incident updates, facilitates meetings, and proactively engages with stakeholders to elicit, clarify, and validate security requirements

Impact/Strategy

• Contributes to projects or workgroups by providing well-analyzed requirements and supporting the design of solutions that align with business objectives within their specified area

• Demonstrates growing autonomy and expertise within their specific domain by translating requirements into a strategic plan with supervision, and may identify opportunities for minor process improvements within their immediate scope

Complexity

• Works on a product or larger contexts, handling requirements and analysis for specific features or components

• Can navigate moderate levels of complexity in requirements and stakeholder landscapes

• Begins to understand sources of influence and analyze business problems/opportunities within this product context, starting to map basic interconnections

Business/Technical ability

• Possesses a working knowledge of the relevant business domain and supporting technologies

• Understands sources of influence, comprehending internal and external factors affecting the problem space, and is capable of identifying and analyzing basic business problems or opportunities holistically

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Working knowledge of relevant business domains and supporting cybersecurity technologies

• Experience in conducting stakeholder interviews, synthesizing requirements, and mapping/analyzing current processes

• Demonstrated ability to independently handle less c

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is based in the Regional Customer Support Center which is dedicated to providing excellence while helping laboratory personnel using our products. We operate with a holistic approach, which means that we take care of our product portfolio from the idea through development and market launch to phase-out. The outstanding variety of technologies applied in this area offers you great learning opportunities.

Technical Support Specialist ( Slovak & Czech language)

Locations: Warsaw, Prague or Bratislava (Your choice!)

Are you ready to transition from technical expertise to life-changing impact? Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is the intellectual engine behind laboratory excellence in Central Europe. We are looking for a Czech and/or Slovak-speaking talent who is hungry for knowledge, enjoys problem-solving, and is ready to master the world’s most advanced diagnostic technologies.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

More Than Just Support This isn't a typical helpdesk role. This is an engineering and application consultancy position where you become the "guardian" of diagnostic accuracy.

• Master the Complexity: You will work with high-end IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) systems that combine robotics, complex biochemistry, and advanced IT.

• Continuous Growth: We provide an intensive, world-class training program. We don’t expect you to know everything on day one, but we expect you to be the one who never stops asking "why?".

• Agile Impact: Join a team where your proactivity isn't just welcomed – it's required. You will prevent issues before they happen, using digital twins and remote diagnostic tools.

Who You Are:

• Education: You have a degree in Engineering, IT, Biochemistry, Lab Diagnostics or equivalent. More importantly, you have a "detective’s mind" for troubleshooting.

• Language Power: You are a native or C1/C2 speaker of Czech and/or Slovak . Your English is strong enough to lead you through international trainings and global technical forums.

• The "Lab-to-Office" Bridge: If you’ve worked in a clinical lab and feel you’ve outgrown your current walls, we want your diagnostic logic. We will teach you the engineering; you bring the passion for science.

• Resilience & Ambition: You are someone who sees a complex technical error not as a problem, but as a challenge to be conquered.

What Roche Offers You:

• Autonomy: A hybrid work model in Warsaw, Prague, or Bratislava.

• Unmatched Portfolio: Access to technologies that are setting the standard for the next decade of healthcare.

The role is an 18 - month contract via an external agency.

F or the secondary locations the compensation data will be provided during the first interview.

INTERESED? APPLY!

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche? Check out our blog!
https://diagnostics.roc

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is based in the Regional Customer Support Center which is dedicated to providing excellence while helping laboratory personnel using our products. We operate with a holistic approach, which means that we take care of our product portfolio from the idea through development and market launch to phase-out. The outstanding variety of technologies applied in this area offers you great learning opportunities.

Technical Support Specialist ( Slovak & Czech language)

Locations: Warsaw, Prague or Bratislava (Your choice!)

Are you ready to transition from technical expertise to life-changing impact? Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is the intellectual engine behind laboratory excellence in Central Europe. We are looking for a Czech and/or Slovak-speaking talent who is hungry for knowledge, enjoys problem-solving, and is ready to master the world’s most advanced diagnostic technologies.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

More Than Just Support This isn't a typical helpdesk role. This is an engineering and application consultancy position where you become the "guardian" of diagnostic accuracy.

• Master the Complexity: You will work with high-end IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) systems that combine robotics, complex biochemistry, and advanced IT.

• Continuous Growth: We provide an intensive, world-class training program. We don’t expect you to know everything on day one, but we expect you to be the one who never stops asking "why?".

• Agile Impact: Join a team where your proactivity isn't just welcomed – it's required. You will prevent issues before they happen, using digital twins and remote diagnostic tools.

Who You Are:

• Education: You have a degree in Engineering, IT, Biochemistry, Lab Diagnostics or equivalent. More importantly, you have a "detective’s mind" for troubleshooting.

• Language Power: You are a native or C1/C2 speaker of Czech and/or Slovak . Your English is strong enough to lead you through international trainings and global technical forums.

• The "Lab-to-Office" Bridge: If you’ve worked in a clinical lab and feel you’ve outgrown your current walls, we want your diagnostic logic. We will teach you the engineering; you bring the passion for science.

• Resilience & Ambition: You are someone who sees a complex technical error not as a problem, but as a challenge to be conquered.

What Roche Offers You:

• Autonomy: A hybrid work model in Warsaw, Prague, or Bratislava.

• Unmatched Portfolio: Access to technologies that are setting the standard for the next decade of healthcare.

The role is an 18 - month contract via an external agency.

• · Budget management and product launch experience preferred

• · At least upper-intermediate level of English and fluent Russian
• · Having driving license and willing to travel

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Wer wir sind

Als Learning-Abteilung verantworten wir die Einarbeitung und das Training neuer und bestehender Mitarbeitender in unserem Pharma-Bereich mit über 2000 Beschäftigten (Produktion, Quality, Entwicklung, Cell & Gene). Damit Lernen ein echtes Erlebnis wird und den Teilnehmenden sowie Trainern noch mehr Spaß macht, suchen wir Dich für 6 Monate in Vollzeit (37,5 h/Woche) als Unterstützung in unserem Team!

Unser Ziel

Wir möchten weg von „Read and Understood“ hin zu kompetenzbasierten, praxisorientierten Trainingsformaten (On-the-Job) – idealerweise gestützt von modernen digitalen und automatisierten Lösungen. Auf dieser Reise unterstützt du uns und leistest deinen Beitrag zu unserer Vision: „Jeder findet, was er sucht, versteht, was er findet, und lernt, was er braucht. “

Deine Aufgaben

Innerhalb der folgenden Tätigkeiten können sich deine Aufgaben und Einsatzmöglichkeiten bei uns wiederfinden:

• Didaktische Konzeption: Du unterstützt unsere Learning Partner bei der Anpassung und Weiterentwicklung von Trainings-Konzepten basierend auf unserer Strategie sowie dem Feedback aus der Organisation.

• State-of-the-Art Erwachsenenbildung: Gemeinsam mit Fachexperten entwickelst du Trainings nach modernen Ansätzen der Bildungswissenschaft und Psychologie weiter. Du unterstützt bei der Methodenauswahl, der didaktischen Strukturierung sowie der konzeptionellen und visuellen Gestaltung.

• Digitale Innovation & Automatisierung: Du treibst die Digitalisierung unserer Lerninhalte voran. Dazu gehört die eigenständige Entwicklung von Softwareanwendungen, Apps oder Tools auf Low-Code-Plattformen (z. B. UiPath) sowie die Arbeit mit Content-Lifecycle-Management-Systemen.

• Prozessanalyse & Visualisierung: Gemeinsam im Team identifizierst du Optimierungspotenziale, führst Datenanalysen durch und visualisierst Prozesse in entsprechenden Tools, um die Stabilität und Effizienz im Learning-Bereich zu erhöhen.

• Workshop- und Content-Erstellung: Du bereitest interaktive Workshops und Präsentationsunterlagen vor, führst diese mit durch und breitest die Ergebnisse professionell auf.

Wer du bist

• Studium: Du bist immatrikulierte:r Student:in der Fachrichtungen Pädagogik, Bildungswissenschaften, Sozialpädagogik, Psychologie, Wirtschaftsinformatik (oder vergleichbar) bzw. befindest dich im Gap-Year zwischen Bachelor und Master.

• Didaktisches Fundament: Du bringst theoretisches Wissen oder erste praktische Erfahrungen aus der Didaktik, Lernpsychologie oder Erwachsenenbildung mit und weißt, wie man Wissen nachhaltig und inspirierend vermittelt.

• Digitale Affinität: Du besitzt eine hohe IT- und Tech-Affinität. Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office/Google Workspace sowie idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit E-Learning- und Kollaborations-Tools (Articulate, Synthesia, Miro, Trello, Lucid, Tableau) oder Low-Code-Plattformen (UiPath) zeichnen dich aus.

• Sprachkompetenz: Da wir in einem internationalen Pharma-Umfeld agieren, fließen dir gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift leicht von der Hand; sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

• Persönlichkeit: Du bist kommunikativ, organisierst gerne und liebst es, im Team zu arbeiten und andere für deine kreativen Ideen zu begeistern.

• Präsenz: Es ist dir möglich, rund 80 % deiner Arbeitszeit vor Ort im Büro am Standort Penzberg zu verbringen.

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• attraktive Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-

jobs.title: Product manager Automation & Consultancy solutions

titleByLocale.it: Product Manager Soluzioni di automazione e consulenza
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de produits Solutions d'automatisation et de conseil

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
If you enjoy working in a dynamic environment and are looking for an opportunity to work with a team of specialists in the healthcare environment, Roche Diagnostics Kazakhstan is looking for a Product manager Automation & Consultancy solutions for Central Asia and Caucasian countries.

Location: Almaty, Kazakhstan

Responsibilities:
• interaction with the customer and the project team during the lab´s automation implementation
• collection, analysis, documentation of requirements and implementation of projects
• conducting consulting activities with employees of client organizations
• preparation of presentations, reports, proposals and other project documentation for clients
• development/localization of marketing materials
• product management & strategic development: establishing the groundwork and promotion of the company's digital solutions

Qualification and Requirements:
• higher education (IT, technical)
• knowledge of English at the level of Upper-intermediate and above
• project management experience
• customer experience approach and results orientation
• developed communication skills and ability to work in a team
• experience in negotiating with clients at the KOL/stakeholders level
• ability to travel (up to 40% of working time)
• knowledge and understanding of IT environment
Skills:
• analytical, critical and abstract thinking
• soft skills (ability to interact, ability to persuade, skills to adapt to changes, creativity)
• mapping and visualization of business processes

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Se ti piace lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e stai cercando un'opportunità per lavorare con un team di specialisti nell'ambiente sanitario, Roche Diagnostics Kazakistan sta cercando un Product Manager Automation & Consultancy soluzioni per l'Asia Centrale e i paesi caucasici. Ubicazione: Almaty, Kazakistan Responsabilità:
• interazione con il cliente e il team di progetto durante l'implementazione dell'automazione del laboratorio
• raccolta, analisi, documentazione dei requisiti e realizzazione dei progetti
• condurre attività di consulenza con dipendenti di organizzazioni client
• preparazione di presentazioni, report, proposte e altri documenti di progetto per i clienti
• sviluppo/localizzazione dei materiali di marketing
• gestione del prodotto e sviluppo strategico: creazione del lavoro di base e promozione delle soluzioni digitali dell'azienda Qualifica e requisiti:
• istruzione superiore (IT, tecnico)
• conoscenza dell'inglese a livello di Upper-intermediate e sopra
• esperienza di gestione del progetto
• approccio di customer experience e orientamento dei risultati
• sviluppare capacità di comunicazione e capacità di lavorare in un team
• esperienza nella negoziazione con i clienti al livello KOL/stakeholders
• capacità di viaggiare (fino al 40% del tempo di lavoro)
• conoscenza e comprensione dell'ambiente IT Competenze:
• pensiero analitico, critico e astratto
• soft skills (capacità di interagire, capacità di persuadere, capacità di adattarsi ai cambiamenti, creatività)
• mappatura e visualizzazione dei processi aziendali Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro di parità di opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will complete your internship/Master's thesis in the Near Patient Care Research & Early Development chapter. The chapter's mission is the pre-development of near patient care systems for subsequent product development.
Your task will consist of developing a novel flow-through biosensor and characterizing its performance. To accomplish this, you will:

• Build up a fluidic test setup for whole blood processing

• Develop new sensor layouts and methods for layer construction, employing state-of-the-art manufacturing techniques

• Integrate functional sensor components into the fluidic test setup.

• Synthesize/assemble and characterize different functional sensor components, including thick-film sensors

• Evaluate measurement data using newly developed algorithms and advanced analytical methods

• Work independently on assigned work packages: plan and execute experiments, document results, and prepare detailed technical analyses

Who You Are

We are looking for a highly motivated student with the following educational background:

• Currently enrolled in a Master’s program, with a B.Sc. degree in Biomedical Engineering, Microsystems Technology, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, Physics, Electrochemistry, or a related field (very good grades required)

Technical Experience & Knowledge:

• Ideally, you bring knowledge and experience in prototyping of microfluidic devices and manufacturing or characterization of (bio)sensors

• You are experienced in instrument control programming and fluidics control engineering

• You are familiar with the fundamentals of optical, spectroscopic and electrochemical measurement techniques

• Ideally, you have knowledge of micromachining processes

• Ideally, you possess not only basic knowledge of statistics, but also experience with methods for filtering and fitting measurement data

• Familiarity with various analytical and characterization methods is advantageous

• Willingness to work with human material, e.g., whole blood samples, plasma, serum, and interstitial fluid is required

Personal Qualities:

• High technical interest, especially in interdisciplinary work

• Enthusiasm and passion for microfluidics and biosensor development

• Independence, strong commitment, and goal-oriented mindset

• Excellent teamwork and communication skills; approachability and sociability

• Advanced level of English and at least an Upper-Intermediate level of German

• Eager to gain practical experience in an industrial setting

Your benefits

• Flexible working hours (37.5 hours/week)

• Attractive recognition grant

• Discounted meal prices (- 50%) in our staff canteen

• Sport Center on campus

• Online/Offline student networking events

Your application

Please upload your resume and motivation letter.

Please remember that this opportunity is aimed at students (m/f/d) who are currently enrolled in a master's program and will maintain their student status for the entire period of the internship.

Please note that recommendations for all student activities (e.g. internships, theses, etc.) are excluded.

Period: from November 2026 for a period of 6+6 months.

We are looking forward to your application!

• La familiarità con vari metodi di analisi e caratterizzazione è vantaggiosa
• La volontà di lavorare con materiale umano, ad esempio, campioni di sangue interi, plasma, siero e liquido interstiziale è necessaria QualitÃ personali:

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche .

As a Territory Manager - Jabalpur , you are responsible for managing the sale of the organization’s products through distribution and retail channels across the Mahakoushal Area. You serve as a strategic partner to the Area Sales Manager (ASM), providing critical market insights to estimate product demand and drive the organization’s growth. You apply new approaches to merchandising and field activation to increase brand visibility and ensure that our life-changing products reach the customers and patients who need them. You work collaboratively with distributors and dealers to break down barriers to access, ensuring that our sales plans are executed with precision and operational excellence.

Your Opportunity

• Territory Planning & Execution: You drive business results by providing information on the market environment to help estimate yearly product demand. You ensure the monthly achievement of SKU-wise sales plans and targets by generating secondary sales in the market.

• Distribution Management: You monitor distributor performance, reviewing the existing network to propose the appointment of new partners or the termination of non-performing ones. You motivate distributors and dealers through regular communication, sorting out issues regarding accounts, pricing, and schemes.

• Sales Promotion & Merchandising: You prepare and execute sales promotion plans through field activation and merchandising activities designed by the Marketing Team. You maintain rigorous records of these activities, tracking expenses and sales generated to provide feedback on program efficacy.

• Market Intelligence: You monitor competitor information and feedback within your category. You provide regular reports to the ASM on competitor activities and stock availability of promotional materials to ensure Roche remains competitive in the landscape.

• Customer Excellence: You address all complaints and suggestions from distributors and customers by coordinating with customer care. You organize dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies to ensure brand consistency and strong partnerships.

• Financial Oversight: You ensure timely monthly collections through continuous follow-ups and submit inventory requirements at the distributor level as per the sales plan. You maintain disciplined daily reporting of customer visits as per established work norms.

Who You Are

• Qualified Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Science or Pharmacy . A post-graduate qualification is considered an additional advantage.

• Industry Experience: You have a minimum of 2-3 years of experience with a proven track record in FMCG, OTC, or Retail sales .

• Regional Expert: You possess a deep understanding of the Vadodara/Surat market environment and have experience managing independent representatives, distributors, or agents.

• Strategic Partner: You have demonstrated the ability to assist leadership in planning and executing complex sales promotion plans with a focus on productivity and efficiency.

• Analytical & Disciplined: You rely on data to track sales performance and inventory, with a high degree of accountability for daily reporting and meeting monthly sales targets.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Als Territory Manager - Jabalpur sind Sie für die Verwaltung des Verkaufs der Produkte des Unternehmens über Vertriebs- und Einzelhandelskanäle im gesamten Mahakoushal-Gebiet verantwortlich. Sie sind als strategischer Partner des Area Sales Manager (ASM) tätig und liefern wichtige Marktinformationen, um die Produktnachfrage abzuschätzen und das Wachstum des Unternehmens voranzutreiben. Sie wenden neue Ansätze für Merchandising und Feldaktivierung an, um die Markensichtbarkeit zu erhöhen und sicherzustellen, dass unsere lebensverändernden Produkte die Kunden und Patienten erreichen, die sie benötigen. Sie arbeiten mit Distributoren und Händlern zusammen, um Zugangsbarrieren abzubauen und sicherzustellen, dass unsere Verkaufspläne mit Präzision und operativer Exzellenz ausgeführt werden. Ihre Chance
• Territory Planning & Execution: Sie steigern die Geschäftsergebnisse, indem Sie Informationen über das Marktumfeld bereitstellen, um die jährliche Produktnachfrage zu schätzen. Sie stellen die monatliche Erreichung von SKU-bezogenen Verkaufsplänen und -zielen sicher, indem Sie Sekundärverkäufe auf dem Markt generieren.
• Distribution Management: Sie überwachen die Leistung des Distributors, überprüfen das bestehende Netzwerk, um die Ernennung neuer Partner oder die Kündigung von notleidenden vorzuschlagen. Sie motivieren Händler und Händler durch regelmäßige Kommunikation, indem Sie Probleme in Bezug auf Konten, Preise und Schemata lösen.
• Verkaufsförderung & Merchandising: Sie erstellen und führen Verkaufsförderungspläne durch Feldaktivierungs- und Merchandising-Aktivitäten aus, die vom Marketingteam entwickelt wurden. Sie führen strenge Aufzeichnungen über diese Aktivitäten, verfolgen Ausgaben und Verkäufe, um Feedback zur Wirksamkeit des Programms zu geben.
• Market Intelligence: Sie überwachen die Informationen und das Feedback der Wettbewerber innerhalb Ihrer Kategorie. Sie berichten dem ASM regelmäßig über die Aktivitäten der Wettbewerber und die Verfügbarkeit von Werbematerial, um sicherzustellen, dass Roche in der Landschaft wettbewerbsfähig bleibt.
• Customer Excellence: Sie gehen auf alle Beschwerden und Vorschläge von Distributoren und Kunden ein, indem Sie sich mit der Kundenbetreuung abstimmen. Sie organisieren Händlertreffen in Übereinstimmung mit Marketingstrategien, um Markenkonsistenz und starke Partnerschaften zu gewährleisten.
• Financial Oversight: Sie stellen durch kontinuierliche Nachverfolgungen zeitnahe monatliche Sammlungen sicher und übermitteln Lageranforderungen auf Vertriebsebene gemäß dem Verkaufsplan. Sie pflegen eine disziplinierte tägliche Berichterstattung über Kundenbesuche gemäß den festgelegten Arbeitsnormen. Wer du bist
• Qualified Professional: Sie haben einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Wissenschaft oder Pharmazie. Eine postgraduale Qualifikation gilt als zusätzlicher Vorteil.
• Branchenerfahrung: Sie haben mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz in FMCG, OTC oder Retail Sales.
• Regionalexperte: Sie haben ein tiefes Verständnis für das Marktumfeld von Vadodara/Surat und Erfahrung in der Verwaltung unabhängiger Vertreter, Distributoren oder Agenten.
• Strategischer Partner: Sie haben gezeigt, dass Sie die Führung bei der Planung und Durchführung komplexer Verkaufsförderungspläne mit Schwerpunkt auf Produktivität und Effizienz unterstützen können.
• Analytisch und diszipliniert: Sie verlassen sich auf Daten, um die Verkaufsleistung und den Lagerbestand zu verfolgen, mit einem hohen Maß an Rechenschaftspflicht für die tägliche Berichterstattung und die Erfüllung monatlicher Verkaufsziele.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Voilà ce qui fait de nous Roche. En tant que gestionnaire de territoire - Jabalpur , vous êtes responsable de la gestion de la vente des produits de l'organisation par les canaux de distribution et de vente au détail dans la région de Mahakoushal. Vous servez de partenaire stratégique au Gestionnaire des ventes de secteur (ASM), fournissant des informations essentielles sur le marché pour estimer la demande de produits et stimuler la croissance de l'organisation. Vous appliquez de nouvelles approches de merchandising et d'activation sur le terrain pour augmenter la visibilité de la marque et faire en sorte que nos produits qui changent la vie atteignent les clients et les patients qui en ont besoin. Vous travaillez en collaboration avec les distributeurs et les concessionnaires pour éliminer les obstacles à l'accès, en veillant à ce que nos plans de vente soient exécutés avec précision et excellence opérationnelle. Votre opportunité
• Planification et exécution du territoire : Vous conduisez les résultats commerciaux en fournissant des informations sur l'environnement du marché pour aider à estimer la demande annuelle de produits. Vous veillez à la réalisation mensuelle des plans et des objectifs de vente par SKU en générant des ventes secondaires sur le marché.
• Gestion de la distribution : Vous surveillez les performances des distributeurs, examinez le réseau existant pour proposer la nomination de nouveaux partenaires ou la cessation de ceux qui ne sont pas performants. Vous motivez les distributeurs et les concessionnaires par la communication régulière, le tri des questions concernant les comptes, les prix et les régimes.
• Promotion des ventes & Marchandising: Vous préparez et exécutez des plans de promotion des ventes grâce à des activités d'activation sur le terrain et de merchandising conçues par l'équipe marketing. Vous conservez des registres rigoureux de ces activités, du suivi des dépenses et des ventes produites pour fournir des commentaires sur l'efficacité du programme.
• Intelligence de marché: Vous surveillez l'information et la rétroaction des concurrents dans votre catégorie. Vous fournissez régulièrement des rapports à l'ASM sur les activités des concurrents et la disponibilité de matériel promotionnel afin que Roche reste compétitive dans le paysage.
• Excellence client : Vous répondez à toutes les plaintes et suggestions des distributeurs et des clients en coordonnant avec le service client. Vous organisez des réunions de concessionnaires conformément aux stratégies de marketing pour assurer la cohérence de la marque et des partenariats solides.
• Surveillance financière : Vous assurez des collectes mensuelles en temps opportun grâce à des suivis continus et soumettez les exigences d'inventaire au niveau du distributeur conformément au plan de vente. Vous maintenez un rapport quotidien discipliné des visites des clients selon les normes de travail établies. Qui vous êtes
• Professionnel qualifié: Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en sciences ou en pharmacie. Une qualification postdoctorale est considérée comme un avantage supplémentaire.
• Expérience de l'industrie : Vous disposez d'un minimum de 2-3 ans d'expérience avec une expérience éprouvée dans les ventes FMCG, OTC ou au détail.
• Expert régional: Vous possédez une connaissance approfondie de l'environnement du marché de Vadodara/Surat et avez de l'expérience en gestion de représentants indépendants, de distributeurs ou d'agents.
• Partenaire stratégique : Vous avez démontré la capacité d'aider le leadership dans la planification et l'exécution de plans de promotion des ventes complexes en mettant l'accent sur la productivité et l'efficacité.
• Analyse et discipline : Vous vous fiez aux données pour suivre le rendement des ventes et l'inventaire, avec un haut degré de responsabilité pour les rapports quotidiens et pour atteindre les objectifs de vente mensuels.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) is a global organisation of app. 3,000 colleagues across six Innovation Centres covering multiple disease areas, with the aim of translating science into transformative medicines for patients. Within this exciting and dynamic environment, pRED Communications operates as a high-impact team of strategic business partners.

We are seeking a dynamic Senior Communications Business Partner who embodies a strategic and collaborative mindset. In this role, you will lead on a diverse portfolio of communication responsibilities across the pRED landscape. You will serve as a core member of at least one pRED Leadership Team, deploying your strategic expertise where it is most needed to drive business outcomes and organisational alignment.

​The opportunity

• Strategic advisory: Act as a core communications strategic adviser and valued Leadership Team member for a designated portfolio within pRED. You will translate business strategy into high-impact communication blueprints that resonate from the lab benches to the leadership community and beyond. You will provide strategic counsel to senior leaders and ensure communications are integrated into the business decision-making process.

• Cross-functional impact: Identify the need for, lead and execute both internal and external communication strategies to continue to position pRED and Roche at the forefront of science in healthcare. You will work as part of a Business Partnering team to align across a global network to deliver a unified communications approach.

• Culture and change catalyst: pRED is a highly dynamic and innovative part of our Roche Pharma business that requires communications to match its needs. You will lead communications initiatives around organisational transformation and development, as well as behavioral and culture evolution across different parts of the pRED network.

• Collaborative partnership: Work in partnership with colleagues from across Roche Group Communications (GC), bringing in additional expertise from distinct ‘’Centres of Excellence’’, for example in media relations, social media or employee engagement, as well as collaborating with colleagues from the wider Pharma Communications team, to co-create world class communications.

Who you are
The ideal candidate is more than a communications specialist - they are also a business leader and someone who is deeply energised by how we develop and deliver medicines. A profound curiosity and passion for science and its role in improving healthcare is key to success in this role.

• Experience: 8+ years in scientific, technical, or corporate communications within the Pharma/Biotech or related highly regulated industries; direct experience in a science or healthcare communications environment is strongly preferred.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required (Journalism, Communications, Science, or Business); Master’s degree desirable.

• Executive influence: Proven track record of navigating matrixed environments and advising c-Suite, with the ability to challenge status quo thinking constructively.

• Operational passion: You have a genuine interest in the "how" of pharma—the science, the manufacturing, and the complexity of end-to-end processes that serve our patients.

Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) è un'organizzazione globale di app. 3.000 colleghi in sei Centri di innovazione che coprono più aree di malattia, con l'obiettivo di tradurre la scienza in farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti. All'interno di questo ambiente emozionante e dinamico, pRED Communications opera come un team di partner commerciali strategici ad alto impatto.

Siamo alla ricerca di un dinamico Senior Communications Business Partner che incarna una mentalità strategica e collaborativa. In questo ruolo, si porterà su un portafoglio diversificato di responsabilità di comunicazione attraverso il paesaggio pRED. Potrai servire come membro principale di almeno un team di Leadership pRED, implementando la tua esperienza strategica in cui è più necessario guidare i risultati aziendali e l'allineamento organizzativo.

L'opportunità

• Consulenza strategica: agire come consulente strategico per le comunicazioni di base e valutare il membro del Team Leadership per un portafoglio designato all'interno di pRED. Tradurrai la strategia aziendale in progetti di comunicazione ad alto impatto che risonano dalle panche di laboratorio alla comunità di leadership e oltre. Potrai fornire consulenza strategica ai leader senior e garantire che le comunicazioni siano integrate nel processo decisionale aziendale.

• Impatto cross-funzionale: Identificare la necessità, guidare ed eseguire strategie di comunicazione interne ed esterne per continuare a posizionare pRED e Roche all'avanguardia della scienza nel settore sanitario. Potrai lavorare come parte di un team di Business Partnering per allinearsi in una rete globale per fornire un approccio di comunicazione unificato.

• Cultura e cambiamento catalizzatore: pRED è una parte altamente dinamica e innovativa del nostro business Roche Pharma che richiede comunicazioni per soddisfare le sue esigenze. Condurrai iniziative di comunicazione intorno alla trasformazione e allo sviluppo organizzativo, nonché all'evoluzione comportamentale e culturale in diverse parti della rete pRED.

• Partenariato collaborativo: Lavorare in collaborazione con i colleghi di tutta la Roche Group Communications (GC), apportare ulteriori competenze da distinti “centri di eccellenza”, ad esempio nelle relazioni con i media, nei social media o nell’impegno dei dipendenti, oltre a collaborare con i colleghi del più ampio team di Pharma Communications, per creare comunicazioni di livello mondiale.

Chi sei
Il candidato ideale è più di uno specialista di comunicazione - sono anche un leader di affari e qualcuno che è profondamente eccitato da come sviluppiamo e forniamo farmaci. Una profonda curiosità e passione per la scienza e il suo ruolo nel miglioramento della salute è fondamentale per il successo in questo ruolo.

• Esperienza: 8+ anni di comunicazione scientifica, tecnica o aziendale all'interno delle industrie Pharma/Biotech o connesse altamente regolamentate; l'esperienza diretta in un ambiente di comunicazione scientifica o sanitaria è fortemente preferita.

• Istruzione: Corso di laurea o equivalente richiesto (Journalism, Comunicazioni, Scienza, o Business); laurea auspicabile.

• Influenza esecutiva: comprovata traccia di navigazione degli ambienti matrici e consulenza c-Suite, con la capacità di sfidare lo status quo pensando costruttivamente.

• Passione operativa: Hai un vero interesse per il "come" del farmaco, la scienza, la produzione e la complessità dei processi end-to-end che servono i nostri pazienti.

• Architetto e catalizzatore mindset: Non basta consegnare messaggi; progetta strategie di comunicazione che facilitano il cambiamento, l'impatto e favoriscono un rigoroso dibattito professionale, sia all'interno che all'esterno

In this role, you will lead on a diverse portfolio of communication responsibilities across the pRED landscape. You will serve as a core member of at least one pRED Leadership Team, deploying your strategic expertise where it is most needed to drive business outcomes and organisational alignment.

​The opportunity

• Strategic advisory: Act as a core communications strategic adviser and valued Leadership Team member for a designated portfolio within pRED. You will work as part of a Business Partnering team to align across a global network to deliver a unified communications approach.

• Culture and change catalyst: pRED is a highly dynamic and innovative part of our Roche Pharma business that requires communications to match its needs. You will lead communications initiatives around organisational transformation and development, as well as behavioral and culture evolution across different parts of the pRED network.

Who you are

• Executive influence: Proven track record of navigating matrixed environments and advising c-Suite, with the ability to challenge status quo thinking constructively.

• Operational passion: You have a genuine interest in the "how" of pharma—the science, the manufacturing, and the complexity of end-to-end processes that serve our patients.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) ist eine globale Organisation der App. 3.000 Kollegen in sechs Innovationszentren, die mehrere Krankheitsbereiche abdecken, mit dem Ziel, Wissenschaft in transformative Medikamente für Patienten zu übersetzen. In diesem spannenden und dynamischen Umfeld agiert pRED Communications als einflussreiches Team strategischer Geschäftspartner.

Wir suchen einen dynamischen Senior Communications Business Partner, der eine strategische und kollaborative Denkweise verkörpert. In dieser Rolle führen Sie ein vielfältiges Portfolio an Kommunikationsverantwortlichkeiten in der gesamten pRED-Landschaft. Sie werden als Kernmitglied von mindestens einem pRED-Führungsteam tätig sein und Ihre strategische Expertise dort einsetzen, wo sie am dringendsten benötigt wird, um Geschäftsergebnisse und organisatorische Ausrichtung zu fördern.

Die Chance

• Strategische Beratung: Handeln Sie als strategischer Berater der Kernkommunikation und geschätztes Mitglied des Führungsteams für ein bestimmtes Portfolio innerhalb von pRED. Sie werden Geschäftsstrategie in wirkungsvolle Kommunikationsblaupausen übersetzen, die von den Laborbänken bis zur Führungsgemeinschaft und darüber hinaus ankommen. Sie bieten leitenden Führungskräften strategische Beratung und stellen sicher, dass die Kommunikation in den Geschäftsentscheidungsprozess integriert wird.

• Funktionale Auswirkungen: Identifizieren Sie die Notwendigkeit, führen Sie und führen Sie sowohl interne als auch externe Kommunikationsstrategien durch, um pRED und Roche weiterhin an der Spitze der Wissenschaft im Gesundheitswesen zu positionieren. Sie arbeiten als Teil eines Business-Partnering-Teams, um sich in einem globalen Netzwerk auszurichten und einen einheitlichen Kommunikationsansatz zu liefern.

• Kultur- und Change-Katalysator: pRED ist ein hochdynamischer und innovativer Teil unseres Roche Pharma-Geschäfts, der Kommunikation benötigt, um seinen Bedürfnissen gerecht zu werden. Sie werden Kommunikationsinitiativen rund um organisatorische Transformation und Entwicklung sowie Verhaltens- und Kulturentwicklung in verschiedenen Teilen des pRED-Netzwerks leiten.

• Zusammenarbeit: Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen aus allen Bereichen der Roche Group Communications (GC), indem zusätzliches Fachwissen aus verschiedenen „Centres of Excellence, beispielsweise in den Bereichen Medienarbeit, Social Media oder Mitarbeiterengagement, sowie die Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen aus dem breiteren Pharma Communications-Team eingebracht wird, um eine erstklassige Kommunikation zu schaffen.

Wer du bist
Der ideale Kandidat ist mehr als ein Kommunikationsspezialist - er ist auch ein Wirtschaftsführer und jemand, der durch die Art und Weise, wie wir Medikamente entwickeln und liefern, stark motiviert ist. Eine tiefe Neugier und Leidenschaft für die Wissenschaft und ihre Rolle bei der Verbesserung der Gesundheitsversorgung ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg in dieser Rolle.

• Erfahrung: 8+ Jahre in der wissenschaftlichen, technischen oder Unternehmenskommunikation in der Pharma / Biotech oder verwandten stark regulierten Industrien; direkte Erfahrung in einer Wissenschafts- oder Gesundheitskommunikationsumgebung wird stark bevorzugt.

• Ausbildung: Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertig erforderlich (Journalismus, Kommunikation, Wissenschaft oder Business); Master-Abschluss wünschenswert.

• Exekutiver Einfluss: Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Navigation in matrixisierten Umgebungen und der Beratung von c-Suite mit der Fähigkeit, das konstruktive Denken des Status Quo in Frage zu stellen.

• Operationelle Leidenschaft: Sie haben ein echtes Interesse am "Wie" der Pharmaindustrie - der Wissenschaft, der Herstellung und der Komplexität von End-to-End-Prozessen, die unseren Patienten dienen.

• Architekten- und Katalysator-Mentalität: Sie liefern nicht nur Botschaften; Sie entwerfen Kommunikationsstrategien, die Veränderungen ermöglichen, Auswirkungen haben und strenge professionelle Debatten fördern, sowohl innerhalb als auch außerhalb

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Foodlicious ist unser Tagesgeschäft
Aus der Taverne Roche ist in über 30 Jahren ein erfolgreiches Gastronomieunternehmen im Bereich der Gemeinschaftsgastronomie entstanden. Die Tavero AG ist eine 100% Tochtergesellschaft der F. Hoffmann-La Roche. An den Standorten Basel und Kaiseraugst beschäftigen wir rund 350 Mitarbeitende aus über 41 Nationen.
Unser Angebot umfasst sowohl Staff Restaurants, die vielfältigen Genuss bieten, als auch Fine Dining Restaurants mit gehobener Küche und exzellentem Service. Darüber hinaus gibt es Restaurants mit Köstlichkeiten aus aller Welt, Kaffee in allen Varianten, gezaubert von unseren Baristi, sowie die höchstgelegenen Lounges der Schweiz – traumhafte Afterwork-Spots über den Dächern der Stadt. Grab'n'Go-Angebote von Sushi bis Burger und der erste und einzige Club in der Geschichte von Roche ergänzen unser Angebot.
Zusätzlich bieten wir unseren Gästen Sitzungszimmer- und Eventcatering für bis zu 1.500 Personen an. Die öffentlichen Gastronomien, das Schöpfli im Park und das Chez Jeannot im Museum Tinguely, runden unser Angebot ab.

Wir suchen per sofort eine:n Chef de Partie, Tournant für die Tavero AG in Basel.

Deine Aufgaben

• Abwechselnder Arbeitseinsatz auf allen Posten in den Betrieben Gäste- und Direktionsrestaurant Panorama, Lounge 47, Pebbels Lounge, Schöpfli und Science Club

• Termingerechte Bereitstellung und Produktion aller Angebotskomponenten

• Zubereitung nach Rezeptur, inkl. Degustation und kontinuierlichem Verbesserungsprozess

• Ideenreichtum und Kreativität sind deine Antreiber

• Du bringst die Liebe zum Beruf auf den Teller

• Selbstständiges Führen eines Postens

• Erstellen der benötigten Mise en Place und verantwortlich für den reibungslosen Ablauf auf deinem Posten

• Einhalten von Hygienebestimmungen (TQM / HACCP)

• Wirtschaftlicher und korrekter Umgang mit Lebensmittel bei der Lagerung und/sowie bei deren Verarbeitung

• Sichere Warenbewirtschaftung sowie interne und externe Bestellungen tätigen

• Arbeitszeiten in der Regel zwischen 6.00 und 22.00 Uhr, mit Ausnahmen auch Abendeinsätze möglich

Dein Profil

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene Kochausbildung (EFZ) und verfügst über mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung (exkl. Ausbildungsjahre) in der gehobenen Gastronomie

• Du hast einschlägige Erfahrungen in allen Küchenbereichen

• Du entwickelst gerne neue Rezepte und bist kreativ in der Angebotsplanung

• Du bist ein Organisationstalent und hast ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Du besitzt ein Durchsetzungsvermögen

• Du hast eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise und übernimmst Verantwortung

• Teamfähigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich

• Du hast Kenntnisse der Schweizer Lebensmittelgesetzgebung

• Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um deine Kunden kompetent beraten zu können

• In einer digitalen Welt wünschen wir uns zudem, einen sicheren Umgang mit Computerprogrammen (MS Office)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healt

• Ore lavorative di solito tra 6.00 e 22.00, con eccezioni anche serate possibili Il tuo profilo
• Hai una formazione completa di cucina (EFZ) e hai almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale (esclusi anni di formazione)
• Hai esperienza rilevante in tutte le aree della cucina
• Ti piace sviluppare nuove ricette e sono creativi nell'offerta di pianificazione
• Sei un'istituzione organizzativa e hai un forte senso di responsabilità
• Hai una capacità di esecuzione
• Avete un modo indipendente di lavorare e di assumersi la responsabilità
• Le abilità di squadra e l'affidabilità sono autoevidenti
• Conoscete la legislazione alimentare svizzera

• In un mondo digitale, vogliamo anche garantire una gestione sicura dei programmi informatici (MS Office) Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. jobs.title: Investor Relations Officer (Finance)

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste des relations avec les investisseurs (Finances)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Welcome to a highly dedicated team where you will have the unique opportunity to gain deep insight into all aspects of investor relations at a world-leading, science-driven pharmaceutical company. Our team focuses on maintaining strong relations with the capital market while offering a dynamic and fast-paced environment with ample opportunities for professional development.

As an Investor Relations Officer, your core responsibilities will be to analyze financial community expectations and market sentiment, provide vital internal performance updates, and ensure a continuous information flow to shareholders and bondholders. By doing so, you will strengthen their understanding and appreciation of Roche’s business while gaining extensive experience in internal and external communications directed at senior management and the financial community.

The Opportunity

• Financial Reporting & Presentations: Manage the preparation of quarterly results presentations for the management team with a strong focus on finance, specifically supporting the CFO, and actively participate in the preparation of the Finance Report.

• Investor & Analyst Relations: Act as a key point of contact for analysts and investors to process all finance and sustainability (ESG: Environmental, Social, Governance) related requests, while building and maintaining an internal network of subject matter experts.

• Fixed-Income Management: Lead all fixed-income related activities, which includes handling requests from bondholders, supporting the issuance of new debt, and supporting annual reviews with rating agencies in close collaboration with Group Treasury.

• Market Intelligence & Valuation: Monitor sell-side reports, contextualize consensus estimates, and maintain an internal company valuation model in close collaboration with Group Planning.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Liaise closely with Group Finance, Legal, BD, and Communications on a variety of strategic topics, such as business development, the implementation of regulatory changes, and the ad-hoc release process.

• Capital Market Events: Participate in the preparation of capital market days (e.g., Digitalization Day, Pharma Day, Diagnostics Day) by developing compelling storylines and building slide decks for individual speakers.

• IR Infrastructure: Oversee and run the day-to-day operations of the Investor Relations (IR) website and its associated digital tools.

Who You Are

• Experience & Industry Background: You bring a strong finance, accounting, or business background with at least five years of working experience at the group level of a global Pharma/Biotech company, including hands-on involvement in the quarterly and annual results review process.

• Capital Markets Expertise: You possess a deep interest in capital markets, a validated understanding of company valuations (especially within the healthcare sector), and a solid foundational understanding of accounting policies.

• Technical Skillset: You have strong proficiency in standard business tools such as Excel and PowerPoint; proficiency in specialized analytical tools like Bloomberg is considered a distinct asset.

• Communication & Articulation: You are fluent in English (both written and spoken), with German language skills being a clear advantage. You back this up with excellent interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills, enabling you to clearly explain financial value drivers and complex business concepts.

• Networking & Collaborative Spirit: You have

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Benvenuti in un team altamente dedicato dove avrete l'opportunità unica di acquisire una profonda conoscenza di tutti gli aspetti delle relazioni con gli investitori in una società farmaceutica leader mondiale. Il nostro team si concentra sul mantenimento di forti relazioni con il mercato del capitale, offrendo un ambiente dinamico e veloce con ampie opportunità di sviluppo professionale. In qualità di Investor Relations Officer, le vostre responsabilità principali saranno di analizzare le aspettative della comunità finanziaria e il sentimento di mercato, fornire aggiornamenti vitali delle prestazioni interne e garantire un flusso continuo di informazioni agli azionisti e agli obbligazionisti. Così facendo, rafforzerete la loro comprensione e apprezzamento del business di Roche, acquisendo una vasta esperienza nelle comunicazioni interne ed esterne dirette alla gestione senior e alla comunità finanziaria. L'opportunità
• Financial Reporting & Presentations: Gestire la preparazione di presentazioni trimestrali di risultati per il team di gestione con un forte focus sulla finanza, specificamente sostenere il CFO, e partecipare attivamente alla preparazione del Finance Report.
• Investor & Analyst Relations: Agire come punto chiave di contatto per analisti e investitori per elaborare tutte le richieste relative alla finanza e alla sostenibilità (ESG: Ambientale, Sociale, Governance), costruendo e mantenendo una rete interna di esperti in materia.
• Gestione dei proventi fissi: portare tutte le attività connesse a reddito fisso, che include la gestione delle richieste da parte degli obbligazionisti, sostenere l'emissione di nuovi debiti, e sostenere le recensioni annuali con agenzie di rating in stretta collaborazione con il Tesoro del Gruppo.
• Market Intelligence & Valuation: Monitorare i rapporti sul mercato, contestualizzare le stime del consenso e mantenere un modello di valutazione aziendale interno in stretta collaborazione con la Pianificazione del Gruppo.
• Collaborazione trasversale: Liaise a stretto contatto con le Finanze del Gruppo, Legale, BD e Comunicazioni su una varietà di argomenti strategici, come lo sviluppo aziendale, l'attuazione dei cambiamenti normativi e il processo di rilascio ad-hoc.
• Capital Market Events: Partecipa alla preparazione dei giorni del mercato dei capitali (ad esempio, Digitalization Day, Pharma Day, Diagnostics Day) sviluppando storie convincenti e ponti di scorrimento per i singoli diffusori.
• IR Infrastructure: supervisionare ed eseguire le operazioni quotidiane del sito Investor Relations (IR) e dei relativi strumenti digitali associati. Chi sei
• Experience & Industry Background: Lei porta una forte finanza, contabilità o background aziendale con almeno cinque anni di esperienza lavorativa a livello di gruppo di una società globale Pharma/Biotech, compreso il coinvolgimento pratico nel processo di revisione trimestrale e annuale dei risultati.
• Competenza sui mercati dei capitali: Lei possiede un profondo interesse nei mercati dei capitali, una valida comprensione delle valutazioni aziendali (soprattutto nel settore sanitario) e una solida comprensione fondamentale delle politiche contabili.
• Technical Skillset: Hai una forte competenza in strumenti di business standard come Excel e PowerPoint; la competenza in strumenti analitici specializzati come Bloomberg è considerato un bene distinto.
• Comunicazione & Articulation: Lei è fluente in inglese (sia scritto che parlato), con le competenze linguistiche tedesche è un chiaro vantaggio. Si sostiene questo con eccellenti capacità interpersonali, di presentazione e di comunicazione, consentendo di spiegare chiaramente i driver di valore finanziario e concetti aziendali complessi.
• Networking & Spirito collaborativo: Tu hai

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Willkommen in einem hoch engagierten Team, in dem Sie die einmalige Gelegenheit haben, einen tiefen Einblick in alle Aspekte der Investor Relations in einem weltweit führenden, wissenschaftsgetriebenen Pharmaunternehmen zu erhalten. Unser Team konzentriert sich auf die Aufrechterhaltung starker Beziehungen zum Kapitalmarkt und bietet ein dynamisches und schnelles Umfeld mit reichlich Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Entwicklung. Als Investor Relations Officer besteht Ihre Hauptaufgabe darin, die Erwartungen der Finanzgemeinde und die Marktstimmung zu analysieren, wichtige interne Performance-Updates bereitzustellen und einen kontinuierlichen Informationsfluss zu Aktionären und Anleihegläubigern sicherzustellen. Auf diese Weise stärken Sie ihr Verständnis und ihre Wertschätzung für das Geschäft von Roche und sammeln umfangreiche Erfahrungen in der internen und externen Kommunikation, die sich an die Geschäftsleitung und die Finanzwelt richten. Die Chance
• Finanzberichterstattung & Präsentationen: Verwalten Sie die Erstellung von vierteljährlichen Ergebnispräsentationen für das Managementteam mit einem starken Fokus auf Finanzen, insbesondere die Unterstützung des CFO, und beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an der Erstellung des Finanzberichts.
• Investor & Analyst Relations: Handeln Sie als wichtiger Ansprechpartner für Analysten und Investoren, um alle Anfragen im Zusammenhang mit Finanzen und Nachhaltigkeit (ESG: Environmental, Social, Governance) zu bearbeiten und gleichzeitig ein internes Netzwerk von Fachexperten aufzubauen und zu pflegen.
• Fixed-Income-Management: Führen Sie alle Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit Fixed-Income, einschließlich der Bearbeitung von Anfragen von Anleiheinhabern, der Unterstützung der Emission neuer Schulden und der Unterstützung jährlicher Überprüfungen mit Ratingagenturen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Group Treasury.
• Market Intelligence & Valuation: Überwachen Sie Sell-Side-Berichte, kontextualisieren Sie Konsensschätzungen und pflegen Sie ein internes Unternehmensbewertungsmodell in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Gruppenplanung.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Enge Verbindung mit Group Finance, Legal, BD und Communications zu einer Vielzahl strategischer Themen wie Geschäftsentwicklung, Umsetzung regulatorischer Änderungen und Ad-hoc-Release-Prozess.
• Capital Market Events: Beteiligen Sie sich an der Vorbereitung von Kapitalmarkttagen (z.B. Digitalization Day, Pharma Day, Diagnostics Day), indem Sie überzeugende Handlungsstränge entwickeln und Diadecks für einzelne Referenten erstellen.
• IR-Infrastruktur: Überwachen und betreiben Sie den täglichen Betrieb der Investor Relations (IR)-Website und der zugehörigen digitalen Tools. Wer du bist
• Erfahrung und Branchenhintergrund: Sie haben einen starken Finanz-, Buchhaltungs- oder Geschäftshintergrund mit mindestens fünfjähriger Berufserfahrung auf Gruppenebene eines globalen Pharma- / Biotech-Unternehmens, einschließlich einer praktischen Beteiligung am vierteljährlichen und jährlichen Ergebnisprüfungsprozess.
• Kapitalmarktexpertise: Sie haben ein großes Interesse an Kapitalmärkten, ein validiertes Verständnis der Unternehmensbewertungen (insbesondere im Gesundheitswesen) und ein solides grundlegendes Verständnis der Rechnungslegungspolitik.
• Technische Fähigkeiten: Sie verfügen über starke Kenntnisse in Standard-Business-Tools wie Excel und PowerPoint; Kenntnisse in spezialisierten Analyse-Tools wie Bloomberg gelten als eigenständiges Asset.
• Kommunikation & Artikulation: Sie sprechen fließend Englisch (sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen), wobei Deutschkenntnisse ein klarer Vorteil sind. Sie unterstützen dies mit hervorragenden zwischenmenschlichen, Präsentations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die es Ihnen ermöglichen, finanzielle Werttreiber und komplexe Geschäftskonzepte klar zu erklären.
• Networking & Collaborative Spirit: Sie haben
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Bienvenue dans une équipe très dévouée où vous aurez l'occasion unique d'acquérir une connaissance approfondie de tous les aspects des relations avec les investisseurs dans une société pharmaceutique mondialement leader, axée sur la science. Notre équipe se concentre sur le maintien de relations solides avec le marché des capitaux tout en offrant un environnement dynamique et rapide avec de nombreuses possibilités de développement professionnel. En tant qu'agent des relations avec les investisseurs, vos principales responsabilités consisteront à analyser les attentes de la communauté financière et le sentiment du marché, à fournir des mises à jour essentielles du rendement interne et à assurer un flux continu d'information aux actionnaires et aux détenteurs d'obligations. Ce faisant, vous renforcerez leur compréhension et leur appréciation des activités de Roches tout en acquérant une vaste expérience dans les communications internes et externes destinées à la haute direction et à la communauté financière. L'opportunité
• Rapports financiers et présentations : Gérer la préparation de présentations trimestrielles des résultats à l'intention de l'équipe de gestion, en mettant l'accent sur les finances, en appuyant spécifiquement le DPF, et participer activement à la préparation du rapport financier.
• Relations avec les investisseurs et les analystes : agir en tant que point de contact clé pour les analystes et les investisseurs afin de traiter toutes les demandes liées au financement et à la durabilité (ESG : environnement, social, gouvernance), tout en créant et en maintenant un réseau interne d'experts en la matière.
• Gestion des revenus fixes : Diriger toutes les activités liées aux revenus fixes, notamment le traitement des demandes des détenteurs d'obligations, l'appui à l'émission de nouvelles créances et l'appui aux examens annuels avec les agences de notation en étroite collaboration avec le Trésor du Groupe.
• Intelligence et évaluation du marché : Surveiller les rapports côté vente, contextualiser les estimations consensuelles et maintenir un modèle d'évaluation interne de l'entreprise en étroite collaboration avec la planification de groupe.
• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Assurer une liaison étroite avec le Groupe des finances, les services juridiques, le BD et les communications sur divers sujets stratégiques, comme le développement des entreprises, la mise en oeuvre de changements réglementaires et le processus de diffusion ad hoc.
• Événements sur le marché des capitaux : Participer à la préparation des journées sur le marché des capitaux (p. ex., Journée de la numérisation, Journée de la pharmacie, Journée du diagnostic) en élaborant des histoires convaincantes et en construisant des plates-formes pour les conférenciers individuels.
• Infrastructure IR : Surveiller et gérer les opérations quotidiennes du site Internet Relations Investisseurs (IR) et des outils numériques associés. Qui vous êtes
• Expérience et industrie Contexte : Vous apportez une solide expérience financière, comptable ou commerciale avec au moins cinq années d'expérience de travail au niveau du groupe d'une entreprise mondiale Pharma/Biotech, y compris la participation pratique au processus d'examen des résultats trimestriels et annuels.
• Expertise en marchés de capitaux: Vous avez un intérêt profond sur les marchés de capitaux, une compréhension validée des évaluations des entreprises (surtout dans le secteur de la santé), et une compréhension fondamentale solide des conventions comptables.
• Compétences techniques: Vous avez une solide compétence dans les outils d'affaires standard comme Excel et PowerPoint; la compétence dans les outils analytiques spécialisés comme Bloomberg est considérée comme un atout distinct.
• Communication & Articulation: Vous maîtrisez couramment l'anglais (écrit et parlé), les compétences linguistiques en allemand étant un avantage évident. Vous soutenez cela avec d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, de présentation et de communication, vous permettant d'expliquer clairement les facteurs de valeur financière et les concepts d'affaires complexes.
• Esprit de réseau et de collaboration: Vous avez

As an Intern in Roche Pharma Malaysia, you may be assigned to a variety of tasks and/or projects relevant for the assigned team/function.

The objective of assignments is for the intern to practically apply academic or vocational studies/learning in a Roche setting, as well as learn more about the Roche organization, as future employment with Roche may be a possibility subject to job availability, candidate qualification and past performance.

• Collaborating closely with field-facing and office-based colleagues to understand customer/patient/healthcare ecosystem needs as well as Roche strategies and products in the assigned disease area

• Adapting materials/assets/content from global or other countries to local context and needs

• Creating new materials/assets/content

• Support planning, project management and implementation for (digital) marketing campaigns,

• Support development of content/channel strategies and tactics​

Education & Qualifications:

• Currently pursuing a degree in a Medical, Scientific, or Biotechnology-related field (e.g., Science, Medical, Biotechnology).

jobs.title: Senior Financial Accountant - Talent Pool
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This posting is for Talent Pool purposes and may not correspond to a current vacancy with an active recruitment process. However, it reflects a role for which we regularly recruit or anticipate having openings in the near future for permanent or fixed term opportunities.

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Financial Accountant you will perform day-to-day and closing activities in cooperation with cross-functional departments, according to predefined deadlines with full ownership of their tasks and in compliance with the Process Documentations of the respective business sub-process. In this position in close collaboration with the Country Chief Accountant, you will focus on:

• Leased assets, fixed asset and CAPEX accounting activities

• Taxes, GL journals and accruals/ provisions, reconciling BS accounts

• Clearing customer accounts and bank suspense accounts, collecting direct debit, daily bank posting, posting and reconciling treasury transactions

• Calculating and issuing AR manual invoices

• Defining and calculating cost and revenue allocation in controlling

• Conducting product closing in the Material Management module of SAP

• Performing Month-end Closing and Reporting for Consolidation and for Divisions

• Preparing audit documentation and participating in internal and external audits

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:
University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• 2-4 years of experience in a relevant position

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Outstanding customer orientation and service focus

• Strong interpersonal skills and team player attitude

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance
