descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Der Patient Journey Partner (PJP) steht im Zentrum der Roche-Organisation und ist direkt dafür verantwortlich, Patienten, ihrer Gemeinschaft, dem Ökosystem und der Organisation schneller bessere Ergebnisse zu liefern. Die PJP ist eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit und das lokale Gesicht von Roche. Sie arbeitet eng mit allen Interessengruppen zusammen, die die Patientenreise (in einem bestimmten Therapie- oder Krankheitsbereich) direkt berühren, um ein tiefes Verständnis ihrer Bedürfnisse zu erlangen, um die Fähigkeiten von Roche zu verbinden und sinnvolle Lösungen zu entwickeln. Ihre Chance Der Patient Journey Partner (PJP) fungiert als vertrauenswürdiger Partner und wichtiger Ansprechpartner für Interessengruppen, die an der Oncology-Patientenreise in Sumatera beteiligt sind. Als lokales Gesicht von Roche arbeitet die PJP eng mit Gesundheitsexperten, Gesundheitseinrichtungen und funktionsübergreifenden Roche-Teams zusammen, um die Bedürfnisse von Patienten und Gesundheitssystemen besser zu verstehen und die Patientenergebnisse zu verbessern. In dieser Rolle werden Sie:
• Aufbau und Pflege starker Beziehungen zu medizinischen Fachkräften und relevanten Interessengruppen im gesamten Ökosystem des Gesundheitswesens, um die Bedürfnisse von Patienten und Gesundheitssystemen besser zu verstehen
• Entwicklung eines tiefen Verständnisses der Patientenreise, einschließlich wichtiger Herausforderungen, unerfüllter Bedürfnisse und Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Patientenversorgung und des Zugangs innerhalb des zugewiesenen therapeutischen Bereichs
• Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Roche-Teams zusammen, um Lösungen zu identifizieren, zu entwickeln und zu implementieren, die einen sinnvollen Mehrwert für Patienten, Interessengruppen und die breitere Gesundheitsgemeinschaft schaffen.
• Unterstützung der angemessenen und konformen Nutzung von Roche-Produkten durch den Austausch wissenschaftlicher und Produktinformationen in einer wahrheitsgetreuen, ausgewogenen und patientenorientierten Weise
• Führen Sie die Planung und Ausführung des Stakeholder-Engagements auf der Grundlage von Kundeninformationen, dem Verständnis der Gesundheitslandschaft und sich entwickelnden Patientenbedürfnissen
• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten für die Zusammenarbeit, die dazu beitragen, Barrieren innerhalb des Gesundheitssystems zu beseitigen und die Ergebnisse und Erfahrungen der Patienten zu verbessern
• Koordination und Mobilisierung der entsprechenden internen Expertise, Ressourcen und Unterstützung, um effektiv auf die Bedürfnisse der Stakeholder zu reagieren und gleichzeitig eine positive Erfahrung mit den Mitarbeitern, Produkten und Dienstleistungen von Roche zu gewährleisten Wer du bist Sie haben eine Leidenschaft für die Verbesserung der Patientenergebnisse und den Aufbau sinnvoller Partnerschaften im gesamten Ökosystem des Gesundheitswesens. Sie bringen eine kollaborative Denkweise, starke Stakeholder-Engagement-Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen und sich entwickelnden Gesundheitsumfeld zu navigieren. Sie bringen:
• Ein Universitätsabschluss in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Business, Economics oder einem verwandten Bereich; ein fortgeschrittener Abschluss wie ein MBA ist ein Plus
• Erfahrung im Stakeholder-Engagement in der Gesundheits-, Pharma- oder verwandten Industrie mit der Fähigkeit, vertrauenswürdige langfristige Partnerschaften aufzubauen
• Gutes Verständnis des indonesischen Gesundheitssystems und des breiteren Gesundheitsökosystems
• Kenntnisse der pharmazeutischen Industrie Vorschriften, ethischen Standards und Compliance-Anforderungen in Indonesien
• Verständnis von Patientenreisen, Behandlungswegen und Stakeholder-Dynamik im Onkologie-Bereich
• Starke Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv über mehrere Stakeholder und Funktionen zu arbeiten
• Strategisches Denken, Lernagilität und Interesse an Innovation und Gesundheitstransformation zur Verbesserung der Patientenergebnisse Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft und stellen sicher, dass heute jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le Patient Journey Partner (PJP) est au centre de l'organisation Roche, directement responsable d'obtenir de meilleurs résultats pour les patients, leur communauté, l'écosystème et l'organisation, plus rapidement. Le PJP est un leader et le visage local de Roche. Elle s'associe étroitement avec toutes les parties prenantes touchant directement le parcours du patient (dans un domaine thérapeutique ou de maladie donné), en acquérant une compréhension profonde de leurs besoins afin de relier les capacités de Roches pour co-créer des solutions significatives. Votre opportunité Le Patient Journey Partner (PJP) agit en tant que partenaire de confiance et point de contact clé pour les intervenants impliqués dans le voyage des patients en Oncologie à travers Sumatera. Face locale de Roche, le PJP travaille en étroite collaboration avec les professionnels de la santé, les établissements de santé et les équipes de Roche interfonctionnelles pour mieux comprendre les besoins des patients et du système de santé et améliorer les résultats des patients. Dans ce rôle, vous :
• Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les professionnels de la santé et les parties prenantes pertinentes de l'écosystème de la santé afin de mieux comprendre les besoins des patients et du système de santé
• Développer une compréhension approfondie du cheminement des patients, y compris les principaux défis, les besoins non satisfaits et les possibilités d'améliorer les soins aux patients et l'accès dans le domaine thérapeutique assigné
• Collaborer avec des équipes de Roche interfonctionnelles afin d'identifier, de développer et de mettre en oeuvre des solutions qui créent une valeur significative pour les patients, les intervenants et l'ensemble du milieu de la santé
• Soutenir l'utilisation appropriée et conforme des produits Roche en partageant l'information scientifique et les produits de manière honnête, équilibrée et axée sur le patient
• Planification et exécution de l'engagement des intervenants en fonction des points de vue des clients, de la compréhension du paysage des soins de santé et de l'évolution des besoins des patients
• Identifier les possibilités de collaboration qui aident à surmonter les obstacles au sein du système de santé et à améliorer les résultats et les expériences des patients
• Coordonner et mobiliser l'expertise, les ressources et le soutien internes appropriés pour répondre efficacement aux besoins des intervenants tout en assurant une expérience positive auprès des personnes, des produits et des services Roches Qui vous êtes Vous êtes passionné par l'amélioration des résultats des patients et l'établissement de partenariats significatifs dans l'ensemble de l'écosystème de santé. Vous apportez un état d'esprit collaboratif, de solides capacités d'engagement des intervenants et la capacité de naviguer dans un environnement de santé dynamique et en évolution. Vous apportez :
• Un diplôme universitaire en sciences de la vie, santé, affaires, économie, ou un domaine connexe; un diplôme avancé comme un MBA est un plus
• Expérience de l'engagement des intervenants au sein de l'industrie des soins de santé, des produits pharmaceutiques ou de l'industrie connexe, avec la capacité d'établir des partenariats de confiance à long terme
• Bonne compréhension du système de santé indonésien et de l'écosystème de soins de santé au sens large
• Connaissance des règlements de l'industrie pharmaceutique, des normes éthiques et des exigences de conformité en Indonésie
• Compréhension des parcours des patients, des voies de traitement et de la dynamique des intervenants dans la zone Oncologie
• Fortes compétences en communication et en collaboration, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement entre plusieurs intervenants et fonctions
• Pensée stratégique, agilité d'apprentissage et intérêt pour l'innovation et la transformation des soins de santé pour aider à améliorer les résultats des patients Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde sont dédiés à la promotion de la science, garantissant à tous l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are
passionate about transforming patients’ lives and we are brave in both decision and action. And we believe that good business
means a better world.

Join Our Team: Make a Difference in International Regulatory Affairs!

Roche is seeking a dynamic and highly motivated individual to join our team as an International Regulatory Affairs
Professional. We are looking for candidates who bring an innovative and creative mindset to the table, along with a proven
track record in the Regulatory Affairs field. If you are passionate about making a positive impact on global healthcare through
regulatory excellence, we invite you to be part of our dedicated team.

Key Responsibilities

As an International Regulatory Affairs Professional at Roche, you will be responsible for:

• Leading and supporting regulatory strategies for global IVD/MD instruments and software submissions

• Ensuring compliance with international regulatory requirements and standards

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including R&D, Quality, and Clinical, to drive regulatory initiatives

• Providing regulatory guidance to support product development and lifecycle management

• Staying abreast of evolving regulatory trends and up‐ dates, and implementing best practices

Requirements

• Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, or a related field

• 5 to 7 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs ( Regulatory, R&D, Quality and/or Clinical), with some experience in healthcare regulatory affairs

• In-depth knowledge of global regulatory requirements, guidelines, and procedures especially for IVD instruments & software

• Strong organizational and communication skills

• Ability to multitask and effectively manage multiple projects simultaneously

• Self-motivated and capable of working independently in a self-management environment

• Experience in IVD instrument and/or software development

Why Roche

• Collaborative and innovative work environment

• Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patients' lives globally

• Competitive compensation and benefits package

• Professional development and growth opportunities within a leading global healthcare organization

If you are a dedicated professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about contributing to the
International Regulatory Affairs landscape, we want to hear from you! Submit your resume and cover letter detailing your
relevant experience and qualifications.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are
passionate about transforming patients’ lives and we are brave in both decision and action. And we believe that good business
means a better world.

Join Our Team: Make a Difference in International Regulatory Affairs!

Roche is seeking a dynamic and highly motivated individual to join our team as an International Regulatory Affairs
Professional. We are looking for candidates who bring an innovative and creative mindset to the table, along with a proven
track record in the Regulatory Affairs field. If you are passionate about making a positive impact on global healthcare through
regulatory excellence, we invite you to be part of our dedicated team.

Key Responsibilities

As an International Regulatory Affairs Professional at Roche, you will be responsible for:

• Leading and supporting regulatory strategies for global IVD/MD instruments and software submissions

• Ensuring compliance with international regulatory requirements and standards

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including R&D, Quality, and Clinical, to drive regulatory initiatives

• Providing regulatory guidance to support product development and lifecycle management

• Staying abreast of evolving regulatory trends and up‐ dates, and implementing best practices

Requirements

• Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, or a related field

• 5 to 7 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs ( Regulatory, R&D, Quality and/or Clinical), with some experience in healthcare regulatory affairs

• In-depth knowledge of global regulatory requirements, guidelines, and procedures especially for IVD instruments & software

• Strong organizational and communication skills

• Ability to multitask and effectively manage multiple projects simultaneously

• Self-motivated and capable of working independently in a self-management environment

• Experience in IVD instrument and/or software development

Why Roche

• Collaborative and innovative work environment

• Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patients' lives globally

• Competitive compensation and benefits package

• Professional development and growth opportunities within a leading global healthcare organization

If you are a dedicated professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about contributing to the
International Regulatory Affairs landscape, we want to hear from you! Submit your resume and cover letter detailing your
relevant experience and qualifications.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position is located in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, a department within the Pharmaceutical Sciences function. We drive the non-clinical safety assessment of drug candidates from small molecules to complex biological products during the discovery and development phases at Roche.

The Opportunity

As an engaged Pathology and Applied Safety Science Hematology & Safety Biomarker Expert, you will play a pivotal role in the development, validation, and implementation of assays for translational safety assessment. Your primary responsibility will be to propose, conduct and report relevant assays to understand mechanisms of toxicity, leveraging modern tools to maximise scientific insights, drive innovation, and advance our therapeutic pipeline in a highly collaborative environment.

• Strategic Biomarker Integration & Translational Safety: Collaborate with experts to develop and execute integrated in vitro and in vivo hematology and safety biomarker strategies, provide subject matter expertise for clinical candidate selection, and deliver comprehensive safety risk assessments for regulatory documentation (e.g., IND/CTA).

• Multi-Disciplinary Laboratory Expertise: Allocate approximately 50% of working time to wet-lab work, focusing on the development and implementation of tailored in vitro and ex vivo hematology and fluid-based safety biomarker assays, as well as generating and compiling clinical pathology data (hematology, coagulation, clinical chemistry, urinalysis) for the responsible pathologist.

• Digitisation, Image Analysis, and Automation: Partner with Digital Pathology and modelling experts to develop screening assays, utilise digital and data curation platforms (e.g., LIMS, SLIMS, Arvados) to ensure streamlined data transfer and harmonised datasets, and optimise workflow integration to maximise operational efficiency.

• Vendor Management, Quality, & Compliance Outsourcing & CRO Coordination: Manage external partnerships and drive the outsourcing of relevant assays to contract research laboratories (CROs), ensuring strict adherence to timelines and data quality standards.

• Safety Standards: Maintain strict compliance with Safety, Health, and Environmental (SHE) regulations, actively fostering a culture of safe and res

La vostra responsabilità primaria sarà quella di proporre, condurre e segnalare saggi rilevanti per comprendere meccanismi di tossicità, sfruttando strumenti moderni per massimizzare le intuizioni scientifiche, guidare l'innovazione, e avanzare il nostro pipeline terapeutico in un ambiente altamente collaborativo.
• Strategic Biomarker Integration & Translational Safety: Collabora con gli esperti per sviluppare ed eseguire strategie integrate in vitro e in vivo di ematologia e biomarcazione, fornire competenze in materia per la selezione dei candidati clinici, e fornire valutazioni complete di rischio di sicurezza per la documentazione normativa (ad esempio, IND/CTA).
• Multi-Disciplinary Laboratory Expertise: Legare circa il 50% del tempo di lavoro al lavoro a lastra bagnata, concentrandosi sullo sviluppo e l'implementazione di ematologia su misura in vitro ed ex vivo e saggi biomarcatori di sicurezza basati sui fluidi, oltre a generare e compilare dati di patologia clinica (ematologia, coagulazione, chimica clinica, analisi urinaria) per il patologo responsabile.
• Digitisation, Image Analysis, and Automation: Partner con la Patologia Digitale e gli esperti di modellazione per lo sviluppo di saggi di screening, l'utilizzo di piattaforme digitali e di cura dei dati (ad esempio, LIMS, SLIMS, Arvados) per garantire il trasferimento e l'armonizzazione dei dati, e ottimizzare l'integrazione del flusso di lavoro per massimizzare l'efficienza operativa.
• Gestione del Fornitore, Qualità, & Compliance Outsourcing & CRO Coordinamento: Gestire partnership esterne e guidare l'outsourcing di saggi rilevanti ai laboratori di ricerca di contratto (CRO), garantendo una rigorosa adesione alle linee temporali e agli standard di qualità dei dati.
• Norme di sicurezza: Mantenere il rigoroso rispetto delle normative sulla sicurezza, la salute e l'ambiente (SHE), promuovendo attivamente una cultura di sicurezza e res

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires et changeantes. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, pharmacologie de la traduction et biomarqueurs —, nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain. Ce poste est situé à Pathology and Applied Safety Science, un département de la fonction Sciences pharmaceutiques. Nous conduisons l'évaluation non clinique de l'innocuité des médicaments candidats à partir de petites molécules à des produits biologiques complexes pendant les phases de découverte et de développement à Roche. L'opportunité En tant qu'expert engagé en sciences de la pathologie et de la sécurité appliquée en hématologie et en biomarqueur de sécurité, vous jouerez un rôle central dans le développement, la validation et la mise en oeuvre d'essais pour l'évaluation de la sécurité translationnelle. Votre responsabilité principale sera de proposer, de mener et de signaler des essais pertinents pour comprendre les mécanismes de toxicité, en tirant parti des outils modernes pour maximiser les connaissances scientifiques, stimuler l'innovation et faire progresser notre pipeline thérapeutique dans un environnement hautement collaboratif.
• Intégration stratégique des biomarqueurs et sécurité translationnelle : Collaborer avec des experts pour élaborer et exécuter des stratégies intégrées d'hématologie in vitro et in vivo et de biomarqueur de sécurité, fournir une expertise en la matière pour la sélection des candidats cliniques et fournir des évaluations complètes des risques liés à l'innocuité pour la documentation réglementaire (p. ex., IND/CTA).
• Expertise en laboratoire multidisciplinaire : Allouer environ 50 % du temps de travail au travail en laboratoire humide, en mettant l'accent sur l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre d'essais d'hématologie in vitro et ex vivo et de biomarqueurs de sécurité basés sur les fluides, ainsi que sur la production et la compilation de données de pathologie clinique (hématologie, coagulation, chimie clinique, analyse d'urine) pour le pathologiste responsable.
• Numérisation, analyse d'image et automatisation: partenariat avec des experts en pathologie numérique et en modélisation pour développer des tests de dépistage, utiliser des plateformes numériques et de curation des données (par exemple LIMS, SLIMS, Arvados) pour assurer un transfert simplifié des données et des ensembles de données harmonisés, et optimiser l'intégration des flux de travail pour maximiser l'efficacité opérationnelle.
• Gestion des fournisseurs, qualité et conformité L'externalisation et la coordination des CRO : Gérer les partenariats externes et orienter l'externalisation des essais pertinents vers les laboratoires de recherche (CRO), en assurant le strict respect des délais et des normes de qualité des données.

jobs.title: Digital Pathologist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position is located in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, a department within the Pharmaceutical Sciences function. We drive the non-clinical safety assessment of drug candidates from small molecules to complex biological products during the discovery and development phases at Roche.

The Opportunity

As an engaged Digital Pathologist, you will play a pivotal role in the development, validation, and implementation of pathology investigations and the application of computational pathology approaches for translational safety assessment. Your primary responsibility will be to propose, conduct, and report computational toxicologic pathology approaches to understand mechanisms of toxicity, leveraging modern tools to maximise scientific insights, drive innovation, and advance our therapeutic pipeline. You will support the automation of pathology algorithms, workflows, and platforms, remaining accountable for the scientific delivery of pathology data to inform risk assessment across projects ranging from small molecules to complex biological products.

• Core Portfolio Toxicologic Pathology : Provide expert pathology support in preclinical development, aligning toxicity study designs with current science and regulatory guidelines. Conduct qualitative and quantitative (histo)pathologic evaluations for discovery and development toxicology studies, including GLP-compliant studies. Peer-review histopathologic data and interpretations from internal or CRO pathologists per established SOPs. Integrate clinical pathology data (haematology, clinical chemistry) with histopathology findings for a holistic, mechanistic interpretation of toxicity. Deliver clear, concise test result interpretations and author pathology sections for Research Reports, regulatory filings (e.g., IND/CTA), and governance presentations.

• Algorithm Architecture & Image Analysis Deployment : Propose, build, test, and implement custom image analysis solutions and algorithms to automate cell and biomarker quantification on scanned tissue. Oversee the integration of ML and non-ML software to detect, segment, and score complex tissue morphologies. Extract high-dimensional spatial features and quantitative metrics from multiplexed or standard IHC and ISH slides. Transform comp

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti innovazione straordinaria e mutevole a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. Questa posizione si trova in Patologia e Scienze della Sicurezza Applicata, un dipartimento all'interno della funzione Scienze Farmaceutiche. Noi guidiamo la valutazione di sicurezza non ciclica dei candidati alla droga da piccole molecole a prodotti biologici complessi durante le fasi di scoperta e sviluppo a Roche. L'opportunità Come un Patologo Digitale impegnato, si svolgerà un ruolo cardine nello sviluppo, nella convalida e nell'implementazione di indagini patologiche e nell'applicazione di approcci di patologia computazionale per la valutazione della sicurezza traduttiva. La vostra responsabilità primaria sarà quella di proporre, condurre e riferire approcci di patologia tossicologica computazionale per comprendere meccanismi di tossicità, sfruttando strumenti moderni per massimizzare le intuizioni scientifiche, guidare l'innovazione e avanzare la nostra pipeline terapeutica. Sosterrete l'automazione di algoritmi di patologia, flussi di lavoro e piattaforme, rimanendo responsabili per la consegna scientifica dei dati di patologia per informare la valutazione del rischio attraverso progetti che vanno da piccole molecole a prodotti biologici complessi.
• Patologia Tossicologica Core Portfolio: Fornire un supporto di patologia esperto nello sviluppo preclinico, allineare i progetti di studio tossicologico con le attuali linee guida scientifiche e regolamentari. Condurre valutazioni qualitative e quantitative (sito)patologiche per la scoperta e lo sviluppo di studi tossicologici, compresi gli studi conformi al GLP. Peer-review dati e interpretazioni istopatologiche dai patologi interni o CRO per i SOP consolidati. Integra i dati di patologia clinica (ematologia, chimica clinica) con i risultati di istopatologia per un'interpretazione olistica e meccanistica della tossicità. Fornire chiare e concise interpretazioni dei risultati dei test e sezioni di patologia dell'autore per i Rapporti di ricerca, i documenti normativi (ad esempio, IND/CTA) e le presentazioni di governance.
• Deployment: Proporre, costruire, testare e implementare soluzioni e algoritmi di analisi delle immagini personalizzate per automatizzare la quantificazione delle celle e dei biomarcatori sui tessuti scansionati. Controllare l'integrazione di software ML e non-ML per rilevare, segmentare e segnare morfologie di tessuto complesse. Estrarre caratteristiche spaziali altamente dimensionali e metriche quantitative da multisala o standard IHC e ISH diapositive. Trasformazione comp

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position In Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organisation (pRED) stellen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten her, um einige der weltweit härtesten unerfüllten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED verbindet uns unsere Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen. An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft und Innovation ermöglicht die pRED-Organisation Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) die Entdeckung und Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Therapeutika in optimalen Dosen in relevanten Populationen mit einer Vision für die Energieübersetzung, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Genauigkeit unserer Vorhersagen und die Beschleunigung der Entwicklung von Medikamenten von morgen. Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Unsere Mission ist es, die prädiktive Genauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, Dosierungsstrategien für die richtigen Patientengruppen zu optimieren und die Entwicklung der sicheren und wirksamen Therapeutika von morgen zu beschleunigen. Diese Position befindet sich in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, einer Abteilung innerhalb der Pharmaceutical Sciences Funktion. Wir fördern die nichtklinische Sicherheitsbewertung von Wirkstoffkandidaten von kleinen Molekülen bis hin zu komplexen biologischen Produkten während der Entdeckungs- und Entwicklungsphase bei Roche. Die Chance Als engagierter Digital Pathologist spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Entwicklung, Validierung und Umsetzung von Pathologieuntersuchungen und der Anwendung von computergestützten Pathologieansätzen für die translationale Sicherheitsbewertung. Ihre Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, rechnerische toxikologische Pathologieansätze vorzuschlagen, durchzuführen und zu berichten, um die Mechanismen der Toxizität zu verstehen, indem Sie moderne Werkzeuge nutzen, um wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse zu maximieren, Innovationen voranzutreiben und unsere therapeutische Pipeline voranzutreiben. Sie unterstützen die Automatisierung von Pathologiealgorithmen, Workflows und Plattformen und bleiben für die wissenschaftliche Bereitstellung von Pathologiedaten verantwortlich, um die Risikobewertung in Projekten von kleinen Molekülen bis hin zu komplexen biologischen Produkten zu unterstützen.
• Kernportfolio Toxikologische Pathologie: Bereitstellung von Experten-Pathologie-Unterstützung bei der präklinischen Entwicklung, Ausrichtung der Toxizitätsstudien mit aktuellen wissenschaftlichen und regulatorischen Richtlinien. Durchführung qualitativer und quantitativer (histo)pathologischer Bewertungen für toxikologische Studien zur Entdeckung und Entwicklung, einschließlich GLP-konformer Studien. Peer-Review histopathologische Daten und Interpretationen von internen oder CRO-Pathologen nach etablierten SOPs. Integrieren Sie klinische Pathologiedaten (Hämatologie, klinische Chemie) mit histopathologischen Befunden für eine ganzheitliche, mechanistische Interpretation der Toxizität. Liefern Sie klare, prägnante Interpretationen der Testergebnisse und Abschnitte zur Pathologie des Autors für Forschungsberichte, behördliche Einreichungen (z. B. IND / CTA) und Governance-Präsentationen.
• Algorithm Architecture & Image Analysis Deployment: Vorschlagen, erstellen, testen und implementieren Sie benutzerdefinierte Bildanalyselösungen und Algorithmen, um die Quantifizierung von Zellen und Biomarkern auf gescanntem Gewebe zu automatisieren. Beaufsichtigen Sie die Integration von ML- und Nicht-ML-Software, um komplexe Gewebemorphologien zu erkennen, zu segmentieren und zu bewerten. Extrahieren Sie hochdimensionale räumliche Merkmale und quantitative Metriken aus gemultiplexten oder standardisierten IHC- und ISH-Objektträgern. Verwandeln comp

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
At Roche, we combine science and digital innovation to deliver life-changing medicines and diagnostics globally. Behind our success is the global Roche content and digital services Lab, a cutting-edge unit driving scalable, high-quality content production across the enterprise.

We are seeking a structured, visionary Service Delivery Lead (SDL) to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will be accountable for ensuring effective, scalable, and high-quality operational service delivery within our global Medical Writing and core content ecosystem. You will oversee operational governance across both internal teams and external vendors, ensuring our communications remain scientifically accurate, regulatory-compliant, and impactful.

The Role: What You Will Do
As an SDL, you will be the operational engine and accountable owner for day-to-day service delivery performance within your scope. You will bridge the gap between creative storytelling, medical writing expertise, and rigorous operational governance.
Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Lead Medical Writing Services: Oversee Medical Writing services, ensuring that content production perfectly aligns with therapeutic guidelines, business needs, and strict regulatory standards.

• Harmonize Workflows: Manage and streamline cross-pillar content processes and workflows between medical writing and other core digital content functions.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate closely with Compliance and Medical Affairs to maintain a perfect balance between creative brand storytelling and regulatory requirements.

• Operational Governance: Implement, monitor, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), delivery frameworks, KPIs, and SLAs to guarantee consistent and measurable service execution.

• Stakeholder & Vendor Orchestration: Serve as the central coordination point between internal Business Leads, GDH Leads, and external delivery partners to ensure structured, transparent operations.

• Drive Continuous Improvement: Analyze service performance data, monitor metrics, identify inefficiencies, and execute structured improvement initiatives using defined governance frameworks.

• Future-Ready Innovation: Ensure cost-conscious, scalable delivery models while actively driving the adoption of modern technologies—including GenAI where applicable—to maximize efficiency.

• Capacity & Incident Management: Coordinate operational capacity planning for workload balance, and manage service incidents or escalations with rigorous root-cause follow-up.

• Collaboration with business partners in Switzerland, this position is based in Malaysia will need to work flexible hours . Occasionally—though not regularly—need to work during Malaysian evening hours.

Who You Are
You thrive within structured governance environments and are highly comfortable balancing operational oversight with executive stakeholder alignment. You are an expert at anticipating risks, addressing delivery challenges proactively, and championing a culture of continuous service improvement. Process integrity, performance transparency, and service consistency are at the core of how you operate.

Your Experience & Background

• 7–10 years of relevant experience in service delivery management, operational governance, or structured digital/content operations environments (corporate or agency setting).

• A strong, demonstrated background in the delivery of medical writing services , with personal experience as a medical writer consider

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
At Roche, we combine science and digital innovation to deliver life-changing medicines and diagnostics globally. Behind our success is the global Roche content and digital services Lab, a cutting-edge unit driving scalable, high-quality content production across the enterprise.

We are seeking a structured, visionary Service Delivery Lead (SDL) to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will be accountable for ensuring effective, scalable, and high-quality operational service delivery within our global Medical Writing and core content ecosystem. You will oversee operational governance across both internal teams and external vendors, ensuring our communications remain scientifically accurate, regulatory-compliant, and impactful.

The Role: What You Will Do
As an SDL, you will be the operational engine and accountable owner for day-to-day service delivery performance within your scope. You will bridge the gap between creative storytelling, medical writing expertise, and rigorous operational governance.
Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Lead Medical Writing Services: Oversee Medical Writing services, ensuring that content production perfectly aligns with therapeutic guidelines, business needs, and strict regulatory standards.

• Harmonize Workflows: Manage and streamline cross-pillar content processes and workflows between medical writing and other core digital content functions.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate closely with Compliance and Medical Affairs to maintain a perfect balance between creative brand storytelling and regulatory requirements.

• Operational Governance: Implement, monitor, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), delivery frameworks, KPIs, and SLAs to guarantee consistent and measurable service execution.

• Stakeholder & Vendor Orchestration: Serve as the central coordination point between internal Business Leads, GDH Leads, and external delivery partners to ensure structured, transparent operations.

• Drive Continuous Improvement: Analyze service performance data, monitor metrics, identify inefficiencies, and execute structured improvement initiatives using defined governance frameworks.

• Future-Ready Innovation: Ensure cost-conscious, scalable delivery models while actively driving the adoption of modern technologies—including GenAI where applicable—to maximize efficiency.

• Capacity & Incident Management: Coordinate operational capacity planning for workload balance, and manage service incidents or escalations with rigorous root-cause follow-up.

• Collaboration with business partners in Switzerland, this position is based in Malaysia will need to work flexible hours . Occasionally—though not regularly—need to work during Malaysian evening hours.

Who You Are
You thrive within structured governance environments and are highly comfortable balancing operational oversight with executive stakeholder alignment. You are an expert at anticipating risks, addressing delivery challenges proactively, and championing a culture of continuous service improvement. Process integrity, performance transparency, and service consistency are at the core of how you operate.

Your Experience & Background

• 7–10 years of relevant experience in service delivery management, operational governance, or structured digital/content operations environments (corporate or agency setting).

• A strong, demonstrated background in the delivery of medical writing services , with personal experience as a medical writer consider

titleByLocale.it: Piombo di Farmacologia Clinica - Principale Scienziato

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

Within the Clinical Pharmacology Section in the Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology Department, this position operates globally, is deeply embedded within cross-functional matrix project teams and can support multiple of Roche's focus disease areas (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology).

The Opportunity

In this role, you will lead the scientific advancement of clinical programs by serving as the core quantitative and clinical pharmacology lead within cross-functional project teams. You will drive all aspects of Clinical Pharmacology (CP) across all development phases and strategically apply Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) approaches to optimise trial designs, justify dose selections, inform development decisions and mitigate risks across both early and late-stage development. Your scope will be modality-agnostic, giving you oversight that spans small molecules, large molecules, and novel platforms.

• Strategic & Quantitative Plan Execution: Actively contribute to the development of clinical development strategies, including the design of clinical trials and lead the development, implementation, and execution of the Clinical Pharmacology and MIDD strategies for assigned assets across all development phases. Translate Clinical Pharmacology principles into predictive models that guide dose/regimen selection, drug-drug interactions (DDI), special population strategies, pediatric extrapolations and geographic/ethnic bridging.

• Modelling & Simulation Mastery: Apply pharmacometric methodologies (such as population PK/PD, PBPK, or QSP) to perform clinical trial simulations, characterise exposure-response relationships, and define quantitative criteria for early, data-driven go/no-go decisions. You bring proficiency in pharmacometric software (e.g., NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB).

• Regulatory & Asset Maximisation: Lead the CP sections of major regulatory documents (including IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Ensure high-quality, fit-for-purpose submission documents using Roche initiatives like lean development authoring and digital submission excellence. Represent the company as a subject matter expert in health authority interactions.

• Business Development: Provide clinical and quantitative pharmacology exp

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti innovazione straordinaria e mutevole a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. All'interno della Sezione Farmacologia Clinica nel Dipartimento di Farmacologia Clinica Quantitativa, questa posizione opera a livello globale, è profondamente incorporata all'interno di team di progetto di matrice multifunzionale e può supportare più aree di malattia di fuoco di Roche (CVRM, Immunologia, Neuroscienze, Oncologia e Oftalmologia). L'opportunità In questo ruolo, si porterà l'avanzamento scientifico dei programmi clinici servendo come il nucleo quantitativo e farmacologia clinica piombo all'interno di team di progetto interfunzionali. Potrai guidare tutti gli aspetti della Farmacologia Clinica (CP) in tutte le fasi di sviluppo e applicare strategicamente Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) approcci per ottimizzare i progetti di prova, giustificare le selezioni di dose, informare le decisioni di sviluppo e mitigare i rischi sia all'inizio che al tardo stadio di sviluppo. Il vostro scopo sarà la modalità-agnostica, dando la supervisione che abbraccia piccole molecole, grandi molecole, e nuove piattaforme.
• Strategic & Quantitative Plan Execution: contribuisce attivamente allo sviluppo di strategie di sviluppo clinico, tra cui la progettazione di studi clinici e condurre lo sviluppo, l'implementazione e l'esecuzione delle strategie di Farmacologia Clinica e MIDD per le attività assegnate in tutte le fasi di sviluppo. Traduci i principi clinici di Farmacologia in modelli predittivi che guidano la selezione di dosi / regimi, interazioni farmaco-droga (DDI), strategie di popolazione speciali, estrapolazioni pediatrico e ponteggio geografico / etnico.
• Modellazione & Simulazione Mastery: Applicare metodologie farmacometriche (come la popolazione PK/PD, PBPK o QSP) per eseguire simulazioni di prova clinica, caratterizzare le relazioni di esposizione-risposta e definire criteri quantitativi per le decisioni di go/no-go iniziali e data-driven. Porti la competenza nel software farmacometrico (ad esempio, NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB).
• Regolazione & Asset Maximization: Guidare le sezioni CP dei principali documenti normativi (compresi IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Assicurare documenti di presentazione fit-for-purpose di alta qualità utilizzando iniziative Roche come l'autore magra dello sviluppo e l'eccellenza della presentazione digitale. Rappresentare l'azienda come esperto di materia in interazioni dell'autorità sanitaria.
• Sviluppo aziendale: fornire analisi farmacologiche cliniche e quantitative

Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen. An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft und Innovation ermöglicht die pRED-Organisation Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) die Entdeckung und Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Therapeutika in optimalen Dosen in relevanten Populationen mit einer Vision für die Energieübersetzung, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Genauigkeit unserer Vorhersagen und die Beschleunigung der Entwicklung von Medikamenten von morgen. Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Unsere Mission ist es, die prädiktive Genauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, Dosierungsstrategien für die richtigen Patientengruppen zu optimieren und die Entwicklung der sicheren und wirksamen Therapeutika von morgen zu beschleunigen. Innerhalb der Sektion Klinische Pharmakologie in der Abteilung Quantitative Klinische Pharmakologie ist diese Position weltweit tätig, tief in funktionsübergreifende Matrix-Projektteams eingebettet und kann mehrere Schwerpunktbereiche von Roche unterstützen (CVRM, Immunologie, Neurowissenschaften, Onkologie und Ophthalmologie). Die Chance In dieser Rolle werden Sie die wissenschaftliche Weiterentwicklung der klinischen Programme führen, indem Sie als Hauptleiter der quantitativen und klinischen Pharmakologie in funktionsübergreifenden Projektteams fungieren. Sie werden alle Aspekte der klinischen Pharmakologie (CP) über alle Entwicklungsphasen hinweg vorantreiben und MIDD-Ansätze strategisch anwenden, um Studiendesigns zu optimieren, Dosisauswahlen zu rechtfertigen, Entwicklungsentscheidungen zu treffen und Risiken sowohl in der frühen als auch in der späten Entwicklungsphase zu mindern. Ihr Umfang wird modalitätsunabhängig sein und Ihnen einen Überblick über kleine Moleküle, große Moleküle und neuartige Plattformen geben.
• Strategische und quantitative Planausführung: Tragen Sie aktiv zur Entwicklung klinischer Entwicklungsstrategien bei, einschließlich der Gestaltung klinischer Studien, und leiten Sie die Entwicklung, Implementierung und Durchführung der klinischen Pharmakologie- und MIDD-Strategien für zugewiesene Vermögenswerte in allen Entwicklungsphasen. Klinische Pharmakologie Prinzipien in prädiktive Modelle zu übersetzen, die Dosis / Regime-Selektion, Arzneimittel-Wechselwirkungen (DDI), spezielle Populationsstrategien, pädiatrische Extrapolationen und geographische / ethnische Brücken führen.
• Modellierung und Simulationsbeherrschung: Wenden Sie pharmakometrische Methoden (wie Populations-PK/PD, PBPK oder QSP) an, um klinische Studiensimulationen durchzuführen, Expositions-Wirkungs-Beziehungen zu charakterisieren und quantitative Kriterien für frühe, datengesteuerte Go/No-Go-Entscheidungen zu definieren. Sie verfügen über Kenntnisse in pharmakometrischer Software (z. B. NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB).
• Regulatory & Asset Maximierung: Führen Sie die CP-Abschnitte der wichtigsten regulatorischen Dokumente (einschließlich IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Sicherstellung hochwertiger, zweckgerechter Einreichungsdokumente unter Verwendung von Roche-Initiativen wie Lean Development Authoring und Digital Submission Excellence. Repräsentieren Sie das Unternehmen als Fachexperte für Interaktionen mit Gesundheitsbehörden.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation Recherche Pharmaceutique et Développement Débutal (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformateurs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires et changeantes. A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité de la traduction, pharmacologie de la traduction et biomarqueurs —, nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer continuellement la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des thérapies sûres et efficaces de demain. Au sein de la Section de pharmacologie clinique du Département de pharmacologie clinique quantitative, ce poste fonctionne à l'échelle mondiale, est profondément ancré dans les équipes de projets de matrices interfonctionnelles et peut soutenir plusieurs des domaines d'intervention de Roche (CVRM, immunologie, neuroscience, oncologie et ophtalmologie). L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez l'avancement scientifique des programmes cliniques en servant de chef de file en pharmacologie quantitative et clinique au sein des équipes de projets interfonctionnelles. Vous dirigerez tous les aspects de la pharmacologie clinique (PC) dans toutes les phases de développement et appliquerez stratégiquement des approches de développement de médicaments en connaissance de cause (PDIM) pour optimiser les conceptions d'essais, justifier la sélection des doses, éclairer les décisions de développement et atténuer les risques au début et à la fin du développement. Votre portée sera agnostique de modalité, vous donnant une surveillance qui couvre de petites molécules, de grandes molécules et de nouvelles plateformes.
• Exécution du plan stratégique et quantitatif : Contribuer activement à l'élaboration de stratégies de développement clinique, y compris la conception d'essais cliniques et diriger l'élaboration, la mise en oeuvre et l'exécution des stratégies de pharmacologie clinique et de MIDD pour les actifs attribués à toutes les phases de développement. Traduire les principes de pharmacologie clinique en modèles prédictifs qui guident la sélection des doses/régimes, les interactions médicamenteuses (DDI), les stratégies démographiques spéciales, les extrapolations pédiatriques et les transitions géographiques/ethniques.
• Modélisation et maîtrise de la simulation : Appliquer des méthodologies pharmacométriques (telles que PK/PD, PBPK ou QSP) pour effectuer des simulations d'essais cliniques, caractériser les relations exposition-réponse et définir des critères quantitatifs pour les décisions d'aller/de ne pas aller fondées sur les données. Vous apportez des compétences en logiciel pharmacométrique (p. ex. NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB).
• Maximisation de la réglementation et des actifs : Diriger les sections du CP des principaux documents réglementaires (y compris IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Veiller à ce que des documents de présentation de haute qualité et adaptés à l'usage soient utilisés à l'aide d'initiatives Roche comme l'auteur de développement maigre et l'excellence de la soumission numérique. Représenter l'entreprise en tant qu'expert en matière d'interactions avec les autorités sanitaires.

jobs.title: Clinical Pharmacology Lead - Principal Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

Within the Clinical Pharmacology Section in the Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology Department, this position operates globally, is deeply embedded within cross-functional matrix project teams and can support multiple of Roche's focus disease areas (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology).

The Opportunity

In this role, you will lead the scientific advancement of clinical programs by serving as the core quantitative and clinical pharmacology lead within cross-functional project teams. You will drive all aspects of Clinical Pharmacology (CP) across all development phases and strategically apply Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) approaches to optimise trial designs, justify dose selections, inform development decisions and mitigate risks across both early and late-stage development. Your scope will be modality-agnostic, giving you oversight that spans small molecules, large molecules, and novel platforms.

• Strategic & Quantitative Plan Execution: Actively contribute to the development of clinical development strategies, including the design of clinical trials and lead the development, implementation, and execution of the Clinical Pharmacology and MIDD strategies for assigned assets across all development phases. Translate Clinical Pharmacology principles into predictive models that guide dose/regimen selection, drug-drug interactions (DDI), special population strategies, pediatric extrapolations and geographic/ethnic bridging.

• Modelling & Simulation Mastery: Apply pharmacometric methodologies (such as population PK/PD, PBPK, or QSP) to perform clinical trial simulations, characterise exposure-response relationships, and define quantitative criteria for early, data-driven go/no-go decisions. You bring proficiency in pharmacometric software (e.g., NONMEM, R, SimCyp, MATLAB).

• Regulatory & Asset Maximisation: Lead the CP sections of major regulatory documents (including IB, IND, PIP, PSP, NDA, BLA). Ensure high-quality, fit-for-purpose submission documents using Roche initiatives like lean development authoring and digital submission excellence. Represent the company as a subject matter expert in health authority interactions.

• Business Development: Provide clinical and quantitative pharmacology exp

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position sits within the Clinical Pharmacology Section in the Quantitative Clinical Pharmacology Department in pRED / Pharmaceutical Sciences, but maintains a company-wide footprint. The scope of influence transcends individual teams, regularly partnering across major organisational boundaries and cross-entities (e.g., pRED, gRED, PDR) to shape institutional knowledge.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will serve as a senior enterprise leader and expert in Clinical Pharmacology, including Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) and Quantitative Medicine, solving high-risk development challenges and embedding advanced computational capabilities to accelerate the R&D pipeline. Operating on a senior strategic and scientific track, you will hold high accountability for shaping long-term scientific and development strategies and capital allocation for entire disease areas or global functions. Additionally, you will drive high-stakes corporate due diligence for licensing opportunities, lead complex global health authority negotiations, and act as a strategic mentor across the wider organisation.

• High-Impact Strategic and Scientific Leadership : Formulate and evolve overarching Clinical Pharmacology and MIDD strategies for high-profile molecules or portfolio segments (e.g. Antibody-Drug-Conjugates) of Roche's focus disease areas (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology), ensuring alignment with end-to-end development goals.

• Pioneering Technical Innovation : Identify, develop, and integrate state-of-the-art computational methodologies into workflows, stimulating the broader scientific community to experiment and challenge development paradigms.

• Complex Submissions & Regulatory Defence : Provide authoritative guidance on highly complex or unprecedented submission strategies (e.g., pediatric extrapolations, novel modalities) and serve as a primary counter-partner to health authorities and KOLs.

• Strategic Business Development : Lead Clinical Pharmacology and modelling evaluations and actively contribute to the development of Clinical Development Plans for high-stakes due diligence, in-licensing, and out-licensing opportunities to assess the path to value as well as the technical viability and risks of external

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti innovazione straordinaria e mutevole a velocità. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. Questa posizione si trova all'interno della Sezione Farmacologia Clinica nel Dipartimento di Farmacologia Clinica Quantitativa in Scienze pRED / Farmaceutiche, ma mantiene un'impronta aziendale. La portata dell'influenza trascende i singoli team, collaborando regolarmente tra i principali confini organizzativi e le intersezioni (ad esempio, pRED, gRED, PDR) per plasmare le conoscenze istituzionali. L'opportunità In questo ruolo, si servirà come leader di impresa senior e esperto in Farmacologia Clinica, tra cui Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) e Quantitative Medicine, risolvendo sfide di sviluppo ad alto rischio e incorporando capacità computazionali avanzate per accelerare la pipeline R&D. Operando su una traccia strategica e scientifica senior, si terrà alta responsabilitÃ per la definizione di strategie scientifiche e di sviluppo a lungo termine e allocazione di capitale per intere aree di malattia o funzioni globali. Inoltre, guiderai le due diligence aziendali ad alto livello per le opportunità di licenza, guiderai negoziazioni di autorità sanitarie globali complesse e agirai come mentore strategico in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Leadership strategica e scientifica di alto impatto: formulare ed evolvere le strategie cliniche di farmacologia e MIDD per le molecole di alto profilo o segmenti di portafoglio (ad esempio Antibody-Drug-Conjugates) delle aree di malattia di punta di Roche (CVRM, Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology e Ophthalmology), garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi di sviluppo end-to-end.
• Identificare, sviluppare e integrare metodologie computazionali all'avanguardia nei flussi di lavoro, stimolando la più ampia comunità scientifica a sperimentare e sfidare i paradigmi dello sviluppo.
• Submissions & Regulatory Defence: Fornire una guida autorevole su strategie di presentazione altamente complesse o senza precedenti (ad esempio, estrapolazioni pediatriche, nuove modalità) e servire come contro-partner primario alle autorità sanitarie e KOL.
• Sviluppo Strategico delle Imprese: Lead Clinical Pharmacology and modelling assessments e contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo di Piani di Sviluppo Clinico per un elevato fabbisogno di diligenza, in-licenziamento e opportunità per la valutazione del percorso di valore, nonché la fattibilità tecnica e i rischi di esterna

Dans le cadre d'une démarche stratégique et scientifique de haut niveau, vous serez fortement responsable de l'élaboration de stratégies scientifiques et de développement à long terme et de l'affectation des capitaux pour l'ensemble des domaines de maladie ou des fonctions mondiales. De plus, vous dirigerez une diligence raisonnable de l'entreprise pour les possibilités d'octroi de licences, dirigerez des négociations complexes sur les autorités sanitaires mondiales et agirez comme un mentor stratégique dans toute l'organisation.
• Leadership stratégique et scientifique à haut impact : Formuler et développer des stratégies globales de pharmacologie clinique et de MIDD pour les molécules ou les segments de portefeuille à haut rayonnement (p. ex. anticorps-drogue-conjugués) des domaines d'intervention de Roche (CVRM, immunologie, neuroscience, oncologie et ophtalmologie), en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs de développement de bout en bout.
• Innovation technique pionnière : Identifier, développer et intégrer des méthodologies informatiques de pointe dans les flux de travail, en stimulant la communauté scientifique à expérimenter et à défier les paradigmes de développement.
• Soumissions complexes et défense réglementaire : Fournir des lignes directrices faisant autorité sur les stratégies de présentation très complexes ou sans précédent (p. ex. extrapolations pédiatriques, nouvelles modalités) et servir de principal contre-partenaire aux autorités de la santé et aux KOL.
• Développement stratégique des affaires : Diriger les évaluations de la pharmacologie clinique et de la modélisation et contribuer activement à l'élaboration de plans de développement clinique pour la diligence raisonnable élevée, l'octroi de licences et les possibilités de sous-licence pour évaluer la voie de la valeur ainsi que la viabilité technique et les risques de l'extérieur
