jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Como Estagiário de Engenharia - Customer Experience, você integrará a equipe de atendimento ao cliente, oferecendo suporte vital às operações diárias. Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para aplicar seus conhecimentos técnicos e causar um impacto positivo na experiência dos nossos clientes.

A Oportunidade:

• Você realiza o cadastro de peças e a consolidação de informações em planilhas de Excel.

• Você fornece suporte essencial ao time de especialistas de campo e interage constantemente com a equipe.

• Você controla e afere instrumentos e ferramentas utilizadas nas operações.

• Você atua no controle de modificações e gerencia as manutenções preventivas.

• Você monitora os casos de preparação do local ( site preparation ), bem como os processos de instalação e desinstalação.

• Você oferece suporte na utilização das ferramentas ASA, Online Support e cobas link.

• Você presta suporte presencial ( on site ) de forma proativa aos clientes da sua base.

Quem você é:

• Você tem previsão de conclusão de curso acadêmico a partir de 2028 e manterá vínculo ativo com a instituição de ensino durante todo o período.

• Você tem disponibilidade para estagiar de 1 a 2 anos, com uma carga horária de 6 horas diárias.

• Você possui conhecimento técnico/científico na área e demonstra um raciocínio analítico, lógico e focado.

• Você tem conhecimento, no mínimo intermediário, do pacote Windows Office.

• Você é proativo, demonstra grande interesse em aprender e mantém uma postura atenta e cuidadosa em suas atividades.

• Você constrói um bom relacionamento com todas as áreas e valoriza fortemente o trabalho em equipe.

• Você não se importa em lidar com demandas de rotina operacional e se adapta bem a elas.

Desejável:

• Você possui conhecimento de inglês em nível intermediário.

*Benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about people, communication, and making a real difference in a global organization? If you excel at coaching, building relationships, and solving complex problems, we want you! Join our People Support Solutions team as a Talent Acquisition Partner and leverage your expertise in human interaction to launch a career in global talent acquisition.

The Opportunity:

• Launch your career in Talent Acquisition by learning to manage the full recruiting lifecycle within a supportive global team.

• Act as a key communication partner for hiring managers and senior leaders, applying your coaching and interpersonal skills to guide them through the hiring process.

• Learn to conduct in-depth candidate assessments , focusing on evaluating core competencies and fit.

• Manage and optimize the candidate experience , ensuring clear, consistent communication from application to offer.

• Utilize advanced HR technology (Workday) to streamline recruiting activities and support crucial data management.

• Collaborate closely on internal talent management efforts, including succession planning and internal mobility, applying a strategic lens to organizational needs.

• Contribute to process innovation , helping us challenge the status quo and continuously improve our talent search strategies.

Who You Are:

• Advanced language skills in German and English (both written and spoken) are mandatory.

• 2-3 years of experience in end-to-end recruitment

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Life Science or equivalent work experience is required

• You possess a strong customer-centric, growth, and agile mindset , thriving in ambiguous and multicultural environments.

• You demonstrate proven stakeholder management and influencing skills , with the ability to manage expectations and build trust with diverse partners.

• You are capable of working independently , effectively managing multiple, competing priorities, and driving toward results with a positive attitude.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Customer Partner, you will be responsible for growing the market share and achieving sales goals for the assigned territory. You will be responsible for executing the sales process, ensure operation effectiveness and efficiency, with proficient interpersonal and communication skills, and providing effective solutions to establish and maintain relationships that result in customer satisfaction, retention and acquisition.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

Territory coverage: Central + Negeri Sembilan
Primary work location: Central - based

In this role, you will

• Lead the complete sales process including prospecting, qualification, closing, contracting, implementation, and ensuring high-standard after-sales support through solution/consultative selling.

• Build long-term, value-based customer relationships by continuously uncovering changing needs, improving customer experience, and adding value through creative solutions.

• Establish credibility with stakeholders by demonstrating business acumen, professional expertise, and adapting one's communication style to align with customers' working styles.

• Drive business development by identifying, developing, retaining, extending, and acquiring accounts, and collaborating across teams to attain objectives.

• Strategize for growth by developing and implementing annual territorial plans to achieve sales goals and future growth, and profiling accounts to position RDMY strongly to win tenders.

• Maintain data integrity in REXIS Salesforce by regularly updating accounts/contacts, and ensuring weekly entry and monitoring of activities and business opportunities.

• Support sales execution with technical proficiency, including conducting basic troubleshooting and using the Global Deal Calculator (GDC) to prepare sales proposals, along with participation in relevant marketing events.

Any other tasks or projects as assigned from time to time.

Who you are

• Strong client-facing skills including communication, negotiation, and influencing.

• Highly efficient and results-driven, demonstrating strong critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.

• Commercial awareness and product knowledge, plus the ability to be a team player who thrives and collaborates in a cross-functional, fast-changing environment.

• Required education is a Bachelor or Master Degree in Health/Science/Medical disciplines (Tertiary qualification in Science and Business focus is desired), preferably with at least one year of related industry experience.

• High technical ability and computer literacy are required, along with a valid Malaysian driver’s license and the ability to travel interstate; IT, people management, marketing, and business development experience are beneficial.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
As the AI Product Manager, you will lead the strategic development and implementation guidance of AI & Digital empowered solutions, ensuring strict alignment with business objectives. You will drive the delivery of key initiatives including DPMM (Digital Patient Monitoring and Management), PLM (Patient-Like-Me), Content Generation, and Research Solutions. Success in this position requires partnering closely with Medical Affairs, Customer Engagement (CE), and Access teams to foster strategic synergy and ensure the seamless execution of these digital innovations.

Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Strategic Planning & Lifecycle Management Develop and execute a long-term strategic plan for the assigned AI & Digital empowered solutions (e.g., DPMM, PLM, Content Generation, or Research Solutions) that aligns with the organization’s overall business goals.
a) Market Intelligence: Conduct regular analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and threats within the data-driven product management and marketing landscape.
b) Roadmap & Implementation: Provide strategic guidance to cross-functional teams on the deployment of digital solutions; develop and maintain a phased roadmap to ensure structured execution and scalability.
c) Partnership Management: Establish and nurture relationships with external partners—including data providers, technology vendors, and industry experts—to leverage external capabilities and accelerate innovation.
d) Continuous Improvement: Create a systematic mechanism for the ongoing review and optimization of strategies, processes, and product performance across the solution lifecycle.

2. Scientific Leadership & Ecosystem Engagement Reinforce Roche’s position as a scientific leader in the increasingly competitive and evolving Innovative Healthcare Solution landscape.
a) Ecosystem Collaboration: Leverage internal expertise while fostering collaborations with key players in the external AI & Digital Innovation ecosystem to demonstrate scientific value and address stakeholder needs.
b) Value Communication: Ensure the medical and scientific value of the digital solutions is effectively communicated and recognized by the healthcare system, leveraging existing medical team expertise and stakeholder networks.

3. Governance, Compliance & Risk Management Ensure strict adherence to corporate policies, SOPs, and local regulations across all initiatives.
a) Medical Governance: Uphold high standards of scientific and medical compliance, ensuring a balanced framework for risk/benefit management specifically tailored to digital health innovations.
b) Regulatory Adherence: Guarantee that all initiatives strictly comply with Roche’s SOPs, codes of conduct, and local regulatory requirements throughout the product lifecycle.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
1. Bachelor’s degree or above in life sciences, medicine, or data science, i.e. an MBA, or equivalent combination of scientific and business education/experience is helpful, such as strategy consulting experience
2. >2 years’ experience in medical affairs, marketing, business development, digital innovation in multinational company
Leadership Competencies
1. Strategic agility
2. Technical and business expertise
3. Inspiring and influencing
4. Teamwork and collaboration
5. Experienced strategic thinking and planning skills.
6. Demonstrated ability in cross-functional leadership, cross-industry and ecosystem leadership

Job Req

Strategic Planning & Lifecycle Management Sviluppare ed eseguire un piano strategico a lungo termine per le soluzioni abilitate AI & Digital (ad esempio, DPMM, PLM, Content Generation, o Research Solutions) che si allineano con gli obiettivi aziendali globali dell'organizzazione. a) Market Intelligence: condurre analisi regolari per identificare tendenze, opportunità e minacce all'interno della gestione dei prodotti e del paesaggio di marketing. b) Roadmap & Implementation: Fornire indicazioni strategiche per i team interfunzionali sull'implementazione di soluzioni digitali; sviluppare e mantenere una roadmap graduale per garantire l'esecuzione strutturata e la scalabilità. c) Partnership Management: Stabilire e nutrire relazioni con partner esterni, inclusi fornitori di dati, fornitori di tecnologia e esperti del settore, per sfruttare le capacità esterne e accelerare l'innovazione. d) Miglioramento continuo: creare un meccanismo sistematico per la revisione e l'ottimizzazione in corso di strategie, processi e prestazioni del prodotto attraverso il ciclo di vita della soluzione. 2. Leadership scientifica & Ecosystem Engagement Rinforzare la posizione di Roche come leader scientifico nel sempre più competitivo e in evoluzione Innovative Healthcare Solution landscape. a) Ecosystem Collaboration: Leverage competenze interne, promuovendo collaborazioni con attori chiave nell'ecosistema esterno AI & Digital Innovation per dimostrare valore scientifico e soddisfare le esigenze degli stakeholder. b) Comunicazione di valore: Assicurare il valore medico e scientifico delle soluzioni digitali è efficacemente comunicato e riconosciuto dal sistema sanitario, sfruttando le competenze del team medico esistente e le reti di stakeholder. 3. Governance, Compliance & Risk Management Assicurare una stretta adesione alle politiche aziendali, alle SOP e alle normative locali in tutte le iniziative. a) Governance medica: Mantenere elevati standard di conformità scientifica e medica, assicurando un quadro equilibrato per la gestione dei rischi/benefici specificamente adattato alle innovazioni sanitarie digitali. b) Aderenza normativa: garantire che tutte le iniziative rispettino rigorosamente le SOP di Roche, i codici di condotta e i requisiti normativi locali durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Qualificazione ed esperienza Formazione
• Qualifiche 1. Corso di laurea o superiore in scienze della vita, medicina, o scienza dei dati, cioè un MBA, o combinazione equivalente di formazione scientifica e aziendale / esperienza è utile, come l'esperienza di consulenza strategica 2. > 2 anni di esperienza in affari medici, marketing, sviluppo aziendale, innovazione digitale in multinazionale Competenze di leadership 1. Agilità strategica 2. Competenze tecniche e aziendali 3. Ispirare e influenzare 4. Lavoro di squadra e collaborazione 5. Esperienza di pensiero strategico e capacità di pianificazione. 6. Capacità dimostrata nella leadership interfunzionale, cross-industry e nella leadership dell'ecosistema Lavoro richiesto

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Position Summary: The Senior Product Managerfor New Product Launch acts as the "strategic architect" and "commercial driver" for upcoming innovative drugs, new indications, or core medical devices in the pipeline. This role is responsible for defining the product’s core value proposition, developing the cross-functional Go-to-Market strategy, building strong scientific advocacy among Top KOLs, and empowering the field force. The ultimate goal is to ensure a compliant, high-impact, and commercially successful market entry and accelerated post-launch uptake.

1. Pre-Launch Market Insight & Strategic Positioning

• Clinical & Unmet Need Assessment: Conduct deep dives into medical literature, clinical trial data, and treatment guidelines to identify target patient profiles and critical unmet medical needs.

• Core Value Proposition : Translate complex clinical and evidence-based medical data into compelling, differentiated, and compliant brand stories and product positioning.

• Competitive Intelligence: Monitor competitors’ clinical pipelines, pricing structures, and marketing activities to develop effective defense and counter-attack strategies.
2. Go-to-Market & Access Strategy Development

• Brand Plan Ownership: Design and execute the 1-to-3-year strategic and tactical Brand Plans for the product launch, effectively allocating the Marketing Budget to maximize ROI.

• Cross-Functional Synergy: * Partner with the Medical Affairs team to align on post-launch evidence generation, Investigator-Initiated Trials, or Real-World Studies.Collaborate with the Market Access team to provide pharmacoeconomic data supporting National Reimbursement Drug List (NRDL) negotiation and provincial bidding.

• Omnichannel Marketing (OCM): Develop and implement a digital/omnichannel engagement strategy tailored to Healthcare Professionals to expand brand share-of-voice .
3. KOL Engagement & Academic Advocacy

• KOL Network Building: Establish and maintain robust academic relationships with national and regional Key Opinion Leaders , medical associations, and guideline committee members.

• High-Impact Academic Events: Plan and lead nationwide launch events, standalone symposia, advisory boards, and satellite meetings to establish scientific credibility.

• Compliance Management: Ensure all marketing materials (Detailing Aids, Slides, Patient brochures) and events strictly adhere to industry compliance standards (e.g., RDPAC guidelines), local Advertising Laws, and internal policies.
4. Sales Enablement & Launch Performance Tracking

• Launch Toolkits Generation: Create high-quality, scientifically sound marketing toolkits, detailing flows, objection handling guides, and FAQs for the field force.

• Field Force Training: Lead product strategy and message training for the sales team (VFE, Regional Managers, Medical Representatives) to ensure message consistency and executional excellence.

• KPI Tracking & Course Correction: Track and analyze key launch metrics (e.g., hospital listing rate, target physician penetration, prescription conversion, and market share). Dynamically adjust tactics based on market feedback.
【Job Requirements】

• Education background: * Bachelor’s degree or above in Clinical Medicine, Pharmacy, Biology, Life Sciences, or a related field (Master’s, Ph.D., or MBA is highly preferred). A strong scientific background is critical to understanding clinical data.

• Work Experience: Minimum of 5 years of marketing experience in the pharmaceutical/biote

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Sintesi della posizione: Il Senior Product Manager for New Product Launch agisce come "architetto strategico" e "pilota commerciale" per i prossimi farmaci innovativi, nuove indicazioni, o dispositivi medici core nella pipeline. Questo ruolo è responsabile della definizione della proposizione di valore centrale del prodotto, sviluppando la strategia di Go-to-Market cross-funzionale, costruendo una forte advocacy scientifica tra i Top KOL e potenziando la forza di campo. L'obiettivo finale è quello di garantire una voce di mercato conforme, ad alto impatto e commercialmente di successo e un'accelerazione post-lancio.

1. Pre-Launch Market Insight & Strategic Positioning

• Valutazione dei bisogni clinici e non metri: condurre immersioni profonde in letteratura medica, dati di prova clinica e linee guida di trattamento per identificare i profili dei pazienti target e le esigenze mediche non metriche critiche.

• Proposizione del valore di base: Tradurre dati medici clinici e basati su prove complesse in storie di marca e posizionamento convincenti, differenziati e conformi.

• Intelligenza Competitiva: Monitorare le condotte cliniche dei concorrenti, le strutture dei prezzi e le attività di marketing per sviluppare strategie efficaci di difesa e contro-attacco.
2. Go-to-Market & Access Strategy Development

• ProprietÃ di Brand Plan: Progettare ed eseguire i piani strategici e tattici da 1 a 3 anni per il lancio del prodotto, stanziando efficacemente il budget di marketing per massimizzare il ROI.

• Synergy cross-Functional: * Partner con il team di Medical Affairs per allineare sulla generazione di prove post-launch, le prove iniziate da investitori, o studi reali. Collabora con il team Market Access per fornire dati farmacoeconomici che supportano la negoziazione della National Reimbursement Drug List (NRDL) e le offerte provinciali.

• Omnichannel Marketing (OCM): Sviluppare e implementare una strategia di fidanzamento digitale/omnichannel su misura per i professionisti sanitari per espandere la condivisione del marchio di fattura .
3. KOL Engagement & Academic Advocacy

• KOL Network Building: Stabilire e mantenere robuste relazioni accademiche con i leader nazionali e regionali Key Opinion Leaders, associazioni mediche e membri del comitato di orientamento.

• Eventi Accademici di alto impatto: pianificare e condurre eventi di lancio a livello nazionale, simposi standalone, consiglieri e riunioni satellitari per stabilire credibilità scientifica.

• Gestione della conformità: Assicurare tutti i materiali di marketing (Aiuti dettaglianti, Scivoli, brochure dei pazienti) e gli eventi aderiscono rigorosamente agli standard di conformità del settore (ad esempio, linee guida RDPAC), leggi pubblicitarie locali e politiche interne.
4. Sales Enablement & Launch Performance Tracking

• Generazione di Toolkits: Crea strumenti di marketing di alta qualità, scientificamente sonori, dettaglianti flussi, guide di gestione delle obiezioni e FAQ per la forza di campo.

• Field Force Training: Guidare la strategia dei prodotti e la formazione dei messaggi per il team di vendita (VFE, Regional Managers, Medical Representatives) per garantire la coerenza dei messaggi e l'eccellenza esecutiva.

• KPI Tracking & Course Correction: Traccia e analizza le metriche di lancio chiave (ad esempio, il tasso di elenco ospedaliero, la penetrazione del medico di destinazione, la conversione della prescrizione e la quota di mercato). Regolare dinamicamente le tattiche in base al feedback di mercato.
【 Requisiti di lavoro

• Sfondo educativo: * Laurea di laurea o superiore in medicina clinica, farmacia, biologia, scienze della vita, o un campo correlato (Master’s, Ph.D., o MBA è altamente preferito). Un forte background scientifico è fondamentale per comprendere i dati clinici.

• Esperienza di lavoro: minimo 5 anni di esperienza di marketing nel farmaceutico/biote

La position

Ce rôle est responsable de la définition de la proposition de valeur de base du produit, de l'élaboration de la stratégie interfonctionnelle Go-to-Market, de la mise en place d'un plaidoyer scientifique fort parmi les meilleurs KOL et de l'autonomisation de la force sur le terrain. L'objectif ultime est d'assurer une entrée sur le marché conforme, à fort impact et commercialement réussie et une adoption accélérée après le lancement.

• Intelligence concurrentielle : Surveiller les concurrents, les pipelines cliniques, les structures de tarification et les activités de marketing pour développer des stratégies de défense et de contre-attaque efficaces.

• Propriété du plan de marque : Concevoir et exécuter les plans stratégiques et tactiques de 1 à 3 ans pour le lancement du produit, en allouant efficacement le budget de marketing pour maximiser le rendement.

• Synergy interfonctionnelle : * Associé à l'équipe des affaires médicales pour s'aligner sur la génération de preuves après le lancement, les essais initiés par l'enquêteur ou les études du monde réel. Collaborer avec l'équipe d'accès aux marchés afin de fournir des données pharmacoéconomiques à l'appui des négociations sur la Liste nationale des médicaments à remboursement (LMNR) et des soumissions provinciales.

• Omnicanal Marketing (OCM) : Élaborer et mettre en œuvre une stratégie d'engagement numérique/omnicanal adaptée aux professionnels de la santé pour élargir le partage de la voix de marque.
3. Engagement de KOL et plaidoyer académique

• KOL Network Building: Établir et maintenir des relations universitaires solides avec les leaders d'opinion clés nationaux et régionaux, les associations médicales et les membres du comité directeur.

• Événements universitaires de grande envergure : Planifiez et dirigez des événements à l'échelle nationale, des colloques autonomes, des conseils consultatifs et des réunions par satellite pour établir la crédibilité scientifique.

• Gestion de la conformité : Veiller à ce que tous les documents de marketing (aide détaillée, diapositives, brochures pour les patients) et les événements respectent strictement les normes de conformité de l'industrie (p. ex., lignes directrices du PAPAC), les lois locales sur la publicité et les politiques internes.
4. Suivi des performances d'activation et de lancement des ventes

• Launch Toolkits Generation: Créez des boîtes à outils marketing de haute qualité scientifiquement solides, des flux détaillés, des guides de manipulation des objections et des FAQ pour la force sur le terrain.

• Formation de la Force sur le terrain : Diriger la stratégie des produits et la formation des messages pour l'équipe de vente (VFE, gestionnaires régionaux, représentants médicaux) afin d'assurer la cohérence des messages et l'excellence de l'exécution.

• Suivi de l'ICP et correction des cours : suivre et analyser les principales mesures de lancement (p. ex. taux d'inscription à l'hôpital, pénétration des médecins cibles, conversion des ordonnances et part de marché). Régler dynamiquement les tactiques en fonction de la rétroaction du marché.
Exigences en matière d'emploi

• Études : * Baccalauréat en médecine clinique, en pharmacie, en biologie, en sciences de la vie ou dans un domaine connexe (Master, Ph.D. ou MBA est très préféré). Une solide expérience scientifique est essentielle pour comprendre les données cliniques.

• Expérience professionnelle : minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en marketing dans le domaine pharmaceutique/biote

• Du bist routiniert im Umgang mit Dokumentationsarbeiten und gängigen IT-Anwendungen (insbesondere MS Office, MES, Unilab).

• Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis für die Bedienung und Kenntnis von Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen.

• Si tratta di routine nel trattare i lavori di documentazione e le applicazioni IT comuni (soprattutto MS Office, MES, Unilab).

• Vos quelques années d'expérience professionnelle pertinente dans la production pharmaceutique et, le cas échéant, l'expérience professionnelle dans la production parentérale vous distinguent.
• Des connaissances bien fondées dans le secteur de l'hygiène et en conformité avec les lignes directrices sur les BPF sont bien sûr une question pour vous.
• Vous êtes de routine dans le traitement des travaux de documentation et des applications informatiques communes (en particulier MS Office, MES, Unilab).
• Vous avez une forte compréhension technique du fonctionnement et de la connaissance des usines de production et des machines.
• Vous aimez travailler en équipe et convaincre par votre façon de travailler fiable.
• Vous rencontrez ouvertement tous les employés avec respect et reconnaissance.
• Il existe une volonté d'être utilisé dans les modèles de temps de travail flexible. En outre, vous êtes prêt à travailler dans les systèmes de quart avec tôt / tard / nuit. • CV actuel Aucun autre document n'est actuellement requis. Avant de soumettre la demande, veuillez noter qu'aucun autre document ne peut être ajouté par la suite. Ce travail est limité à 2 ans! jobs.title: Senior Buyer Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Senior Buyer Specialist , serás responsable de liderar y estructurar la nueva área de compras directas dentro de la afiliada de Chile Diagnóstica, sirviendo como una pieza fundamental del plan de acción estratégico GARA. Tu objetivo central será desarrollar e implementar buenas prácticas de abastecimiento estratégico, optimizando el gasto con proveedores, liderando licitaciones complejas bajo entornos de alta presión y mitigando los riesgos del proceso para alcanzar las metas de ahorros, flujo de caja, cumplimiento y rentabilidad del negocio.

The Opportunity

• Desarrollar y ejecutar el plan anual de abastecimiento estratégico y licitaciones para las principales categorías de compras directas en alineación con los objetivos de la afiliada.

• Liderar de punta a punta los procesos de licitación, negociación y análisis comparativo de propuestas comerciales con proveedores locales y regionales.

• Actuar como un socio estratégico del negocio ( Business Partner ), involucrándote tempranamente con las diversas áreas internas para atender y planificar de forma óptima sus requerimientos en proyectos críticos y soluciones digitales tipo LIS.

• Garantizar el estricto cumplimiento de los requerimientos de Compliance , debida diligencia ( Due Diligence ) y códigos de conducta en todo el ciclo de requisición a pago (RSS).

• Identificar, evaluar y mitigar los riesgos de suministro mediante análisis integrales de SRM ( Supplier Relationship Management ) para diseñar planes de contingencia que aseguren la continuidad del negocio.

• Liderar la clasificación, evaluación y gestión del desempeño de proveedores bajo Acuerdos de Nivel de Servicio (SLAs) e indicadores clave (KPIs) bien definidos.

• Configurar, administrar y brindar entrenamiento al equipo y usuarios internos en el uso de plataformas y herramientas de compras corporativas (como SAP, Monday, etc.).

• Velar por el desarrollo de capacidades técnicas y la correcta asignación de códigos de categorías de compra (JCCs) desde que nace la necesidad del negocio hasta la emisión de órdenes de compra.

Who you are

• Profesional graduado con título universitario en Ingeniería Comercial, Ingeniería Civil Industrial, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines al área de Abastecimiento y Operaciones.

• Experiencia sólida y demostrable de entre 5 y 10 años en áreas de compras, Procurement o abastecimiento estratégico, con una destacada trayectoria liderando licitaciones complejas en la industria o sectores corporativos.

• Alta resiliencia y capacidad comprobada para gestionar la presión del entorno y alinear con éxito las expectativas de múltiples stakeholders y directivos internos.

• Dominio avanzado de herramientas de análisis de gasto, principios de Category Management y aplicativos de gestión de compras (SAP avanzado, Monday o similares).

• Enfoque analítico y ágil con orientación a resultados (ahorros, capital de trabajo, eficiencia operativa) y excelente capacidad de negociación persuasiva.

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, s

The Position

Platform Engineer - ERP Data Platform

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As the SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) Datasphere Platform Engineer/Architect, you will lead the technical strategy and operational framework for our B DC ecosystem, driving the modernization of legacy SAP BW/4HANA environments to SAP Datasphere . In this role, you will act as a vital bridge between foundational platform engineering, regulatory compliance, and business domain-driven data productization. You will join a forward-thinking team dedicated to building scalable, inclusive, and cutting-edge data solutions that empower global healthcare discovery.

The Opportunity

• Lead and define the Business Data Cloud (BDC) Solution Architecture, ensuring seamless technical alignment with global "Cloud First" and data mesh strategies.

• Design and implement critical "Architectural Guardrails" alongside deep-dive assessments of S/4HANA backend readiness—focusing on Core Data Services (CDS) view compatibility—to maintain a highly compliant, scalable, and audit-ready environment.

• Oversee the technical lifecycle of Datasphere Spaces, governing everything from automated provisioning and resource allocation to decommissioning standards.

• Maintain the Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) blueprint for the Data Model Lifecycle, facilitating automated promotion across our 4-tier landscape (Sandbox, Development, Test/Quality, Production) while optimizing the Flexible Capacity Unit (CU) model.

• Architect complex, bi-directional data sharing (Zero-Copy) between SAP Datasphere and external ecosystems like Snowflake, ensuring high-performance integration with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and existing DataOne architecture.

• Embed essential compliance and governance directly into the platform setup, integrating Good Practice (GxP) and Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) qualification evidence while managing automated platform vulnerability patching.

• Collaborate closely with Data Teams to enforce metadata management and tagging strategies required for marketplace publication and seamless Collibra synchronization.

• Architect robust security access designs , including Identity and Access Management (IAM) strategies, data privacy/masking layers (ensuring GDPR/CCPA compliance), and global data modeling design standards.

Who you are

• Education: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Years of Experience: You bring 5+ years of

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Platform Engineer - Piattaforma dati ERP Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Come SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) Datasphere Platform Engineer/Architetto, guiderai la strategia tecnica e il quadro operativo per il nostro ecosistema B DC, guidando l'ammodernamento degli ambienti SAP BW/4HANA legacy a SAP Datasphere . In questo ruolo, si agirà come un ponte vitale tra l'ingegneria della piattaforma di base, la conformità normativa e la produzione di dati a dominio aziendale. Ti unirai a un team avanzato dedicato alla costruzione di soluzioni dati scalabili, inclusive e all'avanguardia che consentano la scoperta globale della salute. L'opportunità
• Guida e definisce l'Architettura della Soluzione Business Data Cloud (BDC) garantendo un allineamento tecnico senza interruzioni con le strategie globali di "Cloud First" e di data mesh.
• Progettare e implementare critici "Architetture Guardrails" insieme a valutazioni approfondite della prontezza di backend S/4HANA, focalizzandosi sulla compatibilità di vista Core Data Services (CDS), per mantenere un ambiente altamente conforme, scalabile e pronto all'audit.
• Superare il ciclo di vita tecnico di Datasphere Spaces, governando tutto dal provisioning automatizzato e allocazione delle risorse agli standard di decommissione.
• Mantenere la continua integrazione e la continua distribuzione (CI/CD) del ciclo di vita del modello di dati, facilitando la promozione automatizzata attraverso il nostro paesaggio a 4 livelli (Sandbox, Development, Test/Quality, Production) ottimizzando al contempo il modello di unità di capacità flessibile (CU).
• La condivisione di dati bidirezionali (Zero-Copy) tra SAP Datasphere e ecosistemi esterni come Snowflake, assicura un'integrazione ad alte prestazioni con SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) e l'architettura DataOne esistente.
• Integrare la conformità essenziale e la governance direttamente nella configurazione della piattaforma, integrando Good Practice (GxP) e il controllo interno sulle prove di qualificazione del reporting finanziario (ICFR), gestendo la patch di vulnerabilità della piattaforma automatizzata.
• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di dati per far rispettare la gestione dei metadati e le strategie di tagging necessarie per la pubblicazione sul mercato e la sincronizzazione senza soluzione di continuità Collibra.
• Architetto robusti progetti di accesso alla sicurezza, comprese le strategie Identity and Access Management (IAM), i livelli di privacy/mascheramento dei dati (conformità GDPR/CCPA) e gli standard globali di progettazione della modellazione dei dati. Chi sei
• Istruzione: Lei ha una laurea o Master in Informatica, Tecnologia dell'informazione, Ingegneria dei dati, o un campo tecnico correlato.
• Anni di Esperienza: porti 5+ anni di

• Entwerfen und Implementieren Sie kritische "Architectural Guardrails" neben eingehenden Bewertungen der S/4HANA-Backend-Bereitschaft - mit Schwerpunkt auf der Kompatibilität der Core Data Services (CDS) -, um eine hochkompatible, skalierbare und auditfähige Umgebung zu erhalten.
• Beaufsichtigen Sie den technischen Lebenszyklus von DataSphere Spaces und regeln Sie alles von der automatisierten Bereitstellung und Ressourcenzuweisung bis hin zu Stilllegungsstandards.
• Pflegen Sie die Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) Blaupause für den Data Model Lifecycle, um die automatisierte Promotion in unserer 4-stufigen Landschaft (Sandbox, Entwicklung, Test/Qualität, Produktion) zu erleichtern und gleichzeitig das Flexible Capacity Unit (CU) Modell zu optimieren.
• Architektin komplexer, bidirektionaler Datenaustausch (Zero-Copy) zwischen SAP DataSphere und externen Ökosystemen wie Snowflake, um eine leistungsstarke Integration mit SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) und bestehender DataOne-Architektur zu gewährleisten.
• Betten Sie wesentliche Compliance- und Governance-Anforderungen direkt in das Plattform-Setup ein, integrieren Sie die Qualifikationsnachweise für Good Practice (GxP) und Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) und verwalten Sie gleichzeitig das automatisierte Patchen von Schwachstellen auf Plattformen.
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Data Teams zusammen, um Metadatenmanagement- und Tagging-Strategien für die Veröffentlichung von Marktplätzen und die nahtlose Collibra-Synchronisierung durchzusetzen.
• Erstellen Sie robuste Sicherheitszugriffsdesigns, einschließlich Identitäts- und Zugriffsmanagement (IAM)-Strategien, Datenschutz-/Masking-Schichten (Gewährleistung der DSGVO/CCPA-Compliance) und globalen Standards für die Gestaltung von Datenmodellen. Wer du bist
• Ausbildung: Sie haben einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Informationstechnologie, Data Engineering oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.
• Jahre Erfahrung: Sie bringen 5+ Jahre

En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Vous rejoindrez une équipe d'avant-garde dédiée à la construction de solutions de données évolutives, inclusives et de pointe qui permettent la découverte de soins de santé mondiaux. L'opportunité
• Dirigez et définissez l'architecture de solution Business Data Cloud (BDC), assurant un alignement technique sans faille avec les stratégies globales de «Cloud First» et de maillage de données.
• Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des « garde-corps architecturaux » critiques en plus d'évaluer en profondeur l'état de préparation du moteur S/4HANA – mettant l'accent sur la compatibilité des services de données de base (CDS) – afin de maintenir un environnement hautement conforme, évolutif et prêt à l'audit.
• Surveiller le cycle de vie technique des espaces de données, qui régit tout, depuis la fourniture automatisée et l'allocation des ressources jusqu'aux normes de déclassement.
• Maintenir le plan d'intégration et de déploiement continu (IC/CD) pour le cycle de vie du modèle de données, en facilitant la promotion automatisée dans notre paysage à quatre niveaux (boîte à sable, développement, test/qualité, production) tout en optimisant le modèle d'unité de capacité flexible (UC).
• Architecte un partage de données bidirectionnel complexe (Zero-Copy) entre SAP Datasphere et des écosystèmes externes comme Snowflake, assurant une intégration à haute performance avec SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) et l'architecture DataOne existante.
• Intégrer directement la conformité et la gouvernance essentielles à la configuration de la plateforme, en intégrant les preuves de qualification de Bonnes Pratiques (GxP) et de Contrôle Interne sur les Rapports Financiers (ICFR) tout en gérant le patchage automatisé de vulnérabilité de la plateforme.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de données afin d'appliquer les stratégies de gestion des métadonnées et d'étiquetage requises pour la publication sur le marché et la synchronisation transparente de Collibra.
• Architecter des conceptions robustes d'accès à la sécurité, y compris des stratégies de gestion de l'identité et de l'accès (IAM), des couches de confidentialité et de masquage des données (assurer la conformité au RGPD/CCPA) et des normes mondiales de modélisation des données. Qui vous êtes
• Éducation: Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en informatique, technologie de l'information, génie des données ou un domaine technique connexe.

jobs.title: Maintenance Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Maintenance Specialist, you will be able to contribute to shape the future of the Roche Diagnostics Operations by maintaining the best performance of our electro-mechanical equipment used in the Facilities/Utilities organization.

The Opportunity:

• You're performing electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning electromechanical equipment, HVAC, electrical, refrigeration, and chilled water systems used in Facilities/Utilities. Dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches, or drawings.

• You're using test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts & rebuild facilities/utilities equipment as required and perform equipment modifications including installation, validation support and start-up of new equipment, as well as decommissioning activities as directed by manufacturing engineers

• You're using maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies and apply advanced knowledge and skills to complete assignments requiring judgment and initiative. You will understand the implications of work and make recommendations for solutions. You will receive little instruction on daily assignments and may determine methods and procedures on new assignments.

• You're responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

• You're completing preventative maintenance tasks according to detailed procedures and schedules. You will provide emergency call-in support for operations that run during off- hours and weekends. Maintains accurate records of all activities

Who you are:

Minimum Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalency

• 2+ years related operations or manufacturing experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Associates Degree or equivalent military training or documented 3 years’ experience troubleshooting and repairing the following types of systems: HVAC, Ammonia refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic in an operations or manufacturing setting

• Proficient in Google Office Suite: Docs, Sheets, Slides, Email, Calendar

• Knowledge of screw and reciprocal compressors, electrical and controls troubleshooting

• Experience with Precision Maintenance practices; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and GDP (Good Documentation Practices)

• Experience with HVAC systems (rooftop units, air handling units, VAVs, fan coil units, electric and gas heaters); chilled water systems (ammonia screw chillers, ammonia and pumps); boilers and hot water systems (gas and electric boilers); refrigeration (stand-alone refrigerator/freezers, walk in coolers and freezers, CO2 refrigeration, and ammonia refrigeration)

• Experience with Building Automation systems

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Pay transparency

Account Executive - Molecular Diagnostics - Boston

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
Are you an experienced sales professional with a talent for solving complex challenges? In this role, you'll use your expertise to navigate diverse issues and make strategic decisions that drive success. You'll manage medium to large accounts, exceeding sales targets while building lasting relationships with key decision-makers.
Your goal will be to expand your network, identify new opportunities, and present compelling value propositions. With a deep understanding of our product line, you'll serve as a trusted advisor, continuously improving our quality system through your daily actions.
As an Account Executive - Molecular Diagnostics, you will:

• be responsible for promoting molecular diagnostic testing, including infectious disease, respiratory and transplantation.

• contact new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• generate demand and maximize product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• work with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• conduct and organize necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• communicates competitive market information internally.

• networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

This is a field-based role covering the Boston area. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the territory.

Travel: 50%

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 3+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience.

• Proven leadership abilities

• Negotiation, contracting and problem solving skills

• Ability to work in a regulated environment

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

• be responsible for promoting molecular diagnostic testing, including infectious disease, respiratory and transplantation.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
职位：（高级）渠道拓展项目经理-医院
部门： 多渠道生态体系拓展部（ MCE ）

Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责 / 责任
1 、结合公司产品特点，制定区域市场策略与执行
深度解读国家及各省市政策动态、市场竞争格局，结合产品特性与医院终端需求，制定拓展目标医院业务整体策略，搭建医院端业务运作体系。
2 、项目管理与经销商协作
结合总部策略和区域实践提升产品医院覆盖广度与深度。
与区域合作伙伴构建良好的合作关系；整合经销商资源建立与合作伙伴的协同机制，确保产品在医院终端的供应保障以及业务目标达成。 联动市场部制定市场方案，赋能经销商聚焦产品临床价值传递。赋能合作伙伴的业务活动，定期向业务部门/职能部门负责人提供反馈
3 、目标达成与模式探索
向经销商商议制定负责区域内经销商年度/季度/月度商业目标，监督经销商建立关键绩效指标跟踪体系，监控业务数据，定期汇报目标达成情况、策略执行效果及市场动态。 针对目标达成偏差，敦促经销商快速制定优化策略与资源配置，确保产品医院端业务稳健发展。
制定区域市场策略和区域准入跟进机制，制定项目计划，建立区域项目管理回顾机制，确保区域项目合规落地及实现区域项目高效费用管理。积极探索创新模式并试点推广。
4 、跨部门协同与资源整合
积极协同公司内外部资源，联动公司各个跨部门团队，协调资源支持推动解决业务推进中的跨部门协作问题。推进渠道资源的整合，保障目标达成。
5 、其他
严格遵守中国法律法规及罗氏内部的合规政策，确保所有市场活动合法合规。监控业务流程中的潜在风险及时处理以保障业务健康运行。完成上级主管指派的其他临时性项目工作。

Education/
• Qualifications 教育程度/所获资格证书
医学/药学/本科及以上；
有销售、项目管理或市场营销经验；
5年及以上医药行业经验，其中至少3年销售管理或项目管理经验；
有医院/成熟产品渠道策略制定或运营经验者优先；
具备深度业务洞察能力，具有预见风险能力，并能提供长远发展建议和创新方案 ；
具备客户管理能力，能够分析区域信息，制定区域业务目标和工作计划能力，并能带领团队推动计划执行；
具备项目管理能力，具有多项目和复杂项目的管理知识，能够资源优化配置，有序推动项目计划 具备系统思考能力和区域管理能力；
能进行区域策略制定，流程优化和团队管理能力；
良好的跨部门合作、沟通能力 成长型思维

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As the Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader for the Master Data Data Product, you will be a vital member of the MRHub Team within the Data Management & Data Quality Platforms department. Your primary mission is to deliver high-quality IT operation services that empower our business partners to reliably provide life-saving products to patients.
In this role, you will lead the setup and lifecycle management of Master Data Data Products, ensuring they deliver consistent value regardless of the source system (MDMS, Aspire, MRHub).

Job Responsibilities

• Leads the Master Data Product setup and lifecycle, independent of specific source systems

• Manages and directs a small external team (4 people) delivering the Master Data Data Products and Snowflake capabilities.

• Manages the end‑to‑end request process for new/changed Master Data Data Products: intake, governance board engagement, approvals, coordinating with source system owners.

• Designs and implements the Data Product technically in Snowflake (pipelines, datasets, exposure for consumption).

• Coordinates closely with the Data Quality team and Ataccama so data quality rules run on Snowflake datasets from the Master Data Data Products.

• Serves as the main operational contact for ongoing demand, changes, and incident/support needs around the Master Data Data Products

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their data and analytics needs and develop a product roadmap that aligns with business goals.

• Define and prioritise product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for data and analytics products and ensure what was agreed gets delivered.

• Collaborate with Infrastructure Teams and software developers to ensure that data and analytics products are integrated into existing systems and platforms in a sustainable way that still meets the needs of business to generate the insights necessary to drive their decisions.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field.

• Extensive experience leading complex data science projects from end-to-end and driving significant business impact.

• Proven track record of working closely with senior leadership to inform and influence high-level strategic business decisions.

• Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing enterprise-wide data science frameworks and best practices.

Technical Skills

• Deep understanding of Master Data, Data Quality and

A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale di intelligenza artificiale, dati e innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutto Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici dell'ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Come Senior Master Data Analyst / Leader per il Master Data Data Product, sarai un membro vitale del team MRHub all'interno del reparto Gestione dei dati e piattaforme di qualità dei dati. La vostra missione primaria è quella di fornire servizi operativi IT di alta qualità che consentono ai nostri partner commerciali di fornire in modo affidabile prodotti salvavita ai pazienti. In questo ruolo, si porterà la configurazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita dei prodotti Master Data, assicurando che essi forniscono un valore coerente indipendentemente dal sistema sorgente (MDMS, Aspire, MRHub). Responsabilità del lavoro
• Leads the Master Data Product setup and lifecycle, indipendente da specifici sistemi di sorgente
• Gestisce e dirige un piccolo team esterno (4 persone) che fornisce le funzionalità Master Data Products e Snowflake.
• Gestisce il processo di richiesta end-to-end per i nuovi/cambiati Master Data Data Products: assunzione, governance board engagement, approvazioni, coordinamento con i proprietari di sistemi sorgente.
• Progetta e implementa tecnicamente il Data Product in Snowflake (pipeline, dataset, esposizione al consumo).
• Coordina a stretto contatto con il team di Data Quality e Ataccama così le regole di qualità dei dati vengono eseguite sui dataset di Snowflake dai prodotti Master Data.
• Serve come principale contatto operativo per la domanda, le modifiche e le esigenze di incidente/supporto in tutto il Master Data Products
• Collabora con gli stakeholder aziendali per comprendere le loro esigenze di dati e analisi e sviluppare una roadmap del prodotto che si allinea agli obiettivi aziendali.
• Definire e dare priorità ai requisiti del prodotto, alle storie degli utenti e ai criteri di accettazione dei dati e dei prodotti di analisi e garantire che ciò che è stato concordato venga consegnato.
• Collaborare con i team di infrastruttura e gli sviluppatori di software per garantire che i prodotti di dati e analytics siano integrati in sistemi e piattaforme esistenti in modo sostenibile che soddisfi ancora le esigenze del business per generare le informazioni necessarie per guidare le loro decisioni. Qualifiche Istruzione / Esperienza
• Bachelor o Master in informatica, sistemi informativi, o un campo correlato.
• Esperienza estesa che conduce complessi progetti di scienza dei dati da end-to-end e la guida di impatto commerciale significativo.
• Provato record di lavoro a stretto contatto con la leadership senior per informare e influenzare le decisioni strategiche di business di alto livello.
• Esperienza dimostrata nella progettazione e nell'attuazione dei quadri di scienza dei dati a livello aziendale e delle migliori pratiche. Competenze tecniche
• Profonda comprensione dei dati master, qualità dei dati e

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Analyste principal principal des données / Chef Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force centrale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde entier. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau peuvent varier selon les besoins opérationnels, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements de collaboration. En tant qu'analyste principal des données / responsable du produit Master Data, vous serez un membre essentiel de l'équipe MRHub au sein du département Gestion des données et plateformes de qualité des données. Votre mission principale est de fournir des services d'exploitation informatique de haute qualité qui permettent à nos partenaires commerciaux de fournir de façon fiable des produits de sauvetage aux patients. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez la configuration et la gestion du cycle de vie de Master Data Data Products, en s'assurant qu'ils fournissent une valeur cohérente quel que soit le système source (MDMS, Aspire, MRHub). Responsabilités professionnelles
• Dirige la configuration et le cycle de vie du produit Master Data, indépendamment des systèmes sources spécifiques
• Gère et dirige une petite équipe externe (4 personnes) qui fournit les produits Master Data Data et les capacités Snowflake.
• Gère le processus de demande de bout en bout pour les produits de données maîtresses nouveaux ou modifiés : entrée, engagement du conseil de gouvernance, approbations, coordination avec les propriétaires de systèmes sources.
• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre le produit de données techniquement dans Snowflake (pipélines, ensembles de données, exposition à la consommation).
• Coordonne étroitement avec l'équipe Qualité des données et Ataccama afin que les règles de qualité des données soient appliquées sur les ensembles de données Snowflake des produits Master Data Data.
• Fonctionne comme le principal contact opérationnel pour la demande continue, les changements et les besoins d'incident/de soutien autour des produits de base de données
• Collaborer avec les intervenants pour comprendre leurs besoins en matière de données et d'analyses et élaborer une feuille de route qui s'harmonise avec les objectifs opérationnels.
• Définir et hiérarchiser les exigences des produits, les histoires des utilisateurs et les critères d'acceptation pour les produits de données et d'analyse et s'assurer que ce qui a été convenu est livré.
• Collaborer avec les équipes d'infrastructure et les développeurs de logiciels pour s'assurer que les produits de données et d'analyse sont intégrés dans les systèmes et les plateformes existants de manière durable et qu'ils répondent encore aux besoins des entreprises pour générer les idées nécessaires à la conduite de leurs décisions. Compétences Éducation / Expérience
• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, systèmes d'information ou domaine connexe.
• Expérience étendue menant des projets complexes de science des données de bout en bout et entraînant un impact commercial important.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities

Leadership & People Management

• ﻿﻿Build and retain an inclusive workforce and foster an environment where diversity of thought and perspective are valued.

• Maintain an inclusive team that values diversity of thought.

• Maintain strong partnerships with leaders to ensure alignment on strategic projects and daily operations.

• ﻿﻿Take the responsibility for department daily SHE management, implement site SHE procedure and program, and achieve site corporate /site SHE KPI. Promote SHE culture and improve employee safety behavior.

• ﻿﻿Manage performance and development team members to achieve organizational goals and employee personal and professional growth.

• Support manager to build a strong pipeline of talent and robust succession plans for key positions.

• ﻿﻿﻿﻿Maintain a culture of continuous improvement and model lean leadership principles.

• Maintain a culture of transparent, high performance, empowerment and innovation culture.

Technical

Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, equipment selection, URS review, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.

• As a key role, support to establish an effective operation system in alignment with the Roche’s standards, including manufacturing system, CCS strategy, people training and qualification system.

• Lead to establish the procedures related to aseptic techniques, good aseptic practices on the shop floor, and other relevant processes for aseptic production execution.

• Participate in CCS strategy implementation in operation to ensure a sustaining sterility assurance program setting up.

• Support the filling manager to establish the site aseptic training program and implement it, ensure only qualified people perform GMP lots’ manufacturing.

• Ensure team's competencies in performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, depyrogenating, filling and stoppering, crimping.

• Participate in tech transfer, collaboration with other functions to ensure the success of new product manufacturing.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:

• Ensure routine operation compliance with regulations, maintain sterile conditions, and achieve high-quality production standards .

• Ensure total readiness of manufacturing suites, including housekeeping, machine, materials, documents and other resources to ensure product delivery in time and within budget.

• Arrange the filling shifts in routine production, participate in operation as an aseptic SME and perform daily review of production batch record, deviation according to schedule.

• Lead annual aseptic operators’ qualification, provide on-the-job training to support formalized technical and GMP training.

• Oversee the daily operation, monitoring, and maintenance of filling equipment to ensure compliance with aseptic requirements .

• Supervise aseptic operations during production and intervene promptly in case of abnormalities .

• Participate in the response of regulator audit and global quality audit as SME during regulatory inspections and audits.

• Raise deviation and involve the root cause investigation, including appropriate escalation where needed to ensure closure of deviation within the set timeline.

• Raise change control and provide assessment.

• Execute regular validation activities, such as APS.

•

As a Medical Affairs Partner, you will act as a trusted, externally focused, and scientifically grounded collaborator within our customer engagement ecosystem. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que partenaire des affaires médicales, vous agirez en tant que collaborateur fiable, ciblé et scientifiquement fondé au sein de notre écosystème d'engagement client. Basée dans l'équipe d'affiliation, vous dirigerez la stratégie médicale locale, établirez des liens profonds entre les pairs et les communautés scientifiques, et vous assurerez que nos innovations diagnostiques et thérapeutiques atteignent leur plein potentiel pour transformer la vie des patients. Dans ce rôle, vous :
• Diriger la stratégie scientifique et médicale : Diriger la composante médicale de la stratégie thérapeutique intégrée, en transformant des données cliniques complexes en une histoire de valeur claire et différenciée dans les domaines clés de la maladie.
• Cultiver des partenariats de confiance : dialoguer de façon proactive avec des leaders clés de l'opinion, des experts scientifiques externes et des intervenants de la santé pour favoriser des collaborations significatives et axées sur la science.
• Production avancée de données probantes : Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des plans intégrés locaux de données probantes, cerner les lacunes dans les données et appuyer les études sur les données probantes dans le monde réel, les études non interventionnelles et la recherche initiée par les chercheurs.
• Accélérer l'accès au marché des patients : Contribuez à l'expertise scientifique des présentations locales d'évaluation des technologies de la santé (ETS), articulant la valeur réelle de nos innovations afin d'obtenir un accès plus rapide aux patients.
• Lead Digital & Ecosystem Innovation: Rassembler systématiquement des informations cliniques externes, en utilisant des outils numériques émergents et des informations sur l'IA de manière responsable pour anticiper et optimiser l'adoption de pratiques médicales locales.
• Assurer l'excellence absolue et la conformité : Surveiller les demandes d'information médicale et collaborer avec les équipes des opérations réglementaires et cliniques, en maintenant le strict respect des règlements de l'industrie, des normes éthiques et des bonnes pratiques cliniques (BCP). Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel entrepreneurial orienté vers la solution qui prospère dans des environnements d'équipe interfonctionnels. Vous équilibrez une expertise scientifique profonde avec l'acuité stratégique requise pour naviguer dans l'ambiguïté et communiquer des idées complexes avec clarté et impact. Vos qualifications :
• Excellence en éducation : Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme avancé en sciences médicales, pharmaceutiques ou naturelles (p. ex., MD, PharmD, PhD ou équivalent).
• Expérience professionnelle : vous apportez une expérience éprouvée en affaires médicales ou une expertise clinique/scientifique équivalente dans les domaines thérapeutiques pertinents de préférence en maladies rétiniennes et en ophtalmologie
• Communication stratégique : Vous possédez des compétences exceptionnelles en communication verbale et écrite, avec la capacité de diriger avec confiance le dialogue scientifique entre pairs au niveau des cadres en anglais.
• Littératie numérique : Vous gardez une attitude de croissance envers les outils numériques, démontrant la littératie de base en matière d'IA et la capacité d'assurer une surveillance robuste du contenu numérique.
• Compliance & Collaborative Mindset: Vous faites preuve d'une forte responsabilité personnelle, d'une approche collaborative des environnements interfonctionnels de l'équipe et d'un engagement indéfectible envers la conformité éthique. Ensemble, nous progresserons tout au long du parcours patient avec l'aspiration à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics.
