• Documentazione di controllo della progettazione dell'autore (ad esempio Piani di sviluppo di progettazione, Specifiche dei requisiti degli utenti, Input di progettazione, uscite di progettazione, piani di verifica di progettazione ), valutazioni di conformità e documentazione di gestione del rischio.
• Applicare la conoscenza del paesaggio normativo per garantire disegni conformi standard (ad esempio ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 e 21 CFR 820.30) Chi sei:
• Laurea universitaria (BSc o MSc) in ingegneria o una disciplina tecnica correlata da un istituto accreditato.
• 5+ anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di dispositivi di ingegneria meccanica e di distribuzione di farmaci in ambienti farmacologici o altamente regolamentati (cGxP, QSR).
• Competenze manuali nell'iniettore della penna e nello sviluppo dell'autoiniettore durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto.
• Forte sfondo nei sistemi di chiusura dei container, in particolare siringhe preriempite e cartucce per la somministrazione di droga parenterale.
• Prova leadership tecnica e capacità avanzate di problem solving in ambienti di team interfunzionali.
• Solida comprensione della scienza dei materiali applicata ai sistemi di consegna della droga, con competenza nei meccanismi di danno, identificazione del difetto e test delle prestazioni.
• Conoscenza profonda delle normative, degli standard industriali e della guida per prodotti combinati e dispositivi medici su scala globale.
• Esperimenti diretti
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global Technical Development (PTD) is an organization of over two thousand people globally that are integral for the mission of Roche to develop meaningful medicines for patients. Therefore, we actively collaborate and develop creative technical solutions to bridge early-stage, late-stage and commercial product needs. The mandate is to expertly deliver the pipeline and supply quality products to patients.

The Device Development department within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support.

Device Engineering combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities.

The opportunity:

This hands-on role drives engineering excellence by applying design controls, solving complex device engineering challenges, and providing strategic technical guidance to ensure robust product development and compliance.

In this role, you will engage in extensive cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Commercial teams.

This role reports to the Section Head of Device Engineering and is integrated into the Roche Device Development function.

• Act as technical project leader or technical expert to successfully bring combination products and medical devices to the market

• Evaluation of new and breakthrough technologies. Application of theoretical engineering knowledge, to establish robust technical product requirements, and develop engineering design solutions to assure devices maintain the required level of performance throughout the life of the product

• Collaborate with external partners providing technical oversight on mechanical designs for combination products to ensure high performance, design robustness and innovation.

• Lead internal and external technical investigations, swiftly resolve design related device issues by applying structured problem solving methodologies.

• Author design control documentation (e.g. Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, Design Verification Plans ), conformity assessments and risk management documentation.

• Apply knowledge of the regulatory landscape to ensure standard compliant designs (e.g. ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 and 21 CFR 820.30)

Who you are:

• University degree (BSc or MSc) in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.

• 5+ years of experience in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development within pharma or highly regulated environments (cGxP, QSR).

• Hands-on expertise in pen injector and autoinjector development throughout the entire product lifecycle.

• Strong background in container closure systems, specifically prefilled syringes and cartridges for parenteral drug delivery.

• Proven technical leadership and advanced problem-solving capabilities in cross-functional team environments.

• Solid understanding of materials science applied to drug delivery systems, with expertise in damage mechanisms, defect identification, and performance testing.

• Deep knowledge of regulations, industry standards, and guidance for combination products and medical devices on a global scale.

• Direct experienc

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Global Technical Development (PTD) est une organisation de plus de deux mille personnes dans le monde qui font partie intégrante de la mission de Roche de développer des médicaments significatifs pour les patients. Par conséquent, nous collaborons activement et développons des solutions techniques créatives pour combler les besoins en produits en début de phase, en fin de phase et en commercial. Le mandat consiste à livrer le pipeline et à fournir des produits de qualité aux patients. Le service de développement des dispositifs au sein de Roche Technical Development est responsable du développement et du soutien des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments pour le portefeuille de produits. Nos activités couvrent une gamme de disciplines d'ingénierie, de la phase de définition des exigences jusqu'à la commercialisation et le soutien des produits commercialisés. L'ingénierie des appareils combine la conception, l'ingénierie, les essais et la fabrication pour mettre au point des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments fiables et sûrs qui répondent aux besoins des patients, des fournisseurs de soins de santé et des autorités sanitaires. L'occasion : Ce rôle pratique stimule l'excellence en ingénierie en appliquant des contrôles de conception, en résolvant les défis complexes d'ingénierie des appareils et en fournissant des conseils techniques stratégiques pour assurer le développement et la conformité robustes des produits. Dans ce rôle, vous participerez à une vaste collaboration interfonctionnelle, en particulier avec les équipes d'assurance de la qualité, d'affaires réglementaires, cliniques et commerciales. Ce rôle relève du chef de section de l'ingénierie des appareils et est intégré à la fonction de développement des appareils Roche.
• Agir en tant que chef de projet technique ou expert technique pour mettre sur le marché des produits combinés et des dispositifs médicaux
• Évaluation des technologies nouvelles et novatrices. Application des connaissances théoriques en ingénierie, pour établir des exigences techniques robustes du produit, et développer des solutions de conception technique pour assurer que les appareils maintiennent le niveau de performance requis tout au long de la durée de vie du produit
• Collaborer avec des partenaires externes fournissant une supervision technique sur les conceptions mécaniques pour les produits combinés pour assurer des performances élevées, la robustesse de conception et l'innovation.
• Diriger les enquêtes techniques internes et externes, résoudre rapidement les problèmes liés à la conception des appareils en appliquant des méthodes structurées de résolution des problèmes.
• Documentation sur le contrôle de la conception de l'auteur (p. ex. plans d'élaboration de la conception, spécifications relatives aux exigences de l'utilisateur, intrants de conception, extrants de conception, plans de vérification de conception), évaluations de la conformité et documentation sur la gestion des risques.
• Appliquer les connaissances du paysage réglementaire pour assurer des conceptions conformes aux normes (par exemple ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 et 21 CFR 820.30) Qui vous êtes :
• Diplôme universitaire (BSc ou MSc) en génie ou dans une discipline technique connexe d'un établissement accrédité.
• 5 ans et plus d'expérience en génie mécanique et en mise au point d'instruments de prestation de médicaments dans des environnements pharmaceutiques ou hautement réglementés (cGxP, QSR).
• Expertise pratique dans le développement du stylo injecteur et de l'autoinjecteur tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.
• Solide fond dans les systèmes de fermeture des contenants, en particulier les seringues préremplies et les cartouches pour l'administration de médicaments parentéraux.
• Un leadership technique éprouvé et des capacités avancées de résolution de problèmes dans des environnements d'équipe interfonctionnels.
• Compréhension solide de la science des matériaux appliquée aux systèmes de livraison de médicaments, avec une expertise dans les mécanismes de dommages, l'identification des défauts et les tests de performance.
• Connaissance approfondie des règlements, des normes de l'industrie et des conseils pour les produits combinés et les dispositifs médicaux à l'échelle mondiale.
• Expérienc direct

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Business Developer , serás responsable de diseñar, comunicar, desarrollar e implementar la estrategia de negocio y marketing para el portafolio de Banco de Sangre y Serología dentro de la subregión de Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Bolivia (SAN). En este rol, actuarás como un nexo estratégico clave con el mercado , capturando oportunidades con agilidad e incorporando la inteligencia de mercado y tendencias emergentes. Trabajarás de manera colaborativa y estrecha con el Infectious Diseases Disease Management Squad y equipos multidisciplinarios para expandir la participación de mercado, asegurar la ejecución comercial de punta a punta, aportar valor a los clientes y elevar el estándar de cuidado de los pacientes.

The Opportunity

• Planificación Estratégica: Diseñar e implementar los planes y estrategias de desarrollo de negocios en total alineación con el Disease Management Squad . Contribuir a la definición de la estrategia y priorizar las tácticas para el portafolio asignado, adaptando los lineamientos globales/regionales al contexto de la red SAN y definiendo el posicionamiento de precios.

• Gestión Comercial y Licitaciones: Gestionar y validar propuestas comerciales (GDC), adecuar las listas de precios y apoyar activamente en la preparación y defensa de licitaciones públicas y privadas.

• Ejecución y Soporte Técnico: Liderar de punta a punta la ejecución de proyectos de desarrollo de negocios , brindando soporte científico y técnico integral tanto a los clientes como entrenamiento técnico a los roles comerciales internos de Roche y a la red de canales distribuidores. Actuarás como el punto de contacto principal y referente experto dentro de tu área de especialidad.

• Inteligencia de Mercado: Relevar de forma proactiva insights del mercado y de los clientes para compartirlos con el squad , moldeando la estrategia según las necesidades del entorno e integrando la perspectiva del cliente en los squads y redes regionales (EMEA-LATAM).

• Relaciones Estratégicas y Co-creación: Identificar nuevas oportunidades junto a los equipos de campo y co-crear los planes de cuentas clave en colaboración con los Key Account Managers (KAMs). Construir y mantener relaciones sólidas, efectivas y de confianza con clientes, partners y stakeholders clave del sector científico e institucional (sociedades científicas, planes nacionales y provinciales) para influir en la estrategia.

• Sinergia Interna: Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con los equipos de Ventas, Finanzas, Supply Chain, Healthcare Manager y Experiencia del Cliente para optimizar los indicadores clave de negocio, alocación de recursos y planes financieros (BP & IP).

Who you are

• Formación Académica: Profesional graduado en Ciencias Naturales, Bioquímica, Biotecnología o carreras afines. Es muy valorable contar con estudios de posgrado o MBA.

• Experiencia Laboral: Experiencia previa comprobable en roles de desarrollo de negocios, marketing de productos, especialista de aplicaciones o ventas dentro de la industria del diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) o farmacéutica.

• Conocimientos Técnicos Críticos: Trayectoria demostrable y conocimientos técnicos profundos y actualizados tanto en serología como en biología molecular . Es indispensable contar con un entendimiento sólido en técnicas de diagnóstico y, específicamente, en pruebas de tamizaje NAT (Nucleic Acid Testing) para bancos de sangre.

• Idiomas: Dominio avanzado del idioma inglés (nivel B2, C1 o C2) para interactuar fluidamente en un entorno global, corpora

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als F acharbeiter Pharma für Abfüllung & optische Kontrolle (m/w/d) bist Du für die Vorbereitung, Überwachung, Reinigung und Desinfizierung der Abfüllmaschine, der Gefriertrocknungsanlage und den optischen Kontrollmaschinen verantwortlich.

Verantwortlichkeiten

• Du steuerst und überwachst die maschinelle Abfüllung sowie die optische Kontrolle von sterilen Lösungen in Spritzen unter strikter Einhaltung von GMP- und Hygienevorschriften.

• Du führst mikrobiologische Umgebungskontrollen eigenständig durch und behebst auftretende, auch komplexe Systemstörungen an den Produktionsanlagen.

• Du übernehmst die lückenlose, GMP-gerechte Dokumentation aller Arbeitsschritte in elektronischen Logbüchern, Herstellprotokollen und Systemen wie SAP und MES.

• Du bereitest Arbeitsgeräte vor, reinigst sowie desinfizierst Anlagenkomponenten und unterstützt aktiv bei Qualifizierungs-, Validierungs- und Wartungsarbeiten.

• Du aktualisierst Standardarbeitsanweisungen (SOPs), erstellst GMP-Dokumente und bringst Deine Ideen im kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess (KVP) ein.

Das bringst Du mit

• Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Pharmakant, Chemikant oder Pharmazeutisch-technischer Assistent (PTA).

• Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige einschlägige Praxiserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion, idealerweise im Bereich der aseptischen Sterilfertigung.

• Fachkompetenz: Fundierte Kenntnisse der GMP-Richtlinien, sicheres Arbeiten im Hygienebereich sowie ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis zur Bedienung komplexer Anlagen.

• IT-Kenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen DV-Anwendungen und Produktionssystemen (z. B. MS Office, MES, SAP, SingleLims).

• Team & Flexibilität: Eine zuverlässige, wertschätzende Arbeitsweise im Team sowie die uneingeschränkte Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im Vollkonti-Schichtbetrieb (Früh/Spät/Nacht) inklusive regelmäßiger Samstagsarbeit.

Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

La posizione In qualità di Pharma specializzata per l'imbottigliamento e il controllo ottico (m/f/d), siete responsabili della preparazione, del monitoraggio, della pulizia e della disinfezione della macchina di imbottigliamento, del sistema di essiccazione del congelamento e delle macchine di controllo ottico. Responsabilità
• Controlli e monitori il riempimento meccanico e l'ispezione visiva di soluzioni sterili in siringhe in stretta conformità con GMP e normative igieniche.
• Effettuate controlli ambientali microbiologici in modo indipendente e riparate eventuali guasti del sistema anche complessi presso gli impianti di produzione.
• Accetti la documentazione senza soluzione di continuità e conforme a GMP di tutti i passaggi di lavoro nei registri elettronici, protocolli di produzione e sistemi come SAP e MES.
• Si preparano attrezzature di lavoro, componenti vegetali puliti e disinfettanti e supportano attivamente la formazione, la convalida e il lavoro di manutenzione.

• Esperienza professionale: Diversi anni di esperienza pratica rilevante nella produzione farmaceutica, idealmente nel campo della produzione sterile asettica.
• Competenza: conoscenza approfondita delle linee guida GMP, lavoro sicuro nel settore dell'igiene e una forte comprensione tecnica del funzionamento di sistemi complessi.
• Competenze IT: Gestione sicura delle applicazioni informatiche e dei sistemi di produzione comuni (ad esempio MS Office, MES, SAP, SingleLims).

Responsabilité
• Vous contrôlez et surveillez le remplissage mécanique et l'inspection visuelle des solutions stériles dans les seringues en stricte conformité avec les règles de BPF et d'hygiène.

• Expérience professionnelle: Plusieurs années d'expérience pratique pertinente dans la production pharmaceutique, idéalement dans le domaine de la production stérile aseptique.
• Expertise : Connaissance approfondie des lignes directrices sur les BPF, sécurité du travail dans le secteur de l'hygiène et bonne compréhension technique du fonctionnement de systèmes complexes.
• Compétences en TI: Gestion sécurisée des applications informatiques et des systèmes de production communs (par exemple MS Office, MES, SAP, SingleLims).
• L'équipe et la flexibilité : une méthode de travail fiable et appréciatrice au sein de l'équipe ainsi que la volonté de travailler en équipe à temps plein (début/fin/nuit) y compris le travail régulier du samedi. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions:

• En tant que Directeur / Directrice Régional des Ventes pour la Gamme Core Lab, vous êtes responsable de la qualité du service produit par l’équipe et de l’amélioration continue des processus que vous supervisez.

• Leader VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst and Coach), vous savez engager autour d’une vision stratégique, et structurer les activités de manière efficace et collaborative.

• En tant que coach, vous accompagnez le développement de votre équipe, savez repérer et faire grandir les talents.

• Multiplicateur de la culture agile, vous mettez en place au sein de votre équipe un cadre d’autonomie croissante et créez les conditions d’une décision déléguée efficace; vous recrutez les talents dont l’organisation a besoin, anticipez les nouvelles compétences grâce à la veille des évolutions du marché et à vos connexions au sein du groupe,

• Enfin, vous incarnez les Leadership commitments.

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous participez à des projets/squads au sein de votre Chapter/de la FIiliale/ de la Région

• Vous pilotez l’activité commerciale des comptes locaux et mettez en œuvre l’évolution des pratiques et compétences des CSM (Customer Success Managers) au regard des objectifs stratégiques de la filiale et du groupe (notamment en lien avec les Key Account Managers).

• Vous êtes également garant(e) du strict respect de la compliance pour votre équipe et du respect des politiques et processus de pricing pour les gammes, par segment.

• Vous coopérez avec les Network Leads et le Resource Manager de manière à garantir le bon niveau de compétence et de ressources pour les SPS dans le respect des objectifs financiers .

• Agent du changement, vous êtes responsable de la bonne adoption des nouveaux processus vente dans la filiale et de la coopération inter Chapters

Qui vous êtes:

• Vous bénéficiez d'une solide culture de l'industrie du diagnostic et, plus largement, de l'écosystème de la santé

• Expérimenté en management d’équipe, vous maîtrisez les postures de leader et de coach pour inspirer, engager et faire grandir vos équipes

• Doté d'une forte pensée systémique, vous excellez dans la gestion d'environnements complexes et pilotez vos projets avec agilité

• Vos compétences en négociation de haut niveau et votre sens des affaires (business acumen) sont reconnus

• Vous possédez une excellente communication (écrite et orale), un esprit de synthèse affûté

• Votre anglais est courant

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Project Leader
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Project Leader , serás responsable de generar una experiencia de cliente superior desde tu experiencia en gestión de proyectos, logrando implementar soluciones integrales que garanticen la máxima satisfacción, fidelización del cliente y la rentabilidad de nuestro negocio. En este rol dentro de la división de Diagnóstica (DIA), actuarás como el orquestador técnico y operativo que planifica, ejecuta y asegura la puesta en marcha de proyectos de mayor envergadura y complejidad.

The Opportunity

• Orquestar la implementación: Planificar, coordinar y ejecutar la instalación de sistemas de diagnóstico de mediana y gran envergadura.

• Co-diseñar la estrategia: Validar las propuestas técnicas y económicas junto a los equipos de Comercial, Estrategia y Servicio Técnico.

• Optimizar recursos: Gestionar tiempos, costos y presupuestos en conjunto con los KAMs de Servicio y Líderes de línea.

• Asegurar la cadena de suministro: Monitorear el abastecimiento de instrumentos, reactivos y repuestos junto al área de Importaciones.

• Mitigar riesgos: Diseñar y ejecutar planes de contingencia eficaces ante desvíos en el cronograma.

• Comunicación y Control: Controlar el avance del proyecto, reportar los estados a los clientes (internos/externos) y mantener los KPIs actualizados.

Who you are

• Formación: Profesional titulado en áreas de la Salud (Tecnología Médica, Bioquímica, Biomédica o carreras afines) o Ingeniería (Civil, Electrónica, Industrial o carreras afines).

• Experiencia (Excluyente): Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en laboratorios clínicos, gestión de clientes e implementación de proyectos en el sector salud.

• Project Management: Experiencia demostrable en gestión de proyectos complejos, idealmente bajo metodología del PMI o metodologías ágiles.

• Herramientas: Dominio de Microsoft Project, Microsoft Excel, Monday.com o plataformas afines de análisis de datos y gestión de proyectos.

• Idiomas: Inglés intermedio (lectura técnica y comunicación operativa).

• Habilidades blandas: Orientación al cliente, autonomía, negociación y adaptabilidad al modelo de liderazgo VACC (Visionario, Arquitecto, Coach y Catalizador).

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
（高级）治疗领域专员负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
At Roche, we are in the midst of the ASPIRE program—one of our most significant enterprise-wide digital transformations, simplifying global processes and transitioning our global footprint to a modern ERP environment . A transformation of this scale succeeds only when built on a foundation of high-fidelity, trusted data .
The ASPIRE Data Migration team orchestrates the journey of our global data footprint . We are looking for a highly skilled Data Management & Governance Specialist to execute our end-to-end data migration strategy, ensuring a seamless, accurate, and secure transition from complex legacy systems to our future-state digital backbone .

The Role: What You Will Do
In this enterprise-level position, you will bridge the gap between technical data engineering and strategic business goals . You will navigate complex legacy data structures, manage large-scale data governance platforms, and ensure migrated data perfectly supports global operations .
Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Migration Strategy Execution: Lead the design and execution of comprehensive data migration frameworks, policies, and processes to smoothly transition legacy data into the new ERP environment .

• Advanced Governance & Compliance: Design, implement, and maintain advanced enterprise-level data governance frameworks that scale across the organization, ensuring robust data compliance practices .

• Complex Problem Solving: Tackle highly complex data migration anomalies and discrepancies, performing root-cause analysis to protect the integrity of corporate data .

• Data Profiling & Quality: Establish rigorous data quality metrics, validation standards, cleansing routines, and profiling methodologies to ensure a high-fidelity migration .

• Target Data Mapping: Analyze convoluted, highly fragmented legacy data architectures and map them cleanly to future-state target ERP data models .

• Senior Stakeholder Alignment: Act as a key strategic advisor, liaising directly with senior leadership, functional business owners, and external vendors to align on migration strategy and translate technical data risks into clear business impacts .

• Team Leadership & Mentorship: Guide, direct, and mentor junior specialists and cross-functional teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment .

​ What You Will Bring to the Team
Experience & Background

• Extensive Experience: A proven track record of leading full-cycle data migration projects for major ERP platforms and continuously improving complex migration frameworks .

• Governance Impact: Demonstrated success spearheading high-impact data governance projects that successfully shape overarching organizational data policies and long-term business strategies .

• Matrix Collaboration: Experience working alongside technical teams, business leaders, and external consultants within a global, fast-moving organization .

Technical Skills & Craft

• Tooling Expertise: Recognized technical mastery in industry-standard data migration and ETL tools .

• Data Cleansing & Profiling: Advanced capabilities in data profiling, structural validation, and complex data cleansing to achieve absolute data hygiene .

• Data Modeling: Exceptional ability to deconstruct legacy systems and translate them into clean, structured target configurations .

Leadership & Communication

• Executive Presence: Exceptional stakeholder management and advisory skills, comfortable guiding senior executives through governance strategy decis

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Chi siamo A Roche, siamo nel mezzo del programma ASPIRE, una delle nostre più significative trasformazioni digitali a livello aziendale, semplificando i processi globali e trasformando la nostra impronta globale in un ambiente ERP moderno . Una trasformazione di questa scala riesce solo quando costruito su una fondazione di alta fedeltà, dati di fiducia. Il team ASPIRE Data Migration organizza il viaggio della nostra impronta globale dei dati . Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto Data Management & Governance Specialist per eseguire la nostra strategia di migrazione dei dati end-to-end, garantendo una transizione senza soluzione di continuità, accurata e sicura da sistemi legacy complessi alla nostra backbone digitale di stato futuro. Il ruolo: cosa farai In questa posizione a livello aziendale, colmare il divario tra ingegneria dei dati tecnici e obiettivi strategici di business . Potrai navigare in strutture dati legacy complesse, gestire piattaforme di governance dati su larga scala, e garantire i dati migrati perfettamente supporta le operazioni globali. Le tue responsabilità principali includono:
• Esecuzione di strategia di migrazione: portare la progettazione e l'esecuzione di quadri di migrazione dati completi, politiche e processi per transizione senza intoppi dati legacy nel nuovo ambiente ERP .
• Governance & Compliance Avanzata: Progettazione, implementare e mantenere avanzati framework di governance dei dati a livello aziendale che si ridimensionano in tutta l'organizzazione, garantendo pratiche di conformità dei dati robuste .
• Risolvere i problemi complessi: alterare le anomalie e le discrepanze della migrazione dei dati altamente complesse, eseguendo l'analisi root-cause per proteggere l'integrità dei dati aziendali.
• Data Profiling & Quality: Stabilire metriche di qualità dei dati rigorose, standard di validazione, routine di pulizia e metodologie di profilazione per garantire una migrazione ad alta fedeltà .
• Target Data Mapping: Analizzare architetture di dati legacy convolute e altamente frammentate e mapparle in modo pulito ai modelli di dati ERP target futuri.
• Senior Stakeholder Alignment: Atto come consulente strategico chiave, legandosi direttamente con leadership senior, proprietari di business funzionali e fornitori esterni per allineare sulla strategia di migrazione e tradurre i rischi di dati tecnici in chiari impatti aziendali.
• Team Leadership & Mentorship: Guida, diretto e mentore specialisti junior e team cross-funzionali, promuovendo un ambiente collaborativo e ad alto rendimento. Cosa porterai al team Esperienza e sfondo
• Extensive Experience: una comprovata traccia dei principali progetti di migrazione dei dati a ciclo pieno per le principali piattaforme ERP e migliorando continuamente i complessi framework di migrazione.
• Impatto di governance: il successo dimostrato guida progetti di governance dati ad alto impatto che modellano con successo le politiche organizzative dei dati e le strategie aziendali a lungo termine.
• Matrix Collaborazione: Esperienza di lavoro a fianco di team tecnici, leader aziendali e consulenti esterni all'interno di un'organizzazione globale, in rapida evoluzione . Competenze tecniche & Artigianato
• Tooling Expertise: masterizzazione tecnica riconosciuta nella migrazione dei dati standard del settore e strumenti ETL .
• Data Cleansing & Profiling: Capacità avanzate nella profilazione dei dati, validazione strutturale e pulizia dei dati complessa per raggiungere l'igiene dei dati assoluta.
• Data Modeling: eccezionale capacità di decostruire i sistemi legacy e tradurli in configurazioni target pulite e strutturate. Leadership e comunicazione
• Presenza esecutiva: Gestione eccezionale delle parti interessate e competenze di consulenza, guida confortevole dirigenti senior attraverso la strategia di governance decis

Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wer wir sind Bei Roche befinden wir uns mitten im ASPIRE-Programm – einer unserer wichtigsten unternehmensweiten digitalen Transformationen, die globale Prozesse vereinfacht und unsere globale Präsenz auf eine moderne ERP-Umgebung umstellt. Eine Transformation dieser Skala gelingt nur, wenn sie auf einer Grundlage von hochtreuen, vertrauenswürdigen Daten aufbaut. Das ASPIRE Data Migration Team orchestriert die Reise unseres globalen Daten-Fußabdrucks. Wir suchen einen hochqualifizierten Data Management & Governance-Spezialisten, der unsere End-to-End-Datenmigrationsstrategie umsetzt und einen nahtlosen, genauen und sicheren Übergang von komplexen Altsystemen zu unserem digitalen Rückgrat der Zukunft gewährleistet. Die Rolle: Was Sie tun werden In dieser Position auf Unternehmensebene schließen Sie die Lücke zwischen technischem Data Engineering und strategischen Geschäftszielen. Sie navigieren durch komplexe Legacy-Datenstrukturen, verwalten große Data-Governance-Plattformen und stellen sicher, dass migrierte Daten den globalen Betrieb perfekt unterstützen. Ihre Hauptaufgaben umfassen:
• Migrationsstrategieausführung: Führen Sie die Gestaltung und Ausführung umfassender Datenmigrations-Frameworks, -Richtlinien und -Prozesse, um Legacy-Daten reibungslos in die neue ERP-Umgebung zu überführen.
• Advanced Governance & Compliance: Konzipieren, implementieren und pflegen Sie fortschrittliche Data-Governance-Frameworks auf Unternehmensebene, die im gesamten Unternehmen skalierbar sind und robuste Daten-Compliance-Praktiken gewährleisten.
• Komplexe Problemlösung: Bewältigen Sie hochkomplexe Anomalien und Diskrepanzen bei der Datenmigration und führen Sie eine Ursachenanalyse durch, um die Integrität von Unternehmensdaten zu schützen.
• Datenprofilierung und -qualität: Festlegung strenger Datenqualitätsmetriken, Validierungsstandards, Bereinigungsroutinen und Profiling-Methoden, um eine Migration mit hoher Genauigkeit sicherzustellen.
• Target Data Mapping: Analysieren Sie verworrene, stark fragmentierte Legacy-Datenarchitekturen und ordnen Sie sie sauber zu Future-State-Ziel-ERP-Datenmodellen ab.
• Senior Stakeholder Alignment: Handeln Sie als wichtiger strategischer Berater und arbeiten Sie direkt mit Führungskräften, funktionalen Geschäftsinhabern und externen Anbietern zusammen, um sich auf die Migrationsstrategie auszurichten und technische Datenrisiken in klare Geschäftsauswirkungen umzusetzen.
• Team Leadership & Mentorship: Guide, Direct und Mentor Junior-Spezialisten und funktionsübergreifende Teams, die eine kollaborative und leistungsstarke Umgebung fördern. Was Sie dem Team bringen werden Erfahrung & Hintergrund
• Umfangreiche Erfahrung: Eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei führenden Full-Cycle-Datenmigrationsprojekten für große ERP-Plattformen und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung komplexer Migrationsframeworks.
• Governance Impact: Demonstrierter Erfolg an der Spitze von einflussreichen Data-Governance-Projekten, die übergreifende organisatorische Datenrichtlinien und langfristige Geschäftsstrategien erfolgreich gestalten.
• Matrix Collaboration: Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Teams, Unternehmensleitern und externen Beratern in einer globalen, schnelllebigen Organisation. Technische Fähigkeiten & Handwerk
• Tooling Expertise: Anerkannte technische Beherrschung der branchenüblichen Datenmigration und ETL-Tools.
• Data Cleansing & Profiling: Erweiterte Funktionen im Bereich Datenprofilierung, strukturelle Validierung und komplexe Datenbereinigung, um absolute Datenhygiene zu erreichen.
• Datenmodellierung: Außergewöhnliche Fähigkeit, Legacy-Systeme zu dekonstruieren und in saubere, strukturierte Zielkonfigurationen zu übersetzen. Führung & Kommunikation
• Executive-Präsenz: Außergewöhnliche Stakeholder-Management- und Beratungsfähigkeiten, komfortable Führung von Führungskräften durch Governance-Strategie

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Qui nous sommes Chez Roche, nous sommes au cœur du programme ASPIRE, l'une de nos transformations numériques les plus importantes à l'échelle de l'entreprise, simplifiant les processus mondiaux et transformant notre empreinte mondiale en un environnement ERP moderne. Une transformation de cette échelle ne réussit que lorsqu'elle est construite sur une base de haute fidélité, de données de confiance. L'équipe ASPIRE Data Migration orchestre le parcours de notre empreinte de données globale. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un spécialiste hautement qualifié en gestion de données et gouvernance pour exécuter notre stratégie de migration de données de bout en bout, en assurant une transition transparente, précise et sécurisée de systèmes existants complexes à notre colonne vertébrale numérique future. Le rôle : ce que vous ferez Dans cette position au niveau de l'entreprise, vous comblerez l'écart entre l'ingénierie des données techniques et les objectifs commerciaux stratégiques. Vous naviguerez dans des structures complexes de données existantes, gérerez des plates-formes de gouvernance de données à grande échelle et vous assurerez que les données migrées prennent parfaitement en charge les opérations mondiales. Vos responsabilités principales comprendront :
• Exécution de la stratégie de migration : Diriger la conception et l'exécution de cadres, de politiques et de processus complets de migration des données pour assurer une transition harmonieuse des données héritées dans le nouvel environnement ERP.
• Gouvernance et conformité avancées : Concevoir, mettre en oeuvre et maintenir des cadres avancés de gouvernance des données au niveau de l'entreprise qui s'étendent à l'ensemble de l'organisation, assurant des pratiques de conformité des données solides.
• Résoudre les problèmes complexes : Tâcher des anomalies et des anomalies de migration des données très complexes, effectuer une analyse racine-cause pour protéger l'intégrité des données de l'entreprise.
• Profil et qualité des données: Établir des mesures rigoureuses de qualité des données, des normes de validation, des routines de nettoyage et des méthodologies de profilage pour assurer une migration à haute fidélité.
• Cible de cartographie des données : Analyser les architectures de données existantes, très fragmentées, et les cartographier proprement aux modèles de données ERP cibles futurs.
• Alignement des intervenants principaux : Agir en tant que conseiller stratégique clé, assurer la liaison directe avec les cadres supérieurs, les propriétaires d'entreprises fonctionnels et les fournisseurs externes afin de s'aligner sur la stratégie de migration et de traduire les risques liés aux données techniques en impacts opérationnels clairs.
• Leadership d'équipe et mentorat : Guider, diriger et mentorer les jeunes spécialistes et les équipes interfonctionnelles, favoriser un environnement collaboratif et performant. Ce que vous apporterez à l'équipe Expérience et contexte
• Expérience approfondie: Une expérience éprouvée de projets de migration de données à cycle complet pour les grandes plates-formes ERP et l'amélioration continue des cadres de migration complexes.
• Impact de la gouvernance : Succès démontré à l'origine de projets de gouvernance des données à impact élevé qui façonnent avec succès les politiques globales en matière de données organisationnelles et les stratégies opérationnelles à long terme .
• Collaboration Matrix : Expérience en collaboration avec des équipes techniques, des chefs d'entreprise et des consultants externes au sein d'une organisation mondiale en évolution rapide. Compétences techniques et artisanat
• Expertise en matière d'outillage : Maîtrise technique reconnue dans les outils de migration de données standard et ETL.
• Nettoyage et profilage des données: Capacités avancées en profilage des données, validation structurelle et nettoyage des données complexes pour atteindre l'hygiène absolue des données.

• Exigences du poste : Au moins baccalauréat en informatique ou en informatique. Le titulaire du Master est préféré. Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la TI. Expérience de travail dans la solution numérique et le laboratoire hospitalier HIS/LIS / Interfaçage / AI intégré préféré L'expérience dans le développement de logiciels est préférée. Excellentes compétences en anglais oral et écrit; solides compétences en présentation et en communication et esprit ouvert Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

titleByLocale.en: Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

Operating within an innovation-driven biotech environment, our Technology department (RDT) sits at the intersection of regulatory compliance, quality systems, risk management, and digital transformation. We focus on defining and managing governance frameworks, policies, and processes that ensure our technology platforms—supporting both GxP and non-GxP critical business processes—operate in full compliance with internal standards and external regulations. Our mission is to embed compliance by design, strengthening the quality and risk posture of our systems while simultaneously enabling speed, scalability, and technological innovation. In this collaborative environment, we partner closely with Business Quality, Regulatory, Security, Legal, and Audit functions to advise executives and drive enterprise-wide strategy.

As the Head of Compliance and Quality Governance (Practice Leader), you will be accountable for the entire lifecycle of this critical function, from strategic planning and service design to operational execution and continuous improvement. Operating as a senior escalation and decision authority, you will define the functional vision, strategy, and roadmap, transforming business needs into tangible, high-value capabilities. Leveraging a distinctive combination of deep domain expertise, technical proficiency, and business insight, you will lead multidisciplinary teams to build and deliver desirable, viable, and sustainable functional services that meet the evolving needs of our users while maintaining strict regulatory compliance.

The Opportunity

• Strategy & Vision: Define and own the Technology Compliance & Quality Governance strategy, establishing clear governance frameworks, decision models, and accountabilities while translating global biotech regulations and corporate policies into clear technology outcomes.

• Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve as a trusted partner and senior escalation authority for executives, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Security leadership, representing Technology in executive forums, audits, inspections, and regulatory interactions.

• Functional Management & Delivery: Oversee the end-to-end delivery and lifecycle of defined functions (e.g., QMS), ensuring Technology adherence to GxP, CSV, data integrity, privacy, and global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO) through pragmatic, risk-based interpretations.

• Risk Management & Assurance: Lead enterprise-wide technology risk assessments and compliance maturity evaluations, ensuring timely and effective remediation of findings, deviations, and CAPAs.

• Team Leadership & Development: Build, coach, and develop a high-performing global team of professionals, fostering a culture of accountability and transparency while guiding senior leaders on risk-based decision-making.

• Operational Excellence & Improvement: Define success metrics (KPIs/OKRs) and leverage data analytics to drive informed decisions, immediate operational improvements, and strategic optimizations to achieve business goals.

• Financial & Resource Management: Manage the immediate team's budget and resources, developing detailed business cases—including cost-benefit analyses and resource estimates—for new functional initiatives and significant process changes.

Who You Are

• Experienced Global Leader: You bring 15+ years of IT domain experience, including 10+ years managing global multidisciplinary teams and 10+ years in Technology, Compliance, Q

This role is based in the Global Procurement function, which supports Roche’s goal of bringing innovative solutions to patients through business and supplier partnerships. We act as the bridge between Roche business functions and our suppliers, delivering value through productivity, speed, risk management, sustainability, innovative solutions, and streamlined buying experiences.

As the Procurement Solutions Manager (AI), you will be part of Digital Procurement Solutions & Excellence. You will work closely with Procurement SMEs, internal AI solution engineers, Digital peers, IT, Analytics & Insights, and external partners to move high-value ideas from opportunity framing into robust solution concepts, pilots, and scalable implementations. You will bridge strategic AI priorities and the practical realities of building reliable, enterprise-ready solutions in a complex global procurement environment.

• Solution Evaluation & Observability: Utilize enterprise LLM observability and evaluation tools to monitor agent behavior, track accuracy, analyze failure modes, and systematically iterate on prompts and workflow logic to ensure production-grade reliability.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo ruolo si basa sulla funzione Global Procurement, che supporta l’obiettivo di Roche di portare soluzioni innovative ai pazienti attraverso partnership di business e fornitori. Agiamo come ponte tra le funzioni aziendali Roche e i nostri fornitori, offrendo valore attraverso produttività, velocità, gestione dei rischi, sostenibilità, soluzioni innovative e esperienze di acquisto semplificate. In qualità di Procurement Solutions Manager (AI), farai parte di Digital Procurement Solutions & Excellence. Il nostro scopo è quello di promuovere la consegna del valore attraverso soluzioni digitali e eccellenza, con Digital & AI che aumenta e amplifica la nostra capacità e capacità di magnificare i risultati, alla fine di fornire un maggiore impatto per persona e una migliore esperienza di approvvigionamento. Segnalandosi al Leader delle soluzioni AI di appalti, la vostra responsabilità primaria è quella di progettare, costruire, testare e distribuire agenti AI e flussi di lavoro agentici che trasformano i processi di approvvigionamento. Sfruttando le tue conoscenze e competenze specialistiche, lavorerai a stretto contatto con l'IA Generativa, piattaforme di orchestrazione del flusso di lavoro, MCP, sistemi aziendali e fonti di dati interne per fornire soluzioni AI pronte alla produzione. Aiuterai proattivamente il Global Procurement a migliorare la produttività, la velocità, l'esperienza utente, la qualità e il processo decisionale in tutto l'ecosistema di approvvigionamento. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con le PMI di approvvigionamento, gli ingegneri della soluzione AI interna, i coetanei digitali, l'IT, l'analisi e le insights e i partner esterni per spostare idee ad alto valore dall'opportunità di inquadrare in concetti di soluzione robusta, piloti e implementazioni scalabili. Avrete a ponte le priorità strategiche dell'IA e le realtà pratiche di costruire soluzioni affidabili e pronte all'impresa in un complesso ambiente di approvvigionamento globale. Le tue responsabilità chiave: In qualità di Procurement Solutions Manager (AI), svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale in base alle tue esigenze di esperienza, conoscenza e business/team strategici, inclusi ma non limitati a:
• AI Solution Discovery & Design: Partner con i team di approvvigionamento per identificare, strutturare e convalidare i casi di automazione ad alto impatto e utilizzo di AI. Traduci le esigenze aziendali, la complessità del processo, i requisiti politici, le realtà dei dati e le considerazioni sull'esperienza degli utenti in progetti di soluzione chiari.
• Workflow & Agent Design: Progettare e costruire logica di flusso di lavoro intelligente per l'approvvigionamento di casi di utilizzo, combinando capacità di AI, regole aziendali, integrazioni MCP e API, controlli di dati, passi umani-in-the-loop e controlli di qualità misurabili. Creare, configurare e incorporare agenti AI in sistemi e processi di approvvigionamento esistenti per automatizzare le attività end-to-end.
• Prototipazione rapida: costruire e testare le prove iniziali-di-concetto (PoCs) utilizzando strumenti di automazione del flusso di lavoro (ad esempio, n8n, Zapier) e fonti di dati interne per convalidare il valore rapidamente prima dell'ingegneria su larga scala. Traduci gli insegnamenti in specifiche attuabili per team interni, partner esterni e ingegneri di soluzioni.
• Valutazione & Osservabilità della soluzione: Utilizzare strumenti di osservazione e valutazione LLM aziendali per monitorare il comportamento dell'agente, tracciare la precisione, analizzare i modi di guasto, e iterare sistematicamente su richieste e logica del flusso di lavoro per garantire l'affidabilità di livello di produzione.
• Build & Delivery Orchestration: Agite come proprietario del prodotto/soluzione dalla scoperta al rollout scalabile. Gestisci portata, tempestività, dipendenze, ipotesi di valore, metriche di successo, rischi e aspettative degli stakeholder in un ambiente di matrice complesso.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Security Engineer

Job description
The Mission: You will be a key member of the SIEM team, contributing to the engineering and strategic evolution of our global Security Log Management and Vulnerability Scanning services. This is an end-to-end ownership role: from defining the roadmap and architectural strategy to hands-on engineering and operational excellence. You will ensure our security infrastructure is not only reliable and scalable but also optimized for the modern era of federated data and AI-driven automation.
Description of the area

Key Responsibilities:

• Service Ownership & Strategy: Drive the end-to-end lifecycle of our Security Log Management (Splunk & Cribl) and Security Scanning (Tenable) platforms.

• Service Reliability: Ensure the high availability and performance of our security services globally, acting as an escalation point for complex technical challenges.

• System Interconnectivity: Develop and manage sophisticated API integrations to ensure seamless data flow between the security scanning (Tenable) and logging (Splunk/Cribl) tiers.

• Next-Gen Security Log Architecture: Drive the transition from a traditional "index-all" logging approach to a "data-tiering" mindset. You will focus on cost optimization and performance across all data lifecycle phases: routing, filtering, storing and searching, ensuring security data is accessible and cost-effective.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Orchestrate the evolution of our security infrastructure by managing all configurations via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub, Ansible, and Python), to ensure a fully automated and version-controlled environment.

• AI-Augmented Engineering: Actively integrate AI Agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers into daily operations. You will build agentic AI workflows to automate configuration, troubleshooting, and complex interconnectivity, while simultaneously improving service offerings and user experience.

• Mentorship: Act as a technical catalyst for the team, mentoring colleagues in the art of prompt engineering, agentic AI development, and advanced AI ecosystems.

• Technical Leadership: Serve as a technical lead, defining implementation plans and driving continuous process improvements.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Effectively manage relationships across functional teams, acting as a clear communicator and advisor to ensure alignment on security goals and project delivery.

Technical Requirements & Expertise:

• Security Service Depth: Deep conceptual understanding of the SIEM/Log Management lifecycle (Collection, Indexing, Storage, Retention and Searching) and Vulnerability Management.

• Networking Fundamentals: Expert understanding of networking (TCP/IP, Load Balancing, Firewalls) as it relates to high-volume security data transport.

• Coding & API Mastery: Strong experience with Python and interacting with complex REST APIs. Proven ability to interconnect disparate technologies via APIs and custom integrations.

• Modern DevOps: Strong experience with Ansible and GitHub for managing infrastructure.

• Advanced AI/Automation: Proven experience or deep project work building Agentic AI workflows. Practical expertise in MCP (Model Context Protocol) or building custom LLM-based tools to automate technical tasks.

• Tooling (Preferred): Experience with Cribl, Splunk, or Tenable is a plus, but the ability to rapidly upscale and automate these via AI is essential.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 10

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Security Engineer

Job description
The Mission: You will be a key member of the SIEM team, contributing to the engineering and strategic evolution of our global Security Log Management and Vulnerability Scanning services. This is an end-to-end ownership role: from defining the roadmap and architectural strategy to hands-on engineering and operational excellence. You will ensure our security infrastructure is not only reliable and scalable but also optimized for the modern era of federated data and AI-driven automation.
Description of the area

Key Responsibilities:

• Service Ownership & Strategy: Drive the end-to-end lifecycle of our Security Log Management (Splunk & Cribl) and Security Scanning (Tenable) platforms.

• Service Reliability: Ensure the high availability and performance of our security services globally, acting as an escalation point for complex technical challenges.

• System Interconnectivity: Develop and manage sophisticated API integrations to ensure seamless data flow between the security scanning (Tenable) and logging (Splunk/Cribl) tiers.

• Next-Gen Security Log Architecture: Drive the transition from a traditional "index-all" logging approach to a "data-tiering" mindset. You will focus on cost optimization and performance across all data lifecycle phases: routing, filtering, storing and searching, ensuring security data is accessible and cost-effective.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Orchestrate the evolution of our security infrastructure by managing all configurations via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub, Ansible, and Python), to ensure a fully automated and version-controlled environment.

• AI-Augmented Engineering: Actively integrate AI Agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers into daily operations. You will build agentic AI workflows to automate configuration, troubleshooting, and complex interconnectivity, while simultaneously improving service offerings and user experience.

• Mentorship: Act as a technical catalyst for the team, mentoring colleagues in the art of prompt engineering, agentic AI development, and advanced AI ecosystems.

• Technical Leadership: Serve as a technical lead, defining implementation plans and driving continuous process improvements.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Effectively manage relationships across functional teams, acting as a clear communicator and advisor to ensure alignment on security goals and project delivery.

Technical Requirements & Expertise:

• Security Service Depth: Deep conceptual understanding of the SIEM/Log Management lifecycle (Collection, Indexing, Storage, Retention and Searching) and Vulnerability Management.

• Networking Fundamentals: Expert understanding of networking (TCP/IP, Load Balancing, Firewalls) as it relates to high-volume security data transport.

• Coding & API Mastery: Strong experience with Python and interacting with complex REST APIs. Proven ability to interconnect disparate technologies via APIs and custom integrations.

• Modern DevOps: Strong experience with Ansible and GitHub for managing infrastructure.

• Advanced AI/Automation: Proven experience or deep project work building Agentic AI workflows. Practical expertise in MCP (Model Context Protocol) or building custom LLM-based tools to automate technical tasks.

• Tooling (Preferred): Experience with Cribl, Splunk, or Tenable is a plus, but the ability to rapidly upscale and automate these via AI is essential.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 10

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
JD - China Enterprise Technology Intern
Company: Roche
Organization: China Enterprise Technology (CET)
Location: Shanghai, China
Duration: 3–6 months

Position Summary
Roche is seeking a versatile and highly motivated Enterprise Technology Intern to join our China Enterprise Technology (CET) team. In this hybrid role, you will bridge the gap between technical project management, DevOps engineering, and operations research.
You will be instrumental in driving our infrastructure modernization by coordinating the large-scale migration of over 100 GitLab projects. Simultaneously, you will dive deep into scientific computing by designing a Linear Programming model to optimize GPU resource allocation for our complex, data-heavy scientific workloads (such as bioinformatics and computational chemistry).

Key Responsibilities
1. Project Coordination & Governance

• Act as the project coordinator for cross-functional IT, DevOps, and scientific computing teams within CET.

• Facilitate project meetings, track milestones, and manage timelines using Agile methodologies.

• Maintain clear documentation, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and present progress reports to technical leads and stakeholders.

• Identify project bottlenecks and collaborate with team members to resolve blockers efficiently.
2. Large-Scale GitLab Projects Migration

• Plan and execute the seamless migration of 100+ GitLab projects into a unified, secure enterprise environment.

• Ensure the integrity of source code, commit histories, access controls, and environment variables during the transition.

• Update and validate CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous integration remains uninterrupted post-migration.

• Create automated scripts and clear user guides to assist development teams in adapting to the new repository structures.
3. Computing Resource Optimization for Scientific Workloads

• Formulate a Linear Programming (LP) model to optimize the scheduling and allocation of Computing resources for intensive scientific workloads (e.g., genomics, drug discovery simulations, and AI/ML modeling).

• Analyze compute constraints, job priorities, memory requirements, and runtime patterns to maximize cluster throughput and minimize idle time.

• Implement optimization solutions using Python libraries

• Deliver data-driven insights and a proof-of-concept scheduling algorithm to improve the cost-efficiency of Roche’s scientific computing infrastructure.
Key Qualifications

• Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Maths, Bioinformatics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

• DevOps & IT Skills: Experience with version control systems (Git) and an understanding of CI/CD pipelines.

• Programming & Math: Strong proficiency in Python and a solid foundational knowledge of mathematical optimization and Linear Programming.

• Project Management: Familiarity with Agile frameworks and project management tools like Jira, Confluence, or Monday.

• Domain Interest: A strong interest in scientific computing, healthcare technology, or bioinformatics infrastructure.

• Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving abilities, strong communication skills, and the capacity to work independently in a dynamic environment.

• Languages: Fluent in both Mandarin and English (written and spoken).
What We Offer

• Meaningful, hands-on experience at the intersection of enterprise IT, DevOps, and life sciences.

• Direct mentorship from experienced architects, DevOps engineers,

jobs.title: Business Innovation Manager (Molecular Lab)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

• Roche Diagnostics Pakistan is looking for a Product Manager, internally titled as Manager Business Innovation Molecular. Reporting to the Team Lead- Business Innovation, this position will see you developing specific marketing plans for products within the organization, interprets and translate scientific clinical data into commercial implications. You will analyze data and make strategic recommendations while providing marketing insight and direction to optimize new product launches.

• This is a permanent and individual contributor position based in Karachi, within our Diagnostics business.

Your Opportunity

• Conceptualize, lead, execute and/or coordinate all activities related to product launches, product promotions, scientific training and for the Sales team, Customer & market analyses, co-creation and implementation of marketing plans and management of allocated A& P budget.

• Co-create with Medical, Sales teams, Clinical Value Marketing promotional, educational, access and partnership initiatives or business model solutions, which support faster adoption of Diagnostics solutions according to clinical guidelines and protocols

• Partner with relevant internal and external stakeholders to develop and communicate unique value propositions for our Diagnostics portfolio

• Identify strategic partners (public or private organizations) which can facilitate improved Patient Access – e.g. MoH, telehealth/teleconsultation system providers, insurance and financial institutions, patient coaching providers, NGOs, Hospitals etc.

• Co-develop the marketing plan based on robust market insights and analytics and informed by regular key Customer visits with Medical & Sales

• Source & analyze (including the development of business cases) market insight for new product launch potential, competitor intelligence, hospital procurement policies, pricing, etc.

• Leverage globally developed campaigns and brand assets to deploy locally translated promotional/educational materials for new and existing products, including brochures, leaflets, detailing materials, presentations, Lead HCP and Institutional marketing efforts for product promotion. including disease education

• Maintain strong disease and product knowledge; support internal and external customer education programs and product training

• Lead KOL engagement and speaker programs

• Leverage Medical and Scientific studies to create content for patients, HCPs and Institutions

• Drive shift in engaging HCPs on digital marketing platforms

• Conduct double visits with the Sales team to shape actionable content and format for the product training and promotional campaigns

• Coordinate with Medical to establish relevant presence and engagement for strategic events (symposia, conferences, etc.)

• Collaborate seamlessly with the rest of the Sales, Medical and other functions to deliver on the company’s objectives

• Ensure full compliance with Roche policies, coordinate with Quality & Regulatory functions, and secure timely and proper approval & documentation of activities and assets according to SOPs including the local customization process

• Contribute to actionable training & progress of the Sales Team by feedback & feed forward and sharing Customer Insight

• Implement Globally developed/validated tools and assets, customized for local use as applicable

• Track and consolidate relevant analytics and ROI KPIs

• Adopt

• Mantenere la forte malattia e la conoscenza del prodotto; sostenere i programmi di formazione interna ed esterna del cliente e formazione del prodotto
• Lead KOL programmi di fidanzamento e altoparlanti
• Studi medici e scientifici per creare contenuti per pazienti, HCP e istituzioni
• Spostamento dell'azionamento in HCP coinvolgente sulle piattaforme di marketing digitale
• Condurre le doppie visite con il team Vendite per modellare contenuti e formati attuabili per la formazione dei prodotti e le campagne promozionali
• Coordinate con Medico per stabilire presenza e impegno rilevanti per eventi strategici (simposia, conferenze, ecc.)
• Collaborare senza soluzione di continuità con il resto delle funzioni Vendite, Mediche e altre da fornire sugli obiettivi dell’azienda
• Assicurare la piena conformità alle politiche Roche, coordinare le funzioni di Quality & Regulatory e garantire tempestiva e corretta approvazione e documentazione delle attività e dei beni secondo le SOP, incluso il processo di personalizzazione locale
• Contribuisci alla formazione attiva e al progresso del Team Vendite tramite feedback e feed forward e condivisione della Customer Insight
• Strumenti e attività globalmente sviluppati/validati, personalizzati per uso locale come applicabile
• Tracciare e consolidare le analisi pertinenti e i KPI ROI
• Adozione

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. La tua opportunità Accelera la tua carriera in medicina di precisione Se stai cercando di passare dalle vendite mediche tradizionali alla frontiera dell'innovazione genomica, questo ruolo permanente offre la piattaforma perfetta per la tua evoluzione professionale. Nell'ambito del team Foundation Medicine Inc. (FMI) all'interno di Roche Diagnostics Pakistan, questo ruolo è basato in Lahore e coprirà le regioni centrali e nord. Segnalando direttamente al Business Manager per FMI, non solo gestirai un territorio – costruirai un mercato, espanderai il tuo acume strategico aziendale e ti stabilirai come un esperto leader nella profilazione genomica completa (CGP).
• Il punto di contatto primario (ma non esclusivo) tra le parti interessate e Roche: Possedere il proprio territorio e costruire partnership di alto livello servendo come il volto di fiducia, esperto di medicina della Fondazione (FMI) per oncologi di spicco, patologi, e schede tumorali multidisciplinari in tutte le regioni del Centro e del Nord.
• Responsabile per i prodotti Roche attraverso il loro ciclo di vita e supporta il loro uso appropriato, che include la condivisione dei loro meriti con HCP: Campione dell'adozione scientifica del portafoglio di test genomici all'avanguardia di FMI, influenzando direttamente percorsi sanitari personalizzati.
• Conoscenza del paesaggio delle malattie e dei prodotti: Affilare le tue competenze scientifiche masterizzando oncologia molecolare complessa, diagnostica di precisione e dati genomici per consultare con fiducia esperti medici di alto livello.
• Responsabilità dei prodotti Roche attraverso il loro ciclo di vita e sostenere il suo uso appropriato: salire alla sfida di gestire gli obiettivi commerciali regionali, affinare le vostre capacità di pianificazione e esecuzione del territorio.
• Ampia comprensione della sua area terapeutica e della sua rispettiva futura pipeline, tale da poter lavorare su soluzioni future: Crescere in un leader strategico collaborando direttamente con FMI Business Manager per co-creare progetti di business regionali, analizzare le dinamiche di mercato e mappare conti istituzionali a lungo termine.
• Partner con stakeholder di viaggio del paziente per rimuovere i blocchi stradali e sbloccare le possibilità per fornire valore per i pazienti e la comunità: Sviluppare sofisticate capacità di problem solving mentre lavori in ecosistemi ospedalieri complessi per ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro di test genomici dal campione al report.
• Consapevolezza della malattia Diagnosi: Posizionati come leader di pensiero educando i medici sul valore di cambiamento del paradigma della profilazione genomica completa sul test tradizionale.
• Istruzione HCP (prodotti pre-approvati e post-approvati) : Espandi le tue capacità professionali di presentazione e leadership guidando tavole rotonde scientifiche, riunioni mediche e recensioni di casi clinici.
• I pazienti’ Accesso ai fondi disponibili, ad esempio PBM/SSP & altri: Ottieni una preziosa esperienza nell'accesso al mercato sanitario esplorando e sfruttando i finanziamenti istituzionali e i viali di supporto dei pazienti.
• Comunicazione proattiva con HCP su PSP: Soluzioni impattanti per il paziente-centric assicurando ai fornitori di servizi sanitari la piena consapevolezza dei programmi progettati per massimizzare l'accessibilità ai test.
• PJP agisce come un pensatore di sistema con la capacità di identificare lo scopo condiviso tra le parti interessate e lo sfrutta per co-creare soluzioni con le parti interessate nell'ecosistema: Sviluppare capacità di "sistemi di pensiero" di alto livello incorporando i test FMI nei protocolli clinici ospedalieri standard.
• Responsabile del repo
