jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Project Management. Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology. You will work with solutions teams for Marketing Technologies who are tasked to deliver strategic transformation while sustaining and evolving ongoing solution operations. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Project Management & Coordination : Coordinate daily project execution across the solution area by facilitating ceremonies (scrums, sprint planning), maintaining product backlogs, and actively managing action and decision logs.

• Inbound Funnel Control & Prioritization : Act as the primary project point of contact to capture, structure, and funnel heavy volumes of cross-program requests, ensuring the product teams maintain adequate focus on prioritized objectives.

• Cross-Program Coordination : Coordinate with other programs and incoming functional demands. Actively plan, track, and facilitate complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with overarching strategic timelines.

• Dependency & Interface Management : Actively manage and track end-to-end dependencies - both internal and external - while refining handover interfaces between product owners and other functions.

• Portfolio Transparency & Consistency : Provide structural project management to maintain project standards, ensuring clear, transparent, and connected tracking of the product's initiative portfolio for leadership visibility.

• Performance Reporting : Establish and drive consistent project KPI tracking and status reporting across the specific product area to ensure schedule and budget adherence across all parallel initiatives.

• Project Management capability development : Serve as a subject matter expert, providing project management delivery coaching to the product teams to embed "one way of project delivery" across the organization.

Capability Building
Be an active member of the Project Management Chapter by

• Continuously improve the project management capabilities , service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics

• Supporting the development of upskilling content and toolkits for our team

• Actively managing your own development

• Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your chapter colleagues

Who You Are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes

• University degree with 5+ years of project management experience; a background in bu

Come organizzazione globale di oltre 3.500 colleghi, possiamo consentire a Roche di operare in un ambiente di business competitivo e in continua evoluzione. Forniamo ai nostri partner servizi e soluzioni aziendali end-to-end, consentendo loro di concentrarsi sulle attività incentrate sui pazienti. Abbracciando una mentalità OneRoche, facciamo leva sulla nostra rete globale situata a Budapest (Ungheria), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), e i nostri altri siti per rimanere clienti-centric 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7 e co-creare soluzioni insieme. L'opportunità Come Project Manager sarete parte dell'organizzazione di gestione del progetto RSS e riferire al capo Piombo per la gestione dei progetti. Sei un appassionato di project management e vuoi fornire i migliori servizi di gestione dei progetti di classe ai partner di Roche? Allora tu sei il candidato che stiamo cercando. In questo ruolo sarete responsabili per la consegna del progetto di successo utilizzando una metodologia di gestione agile o tradizionale del progetto. Potrai lavorare con i team di soluzioni per Marketing Technologies che sono incaricati di fornire una trasformazione strategica, supportando e evolvendo le operazioni di soluzione in corso. Il vostro lavoro comprenderà, ma non sarà limitato a: Engagement Delivery
• Project Management & Coordination: Coordinare l'esecuzione giornaliera del progetto in tutta l'area della soluzione facilitando cerimonie (scrums, pianificazione sprint), mantenendo i backlog del prodotto e gestendo attivamente i registri delle azioni e delle decisioni.
• Inbound Funnel Control & Prioritization: Atto come punto di contatto principale del progetto per catturare, strutturare e imbuto volumi pesanti di richieste cross-program, assicurando che i team di prodotto mantengano sufficiente attenzione sugli obiettivi prioritari.
• Coordinamento cross-Program: Coordinamento con altri programmi e richieste funzionali in arrivo. Pianificare, tracciare e facilitare iniziative complesse e multi-stakeholder, garantendo un'integrazione e un allineamento senza soluzione di continuità con tempi strategici overarching.
• Gestione delle dipendenze e delle interfacce: gestione attiva e monitoraggio delle dipendenze end-to-end - sia interne che esterne - mentre raffinazione delle interfacce di handover tra i proprietari dei prodotti e altre funzioni.
• Portfolio Transparency & Consistency: Fornire la gestione dei progetti strutturali per mantenere gli standard di progetto, assicurando un monitoraggio chiaro, trasparente e connesso del portafoglio di iniziative del prodotto per la visibilità della leadership.
• Performance Reporting: Stabilire e guidare il monitoraggio costante del progetto KPI e la segnalazione dello stato attraverso l'area specifica del prodotto per garantire la pianificazione e l'aderenza del budget in tutte le iniziative parallele.
• Sviluppo delle capacità di gestione del progetto: Servire come esperto di materia tematica, fornire la consegna di project management ai team di prodotti per incorporare "un modo di consegna del progetto" in tutta l'organizzazione. Capability Building Essere un membro attivo del Capitolo Project Management
• Migliorare costantemente le capacità di gestione del progetto, le offerte di servizio e il coinvolgimento della comunità sfruttando gli ultimi sviluppi e le dinamiche di mercato
• Sostenere lo sviluppo di contenuti e toolkit upskilling per il nostro team
• Gestione attiva del proprio sviluppo
• Applicare i tuoi insegnamenti durante gli impegni e condividerli con i tuoi colleghi del capitolo Chi sei Possiedi le seguenti qualifiche, esperienza e attributi personali
• Laurea universitaria con 5+ anni di esperienza di gestione del progetto; uno sfondo in bu

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) zielt darauf ab, "die Art und Weise, wie Roche arbeitet, zu verändern". Als globales Unternehmen mit über 3.500 Mitarbeitern ermöglichen wir Roche, in einem wettbewerbsintensiven und sich ständig verändernden Geschäftsumfeld zu agieren. Wir bieten unseren Partnern End-to-End-Services und -Lösungen, damit sie sich auf patientenzentrierte Aktivitäten konzentrieren können. Mit unserer OneRoche-Mentalität nutzen wir unser globales Netzwerk in Budapest (Ungarn), Riga (Lettland), Chennai & Hyderabad (Indien), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia) und unseren anderen Standorten, um kundenorientiert zu bleiben und gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln. Die Chance Als Projektmanager sind Sie Teil der RSS Project Management Organisation und berichten an den Chapter Lead für Projektmanagement. Sind Sie ein Projektmanagement-Enthusiast und möchten Ihren Partnern in ganz Roche einen erstklassigen Projektmanagement-Service anbieten? Dann sind Sie der Kandidat, den wir suchen. In dieser Rolle sind Sie für eine erfolgreiche Projektabwicklung mit agiler oder traditioneller Projektmanagement-Methodik verantwortlich. Sie arbeiten mit Lösungsteams für Marketing-Technologien zusammen, die die Aufgabe haben, eine strategische Transformation durchzuführen und gleichzeitig die laufenden Lösungsaktivitäten zu unterstützen und weiterzuentwickeln. Ihre Arbeit umfasst, aber nicht beschränkt auf: Verpflichtungserklärung
• Projektmanagement & Koordination: Koordinieren Sie die tägliche Projektausführung im gesamten Lösungsbereich, indem Sie Zeremonien (Scrums, Sprintplanung), Produktrückstände und aktives Management von Aktions- und Entscheidungsprotokollen erleichtern.
• Inbound Funnel Control & Prioritization: Handeln Sie als primärer Projektkontaktpunkt, um große Mengen an programmübergreifenden Anfragen zu erfassen, zu strukturieren und zu leiten, um sicherzustellen, dass sich die Produktteams angemessen auf priorisierte Ziele konzentrieren.
• Programmübergreifende Koordination: Koordinieren Sie sich mit anderen Programmen und eingehenden funktionalen Anforderungen. Planen, verfolgen und erleichtern Sie aktiv komplexe Multi-Stakeholder-Initiativen, um eine nahtlose Integration und Ausrichtung auf die übergreifenden strategischen Zeitpläne zu gewährleisten.
• Dependency & Interface Management: Aktives Verwalten und Verfolgen von End-to-End-Abhängigkeiten - sowohl intern als auch extern - und Verfeinern von Übergabeschnittstellen zwischen Produktbesitzern und anderen Funktionen.
• Portfoliotransparenz und -konsistenz: Bieten Sie strukturelles Projektmanagement, um die Projektstandards einzuhalten und eine klare, transparente und vernetzte Verfolgung des Initiativportfolios des Produkts für die Sichtbarkeit von Führungskräften zu gewährleisten.
• Performance Reporting: Etablierung und Förderung einer konsistenten Projekt-KPI-Tracking- und Statusberichterstattung über den spezifischen Produktbereich, um die Einhaltung des Zeitplans und des Budgets in allen parallelen Initiativen sicherzustellen.
• Entwicklung von Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten: Dienen Sie als Fachexperte und bieten Sie Projektmanagement-Delivery-Coaching für die Produktteams, um "One Way of Project Delivery" in der gesamten Organisation einzubetten. jobs.title: Projektleiter:in Bau & Architektur (w/m/d, 80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Die Organisation “Standort Basel / Kaiseraugst”, Teil der globalen Group Function “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, stellt die Infrastruktur und Services für den gesamten Standort Basel & Kaiseraugst bereit und entwickelt diese kontinuierlich und auf innovative Art weiter. Wir arbeiten mit allen Anspruchsgruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zusammen, von der frühen Forschung bis zur Versorgung der Patient:innen. Bei uns kannst du dich auf ein modernes Organisationsmodell freuen, in welchem du in Eigenverantwortung deine Talente in sinnhafter Arbeit einbringen kannst. Wir garantieren Gestaltungsspielraum und Entscheidungsfreiheit in unserer Organisation.

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Unser Fokus liegt auf langfristigen Investitionen im Bereich Forschung und Entwicklung, um das Leben von Menschen zu verbessern - heute und für künftige Generationen.
Der Bereich Site Assets Project Delivery ist an den Standorten Basel & Kaiseraugst verantwortlich für die kosten-, termin- und qualitätsgerechte Durchführung von Investitionsprojekten.

Wir arbeiten in einem rollenbasierten Modell, das Tätigkeiten in unterschiedlichen Verantwortungsbereichen ermöglicht .

Deine Möglichkeit

Als erfahrener Projektleiter auf Bauherrenseite übernehme ich die professionelle Bauherrenvertretung für Roche. In dieser Rolle verantworte ich die ganzheitliche Leitung und Steuerung von anspruchsvollen Bau-, Labor-, Infrastruktur- und Engineering-Projekten im regulierten Pharma-Umfeld.

• Projektsteuerung & -initiierung: Durchführung von Machbarkeitsstudien (Feasibility Studies) sowie die strategische Projektinitiierung und -organisation gemäß den Anforderungen von Auftraggebern, Nutzern und Betreibern.

• Beschaffung & Vertragsmanagement: Professionelle Erstellung und Prüfung von Konzepten, Ausschreibungen und Vergabeunterlagen sowie die anschließende Beauftragung und Überwachung der Dienstleistungen.

• Projektcontrolling: Umfassendes Kosten-, Termin-, Änderungs- und Risikomanagement zur Sicherung des Projekterfolgs.

• Ressourcen- & Stakeholdermanagement: Effiziente Koordination von Architekten, Fachplanern, Ingenieuren und ausführenden Unternehmen sowie enge Abstimmung mit internen, teils globalen Teams.

• Compliance & Qualität: Konsequente Sicherstellung aller regulatorischen Vorgaben, Qualitätsrichtlinien und Standards zur Arbeitssicherheit.

• Design & Corporate Identity: Verbindliche Einhaltung und Umsetzung der spezifischen Vorgaben der Roche Corporate Architecture .

• Engineering-Expertise: Fachliche Führung von komplexen Projekten an der Schnittstelle von Bau, Labor und kritischer Infrastruktur.

Wer bist du

Du denkst positiv, handelst integer und reflektierst dich und deine Arbeit mit einem klaren Blick. Kommunikation liegt dir und du willst etwas bewegen – im Team und im Projekt als Challenger, Motivator und Macher.

Um deine Rolle als erfolgreiche/r Projektleiter:in (w/m/d) bestmöglich wahrnehmen zu können, bringst du folgende Fähigkeiten mit:

• Ausbildung & Architekturfokus: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Architektur, Bauingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Städtebau, Architektur und Innenarchitektur.

• Berufserfahrung im Pharma-Umfeld: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Leitung von Bauprojekten, idealerweise im regulierten Umfeld wie Pharma, Life Sciences, Chemie oder Industrie.

• Projekt- & Kostencontrolling: Fundierte Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement, im Kosten- und Terminc

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Abteilung Solids DP (Solida Produktion) ist Teil der Manufacturing Unit Solids am Produktionszentrum Kaiseraugst. In der Solida Produktion werden verschiedene feste Arzneiformen (Filmtabletten, Kapseln, Granulat in Glasflaschen) sowie kommerzielle als auch Entwicklungsprodukte hergestellt. Hierbei handelt es sich ausschließlich um High-Potent-Produkte mit einer Batch-Size zwischen 15 KG bis 100 KG. Das Produktionsteam besteht aus ca. 45 Mitarbeitern.

Die Möglichkeit
Als Produktionsexpert:in übernimmst du im Produktionsbereich die folgenden Aufgaben:

• Herstellung von Filmtabletten, Kapsel und deren Zwischenstufen

• Abfüllung von Granulaten in Glasflaschen

• Bedienen, Rüsten und Reinigen der zugehörigen Produktionsanlagen und Räumlichkeiten

• GMP-konforme Dokumentation der durchgeführten Arbeiten am Computersystem

• Warenbewegungen von GMP-Materialien

Wer Du Bist
Um in dieser spannenden Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringst du idealerweise Folgendes mit:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung vorzugsweise im Lebensmittelbereich oder Pharmabereich

• Erfahrung in der Herstellung von festen Arzneiformen (Kapsulierung, Tablettierung, Lackierung von großem Vorteil) im GMP-Bereich

• Gute EDV-Kenntnisse

• Erfahrung in der Herstellung von High-Potent-Produkten (von großem Vorteil)

• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit inkl. Nacht-, Samstag- und Sonntagsarbeit (5-Schicht)

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Du bringst Zuverlässigkeit, Teamgeist und eine hohe Eigeninitiative mit. Du arbeitest gerne selbstständig.

Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem aktuellen Lebenslauf und releventen Zeugnissen und werde Teil unseres Teams, um gemeinsam die Zukunft zu gestalten!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Produzione di compresse, capsule e loro intermedi
• Riempimento di granuli in bottiglie di vetro
• Operazione, installazione e pulizia di impianti e locali di produzione associati

• Formazione professionale completa preferibilmente nel settore alimentare o farmaceutico
• Esperienza nella produzione di forme di dosaggio solido (capsulamento, tablet, laccatura di grande vantaggio) nel settore GMP
• Buone competenze informatiche
• Esperienza nella produzione di prodotti ad alta potenza (di grande vantaggio)
• Prontezza per il lavoro a turni tra cui lavoro notturno, sabato e domenica (5 turni)
• Buona conoscenza del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura
• Porti affidabilità, spirito di squadra e un alto livello di iniziativa. Ti piace lavorare in modo indipendente. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur hautement qualifié en cybersécurité chargé de protéger notre empreinte numérique au niveau du terminal. Notre équipe gère des produits de sécurité critiques dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, y compris la détection et la réponse d'Endpoint (EDR), le contrôle d'application et l'effacement sécurisé des données. Notre équipe est composée d'experts en matière de cybersécurité et nous cherchons un ingénieur de la sécurité techniquement rigoureux pour nous rejoindre. Votre mission principale sera de maintenir et d'évoluer nos outils de sécurité, en apportant un état d'esprit de développement moderne et automatisé à nos pratiques de sécurité opérationnelle pour assurer une performance optimale. Responsabilités professionnelles
• Maintenance à l'échelle : Configurez, déployez et maintenez notre solution globale de détection et de réponse de point d'arrivée (EDR) sur des milliers de paramètres (Windows, macOS et Linux) pour assurer des performances maximales.
• Gouvernance du contrôle d'application : Concevoir, mettre en oeuvre et affiner les politiques de contrôle d'application (p. ex. AppLocker, WDAC ou équivalents tiers) pour s'assurer que seuls les exécutables de confiance, les scripts et les bibliothèques fonctionnent dans notre environnement, en conciliant la sécurité et la productivité des utilisateurs.
• Optimisation : Évaluation continue pour minimiser les faux positifs, optimiser les performances du système et améliorer le rapport signal-bruit global.
• Cycle de vie d'effacement sécurisé des données: Soutenir la maintenance et l'audit de nos services d'essuyage sécurisé des données de qualité entreprise.
• Automatisation : Tirer parti d'un état d'esprit de développement pour construire des scripts, des outils et des intégrations API qui automatisent les tâches d'ingénierie répétitives et les processus de déploiement.
• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Partenaire avec d'autres experts en cybersécurité, traduisant leurs exigences de sécurité profondes en solutions techniques évolutives et automatisées. Compétences Éducation / Expérience
• Baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, cybersécurité ou expérience pratique équivalente.
• 3 ans et plus d'expérience éprouvée en gestion de solutions EDR (par exemple Cortex XDR, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint) dans un environnement d'entreprise à grande échelle.
• Compétence en anglais écrit et parlé (niveau C1 ou supérieur). Compétences techniques
• Fondations de la sécurité : Bonne compréhension fondamentale de la cybersécurité des entreprises, en particulier autour de la sécurité des terminaux (plates-formes EDR/XDR comme Cortex XDR), de la liste blanche des applications et du traitement sécurisé des données.
• Expertise en contrôle d'application : Forte expérience pratique en conception, en déploiement et en maintien des stratégies de contrôle d'application/liste blanche dans les structures organisationnelles complexes.
• OS Internals: Une bonne compréhension des architectures du système d'exploitation, des processus, de la gestion de la mémoire et des systèmes de fichiers (Windows, Linux, macOS).
• Mindset analytique: Excellentes compétences de dépannage avec la capacité de plonger dans des journaux de système complexes pour retracer les problèmes à leur cause racine.
• Automatisation et déploiement : Expérience pratique avec les outils de gestion et de déploiement de configuration (p. ex. Ansible, Terraform, SCCM, Microsoft Intune, Jamf).
• Pratiques exemplaires en matière de développement : Compréhension solide du cycle de vie du développement logiciel (DDLC), du contrôle des versions (Git) et des pipelines CI/CD (p. ex. GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions). Qualifications supplémentaires

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Shape the Future of Secure Engineering with Roche

Are you ready to tackle bold challenges and make a real impact? At Roche, we’re not just building IT infrastructure — we’re engineering secure, scalable, and highly innovative software solutions that protect and empower digital health systems globally. We're looking for passionate and driven individuals to join our Certman PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) team as a Senior DevOps Engineer and help us lead the way in cutting-edge, trust-based technology.

Our Certman team issues and manages the digital certificates that secure Roche's internal systems and services worldwide. We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help us automate, scale, and secure that trust infrastructure end-to-end.

Who We Are: A Better Tomorrow Starts Today

At Roche, everything we do is powered by our passion to transform patients’ lives. We embrace science, ethics, and innovation. We're bold in our decisions and actions because we know a brighter future depends on it. Every day, we show up to build that future — for a better world, for humankind.

Diversity and inclusion aren’t just buzzwords here; they’re essential to who we are. We believe that unique perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we are committed to building teams that reflect the extraordinary range of human potential.

What You'll Do

You'll own the infrastructure that keeps our PKI running . That means designing and maintaining Terraform modules across multi-cloud environments, operating Kubernetes in a genuinely hybrid setup, and running the secrets and PKI plumbing that everything else depends on.

Day-to-day, you'll shape how we ship and observe things : improving CI/CD pipelines in GitLab CI and GitHub Actions, maturing our ArgoCD-based GitOps, managing self-hosted runners, and building observability with Grafana Cloud. When on-prem workloads need it, you'll build VM images.

Beyond the tools, you'll support three product teams in the Certificates organization, balancing their operational needs with the longer-term infrastructure work — and you'll have the autonomy to propose better ways of doing things rather than just executing tickets.

What You Bring

We are looking for thinkers that implement solutions to technical problems (optimisation, reliability). Someone with production Kubernetes experience who's comfortable owning clusters end-to-end, and who has solid hands-on experience with Terraform, AWS, secrets management, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling. Scripting in Python or Bash should feel natural, and your English — written and spoken — needs to be excellent. Your communication skills must be so good that we can see you leading technical conversations at all levels from day one.

But honestly, the mindset matters more than the checklist . In a cohesive DevOps and delivery team, we need someone who takes ownership without being asked, communicates openly when things are unclear, asks for help before getting stuck, and treats teammates and stakeholders with patience and respect. We value people who are curious, pragmatic, and genuinely enjoy improving the things around them.

This role is about taking ownership and leading the charge toward transformational DevOps best practices, precision engineering, and cutting-edge cloud integration. Show your skills, grow your career, and make a measurable impact on enterprise security — all alongside a team that has your back.

Stiamo cercando persone appassionate e guidate per entrare nel nostro team Certman PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) come ingegnere Senior DevOps e aiutarci a guidare la strada in tecnologie all'avanguardia e basate sulla fiducia.

Il nostro team di Certman rilascia e gestisce i certificati digitali che garantiscono i sistemi e i servizi interni di Roche in tutto il mondo. Stiamo cercando un Ingegnere DevOps Senior per aiutarci ad automatizzare, scalare e garantire l'infrastruttura di fiducia end-to-end.

Siamo coraggiosi nelle nostre decisioni e azioni perché sappiamo che un futuro più luminoso dipende da esso. Ogni giorno, ci presentiamo per costruire quel futuro. per un mondo migliore, per l'umanità.

Avrete l'infrastruttura che mantiene in funzione il nostro PKI. Ciò significa progettare e mantenere i moduli Terraform in ambienti multi-cloud, gestire Kubernetes in un setup ibrido, e gestire i segreti e le tubature PKI che tutto il resto dipende da.

Ogni giorno, formerai il modo in cui spediamo e osserviamo le cose: migliorare i tubi CI/CD nelle azioni GitLab CI e GitHub, maturando i nostri GitOps basati su ArgoCD, gestire i corridori auto-ospitati e costruire l'osservabilità con Grafana Cloud. Oltre agli strumenti, potrai supportare tre team di prodotti nell'organizzazione Certificati, bilanciando le loro esigenze operative con il lavoro infrastrutturale a lungo termine. e avrai l'autonomia di proporre modi migliori di fare le cose piuttosto che semplicemente eseguire i biglietti.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Shape the Future of Secure Engineering with Roche

Are you ready to tackle bold challenges and make a real impact? At Roche, we’re not just building IT infrastructure — we’re engineering secure, scalable, and highly innovative software solutions that protect and empower digital health systems globally. We're looking for passionate and driven individuals to join our Certman PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) team as a Senior DevOps Engineer and help us lead the way in cutting-edge, trust-based technology.

Our Certman team issues and manages the digital certificates that secure Roche's internal systems and services worldwide. We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help us automate, scale, and secure that trust infrastructure end-to-end.

Who We Are: A Better Tomorrow Starts Today

At Roche, everything we do is powered by our passion to transform patients’ lives. We embrace science, ethics, and innovation. We're bold in our decisions and actions because we know a brighter future depends on it. Every day, we show up to build that future — for a better world, for humankind.

Diversity and inclusion aren’t just buzzwords here; they’re essential to who we are. We believe that unique perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we are committed to building teams that reflect the extraordinary range of human potential.

What You'll Do

You'll own the infrastructure that keeps our PKI running . That means designing and maintaining Terraform modules across multi-cloud environments, operating Kubernetes in a genuinely hybrid setup, and running the secrets and PKI plumbing that everything else depends on.

Day-to-day, you'll shape how we ship and observe things : improving CI/CD pipelines in GitLab CI and GitHub Actions, maturing our ArgoCD-based GitOps, managing self-hosted runners, and building observability with Grafana Cloud. When on-prem workloads need it, you'll build VM images.

Beyond the tools, you'll support three product teams in the Certificates organization, balancing their operational needs with the longer-term infrastructure work — and you'll have the autonomy to propose better ways of doing things rather than just executing tickets.

What You Bring

We are looking for thinkers that implement solutions to technical problems (optimisation, reliability). Someone with production Kubernetes experience who's comfortable owning clusters end-to-end, and who has solid hands-on experience with Terraform, AWS, secrets management, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling. Scripting in Python or Bash should feel natural, and your English — written and spoken — needs to be excellent. Your communication skills must be so good that we can see you leading technical conversations at all levels from day one.

But honestly, the mindset matters more than the checklist . In a cohesive DevOps and delivery team, we need someone who takes ownership without being asked, communicates openly when things are unclear, asks for help before getting stuck, and treats teammates and stakeholders with patience and respect. We value people who are curious, pragmatic, and genuinely enjoy improving the things around them.

Your Opportunity to Shine:

This role is about taking ownership and leading the charge toward transformational DevOps best practices, precision engineering, and cutting-edge cloud integration. Show your skills, grow your career, and make a measurable impact on enterprise security — all alongside a team that has your back.

Why Choose This Role?

Warenbezeichnung

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, sich für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen, einsetzen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönliche Ausdrucksweisen, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, für wen Sie sind, damit Sie persönlich und professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat, heute und für Generationen.

Die Position

Mit Roche die Zukunft der Secure Engineering gestalten

Sind Sie bereit, mutige Herausforderungen zu meistern und wirkliche Wirkung zu erzielen? Bei Roche bauen wir nicht nur IT-Infrastrukturen – wir entwickeln sichere, skalierbare und hoch innovative Softwarelösungen, die digitale Gesundheitssysteme weltweit schützen und stärken. Wir suchen leidenschaftliche und motivierte Personen, die als Senior DevOps Engineer in unser Team von Certman PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) eingreifen und uns dabei helfen, die Spitzenposition in der innovativen, vertrauensbasierten Technologie zu übernehmen.

Unser Certman-Team stellt und verwaltet die digitalen Zertifikate, die die internen Systeme und Dienstleistungen von Roche weltweit sichern. Wir suchen einen Senior DevOps Engineer, der uns dabei hilft, die Infrastruktur Ende zu Ende zu automatisieren, zu skalieren und zu sichern.

Wer wir sind: Ein besseres Morgen beginnt heute

Bei Roche ist alles, was wir tun, von unserer Leidenschaft angetrieben, Patienten, Leben zu verwandeln. Wir setzen uns für Wissenschaft, Ethik und Innovation ein. Wir sind mutig in unseren Entscheidungen und Handlungen, weil wir wissen, dass eine bessere Zukunft davon abhängt. Jeden Tag zeigen wir uns, um diese Zukunft aufzubauen – für eine bessere Welt, für die Menschheit.

Vielfalt und Inklusion sind hier nicht nur ein Schlagwort, sie sind für uns unverzichtbar. Wir glauben, dass einzigartige Perspektiven Innovation und Kreativität hervorbringen, weshalb wir uns für den Aufbau von Teams einsetzen, die das außergewöhnliche Spektrum des menschlichen Potenzials widerspiegeln.

Was du tun wirst

Sie besitzen die Infrastruktur, die unser PKI am Laufen hält. Das bedeutet, Terraform-Module in Multi-Cloud-Umgebungen zu entwerfen und zu warten, Kubernetes in einem wirklich hybriden Setup zu betreiben und die Geheimnisse und PKI-Kernleitungen zu betreiben, von denen alles andere abhängt.

Sie gestalten Tag für Tag, wie wir die Dinge versenden und beobachten: Verbesserung der CI/CD-Pipelines in GitLab CI und GitHub Actions, Reifung unserer ArgoCD-basierten GitOps, Verwaltung von selbstgehosteten Läufern und Aufbau von Beobachtbarkeit mit Grafana Cloud. Wenn Workloads auf der Basis von On-Prem es brauchen, werden Sie VM-Bilder erstellen.

Neben den Tools unterstützen Sie drei Produktteams in der Organisation der Zertifikate, die ihre betrieblichen Bedürfnisse mit der längerfristigen Infrastrukturarbeit abgleichen – und Sie haben die Autonomie, bessere Möglichkeiten zu bieten, um Dinge zu tun, anstatt nur Tickets auszuführen.

Was du mitbringst

Wir suchen Denker, die Lösungen für technische Probleme implementieren (Optimierung, Zuverlässigkeit). Jemand mit Produktions-Kubernetes Erfahrung, der komfortable Cluster besitzt Ende-zu-Ende, und der solide praktische Erfahrungen mit Terraform, AWS, Secrets Management, CI/CD Pipelines und Beobachtbarkeit Werkzeug hat. Scripting in Python oder Bash sollte natürlich sein, und Ihr Englisch - geschrieben und gesprochen - muss ausgezeichnet sein. Ihre Kommunikationsfähigkeiten müssen so gut sein, dass wir Sie führende technische Gespräche auf allen Ebenen von Tag eins sehen können.

Aber ehrlich gesagt, die Denkweise zählt mehr als die Checkliste. In einem zusammenhängenden DevOps und Delivery Team brauchen wir jemanden, der Eigentümer ist, ohne gefragt zu werden, offen kommuniziert, wenn es nicht klar ist, um Hilfe bittet, bevor er festhält, und Teamkollegen und Stakeholder mit Geduld und Respekt behandelt. Wir schätzen Menschen, die neugierig, pragmatisch sind und die Dinge um sie herum wirklich genießen.

Ihre Chance zum Leuchten

Diese Rolle besteht darin, Eigentümer zu werden und die Verantwortung für die Transformation von DevOps Best Practices, Precision Engineering und modernste Cloud-Integration zu übernehmen. Zeigen Sie Ihre Fähigkeiten, wachsen Sie Ihre Karriere und machen Sie messbare Auswirkungen auf die Unternehmenssicherheit – alles zusammen mit einem Team, das Ihren Rücken hat.

Warum diese Rolle wählen?

Bei Roche können Sie:

- Zeigen Sie sich als sich selbst und werden für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten angenommen - Arbeiten an modernster Technologie, die digitale Gesundheitssysteme schützt und stärkt - Mitglied eines Teams, das Vielfalt und Inklusion schätzt - Eigentum übernehmen und die Verantwortung für die Transformation von DevOps Best Practices - Machen Sie messbare Auswirkungen auf die Unternehmenssicherheit

Every feature you code, every system you architect, and every application you optimize will contribute directly to safeguarding the technology that enhances people’s lives worldwide.

This role demands deep expertise across the full .NET stack — from advanced memory management and asynchronous programming patterns to designing secure, scalable backend systems and orchestrating containerized microservices across AWS and Kubernetes at enterprise scale. You'll apply asynchronous programming practices and design excellence to build high-throughput, low-latency APIs that meet the reliability and compliance requirements of medical devices serving patients worldwide. Your commitment to software engineering excellence, clean code principles, and robust design patterns will be fundamental to delivering seamless and secure experiences that uphold Roche's standards of quality and trust.

What You’ll Do:

As a Software Engineer in the Certman PKI team, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and evolving our certificate issuance API using ASP.NET Core (C#). You will own the end-to-end quality of the service.

You will design and implement well-versioned REST APIs, automate cryptographic and certificate lifecycle workflows, and diagnose and resolve complex performance, concurrency, or architectural bottlenecks using profiling and observability tooling.

You will deploy and operate our services natively on AWS and AliCloud, working hands-on with EKS/Kubernetes, KMS for key operations, EC2, IAM, and other core AWS building blocks. You will own and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines on GitLab and GitHub Actions — building reproducible, secure, and fully automated build, test, scan, and deploy workflows for containerized .NET services.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Position
We are building a global Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team to support critical commercial and internal platforms and applications. As an SRE, you will help design, build, and scale reliable distributed systems that power healthcare innovation worldwide.
This role is focused on reliability, scalability, automation and operational excellence. You will influence system design, define reliability standards and reduce operational toil through engineering solutions.
This role includes participation in a structured on-call rotation.

Who We Are
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

Step into the Future of IT with Roche!
As a seasoned Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at Roche, you will leverage your deep software engineering expertise to propel our products to new heights of robustness, scalability and reliability. This isn't just a role—it's an invitation to shape the backbone of technological innovations forward.

Your Mission
Design and maintain cutting-edge tools, scripts and frameworks that automate repetitive tasks, streamline software deployment and manage expansive systems with unparalleled efficiency. Partner closely with forward-thinking development teams to architect and implement high-performance solutions that elevate system efficiency, optimize resource utilization and enhance deployment processes for superior uptime and user satisfaction.

Your Impact
Lead the charge in incident management and response. Detect system anomalies, troubleshoot swiftly and conduct thorough root cause analyses to prevent recurring issues.
Champion continuous improvement by refining monitoring and alerting mechanisms, conducting insightful post-incident reviews and embedding best practices in software lifecycle management. Your strategic foresight and meticulous planning will ensure our systems are not only reliable but also superlatively performant.
By joining our elite team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering seamless experiences to our end-users, exceeding business and customer demands, and solidifying Roche's reputation as a leader in IT innovation.

Your Core Responsibilities
Reliability Engineering & Architecture

• Define and implement SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with product and engineering teams

• Conduct reliability reviews for new and existing services

• Design scalable, fault-tolerant architectures in AWS and Azure environments

• Lead capacity planning, performance and cost optimization initiatives

• Improve system resilience through automation and self-healing patterns

• Drive organizational observability maturity (metrics, logs, traces, alert quality)

Incident Management & Continuous Improvement

• Perform complex root cause analysis and drive rapid mitigation

• Participate in blameless postmortems and follow-through

• Improve MTTR, reduce incident frequency, and elevate production standards

• Collaborate seamlessly with engineering teams to enable timely and effective

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Project Management. Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology. You will work with solutions teams for Marketing Technologies who are tasked to deliver strategic transformation while sustaining and evolving ongoing solution operations. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Project Management & Coordination : Coordinate daily project execution across the solution area by facilitating ceremonies (scrums, sprint planning), maintaining product backlogs, and actively managing action and decision logs.

• Inbound Funnel Control & Prioritization : Act as the primary project point of contact to capture, structure, and funnel heavy volumes of cross-program requests, ensuring the product teams maintain adequate focus on prioritized objectives.

• Cross-Program Coordination : Coordinate with other programs and incoming functional demands. Actively plan, track, and facilitate complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with overarching strategic timelines.

• Dependency & Interface Management : Actively manage and track end-to-end dependencies - both internal and external - while refining handover interfaces between product owners and other functions.

• Portfolio Transparency & Consistency : Provide structural project management to maintain project standards, ensuring clear, transparent, and connected tracking of the product's initiative portfolio for leadership visibility.

• Performance Reporting : Establish and drive consistent project KPI tracking and status reporting across the specific product area to ensure schedule and budget adherence across all parallel initiatives.

• Project Management capability development : Serve as a subject matter expert, providing project management delivery coaching to the product teams to embed "one way of project delivery" across the organization.

Be an active member of the Project Management Chapter by

• Actively managing your own development

• Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your chapter colleagues

• Gestione delle dipendenze e delle interfacce: gestione attiva e monitoraggio delle dipendenze end-to-end - sia interne che esterne - mentre raffinazione delle interfacce di handover tra i proprietari dei prodotti e altre funzioni.
• Portfolio Transparency & Consistency: Fornire la gestione dei progetti strutturali per mantenere gli standard di progetto, assicurando un monitoraggio chiaro, trasparente e connesso del portafoglio di iniziative del prodotto per la visibilità della leadership.

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) zielt darauf ab, "die Art und Weise, wie Roche arbeitet, zu verändern". Als globales Unternehmen mit über 3.500 Mitarbeitern ermöglichen wir Roche, in einem wettbewerbsintensiven und sich ständig verändernden Geschäftsumfeld zu agieren. Wir bieten unseren Partnern End-to-End-Services und -Lösungen, damit sie sich auf patientenzentrierte Aktivitäten konzentrieren können. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) vise à « transformer le fonctionnement de Roche ». En tant qu'organisation mondiale de plus de 3 500 collègues, nous permettons à Roche de fonctionner dans un environnement commercial concurrentiel et en constante évolution. Nous fournissons à nos partenaires des services et des solutions d'affaires de bout en bout, leur permettant de se concentrer sur les activités centrées sur le patient. En prenant en compte un état d'esprit OneRoche, nous mettons à profit notre réseau mondial situé à Budapest (Hongrie), Riga (Lettonie), Chennai & Hyderabad (Inde), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaisie) et nos autres sites pour rester axés sur le client 24/7 et co-créer des solutions ensemble. L'opportunité En tant que gestionnaire de projet, vous ferez partie de l'organisation de gestion de projet du RSS et ferez rapport au responsable de la gestion de projet. Êtes-vous un passionné de gestion de projet et souhaitez fournir les meilleurs services de gestion de projet de classe aux partenaires de Roche? Alors vous êtes le candidat que nous recherchons. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la réussite de l'exécution de projet en utilisant une méthodologie de gestion de projet agile ou traditionnelle. Vous travaillerez avec des équipes de solutions pour les technologies marketing qui sont chargées de réaliser la transformation stratégique tout en maintenant et en évoluant les opérations de solutions continues. Votre travail comprendra entre autres : Engagement
• Gestion et coordination des projets : Coordonner l'exécution quotidienne des projets dans l'ensemble de la zone de solution en facilitant les cérémonies (scrums, planification du sprint), en maintenant les arriérés de produits et en gérant activement les registres d'action et de décision.
• Contrôle et hiérarchisation des entonnoirs entrants : Agir comme principal point de contact pour saisir, structurer et entonner de lourds volumes de demandes interprogrammes, en veillant à ce que les équipes de produits continuent de se concentrer sur les objectifs prioritaires.
• Coordination entre les programmes : Coordonner avec d'autres programmes et les demandes fonctionnelles entrantes. Planifier, suivre et faciliter activement les initiatives complexes et multipartites, en assurant une intégration et une harmonisation harmonieuses avec les échéanciers stratégiques globaux.
• Gestion de la dépendance et de l'interface : Gérer et suivre activement les dépendances de bout en bout - internes et externes - tout en améliorant les interfaces de transfert entre les propriétaires de produits et d'autres fonctions.
• Transparence et cohérence du portefeuille : Fournir une gestion structurelle de projet pour maintenir les normes du projet, assurer un suivi clair, transparent et connecté du portefeuille d'initiative du produit pour la visibilité du leadership.
• Rapports sur le rendement : Établir et diriger des rapports cohérents sur le suivi et l'état des projets dans l'ensemble du secteur de produits afin d'assurer le respect du calendrier et du budget pour toutes les initiatives parallèles.
• Développement des capacités de gestion de projet : Servir d'expert en matière de gestion de projet, en fournissant un encadrement à la gestion de projet pour les équipes de produits afin d'intégrer « une façon de réaliser le projet » dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Change Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization. Are you a project management and project change management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be working with the Marketing Technologies organization and its solution teams . You will be responsible for successful project change delivery and translating the technical vision into practical user adoption and rollout plans. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Change Management Strategy : Creating, owning and implementing a holistic change management strategy - including engagement, readiness and adoption - in close alignment with the respective solution owner. Drive behavioral change and technology adoption to ensure effective knowledge transfer, user readiness, and the seamless adoption of new functionalities.

• Change Monitoring : Actively monitor the adoption of technical functionalities across the ecosystem. Continuously identify opportunities to enhance product usability and platform capabilities by collaborating directly with Solution Owners, users and the wider ecosystem.

• Enablement and Readiness : Drive end-to-end user adoption by defining readiness frameworks, managing cross-solution engagement strategies, and delivering practical enablement materials that empower stakeholders to autonomously execute new business processes

• Adoption Support & Feedback Loop : Serve as the primary adoption contact for usability questions. Act as the ‘voice of the user’, understanding their business needs, guiding them on how the technology solves those needs, and translating affiliate pain points into actionable feedback for the Solution Owners.

• Content Consistency : Ensure the creation, accuracy, and consistency of learning content, aligning it closely with broader communication campaigns, and global engagement activities. Providing feedback and ensuring adoption of training material.

Capability Building
Be an active member of the RSS Project Management Organization by

• Continuously improving the project management and project change management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics

• Supporting the development of upskilling content and toolkits for our team

• Actively managing your own development

• Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your RSS colleagues

Who You Are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes

• University degree with 5+ years of experience in project management and project change management.

• Proven experience in change management principles , methodologies, and applying instructional design to adult learning portfolios.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche היא חברת הביוטכנולוגיה המובילה בעולם המחויבת לקידום רפואה מותאמת אישית בתחומי האונקולוגיה, המטולוגיה, אופתלמולוגיה, נוירולוגיה ועוד. בישראל, הפעילות של רוש ממוקדת בשיווק, הנגשת תרופות ומחקר קליני. רוש, כחברה פורצת דרך בתחומי רפואה רבים, מובילה פריצת דרך נוספת במודל עבודה חדשני, הטומן בחובו הזדמנויות רבות לצמיחה והתפתחות. אנחנו ברוש מאמינים שעל מנת להגשים את כוכב הצפון שלנו, יש לפעול בראיה רחבה יותר מול כלל הגורמים בשוק המהווים את האקוסיסטם שלנו. מתוך כך נולד תפקיד ה- Patient Journey Partner , שהוא תפקיד מפתח, רחב וחדשני הממוקד בצרכי המטופלים והלקוחות. בתפקיד זה, נדרשת יכולת לבניית קשרים חזקים וליצירת שותפות אמיתית עם לקוחות לאורך הדרך.

תפקיד ה- Patient Journey Partner משלב בתוכו תחומי אחריות ממספר תפקידים המוכרים היום בתעשיית הפארמה, החל מעבודה אסטרטגית, מדעית, שיווקית ועבודת שטח ממוקדת לקוח. ה- Patient Journey Partner מהווה את הפנים של רוש בכלל האינטראקציות מול הלקוחות שלנו ואחראי על יצירת שיתופי פעולה והובלת תהליכים משמעותיים וחדשניים באקוסיסטם הישראלי.

תחומי האחריות המרכזיים:

• ניהול יומיומי של כלל האינטראקציות בשטח עם בעלי עניין במסע המטופל בתוך האקו-סיסטם

• זיהוי צרכים, אתגרים והזדמנויות תוך כדי עבודה צמודה עם הלקוחות בשטח ומתן מענה ופתרונות מותאמים בתחומים עדכניים כגון רפואה מותאמת אישית ובריאות דיגיטלית.

• הובלת חדשנות ותהליכים משמעותיים ויצירת קשרים חזקים מול הלקוחות, שיאפשרו תוצאות טובות יותר עבור המטופלים.

• עבודה בקבוצות חוצות ארגון, מקומיות וגלובליות

מי את/ה:

התפקיד מתאים לאנשים בעלי רצון להתנסות במודל עבודה אחר - מודל מולטידיסיפלינרי, המאפשר מרחב פעולה רחב, אחריות גדולה ומנדט להוביל מהלכים משמעותיים בארגון ומחוצה לו.
אנשים בעלי תשוקה לעבודה עם צוותים רפואיים, המביאים איתם רקע מגוון לתפקיד שהוא "גם וגם" ומשלב בתוכו מגוון יכולות שיאפשרו לדיאלוג עם הרופאים לעשות הבדל בחיי המטופלים.

• ניסיון מוכח בניהול קשרי לקוחות מורכבים וביצירת שותפויות משמעותיות עם מובילי דעה באקוסיסטם הרפואי

• ניסיון קודם בתפקיד PS/נציג/ה רפואי בפארמה (מינימום 3 שנות ניסיון) – עדיפות לניסיון בתחום הנוירולוגיה, בדגש על טרשת נפוצה

• ניסיון בעבודה שיווקית מדעית מול צוותים רפואיים

• נכונות לעבודת שטח אינטנסיבית (אזור מרכז-ירושלים-דרום), מתוך הבנה ששם נמצאים הפתרונות האמיתיים עבור המטופלים

• תואר אקדמי במדעי החיים

• ניסיון בפיתוח והובלת פרויקטים בשיתוף עם הלקוחות

אנחנו רצים יחד למרחקים ארוכים וגאים לעבוד בסביבה בה שליחות ומשמעות נפגשים.
הצטרפו אלינו למסע חדשני שבו כוכב הצפון הוא טובת המטופל.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Roche היא חברת הביוטכנולוגיה המובילה בעולם המחויבת לקידום רפואה מותאמת אישית בתחומי האונקולוגיה, המטולוגיה, אופתלמולוגיה, נוירולוגיה ועוד. בישראל, הפעילות של רוש ממוקדת בשיווק, הנגשת תרופות ומחקר קליני. רוש, כחברה פורצת דרך בתחומי רפואה רבים, מובילה פריצת דרך נוספת במודל עבודה חדשני, הטומן בחובו הזדמנויות רבות לצמיחה והתפתחות. אנחנו ברוש מאמינים שעל מנת להגשים את כוכב הצפון שלנו, יש לפעול בראיה רחבה יותר מול כלל הגורמים בשוק המהווים את האקוסיסטם שלנו. מתוך כך נולד תפקיד ה- Patient Journey Partner , שהוא תפקיד מפתח, רחב וחדשני הממוקד בצרכי המטופלים והלקוחות. בתפקיד זה, נדרשת יכולת לבניית קשרים חזקים וליצירת שותפות אמיתית עם לקוחות לאורך הדרך.

תפקיד ה- Patient Journey Partner משלב בתוכו תחומי אחריות ממספר תפקידים המוכרים היום בתעשיית הפארמה, החל מעבודה אסטרטגית, מדעית, שיווקית ועבודת שטח ממוקדת לקוח. ה- Patient Journey Partner מהווה את הפנים של רוש בכלל האינטראקציות מול הלקוחות שלנו ואחראי על יצירת שיתופי פעולה והובלת תהליכים משמעותיים וחדשניים באקוסיסטם הישראלי.

תחומי האחריות המרכזיים:

• ניהול יומיומי של כלל האינטראקציות בשטח עם בעלי עניין במסע המטופל בתוך האקו-סיסטם

• זיהוי צרכים, אתגרים והזדמנויות תוך כדי עבודה צמודה עם הלקוחות בשטח ומתן מענה ופתרונות מותאמים בתחומים עדכניים כגון רפואה מותאמת אישית ובריאות דיגיטלית.

• הובלת חדשנות ותהליכים משמעותיים ויצירת קשרים חזקים מול הלקוחות, שיאפשרו תוצאות טובות יותר עבור המטופלים.

• עבודה בקבוצות חוצות ארגון, מקומיות וגלובליות

מי את/ה:

התפקיד מתאים לאנשים בעלי רצון להתנסות במודל עבודה אחר - מודל מולטידיסיפלינרי, המאפשר מרחב פעולה רחב, אחריות גדולה ומנדט להוביל מהלכים משמעותיים בארגון ומחוצה לו.
אנשים בעלי תשוקה לעבודה עם צוותים רפואיים, המביאים איתם רקע מגוון לתפקיד שהוא "גם וגם" ומשלב בתוכו מגוון יכולות שיאפשרו לדיאלוג עם הרופאים לעשות הבדל בחיי המטופלים.

• ניסיון מוכח בניהול קשרי לקוחות מורכבים וביצירת שותפויות משמעותיות עם מובילי דעה באקוסיסטם הרפואי

• ניסיון קודם בתפקיד PS/נציג/ה רפואי בפארמה (מינימום 3 שנות ניסיון) – עדיפות לניסיון בתחום הנוירולוגיה, בדגש על טרשת נפוצה

• ניסיון בעבודה שיווקית מדעית מול צוותים רפואיים

• נכונות לעבודת שטח אינטנסיבית (אזור מרכז-ירושלים-דרום), מתוך הבנה ששם נמצאים הפתרונות האמיתיים עבור המטופלים

• תואר אקדמי במדעי החיים

• ניסיון בפיתוח והובלת פרויקטים בשיתוף עם הלקוחות

אנחנו רצים יחד למרחקים ארוכים וגאים לעבוד בסביבה בה שליחות ומשמעות נפגשים.
הצטרפו אלינו למסע חדשני שבו כוכב הצפון הוא טובת המטופל.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Design Project Coordinator (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Design Project Coordinator (DPC), you are the end-to-end owner of design tickets. You act as a central point of contact from ticket intake to delivery, handling all project management, Workfront administration, designer allocation, stakeholder communication. Your mission is to protect creative time for designers and ensure smooth, timely execution across all project types.
This role demands a proactive approach to project management, including the screening and delegation of incoming tasks, constant communication to optimize project delivery, and the maintenance of a balanced and productive team environment.

This is a maternity cover opportunity.

The Opportunity:

• Oversee the full lifecycle of assigned Workfront tickets, from intake to closure.

• Review ticket briefs, clarify missing or unclear information with stakeholders.

• Assign designers based on availability and expertise.

• Manage Workfront administration, including metadata, timelines, task transitions, and documentation.

• Act as the single point of contact between stakeholders and designers.

• Coordinate kick-off calls for complex or high-priority projects, and route feedback to designers.

• Ensure timely deliveries, update stakeholders, close tickets, escalate blockers, and track team progress.

Who you are:

• You have 2+ years of professional experience in project management or workflow management, preferably in a design area or similar fast-paced business.

• You possess exceptional time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• You are able to organize and manage time efficiently, prioritizing tasks to handle multiple projects concurrently.

• You are skilled in fostering client relationships through initial project discussions, ongoing updates, and setting realistic expectations, ensuring smooth project execution.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Explore what the Global Digital Hub is about.

Discover the Roche Services & Solutions Center and how we work together as a truly global team!

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Global Digital Hub è stato fondato all'interno di Roche Services & Solutions Center. Il nostro scopo principale è quello di rafforzare le capacità digitali di Roche a livello globale, supportando iniziative centrali con Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting e Creative Design. In qualità di coordinatore del progetto di design (DPC), sei il proprietario finale dei biglietti di design. L'utente agisce come punto centrale di contatto dall'assunzione dei biglietti alla consegna, gestione di tutta la gestione del progetto, amministrazione di Workfront, allocazione dei progetti, comunicazione degli stakeholder. La vostra missione è quella di proteggere il tempo creativo per i progettisti e garantire l'esecuzione liscia e tempestiva in tutti i tipi di progetto. Questo ruolo richiede un approccio proattivo alla gestione del progetto, tra cui la proiezione e la delegazione di compiti in arrivo, la comunicazione costante per ottimizzare la consegna del progetto e la manutenzione di un ambiente di team equilibrato e produttivo. Questa e' un'opportunita' di copertura di maternità. L'opportunità:
• Superare il ciclo di vita completo dei biglietti Workfront assegnati, dall'assunzione alla chiusura.
• Verificare i biglietti, chiarire le informazioni mancanti o non chiare con gli stakeholder.
• Assegna progettisti basati su disponibilità e competenza.
• Gestisci l'amministrazione di Workfront, inclusi metadati, timeline, passaggi di attività e documentazione.
• Agire come unico punto di contatto tra stakeholder e designer.
• Coordinate kick-off richiede progetti complessi o ad alta priorità, e route feedback ai progettisti.
• Assicurare consegne tempestive, aggiornare le parti interessate, chiudere i biglietti, bloccanti escalate e monitorare i progressi del team. Chi sei:
• Hai 2+ anni di esperienza professionale nella gestione del progetto o nella gestione del flusso di lavoro, preferibilmente in un'area di progettazione o in un'attività simile.
• Possiedi eccezionali capacità di gestione del tempo, con la capacità di priorità compiti in un ambiente frenetico.
• Siete in grado di organizzare e gestire il tempo in modo efficiente, priorità compiti per gestire più progetti contemporaneamente.
• Sei abile nella promozione delle relazioni con i clienti attraverso le discussioni iniziali del progetto, gli aggiornamenti in corso e l'impostazione di aspettative realistiche, assicurando una corretta esecuzione del progetto. In cambio vi forniamo:

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Design Project Coordinator (DPC), you are the end-to-end owner of design tickets. You act as a central point of contact from ticket intake to delivery, handling all project management, Workfront administration, designer allocation, stakeholder communication. Your mission is to protect creative time for designers and ensure smooth, timely execution across all project types.
This role demands a proactive approach to project management, including the screening and delegation of incoming tasks, constant communication to optimize project delivery, and the maintenance of a balanced and productive team environment.

This is a maternity cover opportunity.

The Opportunity:

• Oversee the full lifecycle of assigned Workfront tickets, from intake to closure.

• Review ticket briefs, clarify missing or unclear information with stakeholders.

• Assign designers based on availability and expertise.

• Manage Workfront administration, including metadata, timelines, task transitions, and documentation.

• Act as the single point of contact between stakeholders and designers.

• Coordinate kick-off calls for complex or high-priority projects, and route feedback to designers.

• Ensure timely deliveries, update stakeholders, close tickets, escalate blockers, and track team progress.

Who you are:

• You have 2+ years of professional experience in project management or workflow management, preferably in a design area or similar fast-paced business.

• You possess exceptional time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• You are able to organize and manage time efficiently, prioritizing tasks to handle multiple projects concurrently.

• You are skilled in fostering client relationships through initial project discussions, ongoing updates, and setting realistic expectations, ensuring smooth project execution.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Explore what the Global Digital Hub is about.

Discover the Roche Services & Solutions Center and how we work together as a truly global team!

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
The Delivery capability covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution.
This position is part of the Materials, Manufacturing & Capex (MMC) Procurement leadership team reporting into the Chapter Lead of Materials, Manufacturing & Capex Procurement in Global Procurement (GP).

As the Head of Drug Substance & New Modalities Procurement, you will work in a dynamic global environment where you will meet the challenge to bring vision, guidance, prioritization, and focus to the Procurement Delivery capability area such as team vision, capability development, performance and strategic category management (in line with functional objectives and business needs).
You will lead and guide a team of Procurement Category Experts and Procurement Category Specialists, working closely with them to develop the team vision, prioritize and focus efforts, and provide coaching and guidance to support your team’s development and growth both as individuals and as a team.

You are accountable for the best allocation of your people to ensure flexibility, excellence in execution, delivery and performance, and talent development. Your scope includes

• Portfolio Leadership: Strategic management of a diverse portfolio of Drug Substance and New Modalities manufacturing partnerships, encompassing a significant commercial and development footprint

• Global Reach: Driving procurement strategy across an international landscape, working with cross-functional teams and external partners spanning Europe, North America, and Asia.

• Strategic Complexity: Balancing the management of established commercial partnerships with the unique requirements of high-growth technology platforms and new pipeline assets.

• Value Creation: Leading the end-to-end procurement lifecycle for this critical network, from strategic outsourcing and site selection to long-term supplier relationship management

The Head of Drug Substance & New Modalities Procurement will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and the general business/team requirements, including, but not limited to, these core responsibilities:

• You utilise your in depth knowledge and expertise in External Manufacturing to act as a Delivery domain lead providing thought leadership, advice, and know-how on delivery capability topics, strategies, and best practices, and shaping and defining the Category area vision and priorities.

• You driver performance and category strategies for the Roche Pharma global spend within your category areas. You are accountable for achieving the GP Balanced Score Card targets, translating the GP strategy (including ongoing effectiveness, automation and AI utilisation) and delivering the business specific needs and targets.

• You work within the capability teams, networks, and squads/project teams to ensure prioritization and focus on delivering or supporting both project and foundational work.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.
