Global Procurement gestisce proattivamente l'intero ecosistema dei fornitori, fornendo un contributo vitale per migliorare i risultati della salute, riducendo i costi per i pazienti e i sistemi sanitari globali, e assicurando che Roche continui a fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità La capacità di consegna copre le attività principali di approvvigionamento da gestione di categoria, approvvigionamento strategico e operativo, gestione dei fornitori, contrazione, definizione di strategia di contenuto ed esecuzione. Questa posizione fa parte del team di leadership di Materials, Manufacturing & Capex (MMC) Procurement che segnala nel Capitolo Lead of Materials, Manufacturing & Capex Procurement in Global Procurement (GP). In qualità di Head of Drug Substance & New Modalities Procurement, lavorerai in un ambiente globale dinamico in cui incontrerai la sfida di portare visione, orientamento, priorità e attenzione all'area Procurement Delivery, come la visione del team, lo sviluppo delle capacità, le prestazioni e la gestione strategica delle categorie (in linea con gli obiettivi funzionali e le esigenze aziendali). Potrai guidare e guidare un team di esperti di categoria di appalti e specialisti della categoria di appalti, lavorando a stretto contatto con loro per sviluppare la visione del team, priorità e gli sforzi di messa a fuoco, e fornire coaching e guida per sostenere lo sviluppo e la crescita del tuo team sia come individui e come team. Sei responsabile della migliore allocazione della tua gente per garantire flessibilità, eccellenza nell'esecuzione, consegna e performance e sviluppo del talento. Il tuo scopo include
• Portfolio Leadership: Gestione strategica di un portafoglio diversificato di partnership per la produzione di sostanze stupefacenti e nuove modalità, che comprende una significativa impronta commerciale e di sviluppo
• Global Reach: Guidare la strategia di approvvigionamento attraverso un panorama internazionale, lavorando con team interfunzionali e partner esterni che spaziano dall'Europa, dal Nord America e dall'Asia.
• Complessità Strategica: Bilanciare la gestione di partnership commerciali consolidate con i requisiti unici delle piattaforme tecnologiche ad alta crescita e dei nuovi asset pipeline.
• Creazione del valore: Condurre il ciclo di vita di approvvigionamento end-to-end per questa rete critica, dall'outsourcing strategico e la selezione del sito alla gestione del rapporto dei fornitori a lungo termine Il Capo della Sostanza della Droga & Nuovi Modalities Procurement giocherà una varietà di ruoli secondo la vostra esperienza, la conoscenza e i requisiti generali di business / team, tra cui, ma non solo, queste responsabilità fondamentali:
• Utilizzi la tua profonda conoscenza e competenza nel settore manifatturiero esterno per agire come un lead di dominio di consegna fornendo leadership, consigli e know-how sui temi delle capacità di consegna, strategie e best practice, e modellando e definendo la visione e le priorità dell'area Categoria.
• Le prestazioni del conducente e le strategie di categoria per la spesa globale di Roche Pharma all'interno delle aree di categoria. Sei responsabile per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi della GP Balanced Score Card, traducendo la strategia GP (compresa l'efficacia in corso, l'automazione e l'utilizzo AI) e fornendo le esigenze e gli obiettivi specifici del business.
• Lavorate all'interno dei team di capacità, reti e team di squadra/progetto per garantire la priorità e la messa a fuoco sul fornire o sostenere sia il lavoro di progetto che quello di base.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de file du partenaire de voyage

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Patient Journey Partner Lead based in Buenos Aires , you will be responsible for driving the strategic deployment of the PJP network, ensuring activities generate high-impact value within the Disease Areas aligned with the affiliate's goals and ecosystem priorities. In this role, your absolute priority will be leadership and people empowerment ; you will coach, mentor, and guide a highly diverse and multidisciplinary team, managing a mixed structure spanning both specific geographic territories and key therapeutic areas.

The Opportunity

• Take direct accountability for the deployment of PJPs, ensuring their activities generate high-impact value aligned with strategic goals and ecosystem priorities.

• Diagnose individual capability needs, provide tailored field coaching, and empower PJPs to experiment boldly, remove operational roadblocks, and become self-reliant.

• Architect up-to-date competency models, design comprehensive onboarding and learning roadmaps, and foster a continuous learning culture across the network.

• Catalyze cross-functional ecosystems to form self-sufficient "pods" that share business ideas, assess impacts, and prioritize initiatives based on deep patient journey insights.

• Help teams clearly define their purpose, develop effective operational rituals (such as impact retrospectives), and leverage agile methodologies to drive organizational growth.

• Foster a culture of trust and psychological safety, supporting an environment where teams can give and receive continuous feedback to scale value across the enterprise.

Who you are

• University degree in Science, Economics, Business, or related disciplines; an advanced life science degree or an MBA is considered a strong plus.

• Proven experience leading cross-functional teams and managing complex stakeholder engagement, with a strong priority on exceptional people leadership skills.

• Demonstrated ability and resilience to lead, inspire, and manage highly diverse professional teams (including physicians, biologists, accountants, and lawyers across various ages and seniorities).

• Strong command of agile ways of working, system thinking, data-driven mindset, and a proactive approach to experimenting and learning from failures.

• Fluent in Spanish with a high proficiency in English, enabling effective collaboration and knowledge-sharing across the broader Roche global enterprise.

No relocation benefits are offered for this position.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Partner di Viaggio Paziente con sede a Buenos Aires, sarai responsabile della guida dell'implementazione strategica della rete PJP, assicurando che le attività generino valore ad alto impatto all'interno delle aree Malattie allineate agli obiettivi e alle priorità dell'ecosistema della filiale. In questo ruolo, la vostra assoluta priorità sarà la leadership e l'empowerment delle persone; sarà coach, mentore, e guidare un team altamente diversificato e multidisciplinare, la gestione di una struttura mista che comprende sia specifici territori geografici che aree terapeutiche chiave. L'opportunità
• Prendere la responsabilità diretta per l'implementazione dei PJP, assicurando che le loro attività generino un valore ad alto impatto allineato con obiettivi strategici e priorità dell'ecosistema.
• Diagnosi delle esigenze delle capacità individuali, fornire allenamenti su misura del campo, e consentire ai PJP di sperimentare in modo audace, rimuovere i blocchi stradali operativi e diventare autosufficienti.
• Architetto modelli di competenze aggiornate, progettazione completa onboarding e roadmap di apprendimento, e promuovere una cultura di apprendimento continua in tutta la rete.
• Catalizzare gli ecosistemi interfunzionali per formare "podi" autosufficienti che condividono idee di business, valutare gli impatti e priorità iniziative basate su approfondimenti di viaggio dei pazienti.
• Aiuta i team a definire chiaramente il loro scopo, sviluppare rituali operativi efficaci (come retrospettive di impatto), e sfruttare metodologie agili per guidare la crescita organizzativa.
• Promuovere una cultura di fiducia e sicurezza psicologica, sostenendo un ambiente in cui i team possono dare e ricevere feedback continui per valorizzare l'impresa. Chi sei
• Laurea in Scienze, Economia, Business o discipline correlate; una laurea in scienze della vita avanzata o un MBA è considerato un vantaggio forte.
• Esperienza comprovata leader di team interfunzionali e gestione di complessi stakeholder engagement, con una forte priorità sulle eccezionali capacità di leadership delle persone.
• Capacità dimostrata e resilienza di guidare, ispirare e gestire team professionali altamente diversi (compresi medici, biologi, contabili e avvocati di varie età e anziani).
• Forte comando di modi agili di lavoro, pensiero di sistema, data-driven mindset, e un approccio proattivo per sperimentare e imparare dai fallimenti.
• Fluente in spagnolo con un'alta competenza in inglese, consentendo una collaborazione efficace e condivisione della conoscenza attraverso l'impresa globale Roche più ampia. Non sono offerti benefici di trasferimento per questa posizione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. In dieser Rolle ist Ihre absolute Priorität die Führung und die Stärkung der Menschen; Sie werden ein sehr vielfältiges und multidisziplinäres Team coachen, betreuen und leiten und eine gemischte Struktur verwalten, die sowohl spezifische geografische Gebiete als auch wichtige therapeutische Bereiche umfasst. Die Chance
• Übernahme direkter Rechenschaftspflicht für den Einsatz von PJPs, um sicherzustellen, dass ihre Aktivitäten einen hohen Wert generieren, der mit strategischen Zielen und Ökosystemprioritäten in Einklang steht.
• Diagnose individueller fähigkeitsbedürfnisse, bieten maßgeschneidertes feldcoaching und befähigen pjps, mutig zu experimentieren, operative straßensperren zu beseitigen und selbstständig zu werden.
• Erstellen Sie aktuelle Kompetenzmodelle, entwerfen Sie umfassende Onboarding- und Lern-Roadmaps und fördern Sie eine kontinuierliche Lernkultur im gesamten Netzwerk.
• Katalysieren Sie funktionsübergreifende Ökosysteme, um autarke "Pods" zu bilden, die Geschäftsideen austauschen, Auswirkungen bewerten und Initiativen auf der Grundlage tiefer Erkenntnisse aus der Patientenreise priorisieren.
• Helfen Sie Teams, ihren Zweck klar zu definieren, effektive operative Rituale zu entwickeln (z. B. Impact Retrospektiven) und agile Methoden zu nutzen, um das organisatorische Wachstum voranzutreiben.
• Pflegen Sie eine Kultur des Vertrauens und der psychologischen Sicherheit und unterstützen Sie ein Umfeld, in dem Teams kontinuierliches Feedback geben und erhalten können, um den Wert im gesamten Unternehmen zu skalieren. Wer du bist
• Universitätsabschluss in Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft, Wirtschaft oder verwandten Disziplinen; ein fortgeschrittener Life-Science-Abschluss oder ein MBA gilt als starkes Plus.
• Bewährte Erfahrung in der Leitung funktionsübergreifender Teams und der Verwaltung komplexer Stakeholder-Engagements mit einer starken Priorität auf außergewöhnlichen Führungsqualitäten für Menschen.
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit und Widerstandsfähigkeit, sehr unterschiedliche professionelle Teams zu führen, zu inspirieren und zu verwalten (einschließlich Ärzte, Biologen, Buchhalter und Anwälte verschiedener Altersgruppen und Dienstalter).
• Starke Beherrschung von agilen Arbeitsweisen, Systemdenken, datengesteuerter Denkweise und einem proaktiven Ansatz zum Experimentieren und Lernen aus Fehlern.
• Fließend Spanisch mit hohen Englischkenntnissen, was eine effektive Zusammenarbeit und Wissensaustausch im globalen Unternehmen von Roche ermöglicht. Für diese Position werden keine Umzugsvorteile angeboten. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
Como Patient Journey Partner basado en Neuquén , serás responsable de gestionar de manera integral el recorrido de los pacientes para un portafolio diversificado que abarca Atrofia Muscular Espinal (AME), Neurología, Oftalmología y Hemofilia. Actuando de forma transversal entre las funciones Médica, de Acceso y Comercial, tu misión será adaptarte ágilmente a los equipos de terreno, identificar oportunidades críticas en el ecosistema regional y asegurar el acceso ágil a tratamientos de alto costo y alta complejidad.

The Opportunity

• Liderar de punta a punta las iniciativas orientadas al paciente para un portafolio multiobjetivo de alta especialidad (AME, Neurología, Oftalmología y Hemofilia) en el Sur argentino.

• Integrarse de manera fluida y veloz a los equipos de soporte y colaboradores de terreno de la zona para potenciar el alcance de los objetivos estratégicos propuestos.

• Construir relaciones de largo plazo y valor agregado con especialistas médicos, sociedades científicas regionales y financiadores clave de la salud en la zona Sur.

• Diseñar e implementar soluciones innovadoras que superen las barreras geográficas y de infraestructura locales para agilizar el diagnóstico y la entrega de productos de alto costo.

• Capturar insights valiosos del mercado y tendencias emergentes para alimentar la planificación y asignación estratégica de recursos en la subregión.

Who you are

• Profesional universitario graduado en carreras de Ciencias de la Salud, Administración de Empresas, Economía o afines.

• Experiencia sólida y comprobable gestionando carteras de medicamentos o soluciones de alta complejidad y productos de alto costo.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Patient Journey Partner para la Provincia de Buenos Aires, asumirás un rol estratégico de alto impacto destinado a reforzar el ecosistema de Nefritis Lúpica. Tu propósito principal será actuar como un catalizador en el terreno bonaerense, fusionando las perspectivas Médica, de Acceso y Comercial para preparar el mercado, acelerar la adopción de nuestra innovación diagnóstica/terapéutica y asegurar que los pacientes accedan a soluciones críticas en el menor tiempo posible.

The Opportunity

• Diseñar y ejecutar la estrategia de campo para el recorrido del paciente en el marco del próximo lanzamiento y la fase de expansión de Nefritis Lúpica en la Provincia de Buenos Aires.

• Identificar, mapear y priorizar de manera temprana los centros de referencia, redes de derivación y stakeholders clave (nefrólogos, reumatólogos y comités de auditoría) en PBA.

• Desarrollar e implementar planes de valor que faciliten el diagnóstico temprano de la patología y agilicen los procesos de cobertura y acceso al tratamiento.

• Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos internos de Marketing, Asuntos Médicos y Acceso para asegurar la consistencia del posicionamiento de la marca durante el lanzamiento.

• Monitorear y evaluar el impacto de las iniciativas desplegadas en el terreno, pivotando ágilmente las tácticas comerciales y médicas para maximizar el éxito en la expansión del portafolio.

Who you are

• Profesional graduado de carreras como Bioquímica, Medicina, Farmacia, Comercialización, Administración de Empresas o disciplinas afines al negocio de la salud.

• Experiencia sólida previa en la gestión de lanzamientos de productos biológicos, terapias especiales o soluciones de alta complejidad en la industria de la salud.

• Conocimiento del mercado e instituciones de salud públicas y privadas presentes en la Provincia de Buenos Aires.

• Mentalidad fuertemente emprendedora ( Growth Mindset ), orientación a resultados de negocio y pasión por la innovación disruptiva enfocada en el paciente.

• Excelentes capacidades de comunicación persuasiva, habilidades de negociación estratégica y fluidez intermedia/avanzada en inglés.

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

titleByLocale.it: Partner del Viaggio Paziente - Nefritis Lúpica (Litorale)
titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire de voyage patient - Nefritis Lúpica (Litorial)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Patient Journey Partner con cobertura en la región del Litoral, serás responsable de liderar y desplegar la estrategia enfocada en el recorrido del paciente para el área terapéutica de Nefritis Lúpica. Tu propósito será navegar de forma transversal entre las áreas Médica, de Acceso y Comercial para derribar las barreras del sistema de salud regional, co-diseñando soluciones innovadoras con los actores clave del ecosistema litoraleño que aceleren el acceso oportuno al tratamiento y mejoren la calidad de vida de los pacientes.

The Opportunity

• Establecer un canal de comunicación directo y de confianza con nefrólogos, reumatólogos, instituciones de salud y tomadores de decisión en la región del Litoral para optimizar el recorrido del paciente con Nefritis Lúpica.

• Mapear y diagnosticar las brechas críticas del sistema de salud local en el abordaje de la patología, promoviendo el valor médico y científico del portafolio de Roche.

• Co-crear e implementar iniciativas y soluciones de acceso y comerciales que simplifiquen los procesos de derivación, diagnóstico temprano y continuidad del tratamiento.

• Colaborar estrechamente con redes transversales internas y squads regionales para integrar las perspectivas específicas del Litoral dentro de las tácticas nacionales de la filial.

• Identificar y priorizar aquellas oportunidades y ecosistemas locales que generen un impacto médico y social sostenible en el tiempo.

Who you are

• Profesional graduado de carreras de Ciencias de la Salud, Ciencias Económicas, Empresariales o disciplinas afines.

• Trayectoria demostrable en posiciones de cara al cliente dentro del mercado de la salud (especialista de producto, acceso, relaciones institucionales o áreas médicas).

• Conocimiento o experiencia previa en el manejo de enfermedades autoinmunes, nefrología o reumatología será altamente considerado para este desafío.

• Sólida visión de negocios combinada con un genuino interés por la experiencia del cliente y la excelencia médica.

• Habilidades avanzadas de comunicación, pensamiento sistémico y familiaridad con metodologías ágiles de trabajo.

• Residencia en una ciudad principal de la zona del Litoral y plena disponibilidad para viajar por la región.

No se ofrecen beneficios de relocalización para este puesto.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Finance Excellence Partner (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Finance Excellence Partner (FxP) you collaborate with Commercial Finance colleagues across Diagnostics and beyond geographical boundaries in a networked team, to streamline finance operations by simplifying, standardizing, automating, and utilising insights for enhanced decision making. You also collaborate closely with local Finance Enterprise Partners, finance colleagues across the global Roche finance network and local commercial business partners. You contribute to fostering a culture of innovation and experimentation as well as drive automation and digitalization across finance.

Your key responsibilities
Your main responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Being the liaison to various stakeholders across the global Roche finance network (e.g. local Finance Enterprise Partners, Roche Shared Service Center, Finance Excellence Partner chapter) on several major finance processes (Month End Closing, Budget, Forecasting, Performance Tracking).

• Leveraging technology and automation to drive digitalization as well as exploring and applying new technologies and tools in the fields of automation and Artificial Intelligence.

• Ownership of reporting solutions (sales, P&L, Headcount, Balance sheet) and providing key insights to local commercial affiliate on major KPIs.

• Identifying and implementing opportunities for efficiency gains, promoting continuous improvement through standardised processes and tools in order to be brilliant at the basics.

• Collaborating closely with Finance Enterprise Partners and internal commercial stakeholders to enable increased customer experience and business impact along the customer journey.

• Acting as an enabler for the adaption of the new ways of working by shifting from affiliate focused finance operations towards an above country-cluster level

Your profile

• Ability to work and thrive in a networked environment, cross-departments, stakeholders, hierarchies and geographies in order to work successfully across affiliates, sub-regions and regions with an enterprise perspective combined with an agile mindset.

• Capability to constantly challenge the status quo and successfully influence stakeholders to implement key change initiatives.

• Profound understanding and experience of key financial processes (Month End Closing, Annual Closing, Budgeting, Forecasting and Actual Performance Monitoring) and financial accounting principles.

• Demonstrated problem-solving abilities, effective communication skills, and a growth mindset.

• Actively seeking input and building relationships with other stakeholders in the ecosystem.

• Robust analytical skills, including business process improvement expertise.

• A strong business understanding to drive innovation effectively.

• An inclusive and collaborative approach to how you work.

• Growth mindset and living the Roche Operating Principles.

• English and French - written and spoken.

[FRENCH VERSION]
En tant que Finance Excellence Partner (FxP) , vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Finance Commerciale au sein de Roche Diagnostics ainsi qu’avec des collègues à l’international, au sein d’une équipe connectée. Votre mission principale est de contribuer à l’excellence opérationnelle financière en simplifiant, standardisant et automatisant les processus, tout en apportant des insights pertinents pour éclairer la prise de décision. Vous jouez également un rôle central dans la promotion de l’innovation, de la numérisation et d’une culture d’expérimentatio

jobs.title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a skilled Identity & Access Management Engineer to join our growing IAM team. This role offers a unique opportunity for a Java Developer to expand their expertise into the Identity and Access Management space, with a focus on SailPoint technologies and application integration. You will work on solving complex business problems through practical application of your development skills, contributing to the design, implementation, and evolution of enterprise-scale identity solutions. In this position, you will take on meaningful responsibility for technical design decisions, build resilient IAM infrastructure, and play an active role in shaping how our organization manages identity and access across the enterprise.

The Opportunity
This role positions you at the intersection of software development and information security, where you'll apply your Java expertise to solve complex identity and access management challenges within a large global enterprise.

Your Responsibilities

• Contribute to the end-to-end design of IAM infrastructure solutions and create and maintain related component standards

• Produce and maintain comprehensive documentation for designs, design patterns, and component standards

• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters related to organizational priorities

• Strengthen the Information Security community by building bridges and collaborating with peers and stakeholders

• Contribute to determining success criteria and evaluating promising solutions and technologies via Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and feasibility studies

• Design, build, test, and implement integrated, resilient, and reliable IAM solutions

• Advise, influence, and collaborate with various IT partners and line-of-business stakeholders, integrating their feedback

• Ensure designs and solutions align with organizational policies, standards, and strategic directions

• Contribute to estimating engineering resources and timelines for successful project delivery

• Write and contribute to position papers, white papers, technical recommendations, and best practices documentation for the IAM solution space

• Remain proactive in identifying operational challenges and opportunities, working with support teams to ensure solutions meet quality and regulatory standards

• Collaborate closely with Identity Management Support and Operations teams on incident management, problem management, and continuous service improvement

• Embrace our Infrastructure as Code tool chain and adhere to coding best practices

Who You Are

Technology Skills & Experience

• Deep expertise in Java development with proven ability to apply it within enterprise security contexts

• Hands-on experience with Identity Management technologies; SailPoint experience is highly desired

• Demonstrated experience following CI/CD and DevOps practices

• Knowledge of microservices architectures, API design, and REST APIs

• Understanding of distributed architectures and the challenges they present

• Experience working in an Agile environment

• Proficiency in Python and scripting languages (Perl, JavaScript, PowerShell, etc.) is desired

• Background in Identity and Access Management, Directory Services, or Cyber Security is a plus

Core Competencies & Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience

• 5+ years of overall experience in relevant technology areas

• 2+ years working in a multinational environment as an Engineer or Te

Si lavorerà per risolvere problemi di business complessi attraverso l'applicazione pratica delle vostre competenze di sviluppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, implementazione e l'evoluzione delle soluzioni di identità su scala aziendale. In questa posizione, si assumerà una responsabilità significativa per le decisioni di progettazione tecnica, costruire infrastruttura IAM resiliente e svolgere un ruolo attivo nella definizione di come la nostra organizzazione gestisce l'identità e l'accesso attraverso l'impresa. L'opportunità Questo ruolo ti posiziona all'incrocio di sviluppo software e sicurezza delle informazioni, dove applicherai la tua esperienza Java per risolvere complesse sfide di identità e gestione degli accessi all'interno di una grande impresa globale. Le tue responsabilità
• Contribuisci alla progettazione end-to-end delle soluzioni infrastrutturali IAM e crei e mantieni i relativi standard di componenti
• Produrre e mantenere la documentazione completa per disegni, modelli di progettazione e standard dei componenti
• Interagire con partner interni ed esterni senior su questioni tecniche significative relative alle priorità organizzative
• Rafforzare la comunità di sicurezza dell'informazione costruendo ponti e collaborando con colleghi e stakeholder
• Contribuire a determinare criteri di successo e valutare soluzioni e tecnologie promettenti tramite Proofs of Concept (PoCs) e studi di fattibilità
• Progettazione, costruzione, test e implementare soluzioni IAM integrate, resilienti e affidabili
• Consigliare, influenzare e collaborare con diversi partner IT e stakeholder di linea di business, integrando i loro feedback
• Assicurare design e soluzioni in linea con le politiche organizzative, gli standard e le direzioni strategiche
• Contribuire a stimare le risorse di ingegneria e le tempistiche per la consegna di progetti di successo
• Scrivere e contribuire a posizionare documenti, white paper, raccomandazioni tecniche e best practice documentazione per lo spazio soluzione IAM
• Rimanere proattivi nell'individuazione delle sfide e delle opportunità operative, lavorare con i team di supporto per garantire soluzioni conformi a standard qualitativi e normativi
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team di Supporto e Operazioni di gestione degli incidenti, gestione dei problemi e miglioramento continuo dei servizi
• Abbracciare la nostra infrastruttura come catena di strumenti di codice e aderire alla codifica delle migliori pratiche Chi sei Tecnologia competenze e esperienza
• Profonda competenza nello sviluppo Java con comprovata capacità di applicarlo all'interno di contesti di sicurezza aziendale
• Esperienza pratica con le tecnologie di gestione dell'identità; l'esperienza di SailPoint è altamente desiderata
• Esperienza dimostrata in seguito alle pratiche CI/CD e DevOps
• Conoscenza di architetture di microservices, progettazione API e API REST
• Comprensione delle architetture distribuite e delle sfide che presentano
• Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente Agile
• La competenza in Python e linguaggi di scrittura (Perl, JavaScript, PowerShell, ecc.) è desiderata.
• Background in Identity and Access Management, Servizi di Directory, o Cyber Security è un plus Competenze e qualifiche
• Corso di laurea o equivalente esperienza professionale
• 5+ anni di esperienza complessiva in settori tecnologici rilevanti
• 2+ anni che lavorano in un ambiente multinazionale come Ingegnere o Te

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous recherchons un ingénieur compétent en gestion d'identité et d'accès pour rejoindre notre équipe IAM en pleine croissance. Ce rôle offre une occasion unique à un développeur Java d'étendre son expertise dans l'espace Identity and Access Management, en mettant l'accent sur les technologies SailPoint et l'intégration d'applications. Vous travaillerez à résoudre des problèmes d'affaires complexes par l'application pratique de vos compétences de développement, contribuant à la conception, la mise en œuvre et l'évolution de solutions d'identité à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Dans cette position, vous assumerez une responsabilité significative pour les décisions de conception technique, bâtirez une infrastructure IAM résiliente et jouerez un rôle actif dans la façon dont notre organisation gère l'identité et l'accès à l'ensemble de l'entreprise. L'opportunité Ce rôle vous place à l'intersection du développement logiciel et de la sécurité de l'information, où vous appliquerez votre expertise Java pour résoudre des défis complexes de gestion d'identité et d'accès au sein d'une grande entreprise mondiale. Vos responsabilités
• Contribuer à la conception de bout en bout des solutions d'infrastructure de l'IAM et créer et maintenir des normes connexes
• Produire et tenir à jour une documentation complète pour les conceptions, les modèles et les normes de composants
• Interagir avec les principaux partenaires internes et externes sur des questions techniques importantes liées aux priorités organisationnelles
• Renforcer la communauté de la sécurité de l'information en établissant des ponts et en collaborant avec les pairs et les intervenants
• Contribuer à la détermination des critères de succès et à l'évaluation des solutions et des technologies prometteuses par le biais de preuves de concept (PdC) et d'études de faisabilité
• Concevoir, construire, tester et mettre en œuvre des solutions IAM intégrées, résistantes et fiables
• Conseiller, influencer et collaborer avec divers partenaires informatiques et intervenants du secteur d'activité, en intégrant leurs commentaires
• Veiller à ce que les conceptions et les solutions soient conformes aux politiques, aux normes et aux orientations stratégiques de l'organisation
• Contribuer à l'estimation des ressources et des délais d'exécution des projets
• Écrire et contribuer aux documents de position, aux livres blancs, aux recommandations techniques et à la documentation sur les meilleures pratiques pour l'espace de solution IAM
• Rester proactif pour identifier les défis opérationnels et les possibilités, en travaillant avec les équipes de soutien pour s'assurer que les solutions répondent aux normes de qualité et de réglementation
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de soutien à la gestion de l'identité et des opérations pour la gestion des incidents, la gestion des problèmes et l'amélioration continue des services
• Embrassez notre infrastructure comme chaîne d'outils Code et respectez les meilleures pratiques de codage Qui vous êtes Compétences et expérience technologiques
• Une expertise approfondie en développement Java avec une capacité prouvée de l'appliquer dans des contextes de sécurité d'entreprise
• Expérience pratique avec les technologies de gestion d'identité; l'expérience SailPoint est très souhaitée
• Expérience démontrée suivant les pratiques de CI/CD et DevOps
• Connaissance des architectures des microservices, de la conception des API et des API REST
• Compréhension des architectures distribuées et des défis qu'elles présentent
• Expérience de travail dans un environnement agile
• La compétence en Python et en langages de script (Perl, JavaScript, PowerShell, etc.) est souhaitée
• Contexte dans la gestion de l'identité et de l'accès, les services d'annuaire ou la cybersécurité est un plus Compétences de base et qualifications
• Licence ou expérience professionnelle équivalente
• 5 ans et plus d'expérience générale dans les domaines technologiques pertinents
• 2+ ans de travail dans un environnement multinational comme ingénieur ou Te

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 职位职责：
• （ 1 ）协助在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息

jobs.title: APAC RCSC Service Specialist /Application Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Customer Support Specialist within our APAC Hub, you are the first point of professional contact for our customers. You play a vital role in ensuring that healthcare providers can continue their essential work without interruption. In this role, you will:

• Resolve critical challenges: Handle customer inquiries via phone and digital channels, providing foundational troubleshooting and technical problem-solving to ensure patient testing remains on track.

• Champion digital transformation: Actively promote and guide customers in adopting digital support tools and remote assistance technologies to improve laboratory efficiency.

• Drive quality and safety: Act as a local case handler, identifying product quality issues and escalating them to ensure the highest standards of patient safety.

• Foster continuous improvement: Contribute to the creation of new troubleshooting materials and "self-fix" content, empowering both colleagues and customers.

• Collaborate across borders: Work within an agile, intercultural team, participating in local and global projects that shape the future of service excellence in the region.

• Simulate real-world solutions: Utilize our onsite laboratory to recreate customer scenarios, ensuring our solution approaches are accurate and effective.

Who You Are
We are looking for a curious, customer-centric individual who thrives in a dynamic environment and is passionate about healthcare technology.

Your Qualifications:

• Educational Background: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, or Information Technology.

• Professional Experience: You bring at least 1-2 years of experience in medical technology, laboratory environments, or healthcare IT support.

• Language Excellence: You are fluent in English and possess professional-level proficiency in one or more of the following: Chinese dialects, Thai, or Korean, to support our diverse APAC customer clusters.

• Technical Aptitude: You have a solid understanding of medical analysis systems, connectivity, or IT network technologies, with a methodical approach to troubleshooting.

• Customer-First Mindset: You possess excellent communication skills and the ability to convey complex technical information clearly and concisely.

• Flexibility: You are comfortable working within a 24/7 rotating shift pattern, including public holidays, to support the critical needs of the healthcare systems we serve. Let’s thrive together in a culture built on trust, collaboration, respect, and high performance.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Die Chance Als Customer Support Specialist in unserem APAC Hub sind Sie der erste professionelle Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden. Sie spielen eine wichtige Rolle dabei, dass Gesundheitsdienstleister ihre wichtige Arbeit ohne Unterbrechung fortsetzen können. In dieser Rolle werden Sie:
• Beheben Sie kritische Herausforderungen: Behandeln Sie Kundenanfragen über Telefon- und digitale Kanäle und bieten Sie grundlegende Fehlersuche und technische Problemlösungen, um sicherzustellen, dass Patiententests auf dem richtigen Weg bleiben.
• Champion Digitale Transformation: Aktive Förderung und Unterstützung der Kunden bei der Einführung digitaler Support-Tools und Fernunterstützungstechnologien zur Verbesserung der Laboreffizienz.
• Fahrqualität und Sicherheit: Handeln Sie als lokaler Fallbetreuer, identifizieren Sie Produktqualitätsprobleme und eskalieren Sie sie, um die höchsten Standards der Patientensicherheit zu gewährleisten.
• Förderung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung: Tragen Sie zur Erstellung neuer Fehlerbehebungsmaterialien und "Selbstbehebung" bei, um sowohl Kollegen als auch Kunden zu stärken.
• Über Grenzen hinweg zusammenarbeiten: Arbeiten Sie in einem agilen, interkulturellen Team und beteiligen Sie sich an lokalen und globalen Projekten, die die Zukunft der Service Excellence in der Region gestalten.
• Simulieren Sie reale Lösungen: Nutzen Sie unser Labor vor Ort, um Kundenszenarien zu erstellen und sicherzustellen, dass unsere Lösungsansätze genau und effektiv sind. Wer du bist Wir suchen eine neugierige, kundenorientierte Person, die in einem dynamischen Umfeld lebt und sich für Gesundheitstechnologie begeistert. Ihre Qualifikationen:
• Bildungshintergrund: Sie haben einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in einem relevanten Bereich wie Biochemie, Molekularbiologie, Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering oder Informationstechnologie.
• Berufserfahrung: Sie bringen mindestens 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung in Medizintechnik, Laborumgebungen oder IT-Unterstützung im Gesundheitswesen mit.
• Language Excellence: Sie sprechen fließend Englisch und verfügen über professionelle Kenntnisse in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Sprachen: Chinesische Dialekte, Thai oder Koreanisch, um unsere vielfältigen APAC-Kundencluster zu unterstützen.
• Technische Eignung: Sie haben ein solides Verständnis für medizinische Analysesysteme, Konnektivität oder IT-Netzwerktechnologien mit einem methodischen Ansatz zur Fehlersuche.
• Customer-First Mindset: Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Informationen klar und prägnant zu vermitteln.
• Flexibilität: Sie arbeiten gerne in einem 24/7 rotierenden Schichtmuster, einschließlich Feiertagen, um die kritischen Bedürfnisse der Gesundheitssysteme, die wir bedienen, zu unterstützen. Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam in einer Kultur gedeihen, die auf Vertrauen, Zusammenarbeit, Respekt und hoher Leistung basiert. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opportunité En tant que spécialiste du support à la clientèle au sein de notre Hub APAC, vous êtes le premier point de contact professionnel pour nos clients. Vous jouez un rôle vital pour que les prestataires de soins de santé puissent poursuivre leur travail essentiel sans interruption. Dans ce rôle, vous :
• Résoudre les défis critiques : Gérez les demandes de renseignements des clients par téléphone et par voie numérique, en fournissant des solutions techniques et des solutions de problèmes de base pour s'assurer que les tests des patients demeurent sur la bonne voie.
• Champion de la transformation numérique : Promouvoir et guider activement les clients dans l'adoption d'outils de support numérique et de technologies d'assistance à distance pour améliorer l'efficacité des laboratoires.
• Conduire la qualité et la sécurité : agir en tant que gestionnaire de cas local, identifier les problèmes de qualité du produit et les augmenter pour assurer les normes les plus élevées de sécurité des patients.
• Favoriser l'amélioration continue : contribuer à la création de nouveaux matériaux de dépannage et de contenu « autofix », responsabilisant les collègues et les clients.
• Collaborer au-delà des frontières : travailler au sein d'une équipe agile et interculturelle, participer à des projets locaux et mondiaux qui façonnent l'avenir de l'excellence des services dans la région.
• Simuler des solutions du monde réel : Utilisez notre laboratoire sur place pour recréer des scénarios clients, garantissant que nos approches de solution sont précises et efficaces. Qui vous êtes Nous sommes à la recherche d'un individu curieux et axé sur le client qui prospère dans un environnement dynamique et qui est passionné par la technologie de la santé. Vos qualifications :
• Contexte éducatif : Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise dans un domaine pertinent comme la biochimie, la biologie moléculaire, les sciences de la vie, le génie biomédical ou la technologie de l'information.
• Expérience professionnelle : Vous apportez au moins 1 à 2 ans d'expérience dans la technologie médicale, les environnements de laboratoire ou le soutien informatique de santé.
• Excellence linguistique : Vous maîtrisez couramment l'anglais et maîtrisez un ou plusieurs des éléments suivants : dialectes chinois, thaïs ou coréens, pour soutenir nos divers groupes de clients APAC.
• Aptitude technique : Vous avez une bonne compréhension des systèmes d'analyse médicale, de la connectivité ou des technologies de réseau informatique, avec une approche méthodique du dépannage.
• Customer-First Mindset: Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication et la capacité de transmettre des informations techniques complexes de manière claire et concise.
• Flexibilité: Vous êtes à l'aise de travailler dans le cadre d'une rotation 24/7, y compris les jours fériés, pour répondre aux besoins critiques des systèmes de santé que nous servons. Laissez-les prospérer ensemble dans une culture fondée sur la confiance, la collaboration, le respect et la haute performance. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 職務内容
• フィールドサービスエンジニアとして、下記の業務を行います。 ・当社検査機器(免疫・生化学・遺伝子・病理検査関連の医療機器)の据付、保守点検業務、トラブル対応 ・ユーザーに対する検査機器の操作方法の説明 ・保守点検スケジューリングや作業報告書の作成 ・保守契約の締結、請求

応募条件
• （必須）
• ・機器メンテナンスやフィールドサービスに関する知識
• ・経験（業界不問）
• ・普通自動車運転免許資格および運転経験
• ・全国転勤可

（歓迎）
• ・対顧客コミュニケーションスキルのある方 ・関係各所へのコミュニケーション
• ・調整を取ってきた方 ・医療機器または診断薬業界における検体検査機器の取扱い経験
• ・ネットワーク関連の知識 ・病院でのMEとしての経験

＜必要資格＞
必要条件：普通自動車免許第一種

雇用形態および期間
• 雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
• 試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

• 業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　フィールドサービスエンジニア
　　　　　• （変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
• 就業場所
• （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
　　　　　　　　• ※本社での6か月間の研修後、仙台オフィスへ配属予定。
• （変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　
• 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　
• 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　
• 時間外固定手当：月51,936円　（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　　• ※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
　　• ＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
• 諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
• 所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
• 勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
• 標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
• （※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
• 時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
• 休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
• 休暇:
• ・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
• ・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

• 福利厚生 ・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
• 受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙
• 募集者名 　ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社　(Roche Diagnostics K.K.)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing/Design Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

As a digital marketing intern, you will support the brand in planning, implementing, monitoring campaigns and creating a social media presence. You will be required to work closely with internal and external stakeholders to drive the adoption of Roche’s Health Digital Solutions (HDS) & Glucose Monitoring (GM) solutions to enable the implementation of Roche’s integrated Personalized Diabetes Management (iPDM) strategy.

The Opportunity:

• Exposure to the E-commerce (Shopee & Lazada) and digital space

• Generating content for Roche’s digital platforms

• Designing digital materials for Shopee, Lazada, social media sites I.e. Telegram

• Identifying and monitoring digital market trends (i.e. reading data to track performance of digital campaigns campaigns)

• Collaborating with internal and external stakeholders - you will be able to hone your relationship management skills

• Access to our diverse Roche Network

Who you are:

• You are currently studying for your Bachelor’s degree in Digital Marketing

• Familiar with E-commerce such as Shopee & Lazada as well as the digital space

• Up to date with trends on social channels (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook etc)

• Excellent digital communication skills

• Able to commit for 6 months internshi p

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Come stagista di marketing digitale, supporterai il marchio nella pianificazione, nell'implementazione, nel monitoraggio delle campagne e nella creazione di una presenza sui social media. Sarà necessario lavorare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per guidare l'adozione delle soluzioni di monitoraggio della salute di Roche (HDS) & Glucose (GM) per consentire l'implementazione della strategia di gestione integrata dei diabeti personalizzati di Roche (iPDM). L'opportunità:
• Esposizione all'E-commerce (Shopee & Lazada) e allo spazio digitale
• Generare contenuti per le piattaforme digitali di Roche
• Progettazione di materiali digitali per Shopee, Lazada, social media siti I.e. Telegram
• Identificare e monitorare le tendenze del mercato digitale (cioè leggere i dati per monitorare le prestazioni delle campagne di campagne digitali)
• Collaborando con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni - sarete in grado di affinare le vostre capacità di gestione delle relazioni
• Accesso alla nostra rete Roche Chi sei:
• Attualmente stai studiando per la tua laurea in Digital Marketing
• Familiare con E-commerce come Shopee & Lazada e lo spazio digitale
• Fino ad oggi con tendenze sui canali sociali (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook ecc)
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione digitale
• In grado di commettere per 6 mesi internshi p Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position Summary
As the Chief of Staff for the Roche Diagnostics Japan Enabling Team, you will play a key role in the effective functioning and strategic success of the Japan Dia organization. Reporting to the Chapter Lead, ET Office (Dottedly to GM Japan), you will work side by side with the Dia Japan GM and Dia Japan Enabling Team as the “Chief of Staff”.
In this role, you will be involved in the strategic planning processes across the organization through strong collaboration with key stakeholders and network teams. In addition, you will work with the ET to translate vision/ strategy to actionable deliverables and assist them in facilitating effective decision-making. You will follow through and update the ET on progress of these deliverables as well as communication to employees through dashboard or other avenues. You will work with ET to prioritize on agenda and work through the backlog. And you will plan, convene and facilitate ET meetings to ensure objectives are achieved.

You will be responsible to:
● Support Japan Dia GM to develop short- and long-term priorities (business, financial and people) aligned to Roche Dia business objectives, by engaging in strategic planning processes across the organization through strong collaboration with key stakeholders
and network teams.
● As Chief of Staff, support the ET to ensure they are setting and achieving outcomes, while building and maintaining an environment that keeps the team focused on top priorities.
● Convene and facilitate the ET meetings, plan the agenda and support the team in timely, well-informed decision making.
● Design and facilitate effective meetings by prioritizing key objectives, balancing content review with discussion, and moderating dialogue.
● Strengthen ET cohesiveness by working with the P&C and regular exchanges with individual ET members.
● Increase ET effectiveness; Facilitate the formation of ET squads, make accountability clear, track and monitor ET decisions and backlog; hold ET members accountable to decisions and backlog.
● Lead, supported by administrative staff, on all aspects of logistics and planning of ET meetings.
● Collaborate with the GM and subject matter experts to develop communications and presentation materials for various speaking engagements.

Who you are
Professional and Technical Requirements:
- Degree / Masters in life sciences with typically with 3-5+ years of relevant experience in the life science sector in a similar capacity that may be directly comparable to Diagnostics and/or Pharmaceuticals is an advantage.
- Strategy consulting background and skill set would be desirable.
- Strong leadership experience, preferably with experience leading diverse teams and/or highly complex matrix leadership of enterprise-level projects.
- Strong business sense with a solid understanding of the healthcare industry and experience operating in a regulated environment.

Experience, Skills, Knowledge:

- Fully bilingual in Japanese and English in verbal, writing, and reading
- A systems thinker who can connect the dots between functions and processes in terms of broader business implications, including tactical, strategic, and enterprise dependencies.
- A strong collaborator, able to cultivate a strong and trusting relationship with executive leaders, proven experience in stakeholder management.
- Ability to work effectively in ambiguity and manage through change, able to work effectively across cultures and highly matrix organization
- Be detail-oriented with exce

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary 职位概述:
The Medical Network Expert is a key role that brings the Medical Scientific Affairs (MSA) strategy to life for a given disease area by serving as the interface between China Medical Affairs teams, China cross-functional strategy teams, Regional, and Global teams to deliver an integrated medical strategy plan that incorporates short-, mid- and long-term perspectives. The Medical Network Expert works hand in hand with the Medical Affairs team members to understand and address customer needs, leverages external stakeholder generated insights, and collaborate with the Global teams to provide China-specific insights into products in development.
医疗网络专家是一个关键角色，通过作为中国医疗事务团队、中国跨职能战略团队、区域和全球团队之间的桥梁，为特定疾病领域带来医学科学事务（MSA）战略，以提供包含短期、中期和长期视角的综合医学战略计划。医疗网络专家与医学事务团队成员携手合作，了解并满足客户需求，利用外部利益相关者提出的见解，并与全球团队合作，为正在开发的产品提供中国市场特有的洞见

Main Tasks & Responsibilities 主要工作职责 :
1. Bring clinical insights to all disease area medical squad conversations
在所有疾病领域医学相关讨论中提供临床见解
2. Works within the cross functional core team, in close collaboration with the MSA stakeholders to develop the medical components of the overall China integrated strategy for a given disease area (and related assets/services) leveraging external stakeholder generated insights/needs
在跨职能核心团队中工作，与MSA团队伙伴密切合作利用外部利益相关者提出的见解/需求，针对特定疾病领域制定中国整体综合战略
3. Coordinate medical strategy plan development for a particular disease area to include: INSIGHTS, INNOVATIONS, EVIDENCE, GUIDELINES and EDUCATION & SCIENTIFIC EXCHANGES
协调特定疾病领域的医学战略计划制定，包括：见解、创新、证据、指南以及教育和科学交流
4. Develop a robust KOL network outside of the company that can be strategically tapped for medical insights and advocacy work
在公司外部建立强大的 KOL 网络并战略性地利用该网络进行医学见解宣传
5. Review outputs of internal partners for medical accuracy and patient centricity
审查内部合作伙伴的交付成果以确保医学准确性以及以患者为中心的宗旨被充分贯彻
6. Supports the creation of an inspiring team environment with agile, open, and inclusive culture
支持创建具有敏捷、开放和包容文化的鼓舞人心的团队环境
7. May support Medical Affairs work in the specific disease area as needed and respond to unsolicited requests for information about unapproved products or uses, or off-label information.
按需支持特定疾病领域的医学事务工作，对有关未经批准的产品/用途的信息/标签外信息的需求做出回应。
8. Identifies opportunities for cross-functional cooperation to maximize utilization of resources
识别跨职能合作的机会以最大限度地利用资源

Education & Qualifications 教育背景与专业资格:
Master’s degree or above in Clinical Medicine, Laboratory Medicine, Pharmacy, or equivalent work experience in the In vitro diagnostics industry
医学临床、医学检验或药学硕士及以上，或有相关体外诊断领域的工作经验
Experience工作经验:
1. 4+ years of experience in developing and implementing medical strategies for various diseases in the medical or pharmaceutical industry
4年以上在医药或诊断行业，具备针对各种疾病制定和实施医疗策略的经验
2. Clinical research and trial management experience, and the ability to interact with KOLs with sufficient knowledge, expertise and confidence.
临床研究试验管理经验，及拥有丰富的知识，专长及自信与KOL 进行互动的能力
3. Must maintain knowledge of applicable research and literature
对适用的研究文献有知识储备
4. Fluent English skills and excellent presentation and teaching skills and the ability to represent the company in a professional manner at medical, scientific and public events.
流利的英语语言能力，优秀的报告展示能力及教学技巧，有代表公司参加医学科学及公共活动并表现专业的能力

Values & Core Competencies 价值观与核心能力：
• Demonstrate Roche values of Integrity, Courage, Passion
体现罗氏的价值观：真诚,勇气,激情
• Follow Roche Operating Principles
遵循罗氏运营准则
• Equip wit

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior IT Service Delivery Manager

The Opportunity
As a Senior IT Service Delivery Manager within the Diagnostics R&D Portfolio & Project Management (PPM) organization, you will champion the management, governance, and optimization of IT Services across the entire Diagnostics R&D department.

You will put the needs of our scientific teams at the center of everything you do—ensuring the right processes, resources, and KPIs are in place to meet service commitments. Success in this role requires skillfully navigating a highly complex, matrixed organization to execute comprehensive solution visions and drive strategic vendor partnerships.

Key Responsibilities
Stakeholder & Demand Management

• Strategic Partnership: Identify, engage, and collaborate deeply with all R&D functional heads (including Labs, Computational Science & Engineering, Instrumentation, Engineering, Business Partnering, CDMA, and PPM). Understand their unique technical requirements and propose strategic solutions.

• Demand Forecasting: Maintain a forward-looking perspective of the R&D ecosystem to proactively forecast future infrastructure, platform, and service demands.

• Service Lifecycle Management: Drive the service lifecycle strategy in alignment with broader product roadmaps. Ensure services are clearly cataloged, easily discoverable, and highly consumable for R&D teams, continuously measuring success through User Experience (UX) metrics.

Operations, Governance & Process Optimization

• Metrics & Performance: Define service runs against metrics that matter to R&D teams. Establish new Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), design measurement methods, and hold accountability for delivery against targets, deadlines, and quality standards.

• Process Improvement: Spot operational insights and performance trends to continually drive process efficiencies and quality enhancements. Initiate changes to service specifications based on real-world data.

• Incident & Escalation Management: Swiftly resolve operational incidents to minimize downtime, protecting scientific velocity and business goals. Manage high-profile escalations and implement root-cause improvements to reduce recurring issues.

• Backlog Negotiation: Identify operational gaps, bottlenecks, and technical debt across R&D pillars. Advocate for the prioritization of operational needs directly within product team backlogs.

• Service Continuity: Develop, evaluate, and continually refine business continuity and disaster recovery plans to safeguard critical R&D operations and datasets.

Financial, Sourcing & Vendor Management

• Fiscal Accountability: Manage the team budget with full accountability for invoicing, billing controls, and compliance with local procurement, VMO, security, and legal processes.

• Vendor Performance: Monitor vendor relationships to ensure external operations meet agreed-upon SLA metrics, constantly identifying opportunities to enhance external service delivery.

• Sourcing Innovation: Lead Request for Proposal (RfP) processes, service benchmarking, and the onboarding or transition of services to new suppliers.

• Strategic Sourcing: Partner with sourcing managers to align with global sourcing strategies, exploring modern delivery models (such as co-sourcing or end-to-end sourcing) that fit the R&D landscape.

Methodology & Leadership Innovation

• Agile & DevOps Champion: Drive the implementation of Agile frameworks, DevOps maturity assessments, and automation initiatives to boost operational efficiency across int

• Incident & Escalation Management: risolvere rapidamente gli incidenti operativi per ridurre al minimo i tempi di fermo, proteggere la velocità scientifica e gli obiettivi aziendali. Gestire escalations di alto profilo e implementare root-cause miglioramenti per ridurre i problemi ricorrenti.
• Backlog Negotiation: Identificare le lacune operative, i colli di bottiglia e il debito tecnico attraverso i pilastri R&D. Avvocato per la priorità delle esigenze operative direttamente all'interno dei backlog del team di prodotti.
• Continuità del servizio: Sviluppare, valutare e perfezionare continuamente la continuità aziendale e i piani di ripristino dei disastri per salvaguardare operazioni e set di dati R&D critici. Gestione finanziaria, approvvigionamento e vendita
• Fiscal Accountability: Gestisci il budget del team con piena responsabilità per la fatturazione, i controlli di fatturazione e il rispetto degli appalti locali, VMO, sicurezza e processi legali.
• Performance del fornitore: Monitorare le relazioni dei fornitori per garantire che le operazioni esterne soddisfino le metriche SLA concordate, identificando costantemente le opportunità per migliorare la consegna dei servizi esterni.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Gestionnaire principal des services de TI L'opportunité En tant que gestionnaire principal de la prestation des services de TI au sein de l'organisation du portefeuille et de la gestion de projets diagnostiques, vous serez le champion de la gestion, de la gouvernance et de l'optimisation des services de TI dans l'ensemble du département de R-D diagnostiques. Vous mettrez les besoins de nos équipes scientifiques au centre de tout ce que vous faites – assurer les bons processus, ressources et ICR sont en place pour répondre aux engagements de service. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, il faut naviguer habilement dans une organisation très complexe et matricielle pour réaliser des visions globales de solutions et stimuler les partenariats stratégiques avec les fournisseurs. Principales responsabilités Gestion des intervenants et de la demande
• Partenariat stratégique : Identifier, engager et collaborer étroitement avec tous les responsables fonctionnels de la R-D (y compris les laboratoires, les sciences et l'ingénierie informatiques, l'instrumentation, l'ingénierie, le partenariat d'affaires, CDMA et PPM). Comprendre leurs exigences techniques uniques et proposer des solutions stratégiques.
• Prévisions de la demande : Maintenir une perspective prospective de l'écosystème de la R-D afin de prévoir de façon proactive les besoins futurs en matière d'infrastructure, de plate-forme et de services.
• Gestion du cycle de vie du service : Diriger la stratégie du cycle de vie du service conformément à des feuilles de route plus larges. Veiller à ce que les services soient clairement catalogués, facilement découvrables et très consommables pour les équipes de R-D, en mesurant continuellement le succès grâce aux mesures de l'expérience utilisateur (UX). Opérations, gouvernance et optimisation des processus
• Mesure et rendement : Définir le service est conforme aux mesures qui comptent pour les équipes de R-D. Établir de nouveaux indicateurs clés de rendement (ICP), concevoir des méthodes de mesure et rendre compte de l'exécution par rapport aux cibles, aux échéances et aux normes de qualité.
• Amélioration des processus : Spot des idées opérationnelles et des tendances de rendement pour stimuler continuellement l'efficacité des processus et améliorer la qualité. Initier des modifications aux spécifications de service basées sur des données du monde réel.
• Gestion de l'incident et de l'escalation : Résoudre rapidement les incidents opérationnels pour minimiser les temps d'arrêt, protéger la vitesse scientifique et les objectifs commerciaux. Gérer les escalades à forte visibilité et mettre en œuvre les améliorations de cause racine pour réduire les problèmes récurrents.
• Négociation en arrière-plan : Identifier les lacunes opérationnelles, les goulets d'étranglement et la dette technique entre les piliers de la R-D. Préconiser la hiérarchisation des besoins opérationnels directement dans les arriérés des équipes de produits.
• Continuité des services : Élaborer, évaluer et perfectionner continuellement les plans de continuité des activités et de reprise après sinistre afin de protéger les opérations et les ensembles de données essentiels en R-D. Finances, approvisionnement et gestion des fournisseurs
• Responsabilisation financière : Gérer le budget de l'équipe en rendant pleinement compte de la facturation, des contrôles de facturation et de la conformité aux procédures locales d'approvisionnement, de VMO, de sécurité et de justice.
• Rendement des fournisseurs : Surveiller les relations des fournisseurs pour s'assurer que les opérations externes respectent les paramètres convenus de l'ALS, en identifiant constamment les possibilités d'améliorer la prestation des services externes.
• Sourcing Innovation : Processus de demande de propositions (DP), analyse comparative des services et intégration ou transition des services vers de nouveaux fournisseurs.
• Sourcing stratégique : S'associer avec les gestionnaires de l'approvisionnement pour s'aligner sur les stratégies mondiales d'approvisionnement, explorer des modèles modernes de prestation (comme le co-approvisionnement ou l'approvisionnement de bout en bout) qui correspondent au paysage de la R-D. Méthodologie et leadership Innovation
• Agile & DevOps Champion: Diriger la mise en œuvre des cadres Agile, des évaluations de maturité DevOps et des initiatives d'automatisation pour améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle de l'ensemble de l'entreprise
