descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Sie werden sein:

• Koordinieren Sie sich mit den SSC KL Finance Teams (AP, GAMA, AR, TR, T & E, Compliance und Beschaffung) und führen Sie Abschlussaktivitäten zum Monatsende, Quartalsende und Jahresende durch, um eine rechtzeitige und genaue Schließung der Konten in Übereinstimmung mit der Checkliste zum Monatsende zu gewährleisten.

• Führen Sie eine analytische Überprüfung der Gewinn- und Verlustrechnungen und der Bilanz durch, die für die finanzielle Genauigkeit der Finanzdaten des Affiliates verantwortlich ist. Verantwortlich für alle internen Kontrollen der Finanzberichterstattung (ICFR) Dokumentation und interne Kontrollen Angelegenheiten, handeln als Eigentümer für die ICFR-Tools - INVOLVE und BWISE

• Überprüfen Sie den monatlichen Bilanzabgleich – verfolgen Sie offene Posten und korrigieren Sie alle festgestellten Anomalien. Geben Sie andere Berichtspakete genau und innerhalb eines festgelegten Zeitrahmens ein, z. B. Nachhaltigkeit, Versicherungsberichterstattung. Verantwortlich für IFRS 16 Leasingangelegenheiten, d.h. SimSol /Planon. Überprüfen und genehmigen Sie alle manuellen Journaleinträge für die Veröffentlichung durch das SSC KL-Team. Verantwortlich für alle Management-Accounting-Aspekte, z. B. Periodenkostenzuweisung, COPA-Zuweisung, SSC-Zuweisung usw.

• Accounts Receivables / Accounts Payables : Verantwortlich für alle Aspekte von Accounts Receivables - Überprüfung und Genehmigung manueller Abrechnungen, Überprüfung der alternden Schuldner und Festlegung von Folgemaßnahmen, stellen Sie sicher, dass alle verkaufsbezogenen Aktivitäten rechtzeitig und korrekt gemeldet werden. Verantwortlich für alle Aspekte der Zahlbaren Konten – Überprüfung und Genehmigung von AP-bezogenen Aktivitäten, z. B. Rechnungen von Lieferanten, Zahlungen usw.

• Treasury: Cashflow-Management - Prognose des aktuellen und zukünftigen Cashflow-Bedarfs und Anordnung für notwendige Geldtransfers (falls erforderlich). Verantwortlich für alle Treasury-Angelegenheiten, d. H. FX-Deal, Kreditfazilitäten, Zahlungsanfrage, Bankangelegenheiten.

• Stammdaten: Verwaltung von Stammdaten - Kontenplan, Kostenstelle, Profit Center. WBS, Vendor & Customer Stammdaten, UCI, etc. Andere Aktivitäten, die umfassen: Vorbereitung der gesetzlichen Steuerberechnungen und Abstimmung, einschließlich Steuerberichterstattung und Verbindung mit Steuerberater. Erstellung von Audit-bezogenen Zeitplänen und Dokumentationen, einschließlich der Zusammenarbeit mit dem Auditor. Nehmen Sie an Compliance-Audits teil und beantworten Sie Auditanfragen. Identifizieren, empfehlen und implementieren Sie in Absprache mit dem Management Lösungen für kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten in den operativen Bereichen. Als Hauptansprechpartner für SSC KL Finance Teams für die Problemlösung in allen finanziellen Angelegenheiten. Als Hauptansprechpartner für FM in den Tochtergesellschaften für alle finanziellen Angelegenheiten, Anfragen und Beratung.

Wer du bist :

• Ein Abschluss in Finanzen / Rechnungswesen / Handel oder gleichwertig. ACCA, CPA Australien oder andere berufliche Qualifikationen im Rechnungswesen werden ein zusätzlicher Vorteil sein.

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in verwandten Bereichen und mindestens 3 Jahre In Accountant Rolle / Audit Erfahrung. Kenntnis der Rechnungslegungsgrundsätze und -praktiken; Finanzberichterstattung, Prüfung und Besteuerung.

• Kenntnisse in relevanter Buchhaltungssoftware, vorzugsweise SAP und MS Office Tools. Akribisch, unabhängig, proaktiv und in der Lage, Aufgaben innerhalb enger Fristen auszuführen.

• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die Ideen und Erwartungen klar und prägnant ausdrücken. Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz der effektiven Beziehung und Stakeholder-Management mit verschiedenen Bevölkerungsgruppen (Kunden, Kollegen und leitende Führungskräfte). Kenntnisse in der Beeinflussung von Fähigkeiten. Komfortables Arbeiten in einem dynamischen, sich verändernden und wachsenden Umfeld. Die Fähigkeit, effektiv in verschiedenen kulturellen und geschäftlichen Umgebungen zu arbeiten. Abs.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben.

Das sind wir
Du wirst Teil des Bereichs Gebäudebetrieb / Technische Dienste am Standort Penzberg. Wir sind ein engagiertes, interdisziplinäres Team, das mit Leidenschaft dafür sorgt, dass die Infrastruktur für unsere Wissenschaftler:innen reibungslos funktioniert. In einer Kultur des Vertrauens und Respekts arbeiten wir Hand in Hand, um die täglichen technischen Herausforderungen zu meistern

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle bist Du verantwortlich für die technische Verfügbarkeit sämtlicher Geräte und Anlagen im Laborgebäude sowie im Technikumsbereich. Dabei übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Du koordinierst interne und externe Gewerke für Wartungen, Inspektionen und Instandhaltungen.

• Du arbeitest eng mit den Gebäudebetriebsingenieuren zusammen, um nahtlose Schnittstellen zu gewährleisten.

• Du leitest eigenständig nutzerspezifische Projekte und bindest bei komplexen Vorhaben das Engineering ein.

• Du analysierst Störungen, entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen und leitest präventive Maßnahmen ab.

• Du optimierst kontinuierlich technische Prozesse hinsichtlich Energieeffizienz, Kosten und Anlagenlaufzeit.

In this role, you are part of Site Operations and belong to the Technical BU Services team.

Responsibility | This is what awaits you
Taken over in the role You are responsible for ensuring the functionality, technical availability and continuous optimization of process and building facilities at our locations. In addition, you will take on the following exciting tasks:

• Ensure plant availability: You ensure an economical and highly available operation of the buildings and plants through continuous monitoring, reliability studies and error considerations.

• Manage maintenance: You plan, commission and coordinate efficient maintenance measures and monitor them independently in terms of quality, costs and deadlines.

• Develop concepts: You develop sustainable service concepts and coordinate appropriate maintenance strategies closely with the operators you maintain in the SAP system.

• Managing projects: You plan and control building and process engineering measures and take over the (sub)project management for a professional and timely implementation according to the state of the art.

• Safety & Compliance: You ensure compliance with all laws as well as requirements for occupational safety, environmental protection and quality assurance and assume the delegated plant responsibility.

• Budget & documentation: You support with technical budget planning, monitor the costs of your measures and ensure a complete, up-to-date CV documentation of the technical facilities.

Qualifications | This is what you bring with you

• You have successfully completed an engineering degree (Dipl.-Ing. FH / Bachelor / Master) in the field of mechanical engineering, process engineering, supply engineering or a comparable qualification.

• You bring several years of professional experience in plant construction, in the support of complex technical systems or in building operations.

• You have in-depth expertise in the maintenance and operation of technical systems as well as ideally experience in the regulated environment (GMP / GEP).

• You are characterized by a strong economic thinking, like to make decisions based on data and bring a high IT affinity (e.g. SAP) as well as chemical-process engineering knowledge.

• You speak negotiable English and generally have excellent communication skills. As a team player, you are able to work effectively with different stakeholders and communicate complex relationships in an understandable way.

So far so good? We can do better.
We offer you a wide range of top benefits at our locations. Only with you can we improve the lives of patients. You make Roche unique with your contribution. That’s why we offer exceptional benefits to help you shape your life, finances and health the way you want. Find h

jobs.title: Domain Architect - Site & Services
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Domain Architect – Sites & Services is a senior, pivotal role within the SPG (Strategy, Portfolio & Governance) Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions team. This role serves as the critical connector between the Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) organization and the global Sites, SHE & Sustainability function with a focus on the Sites. Reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions with a dotted line to the Sites leadership team, you will champion our enterprise architecture practices while deeply understanding the unique complexities of Roche’s global site footprint, corporate real estate, and facility management operations.
Crucially, in our federated Roche Digital Technology (RDT) model, you will act as the principal orchestrator of the Sites architecture network. By leading this network—which includes yourself alongside all domain and solution architects embedded directly within the Sites organization—you will drive architecture governance and strategy formulation, ensure enterprise coherence, and translate business goals into adaptable, future-ready technology roadmaps.

Description of the Area
The Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions area serves as the strategic architectural interface for business domain leaders, fostering collaboration to align applications, business capabilities, and information assets with technology solutions. For the Sites domain, this involves deeply integrating with product and engineering teams across the core Sites function, Data, Analytics & AI, and the Regional Business Partnering teams (e.g., Switzerland, Germany, US West Coast, US Mid-West and East Coast). This architectural role ensures that the bridge between SPG’s enterprise vision and the local operational execution for Roche's physical footprint and smart building initiatives is seamless, collaborative, and highly effective.

The Opportunity:

• Drive strategic business partnering by acting as the primary architectural liaison between SPG and the Sites function to align real estate priorities with multi-year technology roadmaps.

• Orchestrate the global architecture network across regional sites, empowering embedded domain and solution architects to execute efficiently while adhering to shared enterprise principles.

• Lead architecture governance by defining technology guardrails and non-functional requirements, including IoT network security, physical access control resilience, and operational data privacy.

• Steer critical program delivery for high-impact initiatives such as smart building deployments, connected workplace technologies, and global real estate portfolio rationalization.

• Develop core domain architecture deliverables, including Facility Management capability maps, target-state architectures, and reference blueprints utilizing the ArchiMEDES toolchain.

• Align portfolio investments by embedding architectural insights into funding decisions, maximizing platform reuse, and actively minimizing technical debt across global sites.

• Evaluate emerging technology innovations and vendor solutions (such as digital twins for buildings and advanced IoT facility ecosystems) to ensure alignment with operational needs.

• Foster a collaborative workplace culture that balances enterprise coherence with local agility, transforming complex architectural visions into scalable, real-world value.

Who you are:

• Educated with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, Arch

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Join us in making this happen with:

• Effective customer engagement (National)

• Expertise in the field of Haematology (Malignant)

• Medical Science Liaison (MSL) experience within the healthcare setting

The Medical Patient Journey Partner (M-PJP) is a local customer facing role unlocking value along the patient journey - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards integrated solutions, much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption.

The M-PJP is a medical affairs role with a reporting line culminating with the Country Medical Director; this role has a Quality Use of Medicines (QUM) focus and operates at all times with non-promotional intent.

The M-PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster (the “triple win”).

What you will be working on:
The Medical PJP is an empowered leader and the local medical affairs face of Roche who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche. In this role, you will be involved in:

• Scientific Leadership: Serve as a scientific expert for the company’s Haematology pipeline and marketed products, providing deep expertise to internal teams and external stakeholders.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), clinical investigators, and academic researchers within the Haematology field.

• Education & Training: Provide scientific education and training to healthcare professionals, internal teams, and partners, ensuring accurate, up-to-date information about our products.

• Evidence Generation and Clinical Support: Support clinical trial development by providing scientific insights and collaborating with clinical teams on ongoing and upcoming clinical trials.

• Data Communication: Effectively communicate complex scientific data, including clinical trial results, in a clear, concise manner to a wide range of audiences.

• Field Intelligence: Gather and analyze scientific and clinical insights from the field, and provide feedback to shape product strategy, development, and commercialization efforts.

• Compliance & Documentation: Ensure all interactions comply with industry regulations and ethical standards. Maintain accurate documentation of scientific activities.

Who you are:
As a driven medical affairs professional, you think from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, in order to bring best possible outcomes to both the local health environment, and more broadly, across Roche globally.

You have:

• University degree (life sciences) and/or Healthcare professional qualification with practical understanding of digital innovation methodologies. An advanced degree in Life Sciences and/or MBA is a plus

• 5+ years of demonstrated experience or equivalent exposure in the medical affairs or related field (e.g. MSL) within in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry with up to date knowledge of Medicines Australia Code of Conduct

• Scientific and Therapy Area expertise in Haematology in mapping patient journeys and related treatments in the assigned TA, enabling engagement at the specialist level

• Robust strategic understanding and experience in tactical imple

• Formazione e formazione: fornire formazione scientifica e formazione a professionisti sanitari, team interni e partner, assicurando informazioni accurate e aggiornate sui nostri prodotti.

• Generazione di prove e supporto clinico: Supporta lo sviluppo di studi clinici fornendo informazioni scientifiche e collaborando con i team clinici su studi clinici in corso e in arrivo.

• Comunicazione dei dati: Efficacemente comunicare dati scientifici complessi, compresi i risultati di prova clinica, in modo chiaro e conciso a una vasta gamma di pubblico.

• Field Intelligence: Raccogliere e analizzare le informazioni scientifiche e cliniche dal campo, e fornire feedback per modellare gli sforzi di strategia, sviluppo e commercializzazione dei prodotti.

• Compliance & Documentation: Assicurarsi che tutte le interazioni siano conformi alle normative del settore e agli standard etici. Mantenere la documentazione accurata delle attività scientifiche.

Chi sei:
Come professionista di affari medici guidato, si pensa da un livello di impresa, oltre i confini e confini, al fine di portare i migliori risultati possibili sia per l'ambiente sanitario locale, e più in generale, attraverso Roche a livello globale.

Hai...

• Laurea universitaria (scienze della vita) e/o qualifica professionale sanitaria con comprensione pratica delle metodologie di innovazione digitale. Un grado avanzato in Scienze della Vita e/o MBA è un plus

• 5+ anni di esperienza dimostrata o esposizione equivalente negli affari medici o nel campo relativo (ad esempio MSL) all'interno del settore farmaceutico o biotecnologico con una conoscenza aggiornata di Medicinali Australia Codice di condotta

• Robusta comprensione strategica ed esperienza nell'imple tattico

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Pharma Technical Operations (PT) department is establishing the One PT Data Office to serve as the strategic center for data governance, strategy, and enablement across the entire global PT network. This team is at the heart of our digital transformation, responsible for architecting and leading a central data office to unlock the full potential of PT’s data assets.

We are recruiting Data Steward Leads who will have the opportunity to establish PT’s data stewardship framework and approach to delivering and embedding effective data governance within PT domains. You will serve as the leader for Business Data Stewards for data specifications and quality, ensuring that global data standards are adopted and data owners are established. Your role involves identifying and resolving data constraints and issues, acting as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Business Data Stewards.

The Opportunity

• Own, build, manage, and mobilize a network of domain Data Stewards and Data Owners, working closely to implement global data governance policies, standards, and processes as centrally defined.

• Act as a single point of contact for a specific PT domain (Supply Chain & Finance, Quality, Regulatory, Development, or Manufacturing & CDMO) for data governance challenges and needs.

• Ensure robust roles, responsibilities, and accountabilities for data stewardship and ownership within the domain and in alignment with broader data domains.

• Enable the data domain to understand and translate global standards, policies, and frameworks and ensure compliance across the domain.

• Identify data constraints and issues, such as data integrity problems, and develop strategies for addressing these challenges on applicable source systems.

• Act as the business process owner within or across the domain, overseeing data governance and ensuring that data practices align with business objectives.

• Work with Data Stewards to implement metadata management processes and establish data dictionaries, glossaries, and cataloguing tools to facilitate documentation.

Who You Are

• Experience: 7 - 10+ years of relevant data stewardship experience or similar, with experience in a leadership capacity and working in a complex organization.

• Domain Expertise: Strong knowledge of data management practices and principles, particularly within the context of Pharma Tech Ops or similar industries, with expertise in Supply Chain & Finance, Quality & Regulatory, Development, or Manufacturing & CDMO.

• Education: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required. A Master’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred.

• Technical Skills: Strong expertise in data governance standards, policy, flow, and quality; data driven, with the ability to analyse and interrogate data.

• General Skills: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of engaging with stakeholders at all levels, and demonstrated leadership and problem-solving abilities to drive data initiatives.

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity!

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Madrid. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il dipartimento Pharma Technical Operations (PT) sta stabilendo l'One PT Data Office per servire come centro strategico per la governance dei dati, la strategia e l'attivazione in tutta la rete PT globale. Questo team è al centro della nostra trasformazione digitale, responsabile dell’archiviazione e della guida di un data office centrale per sbloccare il pieno potenziale dei dati di PT.

Stiamo reclutando Data Steward Leads che avranno l'opportunità di stabilire il framework di gestione dei dati di PT e l'approccio a fornire e integrare una governance efficace dei dati all'interno dei domini di PT. Potrai servire come leader per Business Data Stewards per le specifiche e la qualità dei dati, assicurando che gli standard di dati globali sono adottati e i proprietari di dati sono stabiliti. Il tuo ruolo consiste nell'identificazione e nella risoluzione di vincoli e problemi di dati, agendo come singolo punto di contatto (SPOC) per gli amministratori di dati aziendali.

L'opportunità

• Possedere, costruire, gestire e mobilitare una rete di amministratori di dati di dominio e proprietari di dati, lavorando a stretto contatto per implementare politiche, standard e processi di governance dei dati globali come definiti centralmente.

• Agire come un unico punto di contatto per uno specifico dominio PT (Supply Chain & Finance, Quality, Regulatory, Development, or Manufacturing & CDMO) per le sfide e le esigenze di governance dei dati.

• Assicurare ruoli, responsabilità e responsabilità robuste per la gestione e la proprietà dei dati all'interno del dominio e in allineamento con domini di dati più ampi.

• Abilitare il dominio dei dati per comprendere e tradurre standard, politiche e framework globali e garantire la conformità in tutto il dominio.

• Identificare vincoli di dati e problemi, come problemi di integrità dei dati e sviluppare strategie per affrontare queste sfide sui sistemi sorgente applicabili.

• Agire come proprietario del processo di business all'interno o all'interno del dominio, supervisionare la governance dei dati e garantire che le pratiche dei dati si allineano con gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Lavorare con Data Stewards per implementare i processi di gestione dei metadati e stabilire dizionari di dati, glossari e strumenti di catalogazione per facilitare la documentazione.

Chi sei

• Esperienza: 7 - 10+ anni di esperienza di gestione dei dati rilevanti o simili, con esperienza in una capacità di leadership e lavoro in un'organizzazione complessa.

• Esperienza di dominio: Forte conoscenza delle pratiche e dei principi di gestione dei dati, in particolare nel contesto di Pharma Tech Ops o industrie simili, con competenze in Supply Chain & Finance, Quality & Regulatory, Development, or Manufacturing & CDMO.

• Istruzione: Una laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, o un campo correlato è richiesto. È preferito un master o un'esperienza equivalente.

• Competenze tecniche: Forte competenza negli standard di governance dei dati, politica, flusso e qualità; dati guidati, con la capacità di analizzare e interrogare i dati.

• Competenze generali: Forte comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, in grado di impegnarsi con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli, e dimostrato leadership e capacità di problem solving per guidare le iniziative di dati.

Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Applicare ora per scoprire questa eccitante opportunità!

Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Madrid. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione.
Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 empl

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Le département des Opérations Techniques Pharmaes (PT) est en train de créer le One PT Data Office pour servir de centre stratégique de gouvernance des données, de stratégie et d'habilitation sur l'ensemble du réseau mondial de PT. Cette équipe est au cœur de notre transformation numérique, responsable de l'architecture et de la direction d'un bureau central de données pour libérer tout le potentiel des actifs de données PT.

Nous recrutons des responsables de la gestion des données qui auront l'occasion d'établir un cadre et une approche de gestion des données de PT pour assurer et intégrer une gouvernance efficace des données dans les domaines de PT. Vous serez le chef de file pour les Business Data Stewards pour les spécifications et la qualité des données, en veillant à ce que les normes mondiales de données soient adoptées et que les propriétaires de données soient établis. Votre rôle consiste à identifier et à résoudre les contraintes et les problèmes liés aux données, en agissant comme point de contact unique (SPOC) pour les délégués aux données d'affaires.

L'opportunité

• Propre, construire, gérer et mobiliser un réseau de Data Stewards et de Data Owners, travaillant en étroite collaboration pour mettre en œuvre les politiques, normes et processus de gouvernance mondiale des données tels que définis au niveau central.

• Agir comme un point de contact unique pour un domaine particulier de PT (chaîne d'approvisionnement et finances, qualité, réglementation, développement ou fabrication et CDMO) pour les défis et les besoins en matière de gouvernance des données.

• Assurer des rôles, des responsabilités et des responsabilités solides en matière de gestion et de propriété des données dans le domaine et conformément à des domaines de données plus vastes.

• Permettre au domaine des données de comprendre et de traduire les normes, politiques et cadres mondiaux et d'assurer la conformité dans l'ensemble du domaine.

• Recenser les contraintes et les problèmes de données, comme les problèmes d'intégrité des données, et élaborer des stratégies pour relever ces défis sur les systèmes source applicables.

• Agir en tant que propriétaire de processus opérationnels à l'intérieur ou à travers le domaine, surveiller la gouvernance des données et s'assurer que les pratiques en matière de données cadrent avec les objectifs opérationnels.

• Travailler avec Data Stewards pour mettre en oeuvre des processus de gestion des métadonnées et établir des dictionnaires de données, des glossaires et des outils de catalogage pour faciliter la documentation.

Qui vous êtes

• Expérience : de 7 à 10 ans d'expérience pertinente en gestion des données ou d'une expérience semblable, avec une expérience en leadership et travaillant dans une organisation complexe.

• Domaine d'expertise : Bonne connaissance des pratiques et principes de gestion des données, en particulier dans le contexte des opérations Pharma Tech ou d'industries similaires, avec une expertise en chaîne d'approvisionnement et finances, qualité et réglementation, développement ou fabrication et CDMO.

La posizione

Data Scientist Submission Data and Content Generation & Reuse (AIDCG) - Pharma R&D

Sei appassionato di sfruttare l'intelligenza artificiale all'avanguardia e la scienza dei dati per trasformare la cura dei pazienti? In qualità di Data Scientist, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nel guidare, sviluppare e implementare soluzioni innovative e basate sui dati per risolvere problemi aziendali complessi. È possibile bilanciare l'esecuzione tecnica pratica con la leadership strategica dei contenuti, la costruzione di funzionalità AI all'avanguardia che accelerano direttamente l'innovazione sanitaria.

A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi.

Descrizione dell'Area

La funzione Clinical Submission Data and Content Generation & Reuse si concentra sulla modernizzazione della creazione e della gestione dei dati clinici e delle attività di presentazione delle normative (dati e contenuti). Sviluppa e implementa piattaforme per la gestione dei contenuti strutturata, consentendo il riutilizzo dei componenti approvati attraverso i documenti. Questo gruppo pionieristico anche l'uso di agentic AI per assistere a generare, rivedere e assemblare beni complessi di sottomissione (dati e contenuti), mirando a migliorare la qualità e ridurre i tempi di autore.

L'opportunità

• Proprietà della soluzione end-to-End: Leader, sviluppare e distribuire soluzioni basate sui dati e modelli predittivi dall'inizio alla distribuzione per affrontare complesse sfide aziendali.

• Agentic AI Development: Costruire agenti AI specializzati e fare flussi di lavoro multi-agenti in un ambiente GxP altamente regolamentato per supportare gli scienziati di dati analitici nel ciclo di vita dei dati clinici.

• Risolvere problemi indipendenti: Identificare le opportunità analitiche in modo indipendente e risolvere problemi di dati complessi, assicurando la precisione del modello e la validazione con una supervisione minima.

• Collaborazione trasversale: Coinvolgere direttamente con le unità aziendali per comprendere i loro requisiti di dati e tradurre i risultati analitici in insight attuabili sia per gli stakeholder tecnici che non tecnici.

• Leadership del progetto strategico: guidare progetti di scienze dei dati di medie dimensioni che influenzano direttamente le decisioni aziendali chiave e allineare con strategie organizzative più ampie.

• Data Modeling & Optimization: Lavorare con grandi e complessi dataset per costruire nuovi modelli predittivi da zero e ottimizzare gli algoritmi esistenti per la massima prestazione.

• Guida tecnica: contribuisce frequentemente alla roadmap tecnica del team, bilanciando lo sviluppo AI/ML con la leadership tecnica strategica.

• Process Automation: sviluppare strumenti innovativi, come debugger di codifica proattivi che parse verbose logs e proporre automaticamente correzioni di codice/configurazione per la programmazione clinica complessa.

Chi sei

• Istruzione e esperienza: Master o Bachelor in Data Science, Informatica, Statistica, o un campo quantitativo correlato, accoppiato con un minimo di 5+ anni di esperienza professionale in scienza dei dati, modellazione predittiva e distribuzione end-to-end.

• Consegna del progetto & ProprietÃ: Provato track record di identificare in modo indipendente le opportunitÃ analitiche, i principali progetti di scienza dei dati di medie dimensioni, e la fornitura di soluzioni che guidano i risultati aziendali.

• Proficienza di programmazione: competenza avanzata in Python (per backend AI/ML e logica agente) e R (concentrati su programmi statistici clinici

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

Datenwissenschaftler Einreichung Daten und Content Generation & Reuse (AIDCG) - Pharma R&D

Haben Sie eine Leidenschaft für die Nutzung modernster künstlicher Intelligenz und Datenwissenschaft, um die Patientenversorgung zu verändern? Als Data Scientist spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Führung, Entwicklung und Bereitstellung innovativer, datengesteuerter Lösungen zur Lösung komplexer Geschäftsprobleme. Sie werden die praktische technische Ausführung mit strategischer Content-Führung in Einklang bringen und modernste KI-Fähigkeiten aufbauen, die die Innovation im Gesundheitswesen direkt beschleunigen.

Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Im Moment verlangen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathäuser, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen.

Beschreibung des Gebiets

Die Funktion Clinical Submission Data and Content Generation & Reuse konzentriert sich auf die Modernisierung der Erstellung und Verwaltung von klinischen Daten und regulatorischen Submission Assets (Daten und Inhalte). Es entwickelt und setzt Plattformen für strukturiertes Content Management ein, die die Wiederverwendung von genehmigten Komponenten in allen Dokumenten ermöglichen. Diese Gruppe ist auch Vorreiter bei der Verwendung von Agentic AI, um bei der Generierung, Überprüfung und Zusammenstellung komplexer Einreichungsressourcen (Daten und Inhalte) zu helfen, mit dem Ziel, die Qualität zu verbessern und die Autorenzeit zu verkürzen.

Die Chance

• End-to-End Solution Ownership: Führen, Entwickeln und Bereitstellen datengesteuerter Lösungen und prädiktiver Modelle von der Gründung bis zur Bereitstellung, um komplexe geschäftliche Herausforderungen zu bewältigen.

• Agentische KI-Entwicklung: Erstellen Sie spezialisierte KI-Agenten und maßgeschneiderte Multiagenten-Workflows in einer stark regulierten GxP-Umgebung, um Analytical Data Scientists über den gesamten klinischen Datenlebenszyklus hinweg zu unterstützen.

• Unabhängige Problemlösung: Identifizieren Sie Analysemöglichkeiten unabhängig und lösen Sie komplexe Datenprobleme, um die Genauigkeit und Validierung von Modellen mit minimaler Überwachung zu gewährleisten.

• Funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Engagieren Sie sich direkt mit Geschäftseinheiten, um ihre Datenanforderungen zu verstehen und analytische Ergebnisse in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse für technische und nicht-technische Stakeholder zu übersetzen.

• Strategische Projektleitung: Fördern Sie mittelgroße Data-Science-Projekte, die wichtige Geschäftsentscheidungen direkt beeinflussen und sich an breiteren Organisationsstrategien ausrichten.

• Datenmodellierung und -optimierung: Arbeiten Sie mit großen, komplexen Datensätzen, um neue Vorhersagemodelle von Grund auf neu zu erstellen und bestehende Algorithmen für maximale Leistung zu optimieren.

• Technische Roadmap-Anleitung: Tragen Sie häufig zur technischen Roadmap des Teams bei und balancieren Sie die praktische KI/ML-Entwicklung mit der strategischen technischen Führung.

• Prozessautomatisierung: Entwicklung innovativer Tools wie proaktive Codierungs-Debugger, die ausführliche Protokolle analysieren und automatisch Code-/Konfigurations-Fixes für komplexe klinische Programmierung vorschlagen.

Wer du bist

• Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Master- oder Bachelor-Abschluss in Data Science, Informatik, Statistik oder einem verwandten quantitativen Bereich, gepaart mit mindestens 5+ Jahren Berufserfahrung in Data Science, prädiktiver Modellierung und End-to-End-Bereitstellung.

• Project Delivery & Ownership: Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der unabhängigen Identifizierung analytischer Möglichkeiten, der Leitung mittelgroßer Data-Science-Projekte und der Bereitstellung von Lösungen, die die Geschäftsergebnisse vorantreiben.

• Programmierkenntnisse: Erweiterte Kenntnisse in Python (für AI / ML-Backends und Agentenlogik) und R (fokussiert auf klinische statistische Programmemi)

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Données scientifiques Production et réutilisation de données et de contenu (AIDCG) - R-D pharmaceutique

Êtes-vous passionné par le recours à l'intelligence artificielle de pointe et à la science des données pour transformer les soins aux patients? En tant que Data Scientist , vous jouerez un rôle central dans la direction, le développement et le déploiement de solutions innovantes et axées sur les données pour résoudre des problèmes d'affaires complexes. Vous équilibrerez l'exécution technique pratique avec le leadership stratégique du contenu, en développant des capacités d'IA de pointe qui accélèrent directement l'innovation en soins de santé.

Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration.

Description de la zone

La fonction Production et réutilisation des données et du contenu des présentations cliniques met l'accent sur la modernisation de la création et de la gestion des données cliniques et des éléments de présentation réglementaires (données et contenu). Il développe et déploie des plateformes pour la gestion structurée du contenu, permettant la réutilisation des composants approuvés dans tous les documents. Ce groupe est également à l'avant-garde de l'utilisation de l'intelligence artificielle agentique pour aider à générer, examiner et assembler des actifs complexes de soumission (données et contenu), en vue d'améliorer la qualité et de réduire les délais de rédaction.

L'opportunité

• Propriété de la solution de bout en bout : Diriger, développer et déployer des solutions et des modèles prédictifs axés sur les données, depuis le début jusqu'au déploiement, pour relever des défis opérationnels complexes.

• Développement de l'IA Agentique : Construisez des agents d'IA spécialisés et des workflows multi-agents sur mesure dans un environnement GxP hautement réglementé pour soutenir les chercheurs en données analytiques tout au long du cycle de vie des données cliniques.

• Solution de problèmes indépendante : Identifier les possibilités d'analyse indépendamment et résoudre les problèmes de données complexes, en assurant l'exactitude et la validation du modèle avec une supervision minimale.

• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : S'engager directement auprès des unités opérationnelles pour comprendre leurs besoins en matière de données et traduire les résultats d'analyse en éléments concrets pour les intervenants techniques et non techniques.

• Leadership stratégique des projets : Diriger des projets de moyenne envergure dans le domaine de la science des données qui influent directement sur les principales décisions opérationnelles et s'harmonisent avec des stratégies organisationnelles plus vastes.

• Modélisation et optimisation des données: Travaillez avec de grands ensembles de données complexes pour construire de nouveaux modèles prédictifs à partir de zéro et optimiser les algorithmes existants pour une performance maximale.

• Orientation technique de la feuille de route : contribuer fréquemment à la feuille de route technique de l'équipe, en conciliant le développement pratique de l'IA/ML et le leadership technique stratégique.

• Automatisation des processus : Développez des outils novateurs, comme des débogueurs de codage proactifs qui analysent les journaux de verbes et proposent automatiquement des corrections de code/configuration pour une programmation clinique complexe.

Qui vous êtes

• Études et expérience : Maîtrise ou baccalauréat en sciences des données, informatique, statistique ou domaine quantitatif connexe, jumelé à un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle en sciences des données, modélisation prédictive et déploiement de bout en bout.

• Exécution et propriété du projet : Expérience éprouvée de l'identification indépendante des possibilités d'analyse, de la direction de projets scientifiques de taille moyenne en matière de données et de la prestation de solutions favorisant les résultats opérationnels.

• Compétence en programmation: Compétences avancées en Python (pour les moteurs de l'IA/ML et la logique des agents) et R (concentré sur le programme statistique cliniquemi

The Head of Site Operations, Hospitality & Real Estate is responsible for the strategic management of the site's non-technical infrastructure and "Soft Services." The position ensures a high-quality, compliant, and sustainable working environment for all employees while managing a significant number of outsourced service partners (100+ external staff). This role is critical in maintaining the site's hygiene standards (GMP requirement) and driving sustainability goals through effective waste management.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities:

• Digitalization & Innovation: Implement digital tools for facility booking, service requests, and visitor management to drive operational efficiency.

The Position
Job Summary:
The Head of Site Operations, Hospitality & Real Estate is responsible for the strategic management of the site's non-technical infrastructure and "Soft Services." This role oversees Real Estate management, GMP Cleaning Services, Canteen/Catering, Waste Management, and general site services. The position ensures a high-quality, compliant, and sustainable working environment for all employees while managing a significant number of outsourced service partners (100+ external staff). This role is critical in maintaining the site's hygiene standards (GMP requirement) and driving sustainability goals through effective waste management.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities:

• Real Estate & Space Management: Manage site layout and space utilization; plan and execute office renovation or reorganization projects. Maintain lease agreements and ensure compliance with real estate regulations.

• GMP Service & Hygiene Management: Oversee Plant Service Cleaning to ensure production and lab areas meet strict cleanliness classifications (ISO/GMP standards). Manage GMP garment services and Pest Control programs.

• Employee Services (Hospitality): Manage the Canteen and Catering services, ensuring food safety, quality, and variety for employees. Oversee other site amenities such as shuttle buses, green maintenance, and reception services.

• Waste Management & Environmental Strategy: Manage the collection, storage, and disposal of all site waste in compliance with local laws. Lead initiatives such as zero-waste-to-landfill to reduce the site's environmental footprint.

• Vendor Partnership & Contract Management: Act as the primary contract owner for large Integrated Facility Management (IFM) providers. Foster a "One Team" culture aligned with Roche values and safety standards.

• Financial Scope & Budgeting: Manage a significant OPEX budget for outsourced services and utilities. Continuously optimize service contracts to ensure value for money without compromising quality.

• EHS Support: Collaborate with the SHE team to ensure all service providers adhere to safety protocols and site-specific safety regulations.

• Digitalization & Innovation: Implement digital tools for facility booking, service requests, and visitor management to drive operational efficiency.

Qualification & Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Facility Management, or related field.

• Requirements of China Medical Device GMP article 8 and IVD section 2.1.1.

• 8+ years of experience in Facility Management or Site Operations, preferably in a manufacturing (GMP) environment. Proven experience in managing large integrated facility management (IFM) contracts.

• Specialist knowledge of GMP cleaning requirements and environmental waste regulations. Strong negotiation and SLA definition skills. Fluency in English and Mandarin (written and spoken).

Leadership Competencies:
"Leadership competencies at proficient level, in line with corporate framework."

Remarks:

• SHE Responsibility please refer to RDSZ SHE handbook

A healthier future drives us to innovate. The Position
Job Summary
The Head of Site Engineering & Technical Support is responsible for the strategic planning, operation, and maintenance of the site's "Hard Services" and technical infrastructure. This includes Plant Engineering (Utilities: HVAC, Water, Gas, Electricity), Facility Maintenance, and Technical Support. The role ensures the continuous, safe, and reliable supply of critical utilities to manufacturing operations, strictly adhering to GMP and SHE standards, acting as the technical authority for the site's physical assets and infrastructure lifecycle management.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities

• Utility Operation & Maintenance: Manage the E2E lifecycle of site utilities (Purified Water, WFI, HVAC, Compressed Air, Electrical Power) ensuring >99% uptime for critical systems.

• Facility Management & Infrastructure: Oversee the maintenance of all plant buildings and technical infrastructure to ensure long-term safety, compliance, and asset longevity.

• Technical Authority & Lifecycle Management: Act as the final technical sign-off for engineering changes and asset lifecycle plans; lead the long-term CAPEX roadmap for infrastructure upgrades.

• Financial Accountability: Manage the annual operating budget (OPEX) for Utilities and Maintenance and oversee significant CAPEX budgets for site infrastructure.

• SHE & Compliance: Ensure all technical services comply with Global GMP, local legal regulations (Pressure Vessels, High Voltage etc.), and Roche SHE standards.

• Leadership & People Management: Foster a culture of Safety and Reliability; lead the technical response team during site emergencies and ensure technical competency training for the team.

• Innovation & Sustainability: Lead the digitalization of maintenance (e-Maintenance, IoT monitoring) and champion sustainable energy projects to reduce the site's carbon footprint.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with internal Manufacturing, QA, and SHE heads while managing relationships with external utility authorities, OEM suppliers, and contractors.

Education
Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or HVAC Engineering
Bachelor’s Degree
Preferred: Master’s Degree

Qualification
Compliant with China Medical Device GMP & IVD regulations
Article 8 / IVD 2.1.1
Preferred: Professional Engineer License

Experience
8+ years in Engineering; 5+ years in Plant Engineering or Facility Management
Pharma/Med-Device
Preferred: Multi-national Company exp

Deep knowledge of Utility systems; Strong root cause analysis (RCA) skills
Fluent English & Mandarin

Leadership competencies at proficient level, in line with corporate framework.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Die Rolle gewährleistet die kontinuierliche, sichere und zuverlässige Versorgung der Fertigungsbetriebe mit kritischen Versorgungsunternehmen unter strikter Einhaltung der GMP- und SHE-Standards und fungiert als technische Autorität für das physische Assets- und Infrastruktur-Lifecycle-Management des Standorts.

Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

• Utility Operation & Maintenance: Verwalten Sie den E2E-Lebenszyklus von Dienstprogrammen (Reinigtes Wasser, WFI, HVAC, Druckluft, elektrische Energie) und gewährleisten Sie eine Verfügbarkeit von > 99 % für kritische Systeme.

• Facility Management & Infrastruktur: Beaufsichtigen Sie die Wartung aller Anlagengebäude und der technischen Infrastruktur, um langfristige Sicherheit, Compliance und Langlebigkeit der Anlagen zu gewährleisten.

• Technical Authority & Lifecycle Management: Act as the final technical sign-off for engineering changes and asset lifecycle plans; Lead the long-term CAPEX roadmap for infrastructure upgrades.

• Finanzielle Rechenschaftspflicht: Verwalten Sie das jährliche Betriebsbudget (OPEX) für Versorgungs- und Wartungsdienste und überwachen Sie erhebliche CAPEX-Budgets für die Standortinfrastruktur.

• SHE & Compliance: Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle technischen Dienste den Global GMP, den lokalen gesetzlichen Vorschriften (Druckschiffe, Hochspannung usw.) und den Roche SHE-Standards entsprechen.

• Leadership & People Management: Pflegen Sie eine Kultur der Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit; führen Sie das technische Reaktionsteam in Notfällen vor Ort und sorgen Sie für technische Kompetenztraining für das Team.

• Innovation & Nachhaltigkeit: Führen Sie die Digitalisierung der Instandhaltung (E-Maintenance, IoT-Überwachung) und setzen Sie sich für nachhaltige Energieprojekte ein, um den CO2-Fußabdruck des Standortes zu reduzieren.

• Stakeholder Management: Arbeiten Sie mit internen Fertigungs-, QA- und SHE-Leitern zusammen und verwalten Sie die Beziehungen zu externen Versorgungsbehörden, OEM-Lieferanten und Auftragnehmern.

Qualifizierung & Erfahrung
Bildung
Mechanische, elektrische, Automatisierung oder HVAC Engineering
Bachelor-Abschluss
Bevorzugt: Master’s Degree

Qualifikation
Konform mit China Medical Device GMP & IVD-Vorschriften
Artikel 8 / IVD 2.1.1
Bevorzugt: Professional Engineer License

Erfahrung
8+ Jahre in Engineering; 5+ Jahre in Anlagenbau oder Facility Management
Pharma/Med-Gerät
Bevorzugt: Multinationales Unternehmen exp

Professional Comp
Tiefes Wissen über Utility-Systeme; Strong Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Fähigkeiten
Fließendes Englisch & Mandarin
Bevorzugt: Digitalisierung/IoT exp

Führungskompetenzen
Führungskompetenzen auf kompetentem Niveau, im Einklang mit den Unternehmensrahmenbedingungen.
Bemerkungen

• SHE Verantwortung: Bitte beachten Sie das RDSZ SHE Handbuch.

• Da diese Position mit GMP zusammenhängt, müssen die Qualifikationen den Anforderungen von China Medical Device GMP Artikel 8 und IVD Abschnitt 2.1.1 entsprechen.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns einen gesünderen Fut bauen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Résumé de l'emploi
Le responsable de l'ingénierie et du soutien technique du site est responsable de la planification stratégique, de l'exploitation et de l'entretien de l'infrastructure technique et des « services de garde » du site. Cela comprend le génie des installations (Utilitaires : CVC, eau, gaz, électricité), l'entretien des installations et le soutien technique. Ce rôle assure l'approvisionnement continu, sûr et fiable en services publics essentiels pour les opérations de fabrication, en respectant strictement les normes BPF et SHE, agissant en tant qu'autorité technique pour la gestion des biens matériels et du cycle de vie des infrastructures du site.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

• Exploitation et entretien des services publics : gérer le cycle de vie E2E des services publics du site (eau purifiée, WFI, CVC, air comprimé, électricité) en assurant une disponibilité de plus de 99 % pour les systèmes critiques.

• Gestion des installations et infrastructure : Surveiller l'entretien de tous les bâtiments d'installations et de l'infrastructure technique afin d'assurer la sécurité, la conformité et la longévité des actifs à long terme.

• Autorité technique et gestion du cycle de vie: Agir comme l'approbation technique finale des changements d'ingénierie et des plans de cycle de vie des actifs; diriger la feuille de route à long terme du CAPEX pour la modernisation des infrastructures.

• Responsabilisation financière : gérer le budget de fonctionnement annuel (BPEX) pour les services publics et l'entretien et superviser les budgets importants du CPEX pour l'infrastructure du site.

• SHE & Compliance: S'assurer que tous les services techniques sont conformes aux normes GMP mondiales, aux réglementations légales locales (navires de pression, haute tension, etc.) et Roche SHE.

• Leadership et gestion des personnes : Favoriser une culture de sécurité et de fiabilité; diriger l'équipe d'intervention technique pendant les urgences sur place et assurer la formation technique de l'équipe.

• Innovation et durabilité: Diriger la numérisation de la maintenance (e-Maintenance, suivi IoT) et promouvoir des projets énergétiques durables pour réduire l'empreinte carbone du site.

• Gestion des intervenants : Collaborer avec les responsables internes de la Fabrication, de l'AQ et de la SHE tout en gérant les relations avec les autorités de services publics externes, les fournisseurs d'OEM et les entrepreneurs.

Qualification et expérience
Éducation
Génie mécanique, électrique, d'automatisation ou de CVC
Licence
Préféré : Master , diplôme

Compétence
Conformité avec les règlements de Chine sur les BPF et les DIV
Article 8 / IVD 2.1.1
Preferred: Licence d'ingénieur professionnel

Expérience
8 ans et plus en ingénierie; 5 ans et plus en ingénierie des installations ou en gestion d'installations
Pharma/Med-Device
Preferred: Multi-national Company exp

Comp professionnel
Connaissance approfondie des systèmes d'utilité publique; Compétences solides en analyse des causes profondes
Anglais et mandarin
Préféré: Digitalisation/IoT exp

Compétences en leadership
Compétences en leadership à un niveau compétent, conformément au cadre ministériel.
Commentaires

• Veuillez consulter le manuel de RDSZ.

• Comme ce poste est lié aux BPF, les qualifications doivent être conformes aux exigences de l'article 8 des BPF et de la section 2.1.1 des BPF des instruments médicaux chinois.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Laissez-les construire une fumée plus saine

jobs.title: Study Start Up Lead (SSUL)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Pharma Korea
Cluster: Product Development Global Clinical Operations (PDG)
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Study Start Up Lead (SSUL)
We are looking for a Study Start Up Lead (SSUL) who will specialize in IND (Investigational New Drug) applications and overall regulatory strategy to lead our clinical trials into action.

The Role
As an SSUL specializing in IND and Regulatory submission, you will be the architect of our country-level start-up strategy. You won't just follow processes—you will optimize them. Your primary focus will be ensuring the efficient and compliant start up of Roche-sponsored trials by mastering the bridge between global strategy and local regulatory requirements.

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of the Korean regulatory landscape. You excel in a cross-functional environment and are passionate about driving innovation in clinical trials.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience(0-2 years) in IND/Regulatory submissions within the pharmaceutical industry or a leading CRO.

• In-depth knowledge of local regulatory requirements (MFDS, GCP, etc.) and experience interacting with HA or Ethics Committees.

• A "Solution-Oriented" mindset: Ability to identify bottlenecks and proactively drive process improvements.

• Strong communication skills in both Korean and English to effectively collaborate with global stakeholders.

• Leadership through influence: Ability to lead cross-functional teams without formal authority.

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Leadership through influence: Ability to lead cross-functional teams without formal authority. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. - Oui.

C'est pas vrai.
10. Autres projets ou tâches assignés par le gestionnaire hiérarchique
C'est pas vrai.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

titleByLocale.fr: Digital Campaign Spécialiste (Events & Congresses) (Fixed term for 2 years)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Digital Campaign Specialist (Events & Congresses) will lead the operational execution of our Global Congresses and Events. You will be responsible for bringing our face-to-face, virtual, and hybrid event experiences to life by executing high-impact digital marketing campaigns. Working closely with the global team, you will drive the creation of digital assets, manage complex project timelines, and analyze campaign performance to shape future digital strategies.

Please note that this is a fixed term position for 2 years.

The Opportunity:

• Execute end-to-end digital marketing campaigns for global events and congresses, ensuring seamless delivery across the entire event lifecycle (pre-event, live, and post-event).

• Create, update, and localize high-quality digital assets including webpages, email campaigns, social media posts, and sales enablement materials across our core platforms.

• Manage multiple concurrent event projects with tight deadlines, bringing structured coordination and precision to high-volume campaign operations.

• Track, analyze, and report on campaign performance , maintaining accurate dashboards and translating marketing metrics into actionable optimization insights.

• Collaborate closely with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams to anticipate project bottlenecks, align timelines, and deliver consistent brand experiences.

• Bring a creative, innovative mindset to our digital marketing processes, proactively identifying opportunities to improve our campaign workflows and technologies.

Who You Are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, alongside 3 to 4 years of hands-on experience executing digital marketing campaigns, email marketing, or content creation (events experience is a plus).

• You are highly proficient in managing digital marketing platforms, including website content management systems, email automation tools, social media channels, and CRM systems.

• You have a proven track record of coordinating multiple complex projects simultaneously under tight deadlines with a strong commitment to zero-error execution.

• You possess strong analytical capabilities, with experience using marketing analytics tools to track performance, build reports, and derive insights.

• You are a natural team player with excellent interpersonal skills and a strong ability to manage stakeholder expectations and solve problems creatively.

• You are an adaptable, detail-oriented digital marketer who thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

• You bring a structured approach to managing multiple moving parts and are passionate about leveraging digital channels to create meaningful connections.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coa

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il Global Digital Hub è stato fondato all'interno del Roche Services & Solutions Center di Budapest. Il nostro scopo principale è quello di rafforzare le capacità digitali di Roche a livello globale, supportando iniziative centrali con Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting e Creative Design.

Come Digital Campaign Specialist (Eventi & Congressi) guiderà l'esecuzione operativa dei nostri Congressi ed Eventi Globali. Sarete responsabili di portare a vita le nostre esperienze di eventi faccia a faccia, virtuali e ibridi, eseguendo campagne di marketing digitale ad alto impatto. Lavorando a stretto contatto con il team globale, guiderai la creazione di asset digitali, gestirai tempi di progetto complessi e analizzerai le prestazioni della campagna per modellare le future strategie digitali.

Si prega di notare che questa è una posizione a termine fissa per 2 anni.

L'opportunità:

• Esegui campagne di marketing digitale end-to-end per eventi e congressi globali, assicurando la consegna senza interruzioni in tutto il ciclo di vita degli eventi (pre-evento, live e post-evento).

• Creare, aggiornare e localizzare beni digitali di alta qualità, tra cui pagine web, campagne e-mail, post dei social media e materiali di attivazione delle vendite attraverso le nostre piattaforme principali.

• Gestire più progetti di eventi contemporaneamente con scadenze strette, portando coordinamento strutturato e precisione alle operazioni di campagna ad alto volume.

• Traccia, analizza e segnala le prestazioni della campagna, mantenendo scrivanie accurate e traducendo metriche di marketing in insight di ottimizzazione attuabili.

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con le parti interessate globali e i team interfunzionali per anticipare i colli di bottiglia del progetto, allineare le linee temporali e fornire esperienze di marca coerenti.

• Porta una mentalità creativa e innovativa ai nostri processi di marketing digitale, identificando in modo proattivo le opportunità per migliorare i flussi di lavoro e le tecnologie della nostra campagna.

Chi sei?

• Hai una laurea in Marketing, Business, Comunicazioni o un campo correlato, insieme a 3 a 4 anni di esperienza pratica che eseguono campagne di marketing digitale, email marketing, o creazione di contenuti (l'esperienza di eventi è un plus).

• Sei altamente competente nella gestione di piattaforme di marketing digitale, compresi i sistemi di gestione dei contenuti del sito web, strumenti di automazione e-mail, canali social media e sistemi CRM.

• Hai una comprovata traccia di coordinamento di più progetti complessi simultaneamente sotto scadenze strette con un forte impegno per l'esecuzione zero-error.

• Possiedi forti capacità analitiche, con l'esperienza utilizzando strumenti di analisi di marketing per monitorare le prestazioni, costruire report e trarre insight.

• Sei un giocatore di squadra naturale con eccellenti competenze interpersonali e una forte capacità di gestire le aspettative degli stakeholder e risolvere i problemi in modo creativo.

• Sei un marketer digitale adattabile e dettagliato che prospera in ambienti dinamici e veloci.

• Porti un approccio strutturato per gestire più parti in movimento e sei appassionato di sfruttare i canali digitali per creare connessioni significative.

In cambio vi forniamo:

• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.

• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto si può spostare Sportpass, coa
