jobs.title: Recruitment Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe every employee makes a difference. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are fearless in both decision and action; we believe that good business means a better world.

We are looking for a pro-active, passionate and talented Recruitment Interns colleagues for our team in Shanghai, China. As a Recruitment Intern you will be responsible for supporting the daily work of the Talent Acquisition Partners in the recruitment process for open roles projects.

We are offering an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on work experience and insights into Recruiting as well as wider HR topics during a very dynamic time at Roche. You will be an integral part of our TA team, managing recruiting activities across various client groups. In addition you will lead and support a range of global initiatives enabling our organization to adapt to new technologies and new ways of working.

During the internship you will have the opportunity to be responsible for the following:

• Candidate sourcing, application screening, requisitions clean up, scheduling and assessment

• Handling of candidate workflow using our e-recruitment system workday

• Supporting the team with reports and presentations, as well as actively looking for process improvements

• Other activities related to the role and business needs

We are keen to discover talents who are passionate about learning and show high curiosity in discovering new things.

Who you are:
You are an enrolled student in the advanced phase of your Bachelor or Master degree, preferably in Psychology, Business Management, Human Resources or in a related field. You ideally have first work experience in Human Resources and you are highly motivated to share your knowledge and chip in with new ideas.

You convince us and our business partners with the following skills and competencies:

• Excellent multi-tasking and prioritisation skills, with a high sense for quality and professional management of administrative tasks

• Creative, persistent, driven and eager to learn

• Ambitious self-starter with confident and systematic attitude towards complex tasks and contents

• Communication and Negotiation Skills.

• Knowledge of MS Office, Google Suite is a plus

• Previous project experience is a plus

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Bei Roche glauben wir, dass jeder Mitarbeiter einen Unterschied macht. Wir sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, das Leben der Patienten zu verändern. Wir sind furchtlos in Entscheidung und Handeln; wir glauben, dass gutes Geschäft eine bessere Welt bedeutet.

Wir suchen proaktive, leidenschaftliche und talentierte Recruitment Interns Kollegen für unser Team in Shanghai, China. Als Recruitment Praktikant bist du dafür verantwortlich, die tägliche Arbeit der Talent Acquisition Partner im Recruitingprozess für Open-Role-Projekte zu unterstützen.

Wir bieten eine spannende Gelegenheit, in einer sehr dynamischen Zeit bei Roche praktische Arbeitserfahrung und Einblicke in das Recruiting sowie breitere HR-Themen zu sammeln. Sie werden ein integraler Bestandteil unseres TA-Teams sein und die Rekrutierungsaktivitäten in verschiedenen Kundengruppen verwalten. Darüber hinaus leiten und unterstützen Sie eine Reihe globaler Initiativen, die es unserem Unternehmen ermöglichen, sich an neue Technologien und neue Arbeitsweisen anzupassen.

Während des Praktikums haben Sie die Möglichkeit, für Folgendes verantwortlich zu sein:

• Candidate Sourcing, Application Screening, Requisitions Clean Up, Scheduling und Assessment

• Handhabung des Kandidaten-Workflows mit unserem E-Rekrutierungssystem Workday

• Unterstützung des Teams bei Berichten und Präsentationen sowie aktive Suche nach Prozessverbesserungen

• Sonstige Tätigkeiten im Zusammenhang mit Rolle und Geschäftsanforderungen

Wir sind bestrebt, Talente zu entdecken, die leidenschaftlich lernen und eine hohe Neugier zeigen, neue Dinge zu entdecken.

Wer du bist:
Sie sind ein eingeschriebener Student in der fortgeschrittenen Phase Ihres Bachelor- oder Master-Abschlusses, vorzugsweise in Psychologie, Business Management, Human Resources oder in einem verwandten Bereich. Sie haben idealerweise erste Arbeitserfahrung in Human Resources und sind hoch motiviert, Ihr Wissen zu teilen und neue Ideen zu entwickeln.

Sie überzeugen uns und unsere Geschäftspartner mit folgenden Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen:

• Ausgezeichnete Multitasking- und Priorisierungskompetenzen mit hohem Sinn für Qualität und professionelles Management von Verwaltungsaufgaben

• Kreativ, hartnäckig, motiviert und lernbegierig

• Ehrgeiziger Selbststarter mit selbstbewusster und systematischer Einstellung zu komplexen Aufgaben und Inhalten

• Kommunikation und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten.

• Kenntnisse von MS Office, Google Suite ist ein Plus

• Frühere Projekterfahrung ist ein Plus

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Chez Roche, nous croyons que chaque employé fait une différence. Nous sommes passionnés par la transformation des vies des patients. Nous sommes intrépides tant dans la décision que dans l'action; nous croyons que les bonnes affaires signifient un monde meilleur.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un stagiaire proactif, passionné et talentueux pour notre équipe à Shanghai, en Chine. En tant que stagiaire en recrutement, vous serez chargé de soutenir le travail quotidien des Talent Acquisition Partners dans le processus de recrutement de projets à rôles ouverts.

Nous offrons une occasion passionnante d'acquérir une expérience de travail pratique et des idées sur le recrutement ainsi que sur des sujets plus larges en RH pendant une période très dynamique à Roche. Vous ferez partie intégrante de notre équipe TA, gérant les activités de recrutement dans différents groupes de clients. En outre, vous dirigerez et soutiendraz une série d'initiatives mondiales permettant à notre organisation de s'adapter aux nouvelles technologies et aux nouvelles façons de travailler.

Au cours du stage, vous aurez la possibilité d'être responsable des éléments suivants :

• Approvisionnement des candidats, examen des demandes, nettoyage des demandes, calendrier et évaluation

• Gestion du flux de travail des candidats en utilisant notre journée de travail du système de recrutement électronique

• Aider l'équipe à présenter des rapports et des présentations et à chercher activement à améliorer les processus

• Autres activités liées au rôle et aux besoins des entreprises

Nous sommes désireux de découvrir des talents passionnés d'apprentissage et de montrer une grande curiosité dans la découverte de nouvelles choses.

Qui vous êtes :
Vous êtes un étudiant inscrit dans la phase avancée de votre baccalauréat ou maîtrise, de préférence en psychologie, gestion d'entreprise, ressources humaines ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous avez idéalement une première expérience de travail en Ressources Humaines et vous êtes très motivé à partager vos connaissances et de la puce avec de nouvelles idées.

Vous nous convainquez, ainsi que nos partenaires commerciaux, des compétences et compétences suivantes :

• Excellente polytâche et hiérarchisation, avec un sens élevé pour la qualité et la gestion professionnelle des tâches administratives

• Créatif, persistant, motivé et désireux d'apprendre

• Auto-démarrer ambitieux avec une attitude confiante et systématique envers des tâches et des contenus complexes

• Compétences en communication et en négociation.

• Connaissance de MS Office, Google Suite est un plus

• L'expérience antérieure du projet est un plus

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect in Roche Digital Technologies (RDT) - Biometrics and Clinical Evidence focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within the complex clinical trial and real world data acquisition domain, working across multiple systems in the end-to-end ecosystem. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions.

You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the architectural vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies including the rapidly growing Agentic AI and ML technologies to accelerate innovation and maximize the impact to the business.

Your Responsibilities

• Jointly develop the IT Product roadmap together with the engineering teams and product heads and advise on technology choices

• Design solutions that meet system requirements, business priorities, and fit within the overall CRF & RWD Data Acquisition ecosystem. Accountable for the end-to-end solution architecture design.

• Ensure compliance and alignment with the Roche enterprise standards, principles and policies

• Assess functional & non-functional requirements and technical enablers together with Business Analysts and the technical team to develop architecture-runway and key design decisions

• Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle

• Work closely with the development teams to resolve technical challenges during system development and support

• Continually explore, research and pilot emerging technologies and propose adoption as appropriate

• Identify cost-savings opportunities and optimize IT investments

• Mitigate security and compliance risks from technical debt and obsolescence

• Propose and lead proof of concepts (PoC) to assess technical viability together with the Tech team

• Work with RDT adopting the use of AI and ML solutions in both developing and managing data pipelines.

• Actively participate & collaborate with solution, information, and enterprise architects within the engineering team and across products

Who You Are

• You built 7+ years of work experience as a Solution Architect or Technical Lead, of which at least 4 years in the Life Sciences or Pharma Industry. Knowledge of Pharma Regulations (GxP, Computer Validation) experience preferred

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes

• Proven track record of proactively contributing to architecture practices development and mentoring others

• Experience in the Pharma/Biotech domain, especially Clinical Trial Data Systems, such as Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems, Non-CRF data systems, digital health technologies, and clinical data warehouses

• Experience with ETLs/ELTs, data warehouses/lake/lakehouses, enterprise data integration patterns, relational and object databases, and experience with AWS or other cloud technologies

• In-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for products

• Ability

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect in Roche Digital Technologies (RDT) - Biometrics and Clinical Evidence focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within the complex clinical trial and real world data acquisition domain, working across multiple systems in the end-to-end ecosystem. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions.

You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the architectural vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies including the rapidly growing Agentic AI and ML technologies to accelerate innovation and maximize the impact to the business.

Your Responsibilities

• Jointly develop the IT Product roadmap together with the engineering teams and product heads and advise on technology choices

• Design solutions that meet system requirements, business priorities, and fit within the overall CRF & RWD Data Acquisition ecosystem. Accountable for the end-to-end solution architecture design.

• Ensure compliance and alignment with the Roche enterprise standards, principles and policies

• Assess functional & non-functional requirements and technical enablers together with Business Analysts and the technical team to develop architecture-runway and key design decisions

• Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle

• Work closely with the development teams to resolve technical challenges during system development and support

• Continually explore, research and pilot emerging technologies and propose adoption as appropriate

• Identify cost-savings opportunities and optimize IT investments

• Mitigate security and compliance risks from technical debt and obsolescence

• Propose and lead proof of concepts (PoC) to assess technical viability together with the Tech team

• Work with RDT adopting the use of AI and ML solutions in both developing and managing data pipelines.

• Actively participate & collaborate with solution, information, and enterprise architects within the engineering team and across products

Who You Are

• You built 7+ years of work experience as a Solution Architect or Technical Lead, of which at least 4 years in the Life Sciences or Pharma Industry. Knowledge of Pharma Regulations (GxP, Computer Validation) experience preferred

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes

• Proven track record of proactively contributing to architecture practices development and mentoring others

• Experience in the Pharma/Biotech domain, especially Clinical Trial Data Systems, such as Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems, Non-CRF data systems, digital health technologies, and clinical data warehouses

• Experience with ETLs/ELTs, data warehouses/lake/lakehouses, enterprise data integration patterns, relational and object databases, and experience with AWS or other cloud technologies

• In-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for products

• Ability

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
In qualità di Engineering Manager garantirai e supporterai l'hardware, il software e/o la fornitura di servizi come focus principale, rimuovendo impedimenti, gestendo le parti interessate e creando efficienze in collaborazione ovunque possibile. Ti concentrerai sullo sviluppo delle capacità dei membri del tuo team che si allineano alla visione della funzione e incoraggeranno il tuo team a autodefinire il loro percorso di carriera e cercare modi per consentire opportunità di sviluppo nella direzione del viaggio. Li supporterete nella rimozione dei blocchi stradali e mettendo a fuoco la loro gestione delle prestazioni e assicuratevi di sviluppare il vostro team con le giuste competenze, dinamiche sane e un ritmo sostenibile.

Descrizione della zona
La funzione Digital Operations and Reliability garantisce la gestione e la manutenzione proattiva delle prestazioni ottimali, dell'affidabilità e della disponibilità di tutte le piattaforme digitali e delle Infrastrutture aziendali RDT, riducendo al minimo le interruzioni dei processi aziendali critici nella catena del valore e garantendo la conformità.
Global Operations fornisce assistenza 24x7 al Change Advisory Board Team che gestisce i processi di change board e facilita / coordina i processi di rilascio per le implementazioni di produzione.
Questo team lavorerà in collaborazione con il Major Incident / Problem Management Team e si interfacciarà a stretto contatto con il L1 Support Team.

Lei sarà:

• Team Member Capability and Career Development 
Si concentra sullo sviluppo di capacità di team ingegneristici che si allineano alle esigenze e agli obiettivi e alla visione generale della funzione. Incoraggia i membri del team a autodefinire il loro viaggio di carriera e consente attivamente opportunità di sviluppo che si allineano con esso. Rimuove i blocchi stradali e imposta obiettivi di performance chiari e realizzabili. Assicura che il team sviluppi le giuste competenze e dinamiche interne sane per soddisfare le sfide attuali e future.

• Salute e sostenibilità del team
Mantiene un ritmo di lavoro sostenibile per il team, bilanciando gli obiettivi di consegna con il benessere del team. Coltiva dinamiche e collaborazione di team sane, garantendo sicurezza psicologica e comunicazione aperta. Rimuove gli impedimenti che ostacolano il flusso o il morale, agendo come punto di escalation per la squadra. Assicura che i membri del team siano dotati delle competenze necessarie, pertinenti e che i ruoli siano chiaramente definiti.

• Leadership del prodotto e del servizio ⚙️
- Responsabile per la co-creazione di Product / Service Roadmap da un punto di vista tecnico, collaborando con il Product Manager che è responsabile generale. Affidabile per la consegna end-to-end del team di funzionalità come parte dello sviluppo del prodotto, garantendo l'allineamento con la roadmap del prodotto e gli standard di qualità. Imposta la messa a fuoco chiara e le priorità per il lavoro di consegna del team, garantendo l'allineamento con le roadmap del prodotto. Rimuove attivamente gli impedimenti e i blocchi stradali per progredire, aumentando quando necessario per proteggere l'attenzione del team. Gestisce e allinea le aspettative e le esigenze degli stakeholder, fornendo aggiornamenti regolari sui progressi e sui rischi. Crea efficienze in collaborazione ovunque possibile tra team e funzioni.

• Prestazioni e ottimizzazione ⏫
Definisce le metriche di successo, analizza le tendenze della capacità della forza lavoro e identifica le opportunità di ottimizzazione per raggiungere gli obiettivi aziendali. Traduce i dati in insight attuabili e comunica regolarmente le prestazioni di consegna agli stakeholder e al team più ampio. Identificare e implementa i miglioramenti dei processi all'interno del team e nelle sue interazioni con altri team per aumentare l'efficienza e la qualità

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche RDT Diagnostics, we believe every patient deserves the best possible treatment. To
achieve this, our RDT DIA R&D teams must operate with clinical precision and agile efficiency. We are seeking a Technical Lead to bridge the gap between complex DIA R&D business needs and cutting-edge technology. In this role, you will be the architectural and technical lead for our Portfolio and Project

Management (PPM) ecosystem. You won't just be "managing software", you will be designing the digital backbone that allows Roche to prioritize the right life-saving innovations and bring them to market faster.

The Opportunity

• Stakeholder Partnership - Act as the primary technical consultant for RDT DIA R&D PPM to optimize workflows through automation and data-driven insights

• PPM Solution Leadership - Lead Planisware configuration implementation, translating core business requirements into actionable configurations validated through strategic PoCs

• Solution Design - Translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and compliant cloud-based architectures (SaaS/PaaS)

• Custom Built Solution Leadership - Oversee design and implementation of custom solutions, i.e., RDT DIA PPM Portal, ROMA, DP360, etc.

• Lifecycle Management - Oversee the evolution of the PPM toolset (e.g., Planisware, Jira, or custom solutions) to ensure they remain "fit-for-purpose"

• Data Governance - Ensure the integrity and flow of R&D data across the ecosystem to provide a "single source of truth" for executive decision-making

• Solution Strategy - Define the end-to-end technical vision for the RDT DIA R&D PPM landscape, ensuring seamless integration between financial planning, resource management, and stage-gate execution

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker who thrives at the intersection of DIA PPM business processes, modern PPM software, and data engineering. You understand that in Diagnostics, "speed to market" is a healthcare imperative.

• Communication - Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical senior leadership

• Agile Mindset - Comfort working within SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) or similar agile methodologies

• Experience - 5+ years of experience configuring PPM solutions with a focus on Planisware

• Experience - 7+ years in Solution Design, with a specific focus on Portfolio and Project Management (PPM) or Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems

• Domain Knowledge - Previous experience in Life Sciences, Diagnostics, or Pharmaceuticals is highly preferred. Familiarity with GxP and CSV (Computer System Validation) is a major plus

• Technical Stack - Experience with enterprise PPM tools (e.g., Planisware, Planview, etc.)

• Strong understanding of integration patterns (APIs, Data Mesh/Products, and Middleware)

• Familiarity with Cloud platforms (AWS or Azure)

• Solid collaboration and influencing skills with a proven ability to lead and inspire

• Strong analytical, logical problem-resolution skills

Why Roche?

• Impact - Your work directly supports the development of diagnostic tests that affect millions of lives

• Innovation - You will have access to the latest technology and a culture that encourages experimentation

• Growth - A global environment with extensive opportunities for cross-functional career movement

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position,

Gestione (PPM) ecosistema. Non sarà solo "gestire il software", si sta progettando la spina dorsale digitale che permette Roche per priorizzare le innovazioni salvavita giuste e portarli al mercato più velocemente.

• Leadership della soluzione personalizzata - supervisiona la progettazione e l'implementazione di soluzioni personalizzate, cioè, RDT DIA PPM Portal, ROMA, DP360, ecc.

• Gestione del ciclo di vita - Superare l'evoluzione degli strumenti PPM (ad esempio, Planisware, Jira, o soluzioni personalizzate) per garantire che rimangano "adattati per scopi"

• Gestione dei dati - Assicurare l'integrità e il flusso dei dati R&D in tutto l'ecosistema per fornire una "unica fonte di verità" per il processo decisionale esecutivo

• Solution Strategy - Definire la visione tecnica end-to-end per il paesaggio RDT DIA R&D PPM, garantendo un'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità tra pianificazione finanziaria, gestione delle risorse e esecuzione delle porte

Chi sei
Sei un pensatore strategico che prospera all'incrocio dei processi aziendali DIA PPM, moderno software PPM e ingegneria dei dati. Capisci che in Diagnostics, "velocità al mercato" è un imperativo sanitario.

• Comunicazione - Capacità di spiegare complessi trade-off tecnici alla leadership non tecnologica senior

• Agile Mindset - Comfort lavorando all'interno di SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) o simili metodologie agili

• Esperienza - 5+ anni di esperienza nella configurazione delle soluzioni PPM con un focus su Planisware

• Esperienza - 7+ anni in Solution Design, con un focus specifico sui sistemi Portfolio e Project Management (PPM) o Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)

• Conoscenza del dominio - L'esperienza precedente in Scienze della vita, Diagnostica o Farmaceutici è altamente preferita. La familiarità con GxP e CSV (Computer System Validation) è un vantaggio importante

• Tecnica Stack - Esperienza con strumenti PPM aziendali (ad esempio, Planisware, Planview, ecc.)

• Forte comprensione dei modelli di integrazione (API, Data Mesh/Products e Middleware)

• Familiarità con piattaforme Cloud (AWS o Azure)

• Solida collaborazione e influenzando le competenze con una comprovata capacità di guidare e ispirare

• Forte analitica, logica capacità di risoluzione dei problemi

Perché Roche?

• Impatto - Il vostro lavoro supporta direttamente lo sviluppo di test diagnostici che interessano milioni di vite

• Innovazione - Avrai accesso alle ultime tecnologie e a una cultura che incoraggia la sperimentazione

• Crescita - Un ambiente globale con ampie opportunità per il movimento di carriera interfunzionale

Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità!

L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione,

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
By combining our unique strengths, we’re redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. Discover what it’s like to work at Roche.

The Opportunity
The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a Security Engineer on the Vulnerability and Exposure Management Team, you will help protect sensitive data and defend computer systems and web applications from existing and emerging threats. You will not just be managing scanner output. You will help manage and reduce existing risks, assess and evaluate the weaponization of emerging risks, and act as a core builder of our future capabilities.

Responsibilities

• Triage, investigate, and respond to critical vulnerabilities affecting Roche

• Evaluate and prioritize vulnerabilities found through our tools, including our bug-bounty program

• Research emerging vulnerabilities and develop methods to confirm exploitability against our attack surface

• Communicate risk and work with system owners and other stakeholders to mitigate security vulnerabilities

• Assess company systems and web applications using both automated and manual tools

• Maintain, improve, and engineer our scanning, detection, and automation solutions

• Participating in security monitoring for a global environment

Who you are

• Associate degree in relevant field or 5+ years in information security and fluent English.

• Programming experience (Python, Node.js, JavaScript) and ability to write custom detection logic, scripts, and templates

• Demonstrated ability to triage, analyze, and escalate vulnerabilities; experience validating vulnerabilities and basic exploit development in large global environments

• Focus on web application, network, and computer security; cloud security experience; familiarity with attack surface management and AI-assisted development tools

• Strong communication skills explaining complex risks to non-technical audiences; comfort balancing operational tasks with research; passion for security

• Industry certifications in offensive security (OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE); open-source security project contributions

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.
Combinando i nostri punti di forza unici, ridefiniamo la salute attraverso l’azione sostenibile e l’innovazione. Scoprite com'è lavorare a Roche.

L'opportunità
Il team Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) di Roche si sforza di mantenere le nostre reti e gli utenti al sicuro da minacce in continua evoluzione. In qualità di Ingegnere di Sicurezza sul Team di Gestione della Vulnerabilità e dell'Exposure, ti aiuterà a proteggere i dati sensibili e a difendere i sistemi informatici e le applicazioni web dalle minacce esistenti e emergenti. Non sarà solo la gestione dell'output dello scanner. Si contribuirà a gestire e ridurre i rischi esistenti, valutare e valutare l'armaizzazione dei rischi emergenti, e agire come core builder delle nostre capacità future.

responsabilità

• Triage, indagare e rispondere a vulnerabilità critiche che interessano Roche

• Valutare e prioritizzare le vulnerabilità trovate attraverso i nostri strumenti, incluso il nostro programma bug-bounty

• Ricerca di vulnerabilità emergenti e sviluppare metodi per confermare l'usabilità contro la nostra superficie di attacco

• Comunicare il rischio e lavorare con i proprietari di sistemi e altri stakeholder per mitigare le vulnerabilità di sicurezza

• Valutare i sistemi aziendali e le applicazioni web utilizzando strumenti automatizzati e manuali

• Mantenere, migliorare e progettare le nostre soluzioni di scansione, rilevamento e automazione

• Partecipazione al monitoraggio della sicurezza per un ambiente globale

Chi sei

• Laurea associata in campo rilevante o 5+ anni in sicurezza delle informazioni e inglese fluente.

• Esperienza di programmazione (Python, Node.js, JavaScript) e capacità di scrivere logica di rilevamento personalizzato, script e modelli

• Capacità dimostrata di triage, analizzare e aumentare le vulnerabilità; esperienza di convalida delle vulnerabilità e sviluppo di exploit di base in grandi ambienti globali

• Focus su applicazioni web, rete e sicurezza informatica; esperienza di sicurezza cloud; familiarità con la gestione della superficie di attacco e strumenti di sviluppo assistiti da AI

• Forti capacità di comunicazione che spiegano rischi complessi per il pubblico non tecnico; comfort bilanciando i compiti operativi con la ricerca; passione per la sicurezza

• Certificazioni di settore in sicurezza offensiva (OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE); contributi di progetto di sicurezza open source

I benefici di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa pubblicazione di lavoro.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.
Durch die Kombination unserer einzigartigen Stärken definieren wir das Gesundheitswesen durch nachhaltiges Handeln und Innovation neu. Entdecken Sie, wie es ist, bei Roche zu arbeiten.

Die Chance
Das Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR)-Team von Roche ist bestrebt, unsere Netzwerke und Benutzer vor ständig wachsenden Bedrohungen zu schützen. Als Security Engineer im Vulnerability and Exposure Management Team helfen Sie, sensible Daten zu schützen und Computersysteme und Webanwendungen vor bestehenden und aufkommenden Bedrohungen zu schützen. Sie werden nicht nur die Scannerausgabe verwalten. Sie helfen dabei, bestehende Risiken zu managen und zu reduzieren, die Bewaffnung neuer Risiken zu bewerten und als Kernbauer unserer zukünftigen Fähigkeiten zu fungieren.

Zuständigkeiten

• Triage, Untersuchung und Reaktion auf kritische Schwachstellen, die Roche betreffen

• Bewerten und priorisieren Sie Sicherheitslücken, die durch unsere Tools gefunden wurden, einschließlich unseres Bug-Bounty-Programms

• Erforschen Sie aufkommende Sicherheitslücken und entwickeln Sie Methoden, um die Verwertbarkeit gegen unsere Angriffsfläche zu bestätigen

• Risiken kommunizieren und mit Systembesitzern und anderen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten, um Sicherheitslücken zu mindern

• Bewerten Sie Unternehmenssysteme und Webanwendungen mit automatisierten und manuellen Tools

• Pflege, Verbesserung und Engineering unserer Scan-, Erkennungs- und Automatisierungslösungen

• Teilnahme an Sicherheitsüberwachung für eine globale Umgebung

Wer du bist

• Associate Degree in relevanten Bereich oder 5+ Jahre in Informationssicherheit und fließend Englisch.

• Programmiererfahrung (Python, Node.js, JavaScript) und Fähigkeit, benutzerdefinierte Erkennungslogik, Skripte und Vorlagen zu schreiben

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit zur Triage, Analyse und Eskalation von Schwachstellen; Erfahrung in der Validierung von Schwachstellen und der grundlegenden Entwicklung von Exploits in großen globalen Umgebungen

• Fokus auf Webanwendung, Netzwerk- und Computersicherheit; Cloud-Sicherheitserfahrung; Vertrautheit mit Angriffsflächenmanagement und KI-gestützten Entwicklungstools

• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die komplexe Risiken für nicht-technische Zielgruppen erklären; Komfortausgleich zwischen operativen Aufgaben und Forschung; Leidenschaft für Sicherheit

• Branchenzertifizierungen im Bereich Offensive Sicherheit (OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE); Open-Source-Sicherheitsprojektbeiträge

Umzugsleistungen sind für diese Stellenausschreibung nicht verfügbar.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.
En combinant nos forces uniques, nous redéfinissons les soins de santé grâce à une action durable et à l'innovation. Découvrez ce qu'il aime travailler à Roche.

L'opportunité
L'équipe de surveillance de la sécurité mondiale et de réaction aux incidents (MIR) de Roche s'efforce de protéger nos réseaux et nos utilisateurs des menaces en constante évolution. En tant qu'ingénieur de sécurité de l'équipe de gestion de la vulnérabilité et de l'exposition, vous aiderez à protéger les données sensibles et défendre les systèmes informatiques et les applications web contre les menaces existantes et émergentes. Vous ne gérerez pas seulement la sortie du scanner. Vous aiderez à gérer et à réduire les risques existants, évaluerez et évaluerez l'armement des risques émergents, et agirez comme un moteur de nos capacités futures.

Responsabilités

• Triage, recherche et réponse aux vulnérabilités critiques affectant Roche

• Évaluer et prioriser les vulnérabilités trouvées à travers nos outils, y compris notre programme de bogues

• Recherche de vulnérabilités émergentes et développement de méthodes pour confirmer l'exploitation contre notre surface d'attaque

• Communiquer les risques et travailler avec les propriétaires de systèmes et d'autres intervenants pour atténuer les vulnérabilités en matière de sécurité

• Évaluer les systèmes d'entreprise et les applications Web à l'aide d'outils automatisés et manuels

• Maintenir, améliorer et concevoir nos solutions de numérisation, de détection et d'automatisation

• Participation à la surveillance de la sécurité pour un environnement mondial

Qui vous êtes

• Diplôme associé dans le domaine pertinent ou 5+ ans en sécurité de l'information et l'anglais couramment.

• Expérience de programmation (Python, Node.js, JavaScript) et capacité à écrire une logique de détection personnalisée, des scripts et des modèles

• Capacité démontrée de trier, d'analyser et d'exacerber les vulnérabilités; expérience de la validation des vulnérabilités et de l'exploitation de base dans les grands environnements mondiaux

• Se concentrer sur les applications Web, le réseau et la sécurité informatique; l'expérience en matière de sécurité dans le cloud; la connaissance des outils de gestion de surface d'attaque et de développement assisté par l'IA

• Fortes compétences en communication expliquant les risques complexes pour les publics non techniques; équilibrer les tâches opérationnelles avec la recherche; passion pour la sécurité

• Certifications industrielles en matière de sécurité offensive (OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE); contributions à des projets de sécurité open-source

Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour cette affectation.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Country Medical Manager (Immunology)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
The Country Medical Manager (CMM) is a trusted, externally focused, scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key top-tier customers over a meaningful period of time, the CMM will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, and ensure that Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas.
The Medical function serves as a critical engine of competitiveness to ensure our innovations reach their full potential for patients with an end to end perspective. The role of the CMM is designed to maximize local and cross-country medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, drive strategic advocacy, community engagement, medical practice adoption, and access to our portfolio by proactively capitalizing on "Moments that Matter" across the asset lifecycle.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Contributing with Medical Expertise (core & common):

• Medical Expertise: responsible for proactively contributing strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise within the relevant diseases informing differentiation of our pipeline and portfolio. Acting as a medical expert for the pipeline and portfolio throughout the product life cycle.

• Shape Strategy: Lead the medical part of the integrated strategy, shape a forward-thinking, scientifically sound and differentiated value story locally and communicate Roche’s contributions across key disease areas, reflecting an end-to-end business perspective that pulls through the strategy with impact.

2. Proactive Customer Engagement & Insights (core & common):

• Proactive Targeted Medical Engagement: As a medical function our ambition is to spend the majority of our time proactively engaging with external customers as partners in the integrated customer engagement strategy. The CMM serves as the scientific and medical expert, proactively engaging top-tier TAEs, and other key stakeholders in full strategic and operational alignment with other in-field roles. In the pre-launch phase it is the priority to drive proactive E2E strategies that deliver superior experience, anticipate the future and shape medical practice accordingly. In the post-launch phase the engagement continues to ensure that the right patients are treated at the right time and the engagement scope expands on unserved patient populations. In-field engagement serves as a critical component of this overarching strategy for targeted scientific engagement. It is understood that based on business needs the CMM can serve as the primary point of contact for certain customers with the ambition to drive required healthcare system changes and where feasible earlier and broader adoption of our transformative portfolio.

• Medical Partnership & Education: Establish and maintain effective peer-to-peer relationships with external stakeholders and identify/develop science-driven collaborations withTAEs. Provide current, high-quality, integrated Medical Education plan and differentiating scientific information to external customers, support the scientific training of internal teams and ensure continuous education on medical knowledge for PPoC roles. Conduct high-quality, non-promotional International/National Scientific Exchanges to disseminate relevant data, foster physician confidence and clinical endorsement base

Scopo primario di lavoro (Riepilogo del lavoro)
Il Country Medical Manager (CMM) è un partner affidabile, esternamente focalizzato, scientificamente fondato all'interno del nostro modello di customer engagement. Con la costruzione e il mantenimento di connessioni profonde e affidabili con i clienti di alto livello chiave in un periodo di tempo significativo, il CMM genererà l'impatto anticipando e ottimizzando proattivamente la pratica medica, e assicurarsi che Roche è un partner preferito nelle nostre aree di malattia chiave.
La funzione medica funge da motore critico di competitività per garantire che le nostre innovazioni raggiungano il loro pieno potenziale per i pazienti con una prospettiva finale. Il ruolo del CMM è progettato per massimizzare le attività mediche e scientifiche locali e di fondo per accelerare la consegna della nostra pipeline, differenziare il nostro portafoglio in base ai dati, guidare l'advocacy strategica, l'impegno della comunità, l'adozione della pratica medica, e l'accesso al nostro portafoglio mediante la capitalizzazione proattiva su "Momenti che Matter" attraverso il ciclo di vita degli asset.

Principio ruoli e responsabilità / responsabilità
1. Contribuire con Medical Expertise (core & common):

• Competenza medica: responsabile per contribuire attivamente a una forte competenza scientifica, medica e terapeutica nell'ambito delle pertinenti malattie che informano la differenziazione della nostra pipeline e del nostro portafoglio. Agire come esperto medico per la pipeline e il portafoglio durante il ciclo di vita del prodotto.

• Strategia di forma: Guidare la parte medica della strategia integrata, modellare una storia di valore, scientificamente sana e differenziata localmente e comunicare i contributi di Roche in aree chiave di malattia, riflettendo una prospettiva aziendale end-to-end che tira attraverso la strategia con impatto.

2. Impegno e opinioni dei clienti attivi (core & common):

• Impegno medico mirato attivo: come funzione medica la nostra ambizione è quella di trascorrere la maggior parte del nostro tempo attivamente coinvolgendo con i clienti esterni come partner nella strategia di coinvolgimento del cliente integrata. Il CMM funge da esperto scientifico e medico, attivando proattivamente TAE di alto livello e altri principali stakeholder in pieno allineamento strategico e operativo con altri ruoli in campo. Nella fase pre-lancio è la priorità di guidare strategie E2E proattive che offrono un'esperienza superiore, anticipare il futuro e modellare la pratica medica di conseguenza. Nella fase post-launch l'impegno continua a garantire che i pazienti giusti siano trattati al momento giusto e la portata di fidanzamento si espande sulle popolazioni dei pazienti non servite. Il coinvolgimento in campo serve come componente fondamentale di questa strategia di overarching per il coinvolgimento scientifico mirato. Si capisce che in base alle esigenze aziendali il CMM può servire come punto di contatto primario per alcuni clienti con l'ambizione di guidare i cambiamenti del sistema sanitario richiesti e dove possibile prima e più ampia adozione del nostro portafoglio trasformativo.

• Partenariato medico & Istruzione: Stabilire e mantenere efficaci relazioni tra pari e genitori con gli stakeholder esterni e identificare / sviluppare collaborazioni scientifiche conTAEs. Fornire corrente, di alta qualità, piano di educazione medica integrata e differenziare le informazioni scientifiche ai clienti esterni, sostenere la formazione scientifica dei team interni e garantire la formazione continua sulle conoscenze mediche per i ruoli PPoC. Condurre scambi scientifici internazionali e nazionali di alta qualità, non promozionali per diffondere i dati pertinenti, promuovere la fiducia del medico e la base di approvazione clinica

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
The Country Medical Manager (CMM) is a trusted, externally focused, scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key top-tier customers over a meaningful period of time, the CMM will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, and ensure that Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas.
The Medical function serves as a critical engine of competitiveness to ensure our innovations reach their full potential for patients with an end to end perspective. The role of the CMM is designed to maximize local and cross-country medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, drive strategic advocacy, community engagement, medical practice adoption, and access to our portfolio by proactively capitalizing on "Moments that Matter" across the asset lifecycle.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Contributing with Medical Expertise (core & common):

• Medical Expertise: responsible for proactively contributing strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise within the relevant diseases informing differentiation of our pipeline and portfolio. Acting as a medical expert for the pipeline and portfolio throughout the product life cycle.

• Shape Strategy: Lead the medical part of the integrated strategy, shape a forward-thinking, scientifically sound and differentiated value story locally and communicate Roche’s contributions across key disease areas, reflecting an end-to-end business perspective that pulls through the strategy with impact.

2. Proactive Customer Engagement & Insights (core & common):

• Proactive Targeted Medical Engagement: As a medical function our ambition is to spend the majority of our time proactively engaging with external customers as partners in the integrated customer engagement strategy. The CMM serves as the scientific and medical expert, proactively engaging top-tier TAEs, and other key stakeholders in full strategic and operational alignment with other in-field roles. In the pre-launch phase it is the priority to drive proactive E2E strategies that deliver superior experience, anticipate the future and shape medical practice accordingly. In the post-launch phase the engagement continues to ensure that the right patients are treated at the right time and the engagement scope expands on unserved patient populations. In-field engagement serves as a critical component of this overarching strategy for targeted scientific engagement. It is understood that based on business needs the CMM can serve as the primary point of contact for certain customers with the ambition to drive required healthcare system changes and where feasible earlier and broader adoption of our transformative portfolio.

• Medical Partnership & Education: Establish and maintain effective peer-to-peer relationships with external stakeholders and identify/develop science-driven collaborations withTAEs. Provide current, high-quality, integrated Medical Education plan and differentiating scientific information to external customers, support the scientific training of internal teams and ensure continuous education on medical knowledge for PPoC roles. Conduct high-quality, non-promotional International/National Scientific Exchanges to disseminate relevant data, foster physician confidence and clinical endorsement base
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Hauptzweck des Jobs (Job Summary)
Der Country Medical Manager (CMM) ist ein vertrauenswürdiger, extern fokussierter, wissenschaftlich fundierter Partner in unserem Kundenbindungsmodell. Durch den Aufbau und die Pflege tiefer und zuverlässiger Verbindungen zu wichtigen Top-Kunden über einen sinnvollen Zeitraum hinweg wird das CMM durch die Antizipation und proaktive Optimierung der medizinischen Praxis Wirkung erzielen und sicherstellen, dass Roche ein bevorzugter Partner in unseren wichtigsten Krankheitsgebieten ist.
Die medizinische Funktion dient als entscheidender Motor der Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Innovationen ihr volles Potenzial für Patienten mit einer End-to-End-Perspektive erreichen. Die Rolle des CMM wurde entwickelt, um die lokalen und länderübergreifenden medizinischen und wissenschaftlichen Aktivitäten zu maximieren, um die Lieferung unserer Pipeline zu beschleunigen, unser Portfolio auf der Grundlage von Daten zu differenzieren, strategische Interessenvertretung, Community-Engagement, Adoption in der medizinischen Praxis und den Zugang zu unserem Portfolio zu fördern, indem proaktiv "Moments that Matter" über den gesamten Asset-Lebenszyklus hinweg genutzt wird.

Grundlegende Rollen & Verantwortlichkeiten / Verantwortlichkeiten
1. Beitrag mit medizinischer Expertise (core & common):

• Medizinische Expertise: verantwortlich für die proaktive Einbringung starker wissenschaftlicher, medizinischer und therapeutischer Expertise innerhalb der relevanten Krankheiten, die die Differenzierung unserer Pipeline und unseres Portfolios beeinflussen. Als medizinischer Experte für die Pipeline und das Portfolio während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.

• Strategie gestalten: Führen Sie den medizinischen Teil der integrierten Strategie, gestalten Sie eine zukunftsorientierte, wissenschaftlich fundierte und differenzierte Wertgeschichte vor Ort und kommunizieren Sie die Beiträge von Roche in den wichtigsten Krankheitsbereichen und spiegeln Sie eine End-to-End-Geschäftsperspektive wider, die die Strategie mit Wirkung durchzieht.

2. Proaktives Customer Engagement & Insights (Core & Common):

• Proaktives gezieltes medizinisches Engagement: Als medizinische Funktion ist es unser Ziel, den Großteil unserer Zeit proaktiv mit externen Kunden als Partnern in der integrierten Kundenbindungsstrategie zu verbringen. Das CMM dient als wissenschaftlicher und medizinischer Experte, der proaktiv hochrangige TAEs und andere wichtige Interessengruppen in voller strategischer und operativer Ausrichtung mit anderen Rollen vor Ort einbezieht. In der Pre-Launch-Phase ist es die Priorität, proaktive E2E-Strategien voranzutreiben, die überlegene Erfahrungen liefern, die Zukunft antizipieren und die medizinische Praxis entsprechend gestalten. In der Post-Launch-Phase sorgt das Engagement weiterhin dafür, dass die richtigen Patienten zur richtigen Zeit behandelt werden und der Umfang des Engagements auf ungenutzte Patientenpopulationen erweitert wird. In-Field-Engagement ist eine wichtige Komponente dieser übergreifenden Strategie für gezieltes wissenschaftliches Engagement. Es versteht sich, dass die CMM auf der Grundlage der geschäftlichen Bedürfnisse als primäre Anlaufstelle für bestimmte Kunden dienen kann, die die erforderlichen Veränderungen des Gesundheitssystems vorantreiben und, wo möglich, unser transformatives Portfolio früher und breiter einführen wollen.

• Medical Partnership & Education: Aufbau und Pflege effektiver Peer-to-Peer-Beziehungen mit externen Stakeholdern und Identifizierung / Entwicklung wissenschaftsgetriebener Kooperationen mit TAE. Bereitstellung eines aktuellen, qualitativ hochwertigen, integrierten Medical Education-Plans und differenzierender wissenschaftlicher Informationen für externe Kunden, Unterstützung der wissenschaftlichen Ausbildung interner Teams und Gewährleistung einer kontinuierlichen Schulung zu medizinischem Wissen für PPoC-Rollen. Durchführung eines qualitativ hochwertigen, nicht werbeorientierten internationalen/nationalen wissenschaftlichen Austauschs zur Verbreitung relevanter Daten, zur Förderung des Vertrauens von Ärzten und der klinischen Unterstützungsbasis
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
But principal de l'emploi (résumé de l'emploi)
Le Country Medical Manager (CMM) est un partenaire fiable, axé sur l'extérieur, scientifiquement basé dans notre modèle d'engagement client. En établissant et en maintenant des liens profonds et fiables avec des clients clés de premier plan sur une période de temps significative, le MMC générera de l'impact en anticipant et en optimisant de façon proactive la pratique médicale, et en veillant à ce que Roche soit un partenaire privilégié dans nos domaines de maladies clés.
La fonction médicale est un moteur essentiel de la compétitivité pour assurer que nos innovations atteignent leur plein potentiel pour les patients dans une perspective de bout en bout. Le rôle du MMC est conçu pour maximiser les activités médicales et scientifiques locales et internationales afin d'accélérer la mise en oeuvre de notre pipeline, de différencier notre portefeuille en fonction des données, de stimuler la sensibilisation stratégique, l'engagement communautaire, l'adoption de pratiques médicales et l'accès à notre portefeuille en capitalisant proactivement sur les « Mouvements qui comptent » tout au long du cycle de vie des actifs.

Rôles, responsabilités et responsabilités
1. Contribution à l'expertise médicale (essentielle et courante) :

• Expertise médicale : responsable de la contribution proactive d'une expertise scientifique, médicale et thérapeutique solide au sein des maladies pertinentes pour la différenciation de notre pipeline et de notre portefeuille. Agir comme expert médical pour le pipeline et le portefeuille tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.

• Stratégie de forme : Diriger la partie médicale de la stratégie intégrée, façonner localement une histoire de valeur prospective, scientifiquement solide et différenciée et communiquer les contributions de Roches dans les domaines clés de la maladie, reflétant une perspective commerciale de bout en bout qui tire à travers la stratégie avec impact.

2. Engagement et points de vue proactifs des clients (de base et communs):

• Engagement médical ciblé proactif: En tant que fonction médicale, notre ambition est de passer la majorité de notre temps à s'engager proactivement avec des clients externes en tant que partenaires dans la stratégie intégrée d'engagement client. Le CGM est l'expert scientifique et médical, en faisant participer de façon proactive les TAE de haut niveau et d'autres intervenants clés à l'harmonisation stratégique et opérationnelle complète avec d'autres rôles sur le terrain. Dans la phase de pré-lancement, il est prioritaire de conduire des stratégies proactives d'E2E qui fournissent une expérience supérieure, anticipent l'avenir et façonnent la pratique médicale en conséquence. Au cours de la phase postérieure au lancement, l'engagement continue de garantir que les bons patients sont traités au bon moment et que la portée de l'engagement s'étend aux populations de patients non desservis. L'engagement sur le terrain constitue une composante essentielle de cette stratégie globale d'engagement scientifique ciblé. Il est entendu qu'en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise, le MMC peut servir de point de contact principal pour certains clients ayant l'ambition de provoquer les changements requis du système de santé et, si possible, d'adopter plus tôt et plus largement notre portefeuille de transformation.

• Partenariat médical et éducation: Établir et maintenir des relations efficaces entre les pairs et les intervenants externes et identifier et développer des collaborations fondées sur la science avec les EAT. Fournir un plan d'éducation médicale intégré et de haute qualité et différencier l'information scientifique aux clients externes, appuyer la formation scientifique des équipes internes et assurer une formation continue sur les connaissances médicales pour les rôles du PPOC. Mener des échanges scientifiques internationaux/nationaux de haute qualité et non promotionnels afin de diffuser les données pertinentes, de favoriser la confiance des médecins et de favoriser l'approbation clinique

jobs.title: Supply Chain Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Seeking an enthusiastic and motivated student to join our supply chain team at Roche Diagnostics Norway, the role involves a range of practical and routine tasks from managing weekly dispatch of goods to people with diabetes and pharmacies. This is a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic and important growing industry.

Roles and responsibilities:

You will help manage orders registered in our CRM system by our customer service department and sellers, and ensure that our operations run smoothly. This is a great way for you to help ensure that patients have access to various products they need to manage their diabetes.

You will be responsible for a variety of tasks:

• Pack goods and send them by mail.

• Handle return mail and update the CRM system as needed.

• Responsible for inventory on office inventory with what is needed for sending orders. Check inventory, order items, count inventory, and make sure that the physical inventory matches inventory in SAP.

• Registering product alerts in Smartsheet.

• Contribute to other administrative and ad-hoc tasks related to supply chain and logistics

Who you are:

• A current student, preferably focusing on supply chain, logistics, administration or a related field.

• Dutiful, flexible, and structured, with good ability to handle various tasks efficiently.

• Proficient in Norwegian (written and oral) and in English, as we operate in a global environment.

• Can commit to a flexible working time with an average of around 25 hours per month on specific tasks. We are committed to finding a solution that can be adapted to your studies.

• Comfortable using tools like the Office suite, Salesforce and SAP, or willing to learn Service-minded and sociable, fond of communicating and collaborating with different people in the organization as well as working independently.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Alla ricerca di uno studente entusiasta e motivato per unirsi al nostro team di supply chain in Roche Diagnostics Norvegia, il ruolo coinvolge una serie di compiti pratici e di routine dalla gestione della spedizione settimanale di merci a persone con diabete e farmacie. Questa è una fantastica opportunità per acquisire esperienza pratica in un settore in crescita dinamico e importante.

Ruoli e responsabilità:

Potrai aiutare a gestire gli ordini registrati nel nostro sistema CRM dal nostro servizio clienti e venditori, e garantire che le nostre operazioni funzionano senza intoppi. Questo è un ottimo modo per aiutare a garantire che i pazienti hanno accesso a vari prodotti che hanno bisogno di gestire il loro diabete.

Sarete responsabili di una varietà di compiti:

• Imballaggia le merci e li invii per posta.

• Mantenere la posta di ritorno e aggiornare il sistema CRM come necessario.

• Responsabile per l'inventario su inventario ufficio con ciò che è necessario per l'invio di ordini. Controllare l'inventario, gli articoli d'ordine, contare l'inventario e assicurarsi che l'inventario fisico corrisponda all'inventario in SAP.

• Registrazione degli avvisi di prodotto in Smartsheet.

• Contribuire ad altri compiti amministrativi e ad-hoc relativi alla supply chain e alla logistica

Chi sei:

• Uno studente attuale, preferibilmente concentrandosi sulla supply chain, la logistica, l'amministrazione o un campo correlato.

• Dutiful, flessibile e strutturato, con una buona capacità di gestire in modo efficiente varie attività.

• Proficiente in norvegese (scritto e orale) e in inglese, come operiamo in un ambiente globale.

• Può impegnarsi a un tempo di lavoro flessibile con una media di circa 25 ore al mese su compiti specifici. Ci impegniamo a trovare una soluzione che possa essere adattata ai vostri studi.

• Confortevole l'utilizzo di strumenti come la suite Office, Salesforce e SAP, o disposti a imparare il Service-minded e socievole, appassionato di comunicare e collaborare con persone diverse nell'organizzazione e lavorare in modo indipendente.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.
