• Hai un diploma di liceo o un'equivalenza

• Dettagli orientati.

• Capacità di eseguire calcoli matematici di base.

• Volontà di lavorare 6:30 – 4:00pm (EST) Lunedi - Giovedi e 6:30 am - 10:30 del venerdì.

• 1 o più anni di operazioni correlate o di esperienza di produzione.

• Una corretta comprensione delle procedure di sicurezza, salute e ambiente appropriate.

​
I benefici di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa pubblicazione di lavoro.

L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione in base alla posizione primaria di Indianapolis è $33,300.00- $61,800.00. Un bonus annuale discrezionale può essere disponibile in base alle prestazioni individuali e aziendali. Questa posizione si qualifica anche per i benefici dettagliati al link sottostante.

Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Dies ist eine feste Dauer Position für 1 Jahr.

Wer bist du?

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, in einer Teamumgebung zu arbeiten.

• Detailorientiert.

• Fähigkeit, grundlegende mathematische Berechnungen durchzuführen.

• 1 oder mehr Jahre verwandte Operationen oder Fertigungserfahrung.

• Gründliches Verständnis geeigneter Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltverfahren.

​

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. En tant qu'associé de production , vous effectuerez l'assemblage répétitif et/ou l'inspection des produits de l'entreprise dans des emballages complets et/ou des flacons comprenant, sans s'y limiter, des produits médicaux, des accessoires, des manuels, des instructions de fonctionnement et des fiches techniques. Vous pouvez effectuer d'autres tâches d'emballage ou de production, notamment : placer des étiquettes sur les emballages, utiliser de petits équipements de production, compter et trier divers articles et former ou décomposer des boîtes pour le produit final. Vous fournirez un support et une interface avec les clients internes.

Vous serez responsable du maintien et de l'amélioration continue du système de qualité et de la réalisation des objectifs de qualité par des actions quotidiennes

L'occasion :

• Exécute les tâches d'assemblage d'emballage suivant les processus approuvés et les instructions de travail.

• Vérifier et inspecter les matières premières, les sous-ensembles et les produits finis pour assurer l'intégrité du produit.

• Compléter la documentation et assurer l'exactitude et la vérification des procédures.

• Peut préparer des centres de travail pour une procédure appropriée de dédouanement et effectuer un nettoyage régulier conformément aux procédures opérationnelles standard.

• Peut maintenir les besoins de matériel et d'approvisionnement pour soutenir la production.

Il s'agit d'un poste de durée déterminée pour 1 an.
​
Qui êtes-vous ?

Titres minimums:

• Vous détenez un diplôme d'études secondaires ou une équivalence

​
Qualifications préférées :

• Fortes aptitudes interpersonnelles et capacité de travailler en équipe.

• Des détails orientés.

• Capacité d'effectuer des calculs mathématiques de base.

• Voulant travailler 6h30 – 16h00 (HNE) Lundi – Jeudi et 6h30 – 10h30 le vendredi.

• 1 ou plusieurs années d'exploitation ou d'expérience de fabrication.

• Compréhension approfondie des procédures de sécurité, de santé et d'environnement appropriées.

​
Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour cette affectation.

Transparence salariale

L'échelle salariale prévue pour ce poste en fonction de l'emplacement principal d'Indianapolis est de 33 300,00 $- 61 800,00 $. La rémunération réelle sera déterminée en fonction de l'expérience, des qualifications, de l'emplacement géographique et d'autres facteurs liés à l'emploi permis par la loi. Une prime annuelle discrétionnaire peut être offerte en fonction des performances individuelles et de l'entreprise. Ce poste est également admissible aux avantages décrits au lien ci-dessous.

Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) is the organization that manufactures and delivers Roche’s groundbreaking therapies to 127 million patients around the world. PT is involved in producing every Roche medicine – from the development process through clinical trials – and continuing to product maturity. Our organization coordinates all aspects of production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms.
Pharma Technical Development (PTD) is integral to Roche’s mission to develop innovative and transformative meaningful medicines for patients by applying leading technical expertise to design, develop, supply, and register clinical stage products globally.
The department Pharmaceutical Development is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products (Synthetic molecules and Biologics) from Phase 1 through Launch. Activities encompass formulation and manufacturing process development for parenteral drug products for all clinical stages and the market launch, the transfer of product and process to commercial manufacturing sites, commercial product support and line extension development.

The Opportunity

In this specific position as a Section Leader in Pharmaceutical Development EU, you will be part of the leadership team and lead a team of about 8 people, mostly scientists. You will be accountable for parenteral formulation development for all phases of product development, from preclinical to launch and marketed product support.

• Lead & Empower a High-Performing Team: Direct, coach, and develop a team of approximately 8 scientists, fostering a growth-oriented, high-performing environment built on trust and continuous learning.

• Oversee End-to-End Parenteral Formulation: Provide strategic technical oversight for the formulation development of protein-based biologics, synthetic parenterals, and gene therapies from preclinical stages through launch and commercial product support.

• Drive Portfolio Resource Allocation & Prioritization: Manage project timelines, prioritize key initiatives, and optimize resource allocation across all clinical stages to ensure seamless portfolio delivery.

• Champion Lean Principles & LPS: Embed Lean Production System (LPS) principles and lean behaviors into daily operations to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.

• Manage Regulatory Strategy & Filings: Guide the generation, review, and strategic alignment of regulatory submission documents ranging from IMPD to BLA and PAS.

• Shape Global Technical Strategy: Contribute to the overarching strategic vision of the Drug Product Development units across EU and US sites, ensuring global alignment and long-term department success.

• Serve as Functional Representative: Act as a key ambassador for the function in global stakeholder interactions, promoting agility, harmonization, and an innovation-first mindset.

• Foster Scientific Innovation: Advance research in novel pharmaceutical technologies, keeping the group at the forefront of industry developments to sustain Roche’s scientific leadership.

Who You Are

• Educated Expert: Holds a Ph.D. in a relevant scientific or engineering discipline (or equivalent industry experience) combined with 8+ years of biopharmaceutical experience.

• Parenteral & Regulatory Specialist: Demonstrates deep technical expertise in parenteral formulation development, end-to-end pharmaceutical development, and Health Authority filing requirements.

• Proven People Leader: Features 5+ years of direct people

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) è l'organizzazione che produce e fornisce le terapie innovative di Roche a 127 milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. PT è coinvolto nella produzione di ogni farmaco Roche – dal processo di sviluppo attraverso gli studi clinici – e continua a maturità del prodotto. La nostra organizzazione coordina tutti gli aspetti della produzione di farmaci Roche in tutte le aree di malattia e forme di dosaggio.
Pharma Technical Development (PTD) è parte integrante della missione di Roche di sviluppare farmaci innovativi e trasformativi significativi per i pazienti applicando competenze tecniche di punta per progettare, sviluppare, fornire e registrare i prodotti di fase clinica a livello globale.
Il dipartimento di sviluppo farmaceutico è responsabile per lo sviluppo di prodotti farmaceutici parenterali ( molecole sintetiche e biologiche) dalla fase 1 al lancio. Le attività comprendono la formulazione e lo sviluppo del processo di produzione per i prodotti farmaceutici parenterali per tutte le fasi cliniche e il lancio del mercato, il trasferimento del prodotto e del processo ai siti di produzione commerciale, il supporto commerciale del prodotto e lo sviluppo dell'estensione della linea.

L'opportunità

In questa specifica posizione di leader di sezione nell'UE dello sviluppo farmaceutico, sarai parte del team di leadership e guiderai un team di circa 8 persone, per lo più scienziati. Sarete responsabili per lo sviluppo della formulazione parenterale per tutte le fasi di sviluppo del prodotto, dal supporto preclinico al lancio e al mercato del prodotto.

• Lead & Empower a High-Performing Team: diretto, allenatore, e sviluppare un team di circa 8 scienziati, favorendo un ambiente orientato alla crescita, altamente performante costruito sulla fiducia e sull'apprendimento continuo.

• Superare la Formulazione Parenterale End-to-End: Fornire una supervisione tecnica strategica per lo sviluppo della formulazione di biologici a base di proteine, parenterali sintetici e terapie geniche da fasi precliniche attraverso il lancio e il supporto di prodotti commerciali.

• Guidare Portfolio Resource Allocation & Prioritization: Gestire i tempi del progetto, priorità iniziative chiave, e ottimizzare l'allocazione delle risorse in tutte le fasi cliniche per garantire la consegna del portafoglio senza soluzione di continuità.

• Champion Lean Principles & LPS: Embed Lean Production System (LPS) principi e comportamenti magre nelle operazioni quotidiane per guidare il miglioramento continuo e l'eccellenza operativa.

• Gestire la strategia di regolamentazione & Filings: Guidare la generazione, la revisione e l'allineamento strategico dei documenti di presentazione normativa che vanno da IMPD a BLA e PAS.

• Forma Strategia Tecnica Globale: Contribuisci alla visione strategica di overarching delle unità di sviluppo dei prodotti della droga nei siti UE e degli Stati Uniti, garantendo l'allineamento globale e il successo del dipartimento a lungo termine.

• Servire come Rappresentante Funzionale: agire come ambasciatore chiave per la funzione nelle interazioni globali degli stakeholder, promuovere l'agilità, l'armonizzazione e una mentalità innovativa.

• Foster Scientific Innovation: Avanzare la ricerca nelle nuove tecnologie farmaceutiche, mantenendo il gruppo all’avanguardia degli sviluppi del settore per sostenere la leadership scientifica di Roche.

Chi sei

• Esperto Educato: tiene un Ph.D. in una disciplina scientifica o di ingegneria rilevante (o equivalente esperienza del settore) combinato con 8+ anni di esperienza biofarmaceutica.

• Parenteral & Regulatory Specialist: Dimostra le competenze tecniche profonde nello sviluppo della formulazione parenterale, lo sviluppo farmaceutico end-to-end e i requisiti di deposito dell'Autorità per la Salute.

• Leader delle persone provate: Caratteristiche 5+ anni di persone dirette

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) ist die Organisation, die bahnbrechende Therapien von Roche für 127 Millionen Patienten auf der ganzen Welt herstellt und liefert. PT ist an der Herstellung jedes Roche-Arzneimittels beteiligt – vom Entwicklungsprozess über klinische Studien bis hin zur Produktreife. Unsere Organisation koordiniert alle Aspekte der Herstellung von Roche-Medikamenten in allen Krankheitsbereichen und Dosierungsformen.
Pharma Technical Development (PTD) ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der Mission von Roche, innovative und transformative sinnvolle Medikamente für Patienten zu entwickeln, indem führendes technisches Know-how für die Entwicklung, Lieferung und Registrierung von Produkten im klinischen Stadium weltweit eingesetzt wird.
Die Abteilung Pharmazeutische Entwicklung ist für die Entwicklung parenteraler Arzneimittelprodukte (Synthetische Moleküle und Biologika) von Phase 1 bis Launch verantwortlich. Die Aktivitäten umfassen die Entwicklung von Formulierungs- und Herstellungsprozessen für parenterale Arzneimittel für alle klinischen Phasen und die Markteinführung, die Übertragung von Produkt und Prozess an kommerzielle Fertigungsstätten, kommerzielle Produktunterstützung und die Entwicklung von Linienerweiterungen.

Die Chance

In dieser spezifischen Position als Sektionsleiter in der EU für pharmazeutische Entwicklung werden Sie Teil des Führungsteams sein und ein Team von etwa 8 Personen, hauptsächlich Wissenschaftler, leiten. Sie sind für die Entwicklung parenteraler Formulierungen für alle Phasen der Produktentwicklung verantwortlich, von der präklinischen bis zur Einführung und Vermarktung des Produktsupports.

• Lead & Empower a High-Performing Team: Direct, coachen und entwickeln Sie ein Team von etwa 8 Wissenschaftlern und fördern Sie ein wachstumsorientiertes, leistungsstarkes Umfeld, das auf Vertrauen und kontinuierlichem Lernen basiert.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie die End-to-End-Parenteralformulierung: Bieten Sie strategische technische Aufsicht für die Formulierungsentwicklung von proteinbasierten Biologika, synthetischen Parenteralen und Gentherapien von präklinischen Stadien bis hin zur Einführung und kommerziellen Produktunterstützung.

• Förderung der Portfolio-Ressourcenzuweisung und -priorisierung: Verwalten Sie Projektzeitpläne, priorisieren Sie wichtige Initiativen und optimieren Sie die Ressourcenzuweisung in allen klinischen Phasen, um eine nahtlose Portfoliobereitstellung zu gewährleisten.

• Champion Lean Principles & LPS: Betten Sie Lean Production System (LPS)-Prinzipien und schlankes Verhalten in den täglichen Betrieb ein, um kontinuierliche Verbesserungen und operative Exzellenz zu fördern.

• Manage Regulatory Strategy & Filings: Führen Sie die Generierung, Überprüfung und strategische Ausrichtung von regulatorischen Einreichungsdokumenten von IMPD bis BLA und PAS.

• Globale technische Strategie gestalten: Beitrag zur übergreifenden strategischen Vision der Arzneimittelentwicklungsabteilungen in der EU und den USA, um eine globale Ausrichtung und einen langfristigen Abteilungserfolg zu gewährleisten.

• Als funktionaler Vertreter fungieren: Handeln Sie als wichtiger Botschafter für die Funktion in globalen Stakeholder-Interaktionen und fördern Sie Agilität, Harmonisierung und eine Innovation-First-Mentalität.

• Förderung wissenschaftlicher Innovation: Förderung der Forschung zu neuartigen pharmazeutischen Technologien, um die Gruppe an der Spitze der Branchenentwicklungen zu halten und die wissenschaftliche Führungsposition von Roche zu stärken.

Wer du bist

• Ausgebildeter Experte: Hat einen Ph.D. in einer relevanten wissenschaftlichen oder technischen Disziplin (oder gleichwertige Industrieerfahrung) kombiniert mit 8+ Jahren biopharmazeutischer Erfahrung.

• Parenteral & Regulatory Specialist: Demonstriert umfassende technische Expertise in der Entwicklung parenteraler Formulierungen, der End-to-End-Pharmaentwicklung und den Einreichungsanforderungen der Gesundheitsbehörde.

• Proven People Leader: Features 5+ Jahre direkte Menschen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) est l'organisation qui fabrique et livre des thérapies révolutionnaires à 127 millions de patients dans le monde. PT participe à la production de chaque médicament Roche – du processus de développement jusqu'aux essais cliniques – et continue à atteindre la maturité du produit. Notre organisation coordonne tous les aspects de la production de médicaments Roche dans toutes les zones de maladies et formes posologiques.
Pharma Technical Development (PTD) fait partie intégrante de la mission de Roches visant à développer des médicaments innovants et transformatifs significatifs pour les patients en appliquant une expertise technique de premier plan pour concevoir, développer, fournir et enregistrer des produits de stade clinique à l'échelle mondiale.
Le ministère du Développement pharmaceutique est responsable de la mise au point de produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux (molécules de synthèse et produits biologiques) de la phase 1 jusqu'au lancement. Les activités comprennent la formulation et l'élaboration de procédés de fabrication pour les produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux pour toutes les étapes cliniques et le lancement du marché, le transfert de produits et de procédés vers des sites de fabrication commerciale, le soutien des produits commerciaux et le développement d'extensions de gamme.

L'opportunité

Dans ce poste spécifique de chef de section dans l'UE pour le développement pharmaceutique, vous ferez partie de l'équipe de direction et dirigerez une équipe d'environ 8 personnes, principalement des scientifiques. Vous serez responsable du développement de la formulation parentérale pour toutes les phases du développement du produit, de la préclinique au soutien du lancement et de la commercialisation du produit.

• Lead & Empower a High-Performing Team: Direct, coach, et développer une équipe d'environ 8 scientifiques, favorisant un environnement axé sur la croissance et à haut rendement basé sur la confiance et l'apprentissage continu.

• Superviser la formulation parentérale de bout en bout : Fournir une surveillance technique stratégique pour la formulation de produits biologiques à base de protéines, de produits parentéraux synthétiques et de thérapies géniques à partir des stades précliniques jusqu'au lancement et au soutien commercial des produits.

• Diriger l'affectation et la hiérarchisation des ressources du portefeuille : gérer les échéanciers des projets, prioriser les initiatives clés et optimiser l'affectation des ressources à toutes les étapes cliniques afin d'assurer une prestation transparente du portefeuille.

• Champion Lean Principles & LPS: Embed Lean Production System (LPS) principes et comportements maigres dans les opérations quotidiennes pour stimuler l'amélioration continue et l'excellence opérationnelle.

• Gérer la stratégie de réglementation et les dépôts : Guider la production, l'examen et l'harmonisation stratégique des documents de présentation de la réglementation allant de la DPPR à la BLA et au PAS.

• Former la stratégie technique mondiale : contribuer à la vision stratégique globale des unités de développement des produits pharmaceutiques dans l'ensemble des sites de l'UE et des États-Unis, en assurant l'alignement mondial et le succès à long terme des ministères.

• Servir de représentant fonctionnel : agir en tant qu'ambassadeur clé pour la fonction dans les interactions avec les intervenants à l'échelle mondiale, promouvoir l'agilité, l'harmonisation et un esprit d'innovation.

• Favoriser l'innovation scientifique : faire progresser la recherche dans les nouvelles technologies pharmaceutiques, en maintenant le groupe à l'avant-garde des développements industriels pour soutenir le leadership scientifique de Roche.

Qui vous êtes

• Expert formé: Titulaire d'un doctorat dans une discipline scientifique ou d'ingénierie pertinente (ou expérience équivalente de l'industrie) combiné avec 8+ années d'expérience biopharmaceutique.

• Spécialiste de la parentalité et de la réglementation : fait preuve d'une expertise technique approfondie dans le développement de formulations parentérales, le développement de produits pharmaceutiques de bout en bout et les exigences de dépôt des autorités sanitaires.

• Personnes éprouvées Leader: Caractéristiques 5+ ans de personnes directes

jobs.title: IT Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE/CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CoE organisation, the Portfolio & Operations team organises and drives CoE core operations: portfolio strategy & management, administration, budget planning, vendor management and procurement, managing cloud & software spend, Learning & Development, and Operational Guidelines. This team serves as both the strategic catalyst and operational backbone for the CoE enabling business performance, transparency, and accountability.

We are seeking an experienced Portfolio Manager to help drive the P&O Portfolio Management team. This role is setting the foundation for the CoE with a robust, trustworthy “source of truth” portfolio and supporting processes. Additionally, this role will help sculpt what “Portfolio Management” looks like in the future - transitioning from building the initial portfolio infrastructure to helping guide the strategic vision of the CoE.

Location :
US-based (EST) with the expectation to work within a global team (US and European timezones).

The Opportunity:

• Strategic Leadership: Support creation of the strategy for the portfolio management team, defining and iterating on key processes and roadmaps.

• Execution Oversight: Ensure roadmap execution, on-time delivery, unblocking of issues, and escalation to leadership when needed.

• Data Excellence: Be a true expert of the CS CoE Portfolio data and steward of quality; not only understanding what is present today, but what is missing and will be needed in the future.

• Landscape Research: Partner with other key leaders to understand where the biggest opportunities are for the CoE outside of its current portfolio.

Who You Are:

• PhD or Master’s degree (e.g. MBA); alternatively Bachelor’s degree with equivalent, supplementary experience.

• 5 - 10+ years of experience with Data & Digital/Informatics within Pharma R&D.

• Experience managing a portfolio or a complex set of programs is a must.

• Project & Portfolio management coursework or additional supportive training (e.g. PMP/PgMP/PfMP, Six Sigma, Lean, Design Thinking, Agile methodology, etc.).

• Proven experience in strategic planning and execution, especially in dynamic and evolving environments.

• Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to guide cross-functional teams towards successful outcomes.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, adept at managing a wide range of stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to translate vision into practical tactics and measurable success criteria.

• A strategic thinker with a strong emphasis on execution.

• Ability to work independently and proactively, with a focus on driving strategic initiatives to completion.

• Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.

• Comfortable navigating complex and sometimes challenging stakeholder dynamics.

Onsite presence on our campus is expected in compliance with Roche/Genentech policy.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

I progressi in AI, dati e scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il nuovo Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CS CoE/CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare questo potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'intelligenza artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e trasformativi per i pazienti di tutto il mondo.

Nell'ambito dell'organizzazione CoE, il team Portfolio & Operations organizza e guida le operazioni di core CoE: strategia di portafoglio & management, amministrazione, pianificazione del budget, gestione dei fornitori e approvvigionamento, gestione cloud & software spendere, Learning & Development, e linee guida operative. Questo team serve sia come catalizzatore strategico che come spina dorsale operativa per il CoE che consente prestazioni aziendali, trasparenza e responsabilità.

Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto Portfolio Manager per aiutare a guidare il team P&O Portfolio Management. Questo ruolo sta ponendo le basi per il CoE con un portafoglio robusto e affidabile “fonte della verità” e processi di supporto. Inoltre, questo ruolo aiuterà a scolpire ciò che “Portfolio Management” sembra in futuro - passando dalla costruzione dell'infrastruttura di portafoglio iniziale per aiutare a guidare la visione strategica del CoE.

Posizione:
Usa-based (EST) con l'aspettativa di lavorare all'interno di un team globale (Stati Uniti ed Europa).

L'opportunità:

• Leadership strategica: creazione di supporto della strategia per il team di gestione del portafoglio, definizione e iterazione di processi chiave e roadmap.

• Esecuzione Supervisione: Assicurare l'esecuzione della roadmap, la consegna in tempo, lo sblocco di problemi, e l'escalation alla leadership quando necessario.

• Eccellenza dei dati: essere un vero esperto dei dati del CS CoE Portfolio e amministratore di qualità; non solo comprendere ciò che è presente oggi, ma ciò che manca e sarà necessario in futuro.

• Ricerca Paesaggio: Partner con altri leader chiave per capire dove le maggiori opportunità sono per il CoE al di fuori del suo portafoglio attuale.

Chi sei?

• PhD o Master’s degree (ad esempio MBA); in alternativa Bachelor’s Degree con esperienza equivalente e supplementare.

• 5 - 10 anni di esperienza con Data & Digital/Informatics all'interno di Pharma R&D.

• L'esperienza di gestire un portafoglio o un insieme complesso di programmi è un must.

• Corso di project & Portfolio management o formazione aggiuntiva di supporto (ad esempio PMP/PgMP/PfMP, Six Sigma, Lean, Design Thinking, Agile Method, ecc.).

• Esperienza dimostrata nella pianificazione strategica e nell'esecuzione, soprattutto in ambienti dinamici ed evolutivi.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE/CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CoE organisation, the Portfolio & Operations team organises and drives CoE core operations: portfolio strategy & management, administration, budget planning, vendor management and procurement, managing cloud & software spend, Learning & Development, and Operational Guidelines. This team serves as both the strategic catalyst and operational backbone for the CoE enabling business performance, transparency, and accountability.

We are seeking an experienced Portfolio Manager to help drive the P&O Portfolio Management team. This role is setting the foundation for the CoE with a robust, trustworthy “source of truth” portfolio and supporting processes. Additionally, this role will help sculpt what “Portfolio Management” looks like in the future - transitioning from building the initial portfolio infrastructure to helping guide the strategic vision of the CoE.

Location :
US-based (EST) with the expectation to work within a global team (US and European timezones).

The Opportunity:

• Strategic Leadership: Support creation of the strategy for the portfolio management team, defining and iterating on key processes and roadmaps.

• Execution Oversight: Ensure roadmap execution, on-time delivery, unblocking of issues, and escalation to leadership when needed.

• Data Excellence: Be a true expert of the CS CoE Portfolio data and steward of quality; not only understanding what is present today, but what is missing and will be needed in the future.

• Landscape Research: Partner with other key leaders to understand where the biggest opportunities are for the CoE outside of its current portfolio.

Who You Are:

• PhD or Master’s degree (e.g. MBA); alternatively Bachelor’s degree with equivalent, supplementary experience.

• 5 - 10+ years of experience with Data & Digital/Informatics within Pharma R&D.

• Experience managing a portfolio or a complex set of programs is a must.

• Project & Portfolio management coursework or additional supportive training (e.g. PMP/PgMP/PfMP, Six Sigma, Lean, Design Thinking, Agile methodology, etc.).

• Proven experience in strategic planning and execution, especially in dynamic and evolving environments.

• Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to guide cross-functional teams towards successful outcomes.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, adept at managing a wide range of stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to translate vision into practical tactics and measurable success criteria.

• A strategic thinker with a strong emphasis on execution.

• Ability to work independently and proactively, with a focus on driving strategic initiatives to completion.

• Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.

• Comfortable navigating complex and sometimes challenging stakeholder dynamics.

Onsite presence on our campus is expected in compliance with Roche/Genentech policy.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Obesity is one of the UK's greatest and fastest-growing health challenges — a driver of cardiovascular, renal and metabolic disease that touches millions of lives. As a Medical Affairs Partner in our Cardiovascular, Renal & Metabolism (CVRM) team, you will help shape how Roche brings the next generation of obesity and weight-management science to the healthcare professionals and patients who need it. This is a rare opportunity to build our medical presence from the ground up, in the critical pre-launch window where the groundwork you lay determines the difference we make.

Why this role matters:
Working one to two years ahead of launch, you will map the UK obesity landscape and build the scientific relationships that ensure the right patients can benefit the moment new options become available. Every conversation with a clinician, every insight you surface, and every piece of evidence you translate helps Roche deliver better outcomes to more patients, faster — and helps healthcare providers prepare to change lives at scale. You won't just support a launch; you will help lay the foundations of how Roche shows up in obesity care in the UK.
.

The Opportunity:

• You engage prolifically and meaningfully with healthcare professionals and key opinion leaders across obesity, weight management and the wider cardiometabolic landscape.

• You bring deep therapy-area and scientific expertise , translating complex evidence into meaningful medical value for customers and patients.

• You work with genuine autonomy — creating and adapting high-quality, compliant medical and scientific materials largely independently.

• You map the external scientific landscape and generate insights that shape medical and squad priorities.

• You safeguard the highest standards of compliance, ethics and patient safety, putting patients at the centre of every action.

• You collaborate across teams to remove silos and duplication, and increasingly coach and support colleagues as our team grows.

Who you are:

• You hold a life-sciences, pharmacy or medical qualification and bring strong scientific credibility.

• You have proven experience in a field-based medical role — as a Medical Science Liaison, Medical Advisor or similar.

• You bring demonstrable experience in obesity / weight management or an adjacent cardiometabolic therapy area.

• You are a confident, self-sufficient operator who structures your own priorities and delivers with minimal support.

• You have a sound working knowledge of the ABPI Code of Practice and act as a guardian of compliance and ethics.

Preferred:

• Experience mentoring or coaching colleagues, or early demonstration of leadership behaviours.

• Experience working in agile, squad-based or self-managed team environments.

If you want your science to make a real difference for people living with obesity and cardiometabolic disease, apply now and help us deliver better outcomes to more patients, faster.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthie

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
L'obesità è una delle sfide di salute più grandi e più rapida crescita del Regno Unito — un driver di malattie cardiovascolari, renali e metaboliche che tocca milioni di vite. Come Partner per gli Affari Medici nel nostro team Cardiovascolare, Renale e Metabolismo (CVRM), contribuirai a modellare come Roche porta la prossima generazione di scienza dell'obesità e della gestione del peso ai professionisti e ai pazienti che ne hanno bisogno. Questa è una rara opportunità per costruire la nostra presenza medica da terra in su, nella finestra critica pre-lancio in cui le basi che lavi determina la differenza che facciamo.

Perché questo ruolo è importante:
Lavorando uno a due anni prima del lancio, si mappa il paesaggio di obesità del Regno Unito e costruire le relazioni scientifiche che garantiscono ai pazienti giusti possono beneficiare del momento in cui nuove opzioni diventano disponibili. Ogni conversazione con un ambulatorio, ogni intuizione di superficie, e ogni prova che si traduce aiuta Roche fornire risultati migliori a più pazienti, più veloce — e aiuta i fornitori di assistenza sanitaria si preparano a cambiare la vita in scala. Non solo sosterrai un lancio; aiuterai a gettare le basi di come Roche si presenta nell'assistenza all'obesità nel Regno Unito.
.

L'opportunità:

• Si impegna in modo prolifico e significativo con professionisti del settore sanitario e leader di opinione chiave attraverso l'obesità, la gestione del peso e il più ampio paesaggio cardiometabolico.

• Porti una profonda esperienza terapeutica e scientifica, traducendo prove complesse in valore medico significativo per clienti e pazienti.

• Lavori con una reale autonomia — creando e adattando materiali medici e scientifici di alta qualità in gran parte indipendentemente.

• Si mappa il paesaggio scientifico esterno e generare intuizioni che modellano priorità mediche e squad.

• Tu salvaguardi i più elevati standard di conformità, etica e sicurezza dei pazienti, mettendo i pazienti al centro di ogni azione.

• Collabori tra le squadre per rimuovere silos e duplicazione, e sempre più coach e colleghi di supporto come il nostro team cresce.

Chi sei:

• Si tiene una vita-scienze, farmacia o qualifica medica e portare forte credibilità scientifica.

• Hai dimostrato esperienza in un ruolo medico basato sul campo — come una connessione di scienza medica, consulente medico o simile.

• Si porta esperienza dimostrabile in obesità / gestione del peso o una zona di terapia cardiometabolica adiacente.

• Sei un operatore sicuro e autosufficiente che struttura le tue priorità e offre un supporto minimo.

• Hai una solida conoscenza del codice di pratica ABPI e agisci come custode della conformità e dell'etica.

Preferito:

• Esperienza di mentoring o coaching colleghi, o dimostrazione precoce dei comportamenti di leadership.

• Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti di squadra agili, basati su squad o autogestiti.

Se vuoi che la tua scienza faccia una vera differenza per le persone che vivono con l'obesità e la malattia cardiometabolica, applica ora e ci aiuti a fornire risultati migliori a più pazienti, più veloce.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un sanitario

• Experience working in agile, squad-based or self-managed team environments.

If you want your science to make a real difference for people living with obesity and cardiometabolic disease, apply now and help us deliver better outcomes to more patients, faster.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthie
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Adipositas ist eine der größten und am schnellsten wachsenden Gesundheitsherausforderungen Großbritanniens - ein Treiber für Herz-Kreislauf-, Nieren- und Stoffwechselerkrankungen, die Millionen von Menschenleben betreffen. Als Medical Affairs Partner in unserem kardiovaskulären, renalen und metabolischen (CVRM) Team werden Sie mitgestalten, wie Roche die nächste Generation von Adipositas- und Gewichtsmanagement-Wissenschaft zu den medizinischen Fachkräften und Patienten bringt, die sie benötigen. Dies ist eine seltene Gelegenheit, unsere medizinische Präsenz von Grund auf aufzubauen, im kritischen Pre-Launch-Fenster, in dem die Grundlagen, die Sie legen, den Unterschied bestimmen, den wir machen.

Warum diese Rolle wichtig ist:
Arbeiten Sie ein bis zwei Jahre vor dem Start, werden Sie die britische Fettleibigkeitslandschaft kartieren und die wissenschaftlichen Beziehungen aufbauen, die sicherstellen, dass die richtigen Patienten von neuen Optionen profitieren können. Jedes Gespräch mit einem Arzt, jede Einsicht, die Sie auftauchen, und jedes Beweisstück, das Sie übersetzen, hilft Roche, mehr Patienten bessere Ergebnisse zu liefern, schneller - und hilft Gesundheitsdienstleistern, sich darauf vorzubereiten, das Leben in großem Maßstab zu verändern. Sie werden nicht nur einen Start unterstützen; Sie werden dazu beitragen, die Grundlagen dafür zu legen, wie Roche in der Adipositasversorgung in Großbritannien auftaucht.
.

Die Gelegenheit:

• Sie engagieren sich produktiv und sinnvoll mit Gesundheitsexperten und wichtigen Meinungsführern über Fettleibigkeit, Gewichtsmanagement und die breitere kardiometabolische Landschaft.

• Sie bringen einen tiefen Therapiebereich und wissenschaftliche Expertise mit und übersetzen komplexe Evidenz in einen sinnvollen medizinischen Wert für Kunden und Patienten.

• Sie arbeiten mit echter Autonomie - Erstellen und Anpassen hochwertiger, konformer medizinischer und wissenschaftlicher Materialien weitgehend unabhängig.

• Sie kartieren die externe wissenschaftliche Landschaft und generieren Erkenntnisse, die medizinische und Squad-Prioritäten prägen.

• Sie gewährleisten die höchsten Standards in Bezug auf Compliance, Ethik und Patientensicherheit und stellen Patienten in den Mittelpunkt jeder Aktion.

• Sie arbeiten teamübergreifend zusammen, um Silos und Duplikationen zu entfernen, und coachen und unterstützen zunehmend Kollegen, wenn unser Team wächst.

Wer du bist:

• Sie haben eine Biowissenschaften, Apotheke oder medizinische Qualifikation und bringen eine starke wissenschaftliche Glaubwürdigkeit.

• Sie haben nachgewiesene Erfahrung in einer feldbasierten medizinischen Rolle - als Medical Science Liaison, Medical Advisor oder ähnlich.

• Sie bringen nachweisbare Erfahrung in Fettleibigkeit / Gewichtsmanagement oder einem angrenzenden kardiometabolischen Therapiebereich mit.

• Sie sind ein selbstbewusster, autarker Betreiber, der Ihre eigenen Prioritäten strukturiert und mit minimalem Support liefert.

• Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse des ABPI Code of Practice und fungieren als Hüter der Compliance und Ethik.

Bevorzugt:

• Erleben Sie Mentoring oder Coaching von Kollegen oder frühe Demonstration von Führungsverhalten.

• Erfahrung in agilen, Squad-basierten oder selbstverwalteten Teamumgebungen.

Wenn Sie möchten, dass Ihre Wissenschaft einen echten Unterschied für Menschen mit Fettleibigkeit und kardiometabolischen Erkrankungen macht, bewerben Sie sich jetzt und helfen Sie uns, mehr Patienten schneller bessere Ergebnisse zu liefern.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns ein Healthie bauen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
L'obésité est l'un des plus grands défis de santé au Royaume-Uni, qui connaît la croissance la plus rapide. En tant que partenaire des affaires médicales dans notre équipe Cardiopathie, Renal & Métabolisme (CVRM), vous aiderez à façonner la façon dont Roche apporte la prochaine génération de science de l'obésité et de la gestion du poids aux professionnels de la santé et aux patients qui en ont besoin. C'est une occasion rare de construire notre présence médicale à partir du sol, dans la fenêtre critique de pré-lancement où le terrain que vous posez détermine la différence que nous faisons.

Pourquoi ce rôle est important :
Travaillant un à deux ans avant le lancement, vous allez cartographier le paysage de l'obésité au Royaume-Uni et construire les relations scientifiques qui garantissent que les bons patients peuvent bénéficier dès que de nouvelles options deviennent disponibles. Chaque conversation avec un clinicien, chaque perspicacité et chaque preuve que vous traduisez aide Roche à obtenir de meilleurs résultats pour un plus grand nombre de patients, plus rapidement, et aide les fournisseurs de soins de santé à se préparer à changer les vies à l'échelle. Vous ne vous contenterez pas de soutenir un lancement; vous contribuerez à jeter les bases de la façon dont Roche se montre dans les soins contre l'obésité au Royaume-Uni.
.

La possibilité :

• Vous engagez prolifiquement et significativement avec les professionnels de la santé et les leaders d'opinion clés à travers l'obésité, la gestion du poids et le paysage cardiométabolique plus large.

• Vous apportez un domaine de thérapie profonde et une expertise scientifique, traduisant des preuves complexes en valeur médicale significative pour les clients et les patients.

• Vous travaillez avec une véritable autonomie: créer et adapter des matériaux médicaux et scientifiques de haute qualité et conformes, largement indépendants.

• Vous cartographiez le paysage scientifique externe et générer des idées qui façonnent les priorités médicales et les équipes.

• Vous protégez les normes les plus élevées de conformité, d'éthique et de sécurité des patients, mettant les patients au centre de chaque action.

• Vous collaborez entre les équipes pour éliminer les silos et les duplications, et de plus en plus coacher et soutenir les collègues à mesure que notre équipe grandit.

Qui vous êtes :

• Vous possédez des sciences de la vie, une pharmacie ou une qualification médicale et apportez une forte crédibilité scientifique.

• Vous avez fait preuve d'expérience dans un rôle médical sur le terrain, en tant que conseiller médical ou autre.

• Vous apportez une expérience démontrable dans la gestion de l'obésité / du poids ou une zone cardiométabolique adjacente.

• Vous êtes un opérateur confiant et autosuffisant qui structure ses propres priorités et offre un minimum de soutien.

• Vous avez une bonne connaissance pratique du Code de pratique de l'ABPI et êtes le gardien de la conformité et de l'éthique.

Préféré:

• Expérience de mentorat ou d'encadrement de collègues, ou démonstration précoce de comportements de leadership.

• Expérience de travail en équipe agile, en équipe ou autogérée.

Si vous voulez que votre science fasse une vraie différence pour les personnes vivant avec l'obésité et la maladie cardiométabolique, appliquez maintenant et aidez-nous à obtenir de meilleurs résultats pour plus de patients, plus rapidement.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Laissez-les construire une santé

jobs.title: (Sr.) Specialist, LS & ASAT, Biologics
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is hiring for a greenfield facility in Shanghai and we are looking for Lab Support & ASAT SME, for who takes responsibility for equipment/systems qualification and validation, sample and testing material management and other lab supporting processes. Also provides support during the project, operation readiness and start-up phase and liaises across the design, construction, qualification of the QC area, ensuring they meet the intended standard and regulation requirements.
Strong skill and experience are required to cover two areas: Greenfield project and Routine Operation management.

• The role supports on the equipment/system qualification and validation, sample/material management and QC operation readiness and start up.

• Work independently and with a level of autonomy and authority in efficient execution to ensure on-going compliance against approved global/local procedure documents, current Good Manufacturing Practices, and CN/EU Annex-1 during the product lifecycle.

• Enable and self-motivate, and demonstrate leadership behavior and mindset

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责 / 责任
Routine Operation:

• Perform the qualification, validation, calibration and maintenance activities for relevant equipment with Roche’s QMS and regulatory guidelines.

• Set up master data according to business requirements and ensure data integrity.

• Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements

• Assist Head of Lab Support to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance.

• Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely to internal investigations and regulatory inspectors. Accomplish sample and testing materials management(eg account management, DI assessment), to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time. Report the abnormal status, deviations to supervisors with initiative.

• By identifying abnormal status and unexpected results during routine operation by detailed data, support to alert supervisors to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.

• Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of bioanalytical materials and cell supplies Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Equipment qualification and validation: Support and execute the equipment qualification and validation for the aseptic product.

• Sample and material management: Execute GMP sample management; Execute material inventory management.

• Digital system deployment: Support and ensure on time delivery for QC digital system(eg.LIMS).

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

Job Required Competencies

• 2 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on bioanalytical and bioassay testing. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred

• Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance and physical and chemical testing.

• Experienced in QC new system startup readiness and operation ramp up is preferred.

• ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Fluent communications skills in English

• Project management skills are preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future dri

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Core Lab & POC
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Responsible product: Cardiac & HbA1c

Your Key Responsibilities

1. Define and execute product marketing plans and perform daily product management tasks.

• Develop and execute strategic marketing plans for the disease portfolio, aligning with business goals and clinical trends.

• Manage the product lifecycle from market assessment, launch planning, and demand generation to mature product management.

• Drive key value messaging and positioning tailored to key specialties and stakeholders.

• Develop marketing materials including sales aids, presentations, clinical evidence summaries, and training documents.

• Provide in-depth product training and field support to the sales force and distributors.

• Develop and implement innovative marketing initiatives and omnichannel engagement strategies to expand customer reach.

• Manage and optimize the Advertising & Promotion (A&P) budget, tracking financial performance to ensure effective resource allocation and high ROI.

• Price management: distributor prices and delivery prices.

• Stock management such as forecast, ordering and allocation during bottlenecks.

2. Lead Customer Management and Medical Society Congress Engagement.

• Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), lab directors, clinicians, and key decision-makers to drive product adoption and loyalty.

• Strategically plan and execute Medical Society Congress activities, including symposia, promotional booths, and networking events to maximize brand presence.

• Organize and execute continuous KOL engagement programs, advisory boards, and educational seminars.

3. Gather market insights through regular customer visits, competitor and market trends monitoring and incorporate these insights into product strategy.

• Monitor market trends, competitive landscape, and guideline changes to ensure agility and relevance in strategy.

• Identify unmet clinical and operational needs to drive initiatives that focus on improving laboratory efficiency and patient outcomes, demonstrating the true value of Roche Diagnostics solutions.

4. Align and collaborate with all stakeholders within/outside RDK.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Sales, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Clinical, S&S APAC/Global Marketing) to support commercial success.

• Cooperation with distributors and other business partners.

5. Conduct business in full compliance.

• 100% completion on compliance training.

• Well know about updated regulation and compliance information and share to my team.

• Meet compliance for all external activities.

Who you are

• Prefer Bachelor's degree or higher in life sciences, biomedical engineering, pharmacy, nursing, Business administration, Marketing but not mandatory

• Minimum 5 years of marketing or product management experience in the multinational healthcare industry (preferably in IVD, medical devices, or pharmaceuticals)

• Proven experience in product strategy, lifecycle management, and field collaboration

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills

• Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple priorities

• Fluent in both spoken and written English

• Good command of MS office software application

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Core Lab & POC
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Responsible product: Cardiac & HbA1c

Your Key Responsibilities

1. Define and execute product marketing plans and perform daily product management tasks.

• Develop and execute strategic marketing plans for the disease portfolio, aligning with business goals and clinical trends.

• Manage the product lifecycle from market assessment, launch planning, and demand generation to mature product management.

• Drive key value messaging and positioning tailored to key specialties and stakeholders.

• Develop marketing materials including sales aids, presentations, clinical evidence summaries, and training documents.

• Provide in-depth product training and field support to the sales force and distributors.

• Develop and implement innovative marketing initiatives and omnichannel engagement strategies to expand customer reach.

• Manage and optimize the Advertising & Promotion (A&P) budget, tracking financial performance to ensure effective resource allocation and high ROI.

• Price management: distributor prices and delivery prices.

• Stock management such as forecast, ordering and allocation during bottlenecks.

2. Lead Customer Management and Medical Society Congress Engagement.

• Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), lab directors, clinicians, and key decision-makers to drive product adoption and loyalty.

• Strategically plan and execute Medical Society Congress activities, including symposia, promotional booths, and networking events to maximize brand presence.

• Organize and execute continuous KOL engagement programs, advisory boards, and educational seminars.

3. Gather market insights through regular customer visits, competitor and market trends monitoring and incorporate these insights into product strategy.

• Monitor market trends, competitive landscape, and guideline changes to ensure agility and relevance in strategy.

• Identify unmet clinical and operational needs to drive initiatives that focus on improving laboratory efficiency and patient outcomes, demonstrating the true value of Roche Diagnostics solutions.

4. Align and collaborate with all stakeholders within/outside RDK.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Sales, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Clinical, S&S APAC/Global Marketing) to support commercial success.

• Cooperation with distributors and other business partners.

5. Conduct business in full compliance.

• 100% completion on compliance training.

• Well know about updated regulation and compliance information and share to my team.

• Meet compliance for all external activities.

• Prefer Bachelor's degree or higher in life sciences, biomedical engineering, pharmacy, nursing, Business administration, Marketing but not mandatory

• Proven experience in product strategy, lifecycle management, and field collaboration

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills

• Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple priorities

• Fluent in both spoken and written English

• Good command of MS office software application

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
La persona en esta posición lidera el crecimiento sostenible de Roche Diagnóstica y maximizar el valor que ofrecemos a nuestros clientes estratégicos, tanto actuales como futuros.
Desarrolla y ejecuta estrategias comerciales innovadoras, centradas en la expansión de nuestras cuentas clave y la identificación de nuevas oportunidades de negocio y modelos comerciales disruptivos. El objetivo es consolidar la fidelización de clientes, asegurar el crecimiento del "share of wallet" y expandir la presencia de Roche en el mercado diagnóstico, reforzando nuestra posición de liderazgo. Esto implica un profundo entendimiento del ecosistema diagnóstico, las necesidades no cubiertas de los clientes y el panorama competitivo, para desarrollar propuestas de valor diferenciadoras que generen un impacto significativo en el negocio y la salud.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas asignados en cuentas estratégicas, contribuyendo de manera directa a las metas comerciales de la organización.

• Participar en el estudio y análisis de la estrategia y planes de marketing regional de nuestros portafolios.

• Definir y/o customizar estrategias para la generación de nuevos negocios con nuestros clientes estratégicos; así como para posibles negocios con clientes no Roche en coordinación con los squads de desarrollo de negocio.

• Liderar la ejecución de la estrategia para el desarrollo y la generación de nuevos negocios y modelos de negocio innovadores mediante la elaboración de la propuesta de valor que integre todas nuestras soluciones (consultoría, soluciones digitales, disease management, etc.).

• Ejecutar la estrategia de desarrollo de negocio, generar y conseguir nuevas oportunidades de negocio incremental, crecer el market share, el alcance e impacto de nuestras soluciones/portafolios.

• Colaborar en la implementación de nuevas soluciones de valor y de nuevos modelos de negocio, atendiendo las necesidades del cliente.

• Visita en campo y cobertura nacional para la prospección de nuevas oportunidades de negocio.

• Actuar como conector interno entre equipos y asegurar la colaboración entre diferentes chapters a través del liderazgo de los diferentes SQUADs de la organización (Strategy, Medical, Acceso, Servicio, etc), asegurando que la organización en su conjunto capitalice las oportunidades con los clientes estratégicos.

• Garantizar la diferenciación de Roche en el mercado mediante una propuesta de valor robusta que refuerce nuestro posicionamiento como líder en diagnóstico innovador y socio estratégico confiable y sostenible.

• Monitorear la satisfacción de clientes estratégicos, promoviendo relaciones de largo plazo basadas en confianza y resultados medibles, asegurando que se consideran los insights estratégicos del mercado y de performance de negocio.

Tu perfil:

• Título universitario en ciencias de la salud, ventas, negocios, marketing o similares.

• Experiencia en funciones comerciales similares para la industria de diagnóstico, dispositivos médicos o similares.

• Conocimiento de la dinámica y los participantes del mercado de salud, su sistema y las políticas de salud, también sobre la problemática y soluciones para el laboratorio.

• Amplio conocimiento de la tecnología y marcas de los competidores.

• Conocimiento intermedio del idioma Inglés.

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

En Roche Diagnostica buscamos talento de alto nivel, buscamos a nuestro próximo Demand Planner. No es una posición de soporte; es un rol clave en nuestra toma de decisiones estratégicas.
Lo que Harás Formarás parte fundamental de nuestra Supply Chain.
Tu misión: garantizar la alta disponibilidad de nuestros reactivos y consumibles críticos, optimizando al mismo tiempo los objetivos financieros de la compañía.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:

• Pronóstico de Demanda de Alta Precisión: Generar estimados junto a Ventas y Marketing analizando tendencias e indicadores como Forecast Accuracy.

• Experto en sistemas de ERP: Mantener y optimizar los parámetros de planificación (MRP), Master data.

• Estratega de abastecimiento: Comandar la planeación para el consumo de rutina, lanzamientos e instalaciones de equipos para el aseguramiento de la operación continua, así como el control de caducidades, estrategias de desplazamiento.

• Optimización y monitoreo: Maximizar los indicadores financieros, operativos, estratégicos con impacto en la organización en impacto con la experiencia al cliente.

Tu perfil:

• Dominio avanzado de SAP

• Conocimientos profundos de S&OP, Compras y Comercio Exterior.

• Inglés avanzado fluido para interactuar con nuestra Red Global a diario.

• Experiencia en Planeación de Demanda y Gestión de Materiales dentro de la industria de IVD (dispositivos médicos)

• Un APICS (CPIM o CSCP) te hará destacar de inmediato.

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

La posizione

Il Delivery Management Professional conduce consegne moderatamente complesse, identifica proattivamente miglioramenti, gestisce diversi stakeholder e contribuisce all'implementazione strategica. In questo ruolo, definire e controllare in modo indipendente la portata di iniziative da medie a grandi dimensioni, utilizzando efficace facilitazione e competenze analitiche per guidare la consegna del valore.

Durante la navigazione in ambienti interessati intricati, si collegherà lo sviluppo del team con obiettivi aziendali più ampi. A seconda delle esigenze dell'organizzazione, è possibile operare all'interno di archetipi di ruolo come Project Manager, Service (Delivery) Manager, ITSM Process SME, Scrum Master, RTE o Agile Coach.

Responsabilità del lavoro

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Indipendentemente definisce, gestisce e controlla la portata di iniziative da medio a grandi o flussi di lavoro significativi con una complessità moderata. Conduce e facilita il processo di definizione della portata, allineando con gli obiettivi strategici, le aspettative degli stakeholder e le dipendenze del team. Identificare, analizzare e mitigare i rischi legati allo scopo, gestisce i cambiamenti di portata e sostiene l'adozione delle best practice di gestione degli ambiti all'interno del Capitolo.

• Responsabilità/Problem Solving: Indipendentemente conduce l'analisi di problemi di consegna da moderati a complessi, guidando l'analisi delle cause di root e sollecitando complesse esigenze degli stakeholder. Contabile per piani di miglioramento completi e contribuisce alla progettazione e alla validazione della soluzione. La responsabilità dei campioni, affronta pragmaticamente l'ambiguità e utilizza tecniche di facilitazione efficaci per guidare i team mentre mentoring colleghi e lo spirito del team di costruzione.

• Stakeholder Management: Identificare una vasta gamma di stakeholder in aree funzionali e sviluppa piani di comunicazione di stakeholder completi. Efficacemente gestisce le relazioni per agire come consulente di fiducia, modella proattivamente le prospettive degli stakeholder e naviga in ambienti di stakeholder intricati risolvendo i conflitti per garantire l'allineamento.

• Impatto/Strategia: dimostra prestazioni coerenti con un impatto che si estende tipicamente a un prodotto specifico, iniziativa o cluster. Contribuisce al raggiungimento degli obiettivi del prodotto o del dominio assicurando la consegna del valore, svolge un ruolo proattivo nella modellazione dei processi del team e contribuisce all'implementazione di obiettivi strategici per l'Informatica, il Capitolo e/o i Domini.

• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): gestisce iniziative o flussi di lavoro moderatamente complessi che si estendono attraverso un prodotto o un servizio. Gestisce la consegna di funzioni complesse, servizi o progetti (ad esempio, una transizione di servizio, un rilascio di prodotto, o un incremento Agile Release Train (ART). Seleziona e adatta le metodologie di consegna mentre gestisci le dipendenze tra le attività.

• Capacità commerciale/tecnica: Dimostra forte acume aziendale analizzando le esigenze aziendali e traducendoli in efficaci strategie di consegna. Seleziona e adatta le metodologie di consegna per ottimizzare i risultati, gestisce processi di consegna complessi e utilizza strumenti di consegna avanzati e tecniche per affrontare le sfide aziendali e contribuire alla pianificazione.

Qualifiche

Istruzione / Esperienza

• Provato record di traccia che opera in un archetipo di Delivery Management (ad esempio, Project Manager, Service Manager, Scrum Master, RTE, Agile Coach) che gestisce medie e grandi iniziative o flussi di lavoro significativi.

• Esperienza di gestione della consegna di caratteristiche o progetti complessi (come transizioni di servizio o incrementi ART) in aree funzionali.

• Esperienza dimostrata tradurre richiede
