jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Threat & Vulnerability Analyst (Product Security)

The Opportunity
At Roche, we believe that secure products build trust and save lives. As a Threat & Vulnerability Analyst , you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding our healthcare products, software platforms, and medical technology ecosystem.
You will be responsible for identifying, evaluating, and reporting security vulnerabilities across product lines while leveraging cutting-edge automation and AI-driven methodologies. Working at the intersection of cybersecurity, engineering, and product innovation, you will serve as a trusted security partner to product development teams: helping them understand security risks, prioritize remediations, and continuously strengthen our security posture.
Key Responsibilities

• Vulnerability Assessment & Analysis: Perform end-to-end security assessments on product components and software stacks, identifying potential security flaws, exposure points, and software risks.

• Automation & AI Integration: Contribute actively to the automation of Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) vulnerability management workflows and help pioneer AI-augmented vulnerability assessment frameworks to scale security operations.

• Cross-Stakeholder Reporting: Translate complex technical vulnerabilities into clear, actionable risk reports for engineering, product management, and leadership teams.

• Product Team Enablement & Remediation Support: Partner directly with product teams to help them comprehend vulnerability root causes and potential impact, collaborate on pragmatic and effective remediation strategies, and assist in prioritizing fixes within development roadmaps.

• Continuous Improvement: Track emerging threat vectors, zero-days, and security industry standards (such as CVSS, NIST, OWASP) to continuously refine assessment criteria and automated tooling.
Who You Are

• Remediation Strategy: Ability to guide engineering teams through root-cause analysis and realistic fix prioritization without compromising delivery velocity.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Threat & Vulnerability Analyst (Produktsicherheit)

Die Chance
Bei Roche glauben wir, dass sichere Produkte Vertrauen schaffen und Leben retten. Als Threat & Vulnerability Analyst spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle beim Schutz unserer Gesundheitsprodukte, Softwareplattformen und des Ökosystems der Medizintechnik.
Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, Sicherheitslücken über Produktlinien hinweg zu identifizieren, zu bewerten und zu melden, während Sie modernste Automatisierungs- und KI-gestützte Methoden nutzen. An der Schnittstelle von Cybersicherheit, Engineering und Produktinnovation arbeiten Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Sicherheitspartner für Produktentwicklungsteams: Sie helfen ihnen, Sicherheitsrisiken zu verstehen, Mängel zu priorisieren und unsere Sicherheitslage kontinuierlich zu stärken.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Vulnerability Assessment & Analysis: Führen Sie End-to-End-Sicherheitsbewertungen für Produktkomponenten und Software-Stacks durch und identifizieren Sie potenzielle Sicherheitslücken, Expositionspunkte und Softwarerisiken.

• Automatisierung & KI-Integration: Tragen Sie aktiv zur Automatisierung von Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) Vulnerability Management Workflows bei und unterstützen Sie KI-erweiterte Vulnerability Assessment Frameworks bei der Skalierung von Sicherheitsoperationen.

• Stakeholderübergreifendes Reporting: Übersetzen Sie komplexe technische Schwachstellen in klare, umsetzbare Risikoberichte für Engineering-, Produktmanagement- und Führungsteams.

• Product Team Enablement & Remediation Support: Partner direkt mit Produktteams, um ihnen zu helfen, Ursachen von Schwachstellen und mögliche Auswirkungen zu verstehen, an pragmatischen und effektiven Sanierungsstrategien zusammenzuarbeiten und bei der Priorisierung von Korrekturen innerhalb von Entwicklungs-Roadmaps zu helfen.

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Verfolgen Sie neue Bedrohungsvektoren, Zero-Days und Sicherheitsindustriestandards (wie CVSS, NIST, OWASP), um Bewertungskriterien und automatisierte Tools kontinuierlich zu verfeinern.
Wer du bist
Sie sind ein proaktiver, analytischer Cybersicherheitsexperte, der sich für die Lösung komplexer technischer Herausforderungen einsetzt und Sicherheitskonzepte sowohl für technische als auch für nicht-technische Zielgruppen kommuniziert.
Qualifikationen & Fähigkeiten:

• Erfahrung: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in den Bereichen Bedrohungs- und Schwachstellenmanagement, Produktsicherheit, Anwendungssicherheit oder Softwaresicherheitsanalyse.

• Technisches Wissen: Starkes Verständnis von Schwachstellen-Scoring-Systemen (z. B. CVSS), Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) Management, Software-Zusammensetzungsanalyse (SCA) und gemeinsamen Schwachstellen-Frameworks (CVE / CWE).

• Automation & Scripting: Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit oder starkes Interesse an der Automatisierung von Sicherheits-Workflows (z. B. Python, Bash, CI/CD-Integrationen) und der Anwendung aufkommender AI/ML-Technologien auf Sicherheitsbewertungen.

• Sanierungsstrategie: Fähigkeit, Engineering-Teams durch Ursachenanalyse und realistische Fix-Priorisierung zu führen, ohne die Liefergeschwindigkeit zu beeinträchtigen.

• Kommunikation & Einfluss: Hervorragende schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit einer Erfolgsbilanz beim Aufbau positiver, beratender Beziehungen zu Software- und Produktteams.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Analyste de la menace et de la vulnérabilité (sécurité des produits)

L'opportunité
Chez Roche, nous croyons que des produits sûrs renforcent la confiance et sauvent des vies. En tant qu'analyste de la menace et de la vulnérabilité, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la protection de nos produits de santé, de nos plateformes logicielles et de l'écosystème de la technologie médicale.
Vous serez chargé d'identifier, d'évaluer et de signaler les vulnérabilités en matière de sécurité dans toutes les gammes de produits, tout en tirant parti de l'automatisation de pointe et des méthodologies axées sur l'IA. Travaillant à l'intersection de la cybersécurité, de l'ingénierie et de l'innovation de produits, vous serez un partenaire de sécurité fiable pour les équipes de développement de produits : les aider à comprendre les risques de sécurité, à prioriser les mesures correctives et à renforcer continuellement notre posture de sécurité.
Principales responsabilités

• Évaluation et analyse de la vulnérabilité : Effectuer des évaluations de sécurité de bout en bout sur les composants des produits et les piles de logiciels, en identifiant les défauts de sécurité potentiels, les points d'exposition et les risques liés aux logiciels.

• Automatisation et intégration de l'IA : Contribuer activement à l'automatisation des flux de travail de gestion de la vulnérabilité du logiciel Bill of Materials (SBOM) et aider à mettre en place des cadres d'évaluation de la vulnérabilité renforcés par l'IA pour étendre les opérations de sécurité.

• Rapports entre intervenants : Traduire des vulnérabilités techniques complexes en rapports de risques clairs et réalisables pour les équipes d'ingénierie, de gestion de produits et de leadership.

• Soutien à l'activation et à l'assainissement de l'équipe de produits : S'associer directement aux équipes de produits pour les aider à comprendre les causes profondes de la vulnérabilité et son impact potentiel, collaborer à des stratégies d'assainissement pragmatiques et efficaces et aider à hiérarchiser les correctifs dans les feuilles de route de développement.

• Amélioration continue : suivre les nouveaux vecteurs de menace, les zéros jours et les normes de sécurité de l'industrie (telles que CVSS, NIST, OWASP) afin d'affiner continuellement les critères d'évaluation et les outils automatisés.
Qui vous êtes
Vous êtes un professionnel proactif et analytique de la cybersécurité qui réussit à résoudre des défis techniques complexes et à communiquer des concepts de sécurité aux publics techniques et non techniques.
Qualifications et compétences :

• Expérience : Expérience éprouvée en gestion de la menace et de la vulnérabilité, sécurité des produits, sécurité des applications ou analyse de la sécurité des logiciels.

• Connaissances techniques : Une bonne compréhension des systèmes de notation de vulnérabilité (p. ex., CVSS), de la gestion du logiciel Bill of Materials (SBOM), de l'analyse de la composition des logiciels (SCA) et des cadres communs de vulnérabilité (CVE/CWE).

• Automation & Scripting: Capacité démontrée ou grand intérêt à automatiser les workflows de sécurité (p. ex., intégrations Python, Bash, CI/CD) et à appliquer les nouvelles technologies d'IA/ML aux évaluations de sécurité.

• Stratégie d'assainissement : Capacité de guider les équipes d'ingénierie par l'analyse de causes profondes et la fixation réaliste des priorités sans compromettre la vitesse de livraison.

• Communication et influence: Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, avec une expérience de l'établissement de relations positives et consultatives avec les équipes de logiciels et de produits.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, afin de pouvoir offrir des soins de santé qui changent la vie

The Position
The mission of the Patient Care Country Expert Central & Eastern Europe (CEE) is to deliver a seamless, positive experience for customers across multiple communication channels. Dedicated to efficiently resolving service requests and incidents, the Patient Care Advisor ensures proper classification, assignment, tracking, documentation, and follow-up to guarantee a satisfactory resolution.

By driving customer satisfaction through key performance indicators, the Patient Care Country Expert supports the leader with the internal and external teams to offer robust technical and medical support, manages adverse events and product complaints with high-quality customer service, and adheres to organizational, client, and regulatory guidelines. Committed to continuous development through necessary training, tools, and resources, the Patient Care Country Expert consistently delivers value to the team while operating with a global perspective and leveraging best practices.

The Patient Care Country Expert is reporting to the Customer Care Team Manager or other Customer Care Leader and is responsible for the technical, analytical and operational support of the area and coordinating country related topics. She/He could assist the leader in people management daily tasks and take over deputy functions in case of leader absence. Additionally, is providing excellent customer front-line assistance through a variety of channels and technology to patients and customers related to Products and Digital Solutions commercialized by Roche, understanding their needs and following all the systems and procedures established.

Successful candidate can be located in any of the CEE countries: Poland, Croatia, Slovenia, Romania, Hungary, Czech Republic, Turkey, Greece, Lithuania or Spain (Sant Cugat).

Relocation benefits are not available.

Leadership and Team Support

• Provide constructive feedback and coaching on technical and behavioral issues in partnership with the advisor’s leader or Supplier Operations Manager.

• Inspire and motivate the team by leading by example.

• Support leaders in quality-related topics and audit preparation.

• Assist in the recruitment process, including interviewing and initial candidate selection with People & Culture (P&C).

• Proactively support leaders in specific country-related topics, including country meetings, operational process implementation, and task distribution among advisors.

• In the leader’s absence, ensure the efficient running of daily operations.

• Communicate operational topics to the team and provide necessary follow-ups.

• Manage administrative team tasks such as holiday requests and absences.

Country-Specific Expertise

• Act as the first point of contact for country-specific questions, escalating requests to leaders when necessary.

• Monitor and analyze KPIs, ensuring country procedures are correctly applied and identifying training needs.

• Provide training on country-specific topics and procedures to new advisors and offer refresh training as needed.

• Maintain and update the knowledge base on country-related topics, informing advisors accordingly.

• Take ownership of adapting global processes to local markets by staying up-to-date with changing regulations and legal frameworks.

• Proactively propose improvements to existing workflows based on country-specific knowledge and insights.

Customer Interaction and Support

• Handle escalated customer interactions and provide exemplary solutions.

Competenza Paese-Specifico

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
La mission du Patient Care Country Expert Central & Eastern Europe (CEE) est de fournir une expérience positive et transparente aux clients sur plusieurs canaux de communication. Destiné à résoudre efficacement les demandes de services et les incidents, le conseiller en soins aux patients assure la classification, l'affectation, le suivi, la documentation et le suivi appropriés pour garantir une résolution satisfaisante.

En favorisant la satisfaction de la clientèle grâce à des indicateurs de performance clés, l'expert en soins aux patients accompagne le chef de file auprès des équipes internes et externes afin d'offrir un soutien technique et médical solide, de gérer les événements indésirables et les plaintes de produits avec un service à la clientèle de haute qualité et de respecter les lignes directrices organisationnelles, clientes et réglementaires. Engagé dans le développement continu grâce à la formation, aux outils et aux ressources nécessaires, le Patient Care Country Expert offre systématiquement de la valeur à l'équipe tout en travaillant dans une perspective mondiale et en tirant parti des meilleures pratiques.

L'expert en soins aux patients relève du gestionnaire de l'équipe de soins aux clients ou d'un autre responsable des soins aux clients et est responsable de l'appui technique, analytique et opérationnel du domaine et de la coordination des sujets liés au pays. Il/elle pourrait aider le chef dans les tâches quotidiennes de gestion des personnes et prendre la relève en cas d'absence de chef. De plus, offre une excellente assistance de première ligne à la clientèle par divers canaux et technologies aux patients et clients liés aux Produits et Solutions numériques commercialisés par Roche, en comprenant leurs besoins et en suivant tous les systèmes et procédures établis.

Le candidat retenu peut être situé dans l'un des pays d'Europe centrale et orientale: Pologne, Croatie, Slovénie, Roumanie, Hongrie, République tchèque, Turquie, Grèce, Lituanie ou Espagne (Sant Cugat).

Les prestations de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles.

Principales responsabilités

Leadership et appui aux équipes

• Fournir des commentaires constructifs et un coaching sur les questions techniques et comportementales en partenariat avec le leader du conseiller ou le gestionnaire des opérations des fournisseurs.

• Inspirez et motivez l'équipe en donnant l'exemple.

• Appuyer les dirigeants dans les domaines liés à la qualité et la préparation des audits.

• Aider au processus de recrutement, y compris l'entrevue et la sélection initiale des candidats auprès de People & Culture (P&C).

• Soutenir activement les dirigeants dans des domaines spécifiques liés aux pays, notamment les réunions de pays, la mise en œuvre des processus opérationnels et la répartition des tâches entre les conseillers.

• Dans l'absence de leader, assurer le fonctionnement efficace des opérations quotidiennes.

• Communiquer les sujets opérationnels à l'équipe et fournir les suivis nécessaires.

• Gérer les tâches de l'équipe administrative comme les demandes de vacances et les absences.

Expertise par pays

• Agir en tant que premier point de contact pour les questions spécifiques à chaque pays, en augmentant les demandes aux dirigeants au besoin.

• Surveiller et analyser les ICR, veiller à ce que les procédures nationales soient correctement appliquées et identifier les besoins de formation.

• Offrir une formation sur des sujets et des procédures propres à chaque pays aux nouveaux conseillers et offrir une formation de recyclage au besoin.

• Maintenir et mettre à jour la base de connaissances sur les sujets liés aux pays, en informant les conseillers en conséquence.

• S'approprier l'adaptation des processus mondiaux aux marchés locaux en se tenant au courant de l'évolution des réglementations et des cadres juridiques.

• Proposer activement des améliorations aux flux de travail existants en se fondant sur les connaissances et les connaissances propres à chaque pays.

Interaction client et soutien

• Gérer les interactions avec les clients et fournir des solutions exemplaires.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Employee Experience Operations Travel & Expense Specialist as part of the Demand to Pay department maintains and supports the daily activities of the Travel and Expense and Company Card expenses associated with the Roche Global Credit card programs. This role is expected to offer a high level of customer service as this is the first point of contact for our internal customers.

• Customer Support: Act as the primary point of contact for internal customers, providing high-quality support and guidance for corporate credit cards and Concur expense management via calls and tickets.

• Ticket & Case Management: Own, track, and resolve Help Desk tickets efficiently—aiming for same-day resolution—while making decisions on first-level issues and further actions.

• System Administration: Handle day-to-day administrative duties within the Concur system to keep the platform running smoothly.

• SLA & KPI Compliance: Ensure all services are delivered with high quality and accuracy, strictly adhering to agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), KPIs, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Documentation & Training: Build and maintain up-to-date documentation for business systems and processes, and deliver process training to end-users as requested.

• Reporting & Monitoring: Manage scheduled and ad-hoc reporting and monitoring activities, proactively applying system fixes and communicating resolutions clearly.

• Team Collaboration & Growth: Participate in team availability planning (holidays/training) and contribute to the onboarding and implementation of new tasks arriving at the Roche-Budapest site.

Who you are

• Self-motivated and passionate about the job, understanding the importance of providing high-quality service.

• Open-minded, dedicated to making a difference, and open to constant development.

• Experience in a shared service environment, preferably in the customer service area.

• Experience with corporate credit card programs is an advantage.

• Fluency in English and Turkish Speaking .

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
L'opportunità

L'Employee Experience Operations Travel & Expense Specialist nell'ambito del reparto Richieste a Paga mantiene e supporta le attività quotidiane delle spese di viaggio e di erogazione e carta aziendale associate ai programmi di carta di credito Roche Global. Questo ruolo è previsto per offrire un alto livello di servizio clienti in quanto questo è il primo punto di contatto per i nostri clienti interni.

• Supporto del cliente: agire come punto primario di contatto per i clienti interni, fornendo supporto e guida di alta qualità per le carte di credito aziendali e la gestione delle spese di Concur tramite chiamate e biglietti.

• Ticket & Case Management: Possedere, tracciare e risolvere i biglietti Help Desk in modo efficiente, in base alla risoluzione di un giorno stesso, mentre prendere decisioni su problemi di primo livello e ulteriori azioni.

• Amministrazione del sistema: gestire i dazi amministrativi giornalieri all'interno del sistema Concur per mantenere la piattaforma in esecuzione senza intoppi.

• SLA & KPI Compliance: Assicurarsi che tutti i servizi siano forniti con alta qualità e precisione, rispettando rigorosamente gli accordi di livello di servizio concordati (SLA), KPI e procedure operative standard (SOP).

• Documentazione e formazione: costruire e mantenere la documentazione aggiornata per i sistemi e i processi aziendali, e fornire formazione di processo agli utenti finali come richiesto.

• Reporting & Monitoring: Gestisci le attività di reporting e monitoraggio programmate e ad-hoc, applicando in modo proattivo le correzioni di sistema e le risoluzioni di comunicazione in modo chiaro.

• Team Collaboration & Growth: Partecipa alla pianificazione della disponibilità del team (giorni/formazione) e contribuisce all'integrazione e all'implementazione di nuovi compiti che arrivano al sito Roche-Budapest.

Chi sei

• Automotivato e appassionato del lavoro, comprendere l'importanza di fornire un servizio di alta qualità.

• Aperto, dedicato a fare la differenza, e aperto allo sviluppo costante.

• Esperienza in un ambiente di servizio condiviso, preferibilmente nell'area del servizio clienti.

• L'esperienza con i programmi di carta di credito aziendale è un vantaggio.

• Fluency in lingua inglese e turco .

In cambio vi forniamo

• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.

• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.

• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media). Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.

• Una comunità globale inclusiva, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto focalizzata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità di condividere la tua opinione.

Si prega di leggere la Informativa sulla privacy dei dati per ulteriori informazioni su come gestiamo i vostri dati personali relativi al processo di reclutamento: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla sanità oggi

• Automotivé et passionné par le travail, comprenant l'importance de fournir un service de haute qualité.

• Ouvert, dévoué à faire la différence et ouvert à un développement constant.

• Expérience dans un environnement de service partagé, de préférence dans la zone de service à la clientèle.

• L'expérience des programmes de cartes de crédit est un avantage.

• Connaissance de l'anglais et du turc.

• Possibilités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage. • Flexibilité : Nous soutenons également la flexibilité pour vous aider à trouver votre équilibre. Le bureau à domicile est généralement disponible (habituellement 2 jours/semaine en moyenne). Nous créons l'occasion de la liberté dans le travail, où votre vie privée et d'entreprise coexistent en harmonie.

• Une communauté mondiale inclusive, où nous apprenons les uns des autres. Chez Roche, nous coopérons, débattons, prenons des décisions, célébrons les succès et nous amusons en équipe. Notre leadership est très concentré sur les gens, créant une culture forte et inclusive, donc vous avez toujours la chance de partager votre opinion.

Veuillez lire l'Avis de confidentialité des données pour plus d'informations sur la façon dont nous traitons vos données personnelles liées au processus de recrutement: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde sont dédiés à la promotion de la science, garantissant à tous l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Praktikum (m/w/d) im Team Digital Customer Excellence
Roche Pharma AG

Wer wir sind
Bei Roche leisten über 101.000 Menschen in mehr als 100 Ländern Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Gemeinsam haben wir uns zu einem weltweit führenden, forschungsorientierten Healthcare-Konzern entwickelt. Unser Erfolg baut auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt. Die Roche Pharma AG an ihrem Standort in Grenzach-Wyhlen steuert zentrale Elemente der technischen Qualitätssicherung für den gesamten europäischen Raum sowie die klinische Forschung, das Marketing und die Vertriebsaktivitäten für den deutschen Markt.

Das Kundenerlebnis in den Mittelpunkt zu stellen, Digital-First zu denken und Omnichannel-Marketing zu leben entspricht Deinem Mindset? Wir wollen jeden Touchpoint unserer Kunden mit Roche mit einer besonders positiven Customer Experience belegen. Passt das zu Dir? Dann bist Du bei Roche und in unserem Team genau richtig. Ein umfangreicher Einarbeitungsplan hilft Dir gemeinsam mit dem Team, alle Teilbereiche von Digital Customer Excellence kennen- und verstehen zu lernen. Und dann heißt es mit Unterstützung deines Buddys aus dem Team „Learning by doing“.

Was wir Dir bieten:

• ggf. Unterbringung über die Dauer des Praktikums in unserem modernen Boardinghouse (wohnortabhängig)

• 2.268€ Vergütung monatlich

• Job Shadowings in andere Unternehmensbereiche

• div. Sport- und Wellbeing- Kurse auf dem Roche Campus und/oder digital

• Modernste Büros im Co-Working Stil

Praktikumszeitraum: Geplant ab 1. Oktober für 6 Monate

Deine Aufgaben:

• Superior Customer Experience mitgestalten

• Unterstützung und Auswertung digitaler Kampagnen und Omnichannel-Kommunikation für strategische, abteilungsübergreifende Produkte

• Wissenstransfer digitaler Konzepte in die Kundeninteraktion und standortweite Implementierung

• Omnichannel-Kommunikation (Fokus Digital) erlebbar machen

• Analyse & Bewertung nutzerfreundlicher digitaler Plattformen und Kanäle

• Erarbeitung und Mitwirkung bei digitalen Kampagnen und Konzepten

• Maßnahmen mitgestalten, die einen WOW-Effekt bei unseren Kunden erzeugen und ein nachhaltiges CX-Mindset fördern

• Recherche und interne Kommunikation von Best-Practice-Beispielen zu Customer Centricity

• Content-Erstellung für deutschsprachige Kanäle; Workshop-Moderation und Ergebnisdokumentation in deutscher Sprache

Wer Du bist:
Für Dein Praktikum im Team von Digital Customer Excellence (Bezeichnung der Abteilung) bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen mit:

• Generelle Voraussetzung zur Beschäftigung als Praktikant/in ist die ordentliche Immatrikulation während des gesamten Praktikums oder aber das Praktikum wird innerhalb eines Gap Years absolviert, also nach dem Bachelorabschluss in Vorbereitung auf ein Masterstudium oder auf die Promotion.

• Du bist Student (m/w/d) mit den Schwerpunkten Wirtschafts- oder Naturwissenschaften, Digitales Management und/oder Gesundheitsmanagement.

• Du bist ein "Early Adopter" von neuen, digitalen Tools/Plattformen und zeichnest Dich aus durch Deine Neugierde in Bezug auf die Entwicklung und Implementierung digitaler Kommunikationsformen.

• Du verfügst über eine gute digitale Affinität sowie eine analytische Herangehensweise.

• Interesse an Marketing in der Pharmabranche und allgemeinen Fragestellungen im gesundheitspolitischen Umfeld.

• Idealerweise praktische Erfahrungen im Vertrieb oder Gesundheitsmanagement.

• Interesse an CX/UX & Content Management wünschenswert.

• Du überzeugst durch Deine kommunikative Persönlich

descriptionByLocale.it:

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Stage (m/f/d) nel team Digital Customer Excellence
Roche Pharma AG

Chi siamo
A Roche, più di 101.000 persone sono pionieri della sanità in più di 100 paesi. Insieme, ci siamo sviluppati in un gruppo sanitario leader mondiale e orientato alla ricerca. Il nostro successo si basa sull'innovazione, la curiosità e la diversità. Roche Pharma AG nel suo sito a Grenzach-Wyhlen controlla elementi chiave dell'assicurazione della qualità tecnica per l'intera area europea, nonché delle attività di ricerca clinica, marketing e vendita per il mercato tedesco.

Concentrandosi sull'esperienza del cliente, pensare digitale prima e vivere omnichannel marketing è la vostra mentalità? Vogliamo dimostrare ogni punto di contatto dei nostri clienti con Roche con un'esperienza clienti particolarmente positiva. Ti sta bene? Allora siete esattamente a Roche e nella nostra squadra. Un piano di formazione completo ti aiuta a conoscere e comprendere tutte le aree di Digital Customer Excellence insieme al team. E poi, con il supporto del tuo amico della squadra, dice “Learning by doing”.

I vostri compiti:

• Creazione di un'esperienza clienti superiore

• Supporto e valutazione delle campagne digitali e delle comunicazioni omnicanale per prodotti strategici e cross-departmental

• Trasferimento di conoscenza dei concetti digitali nell'interazione dei clienti e nell'implementazione del sito

• Rendere la comunicazione omnicanale (focus digitale) tangibile

• Analisi e valutazione delle piattaforme e dei canali digitali intuitivi

• Sviluppo e partecipazione a campagne e concetti digitali

• Contribuisci a misure che creano un effetto WOW per i nostri clienti e promuovi una mentalità CX sostenibile

• Ricerca e comunicazione interna degli esempi di best practice sulla centricità dei clienti

• Creazione di contenuti per i canali in lingua tedesca; moderazione di workshop e documentazione dei risultati in tedesco

Chi sei:
Per il tuo stage nel team di Digital Customer Excellence (designazione del dipartimento) Hai i seguenti requisiti:

• Il requisito generale per l'occupazione come tirocinante è l'iscrizione regolare durante l'intero stage o lo stage è completato entro un anno di gap, cioè dopo la laurea in preparazione per un master o dottorato.

• Sei uno studente (m/f/d) con un focus su economia o scienze naturali, gestione digitale e/o gestione della salute.

• Sei un “adottivo precoce” di nuovi strumenti/piattaforma digitali e ti distinguono per la tua curiosità riguardo allo sviluppo e all’implementazione delle forme digitali di comunicazione.

• Hai una buona affinità digitale e un approccio analitico.

• Interessi di marketing nell'industria farmaceutica e questioni generali nell'ambiente della politica sanitaria.

• Idealmente, esperienza pratica nelle vendite o nella gestione della salute.

• Interesse a CX/UX & Content Management auspicabile.

• Convinci attraverso la tua personalità comunicativa e la tua ricchezza di idee.

• Hai usato il tuo metodo di lavoro strutturato e il tuo pensiero analitico nei progetti e li ha promossi in modo indipendente.

• Sei un giocatore di squadra, ti piace dare e ricevere feedback e agire sempre con l'obiettivo di migliorare il portafoglio del team.

• Comunicazione sicura in tedesco e buona conoscenza della rotonda inglese D

Internship (m/f/d) in the Digital Customer Excellence team

Who we are
At Roche, more than 101,000 people are pioneering healthcare in more than 100 countries. Together, we have developed into a world-leading, research-oriented healthcare group. Roche Pharma AG at its site in Grenzach-Wyhlen controls key elements of technical quality assurance for the entire European area as well as clinical research, marketing and sales activities for the German market.

Focusing on the customer experience, thinking digital first and living omnichannel marketing is your mindset? We want to prove every touchpoint of our customers with Roche with a particularly positive customer experience. Does that suit you? Then you are exactly right at Roche and in our team. A comprehensive training plan helps you to get to know and understand all areas of Digital Customer Excellence together with the team. And then, with the support of your buddy from the team, it says “Learning by doing”.

Your tasks:

• Creating Superior Customer Experience

• Support and evaluation of digital campaigns and omnichannel communications for strategic, cross-departmental products

• Knowledge transfer of digital concepts into customer interaction and site-wide implementation

• Making omnichannel communication (focus digital) tangible

• Analysis & evaluation of user-friendly digital platforms and channels

• Development and participation in digital campaigns and concepts

• Contribute to measures that create a WOW effect for our customers and promote a sustainable CX mindset

• Research and internal communication of best practice examples on customer centricity

• Content creation for German-language channels; Workshop moderation and documentation of the results in German

Who you are:
For your internship in the team of Digital Customer Excellence (designation of the department) You have the following requirements:

• The general requirement for employment as an intern is regular enrollment during the entire internship or the internship is completed within a gap year, i.e. after the bachelor's degree in preparation for a master's degree or doctorate.

• You are a student (m/f/d) with a focus on economics or natural sciences, digital management and/or health management.

• You are an “early adopter” of new digital tools/platforms and distinguish yourself through your curiosity regarding the development and implementation of digital forms of communication.

• You have a good digital affinity as well as an analytical approach.

• Interest in marketing in the pharmaceutical industry and general issues in the health policy environment.

• Ideally, practical experience in sales or health management.

• Interest in CX/UX & Content Management desirable.

• You convince through your communicative personality and your wealth of ideas.

• You have used your structured working method and your analytical thinking in projects and promoted them independently.

• You are a team player, you like to give and receive feedback and always act with the aim of improving the portfolio of the team.

• Secure communication in German and good knowledge of English round D

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Stage (m/f/d) au sein de l'équipe d'excellence du client numérique
Roche Pharma AG

Qui nous sommes
À Roche, plus de 101 000 personnes sont des pionniers dans plus de 100 pays. Ensemble, nous sommes devenus un groupe de soins de santé de premier plan, axé sur la recherche. Notre succès repose sur l'innovation, la curiosité et la diversité. Roche Pharma AG sur son site à Grenzach-Wyhlen contrôle les éléments clés de l'assurance qualité technique pour l'ensemble de l'espace européen ainsi que les activités de recherche clinique, de marketing et de vente pour le marché allemand.

Se concentrer sur l'expérience client, penser le numérique d'abord et le marketing omnicanal vivant est votre état d'esprit? Nous voulons prouver chaque point de contact de nos clients avec Roche avec une expérience client particulièrement positive. Ça te va ? Alors vous êtes exactement à Roche et dans notre équipe. Et puis, avec le soutien de votre pote de l'équipe, il est dit : Apprendre en faisant.

• Créer une expérience client supérieure

• Soutien et évaluation des campagnes numériques et des communications omnicanal pour les produits stratégiques et interservices

• Transfert de connaissances sur les concepts numériques dans l'interaction client et mise en œuvre à l'échelle du site

• Développement et participation aux campagnes et concepts numériques

• Contribuer à des mesures qui créent un effet WOW pour nos clients et promouvoir un état d'esprit CX durable

The Position
Clinical Educator - Midlands /East of England

The Position
You bring clinical expertise to the field team. This is a promotional role, working as an integral member of a field based team and will not have direct contact with patients.
Key Responsibilities:

• To assist specialist customers in a secondary care environment, to increase their knowledge, clinical understanding and advocacy of the assigned brands in the relevant therapeutic area/disease state and approved indications (multiple sclerosis)

• To provide education to health care professionals and their staff on the proper administration of designated treatments for assigned disease area

• To support healthcare professionals to provide patients with appropriate information and support informed decision making along the patient journey.
Who you are:

• Nursing background or similar experience required

• Good understanding and working knowledge of the Pharma Market and the local Health Service environment

• Good technical knowledge of Multiple Sclerosis experience preferred but not essential

• Effective verbal and written communication skills

• High level of business planning, organisational & problem solving skills

• Ability to conduct face-to-face presentations to customers

• Highly motivated with drive & determination to succeed & willingness to adapt to change

• Dynamic, self-starter with strong influential skills, as well as entrepreneurial spirit

• Ability to develop and maintain strong, professional relationships

• Commercial, Regulatory and technical awareness

• The ability to navigate a large multi-disciplinary geography (which may require travel 70% of working time)

• Valid driving licence

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose
The Patient Journey Partner works closely with patients and all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey , gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions .
By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the Patient Journey Partner identifies shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions.
●Being successful in this role will deliver better outcomes for patients and better community value, ultimately resulting in better commercial results.

The scope
• What this role is:
• ●It is locally embedded in the ecosystem
• ●It is an integrated role , functionally agnostic, i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs.
• ●It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives
• ●It acts as trusted partner and primary point of contact for defined stakeholders (physicians, nurses, pathologists, etc.)
• ●It works closely with the PJPs and HSP within the ecosystem to create value for the customers and collaborates with PJP of similar DA within DA pods in Levant and the Network

What this role is not :
• ●It does not engage in “tell-and-sell”
• ●It is not limited to scientific engagement .
• ●It does not act as the exclusive point of contact for defined stakeholders.

Your challenges
• ● Partnering with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock value.
• ● Stewarding Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supporting their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.
• ●Sharing patient and stakeholder needs internally, pulling in expertise and resources locally and from the network, and driving solutions that deliver outcomes faster.
• ●Ensuring great customer experience whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche.

Who You Are
• ● You demonstrate excellent entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding customer centricity
• ● You possess Growth mindset , able to learn quickly, take risks and experiment
• ● You have a deep understanding of patient journey(s) and related Roche products

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Objet
Le Patient Journey Partner travaille en étroite collaboration avec les patients et toutes les parties prenantes touchant directement le parcours du patient, en acquérant une compréhension profonde de leurs besoins afin de relier les capacités de Roches pour co-créer des solutions significatives.
En supervisant le cheminement du patient dans son intégralité, le partenaire de voyage du patient identifie le but commun des intervenants et en tire parti pour co-créer des solutions.
● Le succès de ce rôle permettra d'obtenir de meilleurs résultats pour les patients et une meilleure valeur pour la collectivité, ce qui aboutira finalement à de meilleurs résultats commerciaux.

Portée
• Ce rôle est :
• ● Il est intégré localement dans l'écosystème
• ●C'est un rôle intégré, fonctionnellement agnostique, c'est-à-dire qu'il ne s'inscrit pas dans les concepts traditionnels des affaires commerciales/ventes ou médicales.
• ●Elle n'a ni objectifs de rentabilité, ni incitations à la vente
• ●Elle agit en tant que partenaire de confiance et principal point de contact pour les parties prenantes définies (médecins, infirmières, pathologistes, etc.)
• ●Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec les PJP et HSP au sein de l'écosystème pour créer de la valeur pour les clients et collabore avec PJP de DA similaires dans les pods DA à Levant et le réseau

Ce que ce rôle n'est pas :
• ●Elle ne s'engage pas dans la vente
• ●Il ne se limite pas à l'engagement scientifique.
• ● Il ne sert pas de point de contact exclusif pour les parties prenantes définies.

Vos défis
• ● En partenariat avec les intervenants du voyage des patients pour supprimer les barrages routiers et débloquer la valeur.
• ● Le fait de conserver les produits Roches tout au long de leur cycle de vie et de soutenir leur utilisation appropriée, ce qui comprend le partage de leurs mérites avec les HCP d'une manière honnête et équilibrée.
• ● Partager les besoins des patients et des intervenants à l'interne, puiser dans l'expertise et les ressources locales et du réseau, et conduire des solutions qui produisent des résultats plus rapidement.
• ●Assurer une grande expérience client chaque fois que les intervenants de l'écosystème s'engagent avec Roche.

Qui vous êtes
• ● Vous montrez un excellent état d'esprit d'entreprise avec une concentration exceptionnelle des clients
• ● Vous possédez l'état d'esprit de croissance, capable d'apprendre rapidement, de prendre des risques et d'expérimenter
• ● Vous avez une compréhension profonde du(des) parcours(s) patient(s) et des produits Roche associés
• ● Vous avez une solide compréhension des stratégies et des tactiques des affaires médicales et du sens des affaires
• ● Vous apportez d'excellentes compétences d'engagement client
• ● Vous présentez une expérience de leadership interfonctionnelle

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As a Regional Center Partner , you will be at the heart of our Pharmacovigilance (PV) operations, ensuring that safety information is collected, reported, and handled with the highest level of integrity. You will join a mission-driven team dedicated to delivering compliant, high-quality outcomes that directly impact patients' lives worldwide.
In this role, you will act as a guardian of our PV system, driving continuous improvement and simplification of processes. You will collaborate with a diverse network of global experts and external vendors, navigating a complex matrix environment to maintain an inspection-ready state. This is an opportunity to apply your "systems thinking" and entrepreneurial mindset to a function that is critical to Roche’s success and reputation.

• You will ensure the end-to-end collection and reporting of safety information in strict compliance with Roche and local regulatory requirements.

• You will maintain robust oversight of safety risk management activities, including those executed by our external partners and vendors.

• You will lead the preparation of safety-related documents, serving as Lead Author for Local Aggregate Reports (LAR) and Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Reports (PBRER).

• You will drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and effectiveness within the Patient Safety Operations.

• You will identify and escalate potential risks or deviations, ensuring appropriate follow-up actions are taken to maintain compliance.

• You will collaborate closely with Country Champions and Affiliate Patient Safety teams to ensure seamless execution of safety activities.

Who you are

You are a detail-oriented professional with a strong quality mindset and the ability to navigate complex regulatory landscapes with sound judgement. You thrive in collaborative environments and are passionate about continuous learning and process optimization. We offer a positive work environment where your contributions to patient safety are valued, and you are empowered to grow your expertise in a global pharmaceutical leader.

• You hold a Health Care Professional degree (e.g., Medicine, Pharmacy) or a Life Science degree (e.g., Biology, Neuroscience).

• Fresh graduates looking to kickstart their career in Drug Safety or Pharmacovigilance are welcome. Relevant internship experience or personal project work is a strong plus. .

• Strong eagerness to learn end-to-end PV processes and Quality Management Systems (QMS) and to understand global Pharmacovigilance and Medical Device regulatory requirements.

• You are interested in independently evaluate, analyse, and interpret complex data to draw meaningful conclusions.

• You are a proactive problem-solver with excellent communication skills in fluent English.

Location: This position is based in Budapest.

Relocation Assistance is not available

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
L'opportunità

Come Partner del Centro Regionale, sarete al centro delle nostre operazioni di Pharmacovigilance (PV), assicurando che le informazioni di sicurezza siano raccolte, riportate e gestite con il più alto livello di integrità. Ti unirai a un team guidato dalla missione dedicato a fornire risultati conformi e di alta qualità che influiscono direttamente sulla vita dei pazienti in tutto il mondo.
In questo ruolo, si agirà come custode del nostro sistema fotovoltaico, guidando il miglioramento continuo e la semplificazione dei processi. Collaborerai con una vasta rete di esperti globali e fornitori esterni, navigando in un ambiente di matrice complesso per mantenere uno stato pronto all'ispezione. Questa è un'opportunità per applicare il vostro "pensiero di sistemi" e mentalità imprenditoriale a una funzione che è fondamentale per il successo e la reputazione di Roche.

• Garantirai la raccolta end-to-end e la segnalazione di informazioni sulla sicurezza in stretta conformità con Roche e requisiti normativi locali.

• Si manterrà robusta supervisione delle attività di gestione dei rischi di sicurezza, compresi quelli eseguiti dai nostri partner esterni e fornitori.

• Condurrà la preparazione di documenti relativi alla sicurezza, servendo come Lead Author for Local Aggregate Reports (LAR) e Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Reports (PBRER).

• Produrrai iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare l'efficienza e l'efficacia all'interno delle operazioni di sicurezza del paziente.

• Identificherai ed escalerai potenziali rischi o deviazioni, assicurando che vengano prese opportune azioni di follow-up per mantenere la conformità.

• Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i team di Country Champions e Affiliazione per garantire l'esecuzione senza interruzioni delle attività di sicurezza.

Chi sei

Sei un professionista orientato al dettaglio con una mentalità di qualità forte e la capacità di navigare paesaggi normativi complessi con giudizio sonoro. Si prospera in ambienti collaborativi e si appassiona all'apprendimento continuo e all'ottimizzazione dei processi. Offriamo un ambiente di lavoro positivo in cui i vostri contributi alla sicurezza dei pazienti sono valutati, e siete autorizzati a crescere la vostra esperienza in un leader farmaceutico globale.

• Hai una laurea in Scienze della Salute (ad esempio, Medicina, Farmacia) o una laurea in Scienze della Vita (ad esempio, Biologia, Neuroscienze).

• I laureati freschi che cercano di iniziare la loro carriera in sicurezza della droga o farmacia sono i benvenuti. Esperienza di tirocinio rilevante o lavoro di progetto personale è un vantaggio forte. .

• Forte desiderio di apprendere i processi fotovoltaici end-to-end e i sistemi di gestione della qualità (QMS) e di comprendere i requisiti globali di regolamentazione della farmacovigilanza e dei dispositivi medici.

• Siete interessati a valutare, analizzare e interpretare in modo indipendente i dati complessi per trarre conclusioni significative.

• Sei un problem-solver proattivo con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese fluente.

Posizione: Questa posizione si trova a Budapest.

Rilocalizzazione Assistenza non è disponibile

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è una pari opportunità E

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Die Chance

Als Regional Center Partner stehen Sie im Mittelpunkt unserer Pharmakovigilanz (PV) und stellen sicher, dass Sicherheitsinformationen mit dem höchsten Maß an Integrität gesammelt, gemeldet und behandelt werden. Sie werden sich einem Missionsteam anschließen, das sich der Bereitstellung von konformen, qualitativ hochwertigen Ergebnissen widmet, die sich direkt auf das Leben der Patienten weltweit auswirken.
In dieser Rolle treten Sie als Hüter unserer PV-Anlage auf und treiben die kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Vereinfachung von Prozessen voran. Sie arbeiten mit einem vielfältigen Netzwerk globaler Experten und externer Anbieter zusammen und navigieren in einer komplexen Matrixumgebung, um einen inspektionsbereiten Zustand zu erhalten. Dies ist eine Gelegenheit, Ihr "Systemdenken" und Ihre unternehmerische Denkweise auf eine Funktion anzuwenden, die für den Erfolg und den Ruf von Roche entscheidend ist.

• Sie gewährleisten die durchgängige Erfassung und Berichterstattung von Sicherheitsinformationen unter strikter Einhaltung von Roche und lokalen regulatorischen Anforderungen.

• Sie werden die Sicherheitsrisikomanagement-Aktivitäten, einschließlich derjenigen, die von unseren externen Partnern und Lieferanten ausgeführt werden, streng überwachen.

• Sie werden die Erstellung von sicherheitsrelevanten Dokumenten leiten und als Lead Author für Local Aggregate Reports (LAR) und Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Reports (PBRER) fungieren.

• Sie werden kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen vorantreiben, um die Effizienz und Effektivität innerhalb der Patient Safety Operations zu verbessern.

• Sie werden potenzielle Risiken oder Abweichungen identifizieren und eskalieren, um sicherzustellen, dass geeignete Folgemaßnahmen ergriffen werden, um die Compliance zu gewährleisten.

• Sie werden eng mit Country Champions und Affiliate Patient Safety Teams zusammenarbeiten, um eine nahtlose Durchführung von Sicherheitsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.

Wer du bist

Sie sind ein detailorientierter Fachmann mit einer starken Qualitätseinstellung und der Fähigkeit, komplexe regulatorische Landschaften mit fundiertem Urteilsvermögen zu navigieren. Sie gedeihen in kollaborativen Umgebungen und sind begeistert von kontinuierlichem Lernen und Prozessoptimierung. Wir bieten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Ihre Beiträge zur Patientensicherheit geschätzt werden und Sie in der Lage sind, Ihr Fachwissen in einem globalen Pharmaunternehmen auszubauen.

• Sie haben einen Health Care Professional-Abschluss (z. B. Medizin, Pharmazie) oder einen Life Science-Abschluss (z. B. Biologie, Neurowissenschaften).

• Frische Absolventen, die ihre Karriere in der Arzneimittelsicherheit oder Pharmakovigilanz ankurbeln möchten, sind willkommen. Relevante Praktikumserfahrung oder persönliche Projektarbeit ist ein starkes Plus.

• Starker Eifer, durchgängige PV-Prozesse und Qualitätsmanagementsysteme (QMS) zu erlernen und die globalen regulatorischen Anforderungen an Pharmakovigilanz und Medizinprodukte zu verstehen.

• Sie sind daran interessiert, komplexe Daten unabhängig zu bewerten, zu analysieren und zu interpretieren, um aussagekräftige Schlussfolgerungen zu ziehen.

• Sie sind ein proaktiver Problemlöser mit hervorragenden Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in fließendem Englisch.

Standort: Diese Position hat ihren Sitz in Budapest.

Relocation Assistance ist nicht verfügbar

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader.
● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker.
● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies.
● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.
● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators.
● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area.

Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
(Major functions of the position)
1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related biomarker
● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy.
● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs.
● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events; Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs, preferences and views of new data.
● Provide scientific support for cross functional partners in medical training, scientific query handling, speaker material preparation.
● Lead the local innovative business model developing, implementation and further optimization, such as the establishment of regional pathology referral center with synergy from Roche diagnostic company and other external diagnostic related company or medical society.
● Contribute to the execution of advisory boards.
2) Data Generation
● Translate insights on local stakeholder needs and value decision drivers into an effective medical strategy, prioritize gaps and hurdles related to the local patient journey.
● Ensure excellence in access evidence planning and generation as part of the medical strategy, incorporating RWE, clinical studies and data inputs for local economic models etc.
● Receive IISs request, work with country medical manager to review of IISs within the company, and following-up with investigators, in accordance to all local laws and regulations.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Position
In Roche's Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED) , we create transformative medicines for patients to address some of the world's most challenging unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines.

Together, we foster a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, empowering our talented people to deliver life changing innovation with excellence and speed.

The position is located in Biological Core Technologies, a department within the Discovery of the pREDs Large Molecules Research , where the design, supply and development of next generation biologics is the primary focus. We closely collaborate with our therapeutic areas and functions to convert therapeutic hypotheses into innovative therapeutics.

Job Mission
We are seeking a strategic leader and ADC subject matter expert to drive the next evolution of our protein therapeutics pipeline. In this pivotal role, you will take full ownership of our bioconjugation and antibody discovery programs, directing a high-caliber team of specialists through the intricacies of early-stage drug development. You won't just oversee strategies; you will architect the bioconjugation frameworks and protein engineering breakthroughs that define our future therapeutic portfolio through high-impact internal and external collaborations.

Your Impact

• Strategic Leadership: Lead and scale a high-performing team of 6–9 specialists in molecular biology and protein chemistry. You will be responsible for their technical growth, resource allocation, and the delivery of critical project milestones.

• ADC & Bioconjugation Mastery: Serve as the primary architect for our ADC development strategies. You will oversee both high-throughput automated and bespoke manual conjugation workflows, ensuring the successful translation of early discovery concepts into robust therapeutic candidates.

• Portfolio Acceleration: Drive innovation in antibody discovery and next-generation engineered proteins. You will bridge the gap between initial protein design and clinical viability, leveraging your deep understanding of drug-to-antibody ratios (DAR), linker-payload chemistry, and analytical characterization.

• Global Influence: Act as a key technical representative in global partnerships, negotiating and managing complex collaborations to expand our technological capabilities.

Your Profile

• Proven Leadership: Extensive experience (5+ years) in direct people management, with a track record of leading multidisciplinary teams through the high-pressure environment of drug discovery.

• ADC Expert: A deep technical pedigree (5+ years) in Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs), including hands-on mastery of site-specific bioconjugation, linker-payload technologies, and advanced protein engineering.

• Drug Discovery Expert: Multiple years of experience in the early stages of drug discovery, moving candidates from concept through lead optimization. You understand the nuances of biophysical characterization and the "fail fast" mentality required in early-stage research.

• Automation & Systems Visionary: Demonstrated experience integrating liquid-handling automation and sophisticated IT architectures into the lab to maximize throughput and data integrity.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

La posizione
In Roche's Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED) , creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più difficili esigenze sanitarie non meritevoli del mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci.

Insieme, promuoviamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, consentendo ai nostri talenti di offrire la vita cambiando innovazione con eccellenza e velocità.

La posizione si trova in Biological Core Technologies, un dipartimento all'interno della Discovery of the pREDs Large Molecules Research , dove il design, la fornitura e lo sviluppo di biologici di nuova generazione è l'obiettivo primario. Collaboriamo a stretto contatto con le nostre aree terapeutiche e le nostre funzioni per convertire le ipotesi terapeutiche in terapeutiche innovative.

Missione lavorativa
Stiamo cercando un leader strategico e un esperto di materia ADC per guidare la prossima evoluzione della nostra pipeline terapeutica proteica. In questo ruolo fondamentale, si prende la piena proprietà dei nostri programmi di bioconjugation e anticorpo scoperta, dirigendo un team di specialisti di alto calibro attraverso le complessità dello sviluppo di droga di primo stadio. Non sovrintenderai solo alle strategie; sarai architetto dei quadri di bioconiugazione e delle scoperte di ingegneria proteica che definiscono il nostro futuro portafoglio terapeutico attraverso collaborazioni interne ed esterne ad alto impatto.

Il tuo impatto

• Leadership strategica: portare e scalare un team di 6–9 specialisti in biologia molecolare e chimica delle proteine. Sarete responsabili per la loro crescita tecnica, allocazione delle risorse, e la consegna delle pietre miliari di progetto critiche.

• ADC & Bioconjugation Mastery: servire come architetto primario per le nostre strategie di sviluppo ADC. Potrai supervisionare sia i flussi di lavoro di coniugazione manuali ad alto rendimento automatizzati e su misura, garantendo la traduzione di concetti di scoperta precoce in candidati terapeutici robusti.

• Accelerazione del portafoglio: Guidare l'innovazione nella scoperta di anticorpo e proteine ingegnerizzate di nuova generazione. Potrai colmare il divario tra la progettazione iniziale della proteina e la fattibilità clinica, sfruttando la tua profonda comprensione dei rapporti farmaco-anticorpo (DAR), la chimica del linker-payload e la caratterizzazione analitica.

• Influenza globale: agire come un rappresentante tecnico chiave nelle partnership globali, negoziare e gestire collaborazioni complesse per espandere le nostre capacità tecnologiche.

Il tuo profilo

• Leadership provata: Esperienza estesa (5+ anni) nella gestione diretta delle persone, con un track record di squadre multidisciplinari leader attraverso l'ambiente ad alta pressione della scoperta della droga.

• ADC Expert: Un pedigree tecnico profondo (5+ anni) in Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs), tra cui la padronanza hands-on della bioconjugation site-specific, le tecnologie di collegamento-payload e l'ingegneria proteica avanzata.

• Drug Discovery Expert: pluriennale esperienza nelle prime fasi della scoperta della droga, spostando i candidati dal concetto attraverso l'ottimizzazione del piombo. Capite le sfumature della caratterizzazione biofisica e la mentalità "veloce" richiesta nella ricerca del primo stadio.

• Automation & Systems Visionary: Esperienza dimostrata che integra l'automazione a gestione liquida e sofisticate architetture IT nel laboratorio per massimizzare l'integrità dei dati e del throughput.

• Communicator & Influencer: Un leader ricco di risorse che può tradurre dati biochimici complessi in strategie di business attuabili e costruire una cultura di alta fiducia, alta responsabilità collaborazione

Die Position
In Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED) entwickeln wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten, um einige der weltweit anspruchsvollsten unerfüllten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu erfüllen. Die Position befindet sich in Biological Core Technologies, einer Abteilung innerhalb der Discovery of the pREDs Large Molecules Research, wo die Gestaltung, Lieferung und Entwicklung von Biologika der nächsten Generation im Vordergrund steht. Wir arbeiten eng mit unseren therapeutischen Bereichen und Funktionen zusammen, um therapeutische Hypothesen in innovative Therapeutika umzuwandeln.
