Avec les possibilités et les défis auxquels les soins de santé sont actuellement confrontés, de solides collaborations sont plus cruciales que jamais. L'organisation Diagnostics Strategy & Partnering stimule les partenariats Roche Diagnostics, y compris la R-D, la technologie, le biomarqueur, les transactions numériques et commerciales de tous types, à l'échelle mondiale.

Actuellement, le groupe de partenariat Diagnostics à Bâle / Rotkreuz dispose d'une stratégie de partenariat Diagnostics mondiaux & Transactions Position de leader disponible sur l'équipe Stratégie de partenariat Diagnostics et Transactions. Ce poste permet de créer et de diriger des équipes d'affaires et de diligence afin d'évaluer les possibilités, et mène la négociation d'ententes pour accéder à des candidats prometteurs en partenariat dans nos différents secteurs d'activité et clients.

L'opportunité

Want - Définir une stratégie de croissance externe :

• Exécuter et fournir une expertise et un leadership de pensée dans le cadre des équipes d'équipes pour générer proactivement des opportunités stratégiques (zones/segments) qui contribuent à la stratégie de diagnostic Roche

• Co-créer avec les intervenants internes des partenariats stratégiques WANT et des profils de produits cibles (PPT) conformément à la stratégie de Roche Diagnostics.

Trouver - Identifier et prioriser les options de partenariat externe :

• Générez et sécurisez un flux continu d'options de partenariat attrayantes en maintenant un solide réseau interne (entreprises et clients, équipes de cycle de vie, R-D, réseaux, régions et filiales, et fonctions globales et collectives) et externe (entreprises, banques, CR, établissements universitaires, etc.)

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Cybersecurity Software Engineer

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

This role is based within the Network Security Product area, a team dedicated to making Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. By bridging the gap between rigorous infrastructure security and high-speed delivery, you will work alongside Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to protect our networks globally. The rapidly evolving threat landscape and our shift toward a software-driven engineering discipline offer you a unique opportunity to build scalable automation and drive continuous technical learning.

The opportunity:

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Development Frameworks & Automation), your key responsibilities and priorities will include:

• Architecture & Design Baseline: Collaboratively building, designing, adapting, and standardizing internal security development frameworks and engineering practices, establishing consistent coding guidelines and architectural baselines across the product area.

• Structural Engineering & Guardrails: Contributing to structural engineering decisions by providing software design insights, defining secure control guardrails, and creating code abstraction layers to streamline the deployment of network controls.

• Product Lifecycle & Custom Automation: Driving code development to improve infrastructure services by writing robust scripts, modular automation blocks, and custom APIs to seamlessly scale connectivity safeguards.

• CI/CD Integration: Guiding technical implementations through all stages of the software engineering lifecycle—from defining structured automation frameworks to deploying tested, scalable security features using CI/CD.

• Operational Excellence & Code Quality: Standardizing core development workflows (such as version control frameworks, comprehensive testing, and peer review practices) to guarantee the reliability and code quality of live infrastructure configurations.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Working cross-functionally with internal stakeholders and platform teams to measure, monitor, and continuously improve the reliability, maintenance, and automated health checking of network infrastructure code.

• Continuous Improvement of Capabilities: Supporting the end-to-end delivery, design, and maintenance of technologies protecting Roche networks and the Internet (on-prem and cloud), including Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection, Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN), Network Access Control, and Deep Packet Inspect

A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Ingegnere di software di sicurezza informatica

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo.

A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici dell'ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi.

Questo ruolo si basa nell'area Network Security Product, un team dedicato a rendere la connettività di Roche accessibile e sicura attraverso piattaforme di sicurezza all'avanguardia e orchestrazione automatizzata. Attraverso il distacco tra la sicurezza delle infrastrutture rigorose e la consegna ad alta velocità, lavorerai insieme ai team Cloud, Infrastructure e Incident Response per proteggere le nostre reti a livello globale. Il panorama delle minacce in rapida evoluzione e il nostro spostamento verso una disciplina di ingegneria basata sul software offrono un'opportunità unica per costruire l'automazione scalabile e guidare l'apprendimento tecnico continuo.

L'opportunità:

In qualità di Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Development Frameworks & Automation), le tue responsabilità e priorità chiave includono:

• Architettura & Design Baseline: Costruire, progettare, adattare e standardizzare i quadri di sviluppo della sicurezza interna e le pratiche ingegneristiche, stabilendo linee guida di codifica coerenti e basi architettoniche in tutta l'area del prodotto.

• Ingegneria strutturale & Guardrails: Contribuire alle decisioni di ingegneria strutturale fornendo insights di progettazione del software, definendo guardrails di controllo sicuro e creando strati di astrazione del codice per semplificare la distribuzione dei controlli di rete.

• Lifecycle & Custom Automation: Sviluppo del codice di guida per migliorare i servizi infrastrutturali scrivendo script robusti, blocchi di automazione modulari e API personalizzate per garantire la connettività senza soluzione di continuità.

• Integrazione CI/CD: Guidare le implementazioni tecniche attraverso tutte le fasi del ciclo di vita dell'ingegneria software, dalla definizione di framework di automazione strutturati per implementare funzionalità di sicurezza testate e scalabili utilizzando CI/CD.

• Eccellenza operativa e qualità del codice: standardizzazione dei flussi di lavoro di sviluppo del core (come i quadri di controllo della versione, test completi e pratiche di revisione peer) per garantire l'affidabilità e la qualità del codice delle configurazioni delle infrastrutture dal vivo.

• Collaborazione interattiva: Lavorare in modo trasversale con gli stakeholder interni e i team di piattaforme per misurare, monitorare e migliorare continuamente l'affidabilità, la manutenzione e il controllo sanitario automatizzato del codice infrastruttura di rete.

• Miglioramento continuo delle capacità: Sostenere la consegna end-to-end, la progettazione e la manutenzione di tecnologie che proteggono le reti Roche e Internet (on-prem e cloud), tra cui Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection, Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN), Network Access Control e Deep Packet Inspect

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Die Position

Cybersecurity Software Engineer

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation ihren Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch innovative digitale Technologien zu unterstützen und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der Digital eine Kernstärke von Roche ist, intelligentere Arbeitsweisen ermöglicht, menschliches Potenzial freisetzt und Durchbrüche vorantreibt, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt von Bedeutung sind.

Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Im Moment verlangen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathäuser, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen.

Diese Rolle ist im Bereich Network Security Product angesiedelt, einem Team, das sich dafür einsetzt, die Konnektivität von Roche durch hochmoderne Sicherheitsplattformen und automatisierte Orchestrierung zugänglich und sicher zu machen. Indem Sie die Lücke zwischen strenger Infrastruktursicherheit und Hochgeschwindigkeitsbereitstellung schließen, arbeiten Sie mit Cloud-, Infrastruktur- und Incident Response-Teams zusammen, um unsere Netzwerke weltweit zu schützen. Die sich schnell entwickelnde Bedrohungslandschaft und unsere Hinwendung zu einer softwaregesteuerten Ingenieurdisziplin bieten Ihnen die einzigartige Möglichkeit, eine skalierbare Automatisierung aufzubauen und kontinuierliches technisches Lernen voranzutreiben.

Die Gelegenheit:

Als Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Development Frameworks & Automation) umfassen Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben und Prioritäten:

• Architektur & Design Baseline: Gemeinsamer Aufbau, Entwurf, Anpassung und Standardisierung interner Sicherheitsentwicklungs-Frameworks und Engineering-Praktiken, Festlegung einheitlicher Kodierungsrichtlinien und architektonischer Basislinien im gesamten Produktbereich.

• Structural Engineering & Guardrails: Beitrag zu strukturellen Engineering-Entscheidungen durch die Bereitstellung von Software-Design-Einblicken, die Definition sicherer Kontroll-Guardrails und die Erstellung von Code-Abstraktionsschichten zur Optimierung der Bereitstellung von Netzwerksteuerungen.

• Product Lifecycle & Custom Automation: Förderung der Codeentwicklung zur Verbesserung der Infrastrukturdienste durch das Schreiben robuster Skripte, modularer Automatisierungsblöcke und benutzerdefinierter APIs zur nahtlosen Skalierung von Konnektivitätssicherungen.

• CI/CD-Integration: Führen technischer Implementierungen durch alle Phasen des Software-Engineering-Lebenszyklus – von der Definition strukturierter Automatisierungs-Frameworks bis hin zur Bereitstellung getesteter, skalierbarer Sicherheitsfunktionen mit CI/CD.

• Operational Excellence & Code Quality: Standardisierung von Kernentwicklungsworkflows (wie Versionskontroll-Frameworks, umfassende Tests und Peer-Review-Praktiken), um die Zuverlässigkeit und Codequalität von Live-Infrastrukturkonfigurationen zu gewährleisten.

• Funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Arbeitet funktionsübergreifend mit internen Stakeholdern und Plattformteams zusammen, um die Zuverlässigkeit, Wartung und automatisierte Zustandsprüfung von Netzwerkinfrastrukturcode zu messen, zu überwachen und kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Funktionen: Unterstützung der End-to-End-Bereitstellung, des Designs und der Wartung von Technologien zum Schutz von Roche-Netzwerken und des Internets (vor Ort und in der Cloud), einschließlich Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection, Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN), Network Access Control und Deep Packet Inspect

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Ingénieur logiciel de cybersécurité

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force centrale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde entier.

Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins opérationnels, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements de collaboration.

Ce rôle s'inscrit dans le domaine du produit de sécurité réseau, une équipe dédiée à rendre la connectivité Roches accessible et sécurisée grâce à des plateformes de sécurité de pointe et à l'orchestration automatisée. En comblant l'écart entre la sécurité rigoureuse de l'infrastructure et la livraison à grande vitesse, vous travaillerez aux côtés des équipes Cloud, Infrastructure et Incident Response pour protéger nos réseaux à l'échelle mondiale. Le paysage des menaces en évolution rapide et notre transition vers une discipline d'ingénierie axée sur les logiciels vous offrent une occasion unique de construire une automatisation évolutive et de conduire un apprentissage technique continu.

L'occasion :

En tant qu'ingénieur principal en cybersécurité (cadres de développement et automatisation), vos principales responsabilités et priorités comprendront :

• Architecture et conception de base : Élaborer, concevoir, adapter et normaliser en collaboration des cadres de développement de la sécurité interne et des pratiques d'ingénierie, en établissant des lignes directrices cohérentes en matière de codage et des bases architecturales dans l'ensemble du secteur de produits.

• Ingénierie structurale et garde-corps : contribuer aux décisions d'ingénierie structurale en fournissant des idées de conception logicielle, en définissant des garde-corps sécurisés et en créant des couches d'abstraction de code pour rationaliser le déploiement des commandes réseau.

• Cycle de vie du produit et automatisation sur mesure : Conduire le développement de code pour améliorer les services d'infrastructure en écrivant des scripts robustes, des blocs d'automatisation modulaires et des API personnalisées afin d'améliorer les garanties de connectivité.

• Intégration de l'IC/CD: Orientation des implémentations techniques à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie de l'ingénierie logicielle, de la définition de cadres d'automatisation structurés au déploiement de fonctionnalités de sécurité testées et évolutives à l'aide de l'IC/CD.

• Excellence opérationnelle et qualité du code : Normalisation des flux de travail de développement de base (tels que les cadres de contrôle des versions, les tests complets et les pratiques d'examen par les pairs) pour garantir la fiabilité et la qualité du code des configurations d'infrastructure en direct.

• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Travailler de façon interfonctionnelle avec les intervenants internes et les équipes de plate-forme pour mesurer, surveiller et améliorer continuellement la fiabilité, la maintenance et le contrôle automatisé de la santé du code d'infrastructure du réseau.

• Amélioration continue des capacités : Soutenir la prestation, la conception et la maintenance de bout en bout de technologies protégeant les réseaux Roche et l'Internet (sur site et en nuage), y compris Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection, Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN), Network Access Control et Deep Packet Inspect

Strengthening diagnosis improves chances of survival for the millions of people living with cancer, which means precise, personalised diagnostics are critical as we continue the fight against this deadly disease.
As an innovator of tissue-based diagnostic solutions for patients worldwide, we provide the anatomic pathology lab with a powerful combination of instrumentation, medical value assays and digitally integrated workflow.

We work directly with our healthcare partners in hospital and private pathology departments. Our strong product portfolio, excellent team and a deep understanding of our customer’s needs has meant we have been very successful. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.

Purpose
Every year across the globe, more than 14 million people develop cancer, a number that is expected to grow to more than 21 million by the year 2030. Strengthening diagnosis improves chances of survival for the millions of people living with cancer, which means precise, personalised diagnostics are critical as we continue the fight against this deadly disease.
As an innovator of tissue-based diagnostic solutions for patients worldwide, we provide the anatomic pathology lab with a powerful combination of instrumentation, medical value assays and digitally integrated workflow.

We work directly with our healthcare partners in hospital and private pathology departments. Our strong product portfolio, excellent team and a deep understanding of our customer’s needs has meant we have been very successful. We have a strong product portfolio and an excellent pipeline of future products and the determination to continue to be successful. Reporting to the Regional Sales Manager, you will be coming into the sales team at an opportune time to play your part in reshaping the healthcare landscape.

The Opportunity
Locations – South West NHS Networks
We have an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated individual to join our Tissue Diagnostics sales team in the South West UK region, covering the Devon, Somerset, Bristol, Dorset, Hampshire, and Wiltshire - NHS Networks (S1, S2, S3 & S6) . You will be promoting the value proposition of our products with key clinical, procurement and finance stakeholders.
As part of your remit, you will mainly focus on:

• Taking a lead in the account sales strategy and execution for the product portfolio on your territory, you will work closely with Customer Account Managers, Product Specialists, Managed Laboratory Service Team and Workflow IT Specialists

• Managing and coordinating the Tissue Diagnostics response within complex pan pathology procurements, utilising self-discipline and a creative approach to ensure sales methodology is delivered on time and in full. This will involve engagement with all levels of the key decision making team, including senior management

• Identifying market development and changes in NHS landscape on your territory (payment, procurement, tendering, and NHS processes) to maximise opportunities/minimise threats

• Developing innovative strategies to retain existing Roche sites and acquire new sites
Qualifications and Experience

• Educated to BSc (Hons) /BA Degree or equivalent in a life science or with related experiences such as a biomedical scientist background

• Experience of field sales and/or knowledge of laboratories and the Roche Tissue Diagnostics product portfolio

• Skilled in defining customer needs and building strong and effective relationships. Ideally, have knowledge of best practices in Cellular pathology (especially IHC) and cancer pathways.

• Resilient, tenacious and both adaptable and flexible to work within a changing environment. You have the blend of discipline to follow best practice and creativity to re-define best practice. You will understand barriers to acceptance of new solutions and be able to drive positive sales outcomes.

• Self-motivated, focused and methodical, with the ability to work alone, y

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Solution Marketing Manager will be responsible for managing the product lifecycle and commercialization of the Clinical Chemistry and Immunology (CC&I) portfolio across Latvia. Primary goal will be to implement marketing strategies to meet sales and KPI targets for the "Core Lab" segment in Latvia while providing strategic marketing support and portfolio guidance to our authorized distributor in Estonia.

Salary ranges from 38 000 to 48 000 EUR gross/annual. Final salary depends on the level of experience, skills and qualifications of the candidate.

What will you do:

Strategic Core Lab Marketing

• Strategy & Planning: Develop and implement marketing plans for the CC&I portfolio (including Cardiac, Alzheimer, Bone, and Infectious Disease) to achieve revenue targets in Latvia, while aligning promotional priorities with the Estonian distributor.

• Market Assessment: Conduct regular assessments of the Latvian and Estonian markets to identify competitor activity, local healthcare reforms, and automation trends.

• Distributor Synergy: Act as the primary marketing point of contact for the Estonian distributor to ensure their tactical plans align with Roche’s global "Core Lab" strategy.

Product Lifecycle & Automation Management

• Platform Management: Lead the commercial lifecycle for SWA platforms and reagents (e.g., cobas® pro, cobas® pure), and laboratory automation solutions in Latvia.

• Assay Portfolio Growth : Drive adoption of high-medical-value assays in Latvia and support the Estonian distributor in expanding their assay menu to differentiate Roche from competitors.

• Inventory Coordination : Collaborate with logistics for Latvian demand and provide forecasting guidance to the Estonian partner to ensure reagent availability.

Execution & Promotional Excellence

• Content Localization : Ensure promotional materials are accurately adapted for the Latvian medical community. Educate distributor on localization of Estonian materials provided by the distributor to ensure "on-label" compliance.

• Events & Education: Plan local symposia in Latvia and provide content/speaker support for distributors in Estonia.

• Public Procurement: Provide technical expertise for public tenders in Latvia and support the Estonian distributor with complex instrument configurations for state tenders.

Leadership & Compliance

• VACC Leadership : Act as a Catalyst and Coach within the Latvian team and as a strategic advisor to the Estonian distributor.

• Compliance Standards: Ensure all activities, including distributor-led promotions, adhere to the Roche Group Code of Conduct and local Baltic regulations.

Who You Are:

• Education : You hold a University degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or Business/Marketing (Master’s is preferred).

• Experience : You have at least 5 years of experience in Marketing or Product Management within the healthcare or life science industry. Experience from laboratory, immunology and clinical chemistry is highly preferred. Understanding of the national health systems and regulations in Baltic countries is an advantage.

• Leadership : Demonstrated ability to manage senior stakeholders, lead cross-functional project teams. Strong sense of compliance.

• Project Management: Strong skills in managing complex projects across multiple countries and multiple product groups.

• Digital Proficiency: Understanding of digital health ecosystems.

• Languages: Fluent in English and Latvian.

• Technical: Proficient in G Suite, CRM sys

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Solution Marketing Manager sarà responsabile della gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto e della commercializzazione del portafoglio Clinical Chemistry and Immunology (CC&I) in Lettonia. L'obiettivo primario sarà quello di implementare strategie di marketing per soddisfare gli obiettivi di vendita e KPI per il segmento "Core Lab" in Lettonia, fornendo supporto strategico di marketing e guida di portafoglio al nostro distributore autorizzato in Estonia.

La retribuzione varia da 38 000 a 48 000 EUR lordi/anno. Lo stipendio finale dipende dal livello di esperienza, competenze e qualifiche del candidato.

Cosa farai:

Marketing del laboratorio strategico

• Strategia & Pianificazione: Sviluppare e implementare piani di marketing per il portafoglio CC&I (tra cui Cardiac, Alzheimer, Bone e Malattia Infettiva) per raggiungere obiettivi di reddito in Lettonia, allineando le priorità promozionali con il distributore estone.

• Valutazione del mercato: Condurre valutazioni regolari dei mercati lettoni ed estone per identificare le attività concorrenti, le riforme sanitarie locali e le tendenze di automazione.

• Distributore Synergy: Agite come punto di contatto principale per il distributore estone per garantire il loro piano tattico allineare con la strategia globale "Core Lab" di Roche.

Gestione del ciclo di vita e dell'automazione del prodotto

• Gestione della piattaforma: guidare il ciclo di vita commerciale per piattaforme e reagenti SWA (ad esempio, cobas® pro, cobas® pure), e soluzioni di automazione di laboratorio in Lettonia.

• Assay Portfolio Growth: Guidare l'adozione di saggi ad alto valore medico in Lettonia e sostenere il distributore estone nell'espansione del loro menu di analisi per differenziare Roche dai concorrenti.

• Coordinamento dell'inventario: collaborare con la logistica della domanda lettone e fornire indicazioni previsionali al partner estone per garantire la disponibilità dei reagenti.

Esecuzione & Eccellenza Promozionale

• Localizzazione dei contenuti: Assicurare che i materiali promozionali siano accuratamente adattati per la comunità medica lettone. Educare il distributore sulla localizzazione dei materiali estone forniti dal distributore per garantire la conformità "on-label".

• Eventi e Istruzione: Pianifica il simposio locale in Lettonia e fornisci supporto per i distributori in Estonia.

• Appalti pubblici: fornire competenze tecniche per le gare pubbliche in Lettonia e sostenere il distributore estone con complesse configurazioni di strumenti per le gare di stato.

Leadership & Compliance

• Leadership VACC: agire come Catalizzatore e Coach all'interno del team lettone e come consulente strategico per il distributore estone.

• Norme di conformità: Assicurare tutte le attività, incluse le promozioni distributrici, aderire al Codice di condotta del Gruppo Roche e alle normative locali del Baltico.

Chi sei?

• Istruzione: Lei ha una laurea in Scienze della Vita, Farmacia, o Business/Marketing (il Maestro è preferito).

• Esperienza: Hai almeno 5 anni di esperienza nel marketing o nella gestione dei prodotti all'interno del settore sanitario o della scienza della vita. L'esperienza di laboratorio, immunologia e chimica clinica è molto preferita. La comprensione dei sistemi e dei regolamenti sanitari nazionali nei paesi baltici è un vantaggio.

• Leadership: capacità dimostrata di gestire gli stakeholder senior, guidare team di progetto interfunzionali. Forte senso di conformità.

• Project Management: competenze forti nella gestione di progetti complessi in più paesi e gruppi di prodotti multipli.

• Proficienza digitale: comprensione degli ecosistemi della salute digitale.

• Lingue: fluente in inglese e lettone.

• Tecnica: Proficiente in G Suite, CRM sys

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Le gestionnaire du marketing des solutions sera responsable de la gestion du cycle de vie des produits et de la commercialisation du portefeuille de la chimie clinique et de l'immunologie (CC&I) dans toute la Lettonie. L'objectif principal sera de mettre en œuvre des stratégies de marketing pour atteindre les objectifs de vente et de KPI pour le segment "Core Lab" en Lettonie tout en fournissant un soutien marketing stratégique et des conseils de portefeuille à notre distributeur autorisé en Estonie.

Le salaire varie de 38 000 à 48 000 EUR brut/annuel. Le salaire final dépend du niveau d'expérience, des compétences et des qualifications du candidat.

Que ferez-vous :

Commercialisation stratégique des laboratoires de base

• Stratégie et planification : Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des plans de marketing pour le portefeuille des CC&I (y compris les maladies cardiaques, Alzheimer, osseuses et infectieuses) afin d'atteindre les objectifs de revenus en Lettonie, tout en alignant les priorités promotionnelles avec le distributeur estonien.

• Évaluation du marché: procéder à des évaluations régulières des marchés letton et estonien afin d'identifier l'activité des concurrents, les réformes des soins de santé locaux et les tendances en matière d'automatisation.

• Distributeur Synergy: Agir en tant que principal point de contact marketing pour le distributeur estonien afin de s'assurer que leurs plans tactiques s'alignent sur la stratégie mondiale de "Core Lab" de Roche.

Cycle de vie des produits et gestion de l'automatisation

• Gestion des plateformes : Diriger le cycle de vie commercial des plateformes et réactifs SWA (par exemple, cobas® pro, cobas® pur) et des solutions d'automatisation de laboratoire en Lettonie.

• Assay Portfolio Growth : Encourager l'adoption d'essais à haute valeur médicale en Lettonie et soutenir le distributeur estonien dans l'expansion de leur menu d'essais pour différencier Roche des concurrents.

• Coordination des inventaires : Collaborer avec la logistique pour répondre à la demande lettone et fournir des directives prévisionnelles au partenaire estonien pour assurer la disponibilité de réactifs.

Exécution et excellence promotionnelle

• Localisation du contenu : Veiller à ce que le matériel promotionnel soit adapté avec précision à la communauté médicale lettone. Éduquer le distributeur sur la localisation des matériaux estoniens fournis par le distributeur pour assurer la conformité « sur étiquette ».

• Événements & Éducation: Planifier des colloques locaux en Lettonie et fournir un soutien de contenu/parleur aux distributeurs en Estonie.

• Marchés publics: fournir une expertise technique pour les appels d'offres publics en Lettonie et soutenir le distributeur estonien avec des configurations d'instruments complexes pour les appels d'offres publics.

Leadership et conformité

• VACC Leadership : Agir en tant que catalyseur et entraîneur au sein de l'équipe lettone et en tant que conseiller stratégique du distributeur estonien.

• Normes de conformité : Veiller à ce que toutes les activités, y compris les promotions dirigées par les distributeurs, respectent le Code de conduite du Groupe Roche et les règlements locaux de la Baltique.

Qui vous êtes :

• Éducation : Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire en sciences de la vie, en pharmacie ou en affaires/marketing (le Master est préféré).

• Expérience : Vous avez au moins 5 ans d'expérience en marketing ou en gestion de produits dans l'industrie des soins de santé ou des sciences de la vie. L'expérience de laboratoire, d'immunologie et de chimie clinique est très privilégiée. La compréhension des systèmes et réglementations sanitaires nationaux dans les pays baltes est un avantage.

• Leadership : Capacité démontrée de gérer les principaux intervenants, diriger des équipes de projet interfonctionnelles. Un fort sentiment de conformité.

• Gestion de projets : Fortes compétences en gestion de projets complexes dans plusieurs pays et groupes de produits.

• Compétence numérique : Compréhension des écosystèmes numériques de santé.

• Langues: Anglais et letton.

• Technique: Compétence en G Suite, systèmes CRM

jobs.title: Software Test & Verification Engineer Staff
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity

As a Software Test & Verification Engineer Staff you will serve as a technical leader and servant leader responsible for software quality and test delivery across complex medical device systems. In this role, you will lead local and offshore software test teams, driving test planning, execution, and reporting within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment. You will champion test quality through sound system design, pilot cutting-edge AI-assisted testing tools, and ensure full compliance with medical device regulatory standards and traceability requirements.

In this role, you will:

• Collaboratively lead the definition of testing strategies, project milestones, and execution planning for software test activities across local and offshore teams.

• Guide and coach project teams in establishing and refining project scope and quality direction within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) development environment.

• Establish and pilot innovative AI-assisted tools and automated processes for test case generation, execution optimization, and defect analysis.

• Ensure all test strategies, test plans, and processes maintain strict compliance with medical device regulatory standards and regulatory traceability requirements.

• Author, review, and refine Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across software development and testing cycles to uphold quality standards.

• Assure software test quality through sound test design, testing depth, and systems-thinking principles, including Design of Experiment (DoE).

• Mentor new hires and coach team members on software testing best practices, test results evaluation, and high-impact technical presentations.

​
Who you are

• You have 10+ years of software test engineering and quality assurance experience with a strong track record of leading test teams on complex software assignments.

• You bring proven experience defining testing strategies and leading local or offshore test teams within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) or Agile software development process.

• You have hands-on experience in regulated software development environments, including direct exposure to medical device software regulatory standards and traceability requirements.

• You possess strong servant leadership and communication skills with a track record of mentoring team members and presenting technical concepts to cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.

• Experience piloting or implementing AI-assisted testing tools and processes for manual/automated test case generation, execution optimization, and defect triage.

• Knowledge of Design of Experiment (DoE) methodology and advanced systems-thinking principles applied to software quality assurance.

• Familiarity with authoring and revising Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) aligned with FDA, IEC 62304, and ISO 13485 standards.

• Relevant industry certifications, such as SAFe Agilist, CSTE, or ISTQB Advanced/Expert Level.

No relocation benefits are available for this posting
This position requires you to be in the office 3 days a week

The exp

Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

L'opportunità

In qualità di personale dell'Ingegnere di Test & Verification vi servirà come leader tecnico e responsabile della qualità del software e della consegna dei test attraverso sistemi di dispositivi medici complessi. In questo ruolo, guiderai team di test del software locale e offshore, pianificazione del test di guida, esecuzione e report all'interno di un ambiente Scalato Agile Framework (SAFe). Campionerai la qualità del test attraverso la progettazione del sistema sonoro, gli strumenti di prova all'avanguardia pilota AI-assistiti e garantirai la piena conformità con gli standard di regolazione del dispositivo medico e i requisiti di tracciabilità.

In questo ruolo, voi:

• Collaborativamente guidare la definizione di strategie di test, pietre miliari di progetto, e la pianificazione di esecuzione per le attività di test software in team locali e offshore.

• I team di progetto di guida e coach per la creazione e la raffinazione della portata del progetto e della direzione di qualità all'interno di un ambiente di sviluppo scala Agile Framework (SAFe).

• Stabilire e pilotare strumenti innovativi assistiti da AI e processi automatizzati per la generazione dei casi di prova, l'ottimizzazione dell'esecuzione e l'analisi dei difetti.

• Assicurarsi che tutte le strategie di test, piani di test e processi mantengano una stretta conformità con gli standard normativi del dispositivo medico e i requisiti di tracciabilità regolamentare.

• Autore, revisione e perfezionamento delle procedure operative standard (SOP) attraverso lo sviluppo del software e i cicli di test per rispettare gli standard di qualità.

• Assicurare la qualità del software di prova attraverso la progettazione di test del suono, la profondità di prova e i principi di pensiero dei sistemi, tra cui Design of Experiment (DoE).

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity

As a Software Test & Verification Engineer Staff you will serve as a technical leader and servant leader responsible for software quality and test delivery across complex medical device systems. In this role, you will lead local and offshore software test teams, driving test planning, execution, and reporting within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment. You will champion test quality through sound system design, pilot cutting-edge AI-assisted testing tools, and ensure full compliance with medical device regulatory standards and traceability requirements.

In this role, you will:

• Collaboratively lead the definition of testing strategies, project milestones, and execution planning for software test activities across local and offshore teams.

• Guide and coach project teams in establishing and refining project scope and quality direction within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) development environment.

• Establish and pilot innovative AI-assisted tools and automated processes for test case generation, execution optimization, and defect analysis.

• Ensure all test strategies, test plans, and processes maintain strict compliance with medical device regulatory standards and regulatory traceability requirements.

• Author, review, and refine Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across software development and testing cycles to uphold quality standards.

• Assure software test quality through sound test design, testing depth, and systems-thinking principles, including Design of Experiment (DoE).

• Mentor new hires and coach team members on software testing best practices, test results evaluation, and high-impact technical presentations.

​
Who you are

• You have 10+ years of software test engineering and quality assurance experience with a strong track record of leading test teams on complex software assignments.

• You bring proven experience defining testing strategies and leading local or offshore test teams within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) or Agile software development process.

• You have hands-on experience in regulated software development environments, including direct exposure to medical device software regulatory standards and traceability requirements.

• You possess strong servant leadership and communication skills with a track record of mentoring team members and presenting technical concepts to cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.

• Experience piloting or implementing AI-assisted testing tools and processes for manual/automated test case generation, execution optimization, and defect triage.

• Knowledge of Design of Experiment (DoE) methodology and advanced systems-thinking principles applied to software quality assurance.

• Familiarity with authoring and revising Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) aligned with FDA, IEC 62304, and ISO 13485 standards.

• Relevant industry certifications, such as SAFe Agilist, CSTE, or ISTQB Advanced/Expert Level.

No relocation benefits are available for this posting
This position requires you to be in the office 3 days a week

Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

L'opportunité

En tant qu'ingénieur en test et vérification de logiciels, vous serez un chef de file technique et un chef de service responsable de la qualité des logiciels et de la livraison des tests dans les systèmes complexes d'appareils médicaux. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des équipes de test logiciels locales et offshore, la planification des tests de conduite, l'exécution, et les rapports dans un environnement Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). Vous serez le champion de la qualité des tests grâce à la conception d'un système sonore, à des outils pilotes de pointe pour les tests assistés par l'IA, et vous assurerez la pleine conformité aux normes réglementaires des appareils médicaux et aux exigences de traçabilité.

Dans ce rôle, vous :

• Diriger en collaboration la définition des stratégies d'essai, des jalons du projet et de la planification de l'exécution des activités d'essai logiciel dans les équipes locales et extracôtières.

• Guider et coacher les équipes de projet pour établir et affiner la portée du projet et l'orientation de la qualité dans un environnement de développement à l'échelle du Cadre agile.

• Établir et piloter des outils innovants assistés par l'IA et des processus automatisés pour la génération de cas d'essai, l'optimisation de l'exécution et l'analyse des défauts.

• Veiller à ce que toutes les stratégies, plans et processus d'essai respectent strictement les normes réglementaires et les exigences réglementaires en matière de traçabilité des instruments médicaux.

• Auteur, révise et peaufine les procédures d'exploitation normalisées (PON) pour tous les cycles de développement et d'essai des logiciels afin de respecter les normes de qualité.

• Assure la qualité des tests logiciels par la conception de tests sonores, la profondeur des tests et les principes de conception des systèmes, y compris la conception de l'expérience (DoE).

• Les nouveaux embauches de mentor et les membres de l'équipe d'entraîneurs sur les pratiques exemplaires des tests logiciels, l'évaluation des résultats des tests et les présentations techniques à impact élevé.

​
Qui vous êtes

• Vous disposez de 10 ans et plus d'expérience en ingénierie et en assurance de la qualité grâce à une solide expérience d'équipes d'essais de pointe sur des tâches logicielles complexes.

• Vous apportez une expérience éprouvée définissant des stratégies de test et dirigeant des équipes de test locales ou offshore au sein d'un cadre agile à échelle (SAFe) ou d'un processus de développement logiciel agile.

• Vous avez une expérience pratique dans les environnements de développement de logiciels réglementés, y compris une exposition directe aux normes réglementaires des logiciels d'appareils médicaux et aux exigences de traçabilité.

• Vous possédez de solides compétences en leadership et en communication avec des membres de l'équipe de mentorat et vous présentez des concepts techniques aux intervenants interfonctionnels.

Qualifications préférées :

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en informatique, génie logiciel, génie biomédical ou d'une discipline quantitative connexe.

• Expérimenter la mise à l'essai ou la mise en oeuvre d'outils et de processus d'essai assistés par l'IA pour la production manuelle/automatisée de cas d'essai, l'optimisation de l'exécution et le triage des défauts.

• Connaissance de la méthodologie de conception d'expériences (DoE) et des principes avancés de conception des systèmes appliqués à l'assurance de la qualité des logiciels.

• Connaissance de la rédaction et de la révision des procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON) alignées sur les normes FDA, CEI 62304 et ISO 13485.

• Certifications pertinentes de l'industrie, comme SAFe Agilist, CSTE ou ISTQB Advanced/Expert Level.

Aucune indemnité de réinstallation n'est disponible pour cette affectation
Ce poste exige que vous soyez au bureau 3 jours par semaine

The Position
- for German version please see below -

At Global Regulatory Affairs our aspiration is to be the world's best Regulatory organization, championing patient access to the world's best diagnostics. Focus of our work is the global approval of in-vitro-diagnostics of the Elecsys Core reagent immunoassay product portfolio. Our dynamic team manages regulatory projects as well as overarching regulatory topics. Join an open-minded work environment where close collaboration with colleagues across various departments and countries is not just encouraged, but essential.

The Opportunity

• Shape Strategic Direction: You will steer the strategic direction and represent the Regulatory Affairs department in international, interdisciplinary teams to foster an effective and successful working environment.

• Manage Global Product Registrations: You will manage product registrations across Europe, the United States, and China, while supporting broader worldwide registration efforts.

• Act as a Key Interface: You will prepare and submit pre-market applications to the FDA or Notified Bodies, serving as the primary liaison to global health authorities.

• Drive Authority Interaction: You will actively interact with regulatory bodies to accelerate approvals or clearances for upcoming registrations and professionally address inquiries of all kinds.

• Ensure Portfolio Excellence: You will support product maintenance activities and continuously keep the technical documentation of our product portfolio up to date.

• Leverage International Synergies: To achieve efficient global approvals, you will collaborate closely with colleagues in Germany, Switzerland, and the US—both intra-departmentally and with global Regulatory Affairs teams,

Who You Are
You bring a sophisticated blend of scientific insights and regulatory acumen, coupled with a passion for collaborating across borders to overcome complex healthcare challenges.

• Education: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Data Science, or a related field.

• Professional Experience: A minimum of 5 years of experience within Regulatory, R&D, Quality, Operations, or Clinical environments.

• Expertise: Strong technical understanding of IVDs, combined with knowledge of international regulations governing IVD development, manufacturing, and registration (specifically EU, US, and China).

• Mindset & Skills: Proven track record in agile project management, exceptional self-organization, and the ability to effectively balance and prioritize multiple overlapping projects.

• Language Skills: Excellent command of English (written and spoken) for daily global collaboration; fluency in any additional language is an advantage.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Possibili Località: Penzberg, Indianapolis e Mannheim. A discrezione della Società, potrebbe essere fatta un'eccezione al requisito di localizzazione.

Chi siamo
A Roche, siamo appassionati di trasformare la vita dei pazienti e siamo senza paura sia nella decisione che nell’azione - crediamo che il buon business significhi un mondo migliore. Ecco perché andiamo al lavoro ogni giorno. Ci impegniamo al rigore scientifico, all'etica insopportabile e all'accesso alle innovazioni mediche per tutti. Lo facciamo oggi per costruire un domani migliore.
A Global Regulatory Affairs, ci sforziamo di essere la migliore organizzazione regolamentare del mondo, sostenendo l'accesso dei pazienti alla migliore diagnostica del mondo. Il focus del nostro lavoro nella Cardiologia Subchapter, Endocrinologia e Fertilità è l'approvazione globale di in-vitro-diagnostici del portafoglio prodotti Elecsys e Point of Care. Il nostro team è incaricato di progetti normativi e di supervisionare argomenti normativi. Puoi aspettarti un ambiente di lavoro aperto, dove lavorerai a stretto contatto con colleghi di altri dipartimenti e altre contee.

In questo ruolo, il vostro scopo principale e le attività saranno i seguenti:

• Fornire la direzione strategica e la rappresentazione degli Affari Regolatori in team internazionali e interdisciplinari per creare un ambiente di lavoro efficace e fruttuoso.

• Gestisci cardiologia, endocrinologia, salute delle donne o registrazione dei prodotti di assistenza critica in Europa, Stati Uniti e Cina e supporta le registrazioni in tutto il mondo

• Preparare e presentare le sottomissioni di premarket a FDA o corpo notificato che serve come interfaccia primaria alle autorità sanitarie. Interagire con il personale dell'agenzia di regolamentazione al fine di accelerare l'approvazione o la liquidazione della registrazione in sospeso e rispondere a qualsiasi domanda

• Essere responsabili per sostenere le attività di assistenza ai prodotti e aggiornare le documentazioni tecniche del portafoglio prodotti.

• Al fine di ottenere approvazioni efficienti in tutto il mondo, si lavora in stretta collaborazione con colleghi in Germania, Svizzera e Stati Uniti all'interno e attraverso i capitoli, nonché con le squadre di regolamentazione globale, soprattutto in Cina e Giappone.

Cosa si dovrebbe avere nella tua casella di strumenti:

Elevato grado di competenza della materia:

• Laurea / Master in Scienze della vita, Scienza dei dati o materie correlate

• minimo 5 anni di esperienza in Regolazione, R&D, Qualità, Operazioni o Clinica

• Comprensione tecnica di dispositivi medici o IVD

• Conoscenza delle leggi e dei regolamenti internazionali per lo sviluppo, la produzione e la registrazione di IVD soprattutto in UE, Stati Uniti e Cina

• Esperienza nel lavorare su progetti sovrapposti - vale a dire in gioco più progetti, multitasking e organizzarsi

• Competenze di gestione del progetto in un ambiente agile

• Ottima conoscenza dell'inglese. Conoscenza aggiuntiva di un'altra lingua è un vantaggio

Ulteriori competenze e la mentalità che porti al ruolo:

• Coraggio, visione e spinta ad essere all'avanguardia del cambiamento innovativo

• Forte track record di capacità di costruzione e di cura come la conoscenza di qualità e conformità, competenze normative, comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder

• Ti piace lavorare in un ambiente internazionale in strutture a matrice in un ambiente globale.

• Lei è flessibile e quindi in grado di spostare le priorità mentre bilancia gli impegni e i requisiti di lavoro quotidiani, indipendentemente

• Siete in grado di prendere decisioni per completare le attività programmate e non programmate ogni giorno e avviare le interazioni tra i dipartimenti come applicabile. Hai il coraggio di prendere decisioni

jobs.title: Principal /Senior Principal Scientist - Toxicology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Principal/Senior Principal Toxicologist to provide translational safety leadership for Genentech's growing China development portfolio.

The successful candidate will serve as the China Translational Safety scientific and regulatory lead, partnering closely with gRED Translational Safety colleagues and cross-functional teams to support drug discovery and development efforts and due diligence activities across all therapeutic areas.

This individual will provide strategic guidance for China-specific development, regulatory interactions, and safety assessment while ensuring alignment with global development strategies. The role requires deep expertise in toxicology, nonclinical safety and PK study design and execution, compliance with international guidelines, CRO study oversight and China's evolving regulatory landscape, combined with the ability to influence across functions, organizations, and geographic regions.

Scope of the position:
The Principal/Senior Principal Toxicologist will:

• Serve as the China subject matter expert (SME) for translational safety and China regulatory requirements supporting China development programs in collaboration with gRED Translational Safety colleagues.

• Partner closely with gRED project toxicologists to optimize safety strategies for China development, registration and lifecycle management.

• Build productive scientific relationships with China regulatory authorities (e.g., NMPA/CDE) and CRO partners.

• Provide onsite technical oversight of the toxicology studies conducted at Contract Research Organizations (CROs) in China and other countries in Asia.

• Will serve as the Translational Safety lead for Asia Partnering and participate in due diligence activities with potential China partners.

• Represent Translational Safety on China governance committees and cross-functional development teams as needed.

• Drive scientific excellence by incorporating innovative approaches, including Weight of Evidence (WoE) and New Approach Methodologies (NAMs), into nonclincial safety assessment.

Responsibilities:

• Leads the nonclinical safety assessment of Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED) therapeutics by creating a best-evidence synthesis of existing knowledge and comprehensive investigations of toxicologic activity, strategic planning, and designing/implementing/supervising toxicology studies in support of program advancement.

• Scientific leadership in the design and implementation of translational safety strategies to support program advancement and decision-making.

• Investigate mechanisms of toxicity.

• Proactive management of potential safety liabilities and communication of impact to teams and governance committees.

• Closely collaborate with pathologists, study operations professionals, pharmacokineticists, and pharmaceutics to create streamlined, innovative translation safety programs for Genentech drug candidates; and to author regulatory documents.

• Closely collaborate with predictive toxicologists to incorporate NAM approaches (e.g. in silico, in vitro models) into safety strategies.

• Work independently to leverage literature to develop and optimize best-evidence arguments in support of data interpretation or experimental approaches.

• Partner with the colleagues in China Innovation center of Roche (CiCOR) on nonclinical safety strategies, regulatory interactions, and CRO oversight

• Provide onsite technical oversight of the toxicology

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Posizione:

Stiamo cercando un tossicologo Principal/Senior Principal altamente motivato ed esperto per fornire una leadership di sicurezza traduttiva per il crescente portafoglio di sviluppo cinese di Genentech.

Il candidato di successo servirà come leader scientifico e normativo della sicurezza traduttiva della Cina, collaborando a stretto contatto con i colleghi della sicurezza traduttiva GRED e i team interfunzionali per sostenere gli sforzi di scoperta e sviluppo della droga e le attività di due diligence in tutte le aree terapeutiche.

Questo individuo fornirà una guida strategica per lo sviluppo specifico della Cina, le interazioni normative e la valutazione della sicurezza, garantendo al contempo l'allineamento con le strategie di sviluppo globali. Il ruolo richiede una profonda esperienza nella tossicologia, nella sicurezza nonclinica e nella progettazione e nell'esecuzione dello studio PK, nel rispetto delle linee guida internazionali, nella supervisione dello studio CRO e nell'evoluzione del paesaggio normativo della Cina, unitamente alla capacità di influenzare funzioni, organizzazioni e regioni geografiche.

Ambito della posizione:
Il Tossicologo Principale/Senior:

• Servire come esperto di materia cinese (SME) per la sicurezza traduttiva e i requisiti normativi della Cina che supportano i programmi di sviluppo della Cina in collaborazione con i gRED Translational Safety colleghi.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i tossicologi del progetto GRED per ottimizzare le strategie di sicurezza per lo sviluppo, la registrazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita della Cina.

• Costruire relazioni scientifiche produttive con le autorità di regolamentazione della Cina (ad esempio, NMPA/CDE) e i partner CRO.

• Fornire la supervisione tecnica in loco degli studi tossicologici condotti presso le Organizzazioni di Ricerca Contrattuali (CRO) in Cina e in altri paesi in Asia.

• Servirà come guida per la sicurezza traduttiva per l'Asia Partnering e parteciperà alle attività di due diligence con potenziali partner cinesi.

• Rappresentare la sicurezza traduttiva sui comitati di governo della Cina e i team di sviluppo interfunzionali come necessario.

• Guidare l'eccellenza scientifica incorporando approcci innovativi, tra cui il peso delle prove (WoE) e nuove metodologie di approccio (NAM), nella valutazione della sicurezza non clincial.

Responsabilità:

• Conduce la valutazione non clinical della sicurezza dei terapeutici Genentech Research e Early Development (gRED) creando una sintesi di best-evidence delle conoscenze esistenti e delle indagini complete di attività tossicologica, pianificazione strategica e progettazione/implementazione/supervisione di studi tossicologici a sostegno dell'avanzamento del programma.

• Leader scientifico nella progettazione e realizzazione di strategie di sicurezza traduttiva per sostenere l'avanzamento dei programmi e il processo decisionale.

• Indagare meccanismi di tossicità.

• Gestione attiva delle potenziali passività di sicurezza e comunicazione di impatto a team e comitati di governance.

• Collaborare con patologi, professionisti delle operazioni di studio, farmacisti, e farmacisti per creare programmi di sicurezza traduttivi snella e innovativa per i candidati alla droga Genentech; e per autorizzare documenti normativi.

• Collaborare con i tossicologi predittivi per incorporare approcci NAM (ad esempio in silico, modelli in vitro) in strategie di sicurezza.

• Lavorare in modo indipendente per sfruttare la letteratura per sviluppare e ottimizzare gli argomenti di best-evidence a sostegno dell'interpretazione dei dati o degli approcci sperimentali.

• Partner con i colleghi in Cina Centro Innovazione di Roche (CiCOR) su strategie di sicurezza non cliniche, interazioni normative e supervisione CRO

• Fornire la supervisione tecnica in loco della tossicologia

Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Position:

Wir suchen einen hoch motivierten und erfahrenen Principal/Senior Principal Toxicologist, um die translationale Sicherheitsführerschaft für Genentechs wachsendes China-Entwicklungsportfolio zu übernehmen.

Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird als wissenschaftlicher und regulatorischer Leiter von China Translational Safety fungieren und eng mit Kollegen von gRED Translational Safety und funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenarbeiten, um die Wirkstoffforschung und -entwicklung sowie die Due-Diligence-Aktivitäten in allen therapeutischen Bereichen zu unterstützen.

Diese Person wird strategische Leitlinien für China-spezifische Entwicklung, regulatorische Interaktionen und Sicherheitsbewertung bereitstellen und gleichzeitig die Ausrichtung auf globale Entwicklungsstrategien sicherstellen. Die Rolle erfordert fundiertes Fachwissen in Toxikologie, nichtklinischer Sicherheit und PK-Studiendesign und -durchführung, Einhaltung internationaler Richtlinien, CRO-Studienaufsicht und Chinas sich entwickelnder Regulierungslandschaft, kombiniert mit der Fähigkeit, Funktionen, Organisationen und geografische Regionen zu beeinflussen.

Umfang der Position:
Der Principal / Senior Principal Toxicologist wird:

• Dienen Sie als China Subject Matter Expert (KMU) für translationale Sicherheit und chinesische regulatorische Anforderungen und unterstützen Sie China-Entwicklungsprogramme in Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen von gRED Translational Safety.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Toxikologen des gRED-Projekts zur Optimierung von Sicherheitsstrategien für Chinas Entwicklung, Registrierung und Lebenszyklusmanagement.

• Aufbau produktiver wissenschaftlicher Beziehungen zu chinesischen Regulierungsbehörden (z. B. NMPA/CDE) und CRO-Partnern.

• Bereitstellung einer technischen Aufsicht vor Ort über die toxikologischen Studien, die bei Contract Research Organizations (CROs) in China und anderen Ländern Asiens durchgeführt werden.

• Wird als Leiter für Translationale Sicherheit für Asia Partnering fungieren und an Due-Diligence-Aktivitäten mit potenziellen chinesischen Partnern teilnehmen.

• Repräsentieren Sie Translational Safety bei Bedarf in China Governance Committees und funktionsübergreifenden Entwicklungsteams.

• Förderung wissenschaftlicher Exzellenz durch die Einbeziehung innovativer Ansätze, einschließlich der Gewichtung von Evidenz (WoE) und New Approach Methodologies (NAM), in die nichtklinische Sicherheitsbewertung.

Zuständigkeiten:

• Leitet die nichtklinische Sicherheitsbewertung von Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED) Therapeutika durch die Schaffung einer Best-Evidence-Synthese des vorhandenen Wissens und umfassende Untersuchungen der toxikologischen Aktivität, strategische Planung und Design / Implementierung / Überwachung toxikologischer Studien zur Unterstützung der Programmentwicklung.

• Wissenschaftliche Führung bei der Gestaltung und Umsetzung translationaler Sicherheitsstrategien zur Unterstützung der Programmentwicklung und Entscheidungsfindung.

• Untersuchung von Toxizitätsmechanismen.

• Proaktives Management potenzieller Sicherheitsverbindlichkeiten und Kommunikation der Auswirkungen an Teams und Governance-Ausschüsse.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Pathologen, Studienfachleuten, Pharmakokinetikern und Pharmazeutikern, um optimierte, innovative Übersetzungssicherheitsprogramme für Genentech-Drogenkandidaten zu erstellen und regulatorische Dokumente zu verfassen.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit prädiktiven Toxikologen, um NAM-Ansätze (z. B. in silico, In-vitro-Modelle) in Sicherheitsstrategien zu integrieren.

• Arbeiten Sie unabhängig, um Literatur zur Entwicklung und Optimierung von Best-Evidence-Argumenten zur Unterstützung der Dateninterpretation oder experimenteller Ansätze zu nutzen.

• Zusammenarbeit mit den Kollegen im chinesischen Innovationszentrum von Roche (CiCOR) zu nichtklinischen Sicherheitsstrategien, regulatorischen Interaktionen und CRO-Aufsicht

• Bereitstellung einer technischen Aufsicht über die Toxikologie vor Ort

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Fonction:

Nous recherchons un principal toxicologue hautement motivé et expérimenté pour assurer la direction de la sécurité translationnelle du portefeuille de développement de Genentech en Chine.

Le candidat retenu sera le responsable scientifique et réglementaire de la sécurité translationnelle en Chine, en partenariat étroit avec les collègues de la sécurité translationnelle gRED et les équipes interfonctionnelles pour appuyer les efforts de découverte et de développement de médicaments et les activités de diligence raisonnable dans tous les domaines thérapeutiques.

Cette personne fournira des orientations stratégiques pour le développement spécifique à la Chine, les interactions réglementaires et l'évaluation de la sécurité tout en assurant l'alignement sur les stratégies de développement mondial. Le rôle exige une expertise approfondie en toxicologie, en sécurité non clinique et en conception et exécution d'études PK, en conformité avec les lignes directrices internationales, en surveillance des études CRO et en évolution du paysage réglementaire en Chine, ainsi que la capacité d'influencer les fonctions, les organisations et les régions géographiques.

Portée de la position:
Le principal ou le principal toxicologue principal :

• Servir d'expert en matière de sécurité translationnelle (SME) et de réglementation chinoise pour appuyer les programmes de développement de la Chine en collaboration avec des collègues de sécurité translationnelle gRED.

• Partenaire en étroite collaboration avec les toxicologues du projet GRED pour optimiser les stratégies de sécurité pour le développement, l'enregistrement et la gestion du cycle de vie de la Chine.

• Établir des relations scientifiques productives avec les autorités de réglementation chinoises (p. ex., NMPA/CDE) et les partenaires du CRO.

• Assurer la supervision technique sur place des études toxicologiques menées par des organismes de recherche sous contrat (ORC) en Chine et dans d'autres pays d'Asie.

• Sera le chef de file en matière de sécurité translationnelle pour les partenaires asiatiques et participera aux activités de diligence raisonnable avec les partenaires potentiels de la Chine.

• Représenter la sécurité translationnelle sur les comités de gouvernance chinois et les équipes de développement interfonctionnelles au besoin.

• Favoriser l'excellence scientifique en intégrant des approches novatrices, y compris le poids des données probantes (WoE) et les méthodes de nouvelle approche (NAM), dans l'évaluation de l'innocuité non clinique.

Responsabilités :

• Dirige l'évaluation non clinique de l'innocuité des produits thérapeutiques Genentech Research and Early Development (GRED) en créant une synthèse des meilleures preuves des connaissances existantes et des enquêtes exhaustives sur les activités toxicologiques, la planification stratégique et la conception, la mise en oeuvre et la supervision d'études toxicologiques à l'appui de l'avancement du programme.

• Leadership scientifique dans la conception et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies de sécurité translationnelle pour appuyer l'avancement des programmes et la prise de décisions.

• Étudier les mécanismes de toxicité.

• Gestion proactive des responsabilités potentielles en matière de sécurité et communication des répercussions aux équipes et aux comités de gouvernance.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les pathologistes, les professionnels des opérations d'étude, les pharmacocinétiques et les pharmaciens pour créer des programmes d'innocuité de la traduction rationalisés et innovateurs pour les candidats aux médicaments Genentech et pour les documents réglementaires d'auteur.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les toxicologues prédictifs pour intégrer les approches NAM (p. ex. dans le silico, les modèles in vitro) dans les stratégies de sécurité.

• Travailler de façon indépendante pour tirer parti de la littérature pour élaborer et optimiser les arguments de la meilleure preuve à l'appui de l'interprétation des données ou des approches expérimentales.

• Partenaire avec les collègues du China Innovation Center de Roche (CiCOR) sur les stratégies de sécurité non cliniques, les interactions réglementaires et la surveillance CRO

• Assurer une surveillance technique sur place de la toxicologie

jobs.title: Senior Safety Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Our Clinical Safety organisation is dedicated to delivering meaningful improvements to patients through medically-differentiated therapies. In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability.

As a Senior Safety Director at Roche, you'll be a recognized expert and strategic leader in drug safety, driving safety strategy for our most complex molecules while building organizational capability across the Clinical Safety organization. You'll provide expert mentorship to colleagues, lead high-stakes regulatory submissions, and represent Roche's safety expertise to regulatory authorities, governance committees, and senior leadership. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic influence. This is the perfect opportunity for a safety leader ready to shape the future of drug development and drive organizational excellence.

The Opportunity:

• Takes the lead in defining, owning, progressing, and guiding the defined safety strategy for their program(s)

• Accountable for establishing and maintaining the company position on the safety profile and shaping the proactive patient risk communication and risk management strategy.

• Must provide an objective and neutral position as a safety professional, even when facing conflicting business priorities or viewpoints.

• Is the expert content reviewer for safety aspects and must be consulted for safety profile decision-making across the product lifecycle (e.g., updates to the Investigator’s brochure (IB)/safety label, Integrated Safety Management Plan/Risk Management Plan (RMP)).

• Leads the development of the safety strategy by providing input into clinical development programs, Target Product Profiles (TPPs), Integrated Evidence Plans (IEPs), health technology assessment (HTA) dossier, and launch strategies.

• Provides critical safety input to inform decision-making on clinical development plans and individual study designs. Also provides requisite oversight and expert review for safety components of regulatory authority submissions (e.g., IND, NDA, MAA).

• Influences key stakeholders (e.g., triad or cross-functional development teams, regulatory leader, medical affairs). Works closely with PCS (Portfolio Clinical Safety) to meet Clinical Safety deliverables and provide medical and scientific interpretation of emerging clinical and nonclinical safety data.

Who you are:

• Qualified healthcare professional or Life Sciences graduate and a minimum 10+ years of drug development experience in pharmaceutical or related industry, including at least 5 years in drug safety; expert-level understanding of scientific aspects of safety, pharmacovigilance, and clinical/patient risk management with demonstrable knowledge of GVP, GCP, and CTR requirements;

• 10+ years of clinical drug development experience in the biopharmaceutical industry or a related sector (e.g. academia; CRO; etc); preferably including at least 5 years of experience in a clinical drug safety-related role.

• Demonstrate expert understanding of the scientific aspects of safety, PV and clinical/patient risk management (e.g. via demonstrable knowledge of the application of GVP, GCP & CTR requirements) is essential.

• Demonstrated ability to lead and influence, with and without authority, in a global matrix envir
