descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Analyste principal des affaires réglementaires

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde.

Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration.

Diagnostics La R-D de Roche opère à travers une intersection complexe de la science, de la technologie et de la réglementation, en utilisant des systèmes d'IA, des plates-formes d'agents et des pipelines de données multimodales qui doivent simultanément être innovateurs et rigoureusement conformes. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un analyste principal des affaires réglementaires qui peut tenir les deux côtés de cette tension : traduire des cadres réglementaires denses en exigences d'ingénierie concrète, et veiller à ce que la conformité soit intégrée dans chaque plate-forme que nous construisons ou à bord, et non pas boulonnée par la suite. Dans ce rôle, vous gérerez de manière indépendante les processus d'analyse des affaires de bout en bout, en s'attaquant aux problèmes d'affaires complexes avec l'ambiguïté émergente tout en agissant comme conseiller de confiance auprès des équipes interfonctionnelles.

L'occasion :

• Portée / contenu Leadership : Gérer de façon indépendante les processus d'analyse opérationnelle de bout en bout sans orientation, résoudre les problèmes avec l'ambiguïté émergente, adapter les cadres standard, encadrer les B.A. juniors/intermédiaires et façonner de façon proactive les méthodes de travail des équipes.

• Responsabilité et résolution des problèmes : Diriger l'analyse des problèmes d'affaires complexes, effectuer des recherches approfondies sur le domaine, stimuler l'analyse des causes profondes, répondre à des besoins complets et identifier de façon proactive les écarts entre les besoins et les solutions afin de proposer des améliorations créatives.

• Gestion et organisation des intervenants : Accroître la dépendance à l'égard d'un éventail diversifié d'intervenants interfonctionnels pour agir comme conseiller de confiance; faciliter les ateliers d'harmonisation et les séances d'examen des risques dans les ministères siloés (juridiques, assurance de la qualité, génie logiciel, validation) afin d'établir des objectifs de conformité unifiés.

• Cartographie des processus et évaluation automatisée des flux de travail : Analyser, documenter et cartographier les flux de travail de R-D multimodaux (As-I vs. To-Be); collaborer avec les équipes d'ingénierie pour documenter, comprendre et traduire les modes d'échec des pipelines d'agents automatisés en évaluations de l'impact opérationnel, en veillant à ce que la logique opérationnelle et l'intégrité des données ne soient pas compromises.

• Conformité à la réglementation des plates-formes et des écosystèmes : évaluer les plates-formes de R-D, les outils logiciels et les écosystèmes nuageux par rapport aux 21 normes CFR Part 11 et GxP, en appliquant les principes ALCOA+ aux cycles de vie des données actuels et futurs tout en effectuant des analyses des lacunes sur les plates-formes logicielles internes et tierces.

• Audit Trail Design & Privacy Standards: Définir les exigences opérationnelles pour l'audit robuste et immuable des systèmes d'exécution des actions des utilisateurs et des modèles automatisés.

jobs.description:

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is seeking a strategic and collaborative ERP Product Lifecycle Management Business Partner to join the Informatics ERP Team at Roche. In this role, you will partner closely with business stakeholders across Roche Diagnostics and Roche Diabetes Care to drive digital transformation initiatives spanning Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) capabilities.
The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor between business functions and Informatics teams, ensuring that enterprise solutions align with operational, regulatory, product development, and manufacturing objectives across the Diagnostics discipline and Diabetes Care portfolio.

The Opportunity:
This role requires strong cross-functional engagement, business process expertise, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technology solutions.

Business Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement

• Serve as the primary Informatics business partner for ERP and PLM initiatives within Roche Diagnostics and Roche Diabetes Care.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders across R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Commercial, and Operations teams.

• Facilitate alignment between business strategy and enterprise technology roadmaps.

• Drive effective communication between business users, solution architects, vendors, and delivery teams.

ERP & PLM Strategy and Delivery

• Lead and support ERP and PLM transformation initiatives across Diagnostics and Diabetes Care.

• Identify opportunities for process optimization, harmonization, and digital innovation.

• Translate business requirements into functional and technical solution designs.

• Support implementation, enhancement, integration, and lifecycle management of ERP and PLM platforms.

• Participate in global PLM initiatives and projects, ensuring consistency and scalability of solutions across Roche divisions.

• Provide support for system testing, validation, and compliance in accordance with regulated industry standards (e.g., GxP).

• Troubleshoot issues, provide end-user support, and contribute to continuous improvement efforts.

• Collaborate with enterprise architecture and data governance teams to ensure scalable and compliant solutions.

Diagnostics & Diabetes Care Support

• Partner with Roche Diagnostics business units to support product development, manufacturing, and quality processes.

• Support Roche Diabetes Care initiatives involving connected devices, product traceability, regulatory compliance, and lifecycle management.

• Ensure systems and processes support global healthcare and medical device regulations.

Governance & Compliance

• Ensure ERP and PLM solutions comply with Roche quality standards, cybersecurity policies, and regulatory requirements.

• Support validation activities and documentation in regulated environments.

• Participate in governance boards, release planning, and portfolio prioritization activities.

Change Management & Continuous Improvement

• Support organizational change management activities related to ERP and PLM adoption.

• Develop and deliver stakeholder engagement and training strategies.

• Drive continuous improvement through metrics, feedback, and operational excellence practices.

Who you are:
Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related discipline.

• 10+ years of experience in ERP, PLM, or enterprise system

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a pioneer in healthcare, we are committed to driving groundbreaking science and technology that have the potential to transform the lives of patients worldwide. To enable this mission, we invest more in R&D than any other healthcare company in the world. External innovation is a cornerstone of our R&D strategy, alongside our broad internal pipeline. With the opportunities and challenges healthcare is currently facing, strong collaborations are more critical than ever before.

The Opportunity:
The Diagnostics Partnering organization drives Roche Diagnostics partnerships including R&D, technology, biomarker, digital and commercial deals of every deal type, world-wide. Currently, the Diagnostics Partnering group in Pleasanton, CA, USA has a Partnering Lead position available on the Diagnostics Partnering Strategy and Transactions team.

This opportunity may be staffed in either Pleasanton, CA or Tucson, AZ, USA (must be able to work onsite). The Diagnostics Partnering organization drives Roche Diagnostics partnerships, including R&D, technology, biomarker, digital, and commercial deals of every deal type, worldwide.

The position sources opportunities, builds and leads deal and diligence teams to evaluate opportunities and negotiates agreements to access promising partnering opportunities across our different business & customer areas.
Your responsibilities as Global Diagnostics Partnering Strategy & Transactions Lead:
WANT - Define external growth strategy

• Lead squad teams to identify strategic opportunities that align with and contribute to Roche Diagnostics strategy.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to define strategic "WANTs" and target product profiles (TPPs).

FIND - Identify and Prioritize Partnership Opportunities

• Build and maintain strong internal and external networks to source a continuous flow of high-potential partnership opportunities.

• Partner with technology and business teams to systematically screen for relevant technologies, products, companies, and digital solutions.

• Evaluate and prioritize opportunities based on strategic fit, financial feasibility, and business modeling against defined "WANTs" and TPPs.

GET - Negotiate and Secure Partnerships

• Lead the structuring and negotiation of complex agreements, including licensing, R&D, and commercial collaborations. Collaborate and co-lead M&A transactions with Group Business Development.

• Direct cross-functional due diligence to ensure opportunities align with strategic "WANTs" and TPPs.

• Prepare and present objective business recommendations to senior management and governance bodies.

MANAGE - Manage Transition

• Establish a business relationship and facilitate a seamless hand-over to Partnering Alliances & Ecosystem Management chapter members following execution of the partnership or transaction

• Have a growth mindset of continuous learning and coaching & mentoring peers

• Have the ability to navigate within a changing organization, maintaining objectivity, respect for differences of opinion, fairness, open communication and consensus-building skill

• You hold a Bachelor's degree in science, engineering, business, or a related field, preferably at a PhD, JD, or MBA level.

• A minimum of 5-7+ years of previous experience or b

Roche / GenMark Diagnostics, la mission est de révolutionner les soins aux patients en fournissant des diagnostics moléculaires multisexiques de grande valeur, simples à réaliser et cliniquement pertinents.

Roche/Genmark Diagnostics cherche un responsable de l'ingénierie logicielle, Test Automation Diagnostic Diagnostics, qui sera chargé de la conception de la prochaine génération de notre stratégie de vérification automatisée. Dans ce rôle de leadership central, vous définirez la vision de la vérification automatisée, en dirigeant à la fois la stratégie technique et le développement d'équipes pour améliorer l'efficacité du laboratoire et les résultats des patients grâce à des solutions rapides et de type échantillon à réponse.

C'est un rôle de « Player-Coach » à fort impact où vous équilibrerez le développement pratique du cadre avec la direction d'une équipe dédiée d'ingénieurs de la qualité des logiciels.

Vous dirigerez l'évolution technique de nos capacités de test pour les instruments de diagnostic réglementés par la FDA. Votre mandat est de promouvoir une culture d'automatisation – l'architecture robuste C#/.NET harnais de test, les intégrer dans les pipelines CI/CD modernes, et de guider l'équipe pour assurer des sorties haute vitesse et de haute qualité.

Responsabilités de surveillance

- Tests de matériel et d'intégration : stratégies architecturales pour les essais complexes de matériel dans la boucle (HiL) assurant des interactions logicielles sans faille avec les instruments et capteurs de diagnostic. - CI/CD & Security : partenaire avec DevOps pour intégrer des suites automatisées dans les pipelines Azure. Conduisez la sécurité "demi-gauche" en automatisant l'analyse SAST/DAST pour répondre aux lignes directrices modernes de la FDA en matière de cybersécurité. - Modernisation et outillage : Possèdez la pile technologique.

Excellence en matière de réglementation et de processus

- Partenariat réglementaire : partenariat avec les Affaires réglementaires pour valider les outils d'essai, assurer une conformité rigoureuse aux normes de l'industrie. - Validation modernisée : mise à jour des plans V et V de Master pour automatiser la production de preuves, rationaliser la conformité avec la FDA 21 CFR Part 820 et ISO 13485. - Qualité des données : suivre les paramètres clés (p. ex., densité de défauts, couverture d'automatisation) pour fournir des informations concrètes et favoriser l'amélioration continue de la qualité. - Stratégie Risque-Première : Workflows critiques pour la sécurité des champions en intégrant l'analyse des risques logiciels (FME)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Global Supply Chain division serves as the strategic architect for the organization's end-to-end Solutions Design, driving enterprise-level excellence across both internal operations and external stakeholder networks. By focusing on multi-year planning, long-term architecture, and comprehensive capability development, the department systematically bridges technical engineering data with commercial needs, global systems, and international regulatory law. Every member of this global team is dedicated to permanently optimizing processes to increase quality and efficiency standards, ensuring a resilient, compliant, and highly optimized supply chain network.
We are seeking a Global Head to lead this critical function, stepping into a high-impact role where you will spend 60-80% of your time on strategic initiatives. This position is a dynamic combination of Process Architecture, Regulatory Governance, and Systems Translation, requiring an experienced matrix leader to act as the chief architect of process integrity. Operating on a global scale with high independent decision-making authority, you will manage a responsibility split of 40% Leadership, 40% Project Lead, and 20% Individual Contributor to confidently navigate highly ambiguous, cross-functional challenges and position the organization for future readiness.
The Opportunity

• Driving organization-wide improvements in operational efficiencies, performance, and customer satisfaction is achieved through the optimized design and execution of the end-to-end supply chain.

• Designing L0, L1, and L2 future-state processes establishes the global master standards and governance necessary for enterprise-wide implementation.

• Enforcing strict compliance with global regulations, such as ISO and CFR820 guidelines, secures international operational alignment across the US, Europe, and China.

• Serving as the primary bridge between Business Owners and technical teams ensures the smooth translation of architectural process designs into functional Warehouse Management Systems.

• Leading large-scale digital and architectural projects enables the division to constructively challenge the status quo and foster entrepreneurial thinking across Hubs, Network Management, and Commercial teams.

• Negotiating the delicate balance between cost efficiency and technical innovation allows you to resolve persistent friction among Manufacturing, Commercial, and Quality functions.

• Presenting strategic alignments, portfolio health metrics, and business cases to the DIA Supply Chain Leadership Team and external industry associations like MedTech happens on a frequent basis.

Who You Are

• An academic foundation consisting of a Bachelor's degree is required, though a Master's degree, Ph.D., or MBA in Life Science, Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field is highly preferred.

• A proven track record of 8+ years of matrix leadership experience within a highly regulated environment, such as the pharmaceutical, diagnostics, or healthcare industry, is essential.

• Deep corporate familiarity across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Quality & Regulatory environments enables you to easily interpret complex regulations into actionable corporate standards.

• Demonstrated experience managing culturally diverse global teams and collaborating cross-functionally with internal stakeholders at all levels of leadership is necessary.

• Exceptional professional alignment with Roche Values, Creative Leadership, and VACC principle

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

La divisione Global Supply Chain funge da architetto strategico per il design di soluzioni end-to-end dell'organizzazione, guidando l'eccellenza a livello aziendale sia nelle operazioni interne che nelle reti di stakeholder esterni. Concentrandosi sulla pianificazione pluriennale, l'architettura a lungo termine e lo sviluppo completo delle capacità, il dipartimento collega sistematicamente i dati tecnici di ingegneria con le esigenze commerciali, sistemi globali e il diritto normativo internazionale. Ogni membro di questo team globale è dedicato all'ottimizzazione permanente dei processi per aumentare gli standard di qualità ed efficienza, garantendo una rete di supply chain resiliente, conforme e altamente ottimizzata.
Stiamo cercando un Global Head per guidare questa funzione critica, entrando in un ruolo di alto impatto dove trascorrerete il 60-80% del vostro tempo su iniziative strategiche. Questa posizione è una combinazione dinamica di Architettura di processo, Governance regolamentare e Traduzione di sistemi, che richiede un leader esperto di matrice di agire come il capo architetto di integrità di processo. Operando su scala globale con elevata autorità decisionale indipendente, gestirai una divisione di responsabilità del 40% Leadership, 40% Project Lead e 20% Individual Contributor per navigare con fiducia in sfide altamente ambigue, cross-funzionali e posizionare l'organizzazione per la prontezza futura.
L'opportunità

• Miglioramento dell'organizzazione di guida nelle efficienze operative, nelle prestazioni e nella soddisfazione del cliente si ottiene attraverso la progettazione ottimizzata e l'esecuzione della catena di fornitura end-to-end.

• Progettare L0, L1 e L2 processi futuri-stato stabilisce i principi generali globali e la governance necessari per l'implementazione a livello aziendale.

• Il rafforzamento del rispetto delle normative globali, come le linee guida ISO e CFR820, assicura l'allineamento operativo internazionale negli Stati Uniti, in Europa e in Cina.

• Servire come ponte principale tra i proprietari di aziende e i team tecnici assicura la traduzione regolare dei progetti di processo architettonico in sistemi funzionali di gestione del magazzino.

• I principali progetti digitali e architettonici su larga scala consentono alla divisione di sfidare costruttivamente lo status quo e promuovere il pensiero imprenditoriale tra i team Hub, Network Management e Commercial.

• Negoziare il delicato equilibrio tra efficienza dei costi e innovazione tecnica consente di risolvere l'attrito persistente tra le funzioni Manufacturing, Commercial e Quality.

• Presentando allineamenti strategici, metriche di salute del portafoglio e casi di business al Team DIA Supply Chain Leadership e associazioni del settore esterno come MedTech avviene frequentemente.

Chi sei

• Una fondazione accademica composta da un diploma di laurea è richiesto, anche se un master, Ph.D., o MBA in Life Science, Ingegneria, Farmacia, o un campo correlato è altamente preferito.

• È essenziale un comprovato record di 8+ anni di esperienza di leadership di matrice in un ambiente altamente regolamentato, come il settore farmaceutico, diagnostico o sanitario.

• La profonda familiarità aziendale in ambienti di produzione, Supply Chain, Procurement e Quality & Regulatory consente di interpretare facilmente le normative complesse in standard aziendali attuabili.

• È necessaria un'esperienza dimostrata nella gestione di team globali culturalmente diversi e nella collaborazione tra le parti interessate interne a tutti i livelli di leadership.

• Allineamento professionale eccezionale con valori Roche, Leadership Creativa e principio VACC

La position

La division de la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale est l'architecte stratégique de la conception de solutions de bout en bout de l'organisation, qui stimule l'excellence au niveau de l'entreprise dans les opérations internes et les réseaux d'intervenants externes. En mettant l'accent sur la planification pluriannuelle, l'architecture à long terme et le développement complet des capacités, le Ministère établit systématiquement des liens entre les données techniques et les besoins commerciaux, les systèmes mondiaux et le droit réglementaire international. Chaque membre de cette équipe mondiale se consacre à l'optimisation permanente des processus afin d'augmenter les normes de qualité et d'efficacité, en assurant un réseau de chaîne d'approvisionnement résistant, conforme et hautement optimisé.
Nous cherchons un Global Head pour diriger cette fonction essentielle, en entrant dans un rôle à fort impact où vous passerez 60-80% de votre temps sur des initiatives stratégiques. Ce poste est une combinaison dynamique d'architecture de processus, de gouvernance réglementaire et de traduction de systèmes, qui exige qu'un chef de matrice expérimenté agisse comme architecte en chef de l'intégrité des processus. En travaillant à l'échelle mondiale avec un pouvoir décisionnel indépendant élevé, vous gérerez une division des responsabilités de 40 % de leadership, de 40 % de chef de projet et de 20 % de cotisant individuel pour naviguer avec confiance dans des défis hautement ambigus et interfonctionnels et positionner l'organisation pour une préparation future.
L'opportunité

• La conception et l'exécution optimisées de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de bout en bout permettent d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle, la performance et la satisfaction des clients à l'échelle de l'organisation.

• La conception des processus futurs L0, L1 et L2 établit les normes-cadres mondiales et la gouvernance nécessaires à la mise en œuvre à l'échelle de l'entreprise.

• En veillant au strict respect des réglementations mondiales, telles que les lignes directrices ISO et CFR820, on assure l'alignement opérationnel international aux États-Unis, en Europe et en Chine.

• Servir de pont principal entre les propriétaires d'entreprise et les équipes techniques assure la traduction en douceur des conceptions de processus architecturaux en systèmes fonctionnels de gestion d'entrepôt.

• La direction de projets numériques et architecturaux à grande échelle permet à la division de défier de façon constructive le statu quo et de favoriser la pensée entrepreneuriale dans les équipes Hubs, Network Management et Commercial.

• Négocier l'équilibre délicat entre rentabilité et innovation technique vous permet de résoudre les frictions persistantes entre les fonctions de fabrication, commerciale et de qualité.

• Présenter des alignements stratégiques, des mesures de santé de portefeuille et des analyses de rentabilisation à l'équipe de leadership de la chaîne d'approvisionnement de la DIA et à des associations industrielles externes comme MedTech sur une base fréquente.

Qui vous êtes

• Une fondation académique composée d'un baccalauréat est nécessaire, bien qu'un diplôme de maîtrise, de doctorat ou de MBA en sciences de la vie, en génie, en pharmacie, ou un domaine connexe est hautement préféré.

• Une expérience éprouvée de 8 ans et plus d'expérience de leadership matriciel dans un environnement hautement réglementé, comme le secteur pharmaceutique, le diagnostic ou les soins de santé, est essentielle.

• Une connaissance approfondie de l'industrie manufacturière, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de l'approvisionnement et de la qualité et de la réglementation vous permet d'interpréter facilement des règlements complexes en normes opérationnelles.

• Une expérience démontrée de la gestion d'équipes mondiales culturellement diversifiées et de la collaboration interfonctionnelle avec les intervenants internes à tous les niveaux de leadership est nécessaire.

• Un alignement professionnel exceptionnel avec le principe Roche Values, Creative Leadership et VACC

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Head of Product Lifecycle & Launch Architecture - Supply Chain (internally called: Global Head of Supply Chain Science, Technology & Launch) in our Global Supply Chain division serves as a critical strategic engine within the organization, focused on driving cross-functional alignment across R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Commercial, and Regulatory functions. By implementing advanced design methodologies, establishing global standards, and optimizing end-to-end supply chain integration, the department breaks down functional silos to foster a transformational leadership environment. The team is dedicated to permanently optimizing processes to increase quality and efficiency standards, ensuring that long-term multi-year planning and innovative technologies position the entire organization for future readiness.

We are seeking a Global Head to step into a primarily strategic role, acting as an architect and systems thinker to shape our global supply chain strategy. This position is highly visible and impactful, with a task split dedicated to 50% Launch & Integration Orchestration, 25% Strategic Architecture, and 25% Leadership & Capability Building. Operating on a global scale, you will lead high-level project execution and empower cross-functional teams to navigate highly ambiguous, unstructured challenges, transforming complex operational hurdles into measurable business opportunities.

The Opportunity

• Driving organization-wide impact by delivering operational efficiencies through Lean design, cost savings, and successful pilot-to-commercial scaling that directly influences commercial sales results.

• Enforcing global design standards and regulatory compliance while acting as the key strategic point of contact for global launch readiness.

• Devoting 60-80% of your focus to multi-year strategic planning during the early stages of the Product Life Cycle (PLC) to challenge the status quo and introduce new technologies.

• Leading and co-owning the Global Supply Chain strategy by setting comprehensive policies, standardizing processes, establishing governance, and defining physical product requirements.

• Overseeing critical, large-scale integration projects encompassing end-to-end supply chain integration and new product commercialization across diverse regions and divisions.

• Influencing and negotiating on a daily or weekly basis with internal leaders across Manufacturing, R&D, and Finance, as well as external Logistics Service Providers and manufacturing sites.

• Managing significant conflicts between competing functional interests, such as balancing R&D’s speed with supply chain compliance, while regularly presenting investment and readiness rationales to senior leadership.

Who You Are

• An advanced degree holder, with a required Master's degree in Life Science, Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related subject, though a Ph.D. or MBA is highly preferred.

• A seasoned professional with 10+ years of leadership experience within the pharmaceutical, diagnostics, healthcare, or a similarly highly regulated industry.

• An expert in industry operations, possessing clear, hands-on experience across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Quality & Regulatory environments.

• A strategic decision-maker with deep knowledge of product development, life cycle management processes, and the Roche Diagnostics product portfolio.

• An exceptional transformational leader committed to role-modeling Roche Values, Creative Leadership, VACC principles, and

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il Global Head of Product Lifecycle & Launch Architecture - Supply Chain (internalmente chiamato: Global Head of Supply Chain Science, Technology & Launch) nella nostra divisione Global Supply Chain serve come motore strategico critico all'interno dell'organizzazione, focalizzato sulla guida allineamento interfunzionale tra le funzioni R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Commercial e Regulatory. Attraverso l'implementazione di metodologie di progettazione avanzate, la definizione di standard globali e l'ottimizzazione dell'integrazione della supply chain end-to-end, il dipartimento rompe silos funzionali per promuovere un ambiente di leadership trasformazionale. Il team è dedicato all'ottimizzazione permanente dei processi per aumentare la qualità e gli standard di efficienza, assicurando che la pianificazione pluriennale e le tecnologie innovative posizionano l'intera organizzazione per la disponibilità futura.

Stiamo cercando un Global Head di entrare in un ruolo principalmente strategico, agendo come architetto e pensatore di sistemi per modellare la nostra strategia globale della supply chain. Questa posizione è altamente visibile e di impatto, con una divisione dedicata al 50% Launch & Integration Orchestration, 25% Architettura Strategica, e 25% Leadership & Capability Building. Operando su scala globale, si porterà l'esecuzione di progetti di alto livello e consentire ai team interfunzionali di navigare sfide altamente ambigue e non strutturate, trasformando ostacoli operativi complessi in opportunità di business misurabili.

L'opportunità

• Guidare l'impatto dell'organizzazione attraverso la fornitura di efficienze operative attraverso la progettazione Lean, il risparmio di costi, e il successo di scaling pilota-to-commerciale che influenza direttamente i risultati delle vendite commerciali.

• Rafforzare gli standard globali di progettazione e la conformità alle normative, agendo come punto strategico chiave di contatto per la prontezza del lancio globale.

• Dedicando il 60-80% della vostra attenzione alla pianificazione strategica pluriennale durante le prime fasi del ciclo di vita del prodotto (PLC) per sfidare lo status quo e introdurre nuove tecnologie.

• Leader e co-finanziare la strategia Global Supply Chain impostando politiche complete, standardizzando i processi, stabilendo la governance e definendo i requisiti fisici del prodotto.

• Sovrintendere a progetti critici di integrazione su larga scala che comprendono l'integrazione della supply chain end-to-end e la nuova commercializzazione dei prodotti in diverse regioni e divisioni.

• Influenza e negoziazione su base giornaliera o settimanale con i leader interni di Manufacturing, R&D e Finance, nonché i fornitori esterni di servizi logistici e siti di produzione.

• Gestione di conflitti significativi tra interessi funzionali concorrenti, come il bilanciamento della velocità di R&D con la conformità della supply chain, presentando regolarmente razionali di investimento e disponibilità alla leadership senior.

Chi sei

• Un titolare di laurea avanzato, con un master richiesto in Life Science, Ingegneria, Farmacia, o un soggetto correlato, anche se un dottorato o MBA è altamente preferito.

• Un professionista esperto con 10+ anni di esperienza di leadership all'interno del settore farmaceutico, diagnostico, sanitario, o simile altamente regolamentato.

• Un esperto nelle operazioni del settore, che possiede un'esperienza chiara e pratica in tutti gli ambienti di produzione, supply chain, appalti e regolazione della qualità.

• Un decisore strategico con profonda conoscenza dello sviluppo del prodotto, dei processi di gestione del ciclo di vita e del portafoglio di prodotti Roche Diagnostics.

• Un leader trasformazionale eccezionale impegnato nella modellazione dei valori Roche, nella Leadership Creativa, nei principi VACC e
